77 mtshe

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lo ngo bzhi stong la nye ba'i lo rgyus ldan la/ de ni gna' bo'i bod kyi gso rig rmang gzhir byas thog rgya gar rgya nag ta zig la sogs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i nying bcud bsdu len byas nas grub pa zhig yin la/gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang zhing lag len gyi myong byang phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par bkra ba'i gso dpyad kyi rig pa zhig yin pas na/ snga mo zhig nas 'dzam gling khyab khongs kyi gso rig smra ba rnams kyis gdeng 'jog chen po gnang mus su mchis/bod kyi gso ba rig pa la gzhung dang lag len gyi bstan bcos bgrang las 'das pa zhig yod pa ste/ de ni nang don gyi thad gso rig lo rgyus dang /rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs/ nad thog lag len/ sman rdzas sdeb bzo/ lus khams bde srung la sogs rig tshan yongs su 'dus yod pa'i nor bu'i bang mdzod cig lags/ de la tang dang srid gzhung gi thugs 'khur dang brtsi mthong chen po'i 'og nye lor bod kyi gso ba rig pa rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gang legs byung yod la/ gna' gzhung gang mang zhig kyang dpe skrun 'grems spel byas zin yod/ yin na yang da dung gna' dpe mang po zhig sngar bzhin 'bus zos rul gog thebs pa'am/ yang na mi'i rtsol ba'i dbang gis gtor brlag tshabs chen thebs kyi yod pas/ gang myur sgos srung skyob ma byas tshe rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gna' dpe gang mang zhig rtsa brlag rgyun chad du 'gro nyen che/1

de la bod kyi gso ba rig pa nyid phyogs yongs nas rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gtong rgyu'i dmigs yul bcangs nas nga tshos 2002lor mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis gtso khrid byas pa'i 6 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉rtsom sgrig tshogs pa mi sgrig 'dzugs byas pa dang / gna' dpe 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig bcas kyi las sgo phye zhing dpe skrun dang 'grems spel gyi bya ba yang 'go bcoms zin yod/ dpe tshogs 'di ni snga na ma mchis pa'i rig gnas kyi las grwa chen po zhig yin la/ 'di nyid bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe yod do cog 'dus pa'i dpe tshogs sheg tu 'gyur bar byed rgyu ni nga tsho'i bsam 'dun yin la/ de ltar byed thub pa'i yid ches kyang nga tshor yod/de ltar dpe tshogs 'di thog mar dpe skrun byed pa'i sgo dang bstun nas 'dir kho bos bya bzhag chen po 'di phyogs gang thad nas bya ba lam lhong yong ba'i bkra shes smon 'dun zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin bod kyi gso ba rig pa la lhag bsam dkar ba'i yul dang phyogs so so'i skyes bu kun nas kyang las grwa 'dir phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor dang rogs 'degs byed pa'i bsam 'dun zhu rgyu yin/zhes 'o tshogs chen nas/2004lo'i zla 2par/2

mtshams spyor ba'i gtam/kha ba ri bo'i bcu phrag rig gnas zhes bya ba ni bod mi rigs kyis 'jig rtenaspyi'i phan bde gzhi mar gyur pa'i blo'i rig pa mtha' dag spyi la btags pa'i ming zhig yin la/ de las gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i gangs can gso ba rig pa ni bod mi rigs rang nyid kyis srol rgyun dar spel mdzad cing 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig yin stabs/ ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa'i las don kho na sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig tu 'khums shing spyi tshogs dang dus rabs ji 'dra zhig gi nang du'ang mkho gal dang phan thogs che ba zhig yin pa ni don dngos kyi steng nas grub pa'i gnas lugs shig yin pas mi su dang su zhig gis kyang bston 'ding dang khyog bshad bya bar mi nus so/ / rang re'i lo rgyus yig tshang dang da yod bstan bcos kyi dkar chag ltar na/ g.yung drung bon lugs kyi drang srod dpyad bu khri shes nas sman pa dung gi thor cog can bar dang / rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po nas gter ston gra ba mngon shes kyi bar/ bee ro tsa na nas lo chen rin chen bzang po'i skabs/ byang zur rnam gnyis nas kong sprul yab sras/ mi dbang sde srid rin po che nas sman rtsis mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu la thug pa'i drang srong mkhas grub rim byon bgrang gis mi langs pa rnams kyi sku drin las/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dgongs 'grel dang yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs 'grel gtso byas pa'i gso rig gi bstan bcos ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa rang gis mjal na dad pa'i 1

spu long g.yo zhing gzhan la ngom na la rgya'i spobs pa rgyas pa 'dis bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus ring la gzhung man ngag gi nang don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa ra sprod gsal po byas 'duga'on kyang mig sngar phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa mang po zhig nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags pas/ da lta'i dus 'dir bdag cag tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshong zong kho na dang yul lung bye brag pa'i khe phan nam phyogs ris can gyi lta ba sogs ring du dor nas mi rigs kyi rig gnas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di la snying khong nas sha tsha dang gces spras/ de bzhin ris su med pa'i 'dzam gling gi mi'i rigs yongs la phan du re ba'i kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung man ngag rnams la 'ol tshod dang rang bzo tsam ma yin par sngar las lhag pa'i ngang sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig byed rgyu bcas ni shin tu gal gnad che ba'i bgyi ba zhig red//de'i phyir mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa rgyud 'dzin yag po zhig dang gsar btod gong spel gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig 'dzugs thub pa'i ched du/da lta'i dus rabs dang srid jus bzang po'i go skabs dam 'dzin ngang mi dngos nor gsum gyi stobs shugs gcig tu bsgril zhing mig rgyang ring ba'i jus gzhi dang bcas te rang re'i sman rtsis skor gyi mkho gal che ba'i gna' dpe dang bstan bcos lag tu zin to chog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du bskrun pa'i dge ba 'dis/ da lta tsam ma zad 'byung 'gyur bod kyi sman rtsis bstan pa nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar bsam yul las 'das pa'i 2

spu long g.yo zhing gzhan la ngom na la rgya'i spobs pa rgyas pa 'dis bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus ring la gzhung man ngag gi nang don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa ra sprod gsal po byas 'duga'on kyang mig sngar phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang re'i gso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa mang po zhig nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags pas/ da lta'i dus 'dir bdag cag tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshong zong kho na dang yul lung bye brag pa'i khe phan nam phyogs ris can gyi lta ba sogs ring du dor nas mi rigs kyi rig gnas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di la snying khong nas sha tsha dang gces spras/ de bzhin ris su med pa'i 'dzam gling gi mi'i rigs yongs la phan du re ba'i kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i bod lugs gso rig gi gzhung man ngag rnams la 'ol tshod dang rang bzo tsam ma yin par sngar las lhag pa'i ngang sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig byed rgyu bcas ni shin tu gal gnad che ba'i bgyi ba zhig red//de'i phyir mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bod kyi sman rtsis rig pa rgyud 'dzin yag po zhig dang gsar btod gong spel gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig 'dzugs thub pa'i ched du/da lta'i dus rabs dang srid jus bzang po'i go skabs dam 'dzin ngang mi dngos nor gsum gyi stobs shugs gcig tu bsgril zhing mig rgyang ring ba'i jus gzhi dang bcas te rang re'i sman rtsis skor gyi mkho gal che ba'i gna' dpe dang bstan bcos lag tu zin to chog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du bskrun pa'i dge ba 'dis/ da lta tsam ma zad 'byung 'gyur bod kyi sman rtsis bstan pa nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar bsam yul las 'das pa'i 2

nus pa thon thub cing lus can kun gyi srog 'tsho'i dpal du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas na/ 'o skol thun mong gis rjes su yi rang zhu 'os pa'i las don gal chen zhig red ces ha cang dga' tshor dang bcas mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig tu/khro ru tshe rnam gyis/spyi lo 2002lo'i zla 11tshes 1nyin la/3

dag sgrig pa'i gsal bshad/bod zal mo sgang ba zhes su grags pa 'dzam gling gi yang steng du gnas pa'i mi rigs nyid la gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i sngon byon dran dbang dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ dam pa'i chos kyis gtsos pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyis yongs su phyug pa'i shes rig bang mdzod ni srid pa'i mthar yang nub pa med pa zhig mchis pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med do// de las gnas bcu'i ya gyal gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi thabs mchog dam par gyur pa'i bod kyi gso ba rig pa ni/ rje g.yu thog chen pos/ mi na bar gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gas gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rig pa zhig ste/ der lo rgyus kyi dus yun ha cang ring zhing gzhung lugs kyi ma lag cha tshang yin pa ma zad/ sman dpyad kyi rigs lam khyad du 'phags shing man ngag nyams myong phun sum tshogs shing gya rnam pa zhig mchis stabs/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu tshan rig pa mkhas can dag gis phyogs yongs nas slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gi gom stabs mgyogs len byed bzhin pa dang / rang re'i rgyal khab nas kyang tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'khyol dang nub rgyud gsar spel byed pa'i 'gros dang bstun nas bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i las don nyid sgo kun nas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel gnang ste nyams dga'i yul khams shig tu bskyal yod/ 'on kyang phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen du ma'i dbang gis rang 1

re'igaso rig thad kyi gzhung man ngag gi gdams pa gang mang nyams nyes su gyur dang 'gyur mus yin pa'ang nga chos mig mthong lag zin du 'khums shing /bod kyi gso rig 'di nyid gna' bo'i rig gnas shig yin pa'i ngos nas zhu na/ri rgyal lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i gzhung man ngag gi gsung rab de rnams sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas sngog 'don myur skyob dang 'tshol sdud legs sgrig bcas byed rgyu ni thog mar bsgrub dgos pa'i rmang gzhi'i las ka gal chen zhig ste 'o skol tshe rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi phrag la rang bzhin gyis babs pa'i dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri zhig lags/ de'i phyir nga tshos lo rgyus kyi las 'gan dang dus rabs kyi blang bya ltar mdo dbus mtho sgang zhes pa'i thun min khor yug khrod du 'phel rgyas byung ba'i gna' bo'i gso dpyad rig pa 'di'i srog dbugs rgyun bsrings byed cing / bod kyi gso dpyad rig par sbyang brtson dang zhib 'jug byed par spro ba brtas pa'i rnam dpyod can mang por rgyu cha mkho sprod kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa/ rang lugs kyi gzhung rkang 'dzin pa la sngar bas sman thogs thub pa/ nyam thag nad pa'i lus srog la gzir ba'i nad rigs rtsa med du 'joms par nus pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgyab rten dang man ngag zab mo'i gdams pa tshig thub kyi skor mang du btsal nas nad kyi sdug bsngal las skyob par rngo thogs pa bcas mdor na gangs can gso ba rig pa 'di nyid ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'dzin legs po zhig byed pa'i ched du/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang gis 'brel yod ched mkhas mi sna rtsa 'dzugs dang gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe dag sgrig gi mi sna ched bskos byas te/ lo rgyus yig cha dang / gzhung lugs bstan bcos/ man ngag lag len/ sman sbyor myong byang / sngo sman 'khrungs dpe/gnam rig skar rtsis sogs kyi dpe rgyun dkon po'i rigs gtso bor bzung thog 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉zhes pa 2

'di rtsom sgrig byas pa yin zhing / dpe skrun thad dpe deb re re ba'in mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyi snga phyi dang nang don la ma bltos par lag len du 'khyol gang thub byas te dpe rnying lag tu son no cog dag sgrig dang dpe skrun 'grems spel bya rgyu yin/ de la lcags ri rig byed gling gi shing dpar zhig gzhir byas nas dag bsgrigs byas pa'i 〈g.yu thog snying thig〉zhes bya ba 'di ni 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉nang gses kyi deb zhe gsum pa yin la/ deb 'di ni sum ston ye shes gzangs dang / zar mkhar mnyam ——— —————— 1ste/ /che/ ra//lha ——— ra pa(11 the:rdonyid rdo rje/ 'jam dpal ba gas rgya ma / kong sprul na tan rgya ma /kurma 'jigs med chos kyi seng ge sogs kyi zin bris dang / gzhung 'grel/kha skong dang / lhan thabs sogs las grub cing / 'di'i nang g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub dang / las byang / sman sgrub/ dbang chog rab gnas/sbyin sreg bsnyen yig sogs nyams len zin bris kyi skor dang / lhag par du snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo g.yu thog snying thig sogs lha rje yongs la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung dang nyams len kyi skor gsal bor bstan yod/de yang dpe tshogs 'di nyid dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig byed pa'i rtsa 'dzin 'di lta yin te/ 1 yi ge nor ba dang dogs gzhi can rnams la ming tshig gang de'i rjes su rtags/ka'adi'i nang dag bcos byas yod/ 2 gzhung tshig chad par 'dod pa rnams rtags ()'di'i nang du kha skong byas yod/ 2 tsom pa po'i mchan rnams gzhung dngos kyi yig gzugs las chung tsam byas nas bkod yod/ 4 ma yig mi gsal ba'am gzhung tshig chad pa rnams la kha skong byed ma nus pa rtags 'dis mtshon par byas yod la gug rtags 〈 〉'di'i nang du ma yig gi shog grangs sam thig phreng ci tsam zhig chad yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/ 5 rgya tsha dang rgyam tsha sogs tshwa sna'i rigs rnazlos

'di rtsom sgrig byas pa yin zhing / dpe skrun thad dpe deb re re ba'in mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyi snga phyi dang nang don la ma bltos par lag len du 'khyol gang thub byas te dpe rnying lag tu son no cog dag sgrig dang dpe skrun 'grems spel bya rgyu yin/ de la lcags ri rig byed gling gi shing dpar zhig gzhir byas nas dag bsgrigs byas pa'i 〈g.yu thog snying thig〉zhes bya ba 'di ni 〈bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gna' dpe phyogs bsgrigs dpe tshogs 〉nang gses kyi deb zhe gsum pa yin la/ deb 'di ni sum ston ye shes gzangs dang / zar mkhar mnyam ——— —————— 1ste/ /che/ ra//lha ——— ra pa(11 the:rdonyid rdo rje/ 'jam dpal ba gas rgya ma / kong sprul na tan rgya ma /kurma 'jigs med chos kyi seng ge sogs kyi zin bris dang / gzhung 'grel/kha skong dang / lhan thabs sogs las grub cing / 'di'i nang g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub dang / las byang / sman sgrub/ dbang chog rab gnas/sbyin sreg bsnyen yig sogs nyams len zin bris kyi skor dang / lhag par du snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo g.yu thog snying thig sogs lha rje yongs la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung dang nyams len kyi skor gsal bor bstan yod/de yang dpe tshogs 'di nyid dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig byed pa'i rtsa 'dzin 'di lta yin te/ 1 yi ge nor ba dang dogs gzhi can rnams la ming tshig gang de'i rjes su rtags/ka'adi'i nang dag bcos byas yod/ 2 gzhung tshig chad par 'dod pa rnams rtags ()'di'i nang du kha skong byas yod/ 2 tsom pa po'i mchan rnams gzhung dngos kyi yig gzugs las chung tsam byas nas bkod yod/ 4 ma yig mi gsal ba'am gzhung tshig chad pa rnams la kha skong byed ma nus pa rtags 'dis mtshon par byas yod la gug rtags 〈 〉'di'i nang du ma yig gi shog grangs sam thig phreng ci tsam zhig chad yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/ 5 rgya tsha dang rgyam tsha sogs tshwa sna'i rigs rnazlos

dag yig mkhas pa'i kha rgyan ltar te/ sog tsha dang rgya tsha zhes tshig grogs dang bsdeb na wa btags mi 'dogs shing / sog po'i tshwa dang rgya mtsho'i tshwa zhes pa'am tshwa ming rkyang pa'i skabs su wa btags 'dogs zhes pa ltar sbyar yod/lan tshwa zhes pa ni bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i dpe gzhung mang che bar bstun nas dmigs bsal du wa zur sbyar nas bkod yod/'dir nga tsho dag sgrig mi sna'i shes bya'i chu tshad dman zhing dpe rnying dag sgrig gi nyams myong zhan pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs 'gal 'khrul gyi cha gang mang yodasrid pa la rgya che klog pa po rnams kyis dgongs 'char lhugs par gnang bar bka' drin che zhu'o//mtsho sngon zhing chen bod kyi gso rig zhib 'jug khang cas /kye bas 4de /sna pe/phyo da wa :sprosnan na zuje /skye ka/spyo ka zudathag( da ga ba ga pa gna' da bsdus ba1 gas da —sa〉 ma — gas pa spyi lo 2006lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 1nyin/4

dkar chagartsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ 1lcags ri grwa tshang gi 'dus tshogs su thog ma'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa bzhugs so// 1g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 3g.yu thog snying thig gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs so//8'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rgyun khyer snying por dril ba bzhugs so//11g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 14rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 31g.yu thog snying thig gi da'ang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam par rgyal lo// 57rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 104g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 133byin rlabs bla sgrub las rtsa ba gsum gyi mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba 1

dkar chagartsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ 1lcags ri grwa tshang gi 'dus tshogs su thog ma'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa bzhugs so// 1g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 3g.yu thog snying thig gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs so//8'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rgyun khyer snying por dril ba bzhugs so//11g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 14rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 31g.yu thog snying thig gi da'ang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam par rgyal lo// 57rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 104g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 133byin rlabs bla sgrub las rtsa ba gsum gyi mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba 1

bzhugs so// 147chos skyong gi gsol kha myur mgyogs glog gi 'od 'bar bzhugs so// 152g.yu thog rtsa gsum dang 'brel ba'i tshogs glu rdo rje'i tshig gi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 155rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 158dpal lha dang / tshe ring mched lnga/ bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs la mchod gtor 'bul tshul bzhugs so// 164tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 171lha mo'i bstod pa sems nyid 'phrin las ma/ 194gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 196g.yu thog snying thig gi gtor ma'i dpe'u ris bzhugs so// 218g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi bzhugs so// 223dang po/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ye shes me long 223gnyis pa/ g.yu thog snying thig gi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bsod nams ngo bo 229gsum pa/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dbang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ 235bzhi pa/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg rta rngam 'bar ba 2402

rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul rnam par bshad pa sku gsum zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 248byin rlabs bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od phyi nang gsang gsum nyams su len pa'i zin bris bklags chog tu bkod pa yon tan 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 296g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 348g.yu thog snying thig las byin rlabs bla ma sgrub pa'i chos skor sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od zhes bya ba bzhugs so 359g.yu thog snying thig byin rlabs bla sgrub las kha byang bzhugs so//359ku g.yu thog snying thig las byin rlabs bla ma sgrub pa'i chos skor sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od ces pa'i thog mar lo rgyus dge ba'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 361kha/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dbang chog bde chen klong yangs zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so// 390ga g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub kyi don dbang mdor bsdus bzhugs so// 413nga / g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub kyi dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya mdud bzhugs so// 416ca/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya mdud las zhal gdams gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so// 4193

cha/ g.yu thog snying thig zab mo bla sgrub las phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// 422ja/ g.yu thog snying thig bla ma nang sgrub dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so// 430nya/ g.yu thog snying thig zab mo bla sgrub las gsang sgrub skal ldan myur 'dren bzhugs so// 435ta/ g.yu thog snying thig bla ma dril sgrub ye shes 'khor lo bzhugs so// 442tha/ zab mo bla sgrub las mkha' 'gro myur mgyogs bzhugs so//444da/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub mkha' 'gro myur mgyogs bzhugs so// 449na/ byin rlabs bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od las rigs lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa bzhugs so// 450pa/ g.yu thog snying thig gi bla ma nang sgrub kyi zhal gdams dngos grub kyi rdzing bu bzhugs so// 451pha/ g.yu thog snying thig gi bla ma gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdams mchog gi bde lam bzhugs so// 453pha/ khros ma'i gsang sgrub bzhugs so// 454ba/ byin rlabs bla ma sman rgyal gyi sgrub thabs las grub chen mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud gsang sgrub bzhugs so// 455ma/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi phyi gtor bsngos pa kun tshim bzhugs so// 4594

cha/ g.yu thog snying thig zab mo bla sgrub las phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// 422ja/ g.yu thog snying thig bla ma nang sgrub dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so// 430nya/ g.yu thog snying thig zab mo bla sgrub las gsang sgrub skal ldan myur 'dren bzhugs so// 435ta/ g.yu thog snying thig bla ma dril sgrub ye shes 'khor lo bzhugs so// 442tha/ zab mo bla sgrub las mkha' 'gro myur mgyogs bzhugs so//444da/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub mkha' 'gro myur mgyogs bzhugs so// 449na/ byin rlabs bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od las rigs lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa bzhugs so// 450pa/ g.yu thog snying thig gi bla ma nang sgrub kyi zhal gdams dngos grub kyi rdzing bu bzhugs so// 451pha/ g.yu thog snying thig gi bla ma gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdams mchog gi bde lam bzhugs so// 453pha/ khros ma'i gsang sgrub bzhugs so// 454ba/ byin rlabs bla ma sman rgyal gyi sgrub thabs las grub chen mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud gsang sgrub bzhugs so// 455ma/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi phyi gtor bsngos pa kun tshim bzhugs so// 4594

tsa/ bla ma sman rgyal gyi sgrub thabs las gzhung dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas las phyi gtor bsngos pa kun tshim sman mchod dang gtor ma'i lhan thabs tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs las byang ma bu don sdebs bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so// 461tsa/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bdud rtsi sman mchod lhan thabs bzhugs so// 476tsa/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi gtor ma'i lhan thabs tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs bzhugs so// 477tsha/ byin rlabs bla sgrub las rtsa ba gsum gyi mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba bzhugs so// 479dza/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi rdzogs rim sku gsum rang shar bzhugs so// 483wa/ bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel gyi 'khrul 'khor gyi rtsa tshig bzhugs so// 512zha/ g.yu thog snying thig byin rlabs bla sgrub kyi chos skor las ngo sprod 'khor 'das rang grol chen mo bzhugs so//515za/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gegs sel bzhugs so// 526'a/ byin rlabs bla sgrub las gsang ba bar chad bdud kyi gegs sel bzhugs so// 571ya/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi lam rtags gsal byed nor bu'i sgron me bzhugs so// 5725

ra/ bla sgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 584ra/ g.yu thog snying thig gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 586la/ byin rlabs bla sgrub las nyams len rgyun khyer bzhugs so// 588sha g.yu thog snying thig gi gtor mchod 'bul ba bzhugs so// 591sa/ gang sku gsang chen ma bzhugs so// 593ha/ byin rlabs bla sgrub las/ tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'joms kyi sgrub pa bzhugs so// 594a/ g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub kyi tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'joms bzhugs so// 596gi g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg las kun myur 'grub bzhugs so// 601khu/ byin rlabs bla sgrub kyi las tshogs las/ srung 'khor 'jigs pa kun skyob bzhugs so// 605ge g.yu thog snying thig las lha sman gyi pra sgrub dngul dkar me long bzhugs so// 607ngo / byin rlabs bla sgrub las lha sman gyi rjes gnang ma la bu 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 614ci/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi las tshogs/ lha sman rgab 'dre mnan thabs mthu stobs gser gyi ri bo bzhugs so// 617chu/ dngul bre las drang srong ser skya'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 619je/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi drang srong pra sgrub 6

yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// 624nyo/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 630ti/ dam can sde dgu'i mdangs bskang dregs pa tshar gcod bzhugs so// 633thu/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bka' srung sde dgu'i mchod bstod bskul gsum spu gri dug ngar bzhugs so// 637thu/ byin rlabs bla sgrub las dam can sde dgu'i sgrub thabs drag po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dgra srog dmar 'byin bzhugs so 643de/ chos skyong gi gsol kha myur mgyogs glog gi 'od 'bar bzhugs so// 651no/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can sde dgu'i sngags byang srog gi thig le bzhugs so// 654g.yu thog snying thig gi rdzogs rim nye brgyud gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 656dam chos sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyi cha lag ku su lu'i tshogs gsog bzhugs so// 6577

rtsom pa po ngo spyod mdon bsdus/g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po ni gtsang nyang stod kyi sgo bzhi re thang zhes pa'i yul grur yab g.yu thog khyung bo rdo rje dang yum padma 'od ldan gnyis kyi sras su dge legs kyi mtshan ma dang bcas rab byung gnyis pa'i me rta (spyi lo 1126)lor sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas rtsa chu'i brtag pa dang sman ngos 'dzin gyi mdzad pa sogs bag chags bzang po lus la lhan skyes su ldan pa dang / dgung lo brgyad nas rig gnas spyi dang khyad par gso rig gzhung lugs la gsan sbyang mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gnyis kyi skabs su mang mkhar tsha lung pa rog ston dkon cog skyabs sgo bzhi re thang du byon dus rgyas pa 'bum dang / rta sga srab bcas 'bul ba gya noms pa phul te dpal ldan rgyud bzhi rdzogs par zhus nas re zhig chig brgyud kyi bka' rgya ma bkrol bar rang gi zab bzhes su mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad nas rgya gar du lan drug la phyin nas sirgyu la dang gser gling tshun chad la phebs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bstan pa bsam las 'das shing brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa bzhin gzigs te/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur thugs thog nas 'chad pa dang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan du paṇa chen brgya phrag du ma'i tshogs dpon mdzad/ yan lag brgyad pa dang zla zer/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung sogs la sbyang ba mdzad nas rig pa'i mnga' rnyed/ nyid kyi gsung las kyang / rgyal ba'i bka' mchog yan lag brgyad pa dang // klu sgrub gzhung dang zla zer dkar nag dang // drang srong lugs dang pha rol gzhung rnams dang // rgya gar rgya nag mkhas pa'i gzhung rnams dang // bod dang mi yul sman pa'i nyams 1

myong dang // mkha' 'gro'i lung dang bu slob bsod nams kyis// rgya che'i gzhung dang bla ma mang bsten nas// skye ba sngon du rang rgyud sbyangs pa las// da lta g.yu thog rig pa kho na shar// zhes gsungs pa dang / de nas phyi rabs rnams kyi don du/ thugs ka chos kyi 'khor lo las// gso dpyad rin chen gter byungs te// phyi rabs rjes 'jug gso ba'i phyir// zhes gsungs te sman gzhung mang po thugs rtsom gnang / de'i nang brgyad pa che chung gi snying po bsdus pa dang dpa' bo'i snying po bsdus pa'i mdo gnas kyi 'grel pa mthong ba'i me long / rtsa dpyad rig pa rang gsal sde tshan lnga pa/ rgyud chung bdud rtsi snying po/ shog dril skor gsum/ rgyud bzhi yi 'chad thabs su cha lag bcu gsum mam bco brgyad du grags pa khog 'bugs khyung chen lding ba dang / stong thun mdzes pa'i 'ja' ris/ sa dpyad stag mo'i rngam thabs/ ṭīkka mun sel sgron me/ 'grel pa 'bum chung gsal sgron/ rtsod bzlog gegs sel 'khor lo/skor tshoms stong thun bcu gcig ming don brda sprod rnam lnga/ lag len rin chen gter spungs/ kha 'thor rin chen spungs pa/ lag len dmar khrid yig chung / med thabs med pa rnam gsum/ gab pa bco brgyad/ zab pa rnam gsum/ mkhas khyad ngo mtshar bzhi sprugs/ rgyud chung bdud rtsi snying po/ gso dpyad mu tig phreng ba/ phan bya sngags 'bum dkar po bcas rnams yod pa las/ skor tshoms stong thun bcu gcig dang / lag len dmar khrid yig chung / gab pa bco brgyad/ med thabs med pa rnam gsum/ kha thor rin chen spungs pa/ khyad par zab pa rnam gsum/ mkhas khyad ngo mtshar bzhi sprugs/ bdud rtsi snying po/ mu tig phreng ba rnams g.yu thog pa rang gi gsung yin par phal che bas bzhed pa dang /gzhan dag rnams rdza ye shes gzungs dang / shag ram pa nyi ma dpal/ 'bal sman/ brang ti/ rog ston dkon cog skyabs sogs kyis bcoms/ de min ṭīkka mun sel sgron me/ ming don 2

brda sprod rnam lnga sogs bee ro tsa nas mdzad zhes zer/ gzhan yang sngo 'bum chen mo dang man ngag snying po dril ba 'bum khu tshur/ thor bu me len/ deb chings skyogs kyi dpe ris/ byang khog gi rtsa pra/ smug po gso ba chu rgyun gyi gdams pa/ lag len pod chung / chu'i 'khor lo dang pra gsal ba'i me long /bu don ma/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gegs sel/ dug nad zhi ba/ mo nad bcos thabs yig sna bcu bzhi pa/ gzer sman gnyen po lnga sbyor/ sman pa'i bya ba mdor bsdus sogs sman gzhung mang po bcoms par mdzad/ khyad par dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di nyid gso dpyad kun gyi yang rtser gzigs nas phyi rabs kyi don du bka' rgya bkrol te lus can kun gyi spyi nor du spel nas rtsa rgyud kyi le'u grangs dang / bshad rgyud du sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po'i dgongs pa rtsa chu'i brtag pa dang ma bu dgra grogs/ ja dkar yol la sogs dang /man rgyud du'ang don gong mtshungs kyi bsnan kha dang zhus legs par mdzad pa dang / bu'i don du gser mchan dang / slob ma'i ngor zong mchan zhes pa btab ste skal ldan gyi thugs sras sogs la bum pa gang 'jo'i tshul du bstsal/mdor na mchog nyid kyis sku tshe hril bor sman dpyad kyi las don mdzad de/rig gzhung dang nad bcos sman sbyor gyi cho ga sngar las bla lhag gi dar spel dang / slob rgyud grangs las 'das pa gso skyong gnang ste/ gangs can yul du gso dpyad kyi bstan pa'i sgron me ches cher spel mthar dgung lo don drug la gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus so//sum ston ye shes gzungs ni dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang sne mi'i mda' sum pa nas sku 'khrungs/ gzhon dus nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa gnang ba dang /khyad par du rje g.yu thog gsar ma'i rnam thar gsan pas khong gi thugs la dad gus tshad med cig 'khrungs nas g.yu thog pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas mi lo 3

bcu gnyis kyi ring la mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog zhus pas rgyud rgyal bdud rtsi snying po gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces pa sum ston ye shes gzungs ma gtogs su la yang ma spel bas thugs kyi sras mchog dam par gyur/ de'i skor bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od las/ phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba g.yu thog pa'i spyan sngar/ rje de nyid kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba ru mtshams su skyes pa'i sum ston ye shes gzungs bdag gis sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas lo grangs du mar zhabs la gtugs shing mnyes pa rnam gsum gyis dgyes par byas pa la brten gzhung dang gdams pa'i zab bcud bka' lung phyag len lhag ma med par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du pha phogs su phogs/ 'phyugs gol med pa'i zab gnad mtha' dag ni bstan/ nyams 'khrid zab mo'i rgya bor nas bton/ thugs kyi sras dam par ni dbang bskur/ mtshungs pa med pa'i rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dngos su kha tshig tsam ma yin par zhe thag pa nas thag chod cing de'i byin rlabs kyis bdag gis kyang stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i gnas lugs thun mong ma yin pa phyin ci ma log pa'i lta ba zab cing phra ba yang ji lta ba bzhin bde blag tu rtogs pas/rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yang dag par bsgrigs/ khyad par du yang gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa'i bka' gtad ni kho bo gcig pu las gzhan du ma gnang zhing / kho bo la brgyud pa gang thub tshad ni 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro don btsan sa zin nas/ gso ba rig pas sems can la phan pa gzhan don bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / brjod kyis mi langs pa byed par 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan yang dgyes par mdzad pa yin 4

la/ zhes dang / sku lnga lhun grub ma las/ kho bo ru mtshams sum pa'i bu/ dzā na dha ra bdag 'dra yis// dpon khong gi snyan pa rgyang nas thos/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mos pa skyes// lam dka' ba spyad nas spyan sngar phyin/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyis byin rlabs phog/ longs spyod 'bul nor mi che yang // pha zhing rta ru btsongs nas phul/ lus kyis zhabs tog ma grub kyang // bla mas ci gsungs bka' ma bcag/ tshig don dpyod kham mi che yang // g.yel 'khrul med par lo gsum bslabs// rgya phyed snyan grong sdod dus su// gdams pa'i rtsa ba ma chad kyang // lan cig smon lam thugs rje yis// gso ba rig pa'i rgyud 'di gnang // chad lhag med pa'i dbu snyung bzhes// drang srong brgyud pa'i byin rlabs mdzad// chig brgyud rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir// da res khyed la gtad pa yin// da yang mi spel gter du sbed// mched grogs gzhan gyis ma mthong bar// phag tu yig chung zin bris thob// lo skor gcig tu gsang thub kyis// de yis dngos grub thob bo gsungs// gsungs pa bzhin du lag len byas// res 'ga' ri bo'i rtse la bris// res 'ga' grog po'i phugs su bris//res 'ga' shing gseb rtsig phag bris// de nas lo grangs bcu gsum na//gnam lo rgyal po rta lo la// g.yas ru dpal skor lha khang du// phyi mo zin bris dpe la bshus// sngon chad thos tshor mthong ba med// da ni mkha' la nyi shar bzhin// 'gro ba'i dpal du shar bar shog/ mkhas pa g.yu thog mgon po de//rig pa'i ye shes lags pa 'dra// dngos rang yid las skyes sam snyam// tshe rabs kyi bla ma yin par nges// bsam gyin sku drin che ba'i phyir// mi brjed dus gsum gtsug tu 'khur// rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// dpon khong la bu slob grangs mang yang // sku tshe'i stod la grags pa de// rtsis mda' byang sman dpe le yin// che 'gran dpon la byed byed nas// gdams pa 'di yi cod ma chod// deng sang grags pa ci la byed// sku tshe bar du grags pa de//5

khams kyi ston pa a tshes yin// brgyad pa'i rtsa 'grel bsgrigs bsgrigs nas//gdams pa 'di yi rtsad ma chod// deng sang gzhung bshad gang la byid// sku tshe'i smad du grags pa de// nub kyi dge bshes rog chung yin// rigs brgyud che sa 'dzin 'dzin nas// gdams pa 'di yi cod ma chod// deng sang 'khor rnams ci yis skyong // thog mar dus med bsgril ba yis// sras po gnyis dang mag pa gnyis// dpon slob goms 'dris 'khyer 'khyer nas// gdams pa 'di yis cod ma chod// deng sang bu slob ci yis skyong // phyogs nas byon pa'i bu slob rnams// la la sdig thog sna re slob// la la snang tshad gces par 'dzin// la la cod gcod nan zhus byed// la la byung tshad yig sna sgrub// la la zong med stong log byed// la la lag len bltas nas 'gro// la la gzhas dang dgod 'phyo byed// la la don med ldong ldang byed// gdams pa 'di yi rtsad ma chod// khong deng sang nad pa ci yis skyong // mkhas pa g.yu thog mgon po yi// gdams pa thob pa a bo tsam// g.yu thog bka' babs bdag la babs// 'tsho byed gzhon nu byon lags kyang // sman dpyad zhu rgyu med dam snyam// bdag snyan grags bsod nams mi dgos te// bla ma drang srong dngos dang mjal// gdams ngag mi che'i ka thabs med// zhes gsungs so// rje 'dis sku tshe gang bor gdul bya'i 'phrin las dpag tu med pa mdzad pa'i slob ma gtso bo ni gzhon nu ye shes yin te/ sku lnga lhun grub ma las/ rig pa'i ye shes g.yu thog mgon po lags// yid las skyes ni slob dpon lha rje lags//dngos rang 'tsho byed gzhon nu ye shes lags// tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i slob dpon lags// bla ma'i thugs rjes kho bo zin pa lags// snod ldan bdag la bla ma bka' drin che// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de dang zhor du g.yu thog pa'i rnam thar bka' rgya ma'am sku lnga lhun grub ma dang / gsang ba'i rnam thar/ bshad rgyud kyi 'grel ba 'bum nag gsal sgron/ rkang 'bam gso ba 6

snyan brgyud zin bris sogs mdzad de/ sku tshe hril bor dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs so//karma 'jigs med chos kyi seṅge'am gzhan phan 'od zer gyi yab yum gyi mtshan dang 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshigs sogs zhib tu ma rnyed kyang / snying thig las rigs 'dus bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg 'di nyid/ rab tshes sa byi lor gzhungs mchog nas par gzhi gsar bskrun mdzad skabs par byang smon tshig tu chos kyi seng gis so// zhes pa la gzhigs na dus rabs nyi shu'i dus 'gor chab mdo sakhul nas 'khrungs/ tsha ba lo tsā'am skyabs mchog rin chen phun tshogs kyi zhabs pad yun du bsten nas phyi nang rig gnas mtha' dag la dbyis phyin par slob gnyer dang / khyad par sman dpyad skor gyi sku yon gsan yul gtso bo rgyud bzhi gsol 'debs nang 'khod pa ltar gso rig mnga' bdag phun tshogs yon tan zhal snga nas gsan pas/ dharma seng ge mchog rjes 'dzin rig pa dang / g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang lung 'khrid gsum sogs gang gi thad nas byin rlabs dpal gyis brjid pa dang/ mthong ba brgyud pa'i zhal shes man ngag gang cir gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i skyes chen dam pa zhig tu gyur/ de bas phyogs mtshungs rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / srid skyong de mo ho thog thu rnam gnyis nas gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi rgyun 'dzugs mdzad skabs bla sman u rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho nas lhag bsam dag pas yang yang bskul ma mdzad pa'i ngor rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las sman sgrub drang srong dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba dang /rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i rnam par bshad pa sku gsum zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas zhes pa bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams dang / oṃ ḍi ya na'i mkhan po slob dpon pad ma rgyal po/g.yu thog rang gzhung / gter chen ratna gling ba/ pad gling kun mkhyen gnyis 7

pa rnams kyi gsung rnams gzhir bzhag gi chog sgrig mdzad/ de min da dung g.yu thog snying thig gi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho dang / las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg g.yu thog snying thig gi rdzogs rim nye brgyud gsol 'debs/ dam chos sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyi cha lag ku su lu'i tshogs gsog sogs gsar du ljags rtsom gnang ba sogs kyis lcags po rir tshe yi rig byed dang / g.yu thog snying thug gi nyams len thun mong ma yin pa ma nyams gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i khar/ nya stong dus tshes skabs 'dus tshogs yongs kyis g.yu thog snying thig gi cho ga phyag len rnam par dag pa sbyor dngos rjes gtsang gi sgo nas gnang ba'i srol btsugs/ lhag tu zug rngu'i tshor bas drag tu gdung ba'i 'gro ba mtha' dag bde ba'i dpal la 'god phyir gzhang sa mchog nas thugs rje tshad med pa'i 'jug pa zab mos rgyud chen rnam bzhis mtshon man ngag nyams yig skor dang / rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i thugs kyi ti la ka g.yu thog snying thig gso ba rig pa'i rgyud 'grel thams cad kyi rab dang phul du gyur ba'i bstan bcos bee sngon sogs rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa byi lor par gzhi gsar skrun mdzad skabs zhus dag dang / dpe tshan mang po'i mjug tu par byang mdzad zhes 'dug de dang zhor du gsung skyes slob ma du ma'i nang nas zhi byed gcod kyi 'gro don skyong mkhan shugs gseb lo chen rin po che dang / zhi khro'i cho ga phyag len gyi 'gro don skyong mkhan bla ma ngag dbang / tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa bla ma 'jigs med 'phrin las/ sman rtsis rig gnas kyi 'gro don skyong mkhan rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gzhan yang gso rig bstan pa yar rgyas dang /g.yu thog snying thig gi snod ldan slob ma bla sman u rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/sbyin bdag dang zhal slob yin pa rag kha shar bka' blon dam pa sogs mang po bskyangs par grags/ dharma seng ge sku tshe ji tsam bzhugs pa'i yig cha ra ma rnyed rung / g.yu thog snying thig gi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho'i mjug tu/8

rmongs pa rgan po chos kyi seng ge zhes 'bri gnang mdzad par bltas na phal cher dgung lo mthon por bzhugs yod snyam/de min da dung gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po rgyal dbang lnga pa chen mo dang /zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho sogs kyi ngo sprod mdor bsdus 'dir yig tshogs mang bar dogs nas ma spros so//

rmongs pa rgan po chos kyi seng ge zhes 'bri gnang mdzad par bltas na phal cher dgung lo mthon por bzhugs yod snyam/de min da dung gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po rgyal dbang lnga pa chen mo dang /zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho sogs kyi ngo sprod mdor bsdus 'dir yig tshogs mang bar dogs nas ma spros so//

1༄7// lcags ri grwa tshang gi 'dus chogs su thog ma'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa bzhugs so//dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying gar padmo'i steng bzhugs la// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// lan gcig/ 7dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs// dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs//bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag/ gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha ba// blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lan gsum/ 7dus gsum skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// sna tshogs chos kyi dbyings nyid sgrogs pa'i gsung // mkhyen brtse nas pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs thugs// bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs//lan gsum/ 7bdud dpung 'joms mdzad sprug nag khro bo'i sku// lta ba'i gdeng ldan brtul zhugs spyod pa skyong // o rgyan thugs kyi skyes mchog sprul pa'i sku// thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lan gsum/ 7rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par dag pa las thon pa'i// lha mo gang gi sprul pas nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo//lan gcig i pi sha tse pa ṇa sha wa ri sarba dzwa la pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ sngags lan bdun/7gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang // 'jigs pa kun las myur du skyob byed cing // dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// lan gcig i ma ri sgyu paṃ swāhā// sngags lan bdun/

7dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// na ma ñtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha ya/hū lu hū lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ brnyi brnya/ ha na ha na/ amṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags bdun brjod/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha// zhes 'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rgyun khyer snying por dril ba 'don/ 'di ni snga tshogs su thog ma dbu tshugs pa'i zhal 'don du gnang dgos pa yin no// sarba marga lam̐// / /

3༄// g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so//na mo ratna gu ru bhyaḥ rgyal ba ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la gsol ba 'debs// nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur rnal 'byor ma// dpal ldan phreng ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mtshungs med g.yu thog zhabs//'gro ba'i mgon po mchog la gsol ba 'debs// nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal sras dam pa bka' drin 'gran zla med// sum ston chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal tshab rmad byung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// dpal ldan 'tsho mdzad ye shes gzhon nu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas byin rlabs mnga' ris mkhas pa'i gtso// gtsang ston sangs rin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rlabs chen spyod pa can// mkhas btsun rin rdor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i bka' la shing rta'i srol 'byed pa// don grub rgyal mtshan dpal la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas gsungs pa'igaso dpyad rgyas par mdzad// brang rgyal mtshan ti dkon mchog skyabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i gtsug na ngal gso mchod pa'i gnas// dpal ldan 'tsho byed zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang sman blas rjes bzung

4 ༄7g.yu thog snying thiga'agro ba'i dpal// 'tsho byed rig 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog gi lam la sgrub pa mthar phyin pa// rnal 'byor bsod dbang zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa can// rnal 'byor chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs 'dzin spangs nas mchog gi go 'phang thob// ri khrod zhig po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub mnga' brnyes pa'i// zur mkhar chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu bka' drin che ba sangs rgyas dngos// dkon mchog mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bla mas rjes bzung chos kyi bag chags sad// nam mkha' rin chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// snang srid zil gnon rin chen kun gyi rje// bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// padma'i thugs sras ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin// rig 'dzin dbang po'i sde la gsol ba 'debs// bka' drin mnyam med zab gter bstan pa'i bdag/ ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// zur chen chos dbyings rang grol gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na padma dkar 'chang // blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lung rig kun mkhyen bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes// blo bzang tshe dbang zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zab dang rgya che'i chos la mnga' brnyes pa'i// kun bzang grol mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gso dpyad mkhas pa'i dbang phyug ded dpon mchog/ chos 'byor rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rim gnyis dbang 'byor gso dpyad gnas la mkhas// rig 'dzin bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje 'dzin dngos 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu//padma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gsol ba 'debs// rmad byung gdams pa'i gsang 'dzin 'gro ba'i mgon// chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 5'debs// lnga rig kun mkhyen mahā paṇḍi ta// mthu stobs rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// bstan 'dzin mthu stobs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gsang bdag sprul pa grub pa'i zlos gar mkhan// byams pa bstan 'phel zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag lung sbyin rje// chos kyi seṅge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong //mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// deng nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob bar// mtshan ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing // ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bla med sngags don spyod par byin gyis rlobs// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams sems nyid dang // de nyid rgyal ba'i thugs dang dbyer med par// 'gyur med spang thob bral ba'i bde ba che// bla med sman pa tshe 'dir thob par shog/skye ba kun tu sogs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam zab kun 'dus rgyal ba'i bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i 'od kyi brgyud pa'i rim pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi char rgyun zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ yongs 'dzin dam pa burnya shrī dpon slob sogs kyis bkas bskul ba'i ngor/ g.yu thog 'bangs kyis 'tsho byed sman pa'i gling bkra shis lha steng gi sman pa chen po'i pho brang du 'brug lor gus pas bris pa'o//gang sku gsang chen ma bzhugs so//na mo gu ru/ gang gi sku yi gsang chen mchog/ dngos po kun khyab bde ba che// rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i dbyings// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i skur

6 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaphyag 'tshal// gang gi gsung gi gsang chen mchog/ sgra grag kun khyab gzhom bral ba// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrogs// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i gsung phyag 'tshal// gang gi thugs kyi gsang chen mchog/ spros pa kun bral bde ba che// shes rab pha rol phyin la gnas// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i thugs phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba kun kyang 'dren pa khyed// khyed las gzhan pa'i skyob pa ni//'gro ba kun la 'ga' ma mchis// de phyir khyed la skyabs su mchi// byis pas khyed mtshan ma thos pas// thos kyang gus par mi bsten par// de las snying rje gzhan med pas// brtse bas khyed kyis rjes su bzung // khyed kyi mtshan thos skyabs song bas// de ni nam yang srid mtshor min// de phyir mig chu g.yo bzhin du// snying nas dus kun gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog/ gsang chen khyed skur ro gcig pas// de ring kho nar mngon sum du// mkha' khyab 'gro bas thob par shog/ e ma ho// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi// mkhyen brtse nus pa gcig tu gyur pa'i gzugs// zhing 'dir mtshungs bral gu khor yongs shar ba// de la bdag sogs sems can skyabs su mchi// bdag gis dus dang srid pa thams cad du// mgon po khyed nyid mnyes pa'i rgyur gyur nas// dmyal ba'i mer yang the tshom mi 'jug cing // lus srog longs spyod kun gyis khyed mchod shog/ gal te khyed nyid mi mnyes gyur pa na// bla med byang chub thob kyang 'dor ba dang //skad cig 'bral med khyed nyid bsten nas kyang // sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem byed shog/bdud bzhi rab bcom ma bzhugs so//bdud bzhi rab bcom gdod nas sangs rgyas kyang // snyigs 'gror

༄7/g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 7rjes brtse sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul// ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos drang don du// thog med da lta'i bar bsags sdig ltung bshags// sgrib pa kun sbyangs sku bzhi rnam dag cing / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis zla ba'i cha rdzogs nas//'gro la chos 'khor rgyun chad med pa dang // thugs bskyed smon lam gang bsam 'grub par shog/ chos srid 'dzin pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yang // sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i g.ya' dag nas// skye ba kun tu khyed nyid mi 'bral zhing //smon lam kun 'grub sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ ces pa 'di ni 'jam mgon sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i gsung ngo / //

༄7/g.yu thog snying thig gi bla sgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 7rjes brtse sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul// ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos drang don du// thog med da lta'i bar bsags sdig ltung bshags// sgrib pa kun sbyangs sku bzhi rnam dag cing / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis zla ba'i cha rdzogs nas//'gro la chos 'khor rgyun chad med pa dang // thugs bskyed smon lam gang bsam 'grub par shog/ chos srid 'dzin pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yang // sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i g.ya' dag nas// skye ba kun tu khyed nyid mi 'bral zhing //smon lam kun 'grub sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ ces pa 'di ni 'jam mgon sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i gsung ngo / //

8༄// g.yu thog snying thig gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs so//'di phyi'i gtan mdun yongs 'du'i 'khri shing las// bde skyid 'bras bu gu ṇa'i zhal lung la// nges rnyed dad thob dngos brgyud bla ma'i drin//gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// nyes brgya'i nad kun sel mdzad sman gyi bla/ dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi gzugs padma 'byung // ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal ldan 'phreng // gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sman rgyal mi yi rnam rol g.yu thog pa// gdams pa'i bka' babs sum ston ye shes gzungs// zab don mdzod 'chang gzhon nu ye shes la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// gtsang ston chen po sangs rgyas rin chen dpal// mkhas btsun bla ma rin chen rdo rje'i zhabs// brang ti mang thos dngos grub rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// rigs chos 'dzin pa brang ti dkon mchog skyabs// gnas lugs mngon gyur dpal ldan 'tsho byed pa// zul phu sman mo che pa rin chen mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol//rtogs pa'i bdag nyid bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs// mtshungs med dam pa rnal 'byor chen po dang // grub pa mchog brnyes ri khrod zhig po la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// gso rig spel mkhas dkon mchog chos kyi rje// zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje bstan pa'i srog/ phrag dbon mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal bzang por// gsol ba 'debs so

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 9mchog thun dngos grub stsol// mthu stobs dbang phyug kong chen nam mkha'i dpal// padma'i gdung 'tshob legs ldan rdo rje'i sde// sum ston rnam sprul bkra shes stobs kyi rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol//byang bdag rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs// 'khor lo'i mgon po chos dbyings rang sar grol// 'jig rten mgon po blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder//gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// blo bzang tshe dbang kun bzang grol mchog zhabs// chos 'byor rgya mtsho rig 'dzin bzang po dang //padma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// mthu stobs rnam rgyal bstan 'dzin mthu stobs dang //bstan pa dar rgyas byams pa bstan 'phel zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med chos kyi seṅge la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhis rang rgyud smin// phyi nang gsang dril bla ma'i sgrub pa yis// bskyed rim phra rags gsal snang nga rgyal brtan// rigs 'dus sman rgyal rang ngo 'phrod par shog/ sbyang gzhi rang lus rtsa khams las rlung kun// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gsang gsum rol gar du// nyams su bstar bas las bzhi lhun grub cing // mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob bar shog/dhū ti ro rkyang 'khor lo bzhi ldan la// 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi rtsa yig lam kun sbyangs// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog zag med bde dbyings dag/ rang lus snang stong lha skur 'char bar shog/ rdor bzlas la sogs rlung gi gtum mo sbar//ngag gi sgra kun sngags kyi gdangs su shar// rmi lam rtsal 'byongs sprul sgyur sna tshogs ston// 'chi ba 'od gsal btsan thabs zin par shog/ gang snang 'dzin med sgyu ma'i rol par shar// rten 'dir ma grol bar dor nyams 'og tshud// yang na 'pho bas dag zhing myul ba'am// grong du 'jug pas lam gyi 'phro mthud shog/ dbang rnon rmi lam man gyi nyams len la// ltos min las

10 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigargyar thig le dbab ldog gis// bcu drug dga' bzhi'i bde chen rab drangs nas// tshe gcig rang sems chos skur grol bar shog/ dben par gong gi bskyed rdzogs lhur len tshe// phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs kun sel nus shing //grangs med 'gro ba'i nad rnams sman dpyad kyis// drungs 'byin phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog/ mthong thos reg pa'i rtags la ma ltos par//lha sman drang srong rig 'dzin rab sgrub pas// lkog gyur chos rnams pra dang mngon shes kyis// me long byad bzhin sgrib med mthong bar shog/ zhang blon gtsor gyur dam can sde dgu yis// dgra bgegs ming gi lhag mar yongs btang nas// dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin tshogs//legs bskyed yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar shog/ dkon mchog thugs rjer nam yang yol ba med// lha dang drang srong bden pa'i tshig la dbang // bka' srung thogs rdugs med pa'i mthu stobs kyis// bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog/ ces rigs 'dus sman rgyal gu ṇa'i zab chos snyan brgyud bka' rgya can g.yu thog snying thig gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni/ sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa nyang stod kyi cha'i dpon tshang dkyil spel ba blo bzang bzod pa'i chos 'di bka' rdzogs lung rdzogs su nyan pa'i tshe bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// dge legs 'phel// //

11༄// 'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rgyun khyer snying por dril ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru lha ṣa dzño ya/ skyabs sems ni/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lhar//gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro/ bla med byang chub mchog thob phyir/gsang bdag lha tshogs bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ tshad med ba'i bsgom pa ni/sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig/ sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog/bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing // chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog/dngosagazhi lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3rta/ rang bzhin skye med stong pa'i ngang nyid las// rol pa 'gags med gsang bdag rdo rje'i sku// mthing nag zhal bgrad tshems dang mche ba gtsigs// phyag gnyis rdo rje sdigs mdzub zhabs dor stabs// nyi zla padma brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng // ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil dbus// gzi brjid 'od 'phro rgyan mdzes gsal bar gyur// snying dbus gu ru padma sman rgyal tshul//phyag g.yas gser gyi mdog ldan a ru ra// g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin// dar nag gsang gos man ṭa'i chos gos dmar// zab chen ber smug mnab cing snyan zhu gsol// gzungs ma jo mo mkhar chen bza' mcho rgyal// rnam pa kha ṭwāṃ tshul gyis dku la brten// sna tshogs padma'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs// spyi gtsug khyung sngon me yi ral pa can// gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i mchu sder sgros// rgya mtsho'i gting dkrugs klu gnyan sa bdag gi/ngo bo sbrul chen zhal gsol nas pa 'joms// spyan gsum nyi zla 'bar ba'i

12 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigasdang mig gis// gdug pa kun 'dul nyi zla rin chen brgyan// phyag gnyis g.yas g.yon mthil na 'khor lo ni// aḥlas zla dkyil rtsibs brgyad 'od zer 'phro// lte bar aḥtsand+ra maṇḍa la// maḥlas nyi dkyil 'dab brgyad 'od zer 'phro// lte bar ma smurla maṇḍa la// rtsibs dang 'dab mar gtum po'i sngags rgod ni// nī lam̐ dzā ti rghaṃ sa tri rbad// sa bon la bskor yig mgo phyir nang bstan// lto sbyar thabs shes phyag rgya bsgyur brdabs pas// gnod byed bsregs sbyangs thal bar brlag par gyur// phrag gong mkha' la rnam pa 'dod chags kyi// rang bzhin khyung dmar 'phur zhing bya nag lding // de bzhin zhe sdang g.yas par sman sbrul dang // g.yon par dug sbrul mthing nag 'khyug cing rgyug/ gti mug lcags kyi phag rgod mgo dgu dang // dug gi g.yung phag nag po mdun nas rol// gtso dang 'khor bcas ye shes me dpung dbus//gzhom med gnam lcags las grub rtse lnga pa// rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas de yi phyir//thod pa skam po phyi dkar nang dmar ba// me klong rab 'bar lhun grub gzhal yas khang // cis kyang mi chod mi shigs bden sra brtan// gang la'ang thogs dang pham pa med par gyur// zhes nan tan du gsal btab bzlas par bya ba ni/ oṃ thim tha ra ti sa dunti dzwa la ram̐ pa ye swāhā/ yi /rmo gyi snying po'o// oṃ mahā gu ruḥ u hā gu ruḥ tri na gu ruḥ ni nā ga shaḥ ro baṃ thul thul: nā ga tsitta rbud:ling shag thum myogs sodaḥ gu ru'i thugos sngags so// tab tse hab tse hūṃ sod:su ru su ru hūṃ sodaḥ 4 ka rdzu ka hūṃ sodabyi sa ti ka ru phroṃ sod: thu la rakshi hūṃ sod: me ru thun tsi hūṃ sod: khyung sngargos so// rma pi khri li mi li ha la swāhāḥ.oṃ pi khri li mi li ha la ma yaḥ dod gaspong gi sngags so// de rnams brgya'am nyer gcig tsam re bzlas shing / thugs sngags bzlas nas mtshon rim par je nyung du btang nas bzla/ zad bzlas/mthar thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ tshi brtul brtul rmu shi shi hrīḥ kṛ tsakra tri sad rbadaḥ ha

༄༅khachi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i rgyun khyer snying por dril ba/ 13la bha ye sarba mā ra ya rbad: rims nad thams cad srungs shig rghaṃ rtu rghaṃ lhaḥzhes pa'ang cuji de'ang yi dam gyi snying po phyed cha tsam sems can sgyu lus 'jigs pa'i nad byung tshe// mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na// yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas// tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes ci nus kyis gsolab btab/ spro zhing nus na rlung ro phyir 'bud pa'i tshe nad gdon bsal ba dang / nang du rngubs pa na srid zhi'i tshe bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang sbrags bum pa can kha sbyor du 'dzin cing sngags rnams yid bzlas kyang bya/ thun bsdu ba na/ snang cha'i spros pa thams cad 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings su bstim ste ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag/ de las ldang ba'i tshe/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/ gsang bdag lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog/ ces sogs bsngo smon bya'o// 'di'i dmigs gnad sogs rgyas par gter gzhung rtsa ba dang / chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i ljags bsgrigs las shes par bya zhing / snod rung gi dbang bskur ba thob nas 'di lta bu zhig tho rangs ma chag par nyams su blangs pas kyang snyigs dus kyi gnyan nad pa rba ta sogs yam thabs su 'go ba'i nad rigs thams cad bsrung bar the tshom med do// gzhan bsrung na/ yung ba/ bong nga / shu dag gsum rigs gsum mgon por bskyed la gong gi sngags kyis ngar btags te dar nag po'i khud du thum bur byas la mgul du gdags/ nang re bzhin lto stong gi dus su snom pas thub bar nges so// 'chi med bdud rtsi bum pa'i bsgom bzlas snying por dril ba sa mas mi thi// gu ru chen po'i gso dpyad bdud rtse bum pa'i skor smin khrid lung rim nod kyi rgyun khyer 'di yang 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i rin chen gter mdzod pod ra pa nas khol du byung 'di ga'i tshogs 'don rgyun 'jug skabs lcags ri 'gro phan rig byed gling grwa tshang nas par du bskrun pa dge legs 'phel// //

14༄tsho// g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na ma a ṣa dhi rā dza gu ṇa nā thā ya/ rmad du byung ba'i gsang ba gsum gyi ma la ya yi dri bsung gis// dug gsum tsha gdung nad kun sel ba'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar mkhan ma// rgyal ba kun dngos sman gyi bla ma tsan dan ljon pa'i bdag nyid can// gang gi thugs rje'i grib bsil dag gis 'gro rnams bde ba'i dpal la sbyor// sku gsum rigs 'dus sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang // gdul bya'i snang ngor 'tsham pa'i zlos gar la// g.yu thog mgon por grags de nges don du// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor lhun gyis grub// khyed gsung gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin sum ston rje// snying thig bstan pa spel phyir bsams bzhin du// sprul pas rnam par rol pa'i rig sngags 'chang // bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal po dbang po'i sde// dpal ldan theg pa mchog gi mkha' dbyings su// zab don 'byor pa'i nyin byed 'phrin las kyis// skal bzang 'dab brgya rab tu rgyas mdzad pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kun phyag gi yul//yang zab bla ma sman rgyal dbyer med du// sgrub pa'i las byang yongs 'du sa brtol dbang // mchog thun dngos grub char du 'bebs byed na// blo ldan mtha' dag dang ba'i yid kyis nyon//de la 'dir zab lam kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal sgrub pa'i las byang khrigs chags 'khyer bde ba brjod par bya'o// thog mar skyabs sems rdo rje sems/ tshogs zhing gtor bsngo mtshams gcod dang //sdig bshags byin dbab mchod gtor brlab// sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim mo// stong pa'i ngang las phroṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje thabs kyi rang bzhin ye shes lnga yi ngo bo dang / a

༄7g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 15las byung ba'i dril bu shes rab kyi rang bzhin stong nyid chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs par gyur/ gnyis ku'ang don dam pa byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin to//oṃ mahā badzra phroṃ/ oṃ badzra ga〉 (gharje a/ rma sarba ta thā ga ta mahā a ṇa rā ga na su bhā wa adma konyarta/ gsol 'debs 'jug rang nyid skad cig gas rtsa gsum rigs 'dus su gsal ba'i thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo rigs 'dus rdo rje 'chang //phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos// bdag gzhan byang chub ma thob bar// snying nas nye bar skyabs su mchi// gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ nam mkhas khyab pa'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral pa'i phyir// rtsa ba gsum gyi go 'phang mchog/ ma thob bar du bsgrub par bya// gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng // hūṃ dkar la sa grub rdo rje sems// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can// phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// thugs kur zla steng hūṃ gi mthar// yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor//'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don byas// bdud rtsi mtheb sor nas 'dzags pas// rang gi lus bkrus sdig sgrib kun// ma lus byang zhing dag par gyur// yi ge brgya ba brjod/ bzhi pa tshogs zhing ni/ rab yangs mdun gyi nam mkha' la// padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba'i dbus// sman rgyal dbyer med gu ṇa'i zhabs// zhi 'dzum 'gro la chags pa'i nyams// dbu skra lcang lo me tog spras//phyag g.yas mchog sbyin utpa la'i// yu ba nas bzung snyan gyi thad// bye ba'i steng du glegs ral mtshan// g.yon pa chos 'chad pad sdong gi/ rtsa ba nas bzung 'dab ma rnams// snyan gyi thad kur rgyas pa'i steng // bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa la// gur kum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang // nor bu gser rdor a

16 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaru ras// g.yas g.yon dbus gsum rnam par mtshan// sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' can// rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i// 'dab bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang gi/ lha mo pi wang bya rgod dang // mi rkang gling bu me long 'dzin//mdzes sdug rgyan ldan lang tsho rgyas// bde stong rab rgyas mchod pa 'bul//gzhan yang rtsa gsum chos srung bcas// ma lus 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur//hūm̐ hrīḥbla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gshegs// seng khri pad sdong nyi zla'i steng du bzhugs// bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus phyag rtag tu 'tshal//dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang bas mchod// nyes ltung nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags// dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang // gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bzhin du// mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes gang bsags byang chub bsngo//'khor ba dong sprugs bde chen mchog thob shog/ lnga pa gtor ma gtong ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig dpal chen rta mgrin du// gsal ba'i thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas// rdzas kyi skyon sbyangs rin chen snod yangs su// bdud rtsi'i ngo bo 'dod pa'i dngos por gyur/ i āḥ:/ thugs ku'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu yis// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha dang rigs drug 'gro// gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun// thogs pa med par gnas 'dir rab 'dus shig sa ma ya dzaḥs ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ argha nas shapta'i bar dang / yo a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṭwāṃ/ abya nutpanda twattam āḥlha phaṭa swāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba tad khaṃ ud ga te spa ra ṇa hi paṃ ga ga na khaṃ gritna (grotna ta ba lī (li ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dkar gtor bsngos la/ ::dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dam tshig can rnams dang // gzhi bdag tshogs kun mchod sbyin gtor ma long // rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// bar chad kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs// 'gro drug lus ngag yid

༄7/g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 17gsum rab tshims nas// sdug bsngal kun bral bde la spyod gyur cig/ ya hi gtsu/ zhes brjod pas rol mo bsgrags shing gshegs/ de nas snying rje'i mgron la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sa ma ya na ra kun badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis dmar gtor bsngos/ hūṃ nyon cig skal med bgegs kyi tshogs// nga ni gdod nas lhun grub pa'i// khro rgyal kun gyi rje btsan yin// bdud dpung thal bar rlog par byed// gsang chen rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir// khyed cag 'jug pa'i skabs med pas// sngon las 'phral rkyen ci yod kyang // mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di long la// gzhan dang gzhan du byer zhing dengs// 'dug na brlag par gdon mi za// na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du bla ma rigs 'dus sman rgyal bka' srung dam can sde dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa la brten nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ 'dir mi gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar gas par gyur ta re/ su bha ni sogs dang / sarba ju ta utsas ya phaṭa/ drug pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ rang byung ye shes khro bo'i rgyal// ma rig log rtog bgegs kyi gshed// lha 'drer 'dzin pa'i 'khrul snang bgegs// bde chen klong du rang grol mtshams// steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus pa// rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che// padma rgya gram me dpung gis// go mtshams med par legs gtams pa'i// 'jigs rung sra brtan srung ba yi// gur khang mtshams las ma 'da' zhig/ oṃ āḥlha gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ gnod byed 'byung po sarba

18 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigabighā na u tsaṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ badzra tsakra ratna padma kurma dzwa la ram̐ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ/bdun pa bshags pa ni/ srung 'khor nang gi mdun gyi bar snang la// rtsa gsum lha tshogs gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol// badzra sa ma dzaḥ skyabs gnas bdag la brtser dgongs mdzod// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum gyis// mi dge gang bgyis mthol zhing bshags//khyad par rdo rje theg pa yi// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gi/ nyes ltung dri mas sbags pa kun// snying nas bshags so dngos grub stsol// brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/hūṃ/ bde chen 'gyur med chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ grangs med gzugs sku'i rnam par ston mdzad pa'i// rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi// zhi dang khro bo'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// bla ma rdor sems rigs bzhi 'khor dang bcas// rta phag yab yum chos skyong dam can tshogs// mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bzhengs la// sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen ma lus phobs// gnas khang 'di la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs skyed//sgrub pa'i rdzas la mthu stobs nus pa stim// rig 'dzin tshogs la byin rlabs dbang bzhi skur// re ba'i 'bras bu mchog thun dngos grub stsol// oṃ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sidhi tiṣṭha a be sha ya a aḥ dgu pa mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lko yig dkar po 'od 'bar ba// rigs lnga yab yum ngo bo nyid//mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba las// 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsir 'gyur// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ aḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar ba// 'khor ba skye med dbyings su sgrol// mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba las// nyon mongs 'joms pa'i raktar gyur// mahā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ yig mthing kha 'od 'bar ba// bde chen thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba las// 'dod yon mi zad gtor mar gyur// oṃ āḥmahā ba li /lo ta te dzo ba li (li ta ba la bā ta gu hya sa ma ye hūṃ swāhā/ hrīḥyig 'od lnga rab gsal ba//

〉〉g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 19las rnams kun byed nam mkha' mdzod// mtshan ldan thod par zhu ba las//phyi nang gsang ma/chod bsam mi khyab// ambha nas/ shapta pū dza me gha rma āḥ&/rū pa nas/ sparsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥlha/ mahā rma sa rakta ke ni ri ti bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇḍagu hya pū dza hoḥting 'dzin rnam gsum gzhal yas khang // lhar skyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag/ mchod bstodabazlas pa'i rim pa rnams// nyams len dngos gzhi'i bya bar nges// dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum ni// hūṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs spros dang bral// skye med stong gsal nam mkha' che// oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na (badzra )su bhā wa adma konyalha/ de ltar ma rtogs sems can la// mi zad snying rje kun khyab bsgom// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi// ngang nas 'gro don bsgrub pa'i phyir// rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer gyur// gnyis pa gzhal yas khang ni/ de las e 'phros nam mkha' cher// yi 'phros rlung gi dkyil 'khor te// ram̐ 'phros rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khrug/ sum̐ las zhing chen sa gzhi gdal// kau las rus pa'i ri rab steng // ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar// de dbus sna tshogs rghaṃ 'phros te// yongs gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang // khyams sgo rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs// gsum pa lha skyed pa ni/de dbus pad sdong 'dab ma bzhi// zla nyi bdud bzhi'i ro gdan steng //hrīḥm ha ri ni sa rnams// dbus dang 'dab bzhi so sor gsal// de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod// sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs// tshur 'dus rdo rje gri gug gyur// de nyid gnas gyur dran rdzogs su// rta mchog dbang chen sku mdog dmar// dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher// dbang sdud gri gug phyag g.yas 'phyar// ma ra'i (ru'i khrag bkang thod pa g.yon//bdud bzhi'i steng na brkyang bskum 'gying // rdo rje phag mos mgul nas 'khyud// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil bzhugs// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar rdo rje dang // rin chen padma 'phrin las kyi// mkha' 'gro mthing ser

20 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadamar ljang mdog/ rus pa'i rgyan spras gri thod 'dzin// brkyang bskum gar stabs tshul gyis 'gying // spyi gtsug pad sdong 'dab bzhi'i dbus// nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du// rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pa rdo rje thod pa g.yon// gcer bu rin chen rus rgyan spras// khro 'dzum 'gying bag skyil krung gi/ pang du rang rigs gsang ba'i yum// rab mdzes gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud// phyogs bzhir rig pa'i ye shes kyi// ngo bo dkar ser dmar ljang mdog/ rnam snang rin 'byung 'od dpag med// don grub rnam bzhi yum dang sbyor// 'khor lo rin chen padma dang // rgya gram rab 'dzin cha lugs rnams// gtso bo ji bzhin bzhugs pa'i mthar// yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams// sprin phung 'khrigs pa lta bur gyur// bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings spros bral ngang nyid las//rigs 'dus bla ma skur bzhengs shig/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir//gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ āḥlha gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/badzra sa ma /mā ya dzaḥ.e hya hi/ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i// gsang chen dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag bzhin// dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ co gsum dkyil 'khor ma lus pa//kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal gyi// rten dang brten par bcas pa la// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// na mo a ti pu hoḥpra ti dza hoḥ bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri dang bshos// rol mo la sogs yid 'ong phyi'i mchod pa// dbang po lnga dang gsur chen zhun chen me// dri chen dri chu thod rnga rkang gling sgra// dug gsum sku gsum dug lnga ye shes lnga// snang srid 'khor 'das bde chen klong du mchod// a rghaṃ nas/ shapta'ibar brjod de phyi nang gi mchod pa dbul lo// thabs shes zla gsang thig le las// dkar dmar bde chen

༄7g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 21ye shes rdzas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// gnyis med ngang du 'bul gyi bzhes// bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥzhes gsang mchod pa dbul lo// hūṃ/ rtsa ba yan lag stong sbyar sman// dug lnga ye shes lngar gyur pa// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs mchod pa 'bul// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā(ṭha1/ rgyal ba sman bla rig 'dzin padma 'byung // dpal ldan phreng ba rje btsun g.yu thog zhabs// ye shes gzungs dang dpal ldan gzhon nu la// bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// rma sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ṭhan/sangs rgyas rin chen rin chen rdo rje dang // don grub rgyal mtshan dkon mchog skyabs kyis phul/ rin chen bsod dbang rnal 'byor chen po la//bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ṭha1/ ri khrod zhig po zur mkhar mnyam nyid rje// dkon mchog pa (dpal dang nam mkha' dpal ldan zhabs// mnga' ris rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje la// bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ṭha1/ bkra shes stobs rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i dpal//gsang chen chos kyi mdzod 'dzi ('dzin ā nanda// 'khor lo'i mgon po blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder// bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// i sarba pañtsa a māṃ /mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ṭha1/ blo bzang tshe dbang kun bzang grol mchog zhabs// chos 'byor rgya mtsho rig 'dzin bzang po dang // padma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal// bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ṭha1/ mthu stobs rnam rgyal bstan 'dzin mthu stobs dang // bstan pa dar rgyas byams pa bstan 'phel zhabs//bka' drin mnyam med chos kyi seng ge la// bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ṭha)/ kun 'dus rigs lnga rta phag yab yum dang // mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs//

22 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigasman gyi drang srong lha mor bcas pa la// bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥthā/ṭha1/ zhes bdud rtsi sman mchod dbul lo/hrīḥ'akhor 'das phyi nang gsang ba shes bya dang // shes byed las 'das dam tshig rdo rje che// thabs shes mtheb srin phyag rgyas cho ga bzhin// myangs pas dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol// kwa ya wa ka tsitta sarba siddhi oṃ āḥ:/ zhes dngos grub blang / hūṃ/ badha mtshan ldan 'bar ba'i snod// bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i snying khrag bcud// rnam rtog 'khor ba dbyings sgrol phyir// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// mahā rakta sogs brjod de rakta dbul lo// hūṃ/ snod bcud gtor mar lhun gyis grub// gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs//'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan pa// bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol// oṃ āḥlha badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ oṃ āḥmai swāhā/ st+waṃ lī māṃ ṭwāṃ tī/hrīḥmaḥha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring/ sa pa ri wā ra i dam /de ba li ta kha kha/khā hi khā hi/ dharma pā la sa pā ri wā ra i dam (rda ba li ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/zhes gtor ma dbul lo// hūṃ/ skye ba med pa thams cad skye// skyes tsam nyid la skye ba dran// 'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i glu// nyams dbyangs (dbyings rang grol ye shes mchod// oṃ te te hūṃ/ te na hūṃ/ te phu spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ hoḥzhes rdo rje'i glus mchod do// brgyad pa bstod pa ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings bde chen kun gsal yangs pa'i ngos// sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rta ljang dbang po yis// mchog thun dngos grub 'dab brgya bzhad mdzad pa'i// rtsa gsum rigs 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen lang tsho beeḍūr mthing kha dang // lhan cig 'khyil ba'i bzhin lag mtshan dpe'i 'ja'// khro 'dzum 'gying bag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal// rnam shes sgrib bral chos dbyings rta ljang can// ind+ra nī lar 'gran bzod rdo rje'i rigs// zhe sdang kunda zum byed mi bskyod pa// dkyil 'khor khyab bdag rigs kyi bdag

༄7g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 23por 'dud// gzugs phung rnyog bral rab dwangs me long chu// zla shel zhun mar 'khu ba'i sangs rgyas rigs// gti mug mun pa drungs 'byin rnam snang mdzad// sku yi rig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal// tshor phung yongs dag mnyam nyid tsan dan shing // gser sbyangs btso mar 'gran bzod rin chen rigs//nga rgyal tsha gdung drungs 'byin rin 'byung ldan// yon tan rig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal// 'du shes rnam dag sor rtog zil dngar bcud// byu ru'i lhun po'i rjes 'gro padma'i rigs// 'dod chags nad kun sel ba'i 'od dpag med// gsung gi rig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal// 'du byed dag pa bya grub yid bzhin nor// mar gad gsar pa'i dpal 'dzin las kyi rigs//phrag dog dbul ba sel ba'i don yod grub// 'phrin las rig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal// gdod nas dbyer med chu nang zla gzugs ltar// mdzes sdug lha mor shar ba'i yum chen lnga// rked phra nu 'bur rgyas pa'i 'jo sgeg gis//zag med bde chen rgyas par mdzad la bstod// brtse chen snying rje'i chu gter ma 'khrugs kyang // drag po'i 'phrin las yol med rlabs phreng can// gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa'i ho ru ka/ dbang chen rta phag yab yum la phyag 'tshal// dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dbang po'i gsang gsum gyi// sna tshogs sprul pa'i rol gar grangs med las// legs grub rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro zhi khro'i lha// chos srung drang srong tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// dgu pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/rang nyid lhar gsal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi// sku gsung thugs la sngags phreng dkar dmar mthing // 'od zer dpag med 'phros pas sangs rgyas rnams// mchod pas mnyes shing byin rlabs ma lus bsdus// sems can sgrib sbyangs rtsa gsum go 'phang bkod// snod bcud gzhal yas lha dang lha mor gyur// mig gi snang ba mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sku// rna bar thos pa ma lus grags stong gsung // yid ngor shar kun gsal stong rig pa'i gshes// blo 'das
