24 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigabarjod med gnyug ma'i klong du gyur// oṃ āḥlha badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmai swāhā/ st+waṃ lī māṃ ṭwāṃ tī/ hrīḥmaḥha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring / sa ma ya dzaḥ: baṃ hoḥ sarba sirnyi hūṃ āḥ zhes gtso 'khor thams cad dril ba'i sngags ring 'di rgyun gyis bzlas par bya'o// de nas dbyangs gsal ye dhar yig brgya bcas bzla'o// hūṃ hrīḥskye med dbyings las 'gag med rtsal shar ba// mkhyen brtse nas pas 'gro 'dul rtsa gsum lha// rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren gnyis med bzhugs//phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig bshags bstod cing bskul// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bzlas brjod ting 'dzin bsgom// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi zhing 'dod dgu rgyas// rang snang dbang bsdus log rtog dgra bgegs thul// mchog thun dngos grub dus 'dir myur stsol mdzod// ces 'dzab bstod bya'o//tshogs mchod byin brlab spyan 'dren 'bul// bshags bsgral bka' srung mchod cing rol//lhag ma dngos grub chad mdo skyong // rta bro gtang rag bzod gsol bsdu// bsngo smon bcu bdun mjug gi rim// dang po ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs kha'i sa bon las//ram̐ yi khaṃ 'phros tshogs rdzas bsreg sbyangs bkrus// rma āḥlha gas ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// 'dod yon lha mo mchod rdzas sprin phung gtibs// mahā ga ṇa tsakra sarba pha la hoḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams// thugs dam thugs rjes brtser dgongs la// tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes slad du// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa ma ya dzaḥ gsum pa 'bul ba ni/ ngo bo zag med bdud rtsi la// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa'i// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di// brtse bas bzhes la dngos grub stsol// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥhrīḥ gsang chen rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas ma tshang med// rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam gnyan po bskang // rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig/ bzhi pa bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu// gsang

༄7/g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 25ba sngags kyi dam tshig ma lus dang // khyad par sman gzhung las gsungs dam bca' las// 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ma lus mthol lo bshags// yi ge brgya pa brjod/ lnga ba bsgral mchod ni/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhesapa nas/ mthu stobs nus pa la brten nas/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gang yin pa de'i bla srog rnam par shes pa'i tshogs thams cad gzugs liṅgā 'di la gnyis med du khug cig co gsum lha tshogs sngags dang phyag rgya dang // ting 'dzin mthu yis log 'dren dgra bgegs kun// thar med gru gsum lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang // dmigs rten gzugs kyi nya bo 'di la khug/ hūṃ/ khro rgyal rta mgrin khrag 'thung he ru ka/ 'jigs rung zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin// sku smad gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur bu yis// dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la mā ra yā// zhes bsgral/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa rnams// ngo bo bdud rtsi rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod// ces bstab pa bya// drug pa chos srung mchod pa ni/ rgyas pa rdo rje 'chang ā nandas mdzad pa'i dam skong dregs pa tshar gcod bya zhing / bsdu na 'di ltar/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i tshogs// mthu stobs gcig bsdus padma 'byung gnas dang //dbyer med rje btsun mahā gu ṇa yis// thugs rje'i mthu dpung dus 'dir stsal du gsol// chos dbyings spros bral bde ba chen po las// gnyis med gnyis su rol pa'i sgyu ma mkhan// bstan srung dbang po dam can sde dgu'i tshogs//gnas 'dir thogs pa med par da tshur spyon// 'jigs rung dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas dbus// dgra bgegs khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i chos 'byung nang //padma nyi zla dgra bgegs gdan steng du// bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs// mtsho skyes rdo rje rje btsun g.yu thog zhabs// rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bskos dam bsgrags pa// dran par mdzod la rnal 'byor

26 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigabadag cag gis// bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod// bka' srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du// me tog bdug spos snang gsal mar me dang // dri chab zhal zas rol mo rta g.yag lug/ bya khyi go mtshon sku gsung thugs rten rdzas// 'dod pa'i g.yab dar drag po sgrub pa'i rdzas// sku mkhar padma nyi zla mda' dar dang // dmar chen gtor ma bdud rtsi rakta sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// srin po'i gzugs can dar nag 'jol ber gsol// gri gug thod 'dzin beng chen rked la btsugs// mi mgo'i phreng brgyan rta nag rting dkar chibs// gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul khyed la bstod// srin mo mthing nag dre'u gwa pa zhon// mtshon dru nad rkyal rab btags gri thod 'dzin// spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan// sngags srung e ka dza ti /ṭī khyed la bstod// srin po dbu dgu bya rog mgo bos brgyan// phyag gnyis sbrul zhags rwa yi mda' gzhu bsnams//lus po mig dang sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil// gza' bdud khyab 'jug nag po khyed la bstod// ce spyang gdong can phyag bzhi gri thod dang // dgra zor rgyu zhags mi mgo 'phyar zhing 'dzin// dur bya mgo dgu la zhon dur khrod bdag/mkha' 'gro ce spyang mchu dmar khyed la bstod// stag gi gdong can zangs gri rgyu zhags thogs// snying gi phreng bas lus brgyan g.yu 'brug zhon// stong gsum skad cig nyul ba'i mthu stobs can// gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po khyed la bstod// srin po 'jigs rung g.yas pa spu gri dang // g.yon pa glo snying thogs zhing mgo phreng brgyan// dar nag 'jol ber rab gsol seng ge zhon//dam can srog gi spu gri khyed la bstod// srin zhal spyi bor spyang gdong mche ring can// ral gri rtse gsum rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'dzin// mi lpags gos gyon ro langs mgo dgu zhon// srin po dgra dur 'jigs byed khyed la bstod// srin mo bya rog mgo can khrag ral sprug/ g.yas pa rgyu zhags dgra sta g.yon pa na//

༄7g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 27tsitta bsnams shing lcags spyang mgo dgu zhon// bdud mo shan ting (to ro zan khyed la bstod// srin zhal spyi bor bya khra'i mgo bo can// phyag bzhi mdung dang dug rkyal mi mgo rlon// phur pa bsnams shing dred mo mgo dgu zhon//srog bdag hob se nag po khyed la bstod// bka' srung sde dgu 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// bstan dang rnal 'byor la 'tshe dgra dang bgegs// steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar gnas kyang // tshe srog mnga' thang choms la thal bar rlog/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// khyad par rje btsun mahā gu ṇa yi// snyan brgyud snying thig nges don ring lugs dang // gso rig gtsug lag 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// rig 'dzin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang // dpal 'byor snyan grags chos srid yon tan kun//bsams pa tsam gyis yid bzhin 'grub pa yi// zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs// mdor na 'chi med grub pa padma 'byung // dbyer med 'gro mgon mahā gu ṇa yi// dam tshig gnyan po dgongs la 'gal rkyen kun//zhi zhing mthun rkyen ma lus sgrub par mdzod// bdun pa tshosas la longs spyod pa ni/las kyi rdo rjes/ ho/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// snang srid 'khor 'das ro mnyam pas// gsang chen bde ba'i longs spyod che// the tshom spangs te bzhes par mdzod// ga ṇa tsakra mahā pū dza hoḥ zhes tshogs phud btegs la 'dran('dren / slob dpon gyis/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'dod yon ma smad rol pa che// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus par// gnyis med dgyes skyed 'di la spyod// a la la hoḥzhes blangs te rol lo// brgyad pa lhag ma gtong ba ni/ rigs 'dus bla ma rgyal ba yi// bka' dang bstan pa srung byed cing // lhag la dbang ba'i tshogs rnams kun// lhag mchod 'di bzhes 'phrin las sgrubs// u tsi ṭa ba li ta bhakṣa si swāhā/ tshogs mchod phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// mi zad gter la longs spyod /spyadakanas// ye shes snang ba rab rgyas te// thar pa chen

28 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigapo'i sa thob shog/ dgu pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ gtor ma gnas gsum du gtugs la/ hūṃ hoḥ bde chen klong yangs rgyal ba'i zhing khams nas// bla ma sman rgyal rigs 'dus thugs dam can// sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las byin chen po//dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥlha sarba sirnyi pha la hoḥbacu pa chad mdo ni/ mtsho skyes rdo rje rje btsun g.yu thog pa'i// spyan sngar khas blangs dam can srung ma'i tshogs// gsang chen sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin mched rnams kyis// gtor ma len zhing rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring // bar chad sel zhing dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod// rgyud bzhi'i bshad nyan 'phrin las spel ba sogs// sngon gyi khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar// gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// bcu gcig pa bstan ma skyong ba ni/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis po// sngon gyi dam bca' gnyan po nyer dgongs la//gtor ma 'di bzhes 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med sgrubs// na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum chos skyong srung ma zhang blon sde dgu'i bden pa'i mthu stobs la brten nas gnod byed ya ma dam sri'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig/ bcu gnyis pa rta bro ni/ dpal chen khros pa'i rdo rje'i bro// dgra bgegs snying la chems se chem// dam sri 'byung po ma lus pa'i// lus ngag yidagasum mā ra ya// bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor ('khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig a yu pukhyiX ku ru ye swāhā/ bcu gsum pa gtang rag ni/ rigs 'dus bla ma dkyil 'khor lha// bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol// bcu bzhi pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ rigs 'dus bla ma rgyal ba'i sku// brtse chen tshad med thugs rjes dgongs// bdag cag byis pa'i

༄zagayu thog snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 29rang bzhin gyis// lhag chad nor 'khrul bzod par bzhes// oṃ āḥlha gu ru de wā ḍā ki ni kā ya wā (ba ka tsitta sa ma ya a a a/ bco lnga pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa kun// gnyis med chos kyi dbyings su 'ja' ltar yal// mgron rnams rten la bzhugs shing gshegs pa rnams//slar yang brtse bas gnas 'dir 'byon par mdzod// sarba burnya la maṇḍal su bhā wa adma konyarta/ bcu drug pa smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// sman rgyal gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang // rang rig gsal stong gnyug ma lhan cig skyes// tshe 'di nyid la mngon du 'gyur bar shog/ bcu bdun pa shis brjod ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha// sman gyi bstan srung mkha' 'gro drang srong tshogs// phun tshogs rnam par dge ba'i bkra shes kyis// yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab par shog/ rje btsun gu ṇa'i thugs bcud chu 'dzin cher// yang zab snying thig 'phrin las dbyar gyi rnga// tshig nyung don 'dus dbyangs su bsgrags pa na// skal bzang rma bya'i dga' ston ci yang 'phel// tha snyad rtog ger zhen pa'i dha ju ras// myos pas theg mchog snying po'i gangs ri la// log rtog sngon por 'khrul ba'i mkhas rlom rnams// zab don 'di 'dra lta ba'i skal bas dben// blo ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar 'khrid lam// mtshams med las kyang 'dag nus nges gsang chos// 'gro mgon gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud gdams pa 'di// sum ston rgyud 'dzin las 'ongs kho bos thos// rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal g.yu thog rje//rje btsun sum ston rnam 'phrul dbang po'i sde// sde bcas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin kun dga'i dpal// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang de'i gsung gi bcud//bcud ldan 'chi med rnams kyi bdud rtsi gang // gang zhig sangs rgyas sar 'khrid nas ldan tshe// tshe gcig kun mkhyen sgrub pa'i zab mo'i theg/ theg mchog 'di yi dpe zlar 'os sam snyam// dge tshogs chu shel dbang po'i dkyil

30 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thiga'akhor gyis// nyes ltung mun pa'i smag rum drungs byung nas// dngos grub rab dkar snang ba'i dga' ston gyis// skye dgu'i snying gi kunda bzhad gyur cig/ces rje btsun g.yu thog pa'i snying thig gi las byang dpag bsam ljon shing 'di ni gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag la blo gros kyi snang ba mchog tu rgyas pa'i bla sman byang ngos pa blo bzang gzhan phan dbang pos bskul ba la brten nas rdo rje 'dzin pa ā nandas mdzad pa'i las gzhung dngos grub kun 'byung la gzhi byas/ snying thig phyi sgrub nas kha cung zad bkang (bskang zhing / tshig sbyor mang ba rnams nyung ngurabasdus/ mi bde ba'i tshig rnams kun gsar du bcos la/ phal cher gzhung dngos nyid byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba'i phyir rang sor bzhag ste/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs dam pa du ma'i dka' drin gyis gsang sngags gsar rnying thams cad kyi so so'i rang lugs rnams ma 'dres par khong du chud pa'i za hor gyi rigs las a wa dhū tī pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos kun 'dzin gyi lo dbyu gu zla ba'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ gong gi gtso 'khor sngags rnams bzlas rjes su/ oṃ a āḥ.i āḥ.u āḥ2 rmāḥbla āḥ.e iḥ.o auḥ.i aḥka kha ga gha nga ཿtsa tsha dza dzha nyaḥ ṭa ṭha ḍa khāe ṇaḥta tha da dha naḥpa pha ba bha maḥya ra la sha ṣa sa hakṣaḥswāhā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tu nti ṣānta tha ga to hya bdata/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥye swāhā/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa te no pra tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi me pra yatstshaḥ sarba kurma su tre me/ cilta shri yo ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ma me muñtsa badzi (badzī bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥlha phaṭaḥ

31༄tsho// rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ rnam dag mi shigs thig le chos kyi sku// lhun grub 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul longs spyod rdzogs// rgyud drug tsha gdung sel mdzad sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum dbyer med bla ma gtsug tu bsten// 'gro khams ye sangs rgyas pa'i klong chen por// glo bur srid sems 'khrugs pa'i tshogs brgyad kyi// gzhan dbang gyur tshe yongs /yang dag lam 'god phyir// sman sgrub drang srong dgongs rgyan bdag gas spel// de la 'dir phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon rang bzhin brgyad ldan las dbang bskur legs par thob cing /dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa gang gis bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa byed par 'dod pas de la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so//dang po la gnyis/ bsham bkod dang / khrus bya ba'o// dang po ni/ lo zla phun sum tshogs pa cho 'phrul zla ba'am/ yang na rgyud bzhi gsungs pa'i dus dbo zla dang / snod bcud sman du byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus chu stod zla ba/ drang srong ri ṣi 'char ba'i dus khrums zla la sogs gang rung la rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas sam/ gtsug lag khang lta bur byi dor legs par byas te/ dar gdugs 'phan dang bla bre rgyal mtshan sogs mchod pa'i rdzas ci 'byor dang / rten gsum spyi bye brag rnams dgram/ grub na mchod sbyin dang gsung rab bklags pa sātstsha gdab pa sogs bsod nams kyi dpung tshogs mang du spel/ sgrub mjug tu dngos grub len chog spro na bdag 'jug sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba bya zhing / stegs kyi khar dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ras bris gang rung sgo rdzogs can bshams par mchod rdzas rnams mthong rgyun ltar bkod cing / dbang gzhung bzhin gyi dbang rdzas rnams kyang 'du bya'o// sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na stegasakyi khar padma 'dab brgyad tsam bris pas 'thus shing kuji ltar yang thod pa lhung bzed gang 'dzom du sman 'bor mang nyung dang bstun pa'i thang / phye ma/ril bu/ lde gu/ sman mar sogs sde tshan byas te tsha grang ma 'dres pa'am/ yang na khrol bsgrub byas

32 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigakyang rung ste/ dkyil 'khor dbus su a ru ra dang bzang drug ste spyi sman/ shar du rtsa ba lnga sogs drod sman/ lhor sbrang rtsi me tog a gar sogs dang mahā me sa'i rigs/ nub tu tsha ba gsum sogs drod can/ byang du bsil gsum tsandan rnams bkod/ logs ci bder rtsa ba gsum dang / sde dgu'i mchod gtor dpe ris ltar mdzes tshon gyis brgyan pa dang / chad mdo/ bstan skyong / dkar bgegs/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ phyi nang gi mchod pa sogs bsham/ gzhan yang khrus bum sbyang chas gul yungs/ 'thor nas/ ḍā dril sogs rol mo'i bye brag bcas ma tshang ba med par 'du bya/ logs su mdo chog dang sman mdo brgyad brgya pa'ang bklag go/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ sman rnams khrus bya ba dang /bgegs bskrad pa'o// dang po ni/ bum pa rdzas ldan mdun du bkod la/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sku// khro 'dzum ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa//g.yas g.yon sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan pad nyi'i steng // skyil krung phyed bcas stod g.yogs smad sham can// ye shes rang 'od 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs// thugs kur nyi steng hūṃ mthar sngags kyis bskor// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ñtsaṇḍa badzra pā ṇa ye/ zhes gzungs ring ci nus dang / snying po bcas bzlas mthar/ mchod bstod ni/ yalha nas/ shapta'i bar dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas mdun gyi bum pa la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zlo las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du dri ma sbyong ba'i mthu dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu bos yongs su gang bar gyur/ rma sarba ta thā ga ta a lha ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes khrus sngags dang / e ho shurnye shudhe/ yo ho shurbhe shudhe/ baṃ ho shurnye shudhe/ lam̐ ho shurnye shudhe/ ram̐ ho shurnye shudhe/e yo baṃ lam̐ ram̐ shurnye shudhe a a swāhā/ ci mang bzlas mthar/ yedharanyer gcig gam bdun bzlas te khrus bum dang 'thor nas gnyis ka la phus 'debs/ de nas me long du sman rnams gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas te khrus bya ba ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇḍa badzra pā ṇa ye/mahā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tarya thā/ rma ha ra ha ra badzra/ ma tha ma tha badzra ju

༄༅khrabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan/ 33na dhu na badzra/ da ha da ha badzra/ pa tsa pa tsa badzra/ dha ra dha ra badzra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya badzra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badzra/ sbyin sbyin badzra/ bhinda bhinda badzra hūṃ phaṭa/na mañtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha ya/ hū lu hū lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bhadha bhadha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭaḥ zhes lan gsum dang / hūṃ/ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong yangs la//grib dang nyon mongs mi mnga' yang // kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i snang cha las/ rmi lam yul gyi bag chags bzhin// dug dang grib kyi rnam par shar// gang la gang gis rten 'brel gyi// bden pas dug rnams dag gyur cig/ mchog gsum gsang sngags rigs (rig sngags dang // gzungs sngags ting 'dzin bden pa'i mthus// nyams grib ma lus dbyings su sangs// sangs rgyas spyan ma'i bden pa'i mthus// sa yi dug rnams dag gyur cig/ ma mā ki yi bden pa'i mthus// chu yi dug rnams dag gyur cig/ gos dkar mo yi bden pa'i mthus// me yi dug rnams dag gyur cig/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i bden pa'i mthus// rlung gi dug rnams dag gyur cig/ dbyings phyug ma yi bden pa'i mthus// nam mkha'i dug rnams dag gyur cig/ e ho shurnye shurbhe ci nus sogs 'byung lngas brabs/ hūṃ/ yul snang bden 'dzin a 'thas grib// ye shes chu yis dag gyur cig mi lam ji bzhin 'khrul snang grib// bden zhen med par dag gyur cig/ nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum grib/ ye shes chu yis dag gyur cig/ gzung 'dzin nyon mongs bag chags grib// gnyis med mthu yis dag gyur cig/ na mo ratna twa yā ya/ na mañtsaṇḍa badzra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tarya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badzra/ ci nus sogs dang / gzhan yang dam tshig nyams chag gi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ bka' bcag dam bkral can gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ btsogs (btsoganamanol bon gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ khro ba zhe sdang can gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ smod pa ru ṭa can gyi grib phog pa

34 ༄zagayu thog snying thigathams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ ru nga phrag dog can gyi grib phog pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ 'gying ba nga rgyal can gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ dme btsogs kyi (btsog gi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ khyi dang bud med kyis reg pa'i dug dang grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ nad 'thab 'khon 'dzin can gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ pho byi mo nal gyi grib phog pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swāhā/mna' dang 'khon rtsod kyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ zla grogs 'dre can rigs ngan gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/dar zab g.yi spyang gos gdan gyi grib phog pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swāhā/rdzun dang phra ma mgo bskor gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ rdzas ngan 'dre can gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ bying (byings chen ro yi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ ri slog spyang thed kyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ bag sna skye sna'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ lo zla zhag dus gza' skar ngan pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa'i mi dang 'grogs shing reg pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku re ye swāhā/ mi 'khon gyi grib lha la phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ lha 'khon gyi grib mi la phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ snang ba bden 'dzin can gyis gos pa phyi'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku re ye swāhā/ dug lnga rang rgyud du shor ba can gyis gos pa nang gi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ tshogs drug bslu brid can gyis gos pa bar gyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ ma rig kha 'byams can gyis gos pa gsang ba'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/tho co rtsing spyod gdol pa'i rigs kyis gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ bdag bstod gzhan smod can gyis gos pa'i grib rdzog pa thams

༄lobs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drangasrongadagongasapa'irgyan/ ྅du cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mi shes shes rdzus gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs can gyis gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ kha lta phyogs ris can gyis gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ grub mtha' phyogs zhen chos spong can gyis gos pa'i grib rdzog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ dam log dang sdig can gyis gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mdze pho dang yugs sa mo dang dme pho dang nya bshan gyis reg pa'i dug dang grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mnol phog ro bag gi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ btson khang gnas khang gos stan snod spyad mi gtsang ba dang bkra mi shis pa'i rigs thams cad kyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ ser sna 'jungs gegs kyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mi dang dud 'gro bya sprel gyis 'gom pa'i dug dang grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mdor na grib dang mi gtsang ba'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ oṃ e ho shurnye shurnye sogs lan gsum brjod/ spro na khyad par gyi tshig 'di brjod/ oṃ/ 'jig rten gsum gyi skyob pa mchog/ ston pa bla na med pa ste// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gzi brjid dang // des gsungs 'gro ba'i khams rgyud kyi// dug lnga rgyu 'bras nad sel ba'i// thabs mchog bdud rtsi bla na med// chos mchog bden pa'i nus mthu dang // don de tshul bzhin nyams bstar bas// rang dang gzhan gyi zug rngu kun// 'byin mdzad mthu dpal mchog mnga' ba// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i byin rlabs dang // sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi// nus pa'i yon tan mi bslu ba'i// mkha' ltar tshad med yangs pa de sa// nyes pa'i tshogs kun byang gyur cig/ āḥ deng 'dir 'gro ba'i nad sel ba'i// mthu ldan sman gyi rnam pa kun// ston pa'i gsung bzhin legs sbyar zhing // cho ga 'khrul med

༄lobs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drangasrongadagongasapa'irgyan/ ྅du cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mi shes shes rdzus gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs can gyis gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ kha lta phyogs ris can gyis gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ grub mtha' phyogs zhen chos spong can gyis gos pa'i grib rdzog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ dam log dang sdig can gyis gos pa'i grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mdze pho dang yugs sa mo dang dme pho dang nya bshan gyis reg pa'i dug dang grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mnol phog ro bag gi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ btson khang gnas khang gos stan snod spyad mi gtsang ba dang bkra mi shis pa'i rigs thams cad kyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ ser sna 'jungs gegs kyi grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mi dang dud 'gro bya sprel gyis 'gom pa'i dug dang grib phog pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ mdor na grib dang mi gtsang ba'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad shinti ku ru ye swāhā/ oṃ e ho shurnye shurnye sogs lan gsum brjod/ spro na khyad par gyi tshig 'di brjod/ oṃ/ 'jig rten gsum gyi skyob pa mchog/ ston pa bla na med pa ste// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gzi brjid dang // des gsungs 'gro ba'i khams rgyud kyi// dug lnga rgyu 'bras nad sel ba'i// thabs mchog bdud rtsi bla na med// chos mchog bden pa'i nus mthu dang // don de tshul bzhin nyams bstar bas// rang dang gzhan gyi zug rngu kun// 'byin mdzad mthu dpal mchog mnga' ba// dge 'dun 'dus pa'i byin rlabs dang // sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi// nus pa'i yon tan mi bslu ba'i// mkha' ltar tshad med yangs pa de sa// nyes pa'i tshogs kun byang gyur cig/ āḥ deng 'dir 'gro ba'i nad sel ba'i// mthu ldan sman gyi rnam pa kun// ston pa'i gsung bzhin legs sbyar zhing // cho ga 'khrul med

36 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabastar mod kyi// gang yang bgyid blo mi gsal zhing // mi mkhas rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pas// dman lhag log dang ro nus khams// zhu rjes ma snyoms tshad las thal// ngos 'dzin 'khrul dang 'bags btsog gyur// nas pa nyams dang yal ba sogs// mi mthun nyes pa'i tshogs rnams kun// dag nas ro nus 'phel gyur cig/ gang zhig bston pas 'du ba rnams// ma snyoms snyoms byed sman gyi mthus// sgrib byed skyon gyi g.ya' dag nas// yon tan mngon par gsal gyur cig/ hūṃ/ 'di na 'jig rten lam tsam gyi// 'dod pa rnams la chags bral dang // dug gsum rags pa dang bcas pa'i// lha dang drang srong mu stegs byed// de nyid kyis brjod gsang sngags dang // sman gyi cho ga'ang mthu ldan na// nyes can cod nas legs byung pa'i// 'dren mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka'// nam yang bslu ba'i go skabs ni// 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin na// gsang sngags sbyor ba las byung ba'i// dag byed khrus kyi cho ga 'dis// mi mthun pa rnams mthun pa dang // ma snyoms pa kun snyoms byed dang // sman rnams mthu dang ldan gyur te// zhi dang bkra shis byed gyur cig/gnyis pa bgegs bskrad ni/ hūṃ/ nyon cig skal med sogs brjod la/ gu gul bdug cing / rdzas thun brabs/ hūṃ hrīḥ rang byung ye shes sogs kyis srung 'khor bsgom// de nas sposadakar a gar tsanda tsandan sogs dri zhim po'i dud pa dang / mnol bsangs kyis bdug cing gtsang bar bya/ sman rnams dar dmar gyis bkab la dme yugs dang dam nyams ma 'dres pa thabs kyis bsal/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bshad rgyud nas rang nyid sman blar gsal zhing gzungs bzlas te byin rlabs byed pa tsam las ma gsungs la/ o rgyan chen po dang / g.yu thog zhabs/ grub thob o rgyan pa/ dam pa dang / thang stong / ras chung pa rnams kyi sman dang ril sgrub rnams ni mdun bskyed gsal zhing slar 'od zhu byed de/ lha tshogs thams cad sman gyi rnam par gyur par bsams pa dang / gzhan baṃ sgrub myong grol chos sman rnams kyang lha'i rnam par gyur pa yin phyir phyogs mtshungs yin la/ de'i phyir 'dir yang bdag mdun so sor bsgrub pa las/dang po bdag bskyed ni/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'khod de theg chen gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam

༄༅slobs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan/ 37dang bcas pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' rtsa gsum sman bla'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa gsal btab ste/ brgyud 'debs/ rgyal ba ma lus zhes dang / 'di phyi'i gtan mdun sogs gang rung mthar/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo rigs 'dus rdo rje 'chang // sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar dkyus bzhin du gyer la/ dmigs pa rtse gcig pas bzlas pa ci nus mthar/ hūṃ hrīḥ skye med dbyings las sogs kyis dzab ('dzabakabastod bya/ dbang dang 'brel na rdzas so lngas bkang ba'i bum pa mdun du bshams la/ yibadzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ bum pa 'od lnga'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bla ma rigs 'dus kyi lha tshogs thams cad rgya mcho la gza' skar shar ba ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas ye shes pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med par spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ sa mā ya tiṣṭha lhan/ a ti pu haḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi/ mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa// rdo rje'i glu dang gar gyis mchod// bzhes nas dngos grub ma lus stsol// oṃ arbhe nas shapta'i bar dang /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba li /li ta khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin// ma lus ye shes dkyil 'khor gcig tu shar// rtsa gsum rigs 'dus sman bla drang srong tshogs// rig pa'i rang mdangs shar la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas gzungs thag drangs la/ rang srog sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brgyud de song bas/ bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āḥlha badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥlha swāhā/skyi lī māṃ ṭwāṃ tī/ hrīḥ ma ha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring sarba sirnyi sa ma ya/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ a mṛ ta dzī banti lha ṣa byo sarba sirnyi hūṃ hoḥ zhes ci nas bzlas la/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya bcas lan gsum res brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ phyi nang gsang ba sogs kyis mchod bstod mthar/ dung chos kyi mchod yon bum par phul la/ oṃ āḥ lha/ bum lha 'od

38 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigadu zhu nas bum chu dang gnyis med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/zhes rnam bum bsgrub/ dbang dang ma 'brel yang gzungs rdor las bum du drangs la/ las bum mi dmigs stong ba'i ngang las stha las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus su hūṃ las khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog sngon po phyag gnyis rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pa khro bo'i rgyan chas yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i thugs kur nyi ma'i steng du sngags kyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ o badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas mthar/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod la/ yi salha sogs kyis mchod/ hūṃ/rnam/ dag chos dbyings rang bzhin las// ma 'gags rol pa'i skur ston pa//khro rgyal yongs kyi mthu stobs kun// gcig bsdus bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bstod//bum lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu khro bo'i rdul phra rab tu gyur nas las rnams 'grub par gyur par bsam/gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ dkyil 'khor las bum chus bsangs la/ oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa atpa ko3 haṃ/ mdun gyi sman rgyal dkyil 'khor mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dbus su ndhu yig kha dog lnga ldan yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang lta na sdug pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa byang chub mchog gi chos sum cu rtsa bdun brda don rtags kyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su bam̐ las padma (redab ma bzhi dbus dang lnga'i lte bar ma las nyi ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bdud bzhi gan rkyal du bskyel ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ ye ge hrīḥdangs ma byu ru'i mdog lta bu dang / 'dab ma bzhi la nyi ma dang ro'i steng du ha ri ni sa bzhi mthing ser dmar ljang 'od dang bcas pa gsal ba las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lha dang / snod gzhal

༄༅rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan/ 39 yas khang du byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje dang gri gug/ 'dab ma bzhir gri gug re re /rer gyur/ de yang 'od du ltems kyis zhu ba las skad cig gis chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul gyis dbang gi lha mchog dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kur 'dzin pa/ dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher 'ing /zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs kyis rol pa'i pang du/ yum rdo rje phag mo khro zhing 'dzum pa dbu'i steng na phag zhal gyis mtshan pa/ nu ma bha ga rgyas pa chags pa'i nyams can gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khril zhing / ya ba yum gnyis kha'ang dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rnam par 'gying zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan par bzhugs pa'i spyi bor padma'i sdong po 'dab ma bzhi dbus dang lnga'i lte bar gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog mthing gsal 'a' gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rnam snang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam bzhag gi steng du bsnams pa/zhabs skyil krung gas bzhugs pa'i pang du yum de bzhin dbyings phyug ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rin 'byung sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin chen dbang rgyal thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag steng du bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang

40 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadu yum rin chen dbyings phyug ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rgyab kyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes snang mtha' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum padma dbyings phyug ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgya gram thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum las kyi dbyings phyug ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras te/ khro 'dzum 'gying ldem sgeg pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o// rta mchog rol pa'i phyogs bzhir padma 'dab ma bzhi la rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi mkha' 'gro bzhi sku mdog mthing ser dmar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kur bsnams pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang dus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis brgyan pa/ gar stabs dang ldan pas bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / dpal phyag na rdo rje dang / kun dga' bo/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu sogs nang pa'i 'khor tshogs/ de'i phyi rol du lha dang drang srong / phyi pa dang nang pa'i 'khor tshogs kyis bskor zhing / skye dgu'i bdag po/ tha skar dang / dbang po brgya byin te lha'i sman pa rnams dang / lha mo bdud rtsi ma la sogs pa lha'i 'khor mang po dang / drang srong chen po rgyun shes kyi bu sogs drang srong gi 'khor tshogs/ mu stegs kyi mes po tshangs pa sogs mu stegs kyi 'khor tshogs/ lha sman mched gsum sogs sman mo'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i tshul

༄༅rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan/ 45rlabs sman gyi bcud phob cig/ lha dang drang srong phyi nang sde bzhi'i 'khor//rang las mi gzhan sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams// bdud rtsi sman gyi dngos grub ster la dbang // gnas dus rdzas la bdud rtsi'i byin phob cig/ snang ba ma 'gags skye med chos dbyings klong // rang rtsal ma 'gags padma'i rigs las 'khrungs// bde chen gar gyis rol pa'i dngos grub stsol// rta mchog yab yum byin rlabs 'dir phob cig/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro 'phrin las bzhi la dbang // bdud bzhi zil gnon tshad med bzhi yi dngos// gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib pa sbyong mdzad bzhis// 'khor lo bzhi la dus 'dir byin phob cig/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba// legs nyes dbang mdzad dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol// gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs//chos skyong dam can tshogs kyis byin phob cig/ sngon tshe rgyal sras gu ṇa'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srog gi snying po phul// sman gyi bstan pa skyong bar mthu ldan pa// bod khams bstan ma'i tshogs kyis byin phob cig/ lha klu dri za gtsang sbra la gnas shing // sman mo mi 'gyur sman gyi bstan pa bsrung //snang gsal pra yi dngos grub ster nus rnams// dam las ma 'da' dus 'dir byin phob cig/ e ma e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// spro dga' bkra shes pho brang a la la// bla ma'i byin rlabs char rgyun si li li// yi dam dngos grub rgya mtsho me re re// mkha' 'gro'i 'phrin las glog ltar khyugs se khyug/ khro tshogs hūṃ phaṭa 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// chos skyong dgra bo'i srog la rubs se rub// rig 'dzin drang srong sprin ltar thibs se thib// sna tshogs lha mo'i glu dbyangs kyu ru ru// rnam mang mchod pa'i bkod pa lings se ling // dri zhim spos kyi dud pa thu lu lu// rab snyan lha yi rol mo khro lo lo// sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub 'khyil li li// bdud rtsi sman gyi char pa sha ra ra// 'dir gshegs gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlobs// skal ldan bu la dbang mchog bskur du gsol// sku yi

46 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigadabang bskur byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par mdzod// gsung gi dbang bskur byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par mdzod// thugs kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs sems la zhugs// yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par mdzod// sku gsung thugs dbang ma lus yid la phob// sgrib gsum dag nas sku gsum mngon 'gyur shog/ 'di nyid reg mthong myong ba tsam gyis kyang // rgyu 'bras dug lnga'i nad las yongs grol te// tshe ring chos nor bde ba mchog thob pa'i//byin rlabs nus dbang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol// oṃ āḥ〉 badzra mahā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ kā ya wākka tsitta a dhi ṣṭha na a dhi khyi te a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ zhes dmigs pa rtse gcig pas byin dbab/ de nas byin rlabs brtan par bya phyir rnga chen rol mo'i bye brag snyir (ldir zhing / me tog gi sil ma rten dang yo byad rnams la 'thor bzhin pas/ oṃ/ bdag mdun sman bla drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs// thusas las 'od 'phros phyi snod 'byung ba'i bcud// sa rdo ri brag rin chen ri bo dang // rtsi bcud sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bcud// bdud rtsi sman du ma gyur gang yang med// bsgrub pa'i rdzas la bcud mchog brtan gyur cig/ nang bcud skye 'gro'i sha khrag drod dbugs mdangs// tshe dpal bsod nams gzi brjid longs spyod dang // phyogs dus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nas pa'i stobs// lung rtogs yon tan bkra shis rdzas rtags kyi// rnam pa bsgrub pa'i rdzas la brtan gyur cig/ rgyal ba'i sku dang ye shes yig 'bru dang // phyag mtshan bum bzang nyi zla'i rnam pa ru// 'od kyi rnam pas drangs te sgrub rdzas la// sib sib thim pas mthu nus gzi brjid 'bar//drang srong rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyis// bkra shes glu dbyangs rol mo'i dbyangs snyan dang // me tog gur gum mchod pa'i rdzas rnams kyi// char du bsnyil zhing byin rlabs brtan par mdzad(mdzod1/ / sman srung dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sde dgu yis// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad ring du bskrad//

kun la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig/rlung mkhris bad kun ba'i brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad// tshe la bar du gcod pa 'i ba dang // gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang // ye 'bros sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa// tshe yi bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzod// ces brjod la/oṃ āḥ& badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te lha 'u byo gu ru beeḍūrya/ pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ba dang / mjug tu sher snying bzlog pa bya zhing / nang du log ste byin 'bebs brtan bzhugs rgyas par bya/ de ltar zhag grangs rab bdun gsum/ 'bring bdun gnyis/ tha ma bdun gcig yang tha'ang 'ag gsum las mi nyung bar bsgrub par bya zhing / grol ba'i nyin par dngos grub len chog tshul du dbang dang 'brel na gong gi tshogs lhag 'gor bdag 'jug blangs la/ phyi dbang dgos tshe bka' rab 'byams kyi gtor kun la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig/rlung mkhris bad kun ba'i brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad// tshe la bar du gcod pa 'i ba dang // gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang // ye 'bros sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa// tshe yi bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzod// ces brjod la/oṃ āḥ& badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te lha 'u byo gu ru beeḍūrya/ pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te saṃ myakarma bud dha ya tabya thā/oṃ lha ṣa rdzu bhi ṣa dzre mahā lha ṣa pyo rā dza sa mung ga te swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas te me tog 'thor// de nas gdan la 'khod de tshogs lhag dang bskang gso'i rjes chog rnams dkyus bzhin bya/rgyun pa rnams kyis bskyed rim mi bsdu zhing / gsar byung rnams bsnyen pa la babs tshe rjes chog bskyed rim bsdu ba rnams phyag len ltar bya'o// de ltar nyin re la thun bzhi re bya ste/ thun gong ma gsum la dus tshod dang bstun nas drag sngags bzla ba dang / las byang dkyus kyi byin 'bebs dang brtan bzhugs tsam bya la/ thun rjes ma la gong ltar cha gsum bsngo ba dang / mjug tu sher snying bzlog pa bya zhing / nang du log ste byin 'bebs brtan bzhugs rgyas par bya/ de ltar zhag grangs rab bdun gsum/ 'bring bdun gnyis/ tha ma bdun gcig yang tha'ang 'ag gsum las mi nyung bar bsgrub par bya zhing / grol ba'i nyin par dngos grub len chog tshul du dbang dang 'brel na gong gi tshogs lhag 'gor bdag 'jug blangs la/ phyi dbang dgos tshe bka' rab 'byams kyi gtor dbang tsam bskur

48 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigabs 'thus/ gzhan yang sbyin sreg sogs zhi rgyas kyi las gang bsgrub kyang skabs 'dir bya bar rigs so// de nas/ oṃ/ phyi nang gsang ba sogs dang / hūṃ/ rigs 'dus bla ma rgyal ba'i gtso// zhes pas mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams la mchod bstod bzod gsol byas te/ lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas sman gyi rnam par gyur te sman rnams ro nas zhu rjes phun sum tshogs pa'i myong grol 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ sman snod thams cad kha phye zhing / sman phye yod na bdud rtsi la cung zad re btab ste/rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtshor mchod (mchod pa'i rdzas su shes par byas nas/ slob dpon dang las rdor rnams kyis bdud rtsi 'thor bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ hūṃ hrīḥ rang sems skye med chos skur ngo 'phrod pa'i// bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mchog thun dngos grub dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i// brgyud pa'i bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// phung khams skye mched gdod nas rnam dag pa'i// rang lus yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol//dam tshig can la dngos grub bde ster ba'i// ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// rgyal ba'i bstan srung zhing bcu sgrol la brtson// chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// skyabs mgon dpung gyur mchod 'os yi dam lha// rang snang dag pa'i gtso 'khor khyed rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mchod pa'i mthus// khams gsum yongs sgrol 'khor ba dong sprugs shog/

༄༅rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan/ 49hrīḥ 'khor 'das phyi nang gsang ba shes bya dang // sogs kyis dngos grub blangs/rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdag nyid sman bla yi// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zungs su yongs grub pa// 'chi med dngos grub ster byed bcud len gyi// 'khrul med cho ga nyams su bstar pa'i mthus// nad gdon bgegs rigs bar chad las rgyal zhing // snang srid sman gyi rol par 'char ba dang // mthong thos dran reg nad pa'i tshogs rnams kun// nad med bde dga' rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog/ces brjod/ bdud rtsi rol la/ sman gyi dwangs bcud 'od lnga'i thig ler 'dril ba rang gi snying khar thim pas rtsa 'khor bzhi la khyab ste nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par gyur par bsams la/ de nas tshogs lhag sogs gong bzhin cho ga'i mjug bsdu zhing / gzhan yang smon lam ni/ dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang // 'jig rten mgon gyur bden tshig grub rnams kyis// smon pa'i gnas kun bdag gis 'grub gyur nas// sman pa'i rgyal po lta bur 'gyur bar shog/ 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs mthus// srid zhi'i 'jigs tshogs ma lus drungs phyungs nas// rig pa'i ye shes sman rgyal go 'phang mchog/ tshe 'dir mngon gyur 'gro kun sgrol bar shog/ rgyal ba kun 'dus mahā gu ṇa yi// dgongs bcud gso rig rim gnyis rnal 'byor che'i// gzhung lam (lugs rgya mtsho rgyud bzhi cha lag bcas// bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs (sgrong par shog/ dug lngas gzir ba'i nyam thag 'gro ba rnams// rgyu las 'bras bu'i tshul smin nad kyi rigs// khyad par lci ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal ba// bsgral ba'i ded dpon mchog tu bdag 'gyur shog/ ji srid nad kyi bskal ba dar ba'i tshe//drang srong sman gyi bla ma'i dpung grogs bcas// thabs mkhas thugs rjes nad kyi dpung bcom nas// sman pa'i rgyal po mchog tu 'gyur bar shog/ mtshon gyi bskal par skyob byed go cha dang // mu ge'i bskal par gang 'dod zas skom

50 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thiganor// tshe yi snyigs mar 'chi med dpal ster rtsi// mun bskal sgron me mchog tu bdag 'gyur shog/ rgyu gcig rang ngo ma shes ma rig pas// zhe sdang mkhris nad tshad pa'i nad rnams dang // 'dod chags rlung nad gti mug bad kun grang // dug gsum nyes gsum sku gsum ngo 'phrod shog/ ltar snang 'phral dang yongs grub tshe yi nad// kun brtags gdon dang gzhan dbang sngon las bzhi'i// phan byed gnyen po 'byung lnga'i ro bcud dang // sman dang sman pa nad g.yog byed par shog/ byams pa'i gzhi bzung snying rje'i shugs phyung ste//smon dang 'jug pa'i phyin drug spyod pa yi// lhag bsam khur gyis mkha' khyab skye 'gro gang // gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde ster nas shog/ skye zhing skye bar bdag ni mthong thos dran// reg pa'i mod la nad zhi srid gsum gyi//nyam thag 'gro rnams bde skyid phun sum tshogs// myur du sku gsum go 'phang thob par shog/ yul ris sa phyogs rgyal khams thams cad du// 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug mi mthun phyogs// zhi zhing rgyal dang de sras drang srong gi/rnam sprul dpag med mgon gyis gang bar shog/ bde gshegs brgyad dang rig pa'i ye shes lnga'i// bden mthus sgo gsum drang por srong ba'i lam//gzhan rgyud nyes pa ma snyoms snyoms byed rgyu// drang srong rgyal ba'i ring lugs 'phel gyur cig/ shes brjod ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha//sman gyi bstan srung mkha' 'gro drang srong rjogs// phun tshogs rnam par dge ba'i bkra shis kyis// yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab par shog/ gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs brjod nas me tog gi char 'bebs par bya'o// de tsam mi nus pa'i rang gcig pu'am/ spros pa bskyungs na rang nyid sman bla'i bdag bskyed gang rung bsgoms la/ sman rnams khrus dang bgegs bskud byas te stegs kyi khar bkod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi bcud dang 'byung ba lnga'i ro bcud nus pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas sman rnams dang ro

༄7rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dbongs pa'i rgyan/ 51gcig tu gyur par bsams la/ dmigs pa ma yengs par sman bla'i gzungs ring thung rab stong phrag tha ma brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba dang / mjug sman gyi byin rlabs bsdu ba'i sngags lnga brgya tsam re bzlas te rab gnas dang bden tshig dngos grub len pa sogs byas pas kyang don 'grub bo//gnyis pa rdul tshon chur sbyang ba ni/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tshan rnams bum par blugs te 'bras bu can gyi shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas te/ rdo rje'i ging pas bsnams nas ser sbreng rnga rol dang bcas chu bo zla gam 'khyil ba lta bur song nas/ 'bru tshom gyi khar bum pa bkod la rdzas rnams lhar bskyed/ las byang 'don/ de nas yul rdzas lhar gsal ba/ gnyis med bstim pa/ che ba bskyed pa dang bzhi las/ dang po yul gsal ba ni/ hūṃ phroṃ lī sum̐/ 'byung ba rnam par dag pa'i lam// yum chen mā ma gī yi mkha'// mkha' klong rnam par dag pa ni//shes rab kun tu bzang mo dngos// dngos dang dngos med dag pa yis//'gro ba'i dpal du cir yang snang // rnam par bzhengs pa'i bcom ldan mo//chos nyid ye nas mā ma gi'o// gnyis pa rdzas rnams gsal ba ni/ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad bzhin// kha dog ye shes lnga yi dngos// gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes sku// 'gro ba'i dpal du cir yang snang // gsang sngags thabs kyi khyad par gyis// thabs kyi ye shes kun bsgrubs pas// 'gro 'dul thabs la 'gags pa med// snying po rten rnams kun gyi brten// gsum pa gnyis med bstim pa ni/ e ma hoḥ gnyis med bde klong dag pa che// yum chen mā ma kyi yi klong //bcom ldan ye shes bzhugs su gsol// thabs shes gnyis su med par bzhugs// e ma hoḥ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med lha// ji srid chu bo'i rgyun ji bzhin// de srid bar du 'gro don mdzod// 'brel tshad mnyam pa nyid du sgrol// e ma hoḥ 'di ni thabs kyi thabs chen po// dang po bum pa'i chu bo bzhin// gnyis pa thabs shes ye shes bzhin// gsum pa shes rab las byung ba'i// thabs kyi thabs ni thabs chen po// bskal pa'i bar du 'gro don mdzod// bzhi pa che ba bskyed pa ni/ e ma hoḥ thabs kyi khyad par las byung ba'i//sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzad// gsang ba gsang chen nges pa yi/

52 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaye shes bla med dkyil 'khor du// rgyud dang sgrub thabs man ngag gi/ dkyil 'khor gsum bzhi lnga'am bdun// la brten bsnyen pa nye bar bsnyen// sgrub pa sgrub chen 'phrin las bcas// grub na yongs rdzogs snyigs ma yi// shes rab rten gyi rus par bcas/ nub pa med par rab 'phel ba'i// rgyal ba'i mkha' klong yangs par bstim// rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'byung lnga yi// de srid 'gro don rab 'phel bar// ye shes kun mkhyen dam pa'i lam// zhes rdul tshon chur gshegs shing gzungs sngags bzlas la/ mthar smon lam ni/ hrīḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso// padma 'byung gnas rgyal tshab gnyis pa yi// grub chen bka' babs lung gis gzhi bzung nas// lha dang rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzas// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs rje chags pa'i rten//phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i smon lam las grub pa'i// 'byung phung ye shes lnga 'dus rdzas mchog 'di// chu dang rgya mtshos gar khyab 'gro ba'i don// rgya mtsho'i rlangs pas gar khyab mkha' mnyam gyi// 'gro rnams ma lus srid mtsho sgrol bar shog/ rlan dang gsher gyi 'byung gnas gar khyab pa// sa 'og sa steng sa bla gar gnas dang // chu la gnas tshad 'gro kun rang grol shog/ gzhan yang nam mkhas khyab tshad 'gro ba rnams// phyam gcig dkyil 'khor 'khor lor dbyer med par// rol pa gcig pa'i sku dang ye shes dang // mdzad pa 'phrin las chos kyi rgyal por shog/ ces brjod do/ gsum pa phan yon ni/ de ltar rgyas bsdus gangabyas kyang byin gyis brlabs pa'i sman khrol phye gang yin de nyid 'dod rgur 'byung ba'i nor dang mtshungs pas/ gtsang sbra chen pos phyag mchod bkur sti'i gnas su 'dzin cing / dam nyams sdig can khyi dang byi la bud med sogs kyis reg par mi byed de/ byin rlabs ma byas pa'i sman rnams la'ang phab rgyun ci 'gro bya/ sman snod kyang dam sdom nyams pa'i rigs dang bud med dme yugs sogs kyis reg tu mi 'jug g.yog tu mi bkol/ gzhan yang sman rnams 'gom yug 'bags btsog gis ma gos par bya'o// de ltar bgyis na rang gzhan gyi nad sel ba'i bdud rtsi dang dbyer med cing / sman de nyid nad par ster ba'i dus su'ang pha ma nad kyis zin pa'i bus mi bzod pa ltar snying rje drag pos

༄7rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan/ 53kun nas bslangs te/ sdug bsngal 'di bsal nas bde ba'i dpal la myur du 'god thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i skyabs sems gsol 'debs shugs drag tu bya la/ rang nyid sman pa'i rgyal por gsal ba'i ngang nas/ 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// sogs gong ltar brjod cing sman sbyin/ mjug tu 'gro mgon ma hā gu ṇa'i gsol 'debs dang / rgyun khyer bar chad sel ba las gsungs pa'i/ sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po bdag skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la blo gros rgyas te phan thogs nyi zla ltar 'byung bar gyur cig smras tshad mngon shes su gyur cig sbyar tshad sogs brjod la/ de ltar 'grub pa'i bden tshig dang smon lam gang shes bya/ gzhan ni bsam pa log pas nor 'dod dang che 'dod sogs kyi ched du dmigs na phan thogs mi 'byung zhing / rang yang sman gyi dam tshig bslab bya dang 'gal bas gnas skabs su 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa'i mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung ba dang / phyi ma rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu bsru ba med pas ngan song du skye ba'i phyir/ bsam pa bzang po'i dge sems dang ldan pa ci nas rigs so// de'i phyir lhag pa'i bsam pa yang dag pas kun nas bslangs te ji ltar nad kyis gdungs pa'i sems can gang dag bde ba'i dpal la 'god pa'i ched du gom pa gang dor ba'am/ sman thun gcig sbyin nam/ yo byad gang ci ster ba'i 'bras bu ni bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang ste/ mdo las/ nad pa gang gi phyir du sman thun gcig gam/ yo byad sna gcig byin pa'am/ gom pa gang dor na tshe 'dir bsod nams kyi tshogasardzogs te/ phyi ma ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs nas byang chub chen po thob bo/ zhes dang / sngon rgya gar na dbus kyi rgyal po tsand+ra zhes bya ba skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa tsam yang med pa zhig gis nad pa'i don kho na byas pas/ tshe der theg chen dgra bcom mngon du byas pa'i lo rgyus ltar na/ nad pa'i bya ba kho na don du gnyer ba las zab pa'i gdams pa 'jig rten 'di na med par bstan to// rgyal ba g.yu thog pas/ nad pa mgon med brtse bas skyongs// nye ring med pa'i 'gro don mdzod// ser sna spangs pa'i sman sbyin thongs// sman thun gcig gi sbyin pa 'di// sbyin pa brgya yis do zla min/ zhes dang / mdo las/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang / nad pa dang ni chos smra dang / skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ yon ni gzhal du med par bshad// ces nad pa dang chos smra ba sogs spyi la rim gro bya ba'i phan yon gsungs pa dang / 'dul ba lung las/ rgyal po gzi mig can gyis slob lam du tshogs gzhan ma bsags par nad pa'i bya ba kho na byas pas/ tshe der dga' bde dpal 'byor dang ldan zhing / phyi mar sa lam mtha' dag bgrod nas mngon par byang chub par gyur pa ni/ las dang smon lam mtha' btsan zhing nad pa'i bya ba byas pa'i don du gsungs pa dang / dkon brtsegs las/ rdo rje rab

54 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thiga'ajoms/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang gi rmi lam na/ bdag sems can nad pa rnams gso bar kun tu shes na byang chub sems dpa' de ni sa dang po brgyad pa dag las gang yang rung bar lta ste/ de las kyi sgrib pa chung ba dang / bdud kyi las shas che bas/ snying rje chen pos yongs su sbyang bar byas shing / gzhan la phan pa la brtson pa dang / phyis re ba med pa yang bya'o// des na de'i sgrib pa de rnam par dag par 'gyur zhing / byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba yang 'gyur ro// gang de'i nad gang zhig gis khye'u sos na sa dang po thob bo// khye'u chung sos nas gnyis pa/ skyes pa sos na sa gsum pa/bud med bu bcas mos na sa bzhi pa/ sdom pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pos na sa lnga pa/ rims nad kyis thebs pa sos na sa drug pa/ skya rbab 'or dmu chu'i nad sos na sa bdun pa/gnyan sha khra glang shu'i sde tshan sa bdag gi nad sos na sa brgyad pa/ skem byed mdze nad sos na sa dgu pa/ 'byung bo dang steng gdon sos na sa bcu pa/ 'dus nad smug po sos na sa bcu gcig pa/ bya gdon pu tra'i nad sos na sa bcu gnyis pa/ khyi smyon gyis zin pa'i nad sos na sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa'o// gzhan yang nad rab tu zhi ba'i mdo las/ nad pa gang zhig gi don du gom pa gang dor na/ de la zas dang skom dang mal cha dang na ba'i gsos sman dang gos dang rgyan la sogs pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// sman thun gcig gam chas gos cha shas gcig byin na bdud kyi las med do// snying rje chen pos zin na ngan song med cing las sgrib dag nas sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ro// zhes dang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ nad gang dang gang gi bye brag sos pa'am/ ma sos kyang sla bcos med par bag yod dang kha nang du bltas pa'i phyir/ gang dang gang gi las byas pa de ni las bzang zhing phyir mi ldog pa'i sa dang po'o// zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis/ sems can mgon med ma nus dang // 'dod yon med dang zug rngus brtagaskyobatabaka/ gnyen med byes su 'khyams pa la// phan yon gzhan gyis do zla med// ces dang / zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba nad pa ji snyed pa// nad sos gyur gyi bar dag tu// sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang //de yi nad g.yog byed par shog/ ces dang / g.yu thog rjes lha sa'i jo bo rin po che la gsol pa/ zag med kyi dge ba gang zhig la/ brjod bral blo 'das bsgom pa phan yon che mod/ zag bcas gang zhig la phan yon gang che zhus pas/ jo bo rin po che'i zhal nas/ zag bcas kyi dge ba bsasas pa la sems can gang zhig gi srog skyabs pa phan yon che/ de bas kyang mi mgon med skyabs med/ ma nus pa/ gos med/ zas med snying rje ba'i yul lam/ chos byed pa'i gegs su 'gro ba'i srog skyabs pa mi gong na med/ bla na med/ gzhan gyis dor bar mi nus/ phun sum tshogs pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog lam gyi rtsa ba/ theg pa'i yang rtse/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i dngos rgyu/ myu gu skye ba'i sa bon dang 'dra'o// pha bla ma byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'khor ba dang ngan

54 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thiga'ajoms/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang gi rmi lam na/ bdag sems can nad pa rnams gso bar kun tu shes na byang chub sems dpa' de ni sa dang po brgyad pa dag las gang yang rung bar lta ste/ de las kyi sgrib pa chung ba dang / bdud kyi las shas che bas/ snying rje chen pos yongs su sbyang bar byas shing / gzhan la phan pa la brtson pa dang / phyis re ba med pa yang bya'o// des na de'i sgrib pa de rnam par dag par 'gyur zhing / byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba yang 'gyur ro// gang de'i nad gang zhig gis khye'u sos na sa dang po thob bo// khye'u chung sos nas gnyis pa/ skyes pa sos na sa gsum pa/bud med bu bcas mos na sa bzhi pa/ sdom pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pos na sa lnga pa/ rims nad kyis thebs pa sos na sa drug pa/ skya rbab 'or dmu chu'i nad sos na sa bdun pa/gnyan sha khra glang shu'i sde tshan sa bdag gi nad sos na sa brgyad pa/ skem byed mdze nad sos na sa dgu pa/ 'byung bo dang steng gdon sos na sa bcu pa/ 'dus nad smug po sos na sa bcu gcig pa/ bya gdon pu tra'i nad sos na sa bcu gnyis pa/ khyi smyon gyis zin pa'i nad sos na sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa'o// gzhan yang nad rab tu zhi ba'i mdo las/ nad pa gang zhig gi don du gom pa gang dor na/ de la zas dang skom dang mal cha dang na ba'i gsos sman dang gos dang rgyan la sogs pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// sman thun gcig gam chas gos cha shas gcig byin na bdud kyi las med do// snying rje chen pos zin na ngan song med cing las sgrib dag nas sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ro// zhes dang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ nad gang dang gang gi bye brag sos pa'am/ ma sos kyang sla bcos med par bag yod dang kha nang du bltas pa'i phyir/ gang dang gang gi las byas pa de ni las bzang zhing phyir mi ldog pa'i sa dang
