༄7rlabs chen rgyal ba'i spyod pa las/ sman sgrub drang srong dgongs pa'i rgyan/ 55song gi rgyu mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs byed pa'i dam nyams sdig can dmu rgod 'dul dka'i 'gro ba phal mo che'i srog skyabs pa la'ang / phan yon gzhal du med/ de yang bag med pa dang / rlom sems dang / khong khro dang / ser sna dang / phrag dog dang / gzhogs slong spangs te/ byams snying rje'i gzhi bzung / khrel ngo tsha'i gos gyon/ brtson 'grus drag po dang / sems bskyed bzang po'i rgyan btags/man ngag gnad ldan gyi lag cha thogs/ cha dpyad 'dzom po grogs su sbran/ lta ba rnam dag gis rtsis zin na phan yon gzhal du med/ brjod du med/ dpag par dka'/ bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa yin/yi dam mnyes pa'i dam rdzas yin/ mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs 'khor yin/ ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba/ ma phyin par sa lam bgrod nus pa/ ma byas par lam sna zin pa'i gdams ngag bya sla tshegs chung don che/ dpag par dka' ba myur du 'grub pa/ bla ma bai ḍūrya'i yi che ba dgu// yid ches bdun yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa sangs rgyas lag bcang gi gdams pa yin no// zhes gsungs pas de ltar na rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i dgos 'byung nor bu rin chen dbang gi rgyal po gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'di nyid don dang lngan par bya'o//slar smras pa/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir phan bde'i mchog gsum gdugs// byams brtses khor yug khyab pa'i grib bsil du// skye dgu ma lus bde la 'god pa'i gnyen// bsod nams zhing mchog phyag na pad dkar rgyal//rmongs pa'i mun sel 'jam mgon khri srong rjes/rje / / slob lam dam bca'i thugs bskyed yongs smin pa'i// lugs zung nyi zlas tshul min mun pa'i smag/mthar byed 'od stong 'phrin las bsam mas 'das// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnyen po mtha' yas kyi// rtser son rgyud bzhi cha lag sman sgrub bcas // drang srong brgyud pa'i phyag srol dbang gi rgyal// mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod// dge de'i lhag bsam ma la ya klung nas// mtha' klas 'gro khams dgyes pa'i tsandan dris// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i gcong nad tsha sadung dpung // gzhom nas sku gsum go 'phang mchog thob shog/ / /cesasan gyi pho brang gnyis pa lcags ri bee ḍūr lta na ngo mtshar 'gro phan rig byed gling gi 'tsho mdzad bla sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / gso rig gzhung kun byang chub pa'i dge rgan rnams dang bcas pas yang yang bskul zhing / rang nas kyang lhag bsam bdud rtsi'i zla ba ying la byas

56 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigate/ sman sgrub thebs su dngul ṭam srang brgya tham pa 'bul lam zhus shing / khyad par gzhung sa mchog nas rtsa ba'i sgrub rten yo byad dang bcas pa sbyor 'jags bka' drin stsal pa'i tshe/ 7bde bar gshegs pa dpal brtsegs rgyal po bsam bzhin mtshan dpe'i lang tsho gsar du ngom pa7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po dang /7'jam dbyangs mi'i rnam rol chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi zlos gar〉srid skyong yongs 'dzin de mo ho thog thu mdun na 'don dang bcas pas lags gse'i (so'i dbugs dbyung dang bcas bka'i gnang ba stsal bar brten/ gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs la mos pa phran bu tsam yod pa kurma 'jigs med chos kyi seng gis drang srong gong ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rnams kyi gzhung dang / khyad par gu ṇa'i rjes 'jug 'gro 'dul rdo rje'i sman gyi byin rlabs chen mo sogs la gzhir byas/ rgyud gzhung lung rigs dang 'thad pa'i man ngag gis brgyan te/ 7'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs/ dge legs rnam par bkra ba'i bkra shis bum pa ri'i nye 'dabs/ dngas bsil yan lag brgyad ldan gyi klung rgyun 'bab pa'i 'gram/ byang chub ljon pa'i skyed mos tshal/ rang nyid kyi bsam gtan khang bu kun dga' rwa ba'i bste gnas su bdud rtsi thun 'char gyi nyin dge bar bris pas/'gro rnams dug lnga'i nad las grol te/ sku gsum sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang tshe 'dir thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣanta thā ga to hya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥye swāhā// sman sgrub drang srong dgongs rgyan 'di bzhin rab tshes sa byi lo gzhung sa mchog nas bstan pa'i gsos sman du bzhengs pa'i par 'di lcags ri bai ḍūr 'gro phan rig byed gling du bzhugs//sarba maṅga lam̐// / /

57༄khya// g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rnam par rgyal lo//na mo mahā gu ru ya/ gdod nas rnam dag chos sku mi shigs pa'i// ngo bor mngon byang chub las ye shes nyid// dug gsum smag rum sel mdzad sman rgyal dang // rnam dbyer mi phyed drin can bla mar 'dud// 'gro ba'i bde gshegs snying nor srid mtsho'i rum// dor de 'tshol slad gru 'dzin mgon po mchog/ rang rtags zur phud bor nas ngur smrig gi/ rnam rol rgyal dbang rim byon gtsug gi rgyan// sems nyid ye nas spros dang bral ba'i gzhi// bral 'bras bde chen snang bzhi'i blar grol phyir// lam bzang smin grol bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// skal ldan tshim byed cho gar gcig tu spro// de yang gaspo las/ rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor du// slob ma rab gzhug dbang bskur te// bya bral rdzogs pa'i man ngag bstan// ting 'dzin brtan pa'i dkyil 'khor du// slob ma 'bring gzhug dbang bskur te// bskyed rdzogs grub pa'i man ngag bstan/ gzugs brnyan bsnyen sgrub dkyil 'khor du// tha ma'i slob gzhug dbang bskur te// rim gyis blo sbyangs man ngag bstan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar slob bu mchog 'bring tha ma'i rigs can la ye shes ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du rigs pa dang 'tshams pa'i dbang bskur nas de dang de'i man ngag rnams ston par gsungs pa las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas nas sgrub pa'i rim pa la/ rtsa ba mchog dbang / smin byed don dbang / sman gyi lha mo'i rjes gnang / drang srong ser skya'i rig gtad/ mtha' rten tshe dbang bskur thabs dang lnga las/dang po la'ang sbyor ba dkyil 'khor yo byad 'du bya zhing sgrub cing mchod pa la sogs pa'i las kyi rim pas khog 'bub pa/ dngos gzhi bskur ba'i thabs rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs sam/ padma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog bshams

58 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigapa'i dbus su mañdzi la bum pa mtshan ldan rdzas nyer lnga'i bcud kyis gang ba kha brgyan mgul 'ching can bkod/ mdun du ka pā la a mṛ tas gang ba me long gis kha bcad pa'i steng du/ ga bur/ shing kun/gser mdog bzang drug bcas bzhag rgyab tu gzhung gtor lnga/ bla ma'i gtor ma dmar zlum pad 'dab dang ril bu bzhis bskor ba/ yi dam gyi gtor ma dmar po gru bzhi bshos phran brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mkha' 'gro'i dpal gtor dmar po padmas bskor ba/ drang srong gi dkar gtor zlum po padmas bskor ba/ bka' srung gi gtor ma gru gsum dmar po gru gsum bdun dang gru gsum g.yas bcus (bcu gcig bcas kyis bskor/ sman rag(raka sku tsaka rnams dang rdor dril/ me long /shelardo/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ rin po che'i gos rgyan/ gtar bsreg sogs sman dpyad/ rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa'i pu ste /ti mthar nyer spyod sogs spyi dang mthun par bshams/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su mig dar/ me tog mar me/ dam chu sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du byas nas las gzhung bsrang ba ni/ rje lnga pa chen po'i gsung las byang dpag bsam ljon shing ltar bdag mdun chabs cig tu sgrub pa las/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la ddhi yig gsal bar gyur/de las 'od zer 'phros rgya9 tsho ba mchod/ 'gro ba'i don byas tshur 'dus sbyi la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar pa bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar bskyed/ ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ phyag rgya bzhis bstim/ lkobadzra ambha nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings bde chen kun gsal yangs pa'i ngos// sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rta ljang dbang po yi//mchog thun dngos grub 'dab brgya bzhad mdzad pa'i// rtsa gsum rigs 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes bstod/ gzungs thag la 'jus nas/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la// 'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kur zhugs// de dag sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun// 'bab pas bum chur gnyis med ro gcig gyur// zhes bzlas pa brgya stong ci rigs kyi nus ldan du sgrub nas dung zhal gyi mchod yon/ i āḥ& gis phul bas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang me long sman dang bcas pa 'chi med bdud

༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 59rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsam ste/ rma āḥlha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrī ṭhaḥzhes ci nus bzlasapas byin rlobs/ bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gus pas 'dug ste/ oṃ/ ye shes rgyal po sogs kyis rig pa'i me dor /gtor nas/ slob ma gzhug par gnang ba zhu ba ni/oṃ/ ye shes rdo rje thob byed pa'i// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// pho brang snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bya// zhes gsol bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyi slob bu dkyil 'khor du chug la dbang snod dang 'tshams par bskur cig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam mo//gnyis pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba la 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dngos 'jug pa la phyi nang gnyis kyi phyi 'jug la brgyad las/ dang po spro ba bskyed pa ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob bu khrus byas/ bgegs gtor royis gyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tram̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin rlobs/ sarba bhu ta a kursha ya dzaḥzhes mgron bkug sarba bisna rna i rda ba lidha kha kha khā hiḥ zhes bsngos nas/na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin brlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la/ dbang bskur zab mo sgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par bgyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas khyod rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/zhes hūṃ bzhi pa'i sgra drag po dang bcas phyir bskud/ badzra rakṣa rakṣaḥ zhes bsrung 'khor bsgom/chos bshad ci rigs pa'i mtshams sbyar te/ slob mas maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par brda'/ kye ho/ nyon cig rigs kyi bu// bskal pa grangs med du ma nas// 'bad kyang grol bar mi 'gyur zhing // byang chub

60 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasgrub pa gtan gyi gegs// theg pa dman pa'i lam yin la// u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar// sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa yang // shin tu ches cher rnyed dka' la// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' 'o// gang gis tshe 'dir mchog gyur pas// lam rnyed gyur pas skal ba bzang // dbul pos rin chen gter rnyed dam// byes su stor ba'i bu rnyed pa'i// byis pa gang dag ches dga' na// sdug bsngal kun las rnam grol zhing //bde chen 'gyur med go 'phang mchog/ yud kyi ster bas cis mi spro// de ltar khyed rang rnams bla med gsang sngags kyi lam zab rnyed pa re dga' 'o snyam spro ba bskyed 'tshal/ thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir chas su 'jug pa ni/ sngon chad gnyis 'dzin gyi zhen rtog 'thug pos mig ldong bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma mjal ba'am mjal na'ang dkyil 'khor so ma 'di nyid ma mjal mtshon byed du ras dmar po res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/oṃ tsakṣu bhadha wa ra ma ṇa ye swāhās mig dar bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal tshe phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas phyag tu u dum wā ra'i me tog gi 'phreng ba kha dog lnga pa re bzung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ gis me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad/ gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// 'khor bar mnar ba bdag la gzigs// bde chen rgyal ba'i grong mchog tu// de ring bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol bar gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bu nyon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// gsang chen bla med gsung ba yi// bdud rtsi'i mchog de ngas sbyin gyi// snod dang ldan par khyod gyur to//zhes brjod/ gsum pa rtog pa bsdu ba ni/ ji skad du/ ma yengs rtog pa'i rba rlabs rnams// legs par bsdus te nyan par byos// bde gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs ni// yid gzhan yengs la 'jug mi 'gyur// zhes gdams/ bzhi ba skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi

༄cu/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 61ngo bo sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bzhugs pa la rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba mngon sum du sad (gsal pa'i spyan sngar dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pas/phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum 'dus pa// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rgyal la//bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi//lnga pa sems bskyed pa ni/ mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog sgrub nas// zhi sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi yis// 'gro rnams bde la 'god par bya// drug pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// so so'i ming 'di zhes bgyi bas// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyi// sdig pa mi dge gang byas pa// gnong (nongs zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis su// snying nas khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags// bdun pa sdom pa gzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'dzin// bdag la brtse ba'i dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin gsang sngags bla med kyi// sdom pa ma lus bdag gis bzung // sems can 'gyur med bde la 'god// ces lan gsum rjes bzlos (zlos bya'o// brgyad pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ slob bu'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas la 'bru gsum brjod de phyi 'jug go/gnyis pa nang 'jug la brgyad las/ dang po ni/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor don dam byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par bsam la/ oṃ badzra tsitta āḥbodhi tsitta hūṃ/ zhes brjod du bcug pas sems bskyed/ gnyis pa sbyor ba dam la bzhag pa ni/ gsang chen dam tshig rdo rje'i mchog/bu khyod spyi bor bzhag pas ni// rdo rje'i sku ru khyod nyid 'gyur// 'gyur med ye shes mchog tu 'gyur// gzhan du smras na de lta min// zhes dam la ba'ag gsum pa

da 62 ༄/g.yu thog snying thigamana' chu blud pa ni/ kyai/ bu khyod bdag la nyon// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i byin thob nas// phyi nang gsang ba'i khyad par gyi// dam tshig mtha' dag bsrung nus sam// zhes dris pa la lan gdab pa ni/ lcags la gser 'gyur rtsi bzhin du//gtso bo'i drin las deng 'dir bdag/ bde ba che la reg pa na// bka' las nam yang 'da' re kun// zhesazhu/ 'di ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu// 'thungs nas dam tshig ma srung na// mnar med dmyal bar khyod bsreg cing // srung na dngos grub mchog thob gyur// badzra a mṛ ta sa ma ya hūṃ/ badzra atpa ko3rta/zhes sbyin bzhi pa nang du drang (drangs pa ni/ slob ma slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du drangs pa'i mos pa gyis/ oṃ āḥ& atpa ko3rta hūṃ dzaḥ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas bzhugs/zhugs / gtso bo'i mdun du 'dug par mos la/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru gu ṇa sarba sidhi hūṃ/ zhes rjes su gzung / lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/ khyed rang rnams snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar bas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye ho bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin//sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod// rang la gnas pa'i ye shes mchog/do nub rang sar dbab tu gsol// ye shes dbab pa yin pas khyed rang rnams lus gnad drang por bsrang / ngag gnad rlung kha sbyor tu bcings/sems gnad ma yengs par 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros khyed rang rnams la phog/ rnam smin sha khrag gdos bcas kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan la khyed rang rnams skad cig gas bla ma sman rgyal sku mdog mthing ga dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can phyag g.yas a ru rnam rgyal dang / g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar

༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 63po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kur hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ku'i sa bon las mu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kha char dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa byed du bcug khyad par gyi rdzas dud bdus rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra sbyar te/ las byang dpag bsam ljon shing gi byin 'bebs/ bde chen 'gyur med chos sku'i sogs sam / spyan 'dren/ chos dbyings spros bral ma gang rung mthar rtsa sngags spyi dril la/ dzha na a be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pa drag tu bzla de ltar byin dbab pa'i ye shes pa de rnams la khyed rang rnams la brten par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab cing / tiṣṭha badzra zhes brtan par bya'o// drug pa me tog dor (gtor ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas dbus su dor (gtor ba'i 'dus pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gi re/ tog 'di dor (gtor bas// sngon tshe rabs grangs med nas// rjes su bzung ba'i yi dam lha// gang yin de la 'bab par shog/ pukhre pra tī tstsha hoḥ lha gang la bab /babs pa yi dam du byin/ de'i rigs las gras pa'i gsang mtshan gdags me tog de nyid slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag te/ sngon 'brel lha yi byin gyis rlobs// bar chad bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags// chos sgra rgyal pa'i zhing du sgrog/ cod pan ming bcas dbang thob shog/ pukhye pra tītstsha a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa mig dbye ba ni/ gdod nas rang gsal ye shes mig/ ma rig ling thog gas sgrib pa// do nub rdo rje'i spyan du dbye// dkyil 'khor 'di ltos dngos grub thob// badzra dzha na tsakṣu pra be sha ya āḥ zhes gser gyi thur mas mig dbye ba'i rgya dang gdong g.yogs (g.yog bsal/ brgyad pa mthong ba bstan pa ni/ de ltar shes bya'i sgrib pa gsal (bsal nas ye shes kyi mig gsar du thob pa de la mthong ba bstan par bya ba yin te/ lha ngo bstan pa

64 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigani/ gsang chen rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// lan gcig mthong ba tsam gyis kyang // grangs med bskal ba'i sdig pa dag/ sngags tshul spyod na smos ci dgos// zhes brjod/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la phyi dbang dang / nang gi dbang dang / rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang dang / gsang ba'i dbang / sher dbang / rig ye'i dbang / lta sgom ri'abras spyod bzhi/ mtha' rten gtad rgya dang bcas pa bdun las/ dang po phyi'i dbang la'ang brgyad las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri padma dang nyi zla'i gdan la khyed rang sman rgyal gyi rnam pas 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mor bcas pas mchod/ yisarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣṭhañtsa tu mo zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang baspyi bo nas/ dbang bskur bas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung bag chags thams cad bkrus/ lus nang mer khrig gis gang / snod bcud lha ru dag pa bum pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod// bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ/ spros bral chos sku'i khor yug bum pa zlum// nang gi (ni ye shes lha yi bdud rtsis gang // skal ldan bu la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas//sgrib gnyis rab bkrus bum pa'i dbang thob shog/ oṃ burnya badzra ratna padma kurma mu dra a bhi ṣāñtsa oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes brjod cing bum chu blud/ gnyis pa ni/ rinapo che'i dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan snying por bcas pas dbang bskur bas/rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i bzhugs gnas byin rlabs kun 'byung bya ba thams cad la ma rmongs par dbang bsgyur pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/

༄7g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 65dbu brgyan (rgyan bskon la/ hūṃ/ 'khor lo rin chen rdo rje padma dang / rgya gram sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas rin chen 'od// rab mdzes rin chen prog zhu'i dbang bskur bas// sku lnga rigs lnga ye shes lnga dbang shog/ oṃ badzra burnya ratna padma kurma mu ku ta tā a bhi ṣṭhañtsa āḥ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs pa'i gos klubs la/ hūṃ/ phreng ba snyan cha mgul chu /cha do shal dang // dpung rgyan se mo do dang gdu bu dang // stod smad gos rgyan mdzes pas dbang bskur bas// mi brjed gzungs thob bdud dpung zil gnon pa//mi snyan skyon bral ye shes dbyings su 'khor// dbyings rig yongs 'brel sna tshogs sprul skur 'char// thabs shes dpung ldan gsang sngags rmad du byung //chos kyi khrims ldan nyon mongs tsha grang skyog snying po'i chos 'khor bskor phyir gdu bu ste// rtags la brten nas don mthong dbang thob shog/ rma sarba ratna a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ bzhi pa ni/ sman raka gtor tshogs thod rnga'i dbang bskur te/ hūṃ/rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi dang // 'khor ba dbyings su grol ba'i rakta mchog/ 'dod yon lha mos brgyan pa'i gtor tshogs dang // grag stong sgra 'byin rnga chen dbang bskur bas// rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam dbyings su skongs// dam can bka' srung dbang sdud bran du 'khol// dgra bgegs log rtog bdud dpung thal bar rlog/ 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro 'dul dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta ba lidha ḍa ma ru sarba pū dza sa ma ya a bhi ṣṭhañtsa sirnyi a bee sha ya a a āḥ zhes spyi bor bskur/ lnga pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i sku sangs rgyas sman bla'i rnam par gyur pa la rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa'i nang pa'i 'khor dang / rgyun shes la sogs pa'i drang srong gi 'khor dang / tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha'i 'khor dang / mahā de wa la sogs pa'i phyi ba'i 'khor/ 'byung ba lnga'i sman gyi lha mo dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba

66 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigasprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bsgom pa'i sman rgyal gyi spyi bo snying ga lte ba gsang gnas bzhi nas rig pa'i ye shes bzhi dang / mgrin pa nas yid las skyes 'od dpag med kyi rnam sprul/ yid las skyes kyis zhu chen mdzad/ rig pa'i ye shes bzhi'i rgyud rim pa bzhin du lung phog rjes su gnang ba bka' gtad de bzhi po de dag kyang yig 'bru mthing dkar ser ljang gi rnam pa nam mkha' nas char lta bu bab khyed rnams kyi spyi bo snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su thim pas/ de'i tshig don rgyud la bkra lam lam skyes/ 'khor tshogs de thams cad kyis kyang // rang rang gi lugs kyi gso ba'i gzhung lugs thams cad kyi lung phog/ de yang dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge dkar dmar 'od kyi rang bzhin khyed rang la thim/ mthar 'khor gzhan thams cad yid las skyes la thim/ de yang khyed rang gi mgrin par 'od dmar po zhu nas thim pas rgyud bzhi'i don ma lus pa khong du chud/ tshig 'chad pa la thogs pa med pa'i mthu thob par mos la/ rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/ 'gro ba ma rig dug lnga'i rgyu las ni//rlung mkhris bad kun ldan 'dus nad lngas gzir// de dag ye shes lnga dang sman sbyor lngas// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i nad rnams rab sel ba// rig pa'i ye shes lnga las byung gyur pa'i// rgyud chen sde bzhi mjug don bcas pa lngas//bco brgyad cha lag dang bcas gso dpyad kyi// gzhung gdams ma lus kun gyi dbang bskur bas// tshig don ji bzhin rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥ: a mṛ ta hri da ya agi aṣṭa gu hya u pa de sha tant+ra sarba a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ drug pa ni/ ka pā la me long sman dang bcas spyi bor bzhag la/ ka pā la ni phyi snod 'jig rten khams// sa chu me rlung sman rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi// bdud rtsis gang ba nang bcud sems can te// sha khrag drod dbugs sman du ma gyur med//me long bsil drod so sor 'char ba'i brda// nyon mongs chags sdang gis bskyed tsha grang nad// thabs shes ga bur shing kun sman gyis sel// gti mug

༄/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 67 chags sdang 'dus pas tsha grang 'thab// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug a rus 'du ba snyoms// 'gro drug ma rig don lnga snod drug nad// pha rol phyin drug bzang po drug gas 'joms// snang srid 'khor 'das bdud rtsi chen po'i klong // ma lus sman gyi dbang chog 'di bskur bas// rgyu 'bras nad rnams kun sel dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ de nas bdud rtsi lce thog tu blugs pas/ rang lus kyi nang 'gro ba rigs drug gis gang ba/bdud rtsi 'thungs pas rgyu 'bras nad las grol bar bsam/ bdun pa ni/ gtsags bu sogs cha byad rnams gtad la/ hūṃ/ ye shes gtsags chas dug gsum rnag khrag dbugs// gtum mo'i me btsas gzung 'dzin zug gzer bsreg/ dran pa'i skam pas rnam rtog mde'u 'byin// shes rab mtshon gris bdag 'dzin sha ro bcad// nyams myong skyung bus nyon mongs rus skyon brdar//bskyed rdzogs thur mas ma rig rab rib dang // snang log rang 'khrul snying rlung sel bar byed// slan brgyud cha dpyad (byad kun 'dus dbang bskur bas// rgyu 'bras nad yul 'byin pa'i dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥlha badzra su ka ka ra sarba a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ brgyad pa ni/ rigs lnga lhung bzed gri thod bcas phyag mtshan rim par byin la/ oṃ/ chos dbyings sman gyi 'khor los gti mug nad rgyun gcod// hūṃ me long ye shes rdo rjes zhe sdang brag ri 'joms// swā mnyam nyid yid bzhin nor bus nga rgyal dbul phongs sel / āḥsor rtog padmo'i bcud kyis chags srid rang sar grol// hā bya grub rgya gram brjid pas phrag dog rlung dmar 'joms// stong nyid bde chen ngang du lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang // ma rungs tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gri gug thod par bcas// dpal ldan rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan dbang bskur bas// dus lnga'i dgra bcom rigs lnga'i rten dbang mchog thob shog/ oṃ āḥdharmā dha tu a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/zhes brjod do// de dag ni phyi rdzas la rten (brten pa'i dbang ngo //gnyis pa nang gi dbang la lnga las/ dang po ni/ lha dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul sasol ba gdabapa ni/ hūṃ/ rigs 'dus sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' drin gyis// bla med phyi dbang rdzogs par thob// da ni bla med nang gi

68 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadabang // bdag la bka' drin stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol bas lha tshogs rnams khyed rang gi snying ga dpral ba mgrin pa lte gsang spyi bo rnams su gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ so so'i tsaka li thogs te/hūṃ/ thugs sprul mi bskyod rig pa'i ye shes mthing // mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs rdo rje lhung bzed bsnams// rtsa rgyud ston mdzad me long ye shes dang //zhe sdang rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥbadzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ sku sprul rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes dkar// mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs 'khor lo lhung bzed bsnams// bshad rgyud ston mdzad chos dbyings ye shes dang // gti mug rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥburnya gu ru a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ āḥgasung sprul mtha' yas yid las skyes pa dmar//mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs padma lhung bzed bsnams// rgyud kyi zhus chen sor rtog ye shes dang / 'dod chags rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// rma āḥpadma gu ru a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ swā yon tan rin 'byung rig pa'i ye shes ser//mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs rin chen lhung bzed bsnams// man ngag rgyud ston mnyam nyid ye shes dang // nga rgyal rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥratna gu ru a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ hā 'phrin las don grub rig pa'i ye shes ljang //mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs rgya gram lhung bzed bsnams// phyi rgyud ston mdzad bya grub ye shes dang // phrag dog rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// rma āḥkarma gu ru a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ rigs kyi gtso bo bcom ldan sman rgyal mthing //mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs sman mchog lhung bzed bsnams// don gnyis mthar phyin ye shes lnga rdzogs dpal// dug lnga rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ mahā gu ru sta ṣa byo a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gnas so sor dbang bskur/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon khyed rang la dbyer med du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ ma chags padma rigs kyi

༄khyagayu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 69rnam rol las// ma rungs gdug pa kun 'dul khro bo'i sku// gnyis med rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor// dbang chen rta mchog dpal gyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥpadmanta krita badzra kro dha ha ya gro wa/ burnya ḍāki ni ka wa tsi abhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dbang chen yab yum gyi skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thugs kur thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'gying pa/ dbyings kyi yum chen rdo rje phag mo dmar mo khro 'dzum can/ dbu gtsug phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog pa gri thod 'dzin pa dang rol pa/ dur khrod rol pa'i chas kyis brgyan cing bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs paralam gyis gsal thob du 'jug zu ki bzhi gnas bzhir thim par bsam la/ rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs// ye shes ḍā ki 'phrin las bzhi sgrub la// mthing ser dmar ljang gri gug thod pa 'dzin// sde bzhi ḍā ki dbang mchog sbyin par bya/oṃ āḥlha burnya ḍā ki ni/ ratna ḍā ki ni/ padma ḍā ki ni/ kurma ḍā ki ni/ ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ zhes bskur/ gnyis pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan ma thogs te/ dkar gsal 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan// 'dab brgyad padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan// mthing mdog rdo rje rgya gram hūṃ gis mtshan/ bde gshegs sku gsung thugs sogs phyag rgya yis// skal ldan bu la nan tan dbang bskur bas// sgo gsum tha mal 'dzin pa rang sar dag/ snang grag rig gsum ye shes rol dbang shog/ oṃ āḥlha burnya kā ya wa ka tsitta a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid du gyur pas lcags ngar blud pa ltar byin rlabs kyi ngar thogs pa yin no//gsum

70 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigapa ni/ man shel mig lam du bstan zhing mgo bor bzhag la/ hūṃ/ kun gzhi sems dang nyon mongs yid rnam shes// sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur bag chags spangs//me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya ba grub// ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog thob gyur cig/ oṃ dzñā na pañtsa a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ chos dbyings rnam dag spros pa thams cad dang bral ba shel lta bu rang rtsal ma 'gag pa'i ye shes 'char ba ni 'di lta bu'o//zhes ngo sprad/ bzhi pa ni/ drang srong brgyud par gtor rme dbul zhing byin 'bebs dbang bskur dang bcas pa las/ stong pa'i ngang las tram̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nam mkha' gang bar bsams la/ 'bru gsum gyi byin rlobs/ mdun du drang srong rnams kyis dam tshig gi rten gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūṃ/ tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag dang tha skar bu// brgya byin rgyun shes bu dang nabs so skyes// thang la 'bar dang rkang pa gnyis spyod pa// 'gro skyong me bzhin 'jug dang lus nag dang // rgya skyegs sna dang mda' mchog lan tsha'i lag/ dpal phreng nyi ma'i snying po zla zer dang // tsa ra ka dang ljang sngon chen po dang // lha skyabs g.yon phyogs dang ni shing khyer dang // ljang sngon bu dang bram ze gzhon nu sprin// rin chen mgo de shan dang gzhon du sreg/ 'drob skyong mu khyud 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad thugs su chud// tshe la dbang bas bcud len dngos grub brnyes// gzhan rig mngon shes byams ldan drang por srong // khyed rnams rang rang bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog nas// tshad med 'gro la dpag med thugs rje yi// rdzu 'phrul lam la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'od ljang la sogs sman gyi lha mo dang // mngon shes pra yi dngos grub ster mdzad pa// sman gyi rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs rnams kun// sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes mi 'da' bar// ring ba'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir

༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 71gshegs su gsol// e hya hi sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ sna tshogs rin chen padma'i gdan la bzhugs// sgo gsum spro dga' gus pas phyag kyang 'bul// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// ma rig nyams chags sdig sgrib nongs 'gyod bshags// dge la yi rang zab don chos 'khor bskor// 'gro ba ji srid gnas par de srid bzhugs// kun kyang bla med byang chub rgyur bsngo'o// de nas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho mgron rnams ljags 'od kyi sbu gus gsol bas thugs rgyud bde bas gang bar bsam la/ tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs lha'i sman pa thams cad mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa'i drang srong chen po rnams gyi zhal du ba lidha pū dza kha /khā nyi/ oṃ āḥlhaḥlan gsum dang /gzhan yang sman gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams dang / sman gyi bka' bsrung (srung lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum mi'am ci la sogs pa'i dam tshig la gnas pa thams cad kyi zhal du i rda ba lidha gro tna khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma phul la/ chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ sman gyi byin 'bebs shing dbang bskur bya ba ni/ gtor ma tsaka li spyi bor bzhag ste/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros dang bral ba'i klong yangs nas//'gro don 'dod rgu'i gar bsgyur gtso dang 'khor// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i nad sel bde gshegs gtso// sngon med sman pa'i byin rlabs dus 'arir phob//rigs lnga sku lnga rig pa'i ye shes lnga// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba yab yum rnams//'gro ba dug lnga'i nad las grol ba'i phyir// dus 'dir byin rlobs sman gyi bcud phob cig/ lha dang drang srong phyi dang sde bzhi'i 'khor// rang las mi gzhan sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams// bdud rtsi sman gyi dngos grub ster la dbang // gnas dus rdzas la bdud rtsi'i phyin phob cig/ snang ba ma 'gags skye med chos kyi klong // rang rtsal ma 'gags padma'i rigs las 'khrungs//bde chen gar gyi rol pas dngos grub stsol// rta mchog yab yum dus 'dir byin phob cig/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro 'phrin las bzhi la dbang // bdud

72 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabazhi zil gnon tshad med bzhi yi dngos// gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib pa sbyong mdzad bzhis// 'khor lo bzhi la dus 'dir byin phob cig/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba// legs nyes dbang mdzad dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul// gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs// chos skyong dam can tshogs kyi byin phob cig/ sngon tshe rgyal sras gu ṇa'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srog gi snying po phul// sman gyi bstan pa skyong ba'i mthu ldan pa//bod khams bstan ma'i tshogs kyi byin phob cig/ lha klu dri za gtsang sbra la gnas shing // sman mo'i mig bsgyur (mi 'gyur sman gyi bstan pa srung // snang gsal pra yi dngos grub ster nas rnams// dam las mi 'da' dus 'dir byin phob cig/ e ma e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// spro dga' bkra shis pho brang a la la// bla ma'i byin rlabs char rgyun si li li// yi dam dngos grub rgya mtsho me re re// mkha' 'gro 'phrin las glog ltar khyugs se khyug/ khri /khro tshogs hūṃ phaṭa 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// chos skyong dgra bo'i srog la rubs se rub// rig 'dzin drang srong sprin ltar thibs se thib// sna tshogs lha mo glu dbyangs kyu ru ru// rnam mang bkod pa'i mchod pa lings se ling // dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa thu lu lu//rab snyan lha yi rol mo khro lo lo// sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub 'khyil li li//bdud rtsi sman gyi char ba sha ra ra// 'dir gshegs gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlobs// skal ldan bu la dbang mchog bskur du gsol// sku yi dbang bskur byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par shog/gsung gi dbang bskur byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par shog/ thugs kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs sems la zhugs//yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par shog/ sku gsung thugs dbang lus ngag yid la phob// sgrib gsum dag nas sku gsum mngon 'gyur shog/ kā ya wakka (ka tsitta a dhi ṣā te a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing tsaka li slob ma'i mgo la reg cing / de

༄g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 73nas/ gtor ma nad med nad sel bdud rtsir/ 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsir/dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir mos nas// dngos grub sogs yi dam la gnas pa'i slob ma rnams la byin pas lus kyi nang bdud rtsis gang //lha tshogs thams cad kyi byin brlabs dang dngos grub thob nas skal ba mnyam par bsam/ lnga pa ni/ gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ rang rang gi sngags sogs/ a dhi ṣṭha na a dhi ṣṭha te a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ ces brjod tsaka li mgo la bzhag khyed rang rnams skad cig gi mthu stobs kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje dregs pa ma lus dbang du sdud/ zil gyis gnon// bran du 'khol ba'i skur gyur pa la bka' srung rnams bran du gtad par bya ba yin te/ hūṃ hūṃ/ nga ni rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal// khro bo kun gyi rje btsan te// khams gsum srid gsum za bar nas// bka' las 'da' ba brlag par byed// bstan pa srung par khas blangs pa'i// chos skyong dam can thams cad dang // khyad par bdud 'dul 'khor dang bcas// dpal ldan e ka dza ti /ṭīkam// gza' bdud chen po rā hu la// mkha' 'gro ce spyang mchu dmar ma// gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag dang // dam can srog gi spu gri'i tshogs// srin po khrag gi ral pa can// bdud mo ro zan bya rgod mgo/ las mkhan hab se 'khor dang bcas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' yis ni// khyod rnams 'di yi bran du bkol// byin pa'i zas zo skul na rgyug/ bcol pa'i las rnams gang kyang // ma 'gyangs myur du 'grub par gyis// sman gyi bstan pa thub par srung // gal te dam las 'da' byed na// bdud du phob la gshed ma gyis// bka' bzhin sgrub na sdong (sdongs grogs mdzod// dregs pa'i rtsal dbang thob gyur cig/ oṃ mahā kā la sarba dus mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/rab gnas dang bkra shis bya/ zhes tsaka li lag g.yas dang gtor ma g.yon du gtad do// gsum pa rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang chad 'gyur du blta'o//bzhi pa gsang ba'i dbang la gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzugs dang lang tsho rdzogs shing

74 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamatshan nyid dang ldan pa'i kurma mu dras thog drangs gnas lus longs spyod thams cad 'bul bar mos la maṇḍal 'bul/ mig dar gyis bkab/ gnyis pa ni/ kye hoḥrdo rje 'dzin rgyal bde chen po// brtse chen dmigs med thugs rje yi//bdag la gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ston// bde chen dngos grub gsang dbang stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ khyed rang rnams gsang dbang gi dam tshig la gnas bzhin par mig dar phyo bas dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod// bu ltos kun bzang yum gyi mkha'// ma lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// gang gis mthong bas sdig pa 'dzad// dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas yin// zhes ngo sprad/ gsum pa ni/ bla ma te ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rta phag yab yum gyi rnam par byung / zhal nas zhugs thugs gar 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam las yum gyi mkhar babs gcig tu 'dres nga/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu gyur pa myang bas bde chen gsang pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ/ phung khams skye mched gdod nas lha ru dag/ byang sems dkar dmar bde chen bla na med// dri med bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi dbang bskur bas// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dbang thob shog/bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ zhes thod chang blud pa myang bas lus thams cad zag med kyi bde bas bde khril khril gang / las rlung 'gyu ba thams cad ye shes kyi rlung 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ bla ma yab yum gyi sku'i bum pa las byang sems kyi chu rgyun byung bas lus sems kyi dri ma mtha' dag bkrus bas bum dbang / lce thog tu bzhag pa la gtsang sme'i rtog pa dang bral zhing de nyid kun gyi spyod yul du ma gyur bas gsang dbang / de'i ro myang bas lus sems la bde bas khyab pa shes rab ye shes/ de gsum ga'i ngo bo gnyis med mngon (sum )du mthong bas dbang bzhi ba'o//

78 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigal mnyam par bzhog (zhogs cig/ hūṃ/ ltos shig skal ldan rigs kyi bu//bar snang yangs pa'i dkyil du ltos// stong gsal rang snang mtha' dbus bral//zhen 'dzin yul med bde ba che// phyogs lhung mtha' spang lta ba'i mchog/kun byed kun grol khyab brdal ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs dbang bskur// thob med tshul gyis thob gyur cig/ a ti hoḥ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/mar me bstan te/ hūṃ/ stong nyid mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa// sgoms shig sgoms shig me sgoms shig/ rlung gis me bskyod mar me 'dra// gsal stong 'dzin med dbang thob shog/ a ti hoḥ ces ngo sprad/ bzhi pa ni/ a mṛ ta sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi khyor ba re blud la/ e ma ltos shig skal ldan (rigs kyi )bu// rang sems chos sku 'gyur med ltos// smra bsam brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das// khur bkar (bkang smra 'dod ji bzhin no// gang yang ma grub stong chen sku// 'gyur med gdengs ldan 'bras bu mchog/ 'di las gzhan du ma re zhig/ rang chas lhun grub dbang thob shog/ a ti hoḥ de ltar lce steng du bdud rtsi yod bzhin pa'i ngang nas phaṭa ces brjod/ khur ba bdud rtsis gang ba smra mi shes de ltar 'bras bu sku gsung thugs kyang tshig don las 'das pa'o// zhes brjod/ lnga pa ni/slob dpon bzhengs tshul lag gnyis pad kor sogs gar stabs bsgyur bzhin par// hūṃ/ nyon cig skal ldan snying gi bu// stong nyid ye shes rol ba las// dgag sgrub med pa'i spyod pa shar// ci byas 'gro don dbang thob shog/ a ti hoḥ zhes ḍā dril sogs rol mo sgrogs/ mtha' rten gtad rgya ni/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu mnga' gsol ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dbang rten padma 'dab ma drug pa'i steng du lha'i rnam par gnas pa la shel gyi mchod rten bang rim dgu pa dang / rdor dril lag tu gtad par bya ba yin te/ hūṃ/ theg sgo bsam gyis mikhyab blo yi 'drid ('brid thabs yin// chos rnams sems la ma rdzogs rdul tsam ga la yod/ sems nyid bden gnyis dbyer med mthar thug chos sku

'gro rnams bde la bkod// phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyis dam ldan zhing // skal ldan slob bu'i tshogs la zab mo de nyid ston// chos kyi rgyal tshab dam par khyed nyid dbang bskur ro// rang gzhan
