80 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigagyis gsol ba gdab pa song nas/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal bas slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed la phog/ phyi gtor ma la nang gzhal yas khang du/ bla ma rigs 'dus sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang yab yum 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar ba snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa bkra lam gyis bzhugs par gyur/ de'i spyi bo nas a dkar po 'od dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i spyi bor thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur/ sku bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / sprul pa'i sku mngon du byas/ yang mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po 'od dang bcas pa byung /slob ma'i mgrin pa la thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/gsang dbang thob/ sgrar grags tshad yi dam lha'i gsung du gyur/ ngag bzlas pa byed pa la dbang / longs spyod rdzogs sku mngon du byas/ yang thugs ka nas hūṃ mthing ga 'od dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i snying gar thim/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dran rtogs thams cad ye shes kyi rol par rgyas thebs/ lam pho nyas bgrod pa la dbang / rtos kyi sku mngon du byas/ slar yang gnas gsum las hrīḥyig dang 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la dus gcig tu thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ tshig dbang rin po che thob/ snang rig bde ba chen po chos kyi skur rgyas thebs/ lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang / ngo bo nyid sku mngon du byas pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod/ gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag cing rol mor bcas pas/ hūṃ/ gnyis med chos dbyings dag pa'i klong yangs nas// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun// sngon gyi dam bcas thugs dam bdag bskul na/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i deng 'dir byin gyis rlobs// phyi ni

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 81dam rdzas gtor ma rgyan dang ldan// ro bcud phun tshogs sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga//nang ni ye shes lha yi gzhal yas khang // bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs// skal ldan bu la dbang mchog bskur du gsol// lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa ma lus dag/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas kyang //ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog thob par shog/ rma aḥmai gu ru de wa ḍami ni kā ya a bhi ṣāñtsa oṃ/ wakka a bhi 〉lca āḥtsitta a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ sarba a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hrīḥ zhes brjod/ drang srong gtor ma 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bltas la 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ phyogs bcu'i drang srong chen po sman lha rnams kyi zhal du ba lidha sarba pū dza khā hi/ zhes bsngos nas/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams dang sman gyi lha mo thams cad char babs pa ltar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba kun 'dus sman rgyal bka' yi 'khor// lha dang drang srong phyi nang sde bzhi po// sngon gyi zhal bzhes thugs dam dran mdzod la// skal ldan bu la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// gcer mthong mngon shes nad ngos 'dzin pa dang // snang srid sman gyi rol par 'char 'gyur zhing // mthong thos dran reg nad pa'i tshogs rnams kun// ma lus bde la 'god pa'i dbang thob shog/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta a bhi ṣṭhañtsa oṃ āḥ:/ zhes bskur/ bka' bsrung gi gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsam la/ i āḥshā/ lan gsum gyis rlobs/rma mahā kā la sarba du mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba lidha khā nyis bsngos/khyed rang skad cig gis mthu stobs kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje gsal ba la chos skyong rnams bran du gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma lag tu gtad de/ hūṃ/rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma'i bka' bsrung zhing / dam las mi 'da' sman gyi bstan pa bsrung / gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs// dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs rang rang mthun pa'i dam

82 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigardzas bzhes// khyed rnams rgyal sras 'di yi bran nyid du// de ring rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis byin// lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa'i 'phrin las sgrub//mahā kā la sarba tsitta sa mā ya a bhi ṣāñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod rdo//gsum pa ni/ gtang rag mchod bstod sogs gzhung ltar bya ste/ dbang bskur 'di nyid gong ma'i phyag len bzhin rtsa dbang gi sa bcad gsum pa'i skabs su 'jug dgos pa'i phyir ro//gsum pa sman gyi lha mo'i rjes gnang la gsum ste/ gshoms bca' zhing sgrub pa dang / dngos gzhi bskur thabs/ mjug bsdu ba'o//dang po ni/ gzhi padma 'dab bzhi bting ba'i steng du/ bum pa chas ldan bzang drug mngar gsum gser mdog chang bzang po sbyar ba blugs pa/ sku tsaka/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor zlum dkar po mtheb kyus bskor la/ mda' dar me long btags pa/ sba gling gtsang ma/ me long /a ru gser mdog rdos gcig/ a ru ra sha chen rdog gnyis bcas rim ba'in gser dngul mtshal gyi a bris pa shar phyogs dang / lho nub bcas kyi pad 'dab la 'jog ste 'du byed sman gsum du grags/'gugs byed rgya tsha dang gur gum ghi waṃ/ rten rdzas bzang drug bcas dang gser skyems/ phye mar nyer spyodasogs bshams/ skyabs sems sngon 'gros mchod rdzas byin rlobs/ dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nyid las// pad stong /sdong zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng // rang nyid bla ma sman pa'i rgyal// sngo sangs 'od zer kun la 'phro// dar gyi yam thabs mdzes par spras// phyag g.yas sman gyi lhung bzed dang // g.yon pa sba dkar gling bu bsnams// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan// 'dzum mdangs 'od kyi sems can rnams// ma lus nad las skyob par bsam// mdun du rin chen bum pa dang // gtor ma gzhal yas khang chen gyi// dbus su dung gi khye'u dkar// rin chen rgyan spras yid 'ong gzugs// g.yu yi zur phud smin 'khyug mdzes// dar dkar gos bzung (bzang sku la gsol// phyag g.yas mda' dar me long bsnams// g.yon pa sba gling snyam par bsgyur// 'dzum sgeg 'gying ldems de nyid kyis// lha dang sman mo dbang sdud cing / snang srid thams cad gsal mthong nas// bdag la thams cad smra bar gyur// shar du

༄/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 83ye shes lha mo dkar// lho ru smra byed lha mo ser// nub tu rno byed lha mo dmar//byang du sman pra ster nus pa'i// sman gyi drang srong ma lus gsal// lha mo bzhi ni gzhon tshul can// rab mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho rgyas// mu tig lan tshar sil bur spras// me tog spel ba'i phreng ba dang // utpal bsgrigs pa'i rked 'ching can// rin chen snyan cha sna tshogs pa// rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis spras//dar dkar gos gzu'i (bzang na bza' la// mtshal gyi thig phran lam se lam// mthing shun mdzes pa'i cha ga can// rin chen gser gyi gong lag la//g.yu yi thig phran mdzes pas spras// phyag g.yas sba gling bsgyur ba yi/sa// sgrub pa po la mngon shes 'char// g.yon pa snang gsal me long bsnams// snang srid thams cad gsal ler ston// yang na sman gyi par bu bsnams// 'gro ba'i nad rnams sel bar byed// gzhan yang lha klu sman gsum gyi// mngon shes can rnams sprin bzhin gtibs// ma lus yongs su rdzogs par gsal//de ltar bdag mdun gnyis ka yi// thugs ku'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros//rang rang gnas nas spyan drangs nas// bsgom pa'i rten la thim par gyur//kyai / chos kyi dbyings nas spyan 'dren pa// sangs rgyas sman rgyal thugs rje'i bdag/ 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul dngos grub zhu// kyai / rang bzhin dbyings nas spyan 'dren pa// ye shes lha mo mched gsum byon// nam mkha' dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// sman gyi lha mo mched gsum byon// gangs dkar rtse yi gnas mchog nas// 'phrul gyi lha mo mched gsum byon// lha yi gnas mchog dam pa nas// ye shes khye'u chung dkar po byon// dad dang dung sems dam tshig gis// bu chung ma la 'bod pa ltar// lhang lhang skad kyi bdag 'bod do// gzhan dang gzhan du ma yengs par// dung dung sems kyi bdag 'bod do// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur byon// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur byon// brten pa'i gnas 'dir da

84 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigatshur byon// phud dang rten la da tshur byon// dngul dkar me long mdangs la byon// sba dkar gling 'khrol skad la byon// phye mar 'o skom phud la byon//sman dang 'bru dang rin po che// sna tshogs mchod rdzas bzhes phyir byon// sman gyi lha mo mched gsum dang // ye shes khye'u chung dkar po ni// sngon gyi dam tshig dran gyis la// ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon// zhes spyan drangs/ sman sna shing sna'i bsangs /bsang 3dud btang la/ kyai / ye shes lha shing dud pa 'dis// sman gyi lha dang drang srong bsangs// rig 'dzin mngon shes ldan pa bsangs//sman gyi lha mo mched gsum bsangs// ye shes khye'u dkar po bsangs//'dzam gling bstan ma bcu gnyis bsangs// bod khams skyong ba'i lha sman bsangs// gangs dkar rtse yi sman rnams bsangs// brag la gnas pa'i sman rnams bsangs// spang la gnas pa'i sman rnams bsangs// nags la gnas pa'i sman rnams bsangs// mtsho la gnas pa'i sman rnams bsangs bar snang gnas pa'i sman rnams bsangs// sman phran nyis khri sum stong bsangs//mchod pa 'bul ba ni// kyi/ ye shes lha sman mched gsum la// phye mar phud dang mchod pa 'bul// sman bshos rtse rgyas mchod pa 'bul// zas phud zhal zas mchod pa 'bul// dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa 'bul// rang rang mnyes mchod thams cad 'bul// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di gsol la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// srid pa shod la srid pa ston// ye shes khye'u dkar po la// phye mar 'o skom mchod pa 'bul// spyan gzigs phud kyi mchod pa 'bul// snang srid ma 'dres gsal le ba// ma sgrib mthong ba'i dngos grub stsol// 'dod don gsol ba ni/ kyi/ phyogs phyogs dag ni pha gi na// nyi ma phyogs mtshams pha gi na// gnam sa gnyis kyi bar shed na// g.ya' dang gangs kyi mtshams zhig na// sprin dang na bun thu lu lu// 'ja' tshon sna lnga gya ma gyu//sbrang char zim bu sha ra ra// gtsang chab sngon mo me re re// dri zhim spos ngad chi

rgu/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 85li li// gangs dkar gnam du zangs se zang // g.yu yi spang ljongs shongs se shong // me tog sna tshogs lam se lam// sman gyi ljon shing si li li// ri dwags rtse rgyug krengs se kreng // g.yu sbrang sngon mo di ri ri// byi ru'i chon thag rgyangs se rgyang // dung gi chan (chon phur ltams se ltam// gzi mchong tshon shing ral la la// dar dkar gur chen ldi ri ri// sna tshogs mchod rdzas thibs se thib//sil snyan rol mo khrol lo lo// snyan sgrogs glu dbyangs kyu ru ru// de 'dra'i gnas na su zhig bzhugs// ye shes sman pra mched gsum bzhugs// 'khor du lha sman grangs med bskor// dkar mo ye shes lha mo de// snang srid shes bya sa ler ston// ser mo smra byed lha sman ma// legs nyes thams cad rna bar sgrogs// dmar mo rno mthong smra byed ma// gang dris rdzun med thig bzhin 'debs// zhal mdzes gzi mdangs ya la la// snyan pa'i gling bu lhangs se lhang // rin chen rgyan cha phra la la// mu tig tsar chung si li li// dar dkar na bza' mtshal thig can// mthing shun mdzes pa'i cha ga btab// gser gyi gos ris 'od 'bar la// g.yu yi rdo rje 'phar ma bsnon// phyag g.yas sba gling khro lo lo// sgrub pa po la gsung snyan sgrogs// g.yon pa snang gsal me long dang // sman gyis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams// snang srid ma lus gsal bar ston// 'gro ba'i nad kyi gdung ba sel// dam tshig can gyi bsrung ma mdzad// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog rtsa chod// 'dir byon mthun pa'i dam rdzas bzhes// dam rdzas gtsang ma 'di na tshang // dngul dkar me long 'di na gsal// sba dkar gling bu 'di na snyan// rdzas dang rten la da tshur byon//khyod ni slob dpon rgyud kyi lha// nga ni slob bu rgyud kyi 'bod// 'bod pa'i dus su snyan ma sra// g.yab pa'i dus su spyan ma brtul// bskul ba'i dus su bang ma bul// brten pa'i dus su rgyang ma ring // lhang lhang de ni dbyangs la byon//kyi/ ye shes gsal byed lha yi sras// khye'u g.yu yi zur phud can// sku mdog

86 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadakar la mdangs dang ldan// mda' dar me long phyag na bsnams// srid gsum gzigs pa'i khye'u chung // ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon//mda' dar bzang po 'di na yod// phye mar 'o skom phud la byon// g.yu shug sngon mo'i ngad la byon// gong ma'i brgyud pa gsung gi 'khrol// pra mthong dngos grub myur du stsol// sngar gyi dam tshig rjes dran mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag la thugs ma/ ring // 'dod pa'i don rnams bsgrub par mdzod// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub bstsol// zhes mda' dar g.yab par bya/ rang gi thugs kur hrī yig las// khye'u chung lha mo gsum bcas pa'i// srog sngags 'phreng bas bskor ba las// so so'i srog rtsa'i 'od kyi tshul// 'ub 'ub tshur la 'dus par gyur/ oṃ tsa munta hrīḥ ta sa mā ya dun bhyoḥ a ma tsitta/ du ma tsitta/ hri la phob/ srid pa shod/ srid pa ston/ zhes bsnyen sngags dang / sgrub sngags/ oṃ ma ma tring tring dzaḥdzaḥm ma sha sha/ ma ma hring hring / tri ma ya/ tri'u tri'u dzaḥzhes gong gi sngags gsham du sbyar la ci nus bzla ba dang / bum par gzungs thag gtad de gong sngags bzlazhing mchod yon 'bul ba'i/ lha 'od du zhu/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir 'khyilabar bsam/ gnang ba nod pa rnams bya/ gnyis pa ni/ slob ma khrus byas/ maṇḍal 'bul/gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mgon po sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol// ye shes sman gyi lha mo yis// rjes gnang bdag la bka' drinastsol// zhes lan gsum/ rgyun bshags skyabs sems bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang // de bzhin bgyid la yi rang ba//mgon po'i spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi//rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang // rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi//bsgom bzlas la sogs bsod nams la// dang bas rjes su yi rang ngo//sems nyid mngon par sangs rgyas dang // chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed cing //

86 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadakar la mdangs dang ldan// mda' dar me long phyag na bsnams// srid gsum gzigs pa'i khye'u chung // ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon//mda' dar bzang po 'di na yod// phye mar 'o skom phud la byon// g.yu shug sngon mo'i ngad la byon// gong ma'i brgyud pa gsung gi 'khrol// pra mthong dngos grub myur du stsol// sngar gyi dam tshig rjes dran mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag la thugs ma/ ring // 'dod pa'i don rnams bsgrub par mdzod// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub bstsol// zhes mda' dar g.yab par bya/ rang gi thugs kur hrī yig las// khye'u chung lha mo gsum bcas pa'i// srog sngags 'phreng bas bskor ba las// so so'i srog rtsa'i 'od kyi tshul// 'ub 'ub tshur la 'dus par gyur/ oṃ tsa munta hrīḥ ta sa mā ya dun bhyoḥ a ma tsitta/ du ma tsitta/ hri la phob/ srid pa shod/ srid pa ston/ zhes bsnyen sngags dang / sgrub sngags/ oṃ ma ma tring tring dzaḥdzaḥm ma sha sha/ ma ma hring hring / tri ma ya/ tri'u tri'u dzaḥzhes gong gi sngags gsham du sbyar la ci nus bzla ba dang / bum par gzungs thag gtad de gong sngags bzlazhing mchod yon 'bul ba'i/ lha 'od du zhu/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir 'khyilabar bsam/ gnang ba nod pa rnams bya/ gnyis pa ni/ slob ma khrus byas/ maṇḍal 'bul/gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mgon po sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol// ye shes sman gyi lha mo yis// rjes gnang bdag la bka' drinastsol// zhes lan gsum/ rgyun bshags skyabs sems bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang // de bzhin bgyid la yi rang ba//mgon po'i spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi//rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang // rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi//bsgom bzlas la sogs bsod nams la// dang bas rjes su yi rang ngo//sems nyid mngon par sangs rgyas dang // chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed cing //

༄/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbangachogabadudartsi'itshurgyun/ /ho watshogs spyod byang chub sems dpa' la// bdag gi gus pas skyabs su mchi//sangs rgyas rnam 'byung ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis//byang chub thugs mchog rgya chen po// 'gro ba rgya chen don la dmigs// ma lus phyogs bzhugs dkyil 'khor gyi// mgon rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol//dus 'di nyid nas sangs rgyas bar// bla med rgya chen dang bas gzigs// zhes lan gsum brjod/dngosagazhi ji ltar bskur ba'i rim pa la lnga las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ de yang bum pa 'di nyid phyi rin po che'i bum pa'i rnam pa can la/ nang du sman gyi lha mo mched gsum khye'u bcas pa zhu ba'i 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad mer khrig gis gang ba'i mos pa gyis/ hūṃ hrīḥ chos sku khyab brdal ye stong klong yangs su// snang stong yab yum bde chen 'gyur med sbyor// ci yang ma grub cir yang ma 'gags 'char//rang snang dag pa'i cho 'phrul rtsa gsum lha// bka' srung lha dang drang srong phyi nang 'khor// ma lus chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la// 'dir gshegs skal ldan bu la dbang mchog bskur// lus ngag yid la sku gsung thugs byin rlobs// oṃ āḥlha sarba sirnyi a bhi ṣpe/ ñtsa hūṃ/ gnyis pa gtor mas dbang bskur ba ni/slob dpon sangs rgyas sman rgyal du gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'phros/ gtor ma lha sman mched gsum khye'ur bcas pa gsal ba la phog pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang gi gnas so sor thim pa'i dmigs pa mdzod/ spyi bor bzhag la/ hrīḥkun 'dus rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' zhing // rnal 'byor bdag gi bran du khas blangs pa// rno mthong mngon shes ster ba'i lha dang sman //thams cad skal ldan bu la 'go bar bgyis// hrīḥye shes lha mo dkar mo mngon shes can// khyed ni lha sman yongs kyi rje btsun te// skal ldan bu la mngon shes dngos grub stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur

88 〉〉g.yu thog snying thigacig/ gtor ma rna ba g.yas g.yon du bzhag la/ lha mo ser mo bden tshig smra byed ma//khyed ni 'jig rten gsal byed drang srong ste// skal ldan bu la lung bstan dngos grub stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur cig gtor ma mig gnyis la gtugs te/ lha mo dmar mo rno mthong 'khrul med ma// khyed ni lha sman kun gyi mo ma ste// skal ldan bu la rno mthong dngos grub stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur cig gtor ma snying gar bzhag la/ ye shes lha yi khye'u chung dkar po ni// snang srid ma lus ma 'dres sa ler ston// skal ldan bu la gcer mthong dngos grub stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur cig/ gtor ma lag tu gtad la/ hrīḥmana' dang dam la mi gnas su yang med//rgyal ba'i bka' la mi brtsi su yang med// lha dang sman rnams 'di yi bran du byin// ci 'dod sgrubs shig 'gal na brlag par 'gyur// zhes brjod/ gsum pa bzlas lung 'bogs pa ni/ slob dpon sman rgyal gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas gtor ma'i lha'i srog snying rnams sngags phreng gi rnam par rang dbang med par bkug nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ tsa mun ta/ hrīḥ ta sa mā ya dun bhyoḥ a ma tsitta/ du ma tsitta/ hri la phob/ srid pa shod/ srid pa ston/ zhes bsnyen sngags dang / sgrub sngags/ oṃ ma ma tring tring dzaḥdzaḥ ma ma sha sham ma hring hring / tri ma ya/ tri'u tri'u dzaḥ zhes lan gsum/ bzhi pa rten rdzas kyi dbang ni/ sba gling mda' dar me long sogs lag tu gtad la/ hrīḥ snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs gling bu dang // shes rab mtshon non mda' bzang la// zab cing phra ston le brgan dar// ma 'dres gsal mthong me long dang / nad sel sman mchog a ru ra//sku gsung thugs rten sgrub rdzas dang // rten rdzas skal ldan bu la byin// dam la gnas pa'i 'di bcang na// bu gcig ma ni ji bzhin du// skad cig tsam yang ma yengs par// 'bral med rtag tu 'grogs pa dang // legs nyes lung

༄7/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 89bstan gsal bar shog/ a tri ma tri pu ra de wi ra ti ru pa sarba sirnyi tri a bhi ṣṭhañtsa oṃ āḥlha/ lnga pa gtor zan dam rdzas dngos grub kyi pham phabs su byin par bya ba ni/ hrīḥdam rdzas dngos grub gtor ma 'dod yon rgyan// ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa'i nor bu yin// sman mchog gtor ma'i bdud rtsi 'di myong bas// ting 'dzin zag pa med par spyod par shog/ ces byin no// de nas sman gyi lha mo mched gsum ye shes khye'ur bcas pa'i rjes gnang legs par song grub pas gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul ba sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/gsum pa ni/ mdun bskyed la mchod cing bstod/ gshegs gsol/ rang nyid ltar gsal ba nyer bsdu bsngo smon bya'o//bzhi pa drang srong ser skya'i rig gtad la gsum las/ dang po bshoms ni/ maṇḍal zlum po nam mkha'i mdog can gyi dbus su me tog gi tshom bu gsum bkod/ mañdzi'i khar rin po che'i bum pa 'bru lnga snying po lnga gtsang chab kyis gang ba dar dkar dri ma med pa'i mgul chings can/ g.yas su spar /par bugatsang mar/ bzang drug/ bsil gsum/ tsha ba gsum/ pha waṃ long bu/ dkar po tshig thub/smug po chig thub/ gtsags bu/ spra ba'i thum po/ g.yon du skyes dar ma rta dang ba glang rnams grir shi ba'i sre long / pho 'ug gi mig gnyis rnams sman pa mkhas pa'i skras dril te me long gi nang du bzhugs par bya ste rten pa'i dam rdzas khyad par ba'o// de rnams dar tshon sna lnga'i tshom bus sbrel/ mdun du dkar gtor rgyan ldan/ gzhan yang nyer spyod sogs bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas mchod rdzas byin rlobs// swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ gnyis snang chos kyi dbyings su bsdu//ka dag rig pa rten med de// gsal 'grib med pa'i ngang la bzhag/ slar yang snying rjes kun blangs nas// bdag mdun drang srong ser skya ni// phyag g.yas ye shes gtsags bu bsnams// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs zug rngu 'byin//g.yon pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin// 'chi med rig 'dzin dngos grub ster//g.yon du gcung po sngo skya ni// phyag g.yas gser gyi skam pa yis// bdag 'dzin rde'u dbyung bar byed// g.yon pa dngul dkar me long bsnams// snang srid ma 'dres gsal bar ston// g.yas na khye'u chung dmar skya ni// phyag

90 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigagayas ne tso smra mkhas 'dzin// nad gdon 'tsho 'chi lung ston byed// g.yon pa rig pa'i khye'u chung khrid// snang srid legs nyes thams cad sgrogs// kun kyang gzhon tshul bkrag mdangs rgyas// 'dzum sgeg yid 'ong lta na sdug/ dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// gnas gsum oṃ āḥ& gis mtshan// hūṃ gi 'od zer spro bsdu yis// rang bzhin ka dag chos kyi dbyings// brtan g.yo kun khyab sman gyi ri// g.ya' gangs mtsho gling phyogs bcu nas// sman bla rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang // drang srong ser skya spun gsum ma// mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu bcas// lha lam chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa ltar// spyan drangs rten la thim par gyur// ngo bo ye shes rnam rol pa// chos kun gsal 'grib med 'char ba'i// rnam pa ra rang rang rdzas kyi tshul// drang srong 'khor bcas 'du bar bsam/ tabya thā/ mahā bai shaṃ tse/ ratna bee shaṃ dzu u ha bee shaṃ tse/ a mṛ ta bi la/ sirnyi dza hūṃ breng hūṃ pra ti ha swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla zhing gnang ba nod pa rnams bya/gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul ni/ slob ma khrus byas gsol ba gdab pa/ drang srong sman bla rdo rje 'dzin// nyam thag 'gro la phan gdags phyir// mngon shes pra sgrub zab mo yis// rig gtad cho ga'i bka' drin stsol// zhes lan gsum/slob ma rnams skad cig gas drang srong ser skya phyag g.yas gtsags bu dang /g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon du gcung po sngo skya g.yas skam pa dang / g.yon me long 'dzin pa/ g.yas su khye'u chung dmar skya g.yas ne tso dang g.yon khye'u khrid chung pa rnams kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ drang srong rig 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang la sib sib thim par bsam la/ sngags la/ rtena.a bai sha ya a a/ zhes btags pa bzla zhing rol mo bya/ de ltar byin phob pa'i ye shes pa/ tiṣṭha badzra kyis bstims pa la bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ rab mdzes bkra shis dbang gi bum// dam rdzas bdud rtsi chen pos bkang // snying gi bu la dbang bskur bas// log rtog the tshom dri bral shog

90 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigagayas ne tso smra mkhas 'dzin// nad gdon 'tsho 'chi lung ston byed// g.yon pa rig pa'i khye'u chung khrid// snang srid legs nyes thams cad sgrogs// kun kyang gzhon tshul bkrag mdangs rgyas// 'dzum sgeg yid 'ong lta na sdug/ dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// gnas gsum oṃ āḥ& gis mtshan// hūṃ gi 'od zer spro bsdu yis// rang bzhin ka dag chos kyi dbyings// brtan g.yo kun khyab sman gyi ri// g.ya' gangs mtsho gling phyogs bcu nas// sman bla rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang // drang srong ser skya spun gsum ma// mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu bcas// lha lam chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa ltar// spyan drangs rten la thim par gyur// ngo bo ye shes rnam rol pa// chos kun gsal 'grib med 'char ba'i// rnam pa ra rang rang rdzas kyi tshul// drang srong 'khor bcas 'du bar bsam/ tabya thā/ mahā bai shaṃ tse/ ratna bee shaṃ dzu u ha bee shaṃ tse/ a mṛ ta bi la/ sirnyi dza hūṃ breng hūṃ pra ti ha swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla zhing gnang ba nod pa rnams bya/gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul ni/ slob ma khrus byas gsol ba gdab pa/ drang srong sman bla rdo rje 'dzin// nyam thag 'gro la phan gdags phyir// mngon shes pra sgrub zab mo yis// rig gtad cho ga'i bka' drin stsol// zhes lan gsum/slob ma rnams skad cig gas drang srong ser skya phyag g.yas gtsags bu dang /g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon du gcung po sngo skya g.yas skam pa dang / g.yon me long 'dzin pa/ g.yas su khye'u chung dmar skya g.yas ne tso dang g.yon khye'u khrid chung pa rnams kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ drang srong rig 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang la sib sib thim par bsam la/ sngags la/ rtena.a bai sha ya a a/ zhes btags pa bzla zhing rol mo bya/ de ltar byin phob pa'i ye shes pa/ tiṣṭha badzra kyis bstims pa la bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ rab mdzes bkra shis dbang gi bum// dam rdzas bdud rtsi chen pos bkang // snying gi bu la dbang bskur bas// log rtog the tshom dri bral shog

༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 91a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i lus kyi dri ma dag 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gzugs snang thams cad mngon sum ma sgrib par mthong bar gyur par bsam/ sku bum pa'i dbang ngo // slob dpon drang srong du gsal ba'i zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying gar thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ gong gi sngags lan gsum gyi bzlas lung 'bogs/ me teg slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag la/ rig sngags 'di ni bzlas gyur na// gso ba'i shes rab phyogs med 'char// kha dmar rno thig gtan la 'bebs// khyod kyi 'gro ba'i don gyis shig/ ngag gi dri ma dag sgrar grags grag stong gzhom med kyi don rtsogs par bsam/ gsung gi dpang po// me long bstan la/ rang rig dri bral me long la/snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun 'char// gsal bzhag med pa shes bgyis la//'khrul pa'i dbang du gtang mi bya// yid kyi dri ma dag dran rtogs thamasacad chos nyid rang byung gi ye shes skyes par bsam/ gtor ma mgo thog tu ba'ag la/ tabya thā/ mahā bai shaṃ tse sogs mjug tu/ ba lidha a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ btags pa dras tu bzla/ dam tshig bsgo zhing khas blangs/ gtang rag gi yon 'bul/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed la/arbhe/ sogs kyis mchod/ pra yi dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// drang srong chen po ser skya mched// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal bstod// nongs pa bshags/ badzra muḥ sa gshegs su gsol/ nyer bsdu/ bsngo shis kyis mtha' brgyan no//lnga pa mtha' rten tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'joms kyi dbang la gsum las/dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor pad 'dab bzhi pa mu khyud rdo rwa me ris bskor ba'i dbus su/ rin po che'i bum par nyer lnga'i chus gang ba dar dmar gyis mgul 'ching can/ de'i steng du tshe gtor nor bu 'bar ba/ rtser rdo rje 'khor lo nyi zlas mtshan pa/ rtsa bar dkar gsum mngar gsum sman spos zas snas bskor ba/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang / rgyab tu tshe mda' dar sna lnga rin chen me long btags pa sku tsaka rigs lnga dang / rta mgrin/ go khrab sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bshams/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems mchod rdzas byin rlabs pa rnams las byang bzhin byas

92 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiganas/ dngos gzhi bskyed pa ni/ shu n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ra sum̐ kau ram̐ las rim pa bzhin nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor yangs shing g.yo ba/ de'i steng du rakta'i rgya mtsho/ zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ dus pa'i ri rab/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus su hūṃ kha dog lnga ldan yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma 'dab ma bzhi dbus dang lnga'i lte bar/ ma las nyi ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i gdan la/ rang rig yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'bar bar gyur/ 'dab ma bzhi la nyi ma dang ro'i steng du ha ri ni sa bzhi mthing ser dmar ljang 'od dang bcas pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ dkon mchog mchod/sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje dang gri gug 'dab ma bzhir gri gug re res mtshan par gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las/ skad cig gis chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du rang nyid rta mchog te ru ka sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kur 'dzin pa/ dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang gur rta skad 'tsher zhing zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs rol pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams can dbu steng phag zhal gyi mtshan pa gri gug dang tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khril zhing / gnyis ga'ang dur khrod rol pa'i chas can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rnam par 'gying zhing gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan par bzhugs pa'i spyi bor pad sdong 'dab bzhi dbus dang lngar gyes pa'i lte bar gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med sku mdog mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag

༄g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 93gnyis g.yas rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med bcud gyis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma sngon mo gri gug dang tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras te khro 'dzum 'gying ldem sgeg pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ mdun du 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rnam snang tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo thugs kur 'dzin cing g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung can/ de bzhin dbyings phyug ma dkar mo gri gug dang tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khril ba/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rin 'byung tshe dpag med sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin chen dbang rgyal thugs kur 'dzin cing g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung can/ rin chen dbyings phyug ma ser mo gri gug dang tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khril ba/ rgyab kyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes snang mtha' tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa/zhabs rdo rje skyil krung can/ padma dbyings phyug ma dmar mo gri gug dang tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khril ba/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgya gram thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung can/ las kyi dbyings phyug ma ljang mo gri gug dang tshe bum bsnams pas 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyang mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas shing rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o// rang gi mdun sogs 'dab ma bzhir gri gug yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing ser dmar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyu nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon

94 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigatshe bum thugs kur bsnams pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan sogs khro mo'i cha lugs thams cad tshang bar gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ gzhan yang steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la chos skyong srung ma thams cad sprin gtibs pa bzhin gsal bar gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥka badzra mahā gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin byon par gyur/ dzaḥ& be hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan gyis dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsams la/ a tipu hoḥ pra ti tstsha hoḥ sa phyag bya/ oṃ āḥlha badzra gu ru dme wa ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wā ra a rghaṃ nas/ shapta pū dza hoḥrū pa/shapta/ ga dhe/ rā sa/ sparsha/ dharma dhā tu mahā pū dza hoḥ bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha ga na gu gye pū dza hoḥ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ mahā ba lidha kha hi/ ru dra sarba mā ra ya khā hi/ te te hūṃ te na hūṃ te phu spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/dharma dmā tu mahwa mu dra pū dza hoḥzhes mchod/ oṃ/ rnam dag chos sku'i klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i skur ston pa// sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'gro ba 'dul//mtsham dpes brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// āḥ bde chen zag med klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i gsung ston pa// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrogs// 'gag med rol par phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ/ khyab gdal spros med klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs ston pa// rang rtsal ting 'dzin bsam mi khyab// kun tu bzang la phyag 'tshal bstod// swā/ ka dag zab gsal klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i yon tan ston// chos rnams ma 'dres ji bzhin du// 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal bstod// hā/ lhun 'byams rig pa'i klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ston// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyis// 'khor ba dong sprugs phyag 'tshal bstod//

༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 95dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa// rtsa ba gsum gyi lha chogs la// sgo gsum gus pas mchod cing bstod// sku gsum rang ngo shes par shog/ ces bstod/bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lha tshogs gtso 'khor thugs kur zla nyi'i steng // srog snying dag las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// bde gshegs mnyes mchod sku gsung thugs brgyud bskul// thugs rjes byin rlabs tshe yi dngos grub bsdus//thugs ku'i srog snying phyag gi tshe bum thim// sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od kyis lus khyab pas// bzhi brgya'i nad dang stong phrag bgegs la sogs// las dang rkyen gyur tshe yi bar chad rnams// 'od zer ye shes me yis rab bsregs nas// gzhob thul bskal ba'i rlung gis phyir gtor te// lus nyid gser gyi rdo rje nas 'bras tsam// rab brtan gnod byed gzhan gyis mi tshugs bsam//slar yang 'od 'phros phyi nang snod bcud kyis// skye 'gro'i tshe srog dpal brjid stobs mnga' ris// sman 'bru zas gos rin chen 'byung ba sogs// kun gyi bcud bsdus 'chi ba med pa yis// dngos grub dam pa bdud rtsis lus gang bas// rdo rje'i lus la nyi zla'i tshe thob bsam// oṃ āḥ& badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa siddhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ& swāhā/ st+waṃ lī māṃ ṭwāṃ tī/ hri /hrīḥ nam ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng sarba sidhi sa mā ya dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ badzra ā yu ṣe hūṃ ddhi dṛ dzaḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ de ltar bdag bskyed kho na la brten nas sgrub pa'am/ 'on te dbang dang sgrub mchod sogs la bdag mdun gnyis med du sgrub pa ni/ sgom gzhi rgya che chung tsam las sgom don la dbye ba med cing /sgrub rdzas la dmigs phyed pa'i bzlas pa byed na bdag mdun gnyis me long dang byad gzugs bzhin so sor phye nas// bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed thugs gar phog/ de'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dmar po 'phros// phyi snod kyi 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma'i bcud// nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ bkrag dang gzi brjid thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang byin

96 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigarlabs thams cad 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par chil li li byung sgrub rdzas rnams la thim par bsam zhing gzungs thag la 'jus te bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o/tshe 'gugs pa ni/ lha tshogs thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya mchog/ sku mdog ma nges dar dang rin chen rgyan// tshe 'gugs lcags kyu tshe bum mda' dar bsnams//grangs med phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun khyab ste// stong gsum ma lus khams gsum srid pa gsum// lha 'dre mi gsum rnams kyi tshe bsdus shing // khyad par bdagashi bla tshe yar (yal dang 'khyams// thams cad yi ge dṛ yi tshul du bkug/ tshur thim 'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam/ mda' dar g.yab cing /hrīḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung mchog 'dus pa'i dpal// rta phag yab yum dbang gi las mdzad gtso// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas dus la babs// steng 'og bla tshe 'gugs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlog/ srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'i srog rtsa dmar po mchod(chodaka/ / yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams pa da lta khug/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro lcags kyu mthing bum 'dzin// zhi ba'i las mdzad sprul dang yang sprul bcas// 'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// shar dang shar lho'i phyogs kyi tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlog/ srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'i srog rtsa dmar po mchod(chodaka/ / yon tan /bdag bla tshe 'khyams pa da lta khug/ rin chen mkha' 'gro lcags kyu gser bum 'dzin//rgyas pa'i las mdzad sprul dang yang sprul bcas// 'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// lho dang lho nub phyogs kyi tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlog/ srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'i srog rtsa dmar po mchod (chodaka/ / yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams pa da lta khug/ padma mkha' 'gro lcags kyu zangs bum

༄cugayu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 97'dzin// dbang gi las mdzad sprul dang yang sprul bcas// 'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// nub dang nub byang phyogs kyi tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlog/ srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'i srog rtsa dmar bo mchod/chodaka/ /yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams pa da lta khug/ las kyi mkha' 'gro lcags kyu g.yu bum 'dzin// drag po'i las mdzad sprul dang yang sprul bcas// 'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// byang dang byang shar phyogs kyi tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlog/ ces bkug nas dmigs med chos dbyings su che 'i'o/ skabs der bsrung mar gsol mchod dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha la rig pa'i me tog dor /gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi slob ma rnams la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab ste gnang ba zhu'o//gnyis pa ni/ slob ma'i bya ba khrus byas/ bgegs bsgrad/ maṇḍal phul te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs// bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la// bde gshegs rigs 'dus 'chi med lha'i// byin rlabs dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum dang / skyabs sems rgyun bshags bya/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer khro bo'i rdul phran me yi tsha tsha 'phro ba mang po spros/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la gnas te bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs thams cad sreg bcom me dang khro bo rnams slar 'dus khyed rang la gzhu lugs su 'dres pa'i dwangs ma 'od dmar po'i gong bur gyur pa las padma 'dab bzhi dbus dang lnga'i lte bar zla nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan la khyed rang rta mchog he ru kuḥ zhesapa nas/ chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad sprin 'thibs pa bzhin gsal ba'i bar gyi dmigs pa spod /spradaka/ de

98 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaltar gsal bar gyur pa na slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par spros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyi mthu dang / 'byung lnga'i mdangs dang rtsi bcud/ khyad par lha klu gnod sbyin rig 'dzin grub pa sogs tshe bskal pa dang mnyam par gnas pa rnams kyi tshe bcud bkrag dang gzi mdangs/ ban bon mthu bo che'i rig sngagasakyi sbyor ba dang / sde brgyad ma rungs pa'i bla tshe 'khyer /khyer ba la sogs pa thams cad rdo khab len gyi lcags phye sdud pa ltar yi ge gro'i rnam par 'ub kyis bsdus nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas 'chi med rdo rje'i srog thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ hrīḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sogs gyer bas tshe bkug/ dbang bskur ba dngos la bdun las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas tshad med pas bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur bas 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma des lus thams cad mer khrig gis gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ hrīḥ bum pa'i ngo bo spros med chos kyi sku// bum bcud rang bzhin bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// bum pa'i rgyan chas 'gro 'dul sprul sku mchog/ bar chad kun sel 'chi med dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥ& badzra mahā gu ru ā yu ṣe hūṃ rghaṃ dṛ dzaḥsarba sirnyi a bhi ṣṭhañtsa hūṃ/ zhes spyi bor 'jog cing bum chu blud/ gnyis pa lha dbang ni/ tsaka li rim par thogs te/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku mchog sman gyi lha// rig pa'i ye shes rnam snang tshe dpag med// 'gyur med sku yi byin rlabs kun bsdus la// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur du gsol// āḥsangs rgyas kun gyi gsung mchog sman gyi lha/ rig pa'i ye shes snang mtha' tshe dpag med// 'gag med gsung gi byin rlabs kun bsdus la// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur du gsol//

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 99hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog sman gyi lha// rig pa'i ye shes mi bskyod tshe dpag med// 'khrul med thugs kyi byin rlabs kun bsdus la// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur du gsol// swā/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan sman gyi lha// rig pa'i ye shes rin 'byung tshe dpag med/ yon tan re bskongs (skong byin rlabs kun bsdus la/ 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur du gsol/hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las sman gyi lha/ rig pa'i ye shes don grub tshe dpag med/ 'phrin las 'gro 'dul ma lus kun bsdus la/ 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur du gsol/ hrīḥsangs rgyas ma lus kun gyi sku gsung thugs//yon tan 'phrin las yongs rdzogs sman gyi lha// rigs 'dus rgyal ba bla ma tshe dpag med// byin rlabs mthar thug tshe dbang bskur du gsol// 'byung lnga rnam dag rigs kyi yum chen lnga// bcom ldan bde gshegs lnga dang gnyis med sbyor// dug lnga 'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung choms la// sku lnga'i byin rlabs tshe dbang bskur du gsol// hrīḥ bde chen gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog dpal//gnyis med rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor// mthu stobs gzi brjid 'chi bdag dpung choms la// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur du gsol// mkha' 'gro sde bzhis 'chi bdag bdud bzhi choms// 'phrin las ba'i sgrub rdo rje tshe 'gugs ma// phyogs bzhi mtshams dang steng 'og tshe khug la// dus bzhi dus med tshe dbang bskur du gsol// rtsa sngags brjod gsum pa gtor dbang ni zhu hrīḥdapal gyi gtor chen tshe dbang ye shes ni// nor bu 'bar ba dgos 'dod re ba bskongs/skong ka/ / nang na rigs lnga tshe yi lha tshogs bzhugs// dbang mchog bskur bas 'chi med dbang thob shog/ rtsa sngags bzla bzhin par spyi bor bskur/bzhi pa bcud len gyi dbang ni/ e ma/ 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi mchog/ tshe zan yi dam lha yi dngos grub 'di// gang gi lce yi thog tu reg ma thag/ dad pas myang na 'chi ba 'byung re kun// sra brtan ri bo lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ chad med

100 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigachu rgyun lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ gzhom med rdo rje lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ nad sel bdud rtsi lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ re bskongs /skong nor bu lta bu'i tshe thob shog/kun khyab nam mkha' lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ gsal dwangs nyi zla lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ 'gyur med chos sku lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi tshe thob shog/ ces lag g.yas su byin/ lnga pa tshe chang gi dbang ni/ hrīḥ tshe chang rigs lnga yab yum byang chub sems// snod bcud bdud rtsir bsgyur ba tshe yi bcud//dad pas 'thung na tshe dbang rig 'dzin thob// skal ldan bu la byin pas 'chi med shog/ hrīḥ sman 'bru rin chen zas skom 'byung ba dang / 'chi med rdzas sngags ting 'dzin bcud bsdus nas// byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi 'di 'thung zhig/ bar chad kun sel ngo mtshar a la la// zhes myang du bcug/ drug pa phyag mtshan go khrab kyi dbang ni/ hrīḥ cis kyang mi 'gyur mi byed (phyed mi shigs pa'i// rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen padma dang // rgya gram phyag mtshan go khrab 'di byin pas// tshe srog sra brtan 'gyur med dbang thob shog/ ces brjod/ bdun pa mi 'gyur ba'i rgyas gdab pa ni/ tshe mda' spyi bor rgya gram du bkod la/ hrīḥ snang srid 'khor 'das rang gi sems// sems nyid stong gsal ngos bzung bral// 'di la skye 'chi grub ma myong // yang dag lta bas rgyas gdab bo// 'khor 'das gnyis snang 'dzin rtog bral// chu dang rba rlabs ji bzhin du// sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal yin// ma bcos sgom pa'i rgyas gdab bo// gdon nas rang shar chos sku'i klong // ma bcings ma bcos lhun gyis grub// blang dor dgag sgrub dbyings su gzhig/ shugs 'byung spyod pas rgyas gdab bo//sangs rgyas sems can dbyer med par// kun bzang rgyal ba'i klong du gcig/sa lam 'bad rtsol ci byar yod// rang chas 'bras bu'i rgyas gdab bo// dang po thig le nyag gcig rgya// gnyis pa thabs shes zung 'jug rgya// gsum pa dug gsum rang grol rgya// bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya// lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya//

༄g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 101drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya// bdun pa byang chub phyag chen rgya// rgya bdun tshe la btab gyur na// snang srid 'khor 'das dgrar langs kyang // gnod pa rdul tsam mi nus na// dgra bgegs gzhan gyi smos ci dgos// badzra rakṣa tiṣṭha/zhes brjod/de ltar dbang bskur ba la mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bkra shis kyi me tog char bzhin du phab pas brtan par byas byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu (cu zhi ba dang // mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / mthun pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shes des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ zhes dang / dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig gnas// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// bya bzang bzhes spro rgyun mi chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shes shog/ ces sogs kyi shes pa brjod/ de ltar dbang thob nas gnas skabs thams cad du khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar nan tan tu srung bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ gtso bo ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gi bgyid// zhes lan gsum gyis khas blangs/ dbang zab mo legs par thob pa'i gtang ngag gi don du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ slar yang mos pa dang dad pa dang mgu ba'i sems kyi lus longs spyod dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas pa thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor ba ltar sprul nas 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag nyid 'bul lags na// khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang //cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes gsol bas/ de ltar dbang thob pa'i dge tshogs thams cad 'gro ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar mdzod// ces brjod la/bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa yi// go 'phang thob nas skyon gyi dgra btul te// rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i rlabs 'khrugs pa'i/ srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog/ zhes sogs kyi bsngo smon bya'o//

102 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagasum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod nongs bshags bzod gsol brtan bzhugs byas nas bdag nyid ltar gsal ba nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar nyer bsdu/ slar yang skur lam gyi gsal btab pa las byang dpag bsam ljon shing ltar bsngo ba smon lam shes brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o//de ltar 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu thog pa'i// man ngag zab don kun gyi snyiXng po phul// rlom 'di ngal ba'i gnas nyid ste// 'on kyang rnam dkar lhag bsam dag pas so//'dis mtshon dge ba'i dngos po gang thob des// rgyal bstan dar zhing de 'dzin yun ring brtan// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyon mongs sgrib byang nas//gnas lugs rang zhal mjal ba'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog nag 'gros su bkod pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs 7rgyal dbang yas ljing gi sku'i bla sman pa mkhan po blo bzang dpal ldan gyis lha rdzas bzang po'i skyes dngabacas ring mo zhig nas yang yang bskul cha/ gnang par brten/ lag len 'jug pa bde ba'i lugs su byas te smyos kyi rigs las 7shākya'i dge bsnyen rmongs rtul patrend+ra dza ya'am 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshor 'bod pas shing mo phag gi lo gro bzhin gyi nya ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu dge bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni drung spyon chos 'phel gyis bgyis pa ste 'gal 'khrul nongs na mkhas grub rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol lo// bi dza yantu//zhes rje btsun g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog nag 'gros su bkod pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba spyon smin grol gling pas sngon nas chog bsgrigs mdzad 'dug pa'i phyi mo sor bzhag 'di bzhin rigs 'dus bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po gu ṇa nā tha dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa rigs kyi bdag po bka' drin gsum ldan rje 'jigs bral chos kyi seṅge rin po che mchog nas lcags ri 'gro phan rig byed gling 'dus tshogs su dpal ldan rgyud bzhi/ man ngag lhan thabs sogs kyi lung 'brel dang / g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i snyan rgyud kyi chos 'khor ma lus pa'i dbang bskur rjes gnang lung khrid rim nod dang / snod bcud sman gyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub pa gzhung sa mchog nas rgyun 'dzugs mdzad skabs 'di ga grwa tshang spyi nas phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba yab sras rnams kyi thugs kyi

༄7/g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 103bzhed don mi nyams shing / bstan 'gro spyi dang / khyad par gso ba rig pa'i ba'ad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su 'gyur ba'i gsos sman du dmigs te rab tshes lcags yos lor par gzhi gsar du bskrun skabs dbu mdzad dkon mchog dge legs nas dngul srang lnga phul ba bcas dge bas rgyal bstan spyi dang gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa rin po che mi nub srid mtha'i bar du sa phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang / 'gro rnams nad med bde ba'i lang tsho mchog tu brtas shing sku gsum sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang rin po che bde blag tu thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig gu/ maṅgā lam̐// dge'o//par 'di lcags ri beeḍūr lta na ngo mtshar 'gro phan rig byed gling du bzhugs// shu rghaṃ mastu sa rba dza ga lta// //

104༄khya// rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog bzhi pa bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu dag pa gdod ma'i ye shes kyi//gzugs brnyan sprul pa phyag rgya bzhi yi grong // cig car 'jug pa bde chen rdo rje'i dngos// khyad chos bdun dang ldan pa de la 'dud// 'dir gang bshad bya'i gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab gnas kyi cho ga ni/ he ru ka gal por/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la// ye shes gzhug pa byin rlabs can// 'khor ba 'byung ba lnga yi gnas// sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid yin// zhes bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rin po che nas shin tu gces par bstan cing / de nyid kyang cho ga rnam dag la brten dgos pa'i tshul/ rgyud las/ cho ga dman pas mi bya ste// rab gnas rtag par bkra mi shes// 'jig rten 'dir yang sdug bsngal la// 'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che//zhes dang / de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyi// dngos grub 'dod pas nan tan bya// zhes gsungs pas de nyid bcu'am/ rang bzhin brgyad ldan gyi rdo rje'i slob dpon dag gis bsnyen pa zhal gso dang bcas nyi ma byang bgrod kyi dus tshes dge ba la brtsam mo//gnyis pa bshad bya ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga dngos la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ni tshon dkyil gnyis gang la brten kyang sa chog nas bzung rdul tshon la bri thig la sogs pa dang thun mong du bum lha'i sta gon sogs rang rang gi sgosaches 'byin 'jug dkyil 'khor gyi las rim gang la brten pa bzhin shes par byas nas rgyan dgram dang dbang rdzas mchod gtor la sogs 'du bya'o// gnyis pa rab gnas kyi yo byad ni/ rten gyi mdun la sogs skabs byed par mnga' dbul gyi maṇḍal ri rab gling bzhi'i bkod pa can gyi dbus su dkar gsum mngar gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i tsā ru'i bza' ba dpal bshos kyi dbyibs can kha zas bzang pos bskor ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi mdun nam g.yas logs sogs skabs btsal nas khrus stegs gru bzhi pa dri dang ba byung gis chag chag btab pa'i steng padma 'dab brgyad/ spro na bkra shis rdzas brgyad bris pa dar dkar pos g.yogs/ steng du rten rnying pa byin can zhig dang sarba bibyu swāhā zhes

༄7/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo/ 105brisapa'ang bzhugs su gsol lo// rī khā (re kha can gyi dbus su mardzi la khrus gzhong me long dang bcas pa bzhag 'dab ma brgyad la khrus bum brgyad bkod pa'i shar nas bcoms te dri lnga/ mngar gsum/ zho gsar/ shing 'bras/ 'bru lnga/ 'bras yos/ sman lnga/ rin po che lnga so sor blugs pa'am/ ma 'byor na bum pa lnga'am gcig thams cad la rdzas nyer lnga kho nas kyang rung / kha tshar ma nyams pa'i ras dri med la dri'i thig le lnga byas pa'i sku phyis/ gos zung (bzang dang rgyan cha'i rigs/rin po che dang 'khar ba la sogs pa'i snod du khrus chal sde tshan bzhi'i dang po la cho ga dag pas sbyar ba'i ba byung lnga/ gnyis pa la zho/ 'o ma/ mar/ ka ra/ sbrang rtsi ste phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga/ gsum pa la dri bzang dang nye shing shu ti/ bzhi pa la skyu ru ra dang yung ba'i phye ma rnams blug silla sogs dri zhim pos sbags pa'i til mar ram 'bru mar gyi bsku mnye/ dril phyi'i rdzas shing shun lnga ni sangs rgyas thod par/a sha dang n+ya gro dha// u dum wā ra brka ti// pa la sha ste shing lnga las// zhes bshad kyang ji bzhin mi rnyed pas/ tsan dan dkar dmar la 'o ma can gyi shing shun rung mthun bsres pa'i phye ma/ dung zhal du tsan dan dkar po/ gur gum/a ka ru/ gla rtsi/ ga bur te dri lnga'i byug pa so sor dur wa phon por byas pa'i pir dang bcas go rim ma 'chol bar bzhag pa'i mtha' mchod pas bskor/steng nas gdugs dbub/ ci bde bar rin po che'i snod me tog dkar pos bkang ba'i dbus su gzungs bum dri'i chus sum gnyis gang ba'i steng me long la tsan dan dkar po/ gi wang / gur gum/ a ru ra rnams 'o mar sbyar bas rten 'brel snying po tshar bdun bris pa dang / dri chus gang ba'i dung zhal kyang bsdogs/ gzhan yang sbyong chas/ dbang po gsal byed kyi mig thur sogs lnga/gu gul/ yungs kur/ rol mo'i bye brag sogs 'og nas 'byung ba thams cad ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o// gnyis pa cho ga la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sta gon la'ang nang gses bcu gsum las/ dang po dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod na/ mdo sgyu sems gsum/ zhi khro bka' brgyad/yang phur la sogs snga 'gyur gyi rgyud sde chen po gang yang rten pa de nyid kyi sgrub thabs dkyil chog bzhin no// bzlas pa'i mjug tu rnam bum du dkyil 'khor

106 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagyi lha tshogs dmigs phyed par gsal btab nas gzungs thag la 'jus te/rtsa sngags kyi gsham bur dbyangs gsal dang su pra tiṣṭha sbrel ba bzla zhing / lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la mthar mchod bstod dang / lha tshogs rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ zhes 'od zhu bya/ zhar la las bum sgrub pa ni/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad nyi'i gdan la hūṃ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes pa byon/ dzaḥ& bo hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rma badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li/ sogs/ji ltar rigs par bzlas rjes mchod cing bstod la/ badzra mus ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba khro bo'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa gzungs khrus kyi bum pa sgrub pa ni/ gzungs bum thog mar bsgrub pa gal po'i dgongs pa yin kyang bum pa'i bskyed chog cho ga gcig gis 'grub ste/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me tog la gnas pa'i gzungs bum dang / 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa'i khrus bum rnams zlo las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/mgrin pa phra ba/ la g.yel zhing mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos pañtsa li ku'i mgul chings dang / dpag bsam shing gis kha rgyan can sha stag gi gzungs bum nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rten 'brel snying po'i sngags phreng 'od dang zer du 'bar bas 'khor 'das kyi dngas bcud bsdu ba dang / khrus bum rnams su'ang zla ba'i steng na rang rang gi sngags rnams 'od zer 'phro zhing / dri ma sbyong ba'i mthu ldan gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsam zhing so so'igazungs thag spo bzhin par/ thog mar gzungs bum la dmigs rten 'brel snying po ci nus bzlas mthar dung zhal gyi chus me long gi yi ge rnams gzungs bum du sbyangs nas gtso las khrus bum me tog thams cad la cung zad re bran/ de nas khrus bum dang por dmigs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga

108 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigata sa pā ri wā ra arbhe sogs kyis mchod/ hūṃ/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing //bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha//bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang rigs /rig sngags dang / gzungs sngags dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang / chos nyid rnam par dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bsru ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed nas gnas skabs su 'jig rten gyi khams la phan pa rgya chen po bsgrub pa dang /mthar thug sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i ched du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi ba la bar du gcod cing / glags blta ba'i 'byung po gtum po gzu lums can gang su yang rung ba dang g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa thams cad 'di ru ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje me'i mtshon chas khyod rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ hūṃ bzhi'i sngags dang bcas yungs thun gyis brab/ gu gul dang bdud rtsi lnga bdugarol mo'i tsham /chom rngams dang bcas phyi rol du bskud/ gnyis pa byur dang skal ngan sbyong ba ni/'bras chan nam gro zan gyis rten la dril phyis byas pa'i chang bus kyang bskor zhing / las sngags bzla bzhin pas bzed zhal du dor/ de nas lag (pa )gnyis gas yungs kur bzung ba hūṃ bzla bas g.yon du bskor zhing / rma sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhā/ zhes mer sreg cing chu nang du dor/ de bzhin chu snod bzung ba yi bzla zhing g.yas su bskor nas sarba pā gyis me chur blugs/ me chu gnyis kyang snga ma'i bzed zhal la blugs te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas rab tu gnas bya'i rten dang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams la mi shis par

༄7/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo/ 109byed pa'i byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shīnti ku ru swāhā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas phyir dor/ gsum pa sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad rang rang gi snying gar ki nag po'i rnam par gyur pa lte ba'i ye shes kyi mes ded sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas thon nas til la thim pa de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan grangs ci rigs pas me chur dor/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib shīnti ku ru swāhā/zhes me yang chu nang du blugs nas phyir dor ro// lnga pa rten dang bzo bo la sogs pa'i dag bya dag byed khrus kyi bya ba ni/ rten dngos su bkru bar 'os pa rnams dri dang sug bul gyi 'dag chal dang bcas bkru/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsku mnye dang dril phyis kyang bya/ phal cher me long du gzugs brnyan bkru ba las khrus chal tshar bzhi/ sku (bsku mnye/ dril phyis/ me long / khrus bum/ khrus ras/ spos mar/dri lnga'i byug pa rnams bsdogs la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// zhes phyed rol dang bcas snyan gsan byas la/ slob dpon gyis khrus chal dang po ba byung lnga dur pa'i pir gyis a mṛ ta'i las sngags bzla bzhin du me long la byug yi hūṃ ṭwāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ zhes 'bru mar gyis bsku mnye bya/ snum bsal ba'i phyir/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya

110 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabi shwa dha ne swāhā/ zhes shing shun lnga'i phye mas dril phyis bya/ bum pa dang por/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ khrus ras kyis phyi zhing / de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūṃ shāḥhrīḥ.a kā ya bi shwa dha nee swāhā/ khrus dang po dri'i bum pa 'di mdun du bzung la 'og ma 'og ma rnams nas thigs pa re blugasaso// yang khrus chal snga ma ltar la bsku mnye dang dril phyis/ rang sngags bcas kun la 'gre/bum pa gnyis pas/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ phyi zhing / de dag sku la sogs/ khrus chal gnyis pa phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga byug cing / bsku mnye/ dril phyi 'gre/ bum pa gsum pas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing // gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ phyi zhing /de dag sku la sogs/ khrus chal ldab cing / bsku mnye dang / dril phyi 'gre/ bum pa bzhi pas/'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing //tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ phyi zhing / dedag sku la sogs/ khrus chal gsum pa dri bzang dang nye shing byug cing / bsku mnye dang / dril phyi 'gre/ bum pa lnga pas/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing // bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ phyi 'ing /de dag sku la sogs/ khrus chal ldab/ bsku mnye/ ༄za/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo/ 113po che'i rgyan cha sogs la rin 'byung dang / go cha sogs la don grub tu sbyar ba yod kyang sku gsung thugs rten la 'dis chog go/ de thams cad kyang zhi ba'i tshul dgu dang rin po che'i rgyan cha bcu gsum gyis mdzes pa'i mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas shing 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal chen por bzhugs pa'o// de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kur hūṃ/ bdag dang rten gyi thugs pa'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lor badzra sa mā dzaḥbadun pa spyan drang ba ni/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgya dang rdor dril spos bcas/ na mo/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab// sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed cing //'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu// 'di na snod min sems can gang yang med// bzhengs sheg bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum// yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams ni dga' ldan nas// sprul pa dam pa tog dkar lha yi bus// mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas// gzigs pa rnam lngas 'dzam gling kun gzigs shing // glang chen thal dkar ltar gshegs lhums zhugs ltar// rdo rje rin chen padma'i rigs mchog dang // las kyi rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// dus 'dir bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren na// rten mchog 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta gu ru dī wa ḍakki (1 gi ni/ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ ces dang / snyan mnan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// padma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde cing yangs

114 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thig par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ gyis gdan dang / malha sogs kyis nyer spyod phul/ brgyad pa dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ rang rang gi phyag rgya bcas te/ ibadzra adku sha dza : rten dam tshig pa'i spyi bor dgug i badzra pā sha hūṃ/rten la bcug ibadzracha ṭa baṃ gyis dbyer med du bcings/ oṃ badzra ā be sha hoḥ dgyes par bskyed do// dgu pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ rang rang gi phyag rgya rten gyi gnas gsum du bzhag la/gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa āḥ sa mtshan pa/ thugs kur hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gas mtshan pas rgyas btab par gyur/ hūṃ/ dpa' ldan sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi sku// deng 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs su rgyas gdab bo// rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtug cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā kā ya badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3 haṃ/ debazhin du kā ya'i gnas su wākka dang / tsikta yang sbyar ro// bcu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs mchod cing bstod la/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang // yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs shing mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskud pa'i las mdzad nas rgyal tshab gyi sa la mngon par dbang bskur bar gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog ma lus sems can skyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang

116 ༄༅g.yuthog snying thigabya/ bcu gsum pa rten dgab pa ni/ sku gzugs kyi gnas gsum dri'i thig le byug cing las sngags bzla/ rdo rjes reg nas/ badzra rakṣa haṃ/ zhes bsrung ba bya/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dbyings su srung bar bsam la/ yibadzra tsakra 〉rti rghaṃ/ zhes mtshon cha dar ser pos dgab/ cho ga'i rjes chog rnams dang chos skyong la gtor ma bsngo/ 'jig rten pa rnams la cha gsum sogs bya zhing thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug go/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rnam grangs bcu bdun las/ dang po dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ gnyis pabum sgrub/ gsum pa bdag 'jug bzhi pa sbyong ba/ lnga pa bkru phyi rnams sta gon bzhin las/khrus kyi bya ba nyi ma 'char ka dang bsgrig go/ spro na 'dir ring bsrel gzhug pa'i srol yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dngos sam/ yang na sarba bibyu swāhā dang / rten 'brel snying po gi wang dang / gur gum bsres pas bris la sku gzugs kyi dbu dang mchod rten gyi bre la gdags pa'am/ rgyab tu bris gang bde bya'o// drug pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dul zhing gus pa'i tshul gyis langs/ spos dngame tog/ dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste dkon mchog gi yon tan rjes su dran pas/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ yon tan thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rdo rje'i rigs dang / rin po che'i rigs dang / padma'i rigs dang / las kyi rigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhesame tog 'thor zhing phyag 'tshal ba lan gsum/ bdun pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang //

༄༅/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo/ 117brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang // bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog/ yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang // rigs /rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang //dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang // lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur//sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang // nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang //sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog/ de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams la rnam kun tu//thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog/'gro ba nad pa ji srid du// nad gsos gyur gyi bar du ni// sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang // de yi nad g.yog byed par shog/ zas dang skom gyi char phab ste// bkres dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal bsal// mu ge'i bskal ba bar ma'i tshe//bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur// sems can phongs shing dbul ba la//bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te// yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su// mdun du nye bar gnas gyur cig/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang // dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang // sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// phangs pa med pa'i gtang bar bya// zhes me tog 'thor/ brgyad pa rten bskyed pa dang / dgu ba ye shes pa spyan drangs pa dang / bcu pa dgug gzhug rnams sta gon bzhin no// bcu gcig pa dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po gang la brten pa de'i dbang chog las byung ba ltar shes par bya ba'am/ma nus na/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs mchod cing bstod la/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang // yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/

118 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigagashegs ma rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs shing mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskud pa'i las mdzad nas rgyal tshab kyi sa la mngon par dbang bskur bar gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas//kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog/ ma lus sems can skyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog/rnam rgyal bum pa btegs la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// hūṃ/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag cing // nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed pa'i// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan sku yi dbang bskur ro// oṃ hūṃ tt+waṃ hrīḥ.āḥbadzra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dbu rgyan bzung la/ hūṃ/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag cing // nyon mongs nga rgyal sbyong byed pa'i// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi// dpal ldan yon tan dbang bskur ro// oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa ṭwāṃ/ rdo rje bzung la/ hūṃ/ 'du shes phung po rnam dag cing // nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa'i// so sor rtogs /rtog pa'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan gsung gi dbang bskur ro// rma padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ dril bu bzung la/ hūṃ/ 'du byed phung po rnam dag cing // nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa'i// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan 'phrin las dbang bskur ro// oṃ kurma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rdor dril spyi bor 'dzin pas (bzung la)/ hūṃ/ rnam shes phung po rnam dag cing //nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa'i// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi// dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ bhu ddha (buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ gnas bya'i lha thams cad rang rang gi rigs kyi yum dang 'khyud rgya byas nas/ dam tshig gsum dang du bzhes par bsams la/ oṃ āḥ:/ thabs

༄7/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo/ 119dang shes rab dbyer med cing // snang stong dbyer med 'di bzung la// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po yi// kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis// 'gro kun rjes su bzung bar mdzod// oṃ mahā badzra hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍi a/ zhes dril bu 'khrol zhing dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā a nu rā ga badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3 haṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ slar yang mtha' rten bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba mi/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams dbang gi bya ba la dgyes pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba yu bar bzung ste dbang bskur bar gyur/ bkra shis chen po'i bum pa ni// bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i pho brang ste// dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gyur pa yi// dbang mchog bde bar sbyin par bya// oṃ ratna kurma bhuddha (buddha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dag bya ma lus di sbyangs/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ nam mkha'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin du rten la thim par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ gsang dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas nyi zla byang chub sems kyi sprin rdo rje'i ljags 'a/ spro bar mos la/ hūṃ/ dga' ba byang chub sems chen po// kun tu tshim par byed pa yi//dkar dmar lhag pa'i byang chub sems// dbang thob khyed kyi lce la ba'ag/a/ ho mahā su kha hoḥ shes rab ye shes ni/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs ka nas thar nga/ bsten (brten)pa la bskul ba'i rig ma gzugs dang lang tsho'i dpal gyis 'byor pa du ma byon nas gnasabya'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bar (phang du byon pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes pa rol ba mdzad par bsam ste/ rig tsaka gam/ dril bu bzung la/ khyer cig khyer cig bde ba can / shes rab dam pa 'di yin no// khyod kyis ye shes bskyed /skyed par byed// 'di la rtag tu rol mo /bar gyis// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā a nu rā ga ṇa badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3 haṃ/ dbang ba'i pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid chen po byang chub sems kyi dbang la bskur bya skur byed kyis rgyu 'bras dag par bsams la/ chos rnams thams cad nam
