120 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamakha'i khams// dngos po mtshan ma kun las 'das// nam mkha' bzhin du ye gnas la// de la mkhas pas bcos su med// ces mnyam par bzhag bcu gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ rdo rje lha mo bcu drug gis mchod/ bcu gsum pa bstod pa ni/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang // sogs dang / brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku// sogs/ de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing //bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces so// bcu gsum pa dbang po'i skyon bsal ba ni/ dngul snod du mar dkar dang sbrang rtsi/ ka ra/ nir mal la (li sogs pa'i mig sman sbyangs pa gser thur gyis blangs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon las/ cung zad blang ba rang yod/ thogs la/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal pos 'jig rten gyi// rab rib gser gyi thur mas bsal ba ltar// sems can rnams la gzigs pa lhur mdzad phyir// ye shes spyan mchog sri zhus dbye bar bya// oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ lan gsum/ rna drung (drud thogs la/ 'on pa lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams//chos kyi dung sgras sad pa'i phyir// rgyal ba'i snyan ni dbye bgyis pas// lha yi rna ba thob par shog/ oṃ dī bya kurṇa ya swāhā/ rmang gzer thogs la/ gzung 'dzin dri yi bzhon pa la// blang dor chags pa'i 'gro ba rnams// 'phags pa'i tshul khrims dri bsung la// spyod phyir shangs ni dbye bar bya// oṃ dī bya ghā ṭī ya swāhā/thur dpyad thogs la/ 'gro kun brjod pa rnam dag pa// rdo rje'i ljags la dbang thob phyir// ye shes zhal mchog dbye bgyis pas// chos kyi ro yis tshim par shog/ oṃ dī bya mu kha ya swāhā/ tshems shing thogs la/ mtshan dpes 'khyud pa'i thag (thags bzang tshems// nyes skyon dri yis ma gos kyang // myu gu gsar pa'i tshems shing 'dis// bkur sti mchog la brtson par bgyi// oṃ dī bya dant+ra ya swāhā/ zhes dang / de la 'dod yon lngas mchod pa ni/ oṃ rū pa pra tītstsha ā:nyu/ shapta/ghadhe/ rā sa/ parsha (sparsha1pra tītstsha āḥ&/ bcu bzhi pa rten bsgyur ba ni/ slob dpon

༄7/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo/ 121gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mos rten la reg cing se gol gyi sgras mtshon pa gnas bya'i sngags dang /rma āḥlha swāhā/ lan gsum brjod la/ rigs kyis mtshon pa'i lha rnams yongs su gyur pa las sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ ces brjod/ bco lnga pa rab tu gnas pa ni/ rten la gzungs thag btags pa'i sne mo slob dpon gyis bzung la/ gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi thugs kur zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rten so so'i rnam par byon nas de la bzhugs par gyur/ sku gzugs la su pra tiṣṭha dang / mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang la/ oṃ hūṃ hrīḥdhu khaṃ bidzñā bha wa dṛ ḍū tiṣṭha bhu khaṃ swāhā/ gsung rten la gnyis ka dang / thun mong du/ rten 'brel snying po ci mang bzla/ bris sku yin na/ oṃ sarba bityā swāhā/ la sogs pa'i rgyab yig gdab/ rjes 'brel du shis pa brjod pa ni/ sngar gzungs bum gyi chus bran pa'i me tog 'thor zhing / byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa rnams (rnam drug po g.yos gyur cing // bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsung zhing // thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing // tshogs kun dpang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// ces dang / na mo ratna twa yā ya/ ye dharmā he tu sogs bzla/ bcu drug pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang //sil snyan rnams dang sogs shlau ka gnyis pos mchod de/ rten gyi khri'am de la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa nas bzung ste/ thal mos sbyar bas btud de/ ji srid sa chu me dang ni// rlung gis bskal pas 'jig bar du// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod// 'di ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu//'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang // nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang //mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol//

122 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaphyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bcu bdun pa mnga' dbul la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po la mchod pa mnga' dbul ba ni/ thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog mandar dang padma dang // utpal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang // phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi//gser gyi padma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal tshim /sem byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig/ ces dang / de bzhin du/ bla na yod pa'i mchod pa rnams bris 'bur gyi rnam par bkod pa 'bul ba las/ maṇḍal 'bul rjes/ de'i bkod pa gling bzhi ri rab bcas phul la/ khor yug rir bcas bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing // ma lus yongs bkang 'dod dgus 'byor ba dang // phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho ji snyed kun// blo yis blangs te thub dbang sras bcas mchod// ston ga'i mtshan mo dkar ba'i ri bong 'dzin// gza' bral rgyu skur phreng bas bskor ba dang // nyin phyed (byedaka'od stong dra bas mdzes 'bar ba// gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur

༄༅/rten gsum rab hūṃ gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo/ 123rnams kyis mchod// ces dang / rin chen sna bdun rdzas brgyad/ nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs phul la/ bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shes rdzas brgyad dang // nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs rgya che bas// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams mchod// rtags brgyad phul la/ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa'i bkra shis rtags// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// zhes dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa / lha tshogs 'jig rten kun na yid 'ong ba'i// gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen dra ba can//glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bab cing // rgyan mchog brgya phrag mnga' ba rnams kyis mchod// rin chen ri bo nags tshal padmo'i tshal// ngang mo'i 'gros kyis gnyer ba de dag dang // sman sogs dri zhim ngad ldan dpag bsam shing // me tog 'bras bus dud pa'i tshogs kyis mchod// 'dab stong g.yo bas bung ba bzung ba yi// lag pa'i gdu bu ku mu das mtshan shing //sprin bral nyi zla'i zer gyis rab phye ba'i// utpal la sogs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// tsan dan bsil ba'i kha yi sbubs bskyod pa'i// dri 'im bser bu bde ba'i ngad rnams dang // phug dang brag ri'i sman ljongs nyam/sa dga' ba// chu bsil rdzing bus gang ba rnams kyis mchod// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub dbang skyes kyi mchog/sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lags na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs 'di dag bzhes su gsol// zhes so// gnyis pa bye bras ni sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so la 'bul ba las/ chags bral gyi rnam pa can la/ 'dreg spyad phul la/ sazhon nu lang tsho gsar pa'i mthon mthing yang // mchod rten rnam dag drung du spangs gyur pas// khyim pa'i rtags las grol ba'i 'dreg spyad ni// phul bas

124 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'agro kun khyim las dbugs 'byin shog/ oṃ sarba sho dha na gatstsha da hūṃ/ chos gos gsum phul la/ mtshan bzang sku yi ljon pas ngur smrig gi/ rgyal mtshan gsar pa'i lhab lhub g.yo ba can// bslab gsum don dang ldan pa'i chos gos gsum// phul bas 'gro rnams brtul zhugs der gnas shog/ oṃ dī bya wa st+ra baṇa ye swāhā/ chu tshags dang lhung bzed sogs phul la/ drang srong mchog la 'os pa'i nyer spyad ni// bee ḍūrya yi lhung bzed dam pa dang // chu tshags la sogs phul bas 'gro ba kun// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis thob par shog/ rma u pa yo dzu te pā ri stu rā ya swāhā/ longs sku'i rnam pa can la/ dung gi so mangs phul la/ mthon mthing g.yas su 'khyil ba'i zur phud can// rin chen nor bu'i tog gas lham par mdzes// skye dgu kun gyis blta bas mi ngoms der// skyang nul cho ga gsar pas sri zhu bgyid// oṃ kā ma mā la dha ra li hūṃ/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i na bza' phul la/ gang la reg na 'jam pa'i lha rdzas kyang // dbang po'i tshon gyis 'khyud pa'i smig sgyu (rgyu yis// bar snang za 'og gcal du bkram pa ltar// 'bar bas 'gro kun bzod pa'i gos thob shog/ oṃ badzra wa st+ra ye swāhā/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs phul la/ rang bzhin lta na sdug pa'i mtshan dpe la// bcos ma'i rgyan gyis brgyan par ma (mina'atshal yang // do shal dpung rgyan se mo do la sogs//kha sbyor bdun gyi bdag nyid mtshon phyir 'bul// rma ratna ā leṅgā kyilaṅgā rā (ra rgyu/ de bzhin du so mangs/ khab snyung / chu gri sogs phul la/ bzo gnas la sogs rig pa'i 'khyud dpyad kyis// 'jig rten rjes su 'dzin pa ston pa'i phyir//rnam pa sna tshogs nyer spyad 'di phul bas// sems can rmongs dang nad las thar bar shog/ oṃ u pa yo dzu ta pā ri sku rā ya swāhā/ khro bo'i sku rnams la dur khrod chas brgyad phul la/ 'jig rten na ni dpa' bo yi// mi bsrun tshar gcod gos gyon bzhin// sngon tshe dpal chen he ru gas// ru tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags ni// thabs mkhas 'phrin las zhing chen dang // khyab pa thugs rje glang po'i ko/

༄༅rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo/ 125dbang sdud stag lpags sham thabs gos// 'di yang dpal gyi dam tshig ste//'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgyar longs// rgyal rigs dkar khra'i dbu rgyan dang //rje rigs ser khra'i snyan cha ste// bram za (ze dmar skya'i mgur chu (cha can//dmangs rigs nag khra'i ska rags dang // gdol pa ljang nag gdu bu'i rgyan//'di yang dpal gyi dam tshig ste// 'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgyar longs// thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang // rlon pa'i se ral tshal bu ni// dpung rgyan dag tu dpyangs pa'o// 'di yang dpal gyi dam tshig ste// 'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgyar longs// dpral bar thal chen tshom bu dang // smin dbrag rakta'i thig le ste// o (og kor zhag gi zo (sor ris gdab// 'di yang dpal gyi dam tshig ste// 'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgyar longs// de nas gdan sogs phul la/ pad nyi dregs pa khyo shug gdan// rus pa'i rgyan drug phyag mtshan dang // dug gsum sreg byed me dpung sogs// drag po'i 'dod yon mtha' yas pas//khro rgyal tshogs la bste stang bgyi// gsung rten la/ khri dang glegs chab na bza' sogs phul la// sna tshogs dar gyis bkab pa'i seng ge'i khri// thabs dang shes rab ljon pa'i glegs bu zung // mtha' dag gcig tu byed pa'i sku chings dang // lnga phrag brtsegs pa'i na bza' dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badzra pusta (pusti ka ā sa nā wa st+ra ye swāhā/ thugs rten la/ srog shing dang chos 'khor phul la/ thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa rin po che// yun du gnas phyir srog shing dam pa dang // 'khor lo brtsegs ma phul bas 'gro ba kun// sku gsum ye shes lnga yi gnas thob shog/oṃ sarba birya dharmā dha tu tsakra swāhā/ cod pan dang 'phan phul la/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa la sogs pa// byang chub phyogs kyi grags snyan mtha' dag kun// ye shes lnga mtshon dar gyi cod pan dang // 'phur lding g.yo ba'i ba dan 'dis thob shog/ oṃ pa haṃ kā lam̐ pā ya kum bhi rwa dhwa dza swāhā/ gdugs dang me tog gi phreng ba

126 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigaphul la/ 'gro 'di dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum gyi// grib bsil nyid du bsti dang (stang dbugs 'byin phyir// gdugs dang me tog phreng ba 'di phul bas// 'khor ba'i tsha gdung gtan nas bcil bar shog/ oṃ bhra ma ṇa ya ratna mā la 〉ཿ (sāhā/) khri gdan khyad par ba rnams phul la/ stobs bcu ldan pa glang po'i khri mchog dang // mi 'jigs bzhi ldan seng ge rdzu 'phrul rta// dbang bcu ldan pa'i rma bya mkha' lding stobs// 'gro ba'i re skong rin po che yi stan// chags pa'i skyon bral padma nyi zla ni// rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam pa thams cad pa'i//gdan khri phul bas 'gro ba ma lus kun// theg pa chen po'i lam la gnas par shog/ces phul/ gsum pa khyad par tsā ru'i bza' bas mnga' gsol ba ni/ lha bshos gtsang ma de nyid chus bran nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlabs/ rten gyi drung du khyogs la btegs nas/zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa// sogs kyis phul/ grub na skabs 'dir rgyas pa'isbyin sreg gi tshogs gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi ye shes sams /sems dpa' thab tu spyan drangs la dkar gsum mngar gsum shing 'bras 'o thug 'bras chen gtso bor gyur pa'i sreg rdzas dang tsā ru'i cha shas kyang 'bul zhing / gshegs gsol gyi tshe slar yang rten gyi thugs kur bzhugs so/gzhug gon/ ji ltar yang / mtha' rten bkra shes kyi mnga' gsol ni/ ye dharmā sogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas padma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan mnga' ba// bkra shis dang po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ de yis nye bar brten pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// bkra shis gnyis po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// bkra shis gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan nga/ dang //

༄7/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo/ 127brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang // snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste// gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang // mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs las grol ba dang //'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang // tshe ring nad med bde legs phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung 'gyur ba'i// lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang // bzod pa sgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsom (rtsom pa dang //mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs gyur pa'i// drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa// rin chen 'byung ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang // don yod grub ces rigs lnga'i bkra shis gang // bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ bde chen rnam dag chos dbyings gang chen mtsho// mkha' 'gro rigs lnga ye shes sprin 'phro ba// snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i zhing // bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bcu las/ dang po gtor ma gtong ba ni/ phyogs skyong dang 'byung bo spyi la phyi rol du cha gsum gyi tshogs bsngo/ 'das gtor dang / chos skyong rnams kyi skong (bskang ba ci nus bya'o/ gnyis pa srung ma bsgo ba ni/ gnas bzhi /gzhi de'i srung ba /ma dang / sgos su gnyer gtad dmigs bsal yod na de'i gtor ma zur du bshams pa phul la/ rdo rje bka' nan gyi rgya btings te/ badzrarakṣa lhaḥ zhes dang / oṃ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭaḥ zhes dam la bzhag rdo rje'i chos skyong che ge mo ma mgon lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rten 'di rnams kyi srung ma dang yon bdag gyis la 'di dag dngos dang dkor cha la mi bsrun par bgyid pa rnams la chad pas gcod cing srung ba dang skyong ba'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad /chad par mdzod cigaces gnyer gtad bya'o/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ me tog

128 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigamachod phreng ring ba'am sprin mdzes lding khang mdzes 'bar ba// spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung dang // gzi ldan sgron me zhal zas rol mo'i sprin//bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod// ces dang / dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang // mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la//rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad par 'bab par shog/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag/ bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos mchod//bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig/ ces rolamo bya/ bzhi pa nongs bshags ni/ brjod med don bshags dang / khyad par cho ga'i bya ba nongs pa la dmigs te thal mo sbyar nas/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// gang dag cho ga ma tshang ba// de dag bzod par mdzad pa'i rigs// dbyangs gsal la yig brgya sbrel ba tshar gsum brjod/ grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kyang bya'o// lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bkra shes pa'i rdzas rnams 'du bya/ de dang nye bar stan bzang po me tog gi tshom bu can la yon bdag gos rgyan bzang po byas la 'khod/ nye logs su rten la 'bul rgyu'i mchod pa sna lnga yang bsdogs/ dpon slob yon bdag bcas par tsā ru'i bza' ba'ang 'grims shing / bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni//gsol zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur// zhes dang / khyed kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar gsungs par rab gnas par// de dag don ni ngas byas te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyis// ci bde bar ni mchod par byos// gus dang sri zhu yang dag gis// yon gnas mchog la bsnyen bkur ba'i// bsod nams de ni brjod mi lang // rnam par gzigs la sran rdog bdun// phul bas gzhon nu nga las nu// 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyur la ltos// de bzhin ston pas 'jam dpal la// nga yi 'khor ni rnam bzhi yis// da lta nga la mchod byas dang // ma 'ongs pa na dad pa yis//gzugs brnyan rnams ni mchod pa la// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin//

༄༅/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis 'dod 'jo/ 129bsod nams mnyam zhing rnam smin mnyam// zhes gsungs snying la yang dag zungs// zhes bsgos pas de ma thag par yon bdag gis kyang sngar bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams lag bstar te rten la dbul zhing phyag byas nas stan la 'khod/ drug pa bkra shes par bya ba ni/ las bum gyi chus rdzas dang yon bdag la 'thor bas bgegs bskud/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las bkra shes pa'i rdzas brgyad so so'i byed las grub pa'i rnam pa dang / yon bdag kyang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon dzam bha lar gyur par bsam la me tog 'thor zhing / dpa' bo chen po gang skyes par// phun tshogs don kun 'byor gyur cing // don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos te// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par gyur// sangs rgyas khyod la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa lha rnams dang // 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyod la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig/ sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang // lha rnams kyi ni bsam pa yis// khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa'i// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig/ ces brjod cing me tog gtor nas bkra shis kyi rdzas re re bzhin yon bdag la gtod /gtad cing / me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis//ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shes des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig/ gi wang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas//nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa yi// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs te// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig/ dur was tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe 'di rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yis//

130 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigabakra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel bar shog/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bca' ba'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shes des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te//chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shes des kyang tshig dbang thob gyur cig/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang // chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pas// bkra shis des kyang chos srid brtan gyur cig/ yungs kur rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yis// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi gyur cig/ ces pa'i mthar yon bdag gis rten la 'bul tshul bya zhing // der 'khod thams cad kyis kyang reg nas mthar yon bdag la gtad do// 'dir rdzas bshad yongs su grags pa ltar spro na de ltar bgyid cing / de lta na'ang khye'u bkra shis kyi rtswa ni dur wa yin pa mdo las ma mthong / de bzhin du ma skyes dgra'i glang po nor skyong lhas byin gyis ston pa la rbad pas ston pa'i byin rlabs kyis de'i sems nye bar zhi ba la sogs pa bshad pa bye brag pas skabs phyed pa smra ba yod na legs so// bdun pa rten la mchod pa ni/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// mchod pa bla med rgya chen rnams kyis mchod// me tog phal cher me tog bla re dang // me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste// me tog sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas//bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba de dag mchod// me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas chu// bla bre 'phan ldi gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra// rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdza rnga la sogs dang // lus dang longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis// 'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog sras bcas mchod// dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang //mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char//rgyun mi chad pa 'bab par shog/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag/ bstod

༄༅/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo/ 131dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos mchod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la//nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig/ ces smon lam kyang gdab bo// bskyid pa dga' ston bya ba ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshims pa drug ldan du bskor zhing / gzhan yang yon gnas mchog dman thams cad la bza' btung gi rnyed pas tshim par bya/ slob dpon dang bzo de'i grogs su gyur pa rnams la'ang drin du gzo ba'i bsti stang dang rol mor bgyid pas mtshon dga' ston rgya chen po bgyid par bshad pa yin no// dgu pa bsngo ba ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos te las don yod par byas pa'i ched du bzang po bzhi ldan gyi bsngo ba'ang khri brgyad stong par/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po dang nam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas zin pa de'i tshe thar ba'i grong khyer du 'jug par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo bas rgyas btab cing slar yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod/ bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rnam dag kyang gdab bo// bcu pa las kyi rjes chog ni/ rdul tshon gyi cho ga dang 'brel na da'i (de'i bya ba sogs mtha' rgyas rnams dkyil 'khor gyi las gzhung bzhin du bya ba yin no// de ltar dngos lta nyin gnyis ma'i// rab gnas nyin zhag mang sbrel na// thog ma'i nyi ma gnyis pa yi// dngos ga'i'i brtan bzhugs gsol gdab rjes// phyi dro sta gon cho ga bya// de ltar sbrel nas nyin tha mar// sta gon gyi ni mal dag tu// mnga' dbul la sogs rjes chog rnams// dkyus su byas pas 'grub pa yin// nyin chog la ni bum pa gsum gtso las khrus// bkod la dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod dang // rten spyod bkru phyi bskyed spyan drangs// dgug dang rgyas gdab song ba'i rjes// dngos gzhi'i dbang bskyar mchod bstod dang // spyan dbye rten bsdur rab gnas sogs//dkyus bzhin byas pas tshang ba'o// shin tu bsdu na bskyed bzlas 132 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigazhing // mtha' 'khob kla klo rnams na med// bstan pa nub na yod min zhing //mu stegs byol song sogs mi mthong // de phyir sku gzugs sprul pa yin// zhes gsungs pa la rab gnas pa'i// phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab kyang // cho ga nor na nongs pa'i tshul// rgyud la bshad pa sngar smos shing // ji bzhin grub pa'i phan yon ni// rgya cher bshad mod gsang snying las// sa la sogs las phyag rgyar byas// rnam grol rig pa thob 'gyur na// dag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyangs pas// smos ci dgos te de nyams min// zhes gsungs so// rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shes 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nub par bya ba'i rten 'brel dang sems can rnams kyi bsod nams rgya chen po 'phel zhing / 'jig rten bde ba'i ched/ bkra shis srong btsan bang sor rten bzhengs kyi rim pa bgyis pa'i tshe rig pa 'dzin pa mkhyen brtse'i lhas sbyar ba'o// rgyu sbyar dge slong mkhyen rab mthar phyin nas//sku gshegs ngag dbang 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang // a ma ye shes sgrol mas thog drangs pa'i// 'gro kun sangs rgyas go 'phang thob phyir du// tshe sgrub dbang bshad rta khyung dbang bsnyen dang // byang sdom rgyun 'khyer rab gnas cha lag par// brkos pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sgrib gnyis byang // chos sbyin mdzad /'dzad med 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ sarba mas lam̐// / /

133༄༅// g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharmā pā la na maḥ bka' srung dam can sde dgu yi/ mngon rtogs mdor bsdus rim pa ni/ mchod gtor bsang sbyangs byin brlabs nas/ rang nyid lhar gsal mdun gyi mkhar// chos 'byung dgra bgegs pad nyi'i steng / skad cig dran rdzogs 'ja' ltar shar// snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ bka' sdod bran 'khor tshul du bskyed// dang po ni/ oṃ brjod pas snod bcud thams cad stong par sbyangs/ āḥbarjod pas thod pa'i snod stong gsum dang mnyam pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūṃ brjod pas gtor ma ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po 'dod yon gyi sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥ: lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo sogs lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /oṃ shu n+ya twa sogs/ dbus su mahā kā la/ gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rab khros 'jigs rung phyag g.yas nor bus yu ba byas pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod rlon gyi nang du bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams shing / dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol ba/ mi mgo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan te/ tsandan gyi beng chen rked par btsugs nas rta nag rting dkar rlung gi shugs 'chang ba la chibs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// 'khor rnams ni shar du e ka dza ṭī mthing nag rab khros zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs yongs

134 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigardzogs g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag dre'u gwa pa la zhon te/ snga sha la tshon gyi dru gu/ phyi sha la nad kyi rkyal pa btags pa/ spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan te/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor nas me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ lhor khyab mjug ('jug chen po rā hu la sku mdog rab tu 'jigs pa'i khro gzugs sku smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba'i dbu dgu'i gtsug na bya rog gi mgo bos brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na sbrul zhags/g.yon na ra'i mda' gzhu bsnams shing / mgo lus thams cad mig 'jigs su rung bas gang ba/ sprin nag chu srin mgo dgu la zhon nas/ sde brgyad gzhan thams cad bran du khol bar bsam mo// nub tu mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ce spyang dmar mo rab tu khros pa'i gdong can khrag ral sprugs pas dgra bgegs la nad kyi char pa 'bebs pa/ lus gcer bur nu ma thur du 'phyang ba'i phyag bzhi'i dang po thod khrag 'og ma gnyis kyis g.yas dgra zor/g.yon rgyu zhags dang mi mgo 'phyar ba/ dur bya mgo dgu pa la zhon nas dur khrod ma lus kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ byang du gnod sbyin shan pa dmar po mtshal cog la'am byu ru'i mdog can/ stag gi gdong pa rab khros phyag gnyis g.yas zangs gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod cing / g.yon dgra snying rgyu ma dron mo thogs pa/ tsitta'i phreng bas lus kun brgyan te g.yu 'brug zhon nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med pa dang bcas nas stong gsum myul ba'i bdag por gyur/ shar lho'i dam can srog gi spu gri sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros shing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can gyi srin po'i zhal rngams shing brjid par phyag gnyis g.yas spu gri/ g.yon dam nyams pa'i glo snying thogs pas dar nag gi 'jol ber gyon zhing / mi mgo'i phreng ba can seṅge la zhon te skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog gi bdag por gyur/ lho nub tu srin po dgra 'dul 'jigs byed dmar nag khro gtum rab 'jigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ yas kyi mche bas

༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long / 135brang gi nyen snar slebs/ mas kyi mche ba dpral ba'i dbyings su slebs pas mi ro chem chem du za zhing spyi bor spyang gdong kha gdangs nga ro sgrogs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon rtse gsum dang rgyu zhags bzung ste/mi lpags rlon pa gyon zhing ro langs mgo dgu zhon pa/ keng rus gar byed dung phyur grangs med kyis bskor ba phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs kyi gshed ma chen mor gyur pa/ nub byang du bdud shānti ro zan dud mdog rab khros 'jigs rung bya mgo can mche gtsigs spyan dmar can khrag gi ral ba sprug nu ma 'phyang ba phyag gnyis g.yas rgyu zhags dang dgra sta 'phyar zhing / g.yon tsitta bsnams nas lcags spyang mgo dgu la zhon nas dgra bgegs sgrol bar gyur/byang shar du srog bdag hob se dug ha la'i mdog can mthing nag rab khros 'jigs rung zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ spyi bor bya khra'i mgo bo cher rgod cing /phyag dang po gnyis mdung dang dug gi rkyal pa thogs pa/ 'og ma gnyis mi mgo rlon pa dang phur ba bsnams shing / dred mo mgo dgu la zhon nas dam nyams thams cad kyi gshed mar gyur/ de dag thams cad kyang nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan/ khro ba/ gtum pa/ 'jigs pa/ rngams pa/ snying rje med cing mi sha mi khrag gsur chen gyi dri tshor ba tsam gyis bzod glags med pa/ rkan sgra rdobs pa/ skad cig re re la sprul pa yang sprul sum sprul nyi zer rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa phyogs bcur 'gyed nus pa dang / khams gsum srid gsum mtha' dag myul ba/ bstan dgra thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog par byed cing / rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i bka' nyan gsung sdod par gyur/ rang nyid yi dam gyi thugs ka dang / khong rnams kyi gnas gsum nas 'od 'phros rang rang gi gnas nas sngon gyi dam tshig dbang gis spyan drangs par gyur/ gsur chen gyi dud pa/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ thod rnga/ rkang gling / rol mo'i sgra sogs mthun rdzas rnams 'tshogs pa'i sgo nas spyan 'dren par bya'o/

136 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigan maḥsarba dharmā pā la ye/ kun 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ dbang thob dam ldan bsnyen sgrub thebs/ lta ba'i gdeng thob rnal 'byor la/ chos skyong ma bsgrubs par yang 'khor/'onakyang dam can sde dgu yi/ gtor mchod bstod bskul mdor bsdus pa/ bla ma'i gsung las legs 'ongs bri/ dgyes bzhin bka' gnang stong grogs mdzod/ dur khrod gnas chen dben gnas su/ sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma'i tshogs// sman rag mchod rdzas spyan gzigs bshams/mthun rten bskang rdzas 'dzoms par bsags/ bdag nyid rtsa gsum las gzhung bsrang / de nas bka' srung mnyes bya'i phyir/ oṃ brjod snod bcud stong par sbyangs/ āḥbarjod thod pa stong gsum mnyam/ hūṃ brjod de nas dgra bgegs kyi/ sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba las/ ngo bo zag med bdud rtsir brlab/ gsur chen dud pa rol mo dang / gdung ba'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do// : :/dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs bka' srung spyan 'dren no//stobs ldan sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa ma ya dza dzaḥ&/ dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas 'dir// sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i klong // bstan bsheg ma rungs bsgral ba'i phyir//bka' srung 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya st+waṃ/ hūṃ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin// dus las mi 'da' dam nyams snying 'byin pa// dam can chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū ho/ hūṃ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i khrag rnams mtsho chen bskyil// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog gcal du bkram//gsur chen bdug spos dud pa sprin ltar gtibs// zhun chen snang gsal mar me nyi bas gsal// rdo rje dri chu byug pa'i rdzing bu mdzes// don snying sha rus zhal zas ri ltar spungs// thod rnga rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog/ rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang med// sman rag gtor tshogs spyan gzigs longs spyod rnams// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bde ba'i mchog/ bka' srung drag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las myur du sgrubs// oṃ mahā kā la yakṣa badzra tsitta sogs/ rang rang rtsa sngags sham bu ru/ ambha

mahā ba li tas gtor ma/ dgra bo'i paṃ sa/ tsitta rakta/ki ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha: i rda gro ṇḍa swāhā/ sarba pū dza bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya ho//dharmā pā la na maḥ skye med
