sogs dus// dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi'i steng // zhing chen khrag snas chag chag gdab/ chos 'byung rtse brgyad thod pa'i khar// dmar nag me ri 'bar ba'i dbus// lcags sam bhantar 'bru nag gi/ dpal gtor sha khrag rgyan dgu'i rtser/ dmar chen tsitta'i phreng ba la/ bya nag mang po lding tshul dang / nya bo sha dum tshe nyungs dang // gtso 'khor rang rang sku 'bag gzugs/ gzhan yang sman gtor rakta dang / dbang lnga'i me tog gsur chen spos/ tshil chen mar me don snying lnga/ khyad par sku gsung thugs rten dang // mthun ldan bskang ba dgyesapa'i rdzas/ bsgrub la gsol kha'i gzhung ltar bshams// zhing lpags gdugs phub yol nag bres// rgyu mas lda ldi tsittas brgyan/ shin tu 'jigs rngam skyi g.ya' zhing / 'byor ldan bag dro'i spyan gzigasadang / tshogs kyi longs spyod bzang bar bshams// rol mo'i tshogs sgra mchod pa'i sprin/bsamagyis mi khyab dngos 'byor dang // yid kyis sprul zhing bskang ba ni/ rtsa ba gsum gyi bskang bshags rjes/ rig pa gzengs bstod 'di skad do// hūṃ mahā kā la gshegs su gsol//legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol// dam can chen po gshegs su gsol//nag po chen po gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas bstan srung gshegs su gsol//rnal 'byor dgra lha gshegs su gsol// rig 'dzin srung ma gshegs su gsol//bdud 'dul dmag dpon gshegs su gsol// chos skyong 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// bye ba sa ya dpung gi tshogs// ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon// sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig dang // byams gdung brtse bas gshegs su gsol// 'jigs pa'i gnas 'dir pad nyi zla// dgra bgegs bsgyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs// gus pas phyag mchod dgyes par bzhes// bstan srung mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol// rtu bskang ngo bskal pa'i

138 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigathugs dam bskang// chos skyong chen po'i thugs dam bskang // dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang // gnod sbyin chen po'i thugs dam bskang //zhang blon chen po'i thugs dam bskang // rdo rje bdud 'dul thugs dam bskang // dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dam bskang // e ka tsa ti'i (dza ṭī'i thugs dam bskang // re ma ti yi thugs dam bskang // gza' bdud rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang // mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang // gnod sbyin dmar nag thugs dam bskang // dam can chen po'i thugs dam bskang //srin po'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang // shān ting ro zan thugs dam bskang //srog bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang // sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs thugs dam bskang // dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang // yang sprul bye ba'i thugs dam bskang // hūṃ thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang // bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// nyi zla padmas thugs dam bskang // sku rten dgyes mdzad yin pa'i phyir// dar nag go zus thugs dam bskang // gsung rten dgyes pa'i rdzas yin phyir// rkang gling thod rdzas thugs dam bskang //thugs rten dgyes pa'i rdzas yin phyir// gri snying srog mdas thugs dam bskang // mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs pa'i phyir// bla rten 'khor los thugs dam bskang // bsten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// snyug tshab mdos dang dar snas bskang // dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gta' gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang // mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// thun gyi gtor mas thugs dam bskang // rgyun du phrin las bcol ba'i phyir// rgyun gtor nar mas thugs dam bskang // dgra bgegs gnas nas 'gugs pa'i phyir// lcags kyu 'bar bas thugs dam bskang // dam nyams thar med bcing ba'i phyir// sbrul nag zhags pas thugs dam bskang // dam nyams

༄7/g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long / 139dbang po bsdam pa'i phyir// rdo rje lcags sgrog thugs dam bskang // dam nyams rnam shes myos pa'i phyir// rdo rje dril bus thugs dam bskang // dgra bgegs btson du 'jug pa'i phyir// lcags khang sgo med thugs dam bskang //dam nyams lha dang phral ba'i phyir// rdzas sngags ting 'dzin thugs dam bskang // dgra bgegs gzugs phung bshig pa'i phyir// drag po'i garwa gyis thugs dam bskang // gzugs phung zhal du bstab pa'i phyir// sha khrag rus pas thugs dam bskang // byad dang bod gtong bzlog pa'i phyir// dmar chen zor gyis thugs dam bskang // dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa'i phyir// rkya mi nag pos thugs dam bskang // dgra la cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i phyir// sna tshogs gzugs kyis thugs dam bskang // hūṃ gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni//spyan gzigs dkor bcas yin pa'i phyir// rta nag rting dkar thugs dam bskang // brjid ldan g.yag gis thugs dam bskang // shel nag spyi dkar lug gis bskang // tshe tshe ra yis thugs dam bskang // ku ku khyi yis thugs dam bskang // mkha' lding bya yis thugs dam bskang // dbang lnga'i me rtog thugs dam bskang // gsur chen dud pas thugs dam bskang // zhun chen mar mes thugs dam bskang // rdo rje dri chus thugs dam bskang // bdud rtsi zhal zas thugs dam bskang // don snying sha rus thugs dam bskang // sman rag gtor mas thugs dam bskang // zhal zas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang // rnga gshang rol mo'i thugs dam bskang // dur khrod bam gyis thugs dam bskang // gsang sna mdos kyis thugs dam bskang // spyan gzigs longs spyod thugs dam bskang // dam rdzas mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang //thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas// mchog thun dngos grub myur du stsol//kye hūṃ dgongs shig dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// mahā kā la dgongs su gsol//legs ldan nag po dgongs su gsol// rnal 'byor dgra lha dgongs su gsol//

140 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigaganod sbyin nor bdag dgongs su gsol// rig 'dzin srung ma dgongs su gsol// chos skyong 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// do nub gnas 'dir spyan yang drangs// do nub thugs dam gnyan po bskang // do nub g.yar dam gnyan po bsre// khyed rnams rgyal sras gu ṇa yi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// slob dpon brgyud kyi srung ma ste// nged ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can// chos bdag slob bu rgyud 'dzin yin// phan tshun gcig la gcig brten 'tshal// tha tshig gnyen (gnyan po ma brjed cig/ rgyang nge g.yel le ma mdzad par// brtse gdung dung sems ci che mdzod// khyed kyi thugs dam bdag gis bskang // bdag gi g.yar dam khyed kyis sgrubs// rkyen ngan zlog la dngos grub stsol// de ltar thugs dam gnyan bskangs nas// rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la//gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba zlog/ phur bu'i dbal kha 'phen pa zlog/ ma mo'i thun zor 'phen pa zlog/ rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gtong ba zlog/ gza' yi ki kyang 'bebs pa zlog/ btsan gyi gzer thabs gtong ba zlog/ sa bdag klu yi gtad khram zlog/ bdud kyi zhags khram btab pa zlog/ mu stegs gdug pa'i ngan sngags zlog/ bande'i hom thun zor 'phen zlog/ skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa zlog/ bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog/ byad kha phur kha zor kha zlog/ thun bzhi'i mi kha smra mchu zlog/ byol ka chag ka mya ngan zlog/ sbyor ngan rbad 'dre bod gtong zlog/ bsam ngan mi mthun gdug rtsub zlog/ lo keg zla keg zhag keg zlog/ za keg bdun zur rbad 'dre zlog/ dgra sna gyod sna byur sna zlog/ nad sna rims sna yams sna zlog/ thog babs sho rtsis babs pa zlog/dal babs bdud babs dgra chag zlog/ nad sri mtshon sri rbab sri zlog/ dgra sri god sri ngan sri zlog/ rgan sri gzhon sri dar sri zlog/ ltas ngan glo bur ye 'brog zlog/ gshed 'khor dus min 'chi ba zlog/ rkyen ngan gnod pa'i

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long / 141tshogs rnams kun// dgra bgegs 'byung po'i steng du bsgyur// bzlog cig bsgyur cig sa ma ya// zhes brjod mi mthun bar chad zlog/ dam bskang mchog thob phrin las rnams// thogs med sgrub byed bka' srung gi/ mdangs bskang bla ma'i gsung gi rgyun// ma nor zur du bkod pa'i dges// bdud dang dgra las rgyal bar shog/de nas bstod cing bsnyen bsgrubs nas// 'bod rbad bsad pa'i las kha bsgyur// bskul zhing dam la gnas par bya'o// gdung ba'i yid dang snyan pa'i dbyangs/ rol mor bcas pas 'di skad bstod do/ hūṃ chos kyi dbyings las 'gag med skur ston pa'i// rdo rje bdud 'dul gnod sbyin chen po'i sku// 'jigs rung mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid// nor bu gri gug thod khrag dgra snying bsnams// dar nag ber gsol mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// tsandan beng btsugs rta nag rting dkar bcibs// bstan pa gnyan bsrung bka' yi bya ra mdzad// chos skyong yongs kyi rje la phyag 'tshal bstod// bhyo ma gcig dpal ldan e ka tsa ti /dza ṭīkam//mthing nag rab khros spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs// khro mo'i chas rdzogs phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin// dre'u rta zhon zhing tshon dru nad rgyal (rkyal btags//snyan g.yas seng chen g.yon pa sbrul nag 'phyo// spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan// me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong nas dgra bgegs sgrol// dam ldan bu bzhin skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ bstan srung khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la//dud kha rab khros sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil// dbu dgu gtsug na bya rog mgo yis brgyan// g.yas g.yon sbrul zhags rwa yi mda' gzhu bsnams// mgo lus mig dang sprin zhon kun tu myul// sde brgyad bran khol mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bdag/ dam can skyong zhing dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// dregs pa'i gtso bo khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ gnas dang yul gyi sha za mkha' 'gro'i gtso//rab 'jigs dmar mo ce spyang mgo dgu ma// khrag ral sprugs pas stong gsum nad kyis 'gengs// gcer bu rgyan med nu ma thur du 'phyang // phyag bzhi dang

142 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigapo gri gug thod khrag gdengs// 'og gnyis dgra zor sbrul zhags mi mgo 'phyar// dur bya mgo dgu zhon nas dur khrod myul// dam nyams srog gcod gtso mor phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ gnod sbyin bshan dmar dam nyams srog gcod gtso// mtshal mdog stag gdong zangs gri dgra snying 'debs// rgyu ma za zhing snying phreng ga sha gyon// g.yu 'brug zhon nas skad cig stong khams bskor// rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med phyogs bcur 'gyed// nyin bzhin dregs pa pho rgyud bran du khol// mtshan bzhin mo rgyud thams cad dbang du sdud// bka' 'das gshed ma khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ bka' srung dam can srog gi spu gri ni// mthing nag rab khros 'jigs rung rngams /rngam pa'i zhal// spyan dmar smin g.yo skra ser gyen du 'bar// lcags kyu spu gri dgra bo'i glo snying bsnams// dar nag ber gyon mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// seng ge zhon nas stong khams ma lus myul// sprul pa yang sprul dgra srog chu bzhin 'thung // bzlog med dgra dpung nag por phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ srin po'i rgyal po dgra 'dul 'jigs byed ni// dmar nag rab 'jigs khro gtum srin po'i zhal// mche ba brang slebs mi ro zhal du gsol// spyi bor spyang gdong kha gdangs nga ro sgrog/ ral gri rtse gsum rgyu zhags nam mkhar 'phyar// mi lpags gyon nas ro langs mgo dgu zhon// 'khor du keng rus gar byed dgod pas bskor// dam nyams cod gcod khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ shan ting ro zan bdud mo bya rgod mgo/ dung (dudakamadog mche gtsigs khrag ral phyogs bcur sprug/ mi sdug nu ma brang gi ngos la 'phyangs// gcer bu mi lpags snying phreng ga sha gyon// g.yas g.yon rgyu zhags dgra sta dgra snying 'phyar//spyang mo mgo dgu zhon nas stong gsum myul// skad cig re la dgra srog 'bum 'bum gcod// rnal 'byor srung ma'i gtso mo khyed la bstod// hūṃ rgyal ba'i bstan srung las mkhan dgra bo'i gshed// srog bdag hob se ha la nag po'i

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long / 143mdog/rab 'jigs khro zhal gtsugs nas khra mgo rgod// mche gtsigs dug rlangs nag pos dgra bo gsod// phyag bzhi dang po mdung dang dug rkyal bsnams// 'og ma phur bu dam nyams mgo rlon za// dred mo mgo dgu bcibs nas stong khams myul// rnal 'byor grogs mdzad dgra gshed phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ kun 'dus rgyal ba bla ma'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srog gi snying po phul// sgrub po'i sku dgra sgrol bar mna' phul ba// dam can bka' srung sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po dran mdzod la// rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod par bzhes// bos pa'i dus su ma thogs myur du spyon// rbad tshe mngags pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs// zhes bstod/ de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ rang nyid rtsa gsum skur gsal ba'i// bran du chos skyong sprin bzhin 'dus// gang 'dod phrin las sgrub bsams nas// sngags rnams dril nas bzlas par bya// grangs tshad 'bum phrag gsum yin no// rang nyid yi dam thugs ka nas//sngags phreng bung ba'i rnam pa can// grangs med sngags kyi dar dir sgrog/bka' srung rnams kyi sna nas zhugs// snying ga padma ma kha bye /phye ba'i// srog gi dwangs ma'i sbrang rtsi 'jibs// slar yang thon nas tshur byung ste// rang gi thugs kur thim pa las// bka' srung rang srog dbang 'dus shing // ci bcol bran bzhin nyan par bsam// oṃ mahā kā la yakṣa badzra tsitta hūṃ phaṭa raṇḍa /ratna sirnyi hūṃ/ zhang blon srog sngags so/ i e ka dza ti /ṭīkam ma ro ru ba (bo lha bhyo/ lha mo'o/ oṃ ke ta ke ta swāhā/ rā hu la sa ma ya hūṃ/ khyab 'jug go/ ḍami (1 gi ni tsitta rakṣa (raktakas ma ya hring hring dzaḥ mkha' 'gro ce spyang mchu dmar ro//yakṣa tsitta mahā tsitta mahā rū dra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bshan dmar ro// badzra sā dhū sa ma ya a mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥdam can no// rakṣa rakṣa rā dza sa ma ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum dza/ srin po'i 'o// durnying tsitta kā la dgra bo thum ril mā ra ya rbad/bdud mo ro zan no// tri shaṃ rbad bhyo gang ka ra dgra bo'i srog la tab hab/ las mkhan gyi'o//

144 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigathams cad kyi mjug tu dza dzaḥbatags nas bzla'o/ rang rang srog sngags dril la bzlas// thun mtshams mchod gtor bstod la 'bad// dngos nyams rmi lam snang ba la// rab tu rang gzugs dngos su ston/ 'bring du mi nag rta nag dang / bya nag mang ba lding tshul 'khor dang // bud med mang pos 'bod pa dang // bshan pa rdo mon a tsa ra// gcan gzan mang po 'du ba dang // de rnams rang la phyag 'tshal zhing / ci bgyi'i bka' sgrub smra ba 'byung / 'od dang thug chom tshag sgra 'ong / tha ma de rnams sna re tsam// res mthong res mi mthong ba 'byung / de tshe bsnyen sgrub bskyar la 'bad/ rtags rnamasardzogs nas gtang rag gam// tshogs gtor btang zhing phyi nang gi/ dam rdzas gzhan la mi bstanagasang // tshogs gtor bsnyen pa rgyun mi bcad/ sngar 'gras mi la snying mi bsre// dam tshig nyams la gtam mi smra// ro dang mdze can yugs grib 'dzem// bya nag khyi nag brdeg gsod spang // zla re'i dgu gtor brtson par bya//de nas mchod bstod gtor bsngos ni/ lhan thabs tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs ltar byas kyang rung la yang na sger bsngo ni/ oṃ badzra ambha nas/ shasta rū pa shapta gadhe ra sa sparsha (sparshanas ma ye āḥ&/ mahā sarba pañtsa mahā ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dgra bgegs kyi mahā māṃ sa rakta ki ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha tt+waṃ i rda grotna swāhā/ sarba pū dza bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya hoḥ lha rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la yakṣa badzra tsitta hūṃ phaṭa/ ratna sirnyi hūṃ/ i rda ba lam̐ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtso bo la 'bul/ 'khor rnams la/ oṃ e ka tsa ti (dza ṭīkam ma ro ru baṃ hūṃ bhyo/i rda ba lam̐ ta kha kha sogs dang / oṃ ke ta ke ta swāhā/ i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rā hu la sa ma ya hūṃ/ i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ḍākki (zu gi ni tsitta rakta sa ma ya hring hring dzaḥ.i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ yakṣa tsitta mahā ru dra mā ra ya hūṃ/ i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ badzra sā dhū sa ma ya a mu ka ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rakta rakta /rakṣa rakṣakas ma ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum dzaḥ i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ durnying tsitta kā la dgra bo thum ril mā ra ya rbad/ i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tri shaṃ rbad bhyo ging ka ra dgra bo'i srog la tab hab i rda ba lam̐ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ho

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogs gsal ba'i me long 145dpal mahā kā la gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo// 'bul lo// mchod do// rgyal bstan spyi dang gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ sems can gyi phan bde spel/ sngags 'chad rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi stong grogs dang phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par dgon gnas grwa tshang 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'khor dang bu slob lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / khams gsum mos pa bzhi dang 'du ba rnam pa gsum thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang dbang du 'du ba dang / dgra bgegs dug lnga dug gsum thams cad tshar bcad nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig/ ces phrin las bcol la/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ chos sku zhi ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang // gzugs sku drag po'i cha lugs sna tshogs kyis// bstan pa srung zhing dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i// chos skyong dam can sde dgu'i tshogs la bstod// de nas snying thig las byang gi tshogs dang 'grel skabs lhag ma'i rjes su mchod gtor gtsang sar gshegs te/ hūṃ/ kun 'dus rgyal ba bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ khas blangs sogs nas/ phrin las bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod/ ces pa'i bar brjod nas/ ho chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams sogs nas tshang nas thon cig/ bar du gyer ro// mthar nongs bshags gshegs gsol rnams snying thig gzhung ltar bya'o//zhes pa'ang lta na sdug pa'i zhing khams gnyis pa lcags po ri bo'i lha'i rje bo rnams kyis phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba yab sras rnams kyi thugs kyi bzhed don mi nyams shing bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas su gyur pa'i gsos sman du bskul ngor chos 'di la mos pa thob

pa'i bya bral ba kurma 'jigs med chos kyi seṅges byang chub ljon pa'i nags khrod 'byung khams lha mo lnga bsil drod cha mi mnyam pa med pa'i bste gnas ga la bar nag 'gros su bkod pas nyes 'gal mchis na sman bla rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dam can sde dgu'i spyan sngar bshags shing / dge bas 'gro rnams nad med bde ba'i lang tsho mchog tu brtas shing rgyal bstan spyi dang gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// / /

pa'i bya bral ba kurma 'jigs med chos kyi seṅges byang chub ljon pa'i nags khrod 'byung khams lha mo lnga bsil drod cha mi mnyam pa med pa'i bste gnas ga la bar nag 'gros su bkod pas nyes 'gal mchis na sman bla rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dam can sde dgu'i spyan sngar bshags shing / dge bas 'gro rnams nad med bde ba'i lang tsho mchog tu brtas shing rgyal bstan spyi dang gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// / /

sang༄7// byin rlabs bla sgrub las rtsa ba gsum gyi mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba bzhugs so//gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba sirnyi ho// kun 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum gyi//dbang thob dam ldan rnal 'byor pas// nya stong dus bzhi bsnyen sgrub dus//lha tshogs thugs dam bskang bya'i phyir// dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor bri//dkon mchog sku gsung thugs rten dgram// sman raka /rag gtor ma spyan gzigs bsham// khyad par thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas// tshil chen dud pa zhun chen me// dbang lnga'i me tog zhal zas tshogs// tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong dang // zal le 'bri dang zhun chen mdangs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams// 'byor ldan bag gro mdzes pa bsham// bdag nyid rtsa gsum las bzhung cigazhung bsrang // tshogs 'khor bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs nas//spyan drangs tshogs phud bshags bskang skabs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// mkha' khyab sprin phung 'khrigs ltar bsam// gsur chen gtong zhing rol mo'ang sgrog/ gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do// hūṃ hrīḥbaskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang // yang dag lta ba klong du gyur pas bskang // ma bcos yeng (yengs 'khrul skyon bral bsgoms pas bskang //blang dor tshul bral shugs 'byung spyod pas bskang // rang bcas phyogs lhung med pa 'bras bus bskang // hrīḥgasang chen lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor na// kun 'dus rgyal ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam can// rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang // yab yum gnyis su med pa'i thugs dam bskang //

148 ༄zagayu thog snying thigarnam shes zhe sdang sems mkha' gnas gyur pa'i// rnam snang rig ye yum bcas thugs dam bskang // tshor ba nga rgyal khrag chu gnas gyur pa'i// rin 'byung rig ye yum bcas thugs dam bskang // 'du shes 'dod chags drod me gnas gyur pa'i// mtha' yas rig ye yab yum thugs dam bskang // 'du byed phrag dog dbugs rlung gnas gyur pa'i// don grub rig ye yab yum thugs dam bskang // hrīḥdon gyi dbyings la bskang yul lha tshogs la// bskang ba'i rdzas dang bskang rdzas mi dmigs kyang // rig rtsal ma 'gags ma rig 'gro don phyir// bla med tshogs mchod 'dod yon du mas bskang // hūṃ/ thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// rtsa ba yan lag stong sbyar sman mchog dang // bdud bzhi 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta dang // rmad byung 'dod yon dam rdzas gtor chen dang // ltag sprod rnga sgra gsur chen rkang chen dung// zhun chen mar me dbang po'i me tog dang // tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong zal le 'bri//rnam dag bam chen 'bru bcud stong sbyar chang // phyi nang gsang mchog /mchodaka zhal zas tshogs mchod kyis// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur cig/ hrīḥbade chen gar gyis rol pas 'gro rnams 'dul//dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang // bde stong zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pas 'khril// yum mchog rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang // zhi ba'i las sgrub bdud 'joms rdo rje'i rigs// mi 'gyur rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang // rgyas pa'i las sgrub bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma// re skong rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang // dbang gi las sgrub khams gsum re ba skong // chags med padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang // mngon spyod las sgrub phrin las thogs med ma// 'gro 'dul las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang // hrīḥthugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman mchog dang // bdud bzhi

༄zakhyen rlabs bla sgrub las rtsa ba gsum gyi mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba/ 149'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta dang // rmad byung 'dod yon dam rdzas gtor chen dang // ltag sprod rnga sgra gsur chen rkang gling dang // zhun chen mar me dbang po'i me tog dang // tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong zal le 'bri// rnam dag bam chen 'bru bcud dza gad bcud// phyi nang gsang mchod zhal zas longs spyod kyis// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur cig/ hūṃ hrīḥchags med dag pa'i brgyud pa ngo sprod phyir// mkha' 'gro dpal ldan phreng ba'i thugs dam bskang // chos nyid don dam gnas lugs mngon gyur phyir// 'gro mgon ma hā gu ṇa'i thugs dam bskang // snang srid 'khor 'das rgyas 'debs rang grol phyir// sum ston ye shes gzung gi thugs dam bskang // rgyal tshab rmad byung 'gro don mthar phyin pa'i// paṇa chen gzhon nu gtsang ston sangs rin dang // mkhas btsun rin rdor don rgyal dkon mchog skyabs// dpal ldan 'tsho byed 'tsho byed rin chen dang // bsod nams dbang phyug rnal 'byor chen po'i mtshan// ri khrod zhig po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang // mchog thun dngos grub mnga' brnyes mnyam rdor sogs// 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang // byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod dgu char 'bebs pa'i// drang srong theg rim dgu dang rgyud sde bzhi'i// pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med rgyud la sogs// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang // dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams gnas yul dur khrod skyong // gang dang ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang // zhing skyong phyogs skyong sha za 'bum phrag tshogs// ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang // chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang // gzugs sku drag po'i cha lugs sna tshogs kyis// bstan pa srung zhing dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i//chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang // sngon tshe rgyal sras gu ṇa'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas sman gyi dngos grub ster// bod khams

150 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigaskyong ba'i sman mo bstan ma'i tshogs// gzhi bdag srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang // ::thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman mchog dang // bdud bzhi 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta dang // rmad byung dam rdzas gtor ma chen po dang // ltag sprod rnga sgra gsur chen rkang gling dang // zhun chen mar me dbang po'i me tog dang // tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong zal le 'bri// rnam dag bam chen 'bru bcud dza gad bcud// phyi nang gsang mchod zhal zas longs spyod kyis// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur cig/ rnal 'byor bdag cag g.yar dam sor stsol cig/ mchog thun dngos grub thams cad 'dir stsol cig/ ces brjod rnal 'byor pho mo rnams// bskang rdzas dar btags spyan gzigs thogs//dkyil 'khor 'chams shing thugs dam bskang // de nas bshags pa'ang 'di ltar bya// mkha' mnyam rgyal ba yid kyis dmigs// kye hoḥphyogs dus rgyas ba zhi khro rab 'byams lha// 'gro 'dul sman rgyal rtsa gsum skur ston dang // rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam rnal 'byor sogs// dbang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol// bdag gis sngon 'das 'khor ba thog med nas//ma rig bag chags 'khrul ba'i las dbang gis// slob dpon sangs rgyas gsung du drang srong sogs// blo bzhag drug dang gzung bya'i dam tshig gnyis//shes gsum phyi yi dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// rdo rje mched lcam bka' 'gal lta ba log/ brdeg btsog rku 'phrog ngan sems gnod sems bsgom //dbang thob lha la sngags dang phyag rgya bcang // bla med theg par khas blangs dam bca' g.yel// gsang ba bcu sogs gsang mchod dam tshig rnams//dam med la bsgrags mnyam 'dres bla ma bslus// rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// yan lag dag la shes bya'i dam tshig ni// phung po 'byung ba yul dbang ye shes lnga// spyad bya sbyor sgrol ma byin rdzun tshig lnga// mi

༄khyakhyen rlabs bla sgrub las rtsa ba gsum gyi mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba/ 151spong chags khro rmongs rgyal phrag dog lnga// dang blang dri chen dri chu dmar chen dang // byang sems gnyis te nyer lnga'i dam 'gal bshags// bla ma'i bka' bcag theg spangs thun bzhi yengs// mchog la the tshom mched lcam thugs dkrugs dang // 'gro la brtse bral nyon mongs rang gar spyod// theg pa'i kha 'dzin ches /chos gzhan smad pa dang // gnyid chang le lo'i dbang shor lta spyod gnyis// zung du ma 'brel bsnyen sgrub mtha' ma 'chol('khyolan// thun mong spyi yi dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// 'khor 'das chos rnams rang rig byang chub sems// gdod nas chos skur ma rtogs mthol zhing bshags//bde gsal mi rtogs dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar gnong (nongs 'gyod drag po yis// dam 'gal bshags pas mchog mthun (thun dngos grub stsol// shulha/ sarba mgi lam̐// //

༄khyakhyen rlabs bla sgrub las rtsa ba gsum gyi mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba/ 151spong chags khro rmongs rgyal phrag dog lnga// dang blang dri chen dri chu dmar chen dang // byang sems gnyis te nyer lnga'i dam 'gal bshags// bla ma'i bka' bcag theg spangs thun bzhi yengs// mchog la the tshom mched lcam thugs dkrugs dang // 'gro la brtse bral nyon mongs rang gar spyod// theg pa'i kha 'dzin ches /chos gzhan smad pa dang // gnyid chang le lo'i dbang shor lta spyod gnyis// zung du ma 'brel bsnyen sgrub mtha' ma 'chol('khyolan// thun mong spyi yi dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// 'khor 'das chos rnams rang rig byang chub sems// gdod nas chos skur ma rtogs mthol zhing bshags//bde gsal mi rtogs dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar gnong (nongs 'gyod drag po yis// dam 'gal bshags pas mchog mthun (thun dngos grub stsol// shulha/ sarba mgi lam̐// //

152༄༅// chos skyong gi gsol kha myur mgyogs glog gi 'od 'bar bzhugs sdo//gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharmā pā la sa ma ya sirnyi hūṃ/ brgyud pa'i rtsa gsum bla ma dang //chos skyong dam can sde dgu yi// gsol mchod phrin las mdor bsdus pa// bla ma'i gsung las legs 'ongs 'bri// dus skabs rdzas mchod phrin las te// nya stong dus bzhi bskang gso'i dus// phrin las tshogs 'khor gzhung bsrangs te// bsgral las bstabs pa tshar skabs su// dkon mchog bka' srung spyisgos kyi/ dam rdzas sman 'bru rin chen lnga// bdud rtsi tshogs dum dza gad kyi// sgos su gsang phyi ('phyi sha khrag bshos/ mkha' lding ra yi sha tshil khrag/ nya sha khrag rul klad mchin khrag/ nal snying nya bo sha khrag snying // rtsi sman sha tshil sna tshogs bsags// bka' srung rang rang mnyes rdzas te// phyi mchod rin chen snod blugs brlabs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rtsa gsum mchod// ho/ mdangs bskang 'od kyi dra ba'i bskang gi mjug rtu 'don/ sangs rgyas mnga' bdag ston pa dam chos gzhi//'dren pa dge 'dun dkon mchog kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di// gsol lo mchod do byin rlabs dngos grub stsol//ho/ kun bzang rgyal ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// pad 'byung gu ṇa dbyer med rdo rje 'dzin// byin rlabs char 'bebs rtsa brgyud bla ma la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di// gsol lo mchod do dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// ho/ rigs lnga yab yum rta phag mkha' 'gro bzhi// lha dang drang srong ye shes sman mo sogs// yi dam dkyil 'khor rgyal ba kun 'dus la//dgyes mnyes mchog gyur zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di// gsol lo mchod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol// srung ma sgos mchod rang rang gi dam rdzas tshogs mchod dbul/hūṃ/ gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul te// mgon po chos skyong pho rgyud

༄༅/chos skyong gi gsol kha myur mgyogs glog gi 'od 'bar/ 153kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes tshogs mchod bshos gtsang sha khrag gis//gsol lo mcho da do bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// hūṃ/ ma gcig dpal ldan e ka dza ṭī ma// nag mo sngags srung mo rgyud kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes zhal zas tshogs mchod mkha' lding gas// gsol lo mchod do dal yams dgra la phob// hūṃ dam can chen po srog gi spu gri ste// dam nyams gshed ma dam can kun 'dus la// dgyes mchod ra yi sha khrag zhal zas mchog/ gsol lo mchod do ltas ngan dgra la phob// hūṃ/ bstan srung khyab 'jug chen po la sogs te// gza' gdong sde brgyad rgyu skar ma lus la// dgyes mnyes tshogs mchod sha khrag rus la sogs// gsol lo mchod do ki ki dgra la phobs :/dgra ngur 'jigs byed dam can srog gcod gtso// keng rus 'bum bskor srin po kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur klad mchin sha khrag tshogs//gsol lo mchod do dam nyams yul mkhar choms// hūṃ/ ce spyang mchu dmar mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso// gnas yul dur khrod sha za ma lus la// dgyes pa'i mchog gyur zhal zas ma lus 'di// gsol lo mchod do ma rungs dgra la bhyo// hūṃ/ shānti nag mo ro zan ded dpon ni// bya rgod mgo can bdud mo kun 'dus ma// dgyes mchod dam nyams gzugs phung sha khrag tshogs//gsol lo mchod do dgra bgegs nyam thag chod// hūṃ/ bshan pa dmar nag dgra bo'i gshed ma ste// sprul pa 'bum 'gyed gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la//dgyes rab mchog gyur tshogs mchod sha khrag snying // gsol lo mchod do bka' 'das rdul du rlog/ hūṃ/ hob se las mkhan chen po srog gi bdag/ khrag la skyems byed srog bdag kun 'dus ma// dgyes mchod rtsi sman sha tshil khrag sna tshogs// gsol lo mchod do dam nyams khong khrag 'thung // ho/ gzhan yang dam can lha srin sde brgyad tshogs// grangs med stong khams khyab rgyug rtsal ldan la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur sha khrag tshogs mchod 'bul// gsol lo mchod

154 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigado rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod// ho yul 'di'i mnga' bdag gnyan po la sogs te// bod khams bstan ma yul lha dge bsnyen la// dgyes rab mchog gyur mnyes rab dam pa'i phud// gsol lo mchod do mi mthun bar chad sol de nas mdangs bskang bshags pa 'don/ zhes brjod 'phrin las 'di ltar gzhol// ho/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la de ltar bskang zhing gsol lo// mchod do// bsngo'o//mgron no// su la mi re khyed rnams la re// su la mi mchod khyed rnams la mchod// su la mi bstod khyed rnams la bstod// dpa' dar du khyed rnams 'phyar ro// phrag pa la khyed rnams khur ro// sdang ba'i dgra la mthu ma chung // gnod pa'i bgegs la rtsal ma zhan// yul du 'khor srungs shig byes su rkyen zlog cig nyin gyi bya ra mdzod cig mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod cig mthu dpung sdong grogs mdzod cigabyad kha phur kha zlog cig 'bod dus snyan ma sra/ g.yab dus spyan ma rtul/ bskul dus bang ma bul/rbad dus mthu ma chung / legs dang sprod la nyes dang bsnol cig sngon gyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sman raka /rag gtor ma'i mchod pa dang / zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod/ dza gad phud kyi mnyes rdzas rgya chen po bzhes la/ bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod cigabacol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig nad pa dang sri'u yod na/ nad pa mal nas slongs/ sri'u tshang nas thon/ ces gang dgos 'dod don gsol lo// gsol ka 'di la rab brtson na// chos skyong mi 'bral grib ltar 'grogs// nad pa'i don kun thog mar 'grub// bstan pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod 'gyur// i thi// //

155༄7// g.yu thog rtsa gsum dang 'brel ba'i tshogs glu rdo rje'i chig gi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ka dag spros bral rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi klong nas// bde chen chos sku'i bla ma sgrib gnyis kyi nad sel// kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon dang dbyer med kyi sman rgyal// sku gsum dgongs pa dbyer med tshogs 'khor la phebs dang // ma dag 'khrul snang zad pa chos nyid kyi klong du// yongs dag ye shes dbyer med khyab gdal gyi dgongs pa// ye dag mnyam nyid ngang du rang grol du rtogs pa// rnam dag chos sku'i mchod pa mkha' khyab tu 'bul na// phra rags bdud sde'i gnod pa ye shes la zad cing // brgyad khri bzhi stong rims nad rang sa la dag nas// nang gsal mkhyen cha ma 'gags kun bzang gi dgongs pa// da lta mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig/ brda' (brda don rtags rdzogs rig 'dzin brda' /brda brgyud kyi klong nas// lhun grub longs sku'i bla mas bag chags kyi nad sel// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med kyi sman rgyal// zung 'jug kha sbyor bdun ldan tshogs 'khor la phebs dang // gdos bcas 'khrul snang zad pa 'od lnga yi klong du// rnam bcas rnam kun mchog ldan lhun grub kyi dgongs pa// sras bcas rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa// ma bcos longs sku'i mchod pa mkha' khyab tu 'bul na// tha mar snang sems bzhi cha sum bral du zad cing // 'od lnga'i rang mdangs rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dag nas// rang bzhin gsal ba sku dang ye shes kyi dgongs pa// da lta mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig/ thugs rje rig rtsal gang zag snyan brgyud kyi klong nas// gang

156 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'adul sprul sku'i bla mas dug gsum gyi nad sel// beeḍūrya snang mgon dang dbyer med kyi sman rgyal// bde dang stong pa dbyer med tshogs 'khor la phebs dang // bden 'dzin 'khrul pa zad pa chos nyid kyi mkha' la// gnyis 'dzin rtog med so sor rang rig gi dgongs pa// ting 'dzin stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi bkod pa// kun 'dzin sprul sku'i mchod pa mkha' khyab tu 'bul na// dug gsum rgyu 'bras bcas pa chos nyid la zad cing // bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs lhag med du dag nas// thugs rjes sna tshogs sprul pa mtha' klas kyi dgongs pa// da lta mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig/brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma rigs lnga yi byin rlabs// thengs gsum rta skad dbyangs snyan phag mo dang mnyam sbyor// rigs lnga mkha' 'gror bcas pa'i bder gshegs kyi rol bas// 'khor 'das gnyis su snang bar ro gcig tu bzhes mdzod// rtsa thig rlung sems dag pa sku gsum gyi rnam smin// sgyu 'phrul tshe la dbang ba'i rdo rje'i srog thob ste// phyag rgya chen po'i rang zhal sgrib med du mjal nas// lhun grub rig 'dzin rtogs pa tshe 'di la stsol cig/ rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba kun bzang gi klong las// thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba sman rgyal dang dbyer med// mtha' klas 'gro ba'i nad sel g.yu thog pa'i 'phrin las// srid pa'i phyi mtha' /mthar rgyas par byin gyis rang rlobs shig/tshul des dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa yi ying med// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi kun 'joms kyi sman mchog/ rnam pa rgyal ba sman bla'i phyag mtshan nyid ji bzhin// sman gyi nus pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mdzod cig/ rtsa gsum gcig tu bsdus pa bla ma yi byin rlabs// bdag dang bdag gar (gi ba la mthong thos dang dran reg/ kun kyang sgrib gnyis rims nad chos nyid du dag nas// g.yu thog bla ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di la thob mdzod//ces g.yu thog rtsa gsum dang 'brel ba'i tshogs glu rdo rje'i tshig gi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di yang

༄7g.yu thog rtsa gsum dang 'brel ba'i tshogs glu rdo rje'i tshig gi rgyud mangs/ 157sku ngo 7bla sman sman rtsis spyi 'doms pra dzñā ma ṇi mchog gis rab dkar lha rdzas dang / rin chen mang sbyor sogs kyi rten gya nom pa bcas gsung gis bskul ngor sman rtsis rig gnas rnam par bkra ba'i lding khang du rje g.yu thog pa'i 'dra sku mthong ba don yod kyi spyan sngar 'jam dpal rol pa'i blo gros kyis rab rgyal na tshod ldan gyi lor sa zla'i dmar phyogs tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang 'brel bar skur blangs pa'o// de ltar mos gus kyis gsol 'debs/ rdo rje'i glu gar sogs byas la nyams bskyang ste gsang ba mchog gi smon lam yang gdab bo/klong chen snying gi thig le las/ las tshogs gang rigs la sbyar chog pa'i tshogs bsdus ni/ ram̐ yo khaṃ/ oṃ āḥlha/ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon ye shes rol pa'i rgyan// tshogs rje tshogs bdag rig 'dzin bla ma dang // gdan gsum dkyil 'khor gnas yul nyer bzhi'i bdag/ dpal bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong rnams// 'dir gshegs longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// 'gal 'khrul nongs dang dam tshig nyams pa bshags// phyi nang bar chad chos kyi dbyings su sgrol//lhag gtor bzhes la 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza ukhyi ṭa ba lī ta kha kha khā hi khā hi// / /

158༄༄/ rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'phags pa kun tu bzang po dang byang chub mchod pa'i lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mang (mangs ni/ mchod rdzas rnams la bsang chu 'thor zhing / oṃ hūṃ tt+waṃ hrīḥ.āḥlha rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin las grub pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod yon gyi sprin phung zad mi shes pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam rol du rgyas par gyur cig na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa sogs lan gsum brjod/ spro na mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs kyang 'don/ de nas dbyangs shin tu snyan pa dang bcas/ padma rgyas pa lta bu'i lang tsho can// reg na bde ba'i mchog ster utpal mig/ gzugs kyi rnam 'gyur ngom pa'i yid 'phrog ma// rdo rje sgeg mo ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra lā lce hūṃ/ pra tītstsha hoḥ srid na rnam par mdzes pa'i zla bas kyang // blta (lta na sdug pa'i gzugs kyi char mi nye// nor bu'i do shal 'dzin pa'i yid 'ong ma//rdo rje phreng ba ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra mā we tsāḥpra tītstsha hoḥ 'jam mnyen puṇḍa ri ku'i lang tsho la// reg 'jam dbang po'i gzhu yi 'khri shing can// skad snyan 'gyur khugs stong gi glu len ma//rdo rje glu ma'i tshogs kyis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra gī rti hrīḥpra twatsulhaḥ bung ba pad ma'i tshal na g.yo ba bzhin// phyag zhabs gser g.yu'i gdu bus mdzes pa'i gar// mig 'phrul lta bur bsgyur

༄༅/rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mangs/ 159pa'i g.yo ldan ma// rdo rje gar ma'i tshogs kyis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra ni rti āḥpra tītstsha hoḥ bcu drug lang chos myos pa'i rnam 'gyur des// snying la dga' ba'i ya mtshan cir (ci yang ster// dri zhim spos phor thogs pa'i smin legs ma// rdo rje bdug spos ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā (ra )badzra dhū pe hūṃ/ pra tītstsha hoḥtshangs dbang 'chi med bu mo'i 'jo sgeg kyang // shin tu mdzes pa'i lang tshos brtan pa 'phrog/ u dum wā ra'i chun 'phyang yid 'phrog ma// rdo rje me tog ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra pukhre 〉ཿpra tītstsha hoḥ yid 'ong blta /lta na sdug pa'i mkhur tshos la// li khri'i thig les bskus pa'i ri dwags mig/ nyi zla'i sgron me thogs pa'i bzhin bzang ma rdo rje snang gsal ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke hrīḥpra tītstsha hoḥ 'chi med bu mo'i dpal 'dzin smin legs gzugs// zhal nas utpal /utpa la yi dri 'thul zhing // bzang drug sman gyi byug pas dgyes pa skong // rdo rje dri chab ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra gharnye āḥpra tītstsha hoḥ lang tsho'i cha shas rdzogs pa'i padma dang // rnam 'gyur cir yang 'char ba'i a darsha// phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu'i gzugs mdzes ma// rdo rje me long ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra rū pa iḥpra tītstsha hoḥ ting 'dzin ri mo mkhan gyis bris pa'i gzugs// bzhin mdzes mju ra ba'i thod bcings can//zlum po'i rnga las bde stong sgra 'byin ma// rdo rje rnga zlum ma yis mnyes gyur cig/gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra mṛ haṃ gi /ge hrīḥpra tītstsha hoḥ ratna'i sor gdub 'khrol ba'i khu tshur gyis// dri za'i bu mor 'gran pa'i tam bu ra//rna ba'i dpyid du bsgrengs pa'i yid 'phrog ma// rdo rje pi wang ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra wi ni hūṃ/ pra tītstsha hoḥ

160 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadaga' ba bcu drug rlung gi rtar bskyon nas// thig le bcu drug gnas su dag pa las// stong nyid bcu drug gling bu'i sgrar ston pa'i// rdo rje gling bu ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra waṃ se (she dzāḥpra tītstsha hoḥ zla gzhon pad dkar lta bu'i lang tsho'i dpal// mig gi bdud rtsir sbyin dang chabs cig par// snyan 'gyur rdza rnga'i sgra sgrog na chung ma// rdo rje rdza rnga ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra mu rañdza āḥpra tītstsha hoḥ stong nyid nam mkha'i rgyan gyur lha yi gos// rin thang brjod du med pa'i pañtsa li// 'phrul ldan sor rtses bsgron (sgron pa'i mdza' na mo//rdo rje reg bya ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra sparnye 〉ཿpra tītstsha hoḥ chags med chags pa chen po'i zur mig gis// dpa' bo'i yid la myos pa'i chom rkun 'jug/ lag na ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin zhal zas thogs// rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs kyis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra rā sa hrīḥpra tītstsha hoḥ bde bas bde ba'i mthar son stong pa nyid// bde chen chos kyi 'byung gnas mngal khur can// bde stong ngang las rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum// chos kyi rdo rje ma yis mnyes gyur cig/ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra badzra dha rma dhā tu āḥpra tītstsha hoḥ de ltar shin tu rmad du byung ba rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug la nang gses kyi dbye na/ phyi sgeg bzhi/ nang sgeg bzhi/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las te gsang ba'i rigs (rig ma lnga/ thun mong 'dod yon gyi lha mo gsum ste de nyid rnam pa bcu drug gi rang bzhin du bsnyad pa las dang po phyi sgeg bzhi'i phyag rgya ni badzralā sgye la rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dkur brten nas g.yon du cung zad 'gyings pa'o/ badzrapā we la rdo rje thal mo gnyis nang nas thur ldog g.yo bas phreng ba 'dogs pa'i tshul lo// badzra gī rti ni glu ma ste/ glu ma'i phyag mtshan pi wang yin pas de nyid bsgreng ba'i tshul 'og nas 'byung ngo // badzra ni rti ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis spyi bor gar byed pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa nang sgeg bzhi'i phyag rgya ni/ badzradhū pe ni thal sbyar tshigs pa bcad pa 'dug (bdug spos kyi khang pa ltar ro// badzrapuspe ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha

༄༅rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mangs/ 161bkan la me tog 'thor ba'i tshul lo/ badzra ā lo ke ni rdo rje khu tshur las mthe bong gnyis mar me ltar bsgreng ba'o/ badzra snyarnye ni g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar gzhan rnams brkyangs pa kha bkan te dung chos ltar byas pa'i snyim pa nas g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis dri'i byugs pa 'gyed pa'i tshul lo/gsum pa gsang ba'i rig ma lnga las/ sku'i rig ma badzra ru pa ni/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo snying gar phyir bstan pa me long ltar bya'o/ gsung gi rig ma badzra mṛ ti gi /rta gi ni rnga zlum brdung ba ltar g.yon pa cung zad gyen la phyogs g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams g.yobs pa'o//thugs kyi rig ma badzra'i ni'i phyag rgya ni pi wang bsgrengs ba ltar g.yon gyen du bsgreng /bsgrengs pa mthe bong gis gung srin mnan te mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung brkyang / g.yas pa'ang de bzhin byas pas bsgrengs pa'o/ yon tan mirig ma badzra wa se /she tre ni gling bu 'bud pa'i phyag rgya snying ga'i mdun na byed pa'o/ 'phrin las kyi rig ma badzra mu rañdza ni lag pa gnyis ka snying ga'i thad nas kha phyir bstan la sor mo rnams g.yob pas rdza rnga brdung pa ltar byed pa'o/ bzhi pa thun mong 'dod yon gyi lha mo gsum las/ bza sparnye ni lag pa so so'i mtheb mdzub gung srin rnams rtse sprad/ mthe'u chung bsgrengs la gos 'bul ba'i tshul lo/ badzrarā sa ni rdo rje thal mo kha sgrubs la brkyang ba slar gyen du ldog pa bshas 'degs pa'i tshul lo/ badzra dharmā ni mkha' dbyings chos 'byung gi phyag rgya ste/mthe bong gnyis rtse sprad/ gzhan rnams brkyangs pa'i srin lag gnyis rtse sprad pa'o// kun la pad kor gyis sngon bsus nas rang sngags dang phyag rgya bstun zhing / rdo rje se gol gtogs pas bsnol te nu ma g.yas g.yon gyi steng du 'jog pa'o/ de ltar rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug gi/ mchod phreng dri za'i bu mos blangs pa'i glu// rgyud mang stong gi 'gyur dang ldan pa 'di//ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mos bdag la byin// dge'o//rab gnas kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i mchod phreng kun tu rgyu/mchog gi me tog 'di dag ni// chu dang thang las de bzhin skyes//

162 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamachog tu dad pas khyed la dbul// ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung // mchog gi bdug pa 'di dag ni// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung // mchog tu gyur pa'i dri 'di ni// mchog gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes// mun pa 'joms phyir snang ba'i mchog/ mar dang til gyi mar me 'di// yang dag ye shes spyan dbye phyir// dad pas bdag gis dbul bar bgyi// bza' dang bca' ba phun sum tshogs// kha dog dri ro rnams dang ldan// thams cad ldan par lha yi bshos// bdag gas dbul gyis so sor bzhes// zhor la rab gnas kyi yan lag bshad pa ni/ de yang sku gzugs dang mchod rten gtsug lag khang la sogs chag grums su gyur pa/gso ba dang / rgyu bzo dman pa rnams bzang du btang ba dang / 'o brgyal sar bzhugs pa rnams gnas phun sum tshogs par spo ba sogs mdor na sngar las legs pa dang de che ru btang ba sogs la arga'i cho ga byar rung zhing byas nas gso ba yang gsungs pas de'i lag len ni/ yi dam gang la brten ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas rdzogs par bya/ rten de'i mdun du mchod pa dang chos skyong gzhi bdag sogs la gtor ma rgyas par phul/ rang gi mdun du me long g.ya' dag pa gcig stegs kyi khar bzhag la rten de'i snang brnyan 'char du bcug la/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rten 'di'i rab gnas spos la sku rgyu ngan pa bzang por bya'o// snyam pa'i bsam pas rdor dril dang bcas/ na mo/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas na//bzhugs pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus 'khor dang bcas// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// khyed rnams mchod phyir rab tu gnas pa spo 'tshal na// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams byin gyis brlabs pa dang //snang brnyan shar ba 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes tshar gsum brjod rjes/rang gi thugs ka nas lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pas rten gyi ye shes pa yi ga (ge gsum gyi rnam paraspyan drangs nas me long nang gi snang brnyan la gnyis su med par bzhugs shing / dzaḥ& baṃ

༄༅jo rje'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod phreng dri za'i rgyud mangs/ 163hoḥ zhes phyag rgyas bcings/ yi ge brgya pa dang supra tiṣṭhas brtan par bya/ yalha sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pas bstod/ shis pa brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas me long dbu zhabs ma log pa byas la dar dmar ser ji ltar rigs pas g.yogs/ rgyab tu rgyas btab/ bkur sti dngabacas mchod gral du bzhugs gsol bya/ rten gsar pa bzhengs grub nas rab gnas dngos gzhi'i tshe me long rten drung du spyan drangs khebs pa sel/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug ran pa na sngar ltar 'od zer spro bsdu dang tshad med bzhi'i sngags rgyas rten gsar pa'i dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du bsre zhing / de rjes spyan 'dren la sogs rab gnas kyi dkyus bzhin byas pas 'grub bo// sku rgyu rnying pa ni gsar pa la ci 'dres dang / rgyu tha dad du gyur pa dag phal pa dang ma 'dres par byas la mchod rten dang satstsha lta bu bzhings nas rab gnas bya'o// sarba maṅga lam̐// //

164༄7// dpal lha dang / che ring mched lnga/ bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs la mchod gtor 'bul tshul bzhugs so//bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir ma gcig dpal lha dang / bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs kyi mchod gtor 'bul tshul ni/ nang mchod dang mchod gtor spyan gzigs rnams phyag len bzhin bkod pas mdzes par bshams/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlab cing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bhyo/ ma lus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i 'phrin las rnams// gang 'dul sprul pa'i gar mdzad spyan ras gzigs// bod rje chos kyi rgyal po'i skur bstan pa// srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod// gdod nas rnam dag nam mkha'i klong yangs nas// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dpal lha mo// bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol// mdun gyi nam mkha' pad dkar zla ba'i steng // yid 'phrog gangs ri'i mdangs 'dzin dpal mo che// g.yas pa'i phyag na khams gsum dbang sdud cing // snang srid gsal ba'i mda' dar me long 'dzin// 'od zer bzhad ldan nor bu'i gzhong pa ni// g.yon pa'i phyag gnas 'dod dgu' /dgu'i dngos grub ster// khyed zhal dgyes pa'i 'dzum chags yid bzhin mtshor// mtshams sprin ngur mo dang 'grogs zla tshes kyi// mche ba'i myu gu ngang mo'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs// rin thang bral ba'i nor bu'i rtse phran dang // sna tshogs 'od chags rin chen do shal sogs// rgyan gyi khyad par du mas rnam par mdzes// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs// rab

164༄7// dpal lha dang / che ring mched lnga/ bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs la mchod gtor 'bul tshul bzhugs so//bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir ma gcig dpal lha dang / bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs kyi mchod gtor 'bul tshul ni/ nang mchod dang mchod gtor spyan gzigs rnams phyag len bzhin bkod pas mdzes par bshams/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlab cing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bhyo/ ma lus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i 'phrin las rnams// gang 'dul sprul pa'i gar mdzad spyan ras gzigs// bod rje chos kyi rgyal po'i skur bstan pa// srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod// gdod nas rnam dag nam mkha'i klong yangs nas// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dpal lha mo// bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol// mdun gyi nam mkha' pad dkar zla ba'i steng // yid 'phrog gangs ri'i mdangs 'dzin dpal mo che// g.yas pa'i phyag na khams gsum dbang sdud cing // snang srid gsal ba'i mda' dar me long 'dzin// 'od zer bzhad ldan nor bu'i gzhong pa ni// g.yon pa'i phyag gnas 'dod dgu' /dgu'i dngos grub ster// khyed zhal dgyes pa'i 'dzum chags yid bzhin mtshor// mtshams sprin ngur mo dang 'grogs zla tshes kyi// mche ba'i myu gu ngang mo'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs// rin thang bral ba'i nor bu'i rtse phran dang // sna tshogs 'od chags rin chen do shal sogs// rgyan gyi khyad par du mas rnam par mdzes// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs// rab

༄༅dpal lha dang / tshe ring mched lnga sogs la mchod gtor 'bul tshul/ 165dkar chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i phang phung la// 'khu ldan lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' dang // yid 'phrog lhab lhub cod pan 'phur lding g.yo// mig sman me dpung 'bar 'dra'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i// 'jigs rung gdong can gnyis sogs grangs med kyi// 'khor tshogs rgyu skar phreng ba'i dbus dag tu// yongs rdzogs ri bong 'dzin pa'i dpal ltar brjid// 'gro 'di'i khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i 'phrin las kyis// sna tshogs sprul pa nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar// grangs med spro bar mdzad pa khyod la bstod//dgyes pa skyed byed mthun pa'i dam rdzas dang // phyi nang gsang ba sku gsung thugs kyi rten// dngos bshams yid sprul ma tshang med pa dang // 'od 'bar nor bu'i tshogs kyis phra bkod pa'i// 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs rin chen snod rnams su// ri rab ltar spungs mchod gtor rgya mtsho'i tshogs// zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// dpal gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//bstan ma bcu gnyis spyir nag mo bzhin mi sdug ces sogs dang / yang na/ tshe ring mched lnga dang bcas par/ oṃ/ 'chi med tshe yi mchog stsol tshe ring ma// snang gsal pra ston mthing gi zhal bzang ma// zas kyi dpal ster mi g.yo blo bzang ma// nor gyi mchog stsol cod pan mgrin bzang ma// rkang bzhi 'phel mdzad gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo khyed lnga yang // sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// 'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes// bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma// dpal ldan lha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong //gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang // 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso// bdud mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang // de man chad sngar bzhin 'gre/

166 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma// mkha' reg khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum// gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang // rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal// gnod spyin chen mo khyed bzhi yang // sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong // btsan la lo ro rdo rje sman gcig ma// sman btsun yug chos rdo rje g.ya' mo bsil// g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma// sman mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang // sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas//chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi// chos ldan 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub mdzad pa'i// chos skyong las byed 'khor dang bcas rnams kyang //sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// zhes sogs gong ltar 'gre'o//sger gsol ni/ bhyo/ sngon tshe khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dang // padma 'byung gnas spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin// dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma// 'khor bcas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// dang po'i rten sa o rgyan gnas mchog ste// bar du rdo rje gdan gyi srung ma mdzad// bal bod mtshams gnas bod khams thams cad du// gtsug lag khang skyong srung ma mthu rtsal can// dus kyi mtha' 'dir khyed kyi brten pa'i gnas// lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gros byin rlabs shing // dam can srung ma sprin bzhin 'du ba yi//bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang // da lta chos 'khor rgyal gyi srung ma ste// gnas 'dir bshad sgrub bstan pa spel ba dang // dge 'dun sde rnams dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir// 'khor bcas thogs pa med par gshegs su gsol// rma/ rang gi mdun du padma zla ba'i steng // 'ja' 'od gur khyim 'khrigs pa'i pho brang du// lha mo he la 'bar ma gangs ri'i mdog/ phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pa bum pa bsnams// rma bya'i sgro thul dar gyi lhab lhub dang // rnam mang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa can// zhi khro chags dang

༄7/dpal lha dang / tshe ring mched lnga sogs la mchod gtor 'bul tshul/ 167sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur ni// sna tshogs ston mdzad gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs// de yi g.yas su rdo rje chos sgron ma// dkar mo 'dzum bcas thod pa'i rde'u chung g.yas// g.yon pa mdzes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur mdzad ma//drel rta la chibs brtan par bzhugs su gsol// g.yon na rdo rje gnas g.yon mig sman mdog/ phyag g.yas lcags kyus dgra bo'i snying 'byin zhing // g.yon pa'i zor bas dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// gtum drag shwa ba la chibs brtan par bzhugs// 'khor du gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang //bod khams skyong mdzad bstan ma 'khor dang bcas// dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas// gnas 'dir bstan pa spel phyir bzhugs su gatheṭa95//bskang gso ni/ rma/ bde stong dbyer med nam mkha'i klong yangs las//byung ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul ba ni// dri zhim spos kyi dud pas nam mkha' gang // ro brgya'i gser skyems btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil// sna tshogs rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yas pas// bka' srung chen mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang // sman sna stong las sbyar ba'i sman phud dang // 'bru sna sna tshogs rin chen sna lnga'i tshogs// phye mar spos dkar sha chen dud sprin dang // dmar chen rakta'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang // rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan drel rta sngon mo dang // sprin dkar lta bur g.yo ba'i rta mchog tshogs// dar gyi cod pan 'phur lding zhol g.yag dang // mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang // 'ja' tshon ltar bkra'i rgyan ldan ra dang lug/ mda' dar me long dung sho dkar pos brgyan// 'dod dgu'i dpal ster brjid pa'i ri rab bcas// rten rdzas dam pa rnams kyis thugs dam bskang // sa chen khyon ltar yangs pa'i thod pa'i nang // bkod mdzes ri rab lta bu'i gtor ma'i tshogs//sngags dang phyag rgyas bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// bka' srung chen mo

168 ༄7ོg.yu thog snying thiga'akhor bcas zhal du 'bul// bla ma dang dpal ldan bstan skyong chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsam i gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtso bo dang / shrī de phris pa ra wī ra i rda sogs lan gsum gyis dpal lha dang / oṃ badzra sa ma ya ḍā ki nī ma ma pañtsa sirnyi dzñā na sam ya i rda sogs lan gsum gyis tshe ring mched lnga/ ma ma sa/ me me/ la la/ le le/ ta ta/ te te/ rdo rje sring 'gro ma hūṃ bhyo i rda sogs lan gsum gyis bstan ma bcu gnyis/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tram̐ abya nutpanda twa ta/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spa ra ṇa i paṃ ga ga na khaṃ ba li ta sogs lan gsum gyis 'khor tshogs spyi bcas par gtor ma 'bul/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ambha nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ guru de wa ḍā ki ni oṃ āḥlha dang / shrī de wī oṃ āḥmai dang / dus bzhi'i lha mo/ tshe ring mched lnga/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ: gis nang mchod kyang 'bul/ spro na sems nyid 'phrin las ma 'don/bstod pa ni/ bhyo/ o rgyan yul du gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso//rdo rje gdan du gtsug lag khang skyong ma// bod khams skyong mdzad bstan ma yongs kyi gtso// dpal ldan rdo rje g.yu sgron khyed la bstod// rlung ltar 'phyo ba'i dre'u sngon po'i steng // rab mdzes sgeg ldem lha mo'i skur ston cing // res 'ga' rab khros srin mo'i gzugs kyis kyang // ma rungs dgra bgegs tshar gcod khyed la bstod// rdo rje chos kyi sgrol ma gangs ri'i mdog/ thod pa'i rnge chung gar stabs phyag rgya can// rdo rje gnas g.yon srin mo khros pa'i gzugs//las byed bka' nyan gtso mo gnyis la bstod// dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong mdzad bstan ma dang //

༄7/dpal lha dang / tshe ring mched lnga sogs la mchod gtor 'bul tshul/ 169dgra bgegs thal bar rlog byed sde brgyad tshogs// dam can 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod// dpal ldan he la 'bar ma drag shul can// ming po klu chen rdo rje 'bar ma dang // bka' nyan gtso mo gnyis dang 'khor tshogs bcas// dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rdo rje 'chang dbang padma thod phreng gi/ spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig rjes dgongs te// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang // bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod mdzod// khyad par rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas dang // dgon gnas dge 'dun sde dang gtsug lag khang // nye bar mkho ba'i nor rdzas longs spyod tshogs// ma lus bsrung zhing rgyas pa'i gnyer mdzod cig/ nad gdon bar chad nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang // tshe dang bsod nams bshad sgrub rgyas pa dang // sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i skye 'gro kun// ma lus dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// dpon slob dgon gnas 'di nyid bcas pa la// gnod pa'i sems 'chang dgra dang bgegs rnams kun// rkyen dang 'tsham par myur du tshar chod la// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// bhyo/bstan pa skyong mdzad dpal ldan yang gha gza'// gsang mtshan dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma ste// rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal// rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen mo khyed la bstod//de nas gsol kha ni/ rin po che'i snod du dbus kyi gtor ma nas ji ltar 'os pa'i phud bcad/mthar bza' bca' btung ba ci 'byor gyis bskor/ rgya por bzang po phud kyis bkang bar mar gyi ze phrog byas pa nas sbran te/ phud kyi mnga' bdag bla ma zhi khro'i lha// dpal gyi lha mo bstan ma bcu gnyis la// ro brgya bda' ba g.yos su sbyar ba'i zas// gser skyems dam tshig spran pas gsol mchod do// dgyes pa chen po bskyed par gyur nas kyang // thugs rje mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis// thub pa'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel// khyad par bdag sogs dpon slob yon

— da 1da ༄// che yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//spros bral chos dbyings zab mo'i kun gsal ngos// sna tshogs gzugs sku'i 'dzum zer grangs med kyis// 'gro sgrol thabs mkhas rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor mchog/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// de yang 'di ga'i bstan srung spyi sgos kyi gtor 'bul bya bar 'dod pas mchod pa bca' lugs dang srung ma mnyes rdzas rnams mthong brgyud ltar 'dzom par byas nas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rang nyid yi dam 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal dang bcas pas mchod pa byin brlabs te/ bskang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/oṃ hrīḥṣṭiḥwi kṛ twa na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa zhesapa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las bskang rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'ig bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung 'ing rgyas par gyur cig i sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ badzra spar ṇa khaṃ/ badzra arbhe nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ su bhā wa bi shurnye dharmate badzra sirnyi hūṃ/ naḥm /na maḥ na sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba tad khaṃ uṅga te spar ṇa i paṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tram̐ ābya nutpanda twa ta/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru sku ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sirnyi lo tsā ni sarba arba sāddha ni swāhā/bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang // de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs

172 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigadang // chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs par// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig/de nas mgron rnams so sor mchod pa las mgon dkar ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na mgon po bar gcod kun sel gyi thugs ka nas mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ hūṃ/chos kyi dbyings las zhi ba'i skur bzhengs pa// gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog mgon po thugs rje'i gter// yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// dngos grub 'dod dgu stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// gu ru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra e sgye hiḥdzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ gu ru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra a: nas/ shāsta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ guru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ&/ oṃ gu ru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra i rda bā lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūṃ/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse gcig 'dus rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// de yi rnam sprul phyag drug mgon po la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro// zhal gcig phyag drug zhabs gnyis nor bdag mnan//dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yas kyi dang pos yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// bar bas gri gug dbul ba cod nas gcod// tha ma cang te'u drag tu 'khrol ba yis// mkha' 'gro dbang sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yon pas rin chen thod bum dku la brten// bar bas rtse gsum mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud// tha mas lcags kyus ngan song gnas nas 'dren//mgon po thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo// sku stod rin chen rgyan gyis

172 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigadang // chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs par// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig/de nas mgron rnams so sor mchod pa las mgon dkar ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na mgon po bar gcod kun sel gyi thugs ka nas mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ hūṃ/chos kyi dbyings las zhi ba'i skur bzhengs pa// gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog mgon po thugs rje'i gter// yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// dngos grub 'dod dgu stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// gu ru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra e sgye hiḥdzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ gu ru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra a: nas/ shāsta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ guru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ&/ oṃ gu ru mahā kā la sā pa ri wā ra i rda bā lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūṃ/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse gcig 'dus rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// de yi rnam sprul phyag drug mgon po la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro// zhal gcig phyag drug zhabs gnyis nor bdag mnan//dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yas kyi dang pos yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// bar bas gri gug dbul ba cod nas gcod// tha ma cang te'u drag tu 'khrol ba yis// mkha' 'gro dbang sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yon pas rin chen thod bum dku la brten// bar bas rtse gsum mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud// tha mas lcags kyus ngan song gnas nas 'dren//mgon po thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo// sku stod rin chen rgyan gyis

༄༅/tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs/ 173rnam par brgyan// sku smad rin chen bzar (zar bus rnam par mdzes//phyag zhabs thams cad yid bzhin nor bus spras// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni yid la dran pa tsam gyis ni// de yi mod la dbul phongs sdug bsngal kun// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu sel mdzad pa// yid bzhin nor bu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod la gus bstod mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar du ni// mgon po khyod kyi thugs rjes legs bzung nas// byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yid bzhin sgrubs//'di yi dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan pa dang // thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol ba la// yid bzhin nor bu lta bur bdag gyur cig/chos rgyal ni/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ku'i hūṃ nag po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug gi nang nas dam can chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ dzaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog/ chos gyi rgyal po yab yum ya ba ti// pho nya mo la sogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas// 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na// gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam gling lho yi phyogs// mthar byed lcags kyi thod mkhar 'bar ba nas// lho sprin nag po rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin// brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ kā la rū pa sā pa ri wā ra a kursha ya dzaḥpadma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ oṃ kā la rū pa sā pa ri wā ra yalhanas/ shādha'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ mchod do// kā la rū pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/bhyo tsa mun ṭi'i zhal du oṃ aḥlha/ ya ba ti la sogs pa gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ aḥlha/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig

174 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigapa dmar po'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kā la rū pa sā pa ri wā ra sarba bighān sha hūṃ mā ra ya i rda bā lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ bhyoḥtsa muṇḍi sā pa ri wā ra sarba bighān sha hūṃ mā ra ya i rda bā lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ ya ba ti la sogs pa gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa sarba bighān sha hūṃ mā ra ya i rda bā lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ kā la rū pa swa pa ri wā ra arbhe nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ mchod do//kā la rū pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ4/ bhyo tsa muṇḍi'i zhal du oṃ aḥlha/ ya ba ta la sogs pa gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ aḥ&/ 'jam dpal bka' nyan bstan srung ni// dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs su rung // mgon po khyod la bdag bstod do//lhamo ni/ bhyoḥrab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las la// dmag zor rgyal mo zhes byar mtshan gsol ba// rtse gcig mos pa'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na// thogs pa med par myur du gshegs su gsol// mdun gyi nam mkha' rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dbus// be con thod khrag 'dzin pa srin mo'i gzugs//dre'u'i steng bzhugs gdug pa tshar gcod sku// ji srid dran pa de srid rtag tu bzhugs// phyi yi spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon gang zhing // nang gi dam rdzas sa gzhi ma lus khyab// yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin zhing khams kun// rgyas par bkang ste 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// sha khrag la sogs bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar// 'bru sna lnga dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'di// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul lo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// sku gsum lhun grub thugs rje mthar phyin kyang // srid gsum gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen mo la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma dang //

༄༅/tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs/ 175 chagasol ba 'debs pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// thub bstan srung ma gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso// dbyer med zhabs kyi padmo bka' drin che//sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam dkar byin rlabs dang // tshul bzhin sgrub la brtson pa'i bsam pa yis// thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal du yun ring zhing // gnas 'dir 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod// dpal ldan thub pa'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can// khyod nyid bsten cing sgrub dang rtse gcig tu//gsol ba 'debs pa'i rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi// 'gal rkyen kun se'/ mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs// rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan pa 'a dzin pa la//log par 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kun// ji ltar bsams pa myur du tshar gcod pa'i// drag po'i 'phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod// mdor na bcom ldan ma khyod phyag bya'i skur// skyabs su song nas re ba 'cha' ba yi/tshul 'di dgongs la 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing // mthun rkyen ma lus yid ba'in 'grub par mdzod// lhag bsam dag pas tshul 'dir brtson pa na//tshangs dang dbang po 'jig rten skyong ba dang // dmag zor rgyal mo la sogs srung mas kyang // g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// chos ba'in sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bar chad bsrung zhing skyong ba zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shes shog/ bslab pa gsum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi// 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gnas 'dir yongs gang zhing // rtag tu bshad sgrub bya bas srid mtha'i bar// thub bstan phyogs su (bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/zhang blon ni/ chos dbyings bde chen ngang las ma g.yos kyang // zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched// zhang blon chen po 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na// thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur spyon// gnod sbyin chen po mthing nag phyag gnyis kyis// nor bu bum pa rab 'dzin dar nag gi/

༄༅/tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs/ 175 chagasol ba 'debs pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// thub bstan srung ma gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso// dbyer med zhabs kyi padmo bka' drin che//sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam dkar byin rlabs dang // tshul bzhin sgrub la brtson pa'i bsam pa yis// thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal du yun ring zhing // gnas 'dir 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod// dpal ldan thub pa'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can// khyod nyid bsten cing sgrub dang rtse gcig tu//gsol ba 'debs pa'i rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi// 'gal rkyen kun se'/ mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs// rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan pa 'a dzin pa la//log par 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kun// ji ltar bsams pa myur du tshar gcod pa'i// drag po'i 'phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod// mdor na bcom ldan ma khyod phyag bya'i skur// skyabs su song nas re ba 'cha' ba yi/tshul 'di dgongs la 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing // mthun rkyen ma lus yid ba'in 'grub par mdzod// lhag bsam dag pas tshul 'dir brtson pa na//tshangs dang dbang po 'jig rten skyong ba dang // dmag zor rgyal mo la sogs srung mas kyang // g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// chos ba'in sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bar chad bsrung zhing skyong ba zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shes shog/ bslab pa gsum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi// 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gnas 'dir yongs gang zhing // rtag tu bshad sgrub bya bas srid mtha'i bar// thub bstan phyogs su (bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/zhang blon ni/ chos dbyings bde chen ngang las ma g.yos kyang // zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched// zhang blon chen po 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na// thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur spyon// gnod sbyin chen po mthing nag phyag gnyis kyis// nor bu bum pa rab 'dzin dar nag gi/

176 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'ajol ber gsol zhing rin chen rgyan gyis spras// gsang yum blon po phyi 'khor bcas pa rnams// mdun du yid 'od skyed mos tshal gyi dbus// 'jam mnyen padma rgyas pa'i lte ba la// mtshams sprin mdangs ldan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng // dgyes pa chen pos brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sman gyis sbags pa'i dri chab mtsho ltar 'khrug/ sna tshogs mdangs ldan me tog rnam par bkra// dri zhim spos kyis nam mkha'i khyon kun 'geng // mar me'i 'od kyis mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog/ ro brgya'i zas kyis bdud rtsi'i dpal kun ster//snyan pa'i sgra yis rna bar rtag tu 'jebs// dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma sogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs kun 'bul// zhang blon chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar po'i 'od kyi sbru gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ratna tsitta rā ga rā gi (ge sā pa ri wā ra i rda bā li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rma a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā ṭwāṃ abya nutpanda twa ta na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ ugi te spa ra ṇa i paṃ bā lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badzra ratna tsitta rā ga rā ge su pa ri wā ra arbhe nas shāsta'ibar gyis mchod/ oṃ badzra ratna tsitta rā ga rā ge sā pa ra wā ra hūṃ phaṭaḥ i āḥ& ind+ra nī la'i ri bo nyin byed kyis// lan brgyar byugs pa lta bu'i gzi brjid can//dpal ldan gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul che// 'khor dang bcas la gus pas bdag bstod do// thub bstan spyi dang khyad par gso rig gi/ gzhung lugs yar ngo'i zla ltar rab 'phel zhing // bdag sogs 'dod pa'i don rnams ma lus pa// 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// cung zad nyes par bgyis pa'i tshogs rnams kun// chos dbyings bde ba'i ngang du bzod par gsol// lhun grub pho brang chen por phyir gshegs nas// slar yang 'gro ba'i don du 'byon par mdzod// dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu

༄7/tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs/ 177ltar// 'dod pa'i re ba ma lus ches skong ba'i// bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas kyis// dus rnams kun tu bkra shis dga' ston stsol// zas gtsang blo bzang rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi// lung rigs dpal chen 'dzin pa'i khyon yangs 'dir// rta ljang nyin byed ngag gi dbang po'i dpal// bskal brgyar mi 'gyur khri la brtan par bzhugs// 'dzam gling tshe lo dpag med brgyad khri'i dbang // gling bzhi dbang phyug rgyal srid bdun gyi gar// mi dbang bstan pa'i bdag po mngon mtho ba// sku tshe chab srid dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// gso rig rgyud sde kun gyi mchog dam pa// dpal ldan rgyud bzhi zhes pas srid gsum du// snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga gsang cher sgrog pa//gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu thog pa'i// rjes 'dzin 'chad nyan byed pa slob ma'i tshogs// gzhan phan gso ba rig pa'i chos rgyun 'di// srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas pa dang // 'gro la mngon sum phan pas gso ba'i phyir//sman dpyad bstan pa yar gyi zla ba ltar// bsam don rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// rab 'byams rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang ba kun// 'chang zhing bka' yi sdud po rdo rje 'dzin// khro bo'i dbang bo khang bu brtsegs pa sogs// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin bye ba'i ded dpon skur// bzhengs nas mchog mthun dngos grub char 'bebs pa// zhang blon chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs// dam can chos srung rnams kyi bkra shes shog/sku lnga ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse ni// grub pa'i dbang bo'i gar gyis rnam rol ba// srid gsum bla ma padma 'byung gnas kyis// dngos grub kun stsol bgegs kun gzhom par mdzod// lhun grub gdod ma'i gshes las ma g.yos kyang // bstan pa bsrung phyir sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar// cir yang 'char ba sprul pa'i chos rgyal che// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir da
