178 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigatshur spyon// sna tshogs rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang // mu tig tshogs 'bar rin chen ba gam can// ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i pho brang du//padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// dus gsum rgyal dbang padma thod phreng gis// dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas kyang // bstan pa bsrung dang dam ldan 'phrin las kun// bsgrub par bka' bsgos dam bcas dran par mdzod// dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma ri ltar spungs// zag med bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil// phyi nang spyan gzigs sa dang bar snang kun//rgyas par bkang ste 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// hūṃ/ 'jig rten mchod bstod dkyil 'khor gru 'dzin pa// dregs pa'i ded dpon sum cu'i nang tshan nas// dpe (pe har rgyal po sku lnga gsang yum dang // blon po 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho da tshur spyon// khyad par dgra lha skyes gcig gsung gi rgyal// blon po rdo rje grags ldan mthu rtsal can// sku lnga'i rnam rol gcig tu ma nges par// ston mdzad sprul pa'i chos rgyal gnas 'dir gshegs// khrag gi sgo nga bdun las nyer brdol ba'i// btsan rgod dmag dpon 'bar ba spun bdun dang //khyad par tsi'u dmar po yang le ber// pho nya mngag gzhug 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon// dmar chen gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyeg/ khrag chang btung ba rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul byed na// rol cig kha ram̐ khā nyis zhal du dbul// padma thod 'phreng so zur gnubs nyang sogs// sngags 'chang rnams kyis khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur dam tshig gnyan po nyer phab nas// thub bstan skyong ba'i srung mar ma bskos sam// ma g.yel ma g.yel sngon gyi tha tshig dgongs// gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig rgya ma bral// rdo rje'i ri mo spyi bo'i gtsug ma yal// lce la bdud rtsi ro mchog ma nyams pas// bshad sgrub bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas//bstan 'dzin skyes bu bla mchod sde gnyis spel// gangs ljongs yul 'dir

༄7/tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs/ 179'thad rtsod rmu ge nad// dus kyi 'khrug pa ma lus zhi bar mdzod// dga' ba'i dpal ldan sde bzhi'i pho brang che'i// chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i mnga' thang dang // chab srid brtan cing dbu rmog btsan pa sogs// zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs// rgyal po sku lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ mahā rā dza sā pa ri wā ra i rda bā lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogasakhu hi/ mahā rā dza sā pa ri wā ra arbhe nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ mahā rā dza sā pa ri wā ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ&/ zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang // bstan pa bsrung phyir khro chags zhi dang sgeg/ nyams brgya'i rol pas gar mdzes rnam 'gyur can// rgyal po sku lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do// khyod zhal nam mkhar mche ba'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs// ljags kyi glog 'phreng srid gsum za ba bzhin// ha ha'i gad brgyangs /rgyangs rgyu hūṃ 'brug sgra can// khams gsum dbang sdud khyod la bdag bstod do// rang bzhin lhun grub gdod nas spros dang bral// ma bcos rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos// kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin cir yang 'char// gnas lugs don gzigs khyod la bdag bstod do// rnam mang yon tan tshogs la mnga' brnyes shing // khyod la mchod bstod bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa las// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i yon tan kun// phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do// zhi rgyas dbang drag rab 'byams 'phrin las kun// dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bka' bsgos bzhin// thogs pa med par sgrub mdzad dam tshig can// chos skyong chen po khyod la bdag bstod do// thang lha ni/ hūṃ/ ye shes gzhal yas bskyed kyi rgya ma chung // seṅge glang chen khri bshams dpangs mi dma'// nyi zla padma'i gdan steng bkrag ma zhan// ye

180 〉〉/g.yu thog snying thigashes lha mchog bsnyen cing rgyang ma ring // 'jig rten srung ma bsgrub kyi mthu ma chung // 'dir gshegs nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ: sku lha'i yab smos pa// 'o de gung rgyal lags// sku lha'i yum smos pa// g.yu bya gshog gcig lags// sku lha nyid smos pa// yar zhur gnyan gyi lha// bzhugs yul mtshan gsol ba// 'dam shod snar mo lags// khri rgod g.yu ljang 'khril// dbyar sngo dgun yang sngo// bzhugs yul nyams re dga'//dgyes so lha yi yul// mi chos mtshan gsol ba// thang lha yar zhur lags//lha chos mtshan gsol ba// dri za'i rgyal po ni// zur phud lnga pa lags//gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba// rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal// sku la ci gsol na//dar dkar ras dkar gsol// chibs su ci chibs na// lha rta ngang dkar chibs// khams gsum kun tu rgyu// mdog dkar 'od zer 'bar// g.yas na sba lcag 'phyar// ma bdun las la 'gyed// g.yon pa shel 'phreng 'dren//thugs dam dbyings su zlo// sprul pa ci 'gyed na// rta dmag 'bum sde 'gyed//bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas// 'dir spyon 'phrin las mdzod// dam can kun gyi lha// dam med kun gyi gshed// mna' zan kun gyi bdud// rnal 'byor kun gyi dpal// sgrub mchog bdag gi grogs// 'phrin las skal phog pa// smyo ba'i 'dre 'dul zhing // sdang ba'i dgra srog gcod// mgyogs su rta rtod /rgod kyi// mig thogs zor ma lci// rno ru mtshon rdor (rdo yi// rtse mo dbal ma zhan// ci dang do bsdo na// do thag chad ta re// mgyogs dang dkyus mnyam na// dkyus thog shor ra re// sdang dgras khyer ra re// byams kyis skyong ta re// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// dam tshig rjes su dran par gyis//las la bab bo bgegs kyi rgyal// bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha khyed// chos skyong rgyal po lha yi sras// khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha yin// u rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis// dam la btags

༄7/tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs/ 183badzra sa dhu sā pa ri wā ra i dam ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rma a kā ro mu sogasakhu hi/ rma badzra sargya sā pa ri wā ra ambha nas shāsta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badzra saju sa pa ri wā ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥlha/ dam can mgar ba'i mtshan can nag po khyod//zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra dmar ser 'khyil// g.yas kyi phyag na khro chu'i tho ba thogs// g.yon gyi phyag na mgar ba'i sbud pa bsnams// ra la chibs shing sku la ber nag gsol// spyan rtsa dmar zhing ljags ni glog ltar 'khyug/dam nyams dgra bo khyur mid byed mdzad pa// zhal nas rkan sgra dras po brdebs pa yis// log par lta ba'i bgegs rnams 'dar du 'jug/ srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad kun// zil gyis gnon cing dbang du sdud mdzad pa// dam can mgar ba nag po khyod la bstod// dam can khyod kyi thugs dang ci 'gal ba// ma rig dbang gis nyes pa byung ba rnams// rab tu 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// nyes pa thams cad bzod par bzhes su gsol// bdag gis bstod cing bshags pa'i bsod nams kyis// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus zhi ba dang // bsam pa 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// sde dgu dang brtan ma 'dir 'don/ dge bsnyen chen mo ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dha rmā su bhā wa shurnyonya haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka yi// sa bon hrīḥlas 'od 'phros me long la// gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin du mdun gyi mkhar// padma zla ba glang po'i gdan gyi steng// phu yig nag po yongs su gyur pa las// klu yi dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po khyod// sku mdog nag la 'od zer 'bar ba can// zhal gcig sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan// phyag gnyis thugs kur thal mo sbyar ba yis//yid bzhin nor bu rab 'dzin mdzes brjid ldan// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa'o// de yi thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng // phu yig nag

184 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigapo'i mtha' las g.yas bskor du// oṃ nā ga rā dza badzra rā dza zhes bskor ba de las 'od 'phros/ mkhar nag dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po khyod// chu bo rgya mtsho la sogs gar gnas kyang // 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par mdzod//oṃ nā ga rā dza badzre rā dza sa mā dza/ klu yi yul nas nā ra seng sngon dang // dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po che// klu btsan mi srun 'bangs blon bcas// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag/sku la rin chen du mas spras// stobs ldan glang po'i khri'i steng du// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ badzra arbhe nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/dzaḥmai baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā swabhā wa shurnyonya haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zad mi shes pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ nā ga rā dza badzra rā dza sā pa ri wā ra i rda bā lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ klu btsan rnams kyi ded dpon che// klu rje mtho rgyal chen po'i sras// klu mtsho 'phel ba'i nang shed na//klu rgyal chen po khyod la bstod// sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs//phyag na nor bu rin chen bsnams// stobs ldan glang bo'i khri steng na//'jigs byed chen po khyod la bstod// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa yi//mthu dang byin rlabs nus pa dang // bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa yis//mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa// dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa yis// dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas//rab tu dgyes zhing tshim gyur cig/ oṃ nā ga rā dza badzra rā dza sa mā dzaḥ klu bdud rdo rje rgyal po che// khros pa'i tshul gyis g.yas rdo rje// g.yon pa nad kyi rkyal ba thogs// zhal nas me lce 'dren par byed// bdud sde nag po 'jigs cing khro// gnod byed thams cad rdul du rlogs// oṃ klu yi dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje rgyal// de yi yum ni na ra seng sngon dang // klu btsan mi srun 'bangs

brgyad dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis gnas 'dir sbyan drangs/ kyaiḥ phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi naḥ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na:btsan yul zangs thang dmar po naḥ padma dbang gi bka' nyan paḥ che

192 ༄zagayu thog snying thigabatsan rol pa skya bdun niḥ phal cher sku mdog dmar po la: phyag na ba dan zhags pa bsnams: sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ tshur byon tshur byon gnas 'dir spyonaḥ shu la triḥbadzra sa mā dzaḥ bhyoḥ btsan mkhar dmar po'i nang shed na: sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyabaḥ yid 'ong spyan gzigs kun nas mdzesaḥ dam tshig gtsang ma'i gdan la bzhugasaḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhanaḥ kyi: skyes bu rol pa skya bdun ni:'phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyabaḥ padma dbang gi bka' nyan paḥ dam tshig gnyer gtad khyed la bstodabyi gtsang ma'i khrus dang gser skyems 'bulaḥ bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la: thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mdzodaḥ arbhe bi shurnye swāhāḥ gtsang ma'i bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs:me tog snang gsal dri chab dang : zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bulaḥthugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mdzodaḥ dhū tpaḥ pu : ā lo keḥ gadhe:nee wi ryaḥ shapta pū dza hoḥ bskang ba gso bar 'dod na/ kyai: skyes bu srog gi bdag po ni: 'jigs byed rol pa sde bdun tshogasaḥ khyed la dgyes pa'i longs spyod ni: sha khrag dmar gtor ri ltar spungs: zag med bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil: rakta'i yon chab rdzing ltar gtams: spyan gzigs longs spyod skar ltar bkramaḥ nga gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogaḥ klu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ dam can mched bdun thugs dam bskangaḥ btsan rgod 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang: sde brgyad bsdongs zla'i thugs dam bskang: dkor srung dam can thugs dam bskangaḥ las bzhi pho nya'i thugs dam bskangaḥ zhes lan gsum mam bdun sogs ci nus gsog/ bhyoḥbase mkhar dmar po ldems se ldemaḥ dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ru ཿ ba dan dmar po yengs se yeng : dregs pa'i mda' 'phen sgrengs se sgreng:las byed bshan pa ro lo loḥ shugs pa'i 'bod sgra di ri riḥ che btsan rgyal

༄zajo yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs/ 193po'i thugs dam bskang ཿ slob dpon padma'i spyan snga duḥ thugs dam zhal bzhes der dgongs laḥ khri srong lde'u btsan rje rigs dang ཿ rnal 'byor dam ldan brgyud par bcas: dam tshig gcig tu skyong ba dang : sku la bsngo ba'i rigs rgyud chod: log lta'i sde dpung cham la phobaḥ sngags 'chang rdo rje'i dam ma bralaḥ bcol lo gnyer ro mthu rtsal skyedaḥ yal yol 'drid bkol ma mdzad par: ngo bsrung zas phyir ma 'brang mdzodaḥ thugs dang 'gal ba skong gyur laḥ bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du skyongasaḥ bstod bskul ni/kyai/ rang bzhin rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas// gnod sbyin dmar po gtum brjid khro bo che// sku mdog dmar po khrag ltar ya la la// khrag 'thung mche ba dmar po gtsigs se gtsig/ gnod sbyin gdug pa kun gyi sde dpon che// drag shul mthu ldan stong dpon mdzad pa'i tshe// g.yas pas ba dan dgra bo'i snying la gzir// g.yon pa'i zhags pas dgra bo'i ske nas bcings//dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la rngams par mdzod// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la// byur dang ltas ngan thams cad dgra la bsgyur// rnal 'byor chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol// yul phyogs tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang // rtag tu 'gal rkyen sel la mthun rkyen sgrubs// rnal 'byor dpon slob bsam don 'grub pa dang // bcol pa'i 'phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod// / /

194 ༄7// lha mo'i bstod pa sems nyid 'phrin las ma/bhyo:sems nyid 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i khyad par ni// sems nyid gud na med cing sems kyang med// don dam dbyer med kha dog gzugs kyang med// rdzu 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems// mthun par bstan pa zhi ba'i dpal lha mo// zhi mdzad zhi 'gyur zhi ba'i ngang tshul can// zhi ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog dkar mo shin tu dwangs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod//sems nyid 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i khyad par ni// sems nyid gud na med cing sems kyang med// don dam dbyer med kha dog gzugs kyang med// rdzu 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems// mthun par bstan pa rgyas pa'i dpal lha mo// rgyas mdzad rgyas 'gyur rgyas pa'i ngang tshul can// rgyas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog ser mo shin tu brjid// kun tu rgyas mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod// sems nyid 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i khyad par ni// sems nyid gud na med cing sems kyang med// don dam dbyer med kha dog gzugs kyang med// rdzu 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems// mthun par bstan pa dbang gi dpal lha mo// dbang mdzad dbang bsgyur dbang gi ngang tshul can// dbang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog dmar mo shin tu chags// kun tu dbang mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum sems can thams cad dbang du sdus(bsdus / / sems nyid 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i

༄༅/lha mo'i bstod pa sems nyid 'phrin las ma/ 195khyad par ni// sems nyid gud na med cing sems kyang med// don dam dbyer med kha dog gzugs kyang med// rdzu 'phrul sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems//mthun par bstan pa drag po'i dpal lha mo// drag mdzad drag 'gyur drag po'i ngang tshul can// drag po'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog nag mo shin tu rngams(rngam / / kun tu drag mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo//bdag gi nad gdon dgra bgegs drag pos sgrol// khyed kyi rang bzhin cir yang ma grub kyang // 'di ltar mtshan nyid cir yang snang ba yis// 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad pa la// bdag gas bsgrims te rab tu bstod bgyid na// bdag kyang las bzhi'i rang bzhin lhun grub ste// khyed ltar 'gro ba'i don la brtson par shog/ / /

196༄// gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so//phyag na mthu stobs 'bar ba rdo rje'i mtshon// gdengs pas yid srubs dpung las rnam rgyal te// gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin khro bo'i dbang po dang //dbyer med drin can bla ma gtsug na bsten// bde stong zung 'jug chos dbyings rdo rje'i thugs// nam yang g.yo ba med kyang bdud sde'i dpung //'dul phyir gnod sbyin chen po'i skur bstan pa// zab gter srung ma'i dbang pos rtag tu skyongs// mgon khyed dgyes pa skyed byed mchod pa'i sprin// mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya// sngon rabs dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas// rnam par 'byed pa'i lde mig 'di na 'o// de'ang gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi dam tshig gso zhing thugs dam skong ba'i ched du las byang gi rim pa nyams su bstar ba la brgyud ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i zhabs pad nye bar bsten nas gsang ba'i bdag po khang bu brtsegs pa'i rjes gnang dang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi rab phyi nang gsang gsum/tha ma'ang phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi rigs 'gre kho na lhur blangs pa ma yin pa'i lugs srol 'di ga'i rgyun nyamasapa med pa nos/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos gnas khang byi dor byas/dkon chog spyi bye brag gi rten dgram/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i gtor ma lha bshos zlum po rgyan can da nga /thugs dam bskang ba'i gtor ma nor bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa gru gsum che ba gcig la 'khor gyi dpal bshos bzhis bskor ba'am yang na so sor bshams/ kha zas kyi bye brag bzang dgu mtshar tshad dang /rin po che/ shing tog 'bru sna/ dar sna tshogs/ gzhan yang me tog lnga (la sogs phyi/ bdud rtsi lnga (la sogs nang / gzugs la sogs pa gsang ba'i mchod pa/ gsang 'phyi dang dam tshig gi rgya phor sogs mthun rdzas/ g.yag nag khyi nag sogs bskang ba'i rten/ ru mtshon/ ba dan/ go cha sogs dang / gos rgyan nor rdzas kyi khyad par spyan gzigs ci 'byor pa bkod pas mdzes par bshams/

༄༅/gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 197gzhi bdag gi gtor ma'ang spyi dang mthun no/ thog mar mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/yibadzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing khams phun sum tshogs par zlo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i nyer spyod 'dod yon sogs phyi nang gsal ba'i spyan gzigs mkho dgu tshang ba bzang dgu 'byor ba mdzes dgus brgyan pa rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ngo bo ye shes kyi sgyu ma'i rang bzhin rnam pa bde bar 'char ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadzra pukhye hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra ā lo ke hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra garnye hūṃ/ rma āḥbadzra nee wirya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra shapta hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing rol mo 'budadakrol byed/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya (dang )bcas te/ namaḥsarba ta thā ga te /ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud ga te spa ra ṇa hi mi ga gan khaṃ su hā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ badzra spa ra na khaṃ zhes pas mang por spel/ sman raka ltarag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ ram̐ yo khaṃ 'phros pas/ sman phud kyi ma dag pa rnams bsregs gtor bkrus te yi las rlung / ram̐ las me/ ki las thod pa'i sgrod bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud lnga sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba/ rlung gas me sbar te zhu ba las phyag mtshan bcu so so'i lte bar rigs lnga yab yum lnga'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das kyi bcud kun bsdus te thim pa las rigs lnga yab yum lngar gyur pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems babs pa'i steng du lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ i āḥlha sarba pañtsa amṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha(bān/ ram̐ yi khaṃ gyis rakta'i snod bcud kyi ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/ padma 'bar ba'i snod chen por ram̐ las rakta'i rgya mtsho gzegs ma la

198 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thiga'adod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa (la )lha/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yibadzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ yos rsāwas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ram̐ las rlung me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kai las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyis bteg tubategs pa'i steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pas gang ba/ de'i steng du nyi zla kha sbyor rdo rje dang bcas pa la oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas rlung g.yos me sbar nas rdzas rnams khol ba'i nang du zla nyi rdo rje dang bcas zhu bas ma dag pa'i skyon rnams sbyangs te ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥlha/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab po/ bdag skyed ni/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag/ sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bgyi//zhes skyabs sems lan gsum sngon du btang nas/ swa bhāwas stong par sbyangs/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od gsal gyi rang gdangs/ rdo rje'i khams las grub pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje khang bu brtsegs pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku lus sbom zhing thung ba gsus khyim che ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dar sngon po'i na bza' dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul dang rin po ches spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gas bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/zhal gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i

༄7/gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 199spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon rkyang ba'i stabs kyis bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kur hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom /sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' la khro bo dang rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra yalha pra tī tstsha su hā/ de bzhin du/ pā ju/ pukhre/ rnyupe/ā lo ke garnye/ niwibya/ shapta pra titstsha su hās mchod/ dzaḥ: be hoḥ sa gnyis med du bstim/ slar yang thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra salha (arbhekanas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sgu (sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan (brgyan par bsam/rang gi thugs kur nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ oṃ na mo nī lambha ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ratsa pa ya ti su hā/ zhes ci nas su bzla/ de nas bzlas gtor 'bul ba ni/rang gi thugs ku'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gsang ba'i bdag po la bla ma rigs (rig 'dzin dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥsaspyan drangs/ rma na mo nī lambha radha ra badzra pā ṇi radzñā pa ya ti yalha paju/ pukhre/ dhupe/ ā lo ke garnye/ ni wibya/ shapta pra tītstsha swā hāsamachod/ oṃ (na mo )'i lambha ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi rarnye pa ya ti swā hā i rda bha li ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor 'bul dang / oṃ nā mo ni

200 kho'iogayu thog snying thigalambha radha ra badzra pā ṇi rarnye pa ya ti swa hā oṃ āḥ: gis nang mchod kyang 'bul lo/brtse ldan thugs rje che las ma g.yos kyang// gtum rngams rab 'bar mi bzad gzi byin gyis// nag po'i rtsa lag sde bcas 'joms mdzad pa// dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag por phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ mdun bskyed ni/ zlo tsakra maṇḍa la/ zhes brjod pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' phun sum tshogs pa'i gter dang nor bu 'bru sna tshogs kyis gtams pa'i sa gzhi/ me tog sna tshogs pas mdzes shing dpag bsam gyi ljon pas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su lha las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / sgo khang / rta babs/ khor yug sogs lta na sdug cing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ba dan rgyal mtshan sogs rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ba'i lte bar bee ḍūrya sngon po'i rang bzhin gyi brag ri'i khri gdan gyi steng du srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la rang gi thugs ka nas kṣa chad de babs pa las 'od 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa mchod/ 'gro ba rnams kyi dbul phongs sogs sdug bsngal rnams sbyangs/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs thams cad bsdus te kṣa la thim/ de zhu ba las oṃ badzra ratna tsitta rā ga rā ge hūṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i mthus gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag sbom la thung zhing gsus khyim che ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / rab tu khros pa'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas pus steng du mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa lte ba'i thugs kur 'dzin pa/dbu la rin po che'i phrog zhu 'od du 'bar zhing / sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber sum brtsegs su gsol ba'i 'og ma la gser rked rin po che'i phra tshom can bcings par dril bu g.yer ga'i /kha'i sgra 'khrol ba rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ sag lham rin po che'i 'bur can gsol ba'i zhabs gnyis rgyal

༄༅gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 201po rol pa'i tshul gyis gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du yum gnod sbyin dbang mo don kun sgrub /grub ma mthing kha /ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas nad rgyal dang g.yon zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i rin po che'i gzhong pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ shar gyi rtsibs su pad nyi'i gdan la dri za pho mo'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i rdza yongs su gyur pa las nor lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dar dkar gyi ber gsol ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas rin po che 'bar ba dang / g.yon gser gyi sgrom bu 'dzin pa/zhabs brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ lho'i rtsibs su pad nyi'i gdan la gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las mgon po nag po shin tu khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bdud kyi ber nag mtha' ljang can gsol ba/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi bing (beng las 'dod dgu'i char 'babs shing /g.yon 'chi med bdud rtsis gang pa'i par bu bsnams pa/ 'bas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nub kyi rtsibs su pad nyi'i gdan la klu gdon pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i kṣa yongs su gyur pa las 'brog gnas mched lnga sku mdog dmar po dbu lnga'i dbus ma seng ge g.yas gnyis rta dang lug g.yon gnyis ra dang spre'u'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rin po che'i sgrom bu thugs kur 'dzin pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis gser gyi 'khor lo dang 'bras kyi gzhong pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis sman dang shing tog sna tshogs bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'bas gnyis brkyang bskum gyis tshul du bzhugs pa/ byang gi rtsibs su pad nyi'i gdan la gnod sbyin pho mo'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i bee yongs

202 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasu gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thung zhing brjid pa gsum khugasus khyim che ba/ sku la gser khyab gsol ba/ phyag g.yas gser gyi sba lcag dang g.yon pa gser gzhong rin po ches bkang ba 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i phrog zhu dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/rta mchog ngang pa sga srab can la bcibs pa/ gtso 'khor de rnams kyi 'khor du gnod sbyin bye ba'i dmag tshogs dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu dam tshig can sogs gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul gyi grangs las 'das pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/bdag mdun gnyis kya'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dag pa rab 'byams gyi zhing nas bla ma yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang / lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ rol mo'i sgra dang snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do// hūṃ/ bde stong zung 'jug chos dbyings pho brang nas// padma thod 'phreng rtsal sogs dngos brgyud kyi// rigs 'dzin bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// gnas 'dir gshegs la byin chen dbab tu gsol// byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// gnod sbyin chen po btsun mo 'khor tshogs bcas// mar me mdzad kyi spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa// ji bzhin bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// dbyangs kyi nga ro snyan brjid rol mo 'khrol// 'bod pa'i dar g.yab sbyar ba'i spos dud 'thul// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan 'dren no// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir da tshur spyon// oṃ badzra tsitta sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥzhes gtso bo 'bod pa dang /oṃ ratna tsitta yakṣa hūṃ/ zhes 'khor 'gugs pa'i sngags brjod/ e hya hi mahā yakṣa ratna tsittajo:྅ baṃ hoḥs mā ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ hūṃ/ rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i// yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i 'phreng // cod pan gnod sbyin chen po'i dbur// legs par bcings te

༄༅/gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 203dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra ratna tsitta mā le hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas zil gnon lha'i brtul zhugs brtan pos nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya (dang )bcas pa/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ dam bsgrags dang g.yar dam lhan cig tu bskul ba ni/ lko badzra ratna tsitta pā sha hūṃ/ badzra dṛ ka swāhā/ hūṃ/ dam can rdo rje bdud 'dul 'khor bcas rnams// dang por mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan zhing // bar du rdo rje 'chang gas dbang yang bskur// de rjes phyag rdor klu sgrub padma 'byung // lo chen bee ro mnga' bdag khri srong rje// gter ston grwa ba mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar// nye gnas grwa bran bsod nams rin chen dpal// smon lam 'bar dang gung chung ston pa'i zhabs// rdo rje rgyal mtshan badzra pā ṇi dang // rgya ston byang sems nyang chen byang chub sems// brag dkar sman bla jo sras kun gzhon pa// mgar ston tshul gzhon bla chen chos dpal bzang // dpal sbas grags rgyan paṇa chen padma dbang // mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje zhabs// o rgyan rgyal po kun dga' bkra shes dang // rdo rje 'chang dngos mgon po bsod nams mchog/ rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang sar grol//gdams pa'i bka' babs 'phrin las lhun gyis grub// bee ro'i sprul sku gter bdag gling pa sogs// rjes gnang lung dang bang (dbang mdzod ma lus kun// 'bad med stsol mdzad rigs rnams kun gyi gtso// dngos brgyud bla ma rdo rje 'dzin gyi bka'// da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis dam bsgrags bzhin//lung dang rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bstan pa dang // tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin dge 'dun tshogs// rten gnas gtsug lag khang dang dgon sde skyongs//'jig rten khams kyi snod bcud legs tshogs spel// 'phung (phung byed nag phyogs bdud sde thal bar rlog/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs dpung tshogs choms// tshe dang longs spyod dpal 'byor lung rtogs rnams// rab 'phel bsam pa'i don

204 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigakun lhun gyis sgrubs// thugs dam bskul kyang dgongs par mi 'gyur zhing //las rnams g.yel na rgyal ba'i bka' bcag cing // rigs /rigaka'adzin dam bral srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// nyams 'gyur gdon mi za na 'jigs ta re// oṃ badzra ha na ha na sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing / rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyis bdud rtsi 'bul/ rma badzra.a la la hoḥ zhes dam bsres te 'phrin las thams cad sgrub par bsam mo// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ yid 'phrog nor bu'i gzhal med nyams dga' bar// brag ri pad nyi'i gdan la 'dul byed steng // gnod sbyin 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs nas kyang // dgyes pa'i zhal ston dngos grub ma lus stsol// oṃ mahā yakṣa ratna tsitta sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ phyag bya ba ni/ hūṃ/nyin byed gos kyis klubs pa'i dbang sngon ni// gar dgu'i nyams kyis zlos gar sgyur mdzad pa// dran pas mchog thun dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal// badzra dunti swāhā/ a ti pu ho/pra tītstsha ho/ phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ me tog chun po bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs// mar me'i 'phreng mdzes dri chab chal chil g.yo// ro brgya'i zhal zas snyan brjid sgra snyan sgrog/ la du la phug zho dang 'o ma mar// ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi shing tog tshogs// 'bras chan 'khur ba tshod ma bza' bca'i ris//rjen bcos /btsos sha dang gsur dud rus pa khrag/ dbang po lnga dang nang khrol zhag rkang tshil// ja dkar /kar rgun 'brum chang sogs btung ba'i mtsho// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i sprin// rdo rje bdud 'dul 'khor bcas spyan snga ru// 'bul gyis dgyes par rol la dngos grub stsol// oṃ mahā yakṣa se nā pa ti badzra mā ra da ma ka sa pa ri wā re (ra bhyaḥ puṣṭha/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gadhe/ nee wi te(23/ shapta pū dza sa yo /mā ya dzaḥ.a mṛ ta rakta ba li ga na tsakañtsa/pañtsa / pa ra shu kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swāhā/ bdud rtsi sman phud ni/hūṃ/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong las sbyar ba yi// dam rdzas myong grol sman gyi

206 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigardzas kyis bskang ba ni/ hūṃ/ dri bzang ngad ldan mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil// thang skyes chu skyes me rtog mngon par bkra// sna tshogs ljon shing sman sna'i dud sprin 'khrigs// mar dang 'bru me'i snang gsal ches cher sbar// ga bur gur kum gyis sbags dri chab 'khyil// ro brgya'i zas sna cher spungs lha bshos dang //sil snyan dung chen sna tshogs rol mo'i sgras// gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig/ bdud rtsi sman dang khrag gi ambha bskyil// phye gtsang chang mar spod sbran (bran bza' bcar bcas// gsang 'phyi rin chen 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang // rgya phor ma da nas bkang mar ze'i phrog/yid 'phrog phyag rgyar mnyam sbyor bde ba che// dbang po'i me tog sha chen gsur dud 'tshub// zhun chen snang gsal thod rnga rkang gling sgras// gnod sbyin 'khor gyi thugs dam skong gyur cig/ bye brag ga bur sbrang sbyar zhun mar gyis// rdo rje bdud 'dul yab yum thugs dam bskang // ka ra mtshal chen sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis// nor lha smugs 'dzin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang // sha khrag dmar dang sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis// srog bdag mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //'bras dang bu ram sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis// 'brog gnas mched lnga 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang // sman dang spos su sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis//rnam mang thos sras 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang // thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong gyur nas// bdag sogs bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod// rten rdzas kyi bskang ba ni/ nor bu 'bru sna gter gyis rab gtams shing //padma utpal la sogs me tog bkra// yongs 'du'i ljon pas legs bskor 'dzin ma'i dbus// rin chen bdun gyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang //bkod pas khyad 'phags dbyibs legs lta na sdug/ ba dan lce gsum dril 'khrol rgyal mtshan sgreng // 'chi med grong khyer la 'gran khang bzang gis//gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig/ g.yab dar lhab lhub

༄/gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 207nor bu'i yu ba can// gser dngul mu tig byu ru mchong dmar las// legs grub mi 'dzad gter gyi bum pa dang // bris 'bur sku 'bag bla rdo srog 'khor bcas// rten gtor yid 'phrog gnas kyi khyad par can// gri snying g.yang gzhi mtshon gyis phule pa'i bam// le brgan dar dang me long bya rgod mdas//gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig/ 'brong g.yag nag po rdo rje'i rwa chen gdengs// sogs (sog par dar rgyan lag (lugananag spyi bo dkar// mche sder khrag gis sbags pa'i khyi nag zug/ sga srab rgyan mdzes rta nag rlung ltar g.yo// gnam lcags mchu sder bya nag 'phur zhing lding // rlung ras dpyangs pa'i bya rog rgyal mtshan dang // gser mig skyung ka nal bu'i rgyal mtshan gyis// gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur cig/spyan gzigs kyis bskang ba ni/ rin chen sna bzhi las grub ri rab la // sra brtan lcags ri gcig gis bskor ba'i nang // gling gzhi gling phran gser ri rol mtsho bcas// rin chen ri bo yongs 'du sa brtol shing // yid la gang bsams 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba// rtsol med lhun grub ma rmos lo tog gas//gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur cig/ za 'og gos kyi bla bre mkha' la bres// sna tshogs dar gyi lda ldi'i cod pan g.yo// srog skyob sra brtan rdo rje'i khyab rmog dang // zhol btags lcags gzhibs rnga rgyan 'ja' ltar bkra/dpag chen mda' mdung dgra sta gri mtshon rigs// dar zab 'jol ber sna tshogs rin chen rgyan// gnyis 'thung dbang po ma he ba lang khyus// gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur cig/ gdugs dkar gser nya bum bzang dpal be'u// padma dung dkar g.yas 'khyil rgyal mtshan gdugs//gser 'khor nor bu blon po bud med mchog/ rta glang khyim bdag rgyal srid rin chen bdun// me long ghi haṃ zho dang rtswa durlu// bil wa g.yas 'khyil li khri yungs kur rdzas// lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi 'byor tshogs kyis// gnod sbyin

208 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thiga'akhor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur cig/ 'khrul ngor shar ba'i dgra bgegs 'joms pa dang // 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol phyir gnod sbyin cher// bstan (bsnyen kyang gdod nas dag pa'i rang sems dang // bla ma yi dam chos skyong dbyer med du// ro gcig rang ngo shes pa'i rnal 'byor sogs//phyi nang gsang dang de nyid mchod tshogs kyis// rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dang // gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur cig/ tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul 'phrin las char 'bebs dang / sman srung dam can sde dgudapal lha/ bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs sger gsol rigs 'don par spro na mtshams 'dir 'jugabashags pa ni/ hūṃ/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// rdo rje bdud 'dul 'khor bcas spyan snga ru// bdag cag nongs pa bsgrag cing bshags byed na//spros med brtse chen dbyings nas gson /gsan cing dgongs// snang stong dbyer med tha mal dbang du shor// grag /grags stong rang sgrar tha snyad dbang gis zhen// rig stong bden 'dzin 'ching bas bcings la sogs// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags// ka dag dbyings las lhun grub 'od gsal ba// bde stong zung 'jug rang la gdod ma nas// yod par ma shes gzhan nas 'tshol ba'i blos// sku gsum ring por spong ba'i 'khrul nyes bshags// lha khyed mchog thun dngos grub gter chen por// ma shes 'jig rten rang rgyud par bzung zhing // don chung tsam du las sbyor bkol ba sogs//yon tan 'phrin las dam tshig nyams pa bshags// smin grol gsang sngags lam du nyer zhugs nas// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig ras /ris su bor// khyad par mgon khyed bsnyen sgrub bskang ba dang // mchod gtor chag sogs nongs pa ma lus bshags// mdor na bshag /bshags bya bshags byed bshags pa'i yul// kun kyang rang gi sems nyid gcig pu'i rtsal// blo 'das byar med bshags pa'i mchog nyid kyis// sgrib bral tshangs pa'i dngos grub deng

༄༅/gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 209'dirastsol// bstod pa ni/ gter gzhung dngos las/ hūṃ/ mgon po rdo rje bdud 'dul ni: thugs rje'i thabs kyis gdug pa 'dulaḥ gzhon nu dpa' bo khros pa'i sku: khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: mgon po g.yul las rnam rgyal te: mgon po rin chen brtsegs par bzhugs: phyag na rin chen thod khrag bsnamasaḥ mgon po khyed la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ mgon po rgyal po dbu mtha' yas: spyan gsum pa la mche ba gtsigs: : dang phaṭa sgra 'jigs drag posaḥ ma rungs 'dul khyed la phyag 'tshalaḥ phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams: sbrul dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyanaḥ dar nag ral ka sku la gsolaḥ rdo rje bdud 'dul sku la bstod: 'khor ni gnod sbyin stong sdes bskor: mdog nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'baraḥrngams pa'i stabs kyis bgegs 'dul baḥ bgegs 'dud khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs 'dzin khro bo'i sku las 'phagasaḥ mthu rtsal mi nyams yangs pa las: srid pa gsum gyis mthar phyin mdzadabyi bdud 'dul 'jigs byed khyed la bstod: :/ dbus kyi gru gsum mthing nag na// rdo rje nor bu'i dngos grub can// gnod sbyin phru gu gdug pa can// klu yi tsha bo zhe gnag can// bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig can// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can// 'jigs pa'i skur ston khyed la bstod// sde dpon chen po khyed la bstod// rin chen gter bdag khyed la bstod// bstan pa bsrung mdzad khyed la bstod// ces dang / gzhan yang / hūṃ/ mi 'gyur bde chen chos kyi dbyings nyid las// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa//gnod sbyin sde dpon chos srung kun gyi gtso// dpal ldan rdo rje bdud 'dul khyed la bstod// srin po'i gzugs can mig sman lta bu'i mdog/ rin chen rgyan dang dar nag 'jol ber mdzes// yid bzhin nor dang bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs la bstod// ha ha hūṃ phaṭa

210 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigarngams pa'i nga ro'i sgras// nag po'i rtsa lag sde bcas klad pa 'gems//dngos grub ster zhes gsung gi gdangs snyan pos// sgrub pa po rnams dbugs dbyung mdzad la bstod// rgya mtsho lta bur gting mtha' dpag dka' ba'i//zab gsal thugs kyis dus gsum kun gzigs nas// gang la gang 'dul zhi rgyas dbang drag dang // mchog thun 'phrin las sgrub par mdzad la bstod//res 'ga' rab khros brkyang bskum tshul gyis 'gying // rtse gsum thod khrag thogs nas dgra dpung 'joms// gnod sbyin rnon po 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas// nang gi mgon po'i rnam par rol la bstod// mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug gtum zhing rngams// rtse gsum dbyug pa gri thod zhags pa dang // lcags kyu 'dzin zhing bdud kyi rgyal po'i tshul// gsang ba'i mgon po'i rnam par ston la bstod// gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i sgyu drwa /dra yis//zag bral bde ba chen po skyed pa'i yum// nad rkyal rin chen zhags pa 'dzin mdzad ma// don kun sgrub (grub pa'i gnod sbyin dbang mor bstod//gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras// phyag gnyis nor bu rin chen sgrom bu nas// 'dod dgu'i longs spyod char bzhin 'bebs mdzad pa// nor bdag dzam la dkar po khyed la bstod// mun pa bye bas byugs pa'i lhun po'i sku// gshin rje ltar khros bing (beng chen par bu can// zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa// lha chen legs ldan mgon po khyed la bstod// mdog dmar dbu lnga phyag drug rin chen sgrom// gser sgrom sman sna 'bras sder shing tog bsnams// log par blta rnams dbang du sdud mdzad pa//gnod sbyin 'brog gnas mched lnga khyed la bstod// mar gad mdangs 'dzin nyi ma'i gzi byin can// cang shes la bcibs gser khrab rin chen rgyan// sba lcag gzhong thogs tshe dpal 'byor pa kun// rgyas mdzad rnam mang thos sras khyed la bstod// pho brang 'khor sa'i khyon kun dbyar dus kyi// chu 'dzin lang

༄༅gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 211long lta bur rab g.yo ba// gnod sbyin gdug pa'i dmag gi sde dpung sogs//grangs med dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod// bzlas pa byed par spro na/ mdun bskyedarnams kyi thugs gar nyi ma'i gdan la rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs/ de la rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer phog pas dbang du 'dus te bka' nyan gyi tshul du gnas pa la/ rang gang 'dod pa'i las bskul ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ rma na mo nī lam bha ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi radzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes phyag rdor gyi rtsa sngags dang /oṃ badzra ratna tsitta rā ga rā ge hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ gtso bo dang / oṃ badzra ratna badhe bdud ma ting skyol ting dzāḥdzāḥ /dzaḥdzaḥ yum dang / oṃ badzra mahā kro dha ārya dzam bha la hro da ya swāhā/ nor lha dang / oṃ badzra mahā kā la ha na ha na badzra na swāhā/ mgon po dang / e mahā yakṣa pañtsa de wa rā dza sāhā/ 'brog gnas dang / oṃ mahā rā dza bai shra ba ṇa ye swāhā/ rnam sras bcas so so'i srog sngags te gtso bo la stong dang 'khor la brgya sogs mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa skabs dang sbyar zhing / yig brgya lan nyer gcig sogs kyang bzla'o// yang tshogs 'bul na/ tshogs las byang shog bcu hūṃ hrīḥrang nyid lha/ sogs nas shog bcu gnyis tshogs lhag bar 'don/ gsol ka 'jug gsol ba'i 'phrin las sbyar ba ni/ gsang 'phyi rin chen 'bar ba'i gzugs can nas kyi phye chang mar rnams spod kyis sbran (bran pa sbyar ba las brdzis shing / kha zasakyi bye brag sna tshogs dang bcas pa dar sna lngas brgyan pa lnga/ dam tshig gi rgya por /phor chang bzang po sman phab (phabs btab pas bkang zhing / mar gyi ze srog gis brgyan pa lnga/ zhun mar dang bu ram sbyar ba la sogs pa'i gtso 'khor lnga'i thun rdzas so so rnams/ sngar bkang (bskang rdzas su bshams pa/ skabs 'dir rang gi mdun du bkod/ rin po che'i snod du gsang 'phyi dang / thun rdzas so so nas ji ltar rigs pa bcad de bsre dam tshig gi rgya phor phud kyis sbran la 'di ltar bsngo'o// oṃ/phud kyi mnga' bdag mchog gsum dam pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dam can srung ma rnams la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba bskang ba'i thun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do// dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig/ mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan

212 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigapa dar zhing / 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud sde zil gyis mnan nas dbang du 'du zhing / dam can las la 'khor te 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub par mdzad du gsol// zhes phud gtor ru mtshon ba dan sogs 'phyar/ rol mo sna tshogs bya'o// de bzhin du sbyar te/ kṣa/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i gtso bo zab mo gter gyi srung ma gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul la gsang 'phye rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ zhun mar dang mngar gsum sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gas sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do//dgyes pa chen po bskyed par gyur cig mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dgon gnas sam/ sman rtsis rig gnas 'dus pa'i gling 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang 'gro kun bde zhing / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud dang log 'dren zil gyis mnan nas dbang du 'du zhing / dam can las la 'khol te yid la brnag pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/phud gtor sogs gong ltar bya zhing 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ kṣi/ yum gnod sbyin dbang mo don kun sgrub (grubakam la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ bskang ba'i rim pa mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa 'dis gsol lo mchod do// dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cigathugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas shing nye bar 'tshe ba rnams gzhom pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la nad rims zhi ba dang zas nor gyis 'byor zhing dpal dang g.yang bskyed pa/ cho rigs kyi srid spel bar mdzad du gsol/ rdza/ shar phyogs nor lha dkar po gnod sbyin rdza bha la 'khor bcas la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba ka ra mtshal dang sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser

212 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigapa dar zhing / 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud sde zil gyis mnan nas dbang du 'du zhing / dam can las la 'khor te 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub par mdzad du gsol// zhes phud gtor ru mtshon ba dan sogs 'phyar/ rol mo sna tshogs bya'o// de bzhin du sbyar te/ kṣa/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i gtso bo zab mo gter gyi srung ma gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul la gsang 'phye rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ zhun mar dang mngar gsum sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gas sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do//dgyes pa chen po bskyed par gyur cig mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dgon gnas sam/ sman rtsis rig gnas 'dus pa'i gling 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang 'gro kun bde zhing / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud dang log 'dren zil gyis mnan nas dbang du 'du zhing / dam can las la 'khol te yid la brnag pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/phud gtor sogs gong ltar bya zhing 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ kṣi/ yum gnod sbyin dbang mo don kun sgrub (grubakam la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ bskang ba'i rim pa mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa 'dis gsol lo mchod do// dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cigathugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas shing nye bar 'tshe ba rnams gzhom pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la nad rims zhi ba dang zas nor gyis 'byor zhing dpal dang g.yang bskyed pa/ cho rigs kyi srid spel bar mdzad du gsol/ rdza/ shar phyogs nor lha dkar po gnod sbyin rdza bha la 'khor bcas la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba ka ra mtshal dang sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser

༄/gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 213skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do//dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig thugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel zhing / 'gro rnams 'byor ba rgyas pa dang khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams longs spyod kyi gter la mnga' 'byor te bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ hūṃ/ lho phyogs mgon po nag po legs ldan chen po 'khor bcas la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ sha khrag dmar dang sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do// dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig thugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rnams tshar gcod pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la/ ngan sdig can gyis mthu byad g.yul 'khrug sogs bsam ngan sbyor tsub rnams zlog cing tshar gcod pa dang bar gcod thams cad las srung skyob kyi 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ kṣa/ 'brog gnas chen po mched lnga 'khor bcas la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba bu ram 'bras dang sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do// dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cigathugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha mu stegs byed sogs log lta can rnams bstan pa la gzud pa dang / skye dgu rnams phan tshun byams pa dang ldan zhing /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la ma dad pa dang sdang bar sems pa rnams 'bangs dang gdul byar gyur zhing /phun sum tshogs pa la dbang 'byor ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bee/rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos pa'i sras 'khor dang bcas pa la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ sman dang spos kyis sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/

214 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagaser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do// dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig thugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha sa spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas shing bstan 'gro kun la rgud pa mi 'byung ba dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la rdo rje lta bu'i srog dang nyi zla lta bu'i tshe dang bkrag mdangs zad mi shes pa stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ 'khor gyi gtso bo dmag dpon/ blon po/ ru 'dren/ pho nya/ lha klu dam tshig can/ mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ bstan ma bcu gnyis yul lha gzhi bdag tu gtogs so cog rigs dang rgyud kyi srung ma 'khor bcas la mthun rdzas dang sbyar ba'i gser skyems dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do// dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur ciga'aphrin las kyi gnyer kha zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang bcol ba sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ gong gi mchod rdzas sogs rgyas pa ma 'byor na gsang 'phyi gser skyems tsam/ram̐ yi khaṃ gis bsregs gtor sbyangs/ oṃ āḥlha gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te phul bas kyang 'grub bo// skabs 'dir sman srung dam can sde dgu dang / dpal lha sogs kyi gser skyems 'bul bar 'dod na byin gyis brlab pa spyi ltar byas te 'bul/ khyad par 'phrin las gnyer gtad ni/ hūṃ/gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang // de 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe brtan// 'dus pa'i sde rnams chos spyod 'phel bar mdzod// stobs kyi dpung bas yangs pa'i nor 'dzin la//dbang sgyur sa la spyod pa'i tshangs pa che'i// sku tshe mnga' thang mtshan byus chab srid rnams// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// khyad par sman rtsis 'dus pa'i sde 'di 'phel// 'gro phan bdud rtsir spyod pa'i 'phrin las rgyas// chos srid dpal yon legs tshogs ci 'dod kun// thogs med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// 'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir// mi phyugs nad rims dus kyi 'khrug pa dang // 'thab rtsod mu ge ma

༄༅gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 215lus rab zhi zhing // phan bde'i dga' ston mchog la spyod par mdzod// rgyal ba'i bka' rnams 'bri zhing klog pa dang // mchod dang sri zhur byed la gegs med cing // de don sgrub pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po yi// bsams (bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod// bshes gnyen chen po grwa pa mngon shes kyi// gtsug lag khang dang sde rnams 'phel zhing rgyas// chos nor gter gyi bum pa bzang po yis// 'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i dngos grub stsol// gtang rag gi mchod pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang rin po che zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/oṃ āḥbadzra pukhye hūṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ rma na mo nī lambha ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi radzñā pa ya ti yalha nas shapta'i bar dang / oṃ mahā yakṣa se nā pa ti badzra mā ra da ma ka sa pa ri wā ra pukhye nas/ shapta pū dza sa yo (ma dzaḥ.a mṛ ta rakta ba lo ga na tsakra:/ par shu kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swāhā/ bar gyis mchod/ yin mo nī lambha ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi radzñā pa ya ti oṃ āḥ:/dang / oṃ mahā yakṣa se nā pa ti badzra mā ra da ma ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥmai/ gis nang mchod kyang 'bul/ brtse ldan thugs rje che las sogs nas/ gsang ba'i bdag por phyag 'tshal lo// bar dang /byang phyogs gnod sbyin bye ba'i sogs nas/ dam can chos srung rnams la phyag 'tshalabastod// ces sogs kyis bstod/ gzhan yang tshe yi rig byed gling gi bstan srung spyi'i gtor 'bul sogs sger bskang rigs sngon du song na 'dir yang mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya pa nyer gcig 'don pa sogs kyis nyams chags (chag bskang / ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang //gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang // cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang // bdag gis brjed ngas ci mchis pa// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// ces sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang // nad med tshe dang dbang

216 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaphyug dang // mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// zhes pas rten la brtan bzhugs/ rten med pa'i 'khor rnams la gatstsha su bhā wa/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis mar gyur 'gro ba rnams// bla med byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i ched// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen po// tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang por rnam rol ba//slob dpon chen po padma thod 'phreng sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog/ rab 'byams rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang ba kun// 'chang zhing bka' yi sdud po rdo rje 'dzin// khro bo'i dbang po khang bu brtsegs pa sogs// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shes shog/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin bye ba'i sde dpon skur// bzhengs nas mchog thun dngos grub char 'bebs pa// zhang blon chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs// dam can chos srung rnams kyi bkra shis shog/gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad ci rigs pa bya'o//smras pa/ deng dus gangs can ljongs 'dir mkhas rlom 'ga'// snga 'gyur chos kyi rang skad nyer bor nas// gsar ma'i chog sgrigs kho na lhur len pa// de dag skom 'dod smig rgyur bsnyeg pa bzhin// la la snga phyir 'gyur ba'i mgon po kun// gcig bsdus sgrub chen bka' brgyad yi ge las//rgyas bkab rang bzos gzhan mgo nyer bskor ba// dbang lung chos kyi rgyun bral nam mkha'i 'ja'//ham can gdol gtam smra la dam pa zhes// mkhas blun dbye ba med pa'i dus ngan 'dir// gang dran yi ger bris kyang dpyad pa dang // rtsod cing rgol ba'i byed po nyin skar bzhin// 'on kyang las 'bras rnam gzhag phra zhing zab// kun la gces pa thub bstan yin pa'i phyir// brgyud ldan dam pa'i sgros dang man ngag bzhin// rang bzos bslad pa med pa deng 'dir spel// dge 'dis nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar// gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyis// shākya'i bstan pa legs par bsrung byas te// bde skyid dpal gyis 'jig rten khyab par shog/ces gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di ni grwa bsam dar ba mda' dpon blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas/ mgon po 'di nyid kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba mi dbar khyis ma chod pa'i brgyud

༄gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / 217pa ma nyams pa las 'ongs pa zur 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i drung du legs par nos pa dang slar sprul sku gter bdag gling pa'i drung du rjes gnang lung man ngag thos shing / gsang chen rnying ma'i chos tshul 'di la ring du sbyangs pa'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos bstan pa spyi la tshad thub tu gyur pa'i mkhas pa chen po bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i las byang las btus shing rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung sgros kyis rnam par brgyan te khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug nag pa zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so//shrī shrī/ spar gyi chos sbyin mi 'dzad gter gyi sgo// chos ldan rgyal po'i 'phrin las dpal du phye// 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i phung po ni// zla shel nor bu'i khang bzang ltar dkar bas// dga' ba brgya ldan chab srid mnga' thang 'phel// kla klo'i dpung zhi rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas// bstan 'dzin spyi dang gtsug nor 7zhabs brtan cing // 'gro kun rdzogs ldan snang bas khyab gyur cig/ces gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul bsnyen cing bsgrubs te 'phrin las bskul ba dang /thugasadam dgyes pa skong ba'i las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing 'di bzhin 'di ga'i slob grwa ser skya tshogs yongs su sngar nas 'don chog bgyid mus kyang las byang dpe cha gsung nang ma'i gras nas lhu 'donabyed dgos kyis dpe rgyun yang 'byor dka' bas da lam 'gro phan rig byed gling gi phyag len ltar sger gsol 'jug 'os mtshams so sor mchan bu dang bcas rtsa gzhung la dri mas ma gos par rab rgyal sa glang khrums stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes la sman rtsis khang du spar gzhi gsar bskrun bgyis pa'i smon tshig tu sman rtsis mkhan pra dzñā ma ṇis so// dge'o// //

223༄khya//g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi bzhugs so//dang po/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ye shes me long //na mo gu ru dme wa ḍā kki (1 gi ni sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsnyen sgrub kha skong sogs kyi skabs snga dro'i dus su sgrub khang gi shar du zhi ba'i thab zlum po la bya rjes btsal ba'i dbus pad 'dab bzhi'i dkyil du rdo rje/ de'i phyir mu khyud rim pa gsum las phyi ma gnyis rdo rwa 'od phreng dkar shasache ba'i rdul tshon gyis mdzes par bya/ srog chags med pa'i bud shing dri zhim pa zlum kor du brtsegs shing / gzhan yang 'o ma can gyi yam shing mngar gsum gyis sbags pa dang / rtsi mar gsar pa'i mar khu til dkar sogs mthong brgyud ltar tshogs par byed de/byas te1/ thab kyi g.yas phyogs su gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du rdzas rnams rim par bshams la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs nyer spyod lnga dang / sman raka (rag gtor gsum tshogs mchod rnams 'du bya/ bsangs chu ḍā dril me g.yab dpal 'bar rnams kyang mdun du bkod de/ sgrub pa pos chas gos dkar por byas te kha shar du phyogs la/ rdor dril gyi don dran pas 'khyud rgya byas te/ amṛ tas dgang blugs bsangs sbyangs/bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros ye shes lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin ye shes sems dpa' 'od zer gyi rnam par bkug dgang blugs la thim pas dngos grub thams cad 'byung pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas su gyur/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs/ sreg rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi bran te rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya'am/ dgang blugs kyis reg cing / rang

224 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigagi thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'bru gsum 'phros/ rdzas rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas su gyur/ shinti ku ru ye swāhāḥ zhes rdzas so sor regabasangs chu'ang 'thor (gtor la/ oṃ kro dha shwa ri sarba dra bye shwa dha ya oṃ āḥ&/ de nas thab kyi shar lhor tsub shing ngam/ dgon pa las byung ba'i me du ba med pas spar /sbar la/ rtsa sngags bzlas/ rlung g.yab g.yob cing / 〉 〉 rtu/ zhes brjod/ de nas thab kyi phyogs bzhir ku sha sngo ljang dri med kyi chun po bzhi dang / dbus su rgya gram bcas bkod la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sarba big rna /bisnani nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa//sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying // bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni//zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swāhā/ thab la bsangs chu 'thor (gtor zhing /hūṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang // hūṃ las ye shes zhi ba'i thab/kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum po// mu ran kha khyer bcas pa'i dbus// sna tshogs padma'i lte ba ru// rdo rje rtse lnga kha khyer la// rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i grwar// zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'o// sgrib g.yogs bral zhing 'od zer 'phro//rgya dpangs tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs// de nang me dkyil gru gsum dang //a las zla dkyil steng du ram̐// dkar po dbyug to ram̐ gyis mtshan// de las me lha drang srong dmar// bram ze'i cha lugs ra skyes bcibs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang phreng dang // spyi blugs 'dzin pa khro 'dzum bsgom// 'od 'phros shar lho mtshams nas ni// me lha spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// lag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i rgya dang mthe bong g.yab cing / hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur spyon tshur spyon me lha che// sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ asne sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ gzi brjid me yi gzhal yas su// yid 'ong

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 225padma'i lte ba la// drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas// 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol// asne ye sa ma ye st+waṃ/ zhes dang / phyag 'tshal sku khrus gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ shar lho'i phyogs rnams skyong mdzad cing // rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung // mthu ldan bsreg bya za ba'i bdag/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ agha ye na mo hūṃ/ atna'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang // bdag gzhan sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyangs slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// mi gtsang skyon gyi dri ma dag gyur cig/ces bum chu sbrengs la/ oṃ badzra ma hā asne ye dme wa pra na sa ta ka ra pra ti sgye swāhā/ phyi nang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri// ro mchog sil snyan sman raka /rag gtor// gzugs sgra dri ro phyi nang gsang // mchod 'bul 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes// asne arbhe sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / asne ya mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ asne ye mahā rakta khā hi/ asne ye mahā ba lidha khā hi/ zhes pas sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba nang mchod/ asne ye bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥsogs kyis 'bul ba gsang mchod/ de nas mar khu sogs sreg rdzas rim pa bzhin du dbul la/ de yangayi shing 'od kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'bru sna phyag dang / gos zung sku/ mar khu dang dkar gsum sogs zhal du 'bul/ dgang blugs tshad ldan thogs nas rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad brjod/hūṃ/ gzi brjid me lha 'khor dang bcas rnams la// zhi ba'i 'phrin las thogs med bsgrub pa'i phyir// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i 'dod yon ma tshang med//sreg blugs mchod 'bul bzhes nas dngos grub stsol// oṃ asne ye ram̐ dī wa sarba pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod/ yo shing la/ oṃ asne ye ba she ha sta badzra swāhāḥ nad gdon sdig sgrib shinti (shanti ku ru swāhāḥ zhes lan gsum bdun 'bul/ de bzhin du mar khu la/ oṃ bi ma la asne swāhāḥ nad gdon sogs dang / til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhāḥ zas mchog la/ rma sarba saṃ bha dī swāhāḥ'abras la/ ibadzra puṣṭa ye swāhāḥ so bar/ rma badzra bi dza ye swāhāḥ nas la/ oṃ

226 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamahā be ga ye swāhāḥ sran ma la/ oṃ mahā bā la ye swāhāḥ grol/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri swāhāḥ dur war/ yi badzra ā yu ṣe swāhāḥ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swāhāḥ me tog sogs rdzas gzhan la/ oṃ a ha ra a ha ra pu la ma hūṃ da ra pa sha shinti ku ru swāhāḥ zhes 'bul zhing spyi khyab du/ nad gdon sogs kyi spel tshig dang / dmigs kyi rdzas so so'i nus pa'i gzi brjid dang 'byor ba sogs kyi dmigs 'dun bya/ de'i tshe man ngag gi dmigs rim ni/ me lha'i sku'i 'od kyis rang ngam bsgrub bya'i sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad ba spu'i bu ga kun nas phyung ste rdzas rnams la bstim pas/ rdzas nyid ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsams la mchod pa zab bo// de bzhin du nad gdon dgra bgegs 'byung po'i 'tshe ba sogs rig pas 'phrul/bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten tshangs pa mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog/ shes rab me yis nyon mongs bsreg/ shar lho skyong mdzad gus pas bstod// dmar ser 'od 'bar ra skyes bcibs// bgrang phreng ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin// tshangs sku la sogs rgyan mdzes spras// khro 'dzum 'gying ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang // dpal grags longs spyod la sogs pa// 'phel rgyas bar chad zhi ba dang // dgra bgegs sgrolaba'i 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ āḥ ྅ rmuḥ /muḥ 1ye shes me lha thab kyi shar lhor gshegs par bsam/ de nas dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che'i nang // de dbus sna tshogs sbyi sogs dang / spyan 'dren pa ni/ chos dbyings spros bral sogs kyis spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol rnams bya/ dus gsum rgyal ba zhes pas phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa'i sngon du bum chus sku khrus gsol te/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha' la// rtsa gsum longs sprul nyi zla shar// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// 'khor ba sbyang phyir sku khrus gsol// oṃ āḥlha gu ru dī wa ḍakki /ḍā gi ni arbhe sogs dang / hūṃ/ me tog bdug spos sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams gzhung ltar mchod cing / dngos gzhi sbyin sreg 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ bde chen ye shes khyab gdal klong yangs dang // thugs rje ma 'gags 'gro don lhun gyis grub//

༄7g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 227kun 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs la// sbyin sreg 'bar ba'i mnyes mchod sna tshogs 'bul/ blang dor med pa'i dbyings su bzhes su gsol// bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// mi mthun rkyen ngan lam gyi bar chad zhi// ci 'dod dngos grub ma lus myur du stsol// dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad las 'od zer dkar po'i rang bzhin zhing khams kun tu khyab par shar bas zhi ba'i 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub pa la ches dpa' zhing de thams cad zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje dkar po'i rnam pa can dang / gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la hūṃ yig 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar ba mtshan pa'i sreg blugs kyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar gyur/ na maḥs manta bud dha ni oṃ asne ye swāhāḥzhes pa mar khu lan bdun dgang blugs kyis 'bul/ yi shing la gtso 'khor sngags su/ oṃ pa she ha sta swāhāḥ nad gdon sdig sgrib shinti ku ru swāhāḥ zhes pus mo'i bar du bskor zhing 'bul ba'am/ yang na sngags la 'dod gsol bsal bas phul/ spyi la rdzas sbags sbrel/ bsnyen sgrub kha skong rtsa sngags kho nas 'bul ba'i bye brag phyed par bya'o// mar khu la/ oṃ bi ma la asne (ye swāhāḥ til la/ oṃ sarba paṃ da ha (na )badzra ye swāhāḥ zhizan la/ oṃ sarba saṃ bha deswahāḥ 'bras la/ cha badzra puṣṭa ye swāhāḥ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhāḥnas la/ yi mahā be ga ye swāhāḥ sran ma la/ oṃ mahā bā la ye swāhā: grol/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri swāhāḥ dur wa la/ ibadzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ kusha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta (badzra ye swāhāḥ me tog sogs rdzas gzhan la/ oṃ a ha ra a ra pa la ma hūṃ da ra pa sha shinti ku ru swāhāḥ zhes 'bul la so po'i mthar bye brag spel tshig gzhan las byung ba ltar/ spyi khyab tu/ bdag cag dpon slob yon sogs gong bzhin/ bsnyen sgrub kha skong la/sngags lhag chad kyis nyes pa thams cad shinti ku ru swāhāḥ denas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba 'dzin pas/ zla ba la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya'i

228 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasteng phyogs nas khrus byas pas sdig sgrib nad gdon la sogs pa thams cad dag cing zhi bar gyur par bsam mo// de nas bu ram dang go la'i khu ba blugs gzar gyis phul la/ oṃ badzra tasbra la ye swāhāḥ zhes brjod de so rtsi 'bul/gos dar sna tshogs la/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs kyis na bza' 'bul la/oṃ badzra wa sta/skra ye swāhāḥ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ spro na tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/ rma ma 'byor pa dang sogs yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol dang / rma khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs kyi mthar/ badzra muḥ sa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/badzra sa mā ya dzaḥs thab kyi shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mar khu 'bul zhing / oṃ ba bā ga asne ye swāhāḥlan gsum dang / gong ltar rdzas rnams phul la/ oṃ ba bā ga (pā ba kuna.asne ye bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin rdzas dang yo byad ma tshogs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ma gsal ba dang / cho ga lhag nyams dang / lha gong 'og nor ba thams cad shinti ku ru swāhāḥ rdzas kun la 'dogs/ oṃ badzra tambha la ye swāhāḥs so rtsi dang / iwa sta na swāhāḥs gos zung phul/ yis lhasogs kyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag/ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis gtor ma lan gsum bsngos nas thab tu 'bul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsdoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang // dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang // longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing // zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srung // dngos grub kun gyi sdong (sdongs)grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang // gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed

228 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasteng phyogs nas khrus byas pas sdig sgrib nad gdon la sogs pa thams cad dag cing zhi bar gyur par bsam mo// de nas bu ram dang go la'i khu ba blugs gzar gyis phul la/ oṃ badzra tasbra la ye swāhāḥ zhes brjod de so rtsi 'bul/gos dar sna tshogs la/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs kyis na bza' 'bul la/oṃ badzra wa sta/skra ye swāhāḥ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ spro na tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/ rma ma 'byor pa dang sogs yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol dang / rma khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs kyi mthar/ badzra muḥ sa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/badzra sa mā ya dzaḥs thab kyi shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mar khu 'bul zhing / oṃ ba bā ga asne ye swāhāḥlan gsum dang / gong ltar rdzas rnams phul la/ oṃ ba bā ga (pā ba kuna.asne ye bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin rdzas dang yo byad ma tshogs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ma gsal ba dang / cho ga lhag nyams dang / lha gong 'og nor ba thams cad shinti ku ru swāhāḥ rdzas kun la 'dogs/ oṃ badzra tambha la ye swāhāḥs so rtsi dang / iwa sta na swāhāḥs gos zung phul/ yis lhasogs kyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag/ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis gtor ma lan gsum bsngos nas thab tu 'bul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsdoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang // dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang // longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing // zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srung // dngos grub kun gyi sdong (sdongs)grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang // gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 229ngan rnams med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang // 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang // bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yi//yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ ces 'phrin las bcol/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs/ asne gatstshas shar lho me lha ye shes pa gshegs la/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis brjod cing me ro chu klung du dor/ phan yon ni/ gzhung las/ 'di ltar 'bad pa'i rnal 'byor ba//nyams chag skong zhing sdig sgrib byang // bsnyen sgrub myur 'grub 'phrin las bzhi// gang sgrub rno ba ngar btags 'dra// zhes so// zhes pa'ang lcags ri'i 'tsho byed7gong sa mchog gi bla sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ngor dharmā (dharma seṅges sum ston chen po'i gsung bltas chog tu bkod pa yongs la dge bar gyur cig/ dge legs 'phel//gnyis pa/ g.yu thog snying thig gi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bsod nams ngo bo/bde chen lhan skyes ye shes rol pa las// dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad pa// rta phag yab yum 'bral med gtsug bsten nas//de yi rgyas pa'i 'phrin las me mchod spel// de la dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod na/ nyin phyed dus su sgrub khang gi lho ru rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi la bya rjes btsal ba'i dbus pad 'dab bzhi'i dkyil du lha gdan gyi tshom bu ser po dang / de'i phyir mu khyud rim pa gsum las phyi ma gnyis la nor bu'i phreng ba dang me ri bcas ser po bya/srog chags med pa'i rung mthun gyi bud shing dri zhim pa gru bzhir brtsegs shing / gzhan yang 'bras can yam shing mngar gsum gyis sbags pa dang / 'bru mar gsar pa'i mar khu sogs mthong brgyud ltar tshogs par byas/ thab kyi g.yas phyogs su gzhi ma ser po'i steng du rdzas rnams ser por bsgyur la rim par bshams/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs dang // bsangs chu ḍā dril me g.yab dpal 'bar rnams kyang 'du bya la/ sgrub pa po kha lho (byang )ru phyogs nas chas gos ser po byas la rin po

230 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigaches mgul pa brgyan cing / gdan la 'khod de rdor dril gyi don dran pas 'khyud rgya byas nas/ a mṛ tasadagang blugs bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros ye shes lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin ye shes sems dpa' 'od zer gyi rnam par bkug dgang blugs la thim pas dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas su gyur/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams gzhungaltar (byin gyis ) brlabs/ sreg rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi bran la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya'am/ dgang blugs kyis reg cing / rang gi thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'bru gsum 'phros/rdzas rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur/ pukhyi ku ru ye swāhā/ rdzas so sor reg bsangs chu 'thor /gtor la/ oṃ kro dha shwa ri sarba dra bye shwa dha ya oṃ āḥmai/ de nas thab kyi shar lhor tsub shing la/ dgon pa las byung ba'i me du ba med pas spar /sbar la/ rtsa sngags bzlas rlung g.yab g.yob cing / 〉 〉 〉/ de nas thab kyi phyogs bzhir ku sha sngo ljang dri med kyi chun po bzhi dang / dbus su rgya gram bcas bkod la/ rma badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sarba big rna(bisnarna nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying // bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// thab la bsangs chu 'thor (gtor zhing /hūṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang // hūṃ las ye shes rgyas pa'i thab//kha dog ser zhing dbyibs gru bzhi// mu ran kha khyer bcas pa'i dbus// sna tshogs padma'i lte ba ru// rin po che dang kha khyer la// rin chen phreng bas bskor ba'i grwar// zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'o// sgrib g.yogs bral zhing 'od zer 'phros// rgya dpangs tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs// de nang me dkyil gru gsum dang // a las zla dkyil steng du ram̐// ser po dbyug to ram̐ gyis mtshan//de las me lha drang srong ser// bram ze'i cha lugs ra skyes bcibs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang phreng dang // spyi blugs 'dzin pa khro 'dzum bsgom//

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 231'od 'phros shar lho mtshams nas ni// me lha spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// lag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i rgya dang mthe bong g.yab cing / hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//tshuraspyan tshur spyon me lha che// sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// gnas 'diraspyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// rma asne sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ gzi brjid me yi gzhal yas su// yid 'ong padma'i lte ba la// drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas// 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol// asne ye sa ma ye st+waṃ/ zhes dang / phyag 'tshal sku khrus gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ shar lho'i phyogs rnams skyong mdzad cing // rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung // mthu ldan bsregs bya za ba'i bdag/lha tshogs 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ asne ye na mo hūṃ/ asne'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang // bdag gzhan sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyangs slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// mi gtsang skyon gyi dri ma dag gyur cig/ces bum chu sbrengs la/ oṃ badzra ma hā asne ye dme wa pra na sa ta ka ra pra ti bhyo zabā swāhā/phyi nang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri// ro mchog sil snyan sman raka (rag gtor// gzugs sgra dri ro phyi nang gsang // mchod 'bul 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes// asne ambha sogs kyis phyi mchod dang / asne ye mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ asne ye mahā rakta khā hi/ asne ye mahā bha (bkalidha khā hi/ zhes pas sman raka (rag gtor gsum 'bul ba nang mchod/ asne ye bo ddha tsitta ga na gu hya snu dza hoḥ sogs kyis 'bul ba gsang mchod/ de nas mar khu sogs sreg rdzas rim pa bzhin du 'bul la/ de yang yo shing 'od kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'bru sna phyag gos zung sku/ mar khu dang dkaragasum sogs zhal du 'bul/ dgang blugs tshad ldan thogs nas rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad brjod/ hūṃ/ gzi brjid me lha 'khor dang bcas rnams la// rgyas pa'i 'phrin las thogs med bsgrub pa'i phyir// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i 'dod yon ma tshang med// sreg blugs mchod 'bul bzhes nas dngos grub stsol// oṃ asne

232 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigaye ram̐ dme wa sarba pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod/ yi shing la/ oṃ asne ye pa she ha sta badzra swāhā/ tshe dang bsod nams pukhyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes gsum mam bdun 'bul/de bzhin du mar khur/ oṃ bi ma la asne swāhā/ tshe dang bsod nams sogs dang / til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ bha dme swāhā/'bras la/ yibadzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ so bar/ oṃ badzrab dza ye swāhā/ nas la/ oṃ mahā beg ye swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ mahā bā la ye swāhā/ grol/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri swāhā/dur war/ oṃ badzra.ā yu ṣe swāhā/ ku sha la/ rma a pra ti ha ta badzra swāhā/ spyi khyab du/tshe dang bsod nams sogs kyi spel tshig dang / dmigs kyi rdzas so so'i nus pa'i gzi brjid dang 'byor pa sogs kyi dmigs 'dun bya/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten tshangs pa mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog/ shes rab me yis nyon mongs bsreg/ shar lho skyong mdzad gus pas bstod// dmar ser 'od 'bar ra skyes bcibs// bgrang phreng ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin// tshangs skud la sogs rgyan mdzes spras// khro 'dzum 'gying ldan khyed phyag 'tshal// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang // dpal grags longs spyod la sogs pa// 'phel rgyas bar chad zhi ba dang // dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ āḥlha rmuḥ ye shes me lha thab kyi shar lhor gshegs par bsam/de nas dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ me lha'i ltob yangs shing rgya che'i nang // de dbus sna tshogs rghaṃ sogs dang /spyan 'dren pa ni/ chos dbyings spros bral sogs kyis spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol rnams bya/ dus gsum rgyal ba zhes pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i sngon du bum chus khrus gsol te/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha' la// rtsa gsum longs sprul nyi zla shar// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// 'khor ba sbyangs phyir sku khrus gsol// oṃ āḥlha gu ru dī wa ḍā ki ni a bhi sogs dang / me tog bdug spos sogs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams gzhung ltar mchod
