༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 233cing dngos gzhi sbyin sreg 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ bde chen ye shes khyab gdal klong yangs ngang // thugs rje ma 'gags 'gro don lhun gyis grub// kun 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs la// sbyin sreg 'bar ba'i mnyes mchod sna tshogs 'bul// blang dor med pa'i dbyings su bzhes su gsol// bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// mi mthun rkyen ngan lam gyi bar chad zhi// ci 'dod dngos grub ma lus myur du stsol// dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad las 'od zer ser po'i rang bzhin zhing khams kun tu khyab par shar bas rgyas pa'i 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub pa la ches dpa' zhing de thams cad zhal brjid chags dang bcas pas cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje rin po che sbu gu'i rnam pa can dang / gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la hūṃ yig 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar ba mtshan pa'i sreg blugs kyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar gyur/ na maḥs manta buddha māṃ oṃ asne ye swāhā/ zhes pa mar khu lan bdun dgang blugs kyis 'bul/ yi shing la gtso 'khor sngags/ oṃ pa she ha sta swāhā/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor pukhyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes pus mo'i bar du bskor zhing 'bul ba'am/ yang na las sngags bsal bas phul/ spyi la rdzas sngags sbrel/ mar khu la/oṃ bi ma la asne swāhā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da hā (na )badzra ye swāhā/ zho zan la/oṃ sarba saṃ bha dme swāhā/ 'bras la/ chabadzra puṣṭha ye swāhā/ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ nas la/ yi mahā be ga ye swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ mahā bā la ye swāhā// grol/oṃ badzra ghasma ri swāhā/ dur wa la/ yibadzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ kusha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swāhā/ me tog sogs rdzas gzhan la/ oṃ a ha ra a ha ra pu la ma hūṃ da ra pa sha pukhyi ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes 'bul lo/ de nas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pas/ zla ba la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya'i steng phyogs nas khrus byas pas che (tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par bsam mo// de nas bu ram dang go

234 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaba'i khu ba blugs gzar gyis phul la/ oṃ badzra tam bu la ye swāhā/ zhes brjod de so rtsi 'bul/gos dar sna tshogs la/ sraba'ajam yang ba sogs kyis na bza' phul la/ rma badzra wa sta ye swāhā/ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ rang nyid lhar gsal sogs/ spro na tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/ ima'abyor pa dang sogs yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol dang / oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs kyi mthar/ badzramuḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥs thab kyi shar lho nas me lha ye shes spyan drangs/ dzaḥ: baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/mar khu 'bul zhing / oṃ ba bā ga asne ye swāhā/ lan gsum dang / gong ltar rdzas rnams phul la/oṃ ba bā ga asne ye bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad pukhyo ku ru swāhā// rdzas kun la 'dogs/ oṃ badzra tarū la ye swāhās so rtsi dang / yiwasta na swāhās gos zung phul/ yisalha sogs kyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag/ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis gtor ma lan gsum bsngos nas thab tu dbul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang // dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang // longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing // zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyi bdag la srung // dngos grub kun gyi sdong (sdongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang // gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// mi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan rnams med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang // 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ ces 'phrin las bcol/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs dang / asne gatstshas shar lhor me

༄7g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 235lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba sogs kyis dge ba bsngo// bkra shis brjod cing me ro chu klung du dor/ 'di yang lcags ri'i 'tsho byed7gong sa mchog gi bla sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ngor dharmā seng gis so/ dge'o//gsum pa/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dbang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/dbang mdzad dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas dbang gi sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod na/ dgong mo'i dus su sgrub khang gi nub tu dbang gi thab zla gam dbus 'dab bzhi'i dkyil du padma/ de'i phyir mu khyud rim pa gsum las phyi ma gnyis la lcags kyu 'od phreng dmar shas che ba'i rdul tshon gyis mdzes par bya/ srog chags med pa'i bud shing zla gam du brtsegs/ gzhan yang mdzo mo shing sogs kyi yi shing mngar gsum gyis sbags padang / mar khu 'bru sna sogs tshogs par byas la/ thab kyi g.yas su gzhi dmar po'i steng rdzas rnams bshams/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'du byas/ bsangs chu ḍā dril sogs mdun du bkod/ sgrub po'i chas gos dmar po padmas mgul pa brgyan te zhal nub tu phyogs la/ rdor dril gyi don dran pas 'khyud rgya byas te/ amṛ tas dgang blugs bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros ye shes me lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin ye shes sems dpa' 'od zer gyi rnam par bkug dgang blugs la thim pas dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas su gyur/de nas mchod pa rnams gzhung ltar brlabs te sreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi bran la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgya'amadagang blugs kyis reg cing / rang gi thugs ba'i hūṃ las 'bru gsum 'phros/rdzas rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas su gyur/ pa (lha shi ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes rdzas so sor reg bsangs chu 'thor(gtor / oṃ kro dha sho ri sarba dra bye sho dha ya oṃ āḥ:/ de nas thab kyi shar lhor smad tshong ma'i me du ba med par spar

236 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig(sbar la/ rtsa sngags bzlas/ rlung g.yab g.yob cing / lha : :/ zhes brjod/ de nas thab kyi phyogs bzhi dbus lngar ku sha bkod la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sarba big ni/bisnan nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying // bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swāhā/ thab la bsangs chu 'thor (gtor zhing / hūṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang // hūṃ las ye shes dbang gi thab// kha dog dmar zhing dbyibs zla gam// mu ran kha khyer bcas pa'i dbus// sna tshogs padma'i lte ba ru// chu skyes gzhon nu kha khyer la// lcags kyu'i phreng bas bskor ba'i grwar// zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'o// sgrib g.yogs bral zhing 'od zer 'phro//rgya dpangs tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs// de nang me dkyil gru gsum dang //a las zla dkyil steng du ram̐// dmar po dbyug to'i ram̐ gis mtshan// de las me lha drang srong dmar// bram ze'i cha lugs ra skyes bcibs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang phreng dang // spyi blugs 'dzin pa khro 'dzum bsgom// 'od 'phros shar lho mtshams nas ni// me lha spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// lag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i rgya dang mthe bong g.yab cing // hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur spyon tshur spyon me lha che// sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ asne sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod//bzhugs su gsol ba la ba ni/ hūṃ/ gzi brjid me yi gzhal yas su// yid 'ong padma'i lte ba la// drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas// 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol// asne ye sa ma ye st+waṃ/ zhes dang / phyag 'tshal sku khrus gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ shar lho'i phyogs rnams skyong mdzad cing / rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung / mthu ldan bsreg bya za ba'i bdag/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ asne ye na mo hūṃ/ asne'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga'

240 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigatshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis gtor ma lan gsum bsngos nas thab tu dbul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ kuna'agrub shog/ ces 'phrin las bcol/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs dang / asne gatstshas shar lhor me lha ye shes pa gshegs la dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ bkra shes brjod cing thal ba chu klung du dor/ zhes pa'ang lcags ri'i 'tsho byed 7gong sa mchog gi bla sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ngor dha rmā seng gis sum ston chen po'i gsung sor bzhag la man ngag gis brgyan te bris pa'o// maṅgālo//bzhi pa/ g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg rta rngam 'bar ba/chos kyi dbyings la byams sdang mi mnga' yang // kun tu rtog pa'i nyer len dgra bo'i dpung // thabs kyis sgrol ba sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar// rta mchog yab yum bdag gi gtsug tu rol// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas drag po'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod na/ srod kyi dus sgrub khang gi byang du drag po'i thab gru gsum pa dbus pad 'dab bzhi'i dkyil du rdo rje/ de'i phyir mu khyud gsul las phyi ma gnyis ral gri dang me ris bskor/ srog chags med pa'i sreg shing gru gsum du brtsegs/ gzhan yang tsher nag yi shing sha khrag gis sbags pa dang / bsreg rdzas rnams gzhi ma nag po'i steng thab kyi g.yas phyogs su bshams/ drag po'i nyer spyod dang sman rag mchod pa rnams kyang 'du bya/ bsangs chu ḍā dril rnga rol bsgral chas nya bo rnams mdun du bkod/ sgrub po'i chas gos nag por byas te kha byang du dor stabs kyis 'khod la/ rdor dril gyi don dran pas 'khyud rgya byas te/ de nas mchod g.yog pas gser skyems mchod cing / sha chen dang gu gul bdug rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūṃ/ khyab gdal

༄7g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 241/bdag gdod ma'i mgon po nas bzung ste// mngon par byang chub dpal mgon bla ma'i bar// dgongs brda snyan brgyud rdo rje slob dpon dang //dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs gzu dang dpang // 'gro kun bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin la// dgra gnyen phyogs cha'i sdang zhen mi dmigs kyang //gzung 'dzin gdon gyis brlams pa'i nyams pa bdun// byang chub sems gnyis bsgom /sgom pa'i dgra ru langs// dam las nyams pas slob dpon mched la brnyas// bka' las nyams pas las 'bras khyad du bsad// don las nyams pas bden gnyis chad par lta// las kyis nyams pas nyes med rnams la 'dzug/ mtshan mas nyams pas chos la phyogs ris bzung // 'dod pas nyams pas khrel med 'phrog bcom byed// log pas nyams pas sems can sdug la sbyor// 'di la mngon spyod 'phrin las mi mdzad na// mthar gyi 'chi ba sems can kun la yod// dus la bab na dpag bsam shing yang 'gyel// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin na// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mthu stobs rdzun du zad// chos nyid bden pa bslu ba med pa dang //sngags kyis sgrol ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthus// a bhi tsarya'i dus la da bab na// brnag pa'i las la btang snyoms ma mdzad cig/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbyings nas gzigs// bden gnyis rgyu 'bras bslu med gzu dang dpang // dpal mgon chos skyong rnams kyis dbyings nas gzigs//dam rdzas gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la// nyes can 'di la mngon spyod 'phrin las mdzod// ces bskul/ 'brub khung bskyed pa ni/ ling ga khrag gis bran la/las kyi 'brub khung kha dog cing gting zab pa/ zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba/ gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs pa'i klong du zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs nyam thag cing mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa/ bla tshe srog dbugs dang 'bral la khad du

242 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigabasgoms (sgom la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du'ang dpal chen rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bka' srung dam can sde dgu pho nya las mkhan dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nas pa la brten nas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ skye 'gro yongs la 'tshe ba/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig/ lan gsum/ dṛ tri sha hūṃ bla sha sum̐ ril dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥpra be sha ya phaṭaḥ tshe khrus gnas lung gi dgongs pa dang ldan pas nya bo'i snying gar phur bu btab la 'di skad do// hūṃ/ bcom ldan khro rgyal he ru ka/ srid gsum dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed// phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'debs// dam nyams thal ba rdul du rlog gnod byed rū twa mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥces ral gris kyang gtubs la ling ro bsreg rdzas rnams dang bsres la bdud rtsi bran/ rang gi thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs te ngo bo zag med kyi bdud rtsi la rnam par dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag mngon spyod drag po'i las so sor sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥ:/ lan gsum/ de nas gdol bshan nam dur khrod las byung ba'i me du ba can gyis spar la/ rtsa sngags bzlas/rlung g.yab kyis g.yob cing / hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod la bsangs chu 'thor bzhin pas/ hūṃ/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang // hūṃ las ye shes drag po'i thab// kha dog ljang nag dbyibs gru gsum// mu ran kha khyer bcas pa'i dbus// sna tshogs padma'i lte ba ru// rdo rje rtse lnga kha khyer la// ral gri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i grwar//

༄7g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 243zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'o// sgrib g.yogs bral zhing 'od zer 'phro// rgya dpangs tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs// de nang me dkyil gru gsum dang // a las zla dkyil steng du ram̐// dmar nag dbyug to ram̐ mtshan las// me lha drang srong mthing nag la// bram ze'i cha lugs ra skyes bcibs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang phreng dang // spyi blugs 'dzin pa khro 'dzum bsgom// 'od 'phros shar lho mtshams nas ni// me lha spyan drangs gnyis med gyur//dar nag g.yab cing /hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur spyon tshur spyon me lha che// sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//oṃ asne sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/gzi brjid me yi gzhal yas su// yid 'ong padma'i lte ba la// drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas// 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol// asne ye sa ma ye st+waṃ/zhes dang / phyag 'tshal sku khrus gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ shar lho'i phyogs rnams skyong mdzad cing // rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung // mthu ldan bsreg bya za ba'i bdag/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ asne ye na mo hūṃ/ asne'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang // bdag gzhan sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyong slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// mi gtsang skyon gyi dri ma dag gyur cig/ ces bum chu sbrengs la/ oṃ badzra mahā asne ye dme wa pra na sa ta ka ra pra ti sgye swāhā/ phyi nang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri//ro mchog sil snyan sman raka khuraganagator// gzugs sgra dri ro phyi nang gsang /mchod 'bul 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes// asne ambha sogs kyi phyi mchod/asne ye mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ asne ye mahā rakta khā hi/ asde ye mahā ba lidha khā hi/zhes pas sman raka ltarag gtor gsum 'bul ba nang mchod/asne ye bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥsogs kyis 'bul ba gsang mchod/ de nas til mar sogs bsreg rdzas rim pa bzhin du 'bul la/ de yang yam shing thugs/ 'bru sna phyag gos zung sku/ mar khu zhal du 'bul te/

244 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadagang blugs thogs nas rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad do// hūṃ/ gzi brjid me lha 'khor dang bcas rnams la// drag po'i 'phrin las thogs med bsgrub pa'i phyir//dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i 'dod yon ma tshang med// sreg blugs mchod 'bul bzhes nas dngos grub stsol// oṃ asne ram̐ dme wa sarba pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi/zhes brjod/ yam shing la/ rma asne pa she hasta badzra swāhā/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log rtogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ bhā dme swāhā/ bdag cag sogs 'og ma kun la 'dogs/ 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ so bar/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/nas la/ imahā be ga ye swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ mahā bā la ye swāhā/ grol/ oṃ badzra gha sma ri swāhā/ yungs kur la/ oṃ sarba an sidhi ye swāhā/ dur war/ rma badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swāhā/ zhes 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten tshangs pa mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog/ shes rab me yis nyon mongs bsreg/ shar lho skyong mdzad gus pas bstod// mthing nag 'od 'bar ra skyes bcibs// bgrang phreng ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin// tshangs skud la sogs rgyan mdzes spras// khro 'dzum 'gying ldan khyed phyag 'tshal// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang // dpal grags longs spyod la sogs pa//'phel rgyas bar chad zhi ba dang // dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//oṃ āḥlha māṃ/ ye shes me lha thab kyi shar lhor gshegs par bsam/ de nas dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che'i nang // de dbus sna tshogs st+waṃ sogs dang //spyan 'dren pa ni/ chos dbyings spros bral sogs kyis spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol rnams bya/ dus gsum rgyal ba zhes pas phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa'i sngon du bum chus khrus gsol te/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha' la // rtsa gsum longs sprul nyi zla shar/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// 'khor ba sbyong (sbyangs phyir sku khrus gsol// oṃ āḥ4 gu ru dme wa ḍākki (1 gi ni a bhi sogs dang / me

༄7g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg ba'i/ 245tog bdug spos sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams gzhung ltar mchod/ dngos bzhi sbyin sreg 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ bde chen ye shes khyab gdal /bdag klong yangs dang //thugs rje ma 'gags 'gro don lhun gyis grub// kun 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs la// sbyin sreg 'bar ba'i mnyes mchod sna tshogs 'bul// blang dor med pa'i dbyings su bzhes su gsol// bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// mi mthun rkyen ngan lam gyi bar chad zhi// ci 'dod dngos grub ma lus myur du stsol// dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs thams cad las 'od zer drag la rtsub pa'i rang bzhin zhing khams kun tu khyab par shar bas drag po'i las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub pa la ches dpa' zhing zhal khros pa dang bcas pa cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags ral gri'i rnam pa can dang /gzar bu'i kha la hūṃ yig 'od zer gyi phur por 'bar ba mtshan pa'i sreg blugs kyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar gyur/ na maḥs manta bud dhwa māṃ oṃ asne ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar nag lan bdun dgang blugs kyis 'bul/ yo shing la gtso 'khor sngags mjug tu/ oṃ pa she hasta swāhā/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log rtog /rtogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ zhes pus mo'i phyir bskor zhing 'bul bar bya/ yang na 'dod gsol bsal bas phul/mar khu la/ oṃ bi ma la asne swāhā/ til la/ rma sarba pā baṃ da ha (na )badzra ye swāhā/zho zan la/ rmasarba saṃ bha dme swāhā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/nas la/ oṃ mahā be ga ye swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhā/ grol/oṃ badzra gha sma ri swāhā/ yungs kur la/ oṃ sarba atpa sirnyi ye swāhā/ dur wa la/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swāhā/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer nag po me lce lta bur 'phro ba las mtshon cha'i char babs pas dgra bgegs thams cad brlag par bsam/ de nas so rtsi 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra haṃ bu la ye swāhā/zhes brjod de so rtsi 'bul/ dar nag gi na bza' phul la/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs nas/

246 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga.oṃ badzra wasta ye swāhā/ de nas mchod bstod byas la rang nyid lhar gsal sogs/ spro na tshogs kyi 'khoraglos mchod/ i ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi yi ge brgya pa bcas bzod gsol dang / oṃ khyedakyis sems can don kun sogs nas/ bza rmyaḥ (muḥ kas ye shes pa gshegs/dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs badzra sa mā yadzaḥs thab kyi shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥdhū hoḥ sa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mar nag 'bul zhing / oṃ ba bā ga asne ye swāhā/ lan gsum dang /rdzasarnams gong ltar 'bul la/ oṃ ba bā ga asne bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log rtog /rtogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥrdzas kun la 'dogs/ oṃ badzra haṃ bu la ye swāhās so rtsi dang / oṃ badzra wasta ye swāhā/ sa gos zung dang bcas phul/ yisalhasogs kyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag/ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la//mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ a kā ra mu khaṃ sogs kyis gtoras lan gsum bsngos nas thab tu phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog/ces 'phrin las bcol/ ma'abyor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs dang / asne gatstshas me lha ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs la/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba sogs kyis dge ba bsngo// bkra shis brjod cing me ro mchod rten rtsar mnan no// zhes pa'ang lcags ri'i 'tsho byed 7 gong sa mchog gi bla sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ngor dharmā seng gis bkod pa yongs la dge bar gyur cig/ sarba marga lam̐/oṃ su sti/ phyag na padmo thub bstan rgya mtsho yi// thugs bskyed mtha' bral kun gsal yangs pa'i klong // gang 'dul 'phrin las nyin byed 'od snang gis// bstan 'gro phan bde'i padmo ci yang 'dzum// kun bzang rigs 'dus

246 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga.oṃ badzra wasta ye swāhā/ de nas mchod bstod byas la rang nyid lhar gsal sogs/ spro na tshogs kyi 'khoraglos mchod/ i ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi yi ge brgya pa bcas bzod gsol dang / oṃ khyedakyis sems can don kun sogs nas/ bza rmyaḥ (muḥ kas ye shes pa gshegs/dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs badzra sa mā yadzaḥs thab kyi shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥdhū hoḥ sa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mar nag 'bul zhing / oṃ ba bā ga asne ye swāhā/ lan gsum dang /rdzasarnams gong ltar 'bul la/ oṃ ba bā ga asne bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log rtog /rtogs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥrdzas kun la 'dogs/ oṃ badzra haṃ bu la ye swāhās so rtsi dang / oṃ badzra wasta ye swāhā/ sa gos zung dang bcas phul/ yisalhasogs kyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag/ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la//mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ a kā ra mu khaṃ sogs kyis gtoras lan gsum bsngos nas thab tu phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog/ces 'phrin las bcol/ ma'abyor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs dang / asne gatstshas me lha ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs la/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba sogs kyis dge ba bsngo// bkra shis brjod cing me ro mchod rten rtsar mnan no// zhes pa'ang lcags ri'i 'tsho byed 7 gong sa mchog gi bla sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ngor dharmā seng gis bkod pa yongs la dge bar gyur cig/ sarba marga lam̐/oṃ su sti/ phyag na padmo thub bstan rgya mtsho yi// thugs bskyed mtha' bral kun gsal yangs pa'i klong // gang 'dul 'phrin las nyin byed 'od snang gis// bstan 'gro phan bde'i padmo ci yang 'dzum// kun bzang rigs 'dus

༄7g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg bzhi/ 247bla ma'i sgrub thabs kyi// las bzhi'i sbyin sreg mi 'dzad par yi 'phrul//'jam mgon mi yi rnam rol 'khor los bsgyur// khri srong gnyis pa de mo rgyal ba yi// slob lam dam bca'i thugs bskyed yongs smin pas// mi 'dzad chos sbyin gter gyi sgo 'phar phyes// grangs med tshogs pa'i bsod nams chu gter rum// spangs rtogs rin chen gdengs ka dbyings su bteg/ bshad sgrub dgos 'dod nor bu'i 'byung gnas che// sku gsum klu yi dbang po thob phyir bsngo// zhes rigs 'dus bla sgrub kyi sbyin sreg 'di nyid/ rang (rab tshes sa byi lor gzhungs mchog nas par gzhi gsar bskrun mdzad skabs par byang smon tshig tu chos kyi seng gos so/ maṅgā lam̐/par 'di lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling du bzhugs/ //

248༄// rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul rnam par bshad pa sku gsum zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru de wa ḍākki (1 gi ni/ sku gsum rnam rol sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar// gsang gsum zad mi shes pa'i gdugs dkar po'i// thugs rje mtshungs pa med pa'i grib bsil gyis// 'gro ba'i dug gsum tsha gdung sel la 'dud// rigs kun 'dus zhal bla ma sman yi rgyal// sgrub pa'i thabs mchog snyan brgyud zab mo'i dbyings// ji bzhin ma nor mjal ba'i lam bzang por//bgrod 'dod skal bzang skyes bu yongs kyis gson//de la 'dir mkha' 'gro dpal ldan phreng bas rje btsun g.yu thog pa chen por dngos su stsal ba'i rdo rje'i gsang tshig snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul cung zad bshad pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong dang thun min no// dang po thun mong la lnga ste/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ tshe mi rtag las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar ba'i phan yon no// dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba ni/dal ba brgyad dang 'byor pa bcu ste/ de la mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes pa la dal ba'i sgrar zhugs pas/ mi khom brgyad ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ste tsha grang bkres skom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i ngan song gsum dang / dge sdig rnam par 'byed pa'i 'du shes dang bral

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 249ba'i tshe ring lha dang / 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i kla klo/ yang dag pa'i chos dang gang zag la mi mos pa'i log par lta ba can dang / mun pa'i bskal pa zhes sangs rgyas ma byon pa'i zhing dang / rnam par shes pa las su mi rung ba'i lkugs pa ste mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad las thar bas dal ba brgyad thob pa dang / de'i steng du dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten bzang khyad par can mi'i lus su gyur pa/ dbang po sgo lnga skyon can du ma gyur pa'i yon tan tshang ba/'khor rnam pa bzhi rgyu ba'i yul dbus su skyes pa/ sgo gsum dbe la gzhol bas las kyi mtha' ma log pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la gcig tu 'dun pa'i dad pa ste rang rgyud kyi 'byor pa lnga dang / sgron me'i bskal ba zhes sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ de'i zhal nas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du gsungs pa/ bstan pa ma nub par gnas pa/ rang nyid de'i sgor zhugs pa/ lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa ste gzhan rkyen gyi 'byor pa lnga dang bcas dal 'byor bco brgyad po tshang ba'i rten bzang bla na med pa 'di nyid dpe grangs ngo bo'i sgo nas ji ltar rnyed dka' ba'i tshul la yang yang bsam ste/ 'khor ba'i bya ba gang la'ang snying po med pa'i rgyu mtshan shes par byas nas dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa la gcig tu brtson par rigs so//gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa ni/ de lta bu'i dal rten phun sum tshogs pa thob kyang nam 'chi cha med pa ste/ de yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang bcud kyi skye 'gro/ khyad par du'ang rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi rtag cing / tshe gnas pa'i thabs nyung ba/ 'chi ba'i rkyen mang ba/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan pa la sogs legs par yang nas yang du bsam zhing sgo gsum dge ba la ci nus su 'bad de/ tshe 'di'i ltar snang gi chos mtha' dag la blo ldog pa zhig dgos te/ rig 'dzin yongs 'dus las/

250 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thiga'akhor ba'i chos la skyo sems skye/ rnyed dka'i rin chen mi lus la// dal dang 'byor pas rnyed sems bskyed// mi rtag sgyu ma'i grong khyer du// nam 'chi nges med bsam pa bskyed// ces so//gsum pa las rgyu 'bras ni/ tshe mi rtag cing 'chi ba tsam du ma zad/las dkar nag gi rjes su 'brangs dgos te/ las la'ang dge sdig mi g.yo ba dang gsum du gsungs pa las/ dge ba'i las kyis mtho ris bde ba myong ba dang / mi dge ba'i las kyis ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang / mi g.yo ba'i las kyis mu bzhi gang rung la'o// de lta bu'i dge sdig gang byas pa ni byas pa'i las yin pas 'dus byas yin pa dang / 'dus ma byas ni don dam pa ste las ma yin/ las la sems pa dang bsam pa gnyis gsungs pas sems pa yid kyi las sam las dngos dang / bsam pa lus ngag gi las sam las kyi lam mo// dge sdig las grol ba ni chos kyi dbyings so// las la dkar nag gis dbye na bzhi las/ las dkar po la rnam smin yang dkar po/ las gnag pa la rnam smin yang gnag pa dang / yang las dkar po la rnam smin gnag po dang / las nag po la rnam smin dkar ba sogs 'byung ba ni/ de la dang po sbyin pa lta bu ni bsam sbyor gnyis ka dag pas dkar po dang / sha khrag gi ched du srog bcad pa ni bsam sbyor gnyis ka gnag pa dang / rang sha za 'dod pa'i ched du dud 'gro la lto sbyin pa lta bu ni las dkar la rnam smin gnag pa dang / mang po'i srog skyabs pa'i phyir gcig gi srog bcad pa ni las nag la rnam smin dkar ba dang / gzhan yang 'phen rdzogs gnyis las/'phen rdzogs gnyis ka dge ba yin na 'phen byed kyis lha mi'i lus rten thob/de la bde ba 'byung ba ni rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa zhes bya ba la/ gnyis ka sdig pa yin na 'phen byed kyis ngan song gsum dang / rdzogs byed kyis de'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong ba'o// tshe 'dir dge ba bsgrubs pas mtho

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 251ris su skye ba 'phen byed dge ba'i las yin la/ nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong ba ni rdzogs byed kyi las so// mi dge ba byas pas ngan 'gror 'phen pa/ gnas skabs bde ba dang ldan pa dge bas rdzogs pa'o// yang gcig tu dkar bas bde ba/ gcig tu gnag pas sdug bsngal/ 'dres mas bde sdug kyang 'dres mar skye ba yin te/ de la spang bya mi dge ba ni/ lus kyi las srog gcod pa/ ma byin pa len pa/ 'dod log dang gsum ste spang bya dang / de gsum go ldog cing srog skyabs pa sogs ni lus kyi dge ba bsgrub bya dang / ngag gi las rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'chal te bzhi spang bya yin la/drang por smra ba sogs ngag gi dge ba ste bsgrub bya/ yid kyi las brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste gsum spang bya dang / chog shes la sogs pa bsgrub bya ste/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge sdig nyi shu po nges par lag len things /thebs par gal che zhing / de'ang mi dge ba'i kun slong zhe sdang gis dmyal bar skye ba dang / 'dod chags kyis yi dwags/ gti mug bis dud 'gro/ ser sna dge ba 'dres mas mi dbul phongs/ phrag dog dge ba 'dres mas lha min/ nga rgyal dge ba 'dres mas lha ste kun slong gis khyad par ro// de la dang po srog gcod la mtshon na gzhi srog gcad bya sems can dang /bsam pa sems can de'i srog gcod snyam pa dang / sbyor ba mtshon cha sogs gang rung gis srog dang bral bar bya ba dang / mthar thug dga' ba bsgom pa'o// des ni srog gcod kyi las yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ de'i nang nas ga'i dang bsam pa ma gtogs gzhan gnyis po ma tshang na cung zhig las srab kyang 'bras bu ni nges par myong dgos so// de bzhin du mi dge ba gzhan la'ang 'gre'o// dge ba'ang srog skyabs pa'i gzhi dang / bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug sogs go ldog pas shes so// gong gi mi dge ba'i las kyis ngan song gsum du skye ba rnam smin gyi las/ ngan song las thar kyang srog bcad pas tshe

252 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigathung ba sogs skyes bu byed pa'i las/ srog la 'tshe ba'i yul du skye ba'am der gnas dgos pa dbang gi 'bras bu/ snga ma'i las ngan gyi rigs sad pa byed pa rgyu mthun dang bzhi ste mi dge ba thams cad la sbyor shes pa dgos so// de bzhin du dge ba la'ang rim par mtho ris su skye ba/ tshe ring ba/ srog la 'tshe ba med pa/ skye ba snga ma'i dge ba'i las sad pa sogs thams cad la mtshungs te/ bshad rgyud las/ srog gcod brku dang log par g.yem pa dang // rdzun dang ngag 'chal tshig rtsub dbyin sbyor dang // brnab sems gnod sems lta ba phyin ci log/ sdig pa'i las bcu lus ngag yid kyis spangs// zhes pas dge ba bcu bsgrub dgos pa ni shugs kyis bstan to// gzhan yang sor byang sngags gsum gyi spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba dang / blang bya dge ba'i phyogs thams cad ngo tsha bag yod dran shes dang ldan pas tshul bzhin du nyams su bstar bar bya'o//bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i las kyi rnam gzhag tshul mthun zhig ma byung na dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/yi dwags su skyes na bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gror blun mongs /rmongs dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal brjod kyis mi lang / de bzhin du mtho ris na'ang bde ba med de/ mi la skye rga na 'chi bzhi dang / rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal gsum dang / gzhan yang gnyen dang bral zhing dgra dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa thog tu mi khel zhing / mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal dang / lha min gnas ris la 'thab cing rtsod pas g.yul nyes pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal lo// lha la'ang 'chi 'pho ba dang / khams 'og mar lhung ba'i sdug bsngal te/ mdor na 'khor ba'i gnas gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang / sdug bsngal gyi las 'ba' zhig las med pas/ da res 'khor ba'i gnas rigs 'di dag la yid smon skad cig tsam mi bya zhing / dus dang

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 253rnam pa kun tu thar 'dod don gnyer gyi ngas (nges 'byung drag pos skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa/ gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa sogs lam bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa/ ltogs pas kha zas don du gnyer ba ltar ma 'bad na zhu zhu dang thob thob mang pos rang gzhan gnyis kyi don gang yang mi 'grub pas shes ldan rnams kyis 'bad par rigs so//lnga pa thar ba'i phan yon ni/ de lta bu'i dge sdig blang dor gyi gnas la tshul bzhin du 'bad na rab myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba dang / 'bring byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang / tha ma'ang nyan rang gnyis kyi go sar zhi ba dang / bsil ba'i yon tan mngon du byed do//gnyis pa thun min la lnga/ dang po phyi nang gi khyad par dbye zhing / log lta'i gnyen por skyabs su 'gro ba/ theg chen gyi bslab pa mi nyams shing /theg dman gyi gnyen por sems bskyed pa/ lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen sel zhing / sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i gnyen por rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ lam gyi mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇḍal/ rang rgyud rnam dag tu bsgrub pa dang /byin rlabs 'jug pa bya phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lnga las/dang po gong du bstan pa'i 'khor ba spyi dang / bye brag gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang 'bras bu la spyod pa mtha' yas pa'i ma rgan 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad kyi don du skyabs su 'gro ba ste/ rtsa gsum sman gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal btab la/ 'gro rnams sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i tshul la bsams te/ de las skyob pa'i thabs mkhyen pa'i yon tan/ skyob par byed pa thugs brtse ba'i yon tan/ skyabs nas pa'i mthu dang ldan pa ste yon tan gsum mthong nas shin tu dad pa chen po dang ldan zhing / sems can rang rang las ngan gyi rnam smin sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ sdug

254 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabasngal gyi rgyu kho na bsgrub pa la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o snyam pas/ pha ma dgra bgegs bzhis gtsor byas pa'i bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mgrin gcig tu skyabs su 'gro bar dmigs te/ na mo rigs 'dus rdo rje 'chang // phyogs dus dkon mchog sogs kyis skyabs su 'gro ba kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par 'bad/ de ltar skyabs 'gro'i phan yon ni lung las/ skyabs song 'di la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha' 'di yang snod du chung // rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter// phul la gzhal bas zad mi nus// zhes so// bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha dang / phyi rol pa'i lha sogs la skyabs su mi 'gro/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi sku'i rten chag dum yan chad la phyag mchod bkur sti bya zhing / sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can gang la'ang gnod pa'i bya ba dug ltar spong / gsung rab yi ge'i ras ma yan chad la gus pa bskyed cing /chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mi dge ba'i sdig grogs su gtogs pa gang dang yang mi 'grogs/ rtags tsam 'dzin dang / dmar ser gos kyi tshal bu yan chad la sri zhu mi lhod cing /dge 'dun dngos kyi blo bzhag spyi'i bslab bya la/ dus rtag tu bza' btung la sogs pa'i phud kyis mchod cing / dkon mchog gi yon tan rjes su dran pas skyabs 'gro dang phyag mchod bya/ gzhan yang mdo sde blta (lta ba dang /bshes gnyen bsten pa sogs 'di ni lam thams cad kyi rmang rdo lta bu med thabs med pa yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba kho na mi brjed par bya'o//gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi pha ma ma byas pa med snyam pa'i mar shes pa dang / de

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 255thams cad da lta'i ma ltar drin shin tu che ba bsam ste drin dran pa dang / ma de rnams sdug bsngal gyis mnar/ bde bas phongs pas mngon mtho dang / nges par legs pa'i sa la 'god par bya snyam pa'i drin gzo ba dang / ma de rnams bde ba dang ldan pa bdag gis bya snyam pa'i byams pa/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral bar bya snyam pa'i snying rje/ pha ma rnams 'khor mtsho las bdag nyid gcig pus 'don snyam pa'i lhag bsam/ ma 'gro ba drug gi ched du bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi smon sems/ lam bslab pa gsum dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab snyam pa'i 'jug sems rnams rgyud dang 'dres nges par byas nas/ skyabs yul rnams sems bskyed pa'i dpar (dpang por dmigs la/ nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir du bdag nyid bla ma yi dam mkha' 'grogasum gyi go 'phang ma thob bar bsgrub snyam pas/ nam mkhas khyab pa'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal mtsho las sogs kyis yang yang du sems bskyed do// de'ang byams pa ni zhe sdang med pa'i sems/ snying rje ni 'dod chags med pa'i sems/ byang sems ni gti mug med pa'i sems te brjod bya bslab pa gsum dang / rjod byed sde snod gsum gyi don la sbyar zhing / smon 'jug gi bslab bya rnams gzung bar bya'o// phan yon yang / dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid//byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang // 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes so//gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ byang chub kyi sems des zin par byas la rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po dri ma med pa yongs su gyur pa las bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba ni rten gyi stobs/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog

256 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamed nas sgo gsum mi dge'i las bcu dang / rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba thams cad dug khong du shor ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems byed pa ni rnam pa sun 'byin gyi stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi dge sdig pa'i las mi byed par dam bca' ba ni nyes pa las slar zlog (ldog pa'i stobs/ thugs kur zla steng hūṃ la yig brgyas bskor ba las bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong byed bzhin du bzlas pa byed pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te bzhi ka tshang ba'i sgo nas/ rang gi spyi bo pad zla'i steng sogs dmigs te bzlas pas thugs ku'i hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa 'od zer rang mdog dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te rdor sems sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros te khams gsum skye 'gro thams cad la phog pas las nyon bag chags thams cad sbyangs/snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rten brten pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/zhabs kyi mtheb sor nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung ste/ rang gzhan rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ tshe rabs nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad sbyangs pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu lta bu/nad thams cad rnag khrag gdon thams cad sdom sdig sbal lcong sog (srog chags kyi rnam pa 'og sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thon te sa 'og tu 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i khar song bar bsam/ rang gzhan rnams kyi lus kyi 'khor lo bzhi shel bum 'o mas bkang ba ltar bdud rtsis gang zhing ba spu'i bu ga dang spyi bo nas lud de/ lus phyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis khyab pas rgyud la bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba skyes par bsams la tshogs gnyis zung 'jug ngang du bzla'o// de ltar brgya stong khri 'bum sogs sdig sgrib dag pa'i mtshan ma ma shar bar du dus dang gnas skabs kun tu

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 257'bad pa shin tu gal che'o// de nas thun bsdu ba na spyi bo'i rdor sems 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum ro gcig tu gyur par dmigs la/ sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs pa dang bcas pa 'khor gsum spros pa med pa'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag la rjes su dge ba bsngo/ phan yon ni snying po rgyan las/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin// nyi shu tsam ni re re bzlas// ltung sogs byin gyis brlabs 'gyur bas// 'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes// grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas// thun mtshams su ni spyod par bya// 'bum phrag tu ni bzlas gyur na// rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// zhes so//bzhi pa maṇḍal ni/ dril sgrub tu bzhir gsal yang / phyin drug gi skabs nas gsungs pa'i maṇḍal rgyu dag pa tshom bu dang bcas pa mthong rgyun ltar byas la/ bdag gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad dang /lus longs spyod mtha' dag ri rab gling bzhi mtsho dang nyi zla mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs nas 'bul bar bya'o// de yang 'khor gsum dmigs med kyis zin par byas pas/ snga mas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang /phyi mas ye shes kyi tshogs zung du 'jug pa'i 'bras bus chos gzugs gnyis kyi rdzu 'phrul thob pa'o// phan yon ni/ dgongs 'dus las/ gnas skabs su longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing / dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal dang bral nas longs spyod rgya chen po 'byung / bla ma dam pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos la nges shes khyad par can skye/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi yid du 'ong zhing kun gyis bkur bar 'gyur/ zhes dang / gzhan yang dus khyad par rnams la bla ma dkon mchog la sogs pa'i rten khyad par can gyi drung du gus pa dang ldan pas maṇḍal tshar gcig phul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs dang

258 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabacas pa thams cad la phyi nang gi mchod gsol rgya chen po byas pa las lhag pa'i bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ ci bsam pa'i don thams cag (cadaka'agrub/ bskal pa nas bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur/ tshar gcig phul nas yid dad pas smon lam ji ltar btab pa thams cad 'bad med du 'grub/ de bas na phyi rabs kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis maṇḍal 'bul ba la brtson par gyis shig gsungs/ de la'ang phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po ni gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa shin tu brjid chags la 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / gnyis pa ni chos kyi rgyal srid bsgrub par bya ba la snying po gzhi 'dzin du gyur pa'i phyir bsod nams khyad par can bsags te mngon mtho'i dpal yon thob par 'gyur ba'o// gsum pa phyi ltar padma'i 'dab ma/ nang ltar du ḍākki'i /dā ki'i mkha' rgya/ gsang ba ltar yul de la rol pas snying po rol pa len pas myur lam pho nya'i man ngag gis gzung 'dzin ro rkyang gi rgyu ba ye shes sgra gcan gyis dbang bar byas te/ rtsa mdud nyer gcig btsan thabs su bkrol bas sa bcu lam lnga'i rtogs pa bsgrub phyir mkhas pa bzhi'i gnad la goms pas byang sems dbab ldog gi 'khrul 'khor la brten/ snying po bde chen gyi ye shes skad cig la len par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor mchog gi spyod yul las kun gyi thun mong ma yin no// gnad de rnams kyis zin pa'i phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi maṇḍal rgyu rkyen bsham dgod/ nang ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs rim gsang ba 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du lta bas rgyas thebs par phul na/ thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i mthu la brten/ bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi tshogs kyang skad cig la zlums pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/de phyir grangs med gsum sogs gsungs pa kun// myur du rdzogs dang ring du rdzogs pa dang // tshe gcig grol pa blo yi stobs la rag/ de yang thabs dang

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 259shes rab brtson 'grus mchog/ gsum gyis bsgrubs gang bla med stobs che'o//zhes so// thabs de lta bu dang mi ldan pa'i maṇḍal lo ga'i chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang / gser dngul rin thang can gyi stegs dang tshom bu bkod pa tsam gyis ni phan yon sgra ji bzhin pa thob par dka' bas go bar bya'o//gnad dang ldan na kun rdzob kyi tshogs gsog thams cad kyi nang nas maṇḍal las khyad 'phags med pa'i rgyu mtshan du ma yod kyang de tsam mo// 'di'i yan lag ku su lu'i tshogs gsog bya ba sngon 'gro brgya phrag lnga pa nas gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang ngo //lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rten bskyed pa dang / spyan 'dren pa/yan lag bdun pa/ bzlas dmigs/ dbang bzhi len pa bcas lnga las/dang po ni sa phyogs thams cad lta na sdug pa'i zhing phun sum tshogs pa lnga rang bzhin du dmigs te/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar padma 'dab bzhi rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus su sman gyi bla ma bai ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po rje btsun chen po mahā gu ṇa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i 'od mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra lcang lo me tog gis spras pa/ phyag g.yas 'gro ba mtha' dag la mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i brdar mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas utpa la'i sdong bu gsar pa 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kur kha phye ba'i steng du dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab kyi bdag po nges pa'i brdar glegs bam dang ral gris mtshan pa/g.yon pa 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang ba'in du bstan pa'i brdar thugs kur chos 'chad phyag rgyas pad sdong bsnams pa/snyan gyi thad kur chu skyes 'dab ma rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gur gum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang bcas pa la/ nor bu dbang rgyal/ gser rdor/ sman mchog a ru bcas kyis g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du mtshan pa can te/ bum pa mi bskyod pa/ nor bu rin 'byung / gser rdor

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 259shes rab brtson 'grus mchog/ gsum gyis bsgrubs gang bla med stobs che'o//zhes so// thabs de lta bu dang mi ldan pa'i maṇḍal lo ga'i chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang / gser dngul rin thang can gyi stegs dang tshom bu bkod pa tsam gyis ni phan yon sgra ji bzhin pa thob par dka' bas go bar bya'o//gnad dang ldan na kun rdzob kyi tshogs gsog thams cad kyi nang nas maṇḍal las khyad 'phags med pa'i rgyu mtshan du ma yod kyang de tsam mo// 'di'i yan lag ku su lu'i tshogs gsog bya ba sngon 'gro brgya phrag lnga pa nas gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang ngo //lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rten bskyed pa dang / spyan 'dren pa/yan lag bdun pa/ bzlas dmigs/ dbang bzhi len pa bcas lnga las/dang po ni sa phyogs thams cad lta na sdug pa'i zhing phun sum tshogs pa lnga rang bzhin du dmigs te/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar padma 'dab bzhi rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus su sman gyi bla ma bai ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po rje btsun chen po mahā gu ṇa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i 'od mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra lcang lo me tog gis spras pa/ phyag g.yas 'gro ba mtha' dag la mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i brdar mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas utpa la'i sdong bu gsar pa 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kur kha phye ba'i steng du dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab kyi bdag po nges pa'i brdar glegs bam dang ral gris mtshan pa/g.yon pa 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang ba'in du bstan pa'i brdar thugs kur chos 'chad phyag rgyas pad sdong bsnams pa/snyan gyi thad kur chu skyes 'dab ma rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gur gum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang bcas pa la/ nor bu dbang rgyal/ gser rdor/ sman mchog a ru bcas kyis g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du mtshan pa can te/ bum pa mi bskyod pa/ nor bu rin 'byung / gser rdor

260 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'od dpag med/ a ru ra rnam snang / kha rgyan gur gum don grub ste rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i brda dang / mchog mthun 'phrin las ba'i'i sgo nas sems can gyi don la brtson pa'i brdar dar sna tshogs kyi na bza'/thugs zag med rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes la 'pho 'gyur med pas 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon pa'i brdar zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa la 'khor gyi lha mo bzhi dang / gzhan yang steng phyogs su byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab thugs kyi thad du dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam rgyud sde ba'i drugamadun du dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal pa sras bcas/ de'i mtha' skor du 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul sde dgu sogs dam can rgya mtsho/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad sman srung rig 'dzin drang srong gi tshogs mkha' dbyings su gza' skar bkra ba lta bur bzhugs pa/ de thams cad sku snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' dang 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong du bzhugs shing / lha dang lha mo mang pos glu gar rol mo sogs mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas brjod du med pas mchod de bskor bar bsams la/ rab yangs mdun gyi nam mkha' sogs brjod/gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas// dus gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sogs gong du dmigs pa ltar nyi zer gyi rdul ltar dpag tu med pa byon nas tshogs zhing rnams dang dbyer med du thim par bsams la/ hūṃ hrī bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sogs brjod do//gsum pa tshogs lam gyi yon tan skad cig la rang rgyud du zlums pa'i thabs khyad par can yan lag bdun pa ni/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba la/bdag gzhan rnams kyis lus tha mal pa 'di grangs med nam mkha' gang bar sprul nas sgo gsum gus pa chen pos khyed shes kyi mos gus dang bcas yan lag lnga ldan gyis phyag 'tshal ba dang / tshogs zhing rnams kyis sku gsung thugs las

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 261byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa nyi ma 'char ga'i thigs phran ltar dpag tu med pa byung nas rang cag rnams kyi sgo gsum la thim pas las nyon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam pa ni nga rgyal gyi gnyen po ste/ bdag gzhan sgo gsum sogs brjod de phyag 'tshal/ phan yon ni sgyu 'phrul las/ gang gi sgo gsum btud byas nas// rgyal ba'i sku la phyag btsal na// de yi bsod nams 'jig rten du// gzugs can gyur na shong mi 'gyur// zhes so// yan lag gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ bla na yod pa dang med pa'o// dang po ni/ dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa lha ma'i me tog sogs phyi mchod rnams dang / sman rag gtor ma sogs nang mchod dang / bde stong zhu bde'i 'bar 'dzag sogs gsang mchod rnams kyis gtsos mchod du 'os pa'i rdzas dngos po thams cad dang /gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i mchod pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba las gong na mchod pa gzhan med pas bla na med pa ste tshul de gnyis kyis mchod pas rgyal ba rnams dgyes shing bskyed par bsams la/ de yang bdag gcig ma yin pa mar gyur 'gro ba kun gyi ched du 'bul lo snyam pa'i lhag bsam dang bcas te/ dngos 'byor yid sprul sogs brjod do// phan yon ni pad dkar las/ me tog gcig tsam gyis kyang mchod pa yang // bde gshegs sku gzugs rtsig ngos bris pa la// lus 'khrugs bzhin du sems kyis phul ba na// de dag rim gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong // zhes so// yan lag gsum pa bshags pa ni/ dang po nyes pa mthong ba'i brda sbyar te/ rang gzhan rnams kyi thog ma med pa nas rgyud dug gsum gyis kun nas blangs pa'i mi dge ba bdag gis bgyis pa/gzhan (la )bcol ba/ deni la rjes su yi rang ba dang / pha ma bkrongs pa sogs mtshams med pa lnga/ mi dge ba bcu/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi dam sdom bslab pa'i rtsa ba yan lag dang

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 261byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa nyi ma 'char ga'i thigs phran ltar dpag tu med pa byung nas rang cag rnams kyi sgo gsum la thim pas las nyon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam pa ni nga rgyal gyi gnyen po ste/ bdag gzhan sgo gsum sogs brjod de phyag 'tshal/ phan yon ni sgyu 'phrul las/ gang gi sgo gsum btud byas nas// rgyal ba'i sku la phyag btsal na// de yi bsod nams 'jig rten du// gzugs can gyur na shong mi 'gyur// zhes so// yan lag gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ bla na yod pa dang med pa'o// dang po ni/ dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa lha ma'i me tog sogs phyi mchod rnams dang / sman rag gtor ma sogs nang mchod dang / bde stong zhu bde'i 'bar 'dzag sogs gsang mchod rnams kyis gtsos mchod du 'os pa'i rdzas dngos po thams cad dang /gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i mchod pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba las gong na mchod pa gzhan med pas bla na med pa ste tshul de gnyis kyis mchod pas rgyal ba rnams dgyes shing bskyed par bsams la/ de yang bdag gcig ma yin pa mar gyur 'gro ba kun gyi ched du 'bul lo snyam pa'i lhag bsam dang bcas te/ dngos 'byor yid sprul sogs brjod do// phan yon ni pad dkar las/ me tog gcig tsam gyis kyang mchod pa yang // bde gshegs sku gzugs rtsig ngos bris pa la// lus 'khrugs bzhin du sems kyis phul ba na// de dag rim gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong // zhes so// yan lag gsum pa bshags pa ni/ dang po nyes pa mthong ba'i brda sbyar te/ rang gzhan rnams kyi thog ma med pa nas rgyud dug gsum gyis kun nas blangs pa'i mi dge ba bdag gis bgyis pa/gzhan (la )bcol ba/ deni la rjes su yi rang ba dang / pha ma bkrongs pa sogs mtshams med pa lnga/ mi dge ba bcu/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi dam sdom bslab pa'i rtsa ba yan lag dang

262 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'agal ba thams cad dran par byas te stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshogs kyi zhing dam ma rnams kyi spyan sngar 'gro don sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bshags pa ni gti mug gi gnyen po ste/ nyes ltung nyams chags sogs brjod do//phan yon ni/ yum bar pa las/ gang gis dran pa'i mod la ni// sdig pa dran pas 'gyod pa yis// bshags pas thams cad 'dzad pa ste// rgyal ba'i sras pos phyis sdoms shig/ ces so// yan lag bzhi pa gzhan gyis tshogs gnyis bsags pa la dga' ba bsgom zhing rjes su yi rang ba ni/ 'phags pa zhes sangs rgyas byang sems sogs khyad par ba rnams dang / mos spyod/ nyan rang rnams kyis bslab pa'i tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / so skye khyim pa rnams kyis 'dus byas kyi dge tshogs mtha' dag la yi rang ba'i dga' ba bsgom pa ni phrag dog gi gnyen po ste/ dus gsum dge ba'i sogs brjod do// phan yon ni/bya sla rlabs che ba zhig ste/ dge ba gsog pa po dang / de la rjes su yi rang ba'i bsam pa bskyed pa gnyis bsod nams mnyam por thob par gsungs te/sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ko sa li'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur gyis mchod tshe/ dbul po zhig gas mthong bas de la rjes su yi rang ba'i bsam pa skyes pa bsod nams mnyam pa'i nang nas kyang ches mchog tu thob par gsungs so// yan lag lnga pa rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba ni/phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la/ sngon ston pa 'di mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ zab zhi spros bral gyi tshigs bcad sho lo ka gsungs nas zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi bar chos ma gsungs par thugs las chung ngur gzhol ba na tshangs pa dang / brgya byin gyis gser 'khor thogs nas chos 'khor bskul ba ltar sangs rgyas byang sems chos mi gsung zhing mnyam par 'jog pa gang na su bzhugs dag gi drung du lus brgya phrag grangs med par

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 263sprul te sangs rgyas re re'i mdun du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa du ma phul nas 'gro ba'i dbang po dang 'tshams par gang la gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba ni 'dod chags kyi gnyen po mchog tu gyur pa ste/gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor sogs brjod do// phan yon ni/ gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mdzad pa la// gang gi gsol ba 'debs pa de// dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ste// de yi bsod nams 'ching pa 'dra// zhes so// yan lag drug pa sku myang na /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rgyal ba gang dag sems can gyi don ci rigs par zin nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dgongs pa can rnams la/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa gshegs par dgongs pa na dge bsnyen tsun dwas gsol ba btab pa ltar bdag gis kyang ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar du bstan pa'i sgron me mdzad de bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa ni log lta'i gnyen po ste/ mya ngan mi 'da' zhes sogs brjod do// phan yon ni mdo las/nyon mongs tshangs pa'i rgyal po khyod// bcom ldan 'das la gsol 'debs pa//bsod nams de ni khyad par 'phags// sangs rgyas mya ngan 'da' mi 'da'//zhes pa ltar ro// yan lag bdun pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ rang gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum du bden gnyis lam gyis bsdus pa'i dge rtsa bdag gas bgyis pa/ gzhan la bcol ba/rjes su yi rang ba/ gang dag phyin ci ma log pa'i rigs rnams la bsngo ba rung ste/ 'khor gsum yongs dge zhes chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stongs kyang rmi lam sgyu ma'i rnam rol du kun rdzob btags yod kyi dge ba rnams rmi lam dang / sgyu ma tsam du bla na med par bsngo ba ni the tshom mam lung ma bstan gyi gnyen po ste/ bsod nams ye shes gang bsags byang chub bsngo// zhes sogs brjod do// de lta bu'i bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs zung gis

264 ༄zagayu thog snying thiga'agro rnams chos gzugs kyi sku mngon du byas nas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs te bde sdug gnyis bral gyi go 'phang 'pho 'gyur bral bar thob pa'i smon lam gyis rdzogs so// phan yon ni/ dper na chu'i thigs pa gcig rgya mtsho chen por lhung na rgya mtsho ma skem bar du chu thigs kyang mi 'dzad pa dang 'dra ba de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so// de ltar yan lag bdun du bzhed pa mdo lugs spyi khyab tu grags che yang / gsang sngags la yan lag brgyad pa dang bcu pa sogs 'byung ba du ma yod pas/ 'dir yang don la spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol mjug gi smon lam bcas yan lag bcu pa rang du 'dug de ltar spyi'i phan yon ni/ spyir tshogs bsags kyi sgo thams cad yan lag bdun la 'dus pa dang / dmigs bsal phar phyin nas grangs med gsum zhes/ gtam dkrigs mi 'khrug khyad 'byin la sogs te grangs kyi mngon brjod sa bcu lam lnga dang sbyar nas mthar grangs med pa ni tha ma'o//zhes grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags dgos pa'ang gnad khyad par can gyis zin na grangs med skad cig la rdzogs nus pa yang / kun mkhyen gyis/sems stobs chen skad cig re re la tshogs bskal ba mang po zlums par bshad pas grangs med gsum ji lta bur gsog mi dgos shing / gsang sngags ni dbang po shin tu non po'i dbang du byas te/ sems stobs chen pos tshogs dpag tu med pa skad cig rer zlums pa can la rgyun chags su bslab pas tshe gcig gas grol bar 'thad pa yin no// zhes dang / tshul gsum sgron me las/don gcig na yang mi rmongs shing // thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang //dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags//zhes pa dbang po'i khyad par shes par bya'o// 'di'i khongs su phyag 'bum ther re 'gro ba dgos shing / sngon 'gro brgya phrag lnga pa nas sku rten la bskor ba bya ba'ang gsungs pas shes par bya'o//

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 265bzhi pa bzlas dmigs ni/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'don zhing maṇḍal dbul la/ snying gi dkyil/ rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu gdab ste/ bla ma'i gnas ba'i las 'od 'phros/ lha mo bzhi la phog thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul/ gang 'dod mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar bsam/ snying po bzla/slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ brtan g.yos bsdus pa'i snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul bas 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i tshul du phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang du thim/ de nyid 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa yang lud/ rang gi spyi bo nas lus kyi nang du chi li li song bas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ slar yang rim gyis lus bdud rtsis ngang chil gyis gang / dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag sku bzhi mngon byas par bsams la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la gus pa'i sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/oṃ āḥlha mahā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ dzaḥ de wa ḍakki (1 gi ni ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng sa ma ya dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ zhes ma skyo bar du bzlas shing / 'bum phrag sogs rtags thon pa bya'o//lnga pa dbang bzhi len pa ni/ bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi sgo gsum la thim/ bum gsang sher tshig gi dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ slar tshogs zhing thams cad 'od du zhu nas bla ma la thim/ bla ma yang rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med gcig tu gyur par bsams la/ rang sems spros bral gdod ma'i dbyings su ci gnas bar mnyam par gzhag pa ni don dam rang zhal bla ma'i ngo bo mthong ba yin no// yang las bzhi'i las tshogs kyi dmigs

266 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabasal dgos pa byung na phyi sgrub ltar nyams 'og tu chud par byed do// des ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams rdzogs so//gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi khog phub pa/ rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam gyi 'gro tshul lto sbyar nas bshad pa/ cho ga dngos la 'jug pa'o//dang po ni/ bsnyen pa'i yi ger brjod pas der shes shing / gnyis pa ni/ rgyu'i theg pa dang chos mtshungs par dang po thugs bskyed pa nas grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / mthar sangs rgyas pa'i bar lam myur bul dbang gis bzhag pa ste/ de la 'bras bu theg pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs kyi skabs ltar na/ sgrub thabs kyi thog ma skyabs sems ni dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang chos mtshungs/ yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal sogs ni/bar du grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa dang chos mtshungs/ bgegs 'dul ba ni srod la bdud btul ba dang mtshungs ldan/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni ma dag pa'i snod 'og min du byin gyis brlabs pa/ rim gnyis kyi lam dngos gzhi'i skabs lhar bsgom zhing g.yo ba med pa ni lus dran pa nyer bzhag tshogs drug dkyil 'khor gsum du rol pa ni tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag sems sems byung gi a 'thas zhi ba ni sems dran pa nyer bzhagasnang srid chos nyid du shes pa ni chos dran pa nyer bzhag ste tshogs lam chung ngu /rim bzhin brtan pa thob pas tshogs lam 'bring por 'phos te yang dag spong bzhi bsgrub tshul ni/ rnam rtog nyon mongs mngon zhen rjes su mi 'brang bas/mi dge ba'i chos mi skye ba dang / skyes pa spong ba gnyis 'grub/ bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor dang ma bral bas dge chos ma skyes pa skyes/ skyes pa spel ba gnyis 'grub/ de nas tshogs lam chen po rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi ngang gis 'byung /bskyed rdzogs las skad cig mi yengs par ngan (dran pa/ de la rtse gcig tu

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 267'dun pa/ de'i rnam rol la rtog cing dpyod/ de'i ngo bo sems tha dad med pa klong du gyur pa'i mthus/ rlung sems las rung gi rdzu 'phrul re 'ga' thob/de bzhin du sbyor lam drod rtse gnyis la dbang po lnga 'byung ba dang mthun pa ni/brtan pa cher thob pas las dang po ba'i bcos ma dang mi 'dra ba'i shugs 'byung gi dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran dang ting 'dzin/ shes rab rnams skye/sbyor lam bzod dang chos mchog skabs su/ dbang lnga rkyen gyis mi 'phrog par bskyed rim gsal brtan gyi tshad grangs can rnams thob/ 'phel 'grib skye bri sogs mi 'byung bar stobs su gyur pa las/ dad stobs brtson stobs sogs 'gyur brtsis pa'i stobs lnga rgyud la skyes shing nyin mtshan khor yug mnyam bzhag la brtan pa thob/ lus phyi nang gi srin bu rgyun chad nas sbyor lam du gnas/ de ltar rim gnyis thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i dmigs pa brjed med dran pa/ chos rab 'byed pa'i shes rab/ mngon mtho'i brtson 'grus/ bde stong gnyis med dga' ba/ lus dang chos thams cad mnyam nyid rtogs pa btang snyoms/ de la brten nas sgo gsum gyi nyes skyon sbyangs pas shin sbyangs byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la dbang thob ste/ mthong lam spros bral gyi bden pa mthong nas sa dang po la gnas pas gzungs dang ting 'dzin gyi sgo mang po la dbang 'byor/ de nas yang dag pa'i lta ba rtogs pa sogs rdzogs rim spros bral gtso che ba bsgoms pas 'phags lam brgyad shugs kyis rdzogs te/ sa dgu pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i skabs su gnas ngan len gyi shes sgrib phra mo yod pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis cig car du bcom nas rgyu'i theg pa'i sa mtha' la myur du reg pa lags so// de ltar sa rnams mthar phyin nas mi slob pa'i lam mngon du gyur te/ bzhi lam gyi 'od gsal ro gcig tu gyur nas sngags lam gyi khyad par can rnams bzhi 'bras dbyer med ngang du dag nas bsgrub bya lha dang sgrub byed

268 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagang zag gnyis dbyer med du lhun gyis grub pa ni tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang mtshungs so// 'di dag ni sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi sa lam lto sbyar nas khog yangs por 'byed pa ltar la/'bras bu theg pa rang la dbang bzhi'i 'gros kyis mthar 'tshang rgya bar bshad pa las/ sa bcu lam lnga'i tshul mdo nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin med mod de/khyad par 'di'i lugs la rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa dang sbyar na lus skye 'chi la rang dbang ma thob pa sems lha sku'i rnam par smin pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs sbyor gnyis su rim gnyis goms pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa dang /skye 'chi rang dbang can tshe dbang rig 'dzin sogs rim bzhin thob pa yin no//de bzhin du dbang bskur ba ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba dang mtshungs/ bdud rtsi myang ba sogs sbyang rtsi rol pa dang chos mtshungs/mchod bstod dang sgrub thabs bskul ba/ bzlas pa don gnyis byas 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo brgya 'byed cing spro bsdu sogs ni chos 'khor bskor ba/ mthar dkyil 'khor bsdus te 'od gsal gyi ngang du spyod lam byed pa ni mdzad 'phrin 'khor ba ma stongs bar du rgyun mi chad par 'gro don byed pa dang chos mtshungs pa'o// de ltar mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i sa lam gyi bgrod tshul 'di dag nges par bya ba gces so//gsum pa cho ga dngos la 'jug pa ni/ gzhi bgegs la gtor ma bsngo ba/srung 'khor bsgom pa/ bshags pa/ byin 'bebs/ phyi nang gi mchod pa brlabs pa dang lnga las/dang po gnyis go bde la/ gnyis pa srung 'khor ni/ rang gi sems nyid spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i rang byung ye shes de nyid ma rig dug lnga'i log rtog la khros te 'dre 'dzin 'khrul snang gi tshogs brgyad kyi rtog tshogs thams cad bde chen skye med klong du rang sar grol ba ni don dam pa'i mtshams

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zabasonyamasasulenapa'itshul/ — 269gcod de/ hūṃ hrī/ rang byung ye shes khro bo'i rgyal sogs/ kun rdzob tsam du ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs rdo rje sogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams kyis bar mtshams med par gtams pas 'jigs rung sra brtan gyi gur du gyur par bsam mo//gsum pa bshags pa ni/ slar yang rtsa gsum lha tshogs skad cig gis gsal te/ bshags yul rten gyi stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas dgongs gsol dang bcas bdag gzhan rnams kyis thog med nas da lta la thug gi bar du sgo gsum mi dge ba spyi dang / khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas mahā yo ga dang lung a nu'i dam tshig spyi dang 'gal ba'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sogs dang / lhag tu thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid kyi khyad chos la'ang phyi nang gsang gsum ste/ dang po slob dpon la sangs rgyas kyi blo ma bzhag pa sogs drug dang / sman brgyud rig 'dzin rnams bka' srung du ma bzung ba'i gzung bya gnyis dang / sman rnams dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu ltar ma shes pa gsum sogs dang 'gal ba dang / gnyis pa nang gi rtsa ba sku gsung thugs gsum las/ sku'i dam tshig tu slob dpon dang / mched lcam la brdeg 'tshog dang / rku 'phrog brnyas sems/ skur pa 'debs pa/ thugs dang 'gal ba rnams ma bsrungs pa dang / gsung gi dam tshig yi dam lha'i bskyed rim/bzlas brjod ting 'dzin gsum dang bral ba dang / thugs kyi dam tshig sgrub rdzas rnams ma gsang ba/ sbyor sgrol ma gsang ba/ sman raka /rag dang mchod rdzas ma gsang ba/ snying po phyag rgya/ mdzad 'phrin man ngag rnams ma gsang ba sogs mdor na bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su 'dus pa yin pas ci nas bsrung / 'gal ba'i rigs byung na rdo rje'i dmyal ba las 'os med pas/ de lta bu'i las rnams dran pa gal che/ gzhan yang gnyer du gtad pa bla ma dang mched kyi man ngag dang sbyor sgrol sogs gsang dgos pa gnyer gtad las

270 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thiga'agal ba dang / de'i yan lag nyer lnga ste/ phung po 'byung ba lnga/ yul lnga/dbang po lnga/ ye shes lnga rnams rigs lnga yab yum du shes par bya ba lnga/ bde chen ye shes ngos zin pa'i ngang nas sbyor ba/ sgrol ba/ ma byin pa len pa/brdzun/ tshig brlangs (brlang lnga po 'gro ba'i don la spyod dgos pas spyad par bya ba lnga/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog ste rigs lnga'i rang bzhin rtogs dgos pas mi spong ba lnga/ rdo rje/ rin chen/padma/ las te le lo med pas bsgrub par bya ba lnga/ dri chen/ dri chu/ dmar chen/ byang sems dkar po/ padma rakta lnga 'dzin rtog med pas dwang /dang du blangs nas spyod dgos pa ste yan lag nyer lnga dang / gsang ba'i med dang /gcig pu phyal ba sogs tshul bzhin du ma bsrungs pa'i nyes ltung thams cad snying nas bshags la/ srung 'khor nang gi mdun gyi bar snang sogs lan gsum gyi bar brjod/ ma bshags na nyams chag ni dngos grub kyi gegs chen po yin pas yang yang du gnad dang ldan pas 'bad/ kha tsam tshig tsam brjod pas ni dag pa ma yin la/ gnad dang ldan na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag tu thob pa'o/bzhi pa byin 'bebs ni/ 'og min sogs zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa thams cad rtsa gsum sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa bdag dang gnas khang mchod rdzas rnams la thim pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ 〉ཿ bde chen 'gyur med chos sku'i klong yangs sogs dang / rtsa sngags yang yang du bzla'o//lnga pa phyi nang mchod rdzas brlab pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs 'phrin las kyi yi ge oṃ āḥlha hrī bzhis rim pa bzhin brlabs pa las/ 'di gzhan dang cung mi 'dra ba nang mchod sman raka khurag gtor gsum dang po brlabs nas rjes su phyi mchod brlab pa 'dug kyang 'gal ba med la/ dang po stegs

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 271gtsang ma'i khar pho thod tshad ldan bharnyi dum bu gcig pa bshams la/ rab tu chang gtsang ma la sel med kyi bdud rtsi btab/ tha na'ang bdud rtsi'i rigs sman dang / sbrang rtsi sogs ro bcud ldan pa g.yas su bshams la/ dar dmar brgyad ltebs kyis zhal khebs byed pa'am/ yang na me long gis bkab kyang rung / spyi khyab nyer bsdus la zhal khebs bsal zhing rlung me thod sgyed gsum gyi steng du āḥlas thod pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir oṃ 'od 'bar ba rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon rnams kyis mtshan pa'i sha lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga las skad cig gis rig sa lnga yab yum du gyur pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags lhag par rgyas pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun nar re babs pas bde skyong gi snod du bdud rtsi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par 'dres pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la yi yig dkar po 'od 'bar sogs brjod/ sngags don/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ni sman dang bcud thams cad bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin dang / ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ hūṃ gis dbyings nas bsdus/ hrīs 'dzad med du spel/ ṭhas ci 'dod du longs spyod pa'i rgyan du byas pa'o// dag dran de'i ngang las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pa mtheb srin g.yas g.yon gyis blangs la res mos su gtor bas dri ma dag par bsam/ sor mo rnams la bdud rtsi'i thig le byas la/ g.yas sor lnga yab lnga/ g.yon sor lnga yum lngar bsams la/ pad kor thal sbyar bcas ka pā li'i steng du 'geb cing / sngags bdun nas nyer gcig bar gang 'os brjod pas/ la ga sor rigs lnga bcu po rjes chags kyis 'od du zhu nas thod pa'i rigs lnga la thim/ bde stong ngang nas de rnams 'od du zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa skyong ba'i bcud du bsam zhing khebs g.yogs la bsgul bskyod med par bzhag go/ ci

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 271gtsang ma'i khar pho thod tshad ldan bharnyi dum bu gcig pa bshams la/ rab tu chang gtsang ma la sel med kyi bdud rtsi btab/ tha na'ang bdud rtsi'i rigs sman dang / sbrang rtsi sogs ro bcud ldan pa g.yas su bshams la/ dar dmar brgyad ltebs kyis zhal khebs byed pa'am/ yang na me long gis bkab kyang rung / spyi khyab nyer bsdus la zhal khebs bsal zhing rlung me thod sgyed gsum gyi steng du āḥlas thod pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir oṃ 'od 'bar ba rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon rnams kyis mtshan pa'i sha lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga las skad cig gis rig sa lnga yab yum du gyur pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags lhag par rgyas pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun nar re babs pas bde skyong gi snod du bdud rtsi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par 'dres pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la yi yig dkar po 'od 'bar sogs brjod/ sngags don/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ni sman dang bcud thams cad bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin dang / ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ hūṃ gis dbyings nas bsdus/ hrīs 'dzad med du spel/ ṭhas ci 'dod du longs spyod pa'i rgyan du byas pa'o// dag dran de'i ngang las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pa mtheb srin g.yas g.yon gyis blangs la res mos su gtor bas dri ma dag par bsam/ sor mo rnams la bdud rtsi'i thig le byas la/ g.yas sor lnga yab lnga/ g.yon sor lnga yum lngar bsams la/ pad kor thal sbyar bcas ka pā li'i steng du 'geb cing / sngags bdun nas nyer gcig bar gang 'os brjod pas/ la ga sor rigs lnga bcu po rjes chags kyis 'od du zhu nas thod pa'i rigs lnga la thim/ bde stong ngang nas de rnams 'od du zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa skyong ba'i bcud du bsam zhing khebs g.yogs la bsgul bskyod med par bzhag go/ ci

272 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigade nas rakta brlab pa ni/ mo thod tshad ldan du mtshal rtsi dmar po rgya skyegs sogs dmar po'i rigs dang / mū la rakta so lnga sel med gtsang ma btab la gtor ma'i g.yon du bshams/ zhal khebs bdud rtsi dang 'dra bas bkab pa bsal la/ bhadha'i nang du padma dmar po kha gyes pa'i dbus su āḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar ba las lha mo girti ma dmar mo lang tsho rgyas pa/khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams can gri thod bsnams pa gcer mo rin po che dang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing / zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bzhugs pa'i thugs kur nyi dkyil la ra (ro yig dmar po'i mthar/ rma āḥmai mahā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūṃ hrī ṭha/ zhes pas bskor ba gsal btab cing /āḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar sogs brjod la/ khams gsum thams cad skye med rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings su bsgral bas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs thams cad 'joms pa'i raktar gyur par bsams la/sngags bdun sogs gong ltar brjod/ sngags don/ mahā rakta ni khrag chen/dzwa la ni 'bar ba ste/ don 'gyur ni rjes chags bde ba chen po 'bar ba'i don dang / maṇḍa'/ ni dkyil 'khor te bde chen bha ga'i dkyil 'khor dang /sngags phreng 'od kyis hūṃ zhes pas dbyings kyi ngang nas dwangs ma'i bcud thams cad bsdus/ hrī zhes pa'i ngang la khyab par byas/ ṭha zhes dbyer med du bsres te/ lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul/ bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can skyes pa'i rkyen gyis sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ bha ga rab tu rgyas pa'i sbubs nas byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rakta'i rgyun dmar chi li li babs te ka pā li'i rakta dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug cing / mi ro rta ro lang long byed pa'i dbus su lbu ba dmar po ri rab lta bu 'phyo bar bsam/ lha mo des 'gro la snying rje chen pos chags pa shin tu rgyas pa'i ngang nas zhal gzar gyis rakta 'phyar zhing / mthar lha mo 'od du zhu nas

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 273kun rdzob kyi rakta dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la zhal khebs g.yogs par bya/ gtor ma brlabs pa ni/ gtor rgyu phye phud zhib dkar la dkar gsum mngar gsum chos sman sogs bsres te mthong brgyud ltar ma ning thod par bshams la/ de yang phyi mchod zhal zas dang / dkar gtor rnams la dkar gsum mngar gsum las sha chang sgog btsong tshwa sogs ma 'dres par byas te rin po che'i snod du bsham/ rtsa gsum gtor ma bhan ca'am/gang rung du bshams te sman raka /rag bar du bkod/ dmigs pa ni/gtor ma de nyid rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs skye med dbyings kyi klong du bde chen ye shes kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig mthing kha 'od 'bar ba zhig tu bsgoms te 'od du zhu nas gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs 'dod yon drug gi rnam par gyur pa la sngags brjod pa dang / de las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi zag med bde ba chen po la sogs te 'khor 'das kyi bza' bca' btung ba'i ro bcud thams cad bsdus te gtor ma la thim par bsams la/ hūṃ yig mthing kha 'od 'bar ba sogs brjod mthar sngags lan bdun gsum sogs brjod/ sngags don/ mahā bha (bkalidha ni gtor ma chen po/ te dzwa bha (ba lidha ni thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i rtsal snang gi gtor ma/ bha la bha te ni de nyid dbyer med ro gcig tu sbyor ba'i don dang /gu hya ni gsang ba byung tshor gyi rtog pa thams cad dbyings khyab gdal chen po'i klong du gyur pa'i don/ sa mā ya ni dam tshig nyams chag gi rtog sgrib thams cad dbyings su bskang ba'i don/ hūṃ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs zhes pa'o// 'di nyid pha rgyud mahā yo ga ltar dang / gzhan du ma rgyud a nu yo ga'i lugs ltar na/rdzogs rim gtsor bstan gyi snod bcud gtor ma'i rang bzhin du brlabs te/ye shes thig le las/ bha yi yig 'bru bha gar brjod// ling ga'i yig 'bru ling gar bstan// zhes pa'i dag sbyor ni phyi ltar du dbang po gnyis sbyor thabs

274 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigashes dang / nang ltar byang sems dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phro/ gsang ba ltar bde stong gnyis med ye shes kyi rnam rol chen po las snang srid snod bcud thams cad gtor ma'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa las/ dngos 'byor tsam la mngon zhen byas na gar yang mi phyin no// des na yo ga rnam gnyis gang yin kyang dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dang gtor ma'i de nyid shes pa ni gal che dam pa'o// de nas phyi nang gsang ba byings gcig tu bsdus nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs gsum ro gcig gi ngo bo hrīḥyig kha dog lnga ldan las rin po che sogs snod sna tshogs su rang gi ming yig rnams las yon chab sogs phyi mchod lnga dang / 'dod yon lnga dang / sha khrag rus pa byang chub kyi sems sogs 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar dmigs pa'o// de yang mtshan ma dang dngos por 'dzin pa rnams mnyam nyid lta ba'i ngang nas thugs srog oṃ āḥ: gsum spros pas/ oṃ gyis mang por spel/ āḥs dngos 'dzin sbyangs/ hūṃ gis gang 'dod nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du bsgyur nas blos ma reg pa'i rnam par dag pa'i ye shes chen por rol pas/ oṃ āḥ: brjod pa de'i rnam rol rgyal ba'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i dag pa'o// 〉ཿyig 'od lnga rab gsal sogs brjod/ sngags don arbhe sogs ni go sla la/ mahā paṃ sa sogs sha chen/ rus chen/ khrag byang chub kyi sems dang / bde ba chen po gsang ba'i tshogs mchod ces so//gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa la gnyis/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang /tshogs dngos la 'jug pa'o//dang po ni/ thabs shes rdzas kyi yo byad bza' bca'i rigs rab brgya rtsa/'bring lnga bcu/ tha ma bcu'am bdun/ yang tha rdzas gzhan rnams mang nyung ji ltar yang / gtso bo sha chang mtshon pa re med du mi rung ste/ dgongs gter

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 275las/ khyad par sha chang med mi rung // zhes dang / mchod tsam /rtsam yang bag rdul med pa'i zhib dkar gtsang zhing yid du 'thad pa la dkar gsum mngar gsum sman sna tshogs kyis sbags pa bcas mdor na 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i 'dod yon tshogs tshad khral chos su ma song ba'i bsam sbyor yang dag par bya la/ spyir tshogs 'khor mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig bya ba la gnas dus yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos pas/ de dag rgyas par 'dod na kho bos byas pa'i tshogs kyi rnam bshad du blta /lta bar rigs so//gnyis pa tshogs dngos kyi rim pa la rnam grangs bco lnga ste/ dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ skad cig gis gtso bo'i nga rgyal la gnas te/ tshogs la las bum chu dang / nang mchod 'thor /gtor te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs brjod la/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ku'i sa bon las// sogs brjod pas mtshan ma'i rdzas rnams la dme yugs dang nyams grib 'bags btsog sogs glo bur du sbags pa rnams ye shes kyi yi ge ram̐ yo khaṃ gsum las 'phros pa'i me rlung chu gsum gyis bsreg gtor bkru bar bya ste/ ram̐ las ye shes kyi me byung bas tshogs dngos por 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma bsregs/ yam̐ las lhag mthong rlung byung bas tshogs gzung 'dzin gyi bags chag skyobag chags gtor/ khaṃ las zhi gnas chu byung bas gnyis 'dzin gyis dri ma thams cad bkrus pas stong par gyur/ de'i ngang las āḥyig yongs su gyur pa las snod ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du bcud dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa'i sprin 'phro ba dang /'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon gyi bcud thams cad bdag gi thugs ku'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bsdus nas tshogs la thim par bsams la/ de'i steng du 'bru gsum brtsegs mar gnas pa las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin
