276 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigarlabs thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs te yi ge gsum la thim pas/yi ge gsum nas pa mchog tu 'bar te 'od du zhu nas tshogs rdzas la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par gyur pa'i rlangs pa las 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo rnams kyis me long (sna tshogs )thogs pa/ sgra'i lha mo ser mo rnams kyis rol mo sna tshogs thogs pa/ dri'i lha mo ljang khu rnams kyis bdug spos sna tshogs thogs pa/ ro'i lha mo dmar mo rnams kyis zhal zas sna tshogs thogs pa/reg bya'i lha mo dmar mo rnams kyis na bza' sna tshogs thogs pa/ chos kyi lha mo mthing kha rnams kyis rdor dril dang chos 'byung sna tshogs thogs pa/ bye brag tu phyi nang gi sgeg sogs bcu drug la sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa de dag kyang gar dang / rnam 'gyur du mas phyag na thod pa dang 'jig rten na mi 'byung ba'i rin po che du ma'i gzhong pa rnams su bza' bca' btung ba'i ro bcud phun sum tshogs pas bkang ste phul ba phyi mchod/ dbang po rnam pa lnga la sogs pa nang gi tshogs mchod/ bde stong zag med ye shes kyi glu dang bcas pa gsang ba'i mchod pa/ rig stong khyab gdal chen po spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yang gsang ba bla na med pa'i mchod pa dang / gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi longs spyod 'khor los sgyur ba'i mnga' dbang rgyal srid sna bdun/bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sogs rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa'i gter chen pos sprin phung gtibs par bsams la/ sngags brjod/ sngags don ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo chen po thams cad bzang po ste kun tu bzang po'i yon la 'gran pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas 'og min chos kyi dbyings dang / shar phyogs lta na sdug pa'i zhing khams sogs phyogs dus rgyal

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 277ba rab 'byams ma lus pa thams cad rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i lha chogs rnams kyi rnam par bdag cag sems can thams cad la thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs te/ bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi zhing dam pa rnams tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes pa'i slad du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ sa mā ya dzaḥzhes sngon gyi dam tshig gi slad du byon par bsams la/ hūṃ hrīḥrigs 'dus/ rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams// sogs brjod/gsum pa bskang ba ni/ sman dka (rag gtor gsum dang spyi bskang ru thung bzhi rnams btang / 'dir gsol kha med kyang snga 'gyur lugs ltar na dgos sam snyam hūṃ hrīḥbaskang ngo gsol lo sogs mdangs bskang rdzogs pa dang /bzhi pa tshogs 'bul ba ni/ las rdor gyis slob dpon la phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ lag g.yas thabs kyi rdzas bza' ba tshogs dang tshogs rdzas kyi phud ci 'dzom dang / g.yon shes rab kyi rdzas btung ba thogs te mañdzi'i khar dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul la/ dmigs rim ni gong gi 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyis 'dod yon tshogs mchod dpag tu med pa thogs te dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du phul bas/ ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rigs su gyur pa ma tshang ba med pa'i tshogs kyi mchod yul dam pa rnams mnyes shing skyes lan gyi tshul du byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol bar bsams la/ hūṃ hrīḥngo bo zag med bdud rtsi la sogs brjod/ mjug tu ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza ho/ zhes ga ṇa ni thabs shes zung 'jug gi tshogs dang / tsakra ni 'khor lo ste bde stong zung 'jug ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyon mongs pa'i 'ching thag gam dra ba gcod par mtshon pa dang / sarba ni thams cad ces phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i mchod pa dang / tho/kyi dza ho ni bzhes shig pa'o//

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 277ba rab 'byams ma lus pa thams cad rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i lha chogs rnams kyi rnam par bdag cag sems can thams cad la thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs te/ bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi zhing dam pa rnams tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes pa'i slad du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ sa mā ya dzaḥzhes sngon gyi dam tshig gi slad du byon par bsams la/ hūṃ hrīḥrigs 'dus/ rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams// sogs brjod/gsum pa bskang ba ni/ sman dka (rag gtor gsum dang spyi bskang ru thung bzhi rnams btang / 'dir gsol kha med kyang snga 'gyur lugs ltar na dgos sam snyam hūṃ hrīḥbaskang ngo gsol lo sogs mdangs bskang rdzogs pa dang /bzhi pa tshogs 'bul ba ni/ las rdor gyis slob dpon la phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ lag g.yas thabs kyi rdzas bza' ba tshogs dang tshogs rdzas kyi phud ci 'dzom dang / g.yon shes rab kyi rdzas btung ba thogs te mañdzi'i khar dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul la/ dmigs rim ni gong gi 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyis 'dod yon tshogs mchod dpag tu med pa thogs te dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du phul bas/ ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rigs su gyur pa ma tshang ba med pa'i tshogs kyi mchod yul dam pa rnams mnyes shing skyes lan gyi tshul du byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol bar bsams la/ hūṃ hrīḥngo bo zag med bdud rtsi la sogs brjod/ mjug tu ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza ho/ zhes ga ṇa ni thabs shes zung 'jug gi tshogs dang / tsakra ni 'khor lo ste bde stong zung 'jug ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyon mongs pa'i 'ching thag gam dra ba gcod par mtshon pa dang / sarba ni thams cad ces phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i mchod pa dang / tho/kyi dza ho ni bzhes shig pa'o//

278 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigalnga pa bshags pa ni/ don dam nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings la glo bur kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i sdig sgrib thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar du nyon mongs pa dug lnga dbang che zhing / shes rab zhan cing / gti mug pa'i dbang gis phyi so thar/ nang byang sems/ gsang ba gsang sngags zab mo'i lta dgongs dang sgrub pa lta spyod ya bral du gyur te gzhung bzhin du ma spyod pa dang /khyad par gso ba rig pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams khas blangs dam bcas pa las 'gal 'khrul nongs pa dang / le lo snyom las chod yod kyi dbang du gyur pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa lo zlar 'gyangs pa dang / dus kyi mchod pa chag pa sogs mdor na rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dang 'gal 'khru shā/ nyams chag tu gyur to cog rnams mi dbang po che la yus kyis zhus pa ltar rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi drung du stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa byas te/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar sogs dang /yig brgya brjod la tshogs gong bzhin 'bul/drug pa bsgral ba la don dgu ste/ bsgral bya'i yul dang / sgrol byed rnal 'byor pa/ ji ltar bsgral ba/ sgrol ba'i tshad/ tshe lung / khrus lung /gnas lung / 'tshengs pa/ bstab pa'o// de la mchog phran nya bo zhes bca' las byas pa'i liṅgā 'khor ba ru log gi rten 'brel du mgo bo lho nub phyogs dang / rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bstan te gan rkyal du bzhag yang na 'khor ba la rgyab phyogs pa'i rten 'brel du mgo bo rgyab dang / myang 'das la mdun phyogs pa'i rten 'brel du gdong pa rang la bstan pa gang bde bya/ bla srog skad cig la chags pa'i rten 'brel du 'khor ba'i rgyu rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rtsa ba rakta bran/ zan ling med na tshogs zan dang / sha dum la de ltar dmigs la/ dang po bsgral bya'i yul ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 279la bdo ba/ rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra/ mched lcam gyi spyi dgra sogs zhing bcu tshang ba'o// zhing bcu 'di la ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ba 'ga' re yod kyang / skabs thob dmigs bsal gyi rnam dbye'o//gnyis pa sgrol byed ni/ rnal 'byor pa lta ba rtogs la snying rje che ba/spyod pa zhib cing btsun pa/ sgrub pa la drod rtags thob pa/ bskyed rim la yul gsum gyad du gyur cing / srog sdom gzer bzhis thebs pa'i drod rtags thon pa/ rang 'dod med cing blo khog yangs la gzu bor gnas pa/ kun rdzob byang sems dang ldan pa las gzhan du ma yin no//gsum pa ji ltar bsgral ba ni/ rtogs pas gzung 'dzin dang bdag nang du bsgral te/ thugs rje'i byang sems kyis log pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i gnas ngan de rjes su bzung ba'i thugs rje'i ngang gas bsgral ba'o//bzhi pa sgrol ba'i tshad ni/ de la rang gi mdun du e las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i khang sgrom 'byung ba dgra gshed 'thab pa'i nang du tstsha dang tri las gnod byed dgra bgegs gang yin pa de shin tu nyam thag cing / yan lag bzhi lcags sgrog gis bsdams par bskyed la/ rdor dril phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs sngags dang phyag rgya dang / zhes sogs kyis dgugs pas rū pa dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam mo// de nas lta ba'i gdeng gis zin pa stong nyid gyad kyi lha/ bskyed rim ngar dang ldan pa gnyen po ye shes kyi lha/ zung 'jug pho nyar 'gyed pa spyod pa las kyi lha ste lta sgom spyod pa gsum gyi rdzong 'phrang srog gsum dang ldan pa ci nas gal che la/ de ltar lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rgyab brten dang thun mong ma yin pa'i tshad med bzhi'i dag sbyor ni/ rang bzhin gyis sgrol ba'i lta ba/ snying rjes sgrol ba'i sgom pa/dbang po yul dus kyis sgrol ba'i spyod pa'o// de la snying rje khros pas gdug pa can rjes su 'dzin pa'i byams pa/ brtse bas myur du sgrol ba'i snying rje/ shes

280 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigapa spar zhing phung po tshogs su bstab pa'i dga' ba/ gdul bya yal bar mi 'dor ba'i btang snyoms te las 'di dag sngags pa'i tshad med bzhi'o// rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi gzhi 'dzin la'ang / lta ba blo 'das kyi rdzong / sgom pa yengs med kyi 'phrang / spyod pa nges med kyi srog gsum ste/ gzhi 'dzin pas so// gzhan yang gnad don bsdu na yul gsum gsal ba/ dgra gsum bsad pa/ bdud bzhi sgrol ba/ 'phrang gsum bsal ba ste/ drag sngags so lnga pa bzla bzhin par phur bskor bya zhing sgril la/ lta ba'i gdeng bskyed la mnyam gzhag (bzhag chos sku'i ngang du rtogs pas bsgral la/ rjes thob snying rje chen po'i thugs rjes gzhan sgrol ba'ang gsang ba bla na med pa'i dgongs pa ste/ de la'ang mi 'byams pa'i ched du phyi'i yul snang rū trar gsal ba/ mi sdug pa'i ched du nang yul phur pa rta mgrin du gsal ba/ mi ldog pa'i ched du gsang ba'i yul rnam rtog lha'i nga rgyal du gsal ba ste thun mong ma yin pa'i yul gsum gsal ba'i ngang nas/ phyi dgra gzung 'dzin gyi dgra bgegs tshad med snying rje'i phur pas sprul sku'i dbyings su bsad pa/ nang dgra dug gsum gyi ngo bo byang chub sems kyi phur pas longs sku'i dbyings su bsad pa/ gsang dgra bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rig pa ye shes kyi phur pas chos sku'i dbyings su bsad pa/ de'i tshe na phung po dur khrod du bsgral bas lnga phung dbyings su zhig ste reg bya phung po'i bdud bcom/ yum gyi mkha' la bsgral bas chags rtog ye shes su dag ste nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ rdor sems mtshan rdzogs kyi sa la bsgral bas snang cha lhar skur grol te lha bu'i bdud bcom/ rnam shes 'og min du bsgral bas skye shi'i khungs stor te 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ lta ba phyogs ris med pas the tshom gyi 'phrang las grol ba/ sgom pa gsang bzhag med pas bying rgod kyi 'phrang las grol ba/ spyod pa gza' gtad med pas tshul 'chos kyi 'phrang las grol ba ste/ de lta bu'i gshis lugs mngon du gyur pa de

280 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigapa spar zhing phung po tshogs su bstab pa'i dga' ba/ gdul bya yal bar mi 'dor ba'i btang snyoms te las 'di dag sngags pa'i tshad med bzhi'o// rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi gzhi 'dzin la'ang / lta ba blo 'das kyi rdzong / sgom pa yengs med kyi 'phrang / spyod pa nges med kyi srog gsum ste/ gzhi 'dzin pas so// gzhan yang gnad don bsdu na yul gsum gsal ba/ dgra gsum bsad pa/ bdud bzhi sgrol ba/ 'phrang gsum bsal ba ste/ drag sngags so lnga pa bzla bzhin par phur bskor bya zhing sgril la/ lta ba'i gdeng bskyed la mnyam gzhag (bzhag chos sku'i ngang du rtogs pas bsgral la/ rjes thob snying rje chen po'i thugs rjes gzhan sgrol ba'ang gsang ba bla na med pa'i dgongs pa ste/ de la'ang mi 'byams pa'i ched du phyi'i yul snang rū trar gsal ba/ mi sdug pa'i ched du nang yul phur pa rta mgrin du gsal ba/ mi ldog pa'i ched du gsang ba'i yul rnam rtog lha'i nga rgyal du gsal ba ste thun mong ma yin pa'i yul gsum gsal ba'i ngang nas/ phyi dgra gzung 'dzin gyi dgra bgegs tshad med snying rje'i phur pas sprul sku'i dbyings su bsad pa/ nang dgra dug gsum gyi ngo bo byang chub sems kyi phur pas longs sku'i dbyings su bsad pa/ gsang dgra bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rig pa ye shes kyi phur pas chos sku'i dbyings su bsad pa/ de'i tshe na phung po dur khrod du bsgral bas lnga phung dbyings su zhig ste reg bya phung po'i bdud bcom/ yum gyi mkha' la bsgral bas chags rtog ye shes su dag ste nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ rdor sems mtshan rdzogs kyi sa la bsgral bas snang cha lhar skur grol te lha bu'i bdud bcom/ rnam shes 'og min du bsgral bas skye shi'i khungs stor te 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ lta ba phyogs ris med pas the tshom gyi 'phrang las grol ba/ sgom pa gsang bzhag med pas bying rgod kyi 'phrang las grol ba/ spyod pa gza' gtad med pas tshul 'chos kyi 'phrang las grol ba ste/ de lta bu'i gshis lugs mngon du gyur pa de

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 281bsgral ba thams cad kyi rgyal po yin no// phur pa'i rnam dbye ni/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa gsum dang ldan dgos pas/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ log lta rnams la snying rje skye ba/ gnyis med sgrol ba'i snying rje bsgom pa/ de ni snying po'i phur pa ste gsungs pas/ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo thabs kyis ma bsgral na las ngan tshabs chen bsags nas ngan song du ltung ste mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal drag la yun ring du myong dgos pa la snying rje'i bsam pas bsgral te las ngan bcom pa'i kun slong dang ldan dgos pa'o// gnyis pa de nyid las/ rang nyid lhar gsal phyag g.yas g.yon// rigs lnga khrag 'thung yab yum bskyed// phur pa byang chub sems su 'dres// 'di ni byang sems phur pa yin// gsungs pas/bsgral bya sgror /sgrol byed kyi nga bdag gdod nas dag pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i rang nyid ltar gsal ba'i phyag gnyis rigs lnga yab yum du mos nas skye 'gag gnyis med lhun grub snying rje'i phur pa 'dril ba yin te/ man ngag snying gzer nag po las/ skye med byang la 'gag med chub// gnyis su med pa'i sems zhes bya// zhes pa'i don la dgongs pa'o// gsum pa'ang de nyid las/ phur pa de la yungs kur dril// gu gul bdug cing dug khrag byug/ 'bar ba me yi gdan la bzhugs// mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa yin// zhes pas phur par byug bdug brabs gsum gyis gzi byin bskyed cing rno ngar me'i tsha tsha 'phro bar bsams nas lag tu thogs pa'o//lnga pa tshe lung ni/ dgongs pa gsum gyis tshar gcod pa la gsum/ tshe khrus gnas lung gi dgongs pa las/ phur pa rta mgrin du gsal ba'i sor mo bcu po rigs lnga yab yum lngar bskyed pa'i bar du bsgril ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi mthu stobs nus pa bsdus nas phur pa la thim/rigs lnga yab yum bcu po thabs shes sbyor bas byang sems dkar dmar

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 281bsgral ba thams cad kyi rgyal po yin no// phur pa'i rnam dbye ni/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa gsum dang ldan dgos pas/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ log lta rnams la snying rje skye ba/ gnyis med sgrol ba'i snying rje bsgom pa/ de ni snying po'i phur pa ste gsungs pas/ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo thabs kyis ma bsgral na las ngan tshabs chen bsags nas ngan song du ltung ste mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal drag la yun ring du myong dgos pa la snying rje'i bsam pas bsgral te las ngan bcom pa'i kun slong dang ldan dgos pa'o// gnyis pa de nyid las/ rang nyid lhar gsal phyag g.yas g.yon// rigs lnga khrag 'thung yab yum bskyed// phur pa byang chub sems su 'dres// 'di ni byang sems phur pa yin// gsungs pas/bsgral bya sgror /sgrol byed kyi nga bdag gdod nas dag pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i rang nyid ltar gsal ba'i phyag gnyis rigs lnga yab yum du mos nas skye 'gag gnyis med lhun grub snying rje'i phur pa 'dril ba yin te/ man ngag snying gzer nag po las/ skye med byang la 'gag med chub// gnyis su med pa'i sems zhes bya// zhes pa'i don la dgongs pa'o// gsum pa'ang de nyid las/ phur pa de la yungs kur dril// gu gul bdug cing dug khrag byug/ 'bar ba me yi gdan la bzhugs// mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa yin// zhes pas phur par byug bdug brabs gsum gyis gzi byin bskyed cing rno ngar me'i tsha tsha 'phro bar bsams nas lag tu thogs pa'o//lnga pa tshe lung ni/ dgongs pa gsum gyis tshar gcod pa la gsum/ tshe khrus gnas lung gi dgongs pa las/ phur pa rta mgrin du gsal ba'i sor mo bcu po rigs lnga yab yum lngar bskyed pa'i bar du bsgril ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi mthu stobs nus pa bsdus nas phur pa la thim/rigs lnga yab yum bcu po thabs shes sbyor bas byang sems dkar dmar

282 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig 'dres pa phur pa'i spyi bo oṃ la thim/ de nas rim par āḥdang hūṃ la thim pas lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros nas dgra bgegs kyi bla srog ṣṭṛ yig ljang khu dbugs dang 'grogs te phur pa'i hūṃ las rim par āḥdang oṃ la thim par bsams la/ bla gnas rgyu ba'i gnas sogs dang dbang po rnams la gdab cing snying khar bsnun/ phur pa bteg la rang gi thugs la bsnun pas thugs srog dang 'dres te tshe bsring zhing / rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur te 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i srog thob par bsam pa ni/dgra bo'i tshe rang la bsdus pas tshe lung zhes so/ /drug pa khrus lung ni/ slar yang phur pa'i rigs lnga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas gzas po'i las ngan gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa kun gzhi'i nyon yid ṣṭṛ yig gi rnam pa rakta'i dwangs ma gnas pa'i dkyil du phur pa bsgril bas nag thum mer song nas dran pa nyams/ las nyon bag chags thams cad cod nas chad de/ rnam par shes pa sku gsum du 'phos par bsam pa ni khrus lung ngo //bdun pa gnas lung ni/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin ā yig dkar por gsal ba phur pa'i khong gseng nas brgyud de/ spyi bor 'og min bde ba chen po'i pho brang du dpal chen rta mchog rol ba'i zhal du spar bas ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur nas/ chos kyi dbyings su sgrol bas skye ba med pa'i ngang du gnas par bsams la/ hūṃ/ khro rgyal rta mgrin khrag 'thung te ru ka/ sogs brjod pa dang / phur rtse nam mkhar gdeng la gong ltar dmigs nas phaṭa sgra dang bcas spar zhing dgra bo'i gzhi dus kyi rnam shes dug lngas sbags pa de nyid 'bras dus sku gsum rang bzhin du gnas 'gyur ba ni bsgral ba'o// spyir dgra bgegs zhes pa gang zhig gnod pa byed cing thar pa'i lam gyi mi mthun phyogs lags na/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas 'khor bar yun ring 'phen byed ni

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 283ma rig pa'i las nyon phyi gzung ba'i yul/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems kyis bskyed pa'i nga dang bdag dang nga yir 'dzin pa sogs kyi bdud dgra gang zhig bsgral bya ru shes par byas te/ gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin gnas rig ces ye grol chos sku'i klong du gong gi bdag 'dzin rū tra nyid bsgral ba'i don ma shes na/ lha sngags ting 'dzin gang yang med par rnga rol drag po'i gzi byin 'gran kyang rang nyid ngan song du 'gro ba'i sgo 'byed pa'ang shes par mdzod/ yang cho ga res 'gar phur pa'i rjes su ral gri gshin rjer bskyed nas bsgral ba dang thun gdab sogs mi 'dra tsam 'byung ba'ang rang gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin bya/ ral phur gang ltar ya nga / rngams glog las/ pho ni rkang pa g.yas nas gtubs// mo ni rkang pa g.yon nas gtubs// zhes pa ltar ro//phur pa thebs pa'i tshad dang grub mtha' yang / de nyid las/ phur pa thebs tshad 'bras bu ni// bdag phur 'ben gsum grub mtha' gcig/ thams cad chos dbyings stong par bsgral// rig pa ye shes phur pa de// chos dbyings thebs pas chos kyi sku// tshad med snying rje'i phur pa de// 'gro drus la thebs sprul sku thob// byang chub sems kyi phur pa de// yum mkhar thebs pas longs sku thob// mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa de// dgra bgegs la thebs bstan pa tshugs// zhes so//brgyad pa 'tshengs pa la lnga las/ tshe lung gi dgongs pas rnal 'byor pa'i tshe'i bsnon mar gyur pas 'tshengs pa/ khrus lung gas bsgral bya (byas sgrib pa dag pas dgra bo 'tshengs pa/ gnas lung gis rnam shes sku gsum bde ba chen po dang sbyor bas 'tshengs pa/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzas po'i sha khrag gis 'tshengs pa/ bstan la gnod byed bral bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pas 'tshengs pa dang lnga ste/ 'di dag (gi )gnad don shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas bdag nyid la sgrib pas mi dgos/gos / bsgral bya sdug la mi sbyor

284 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaba'i gsang sngags kyi thabs te/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra zhing bcu tshang ba rnams dang / 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams byang chub sems dpa'i bsgral bya las/ rang mnog dang / rang rgyal gyi ched du chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi bsam sbyor ngan pas mngon spyod rtsom yang / las 'bras kyi gnam thig drang po gzhan du 'khyogs par mi 'gyur te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/rdo rje theg pa la sbyor sgrol gyi lam bstan pa'ang theg pa la la'i khyad chos du mas 'phags pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar sgrol ba la mtshon na rtogs pas bdag sngon du bsgral nas/ de'i rjes thob tu thugs rjes gzhan sgrol ba yin te/ 'on kyang zan la phur pa 'debs tshad kyis sdang zhen gyi nus pa mngon du mi 'byin cing /srogagacod kyi mi dge ba'i bsam pa sbyor pa mthar thug gsum las/ bsam sbyor gnyis tshang ba'i rnam smin myong dgos pa'i phyir ro// des na rang gis rang nyid mi bsru bar gnyen pos zin pa bya dgos zhes gsungs so//dgu pa bstab pa ni/ ling ro rnams las rdor gyis thogs la/ dmigs gnad ni/ rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i nang du za byed bstab pa rdo rje'i gang pho/ padma'i gang mo sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyis sha khrag rus pa bdud rtsi'i rnam pas bhantar bkang ste gar gyi stangs stabs kyis bteg nas bstab par bsams la/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa rnams// zhes sogs brjod la dbul/mthar mchod gral du bzhag dum phran gcig lhag mar bsre'o// de yang phyi ltar stong gsum tsam gyi zhal du khams gsum yongs grol du bstab/ nang ltar rngams /rngam byed 'bar ba'i zhal du dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams bstab/ gsang ba ltar don dam rnam thar gsum gyi zhal du dug lnga dug gsum bstab pas 'gro ba'i las nyon thams cad sangs/ 'khor ba'i gnas stongs nas chos sku skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'o// tshul de lta bu'i bsgral

284 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaba'i gsang sngags kyi thabs te/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra zhing bcu tshang ba rnams dang / 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams byang chub sems dpa'i bsgral bya las/ rang mnog dang / rang rgyal gyi ched du chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi bsam sbyor ngan pas mngon spyod rtsom yang / las 'bras kyi gnam thig drang po gzhan du 'khyogs par mi 'gyur te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/rdo rje theg pa la sbyor sgrol gyi lam bstan pa'ang theg pa la la'i khyad chos du mas 'phags pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar sgrol ba la mtshon na rtogs pas bdag sngon du bsgral nas/ de'i rjes thob tu thugs rjes gzhan sgrol ba yin te/ 'on kyang zan la phur pa 'debs tshad kyis sdang zhen gyi nus pa mngon du mi 'byin cing /srogagacod kyi mi dge ba'i bsam pa sbyor pa mthar thug gsum las/ bsam sbyor gnyis tshang ba'i rnam smin myong dgos pa'i phyir ro// des na rang gis rang nyid mi bsru bar gnyen pos zin pa bya dgos zhes gsungs so//dgu pa bstab pa ni/ ling ro rnams las rdor gyis thogs la/ dmigs gnad ni/ rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i nang du za byed bstab pa rdo rje'i gang pho/ padma'i gang mo sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyis sha khrag rus pa bdud rtsi'i rnam pas bhantar bkang ste gar gyi stangs stabs kyis bteg nas bstab par bsams la/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa rnams// zhes sogs brjod la dbul/mthar mchod gral du bzhag dum phran gcig lhag mar bsre'o// de yang phyi ltar stong gsum tsam gyi zhal du khams gsum yongs grol du bstab/ nang ltar rngams /rngam byed 'bar ba'i zhal du dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams bstab/ gsang ba ltar don dam rnam thar gsum gyi zhal du dug lnga dug gsum bstab pas 'gro ba'i las nyon thams cad sangs/ 'khor ba'i gnas stongs nas chos sku skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'o// tshul de lta bu'i bsgral

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 285mchod kyi rnam bzhag la/ log pa'i 'du shes can kha gcig gis gsar rnying sngags kyi rnam dbye mi shes bzhin du rgyud dang rgya gzhung la bshad med do snyam na'ang / rgyud las/ dmigs bya'i bdud tsi lnga yi zas lnga nya sha bu ram sbrang rtsi til sha'o la/ mtshan ma ming dang bcas par bya/ bkugs nas rdo rje phur bus gdab// rdul du byas nas tshogs su 'bul// zhes tshul 'di dag rang bzo ma yin gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dgongs pa thams cad 'brel ba bzhi bsgrags su bzhed pa ste/ rgyud sgrub thabs dang 'brel/ sgrub thabs chog sgrigs dang 'brel/ chog sgrigs phyag bzhes dang 'brel/ phyag bzhes bla ma brgyud pa'i gdams ngag dang 'brel ba'i don la dpyad par bya'o// de lta na'ang snga phyi kun tu so so'i chog sgrigs dang phyag bzhes kyi rnam pa mang bas/rgyud lung rnam gzhag dang / mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi rjes su 'brangs pa ni yid brtan 'cha' ba'i gnas so//bdun pa gnam phud la sman raka /rag bran nas/ don du gnam phud ces pa mkha' dbyings gsang ba'i lha tshogs la phul bas bden gnyis dbyer med kyi bskang ba ste/ steng thog sogs gtsang sar mchod cing / hoḥsangs rgyas mnga' bdag ston pa dam chos sogs brjod/ da lta phal gyis bla ma rgya mtsho sogs 'don yang gnam phud mchod gsol mi 'dug pa ni chad skyon lags shing / cho ga re zung la med na'ang de'i rjes su mi 'brang ngo //brgyad pa tshogs rol la gnyis/ rdo rje slob dpon la mchod pa/ 'dus pa rgya mtshor 'bul ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ las slob kyis rdo rje rgyal po la 'bul ba dang / slar lan gdab pa'o// dang po pho rkyang mo kyang gi tshogs lta bu ma yin par tshogs 'khor mtshan nyid pas rdo rje'i las ma dang / spyir btang du las slob kyis phyag sngon du 'gro bas bhan dha tshad ldan mā da nas bkang ba pad kor bcas g.yon pas thogs/ g.yas kyis rtse gsum phyag rgya bstan la/slob dpon nyid chos sku kun bzang gi ngo bor mos pas/ las rogs kyis

286 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigathabs rdzas rnams bteg ste/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ sogs gang 'os kyis 'bul/ sngags don ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo chen po'i mchod pa bzhes/ zhes so// gnyis pa slob dpon gyis pad kor bcas pa'i rtse gsum phyag rgyas blangs te/ e ma ngo mtshar sogs sam/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs brjod de lan gdab bo// gsang chen bla med kyi dam rdzas khyad par can la ngo mtshar du bltas te/ a ho mahā su kha/ zhes brjod la/ bskyed rdzogs zung ldan gyi ngang nas mtheb srin gyis ga'us blangs te rol/ sngags (don )ni skye med dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba'o// zhes so// yang na rnam lnga 'dod kor byas la blangs pas kyang rung ngam snyam/ gnyis pa la'ang gnyis/ 'dus pa rnams la 'bul ba dang / lan gdab pa'o// dang po phyag so sor ma grub tshe spyi phyag dang / yon tan can dmigs bsal yod na phyag sgos su 'dud/ gzhan mched thams cad sman rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor du bsams la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol/ zhes pas bskul te/ thabs rdzas g.yas gral nas mgo bzung / sher rdzas g.yon gral nas drangs la 'bul/ gnyis pa lan gdab pa ni/ 'dus tshogs rnams kyis bza' btung gi snang ba de rnams skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar shes pa'i ngang nas/ gu hya sidhi a la la ho/ zhes sngags don gsang ba'i dngos grub bza' bya za byed kyi gnyis 'dzin dang bral ba'i mtha' bral chen po'i tshul du longs spyod pa ngo mtshar ba'i sgra'o// de ltar bza' btung rnams bskyed rdzogs zung ldan gyi ngang nas rol dgos te/ o rgyan chen pos/ bskyed rdzogs dang bral bza' ba za ba rnams// khyi phag zas la spyod dang khyad par med// ces gsungs pas dbang bzhi'i rang lam dang bstun nas longs spyod do// de dang mi ldan pa rnams phung khams skye mched gdan gsum lha'i 'khor lo yin par mos pa byed pa'o// de yang mi nus tshe lha tshogs de dag la mchod pa'i tshul du dmigs nas rol na zas kyi bu lon mi

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 287'byung bar gsungs/ de'i skabs su spang bya sbom po brgyad dang / khyad par du slob dpon chen pos/ de yang tshogs la rngam dang hab sha byed na spyang gir skye/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas tshogs la rol ma shes na yi dwags kyi rigs su skye bar 'gyur zhes gsungs pas/ de la 'du shes gsum ni/ bla ma la ho ru ka yab yum gyi 'du shes/ mched grogs la lha dang lha mo'i 'du shes/tshogs 'khor la dngos grub kyi 'du shes pa'o// mi 'bral ba rnam gsum ste/lus yi dam gyi lha dang mi 'bral/ ngag snying po'i sngags dang mi 'bral/sems chos nyid dang mi 'bral ba'o// the tshom dang bral ba gsum ni/ rgyud lung bla ma'i gsung la the tshom dang bral ba/ dngosagrub kyi tshogs la gtsang btsog gi the tshom dang bral ba/ gsang spyod la the tshom dang bral ba'o// mi bya ba gsum ste/ bag med pa'i spyod pa mi bya/ chags sdang phrag dog gi sems mi bya/phan tshun du dkrug par mi bya'o// rtog pa mi rung ba gsum ste/ dge slong yin kyang rnam rtog shamang byar mi rung / gtsang sbra can bram ze yin kyang rnam rtog byar mi rung / bya ba la mkhas pa kri ya bya rgyud pa yin kyang rnam rtog byar mi rung ngo // sdig mi gsog pa gsum las/ lam mkhan bla ma la sdig mi gsogalam zab mo'i gdams ngag la sdig mi gsog lam grogs rdo rje'i spun sring la sdig mi gsog go/ mi sbyin pa gsum ni/ dbang rten siddha ra mi la mi sbyin/byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten tshogs skal mi la mi sbyin/ dngos grub kyi rten bdud rtsi mi la mi sbyin no// gsang ba gsum ste/ tshogs byed pa'i dus gsang /byas pa'i grangs gsang / bya ba'i thabs gsang ngo // mi 'bod pa gsum las/bla ma la ma gus pas ming nas mi 'bod/ tshogs 'khor la tha mal gyi ming nas mi 'bod/ rdo rje'i spun la ngan mtshang gis ming nas mi 'bod pa sogs/ de lta bu'i tshogs 'khor la byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba yin pas shes par bya/ bza' rung ba yang / dge slong yin kyang gsang sngags kyi rdzas

288 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigal ma spyod na rtsa ltung du 'gyur te/ gsang sngags rdzas ni ji bzhin nyid// mi bsten pa ni bcu gsum pa// zhes dang / mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud las/sha ni mkhas pas bza' bar bya// chang ni mkhas pas btung bar bya// dpa' bo chang gis gzi brjid bskyed// dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung //zhes mkhas pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs mnga' brnyes pa la zer gyi/ su rung rung gis bag med du rol ba ma gnang ste/ bya rgyud man chad la/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la mi dbang zhing // chang ni nyes pa kun gyi gzhi// sha za ba la snying rje med//chang 'thung ba la sdom pa med// bud med bshol la mtho ris med// sems can bsad par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs/ drod thob pa dang ma thob pa'i gnad bkag kyang / o rgyan chen pos/ dngos grub dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi 'di// skal ldan rnams kyi sman yin te// skal med rnams kyi dug tu 'gyur//sha ni thabs mchog he ru ka/ chang ni shes rab rnal 'byor ma// sngags pa chang gis gzi brjid bskyed// ces so// yang chang gis myos pa dang spyod pa bag med du byas na rdzogs rim gyi lta ba med cing / bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa mi gsal ba dang / 'phrin las la lhag chad nor 'khrul sogs yong bas/ tshogs chang yin kyang dam tshig gi rdzas las btung bar mi bya'o// tshod ma zin na/ o rgyan chen pos/ sngags pa chang gas myos pa na// dmyal ba ngu 'bod gnas su skye// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'ongs// tsha ba btung na tsha ba'i gnas su skye// grang ba btung na grang ba'i gnas su skye// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i phyir thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid rim ma thob cing / thob kyang tshul bzhin nyams su ma blangs par cho 'brang rigs rus thob thang sogs la bsnyad de/ rol dbyangs shes pa tsam gyis gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor du rlom pa rnams dang / za 'dod kyis chos bcur bsnyad pa'i srog gcod sogs rgyu 'bras la mi sems pa'i deng sang gi sngags gzugs nyon mongs 'jol nyog tu

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 289byed pa rnams sngags kyi grub mtha' dang cha lugs tsam gyis gshin gson gyi dkor dang / sha chang la khyi glo 'phrad pa ltar bag med du spyad par mi bya'o//dgu pa lhag ma ni/ tshogs gong du bgos pa'i tha ma de la gtsang lhag bya/rdo rje slob dpon la sngon du drang bar lhag phud tshang bas/ dkyil 'khor dang /slob dpon gyi lhag ma gnyis dang / 'dus pa spyis ma rol ba'i phud bcas sgrub chen lta bu la dkyil 'khor shar lhor mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas yin pas/rab mi lpags steng du thal chen tshom bu bkod/ 'bring sa stegs maṇḍal dri chu dang rakta'i chag chag btab/ sgrub chen min na spyi khyab tu stegs bu gang rung la lhag ma bharnyar bkod de/ sman raka (rag bran la bzhag gang ltar 'dus pa rnams nas tshogs kyi bza' btung la kha mngar dang gtsang sme bral bar longs spyad nas/ 'dus spyi'i lhag ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus la/ gong gigatsang lhag rnams de'i steng du bzhag pas gtsang rme steng 'og bya zhes pa'i don no// sgrub mchod lta bu la dgongs 'dus nas lhag gtor zhes lhag ma'i khar dmar gtor sha khrag yungs kur gzug pa'ang bsngo bar bshad kyang rtag tu mi dgos/ gtsang lhag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams don la sangs rgyas yin mod/ gang 'dul thabs mkhas kyis 'phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub ster ba'i phyir bran gyi tshul du khas blangs dam bcas so/rnam pa gcig tu na bla ma dgongs 'dus las/ lhag mgron rnams kyis 'di skad do// dbus su 'tshal skal mi ldan gyi// dkyil 'khor mu ran mtha' la skor// phud la 'tshal skal mi ldan gyi// lhag ma'i zhal chab bran la zhu// zhes pa ltar slob dpon lta dgongs can yin na rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar ya rkan dang ma rkan rigs gang yin gyi rigs lnga yab yum gsal/ padma'i rigs lta bu yin na snang mtha' gos dkar mo yab yum gsal gdab cing /sman phud khar blugs te lag gnyis mkha' dbyings kyi phyag rgya byas pa'i nang

290 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiganas kha phru lan gsum gtor bas/ dang pos yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkha' gsang nas byang sems kyi bdud rtsi babs pas lhag ma'i nyes skyon sbyangs/ gnyis pas bdud rtsi sha khrag gi phung po zad mi shes pa'i 'dod yon longs spyod kyi rgya mtshor bsam/ gsum pas 'od zer las hrīḥyig dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rta mgrin srid gsum gang ba rnams kyis lhag mgron thams cad bsdus te bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med bsgrub par bsams la i āḥlha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ha ho hrī brjod do// lta dgongs dang mi ldan na de ltar mi 'os pas mos pas spyod pa'i phyag srol rakta dang bdud rtsi bran la a kā ros brlabs/ nyin mo yin na spos thur dang mtshan la dpal 'bar btsugs pas dus mtshan gyi gdong thug bzur bar bshad/ rnam gsum bsre ba las byang 'dir mi gsal yang zhi khro bka' brgyad sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar na/tshogs phud nas lhag mar bsre ba rje nyid 'bangs thob tu phab pa ste bkra shis kyang 'bangs mthu chung bar 'gyur/ lhag ma nas tshogs phud yar bsnan pa 'bangs rje thog tu bskyon pa ste/ 'bangs mthu che yang dpon slob bkra mi shes pa 'byung bas/ skyon de gnyis mi 'byung ba'i thabs dpal gtor nas kyu gu gcig lhag ma'i steng du bskyal/ de la bdud rtsi gsang nan gyi sngags bcas bdud rtsi bran la/ dam tshig dran gso gdab cing yar mar thams cad gcig tu mchod pa ni/ kye dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu// zhes gyer gzhung so sor gsal ba ltar phyag len du yod kyang / 'dir gsal kha mi 'dug 'di skabs dam bsgrags dgos tshul ni/ gsang snying las/ e ma ho/ tshogs kyi dkyil chen po 'dir// ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang // gtsug gi nor bu 'bar ba ltar// g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pa'i// sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi//gtsug tu blangs te bkur bar bgyi// zhes sngon dpal chen he ru ku'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'o// de'ang rab 'bring gsum las/ rnal 'byor pa rab lta

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 291 —dgos dang ldan pa la/ rgyal ba dngos su gus pa dang / lha klu dbang po'i gtsug nor la gang gis 'tshe bar mi nus pa ltar sgrub pa po'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas ma bcol kyang 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du bsgrub pa dang /'bring dbang chen rgyal po che btsan rje bo la 'bangs bran gyis nyan dgos pa ltar rim gnyis ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang / tha ma dbang chen rje dpon la blon ngo chen gyis nan che'i bsnyen bkur la 'byon cing /'bangs mi'i 'dod blo dang bstun pa ltar sgrub pa po dam tshig gtsang zhing rdzas dang yo byad tshang ba/ cho ga lag len ma nor ba sogs byung na/ 'phrin las sgrub cing dngos grub chen po thob par nges so// lhag la dbang ba'i bka'i pho nya rnams ni/ dbang mo nyer brgyad/ mkha' 'gro so gnyis/ ging chen bco brgyad laṅka 'bum dang / dbang gi ma mo chen mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi ste ma bdun sring bzhi zer/ 'bar ma chen mo brgyad/ pho nya sum brgya drus cu rnams yin pas/ de dag la bdud rtsi'i lhag ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin zad pa med par dmigs nas bsngos pas/ mgron rnams shin tu dgyes shing / tha tshig dran te rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med du bsgrub par bsams la/ rigs 'dus bla ma rgyal ba yi// sogs ukhyi ṭa'i bar brjod/sngags don urdzi ṭa ni lhag ma/ bā lo ta ni gtor ma/ bakṣa si swāhā ni tshim par gyur cig ces/ mchod g.yog pas pad kor sngon du 'gro bas mkha' lding gi phyag rgyas lhag ma bteg ste sgo drung bar 'don tshig dang sbrags phyi 'gros kyis 'gro la/ 'don mjug rdzogs pa dang sgrub khang nas gom pa bdun cu'i sar srin mo'i za lam yin pas der dor/ bshal chu'ang bsngos la de'i steng du gshegs nas re zhig bsrung la bzhag sprang po sogs gzhan gyi lag tu sprang na bkra mi shis pa 'byung bar bshad pas spang bar bya/ 'on te bya ni mkha' 'gro'i rigs su gtogs pas khyer kyang nyes pa med par gsungs/ sgrub chen

༄7/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 291 —dgos dang ldan pa la/ rgyal ba dngos su gus pa dang / lha klu dbang po'i gtsug nor la gang gis 'tshe bar mi nus pa ltar sgrub pa po'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas ma bcol kyang 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du bsgrub pa dang /'bring dbang chen rgyal po che btsan rje bo la 'bangs bran gyis nyan dgos pa ltar rim gnyis ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang / tha ma dbang chen rje dpon la blon ngo chen gyis nan che'i bsnyen bkur la 'byon cing /'bangs mi'i 'dod blo dang bstun pa ltar sgrub pa po dam tshig gtsang zhing rdzas dang yo byad tshang ba/ cho ga lag len ma nor ba sogs byung na/ 'phrin las sgrub cing dngos grub chen po thob par nges so// lhag la dbang ba'i bka'i pho nya rnams ni/ dbang mo nyer brgyad/ mkha' 'gro so gnyis/ ging chen bco brgyad laṅka 'bum dang / dbang gi ma mo chen mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi ste ma bdun sring bzhi zer/ 'bar ma chen mo brgyad/ pho nya sum brgya drus cu rnams yin pas/ de dag la bdud rtsi'i lhag ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin zad pa med par dmigs nas bsngos pas/ mgron rnams shin tu dgyes shing / tha tshig dran te rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med du bsgrub par bsams la/ rigs 'dus bla ma rgyal ba yi// sogs ukhyi ṭa'i bar brjod/sngags don urdzi ṭa ni lhag ma/ bā lo ta ni gtor ma/ bakṣa si swāhā ni tshim par gyur cig ces/ mchod g.yog pas pad kor sngon du 'gro bas mkha' lding gi phyag rgyas lhag ma bteg ste sgo drung bar 'don tshig dang sbrags phyi 'gros kyis 'gro la/ 'don mjug rdzogs pa dang sgrub khang nas gom pa bdun cu'i sar srin mo'i za lam yin pas der dor/ bshal chu'ang bsngos la de'i steng du gshegs nas re zhig bsrung la bzhag sprang po sogs gzhan gyi lag tu sprang na bkra mi shis pa 'byung bar bshad pas spang bar bya/ 'on te bya ni mkha' 'gro'i rigs su gtogs pas khyer kyang nyes pa med par gsungs/ sgrub chen

292 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigayin tshe lhag ma rnams kyang grol rgyu'i nyin 'di dang mnyam du gshegs/ lhag mgron rnams 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul sprul pa dang / 'jig rten las ma 'das pa'i dregs pa can rnams ru nga phrag dog shin tu che bas tshogs mchod dang lhag ma chad tho mchod gtor brtan skyong rnams la tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bya byed shar na rgyal khams spyi dang sgrub pa po rnams la mi shes pa du ma 'byung bar gsungs pas bag yod par mdzod/ skabs 'dir thugs dam bskul ba 'byung yang / gzhung du ma gsal bas ma bris la/ gzhan yang chad brtan gong du dngos grub len pa sogs cung mi 'dra tsam 'dug na'ang rnam pa gcig tu ma nges so//bcu pa dngos grub len pa ni/ sman raka ltarag gtor gsum zhal zas mar me rnams snod gcig tu bsdus te rdo rje slob dpon la phul nas/ 'don tshig ltar gnas gsum du gtugs la/ dmigs pa ni mdun bskyed yod na de nyid dang / med na skad cig gis bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun mkhar gsal te sa bcu lam lnga dbang bcu phyi nang 'phrin las rnam brgyad kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar bsams la/ hūṃ ho/ bde chen klong yangs rgyal ba'i zhing khams sogs brjod cing / dngos grub kyi rdzas de nas cung zad re rol te slar yang sngar gnas su bzhag ste ye shes pa rang la bstim mo//bcu gcig chad tho ni/ sngon dpal chen rta mchog rol ba mtsho skyes rdo rje g.yu thog sogs kyi spyan sngar spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa/ sgos gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa la bya ra byed par khas blangs pa bzhin 'phrin las sgrubs shig ces pa ste/ mtsho skyes rdo rje rje btsun g.yu thog pa'i// sogs kyis mchod/bcu gnyis brtan ma ni/ chad tho'i bshal chu brtan gtor du blugs la mchod gtor rnams re re bzhin rin chen snod du 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par dmigs la bdag nyid gtso bo'i thugs ku'i 'od kyis rdo rje

༄za/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 293kun grags sogs bdud mo bzhi sman mo rnam pa bzhi gnod sbyin mo bzhi ste bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' klong sprin gyi ba gam sna tshogs pa'i klong du sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal zhing mdangs dang ldan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub rgyan dang sil snyan rol mo'i bye brag dang bcas 'khor du bran g.yog 'bum sde'i tshogs ma lus pa byon nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i khyams su bzhugs pa la/ mthong dug bsrung phyir sgrub pa po dang brtan ma'i bar du dar dkar po'i yol bas bres par bsam pa'i phyi rol du so sor gang 'dod kyi mchog gtor 'dzad med phul te 'phrin bcol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ bod khams skyong ba'i sman mo brtan ma'i sogs brjod la rang gnas su gshegs te/ gtor ma rgya sgo'i phyi rol gtsang sar kha nub tu bstan te bzhag go/bcu gsum rta bro ni/ gtor gzhong sbubs la steng du rdo rje bzhag ste/rang gi thugs ku'i 'od kyis gnod byed ya ma dam sri rgyal 'gong bse rag sogs phyir 'brang rnams dang khyad par thar ba'i lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa gang yin pa thams cad pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa rnams kyis dbang med du bkug nas gtor snod ri rab chen po'i 'og tu sa rim pa dgu nas mgo thur du bstan la mnan pa'i steng du ri rab rdo rje rgya gram che brjid sra brtan dang ldan pas mnan par bsams la/ dpal chen khros pa'i rdo rje sogs brjod la/ mjug tu gtor snod kha yar bstan pa'i nang du me tog 'bru dkar gyis bkang la tshe 'gugs bya ba'ang yod/bcu bzhi gtang rag mchod bstod dang / bzod gsol bcas dkyus bzhin bya la/ nyer bsdu ni/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ de 'khor rnams la/ 'khor rnams yum/ yum yab la thim/ yab thugs kha'i nyi gdan

294 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig dang hūṃ la thim/ zhabs kyu khog pa/ mgo bo zla tshes/ thig le nā da la thim/nā da gnyis med chos kyi dbyings su 'ja' yal ba ltar bsams la rtag mtha' bsal/ slar yang rang nyid gtso bo rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gsal zhing chad mtha' bsal ba ste/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa sogs brjod/bco lnga smon lam bkra shes ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rigs 'dus sogs go sla bas ma spros so// de lta bu'i bka' gter gsar rnying gang yin sngags bla med kyi sgor 'jug pa la/ dang po lam thams cad kyi rmang rdo lta bu sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnams grangs gsog tsam la chog par mi 'dzin par rang rgyud dang 'dres pa'i rtags thon bya/ de'i rjes su skye 'chi bar do sku gsum lam du khyer ba'i gnad zab mo ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum dang ma bral ba'i 'khor 'das ro snyoms kyi lta ba dang bcas pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung ldan gyi ngang du bzla ba ni don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'o//slar smras pa/ skye med dbyings las sprul pa'i zlos gar ma khan// yon tan mgon zhes grags pas sa gsum khyab// gang de'i thugs bskyed rta bdun dbang po yi// rim gnyis thigs phran 'bum du brdal ba rmad// 'gro khams lus can kun gyi mgon gcig pu// ched bsngags dug lnga'i nad dpung kun 'joms shing // sku gsum bde chen klong du 'dren pa'i mchog/ 'phral dang yun gyi bde ster khyed las su// khyed kyi gsang gsum mi zad 'khor lo'i 'jing // byis blo'i spyod yul lam du ma gyur kyang // rang 'dod dri mas ma gos lhag bsam gyis// thun mong thun mong min pa'i skabs 'di byas// sba 'os gsal bkod rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi/ dgongs pa ji bzhin ma rtogs log rtog dang // 'gal 'khrul nyes pa'i tshogs rnams rtsa gsum lha// mkha' 'gro dam can sde dgu'i tshogs la bshams//

༄༅/mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 295zhesami pham chos kyi skyed tshal dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i skyes mchog 7gong sa skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po dang / chos rgyal sprul pa'i zlos gar 7rgyal tshab 7yongs 'dzin de mo ho thog thu yab sras nas rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che'i thugs bskyed rgya chen pos gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag sman sgrub rgyun 'dzugs mdzad skabs su lcags ri 'gro phan rig byed gling gi 7'tsho byed bla sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho nas grwa tshang rang la phan pa'i lhag bsam dag pas yang yang bskul ngor/ bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams dang / o ḍi ya na'i mkhan po slob dpon padma rgyal po/ g.yu thog rang gzhung dang / gter chen ratna gling pa/ pad gling kun mkhyen gnyis pa rnams kyi rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung chen po tshams sa'ir bzhag ste/ rang bzo'i dri mas ma gos par bskul ba po'i mos ngo bzhin du smras kyang / g.yu thog nyid kyis lung bstan las ma 'ongs pa na nga'i zab mo bla sgrub 'di nyid tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ltar tshig tu 'grigs 'grigs 'dra la don la byin rlabs brgyud pa rtsa ba nas chad bzo bcos dang 'dra min sna tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro gsungs pa la bag tsha yang / rnam pa gcig tu ni 'di nyid snga 'gyur gyi rgyud sde'i dgongs pa kho nar 'dug pas de dang mi mthun pa'i man ngag gi zab khyad yin zhes rang bzo dang rim gnyis 'dra 'chos gya tshom rnams ma 'dres par tshad ldan gyi gzhung las rnam dpyod blo gros kyis snying po len pa 'di nyid snyigs dus kyi chos gzugs dred po chos kyi seng ge zhes don la gnyis med seng gres smras pas 'gro rnams bla med sku gsum sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par gyur cig/oṃ swa ste/ phyag na padmo thub bstan rgya mcho yi// thugs bskyed mtha' bral kun gsal yangs pa'i klong // gang 'dul 'phrin las nyin byed 'od snang gis// bstan 'gro phan bde'i padmo ci yang 'dzum// 'gro mgon mahwa gu khya'i snyan brgyud kyi// rnam bshad sku gsum bgrod pa'i them skas 'di// 'jam mgon mi yi rnam rol 'khor los bsgyur// khri srong gnyis pa de mo rgyal bas bskrun// grangs med tshogs pa'i bsod nams chu gter rum// spangs rtogs rin chen gdengs ka dbyings su bteg/ bshad sgrub dgos 'dod nor bu'i 'byung gnas che// sku gsum klu yi dbang po thob phyir bsngo//zhes pa'ang g.yu thog rje'i snyan brgyud thun mong thun min gyi rnam bshad 'di bzhin/ rab tshes sa byi lor gzhung sa mchog nas par gzhi gsar bskrun mdzad skabs smon tshig tu chos kyi seṅges spel ba dge/ nga/ra 'di lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling du bzhugs/ dge legs 'phel// / /

296༄7// byin rlabs bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od phyi nang gsang gsum nyams su len pa'i zin bris bklags chog tu bkod pa yon tan 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru gu ṇa nā thā ya/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rnam 'dren mchog rnams kyi// thugs bskyed thugs rje gcig bsdus g.yu thog pa// bsil ldan sman gyi ston pa yon tan mgon// grol ba bzhi ldan de yis bdag byin rlobs//phyi ltar lnga rig mthar phyin paṇḍi ta// nang ltar grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi rje//gsang ba bee ḍūrya 'od bcom ldan 'das// gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung yid bzhin nor// kun las khyad 'phags byin rlabs gzi brjid can// ring por mi thogs grub gnyis 'dod 'jo ba// ji ltar nyams su len tshul go bde'i zin// bkod la rtsa gsum srung mas gnang ba stsol//de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma nyid gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal khams su 'tsho mdzad grub pa'i dbang phyug gi skur bzhengs pa rje btsun g.yu thog pa chen pos skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la brtse bas dgongs te rdo rje'i gsang tshig tu gdams pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yang zab mthar thug snying gi thig le'i bsnyen sgrub kyi zin bris cung zad bkod pa la gnyis/ bskyed rdzogs kyi spyi don mdo chings sa bcad du bstan pa/ bsnyen sgrub lag len dngos nyid zhib par smos pa'o//dang po la gnyis/ rim gnyis spyi'i don/ bye brag gzhung 'di nyid kyi

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 297bzhugs tshul lo//dang po la drug bo bo/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ grangs nges/ go rim/grol ba'i 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ yid mtshan rtog las bde myur du skyob pa'i thabs khyad par can te/ bde stong gi ye shes lha sku'i rnam pa dang 'brel ba'o// snga rabs pa rnams kyis bskyed rim mtshan nyid ba'i/ rdzogs rim gsum ldan du'ang gsungs so// gnyis pa la bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po la dbye na/ ting 'dzin gsum/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi la sogs pa dang / gnyis pa la rang byin brlab pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'am/ rdzogs pa dang rdzogs pa chen po sogs su dbyer yod do//gsum pa ni/ 'phags skor ba rnams kyis sbyang gzhi las bcoms te/ tha mal gyi skye 'chi'i rim pa sbyong ba dang mthun par bskyed rdzogs su gdags par bzhed/ dus 'khor ba rnams 'bras bu las bcoms te/ bskyed pa'i don thun mong dang / rdzogs pa'i don mchog gi dngos grub/ rim pa ni de gnyis mngon du byed pa'i lam la gdags par bzhed/ bi rū pas/ rnam rtog gi rtsol bas bskyed pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum ji ltar gnas pa dang mthun par rdzogs pa la de'i sgrar sbyor bar bzhed pa ni snga 'gyur ba rnams dang yang mthun pa yin no// bzhi pa ni/ spang bya tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang / gya nom lhar zhen gnyis/ thob bya gzugs kyi sku dang chos kyi sku gnyis/ sbyang ga'i lus dang sems/ sbyangs 'bras sku dang ye shes rten brten par 'brel ba'i phyir rim pa gnyis su grangs nges pa yin no// lnga pa ni/ 'phags skor ba bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod/ sems 'brel ba kha cig bskyed rim brtan rung / mi brtan rung lo bcu bzhi bar sngon du song nas rdzogs rim la 'jug par bshad/ kha cig bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyi rgyas btab nas bsgom pa dang / nā ro ta pa sogs thun stod la bskyed rim

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 297bzhugs tshul lo//dang po la drug bo bo/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ grangs nges/ go rim/grol ba'i 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ yid mtshan rtog las bde myur du skyob pa'i thabs khyad par can te/ bde stong gi ye shes lha sku'i rnam pa dang 'brel ba'o// snga rabs pa rnams kyis bskyed rim mtshan nyid ba'i/ rdzogs rim gsum ldan du'ang gsungs so// gnyis pa la bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po la dbye na/ ting 'dzin gsum/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi la sogs pa dang / gnyis pa la rang byin brlab pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'am/ rdzogs pa dang rdzogs pa chen po sogs su dbyer yod do//gsum pa ni/ 'phags skor ba rnams kyis sbyang gzhi las bcoms te/ tha mal gyi skye 'chi'i rim pa sbyong ba dang mthun par bskyed rdzogs su gdags par bzhed/ dus 'khor ba rnams 'bras bu las bcoms te/ bskyed pa'i don thun mong dang / rdzogs pa'i don mchog gi dngos grub/ rim pa ni de gnyis mngon du byed pa'i lam la gdags par bzhed/ bi rū pas/ rnam rtog gi rtsol bas bskyed pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum ji ltar gnas pa dang mthun par rdzogs pa la de'i sgrar sbyor bar bzhed pa ni snga 'gyur ba rnams dang yang mthun pa yin no// bzhi pa ni/ spang bya tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang / gya nom lhar zhen gnyis/ thob bya gzugs kyi sku dang chos kyi sku gnyis/ sbyang ga'i lus dang sems/ sbyangs 'bras sku dang ye shes rten brten par 'brel ba'i phyir rim pa gnyis su grangs nges pa yin no// lnga pa ni/ 'phags skor ba bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod/ sems 'brel ba kha cig bskyed rim brtan rung / mi brtan rung lo bcu bzhi bar sngon du song nas rdzogs rim la 'jug par bshad/ kha cig bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyi rgyas btab nas bsgom pa dang / nā ro ta pa sogs thun stod la bskyed rim

298 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadang thun smad la rdzogs rim bsgom par bzhed cing / gsar rnying spyir dbang non la nges pa med cing dbang po 'bring dang tha mas bskyed rim sngon du song nas rdzogs rim la 'jug cing goms nas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bya bar bzhed pa ni mthun no// drug pa ni/ sems dang sems kyi snang cha bzhin lag la sogs pas snang ba ni rigs sam rgyu yin la/ 'dra ba lam du byas pas rigs gnyis mngon du 'gyur ba dang / rigs 'dra dang ldog pa dang rnam pa dang brnan pa ste gnyen por che ba bzhi'i sgo nas thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa sogs kyi phyir grol bar 'thad pa yin no//gnyis pa bye brag gzhung 'di nyid kyi bzhugs tshul mdo tsam smos pa la'ang gnyis/ bzhugs tshul spyi/ de dag nyams su len tshul bye brag tu smos pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir gzhung 'di la smin byed/ grol byed/ cha lag ste skor gsum/ dang po la'ang / dbang rtul spros pa la dga' ba rjes su bzung ba gnas grogs yo byad dus tshod phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi dbang bskur ba sngon du song nas/ snod ldan la gdams pa'i gnyer gtad pa dang bcas pa rgyas pa'i lugs dang / dbang rnon spros med la dga' ba rjes su bzung ba btor ma la brten pa'i don dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa bsdus pa'i lugs dang / gnyis ka la mkho ba tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'joms lhan thabs dang bcas pa/ dbang bskur thob nas bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig phyi ltar blo bzhag drug gzung bya gnyis/ shes bya gsum/ nang ltar rtsa ba sku gsung thugs/ yan lag nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gsang ba byang chub kyi sems dang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i dam tshig rnams legs par srung ba'i tshul gsal ba dam tshig rdo rje rgya mdud zhal gdams dang bcas pa rnams so// gnyis pa grol byed la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim gyi skor ro// dang po la/ bla ma tshogs zhing ltar sgom pa phyi sgrub/ bla ma sangs

༄/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyamasasulenapa'izinabris/ /28—rgyas su sgom pa nang sgrub/ bla ma rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor du sgom pa gsang sgrub/ rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpar sgom pa dril sgrub/ de dag gi zhar las byung ba'i sgrub thabs rnams so// phyi nang la 'khor mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i sgos sgrub/ gsang sgrub srog dril/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong min pa'i snyan brgyud ma la sogs pa rnams so// gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/ lus lha skur 'char ba rtsa sbyong ba'i khrid/ ngag sngags su 'char ba rlung sbyang ba'i khrid /sems chos skur 'char ba thig le sbyong ba'i khrid ston pa sku gsum rang shar gyi gzhung rtsa ba nyams len thams cad kyi ngo sprod gcig tu dril/ ba 'khor 'das rang grol yan lag tu 'brel ba'o// gsum pa cha lag gi skor la/ phyi 'byung ba lus 'khrugs/ nang ting nge 'dzin sems/ gsang ba bar chad bdud kyi gegs bsal ba/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi lam rtags gsal byed/ bsnyen sgrub sngon song gi las kyi sbyor ba/ bkra shis tshe/ las myur me/ 'jigs skyob srung 'khor/ mngon shes pra/ bstan srung chos skyong ste so so'i cha pag nang gses dang bcas pa rnams so//gnyis pa de dag nyams su len tshul bye brag tu smos pa la gsum/ spros bcas bskyed rim/ spros med rdzogs rim/ de dag bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhir 'brel tshul lo// dang po ni/ thog mar phyi sgrub sngon 'gro'i tshul gyis bsags sbyong /sbyang dang gsol 'debs gco bor bton nas rgyud sbyangs te bdag rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i snod rung du byed pa ni bsnyen pa/ nang sgrub dngos gzhi'i tshul du sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i bskyed rdzogs phyi nang gsang ba rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel bar stan thog gcig tu nyams len gyi sa bon gdab pa ni sgrub pa/ gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len gtso bo'i tshul du rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i bskyed rim gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pas bskyed rim gyi grub mtha' lam du slong ba dang dril sgrub rgyun gyi nyams len gyis

300 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigabaskyed bsrings pas dngos grub kyi 'bras bu mngon du byed pa ni sgrub pa chen po'am las la sbyor ba'i tshul gyis nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/sbyang gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po stong gsal 'gag med du bzhugs pa la/ sbyang bya glo bur 'khrul pa'i chos lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam pas gos pa nyid/ sbyong byed rdo rje gsum gyi rdzogs rim zab mos tshul bzhin du sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du byed pa ste/ de'ang thog mar lus lha skur 'char ba rtsa sbyong ba'i khrid la/ phyi lha sku/ nang stong ra/ gsang ba rtsa 'khor la sogs pa gsal gdab cing lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor la 'bad pas rtsa'i bdud (mdud pa grol/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char bar byed/ gnyis pa ngag sngags su 'char ba rlung gi rnal 'byor la/ las dang po pas rdo rje'i bzlas pa zhi ba la bslabs pas ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar dang por 'jug pa'i rtags bcu mthong / cung zad goms pas bar rlung dang bum pa can gyi sbyor ba la bslabs pas bde drod kyi yon tan skye/ goms pa'i stobs brtan du song nas drag rlung gi sbyor ba la 'bad pas gong ma gnyis kyi bogs thon te bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim pa mthar phyin te 'byung lnga'i rlung la rang dbang thob/ rmi lam 'od gsal sgyu lus dang bcas pa'i rtsal rang shugs su 'byongs nas grub pa gnyis ka nyams 'og tu tshud par 'gyur la/ rlung gi nus stobs dman pa'i rnal 'byor pas drod tshad myur du 'byin pa zab mo gnad kyi nyams 4len rmi lam la sogs pa so so'i gdams ngag gis rtsal sbyong ba dang / goms pa dman pas lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba bar do grong 'jug gi gdams pa la brten te skye ba brgyud nas zung 'jug gi go 'phang la bgrod par byed/ gsum pa yid chos skur 'char ba thig le'i rnal 'byor la/ rlung la goms stobs che chung dang bstun pa'i rang lus thabs ldan sngon du song nas/ gzhan lus

༄7khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 3()1brtag cing bkug nas rgyud smin pa la brten/ dwangs ma 'dzin 'dren dgram pa'i sbyor ba mthar phyin pas tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'grub cing 'ja' lus mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob/ na tshod yol ba sogs kyis grol lam la brten te sems gnas pa dang / spro ba dang / bzo bcos rtsis gdab dang bral ba'i bsam gtan la rim gyis bslabs pas/ mthar gnas lugs ji bzhin mthong goms rtsal rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis tshe gcig la kun bzang gu ru sman pa'i rgyal po'i dgongs pa mngon du 'gyur bar byed do// gsum pa de dag bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang ji ltar 'brel na/ de'ang bskyed rim kyang pa'i dbang du byas na/ phyi sgrub bsnyen pa/ nang sgrub skabs rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang sgo bstun pa'i nyams len rnams nye bsnyen bla med kyi nyams len rnams sgrub pa/ gsang sgrub dang dril sgrub ni sgrub pa chen po'i tshul lo//bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgrom nas 'don pa'i dbang du byas na/ sngon 'gro phyi sgrub bsnyen pa/ nang sgrub nye bsnyen/ gsang sgrub dril sgrub sgrub pa/ rdzogs rim sku gsum rang shar sgrub pa chen po ste/lam dang sbyar na gtso bor tshogs lam dang / sbyor lam drod dang / rtse bzod chos mchog chen po'i ngo skal gyi nyams len te/ chos mchog gi rten der rlung sems tsam gyi lha skur grub pas rdo rje gsum gyi rdzogs rim zab mo'i nye rgyus mtshams sbyar nas/ mchog gi dngos grub 'od gsal gyi lha sku mngon du byas te slob pa dang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi go 'phang rim gyis bgrod par 'gyur ro//gnyis par bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len dngos zhib par smos pa la lnga/ gang gas sgrub pa'i gang zag gang du sgrub pa'i gnas/ gang gi tshe sgrub pa'i dus/gang la brten nas sgrub pa'i yo byad/ gang ltar sgrub pa'i thabs so //dang po ni/ dbang thob la dam tshig dang ldan pa ste dbang ma thob pas

302 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigagasang sngags bsgrub tu mi rung zhing dam tshig dang mi ldan na sgrub pa thams cad log par 'gro ba'o//gnyis pa ni/ spyi'i gnas dben cing yid dang mthun pa/ bye brag gi gnas las bzhi'i mtshan nyid tshang ba khyad par gyi gnas grub thob gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ tha mal dang 'du 'dzi can gyi gnas su bsgrubs kyang dngos grub mi 'grub cing bar du gcod pas glags rnyed par 'gyur la/gnas de lta bur de las ldog pa'i yon tan dang bcas pa'o//gsum pa la gnyis/ nam sgrub pa'i dus dang / ji tsam sgrub pa'i dus so// dang po ni/ yon tan gong du 'phel ba'i rten 'brel gyi phyi sgrub dkar phyogs kyi gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang ba la 'dzugs/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i dus chen yin pas nang sgrub dkar phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la brtsam/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i phyir gsang sgrub 6 /ra ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin mo dang mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i mtshan mo la dbu 'dzugs/ dril sgrub dus nges med par rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya bar sems so// gnyis pa ni/ gang zag rab dang 'bring gi lam rtags gsal byed nor bu'i sgron me las gsungs pa bzhin so so'i rtags tshad mngon du gyur gyi bar du bsgrub/ gang zag tha ma nyams rtags mi gsal ba rnams kyis so so nas bshad pa'i grangs ched /tshad ci nas them par bya'o//bzhi pa ni/ spyir 'tsho ba zas la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen dang dkon mchog gi rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad ji ltar 'byor pa/ bye brag sgrub thabs so sor bshad pa'i rten rnams so so'i skabs su tshogs par bya'o// 'byor pa dang ldan kyang sgrub pa'i rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad gal chung du btang ba ni nyes pa lji bas shin tu mi rung zhing rten la rten 'brel gyi gnad yod cing mchod rdzas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rgyu yin pas gzhung mthun gtsang ma rgyas /

༄/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyamasasulenapa'izinabris/ wa 303—par bya dgos la/ 'byor pa dman pas sgrub pa bshol pa ni gegs yin te dad mos kyi nyer len dang nang gi rnal 'byor kho nas mchog thun mong gnyis la 'grub par 'gyur bas ji tsam 'byor pa kho nas chog go/lnga pa la gnyis/ spyi dang / bye brag go/ dang po ni/ sgo gsum rnam par g.yeng ba mtha' dag spangs nas rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis nyams len la 'jugade'ang bsgrub bya'i lha la dad pa dang mos gus kyi shugs drag po/ sgrub thabs kyi chos dang de nyid gnang ba po'i bla ma la the tshom med pa'i yid ches rtse gcig pa dang / rkyen ci byung yang bar du mi chad pa'i dam bca' brtan po dang /snyom las le lo'i dbang du nam yang ma shor ba'i brtson 'grus drag po dang ldan pas myur du sgrub pa mthar phyin par 'gyur zhing mtshams kyi spang blang ga'an rnams kyang spyi ltar lag tu bstar bar bya'o//gnyis pa bye brag tu sgrub pa'i tshul bshad pa la lnga/ phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/gsang sgrub/ dril sgrub/ 'phrin las kyi sbyor ba'o// dang po phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor bu nyams su len pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro bas/gas sbyang / dngos gzhi sgom bzlas/ las kyi kha bsgyur ro// dang po la gnyis/ rten bsham pa/bsags sbyang dngos so// dang po ni/ gnas khang gtsang mar stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng du dri bzang pos byugs pa'i maṇḍal la padma 'dab bzhi bris pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pa'i khar rje btsun gu khya'i sku brnyan rab gnas dang ldan pa bris 'bur gang rung bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du/ a ru ra gser mdog dang bzang po drug la sogs pa'i sman dang rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyi spyan gzigs bkram par bya'o//gnyis pa la drug skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ bstod phyag maṇḍal/rdor sems sgom bzlas/ ku su lu'i (sā li'i tshogs gsog go/ dang po thes/ pa che chung gi lam thams cad kyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ dal 'byor

304 ༄zagayu thog snying thigarnyed par dka' ba dang / snod bcud mi rtag par bsam pa sogs zhen log dang nges par 'byung bas blo chos la bskul zhing stan bde bar mi phyed gus pa chen pos dran pa nye bar bzhag ste/ skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po dang / mtshungs med gu ṇa dbyer mi phyed pa sku gzugs de dang tha mi dad par mdun gyi nam mkhar mtshan dpe 'od kyi phung por bzhugs pa la/ bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i blo rtse gcig pas/ na mo/ rigs 'dus bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang // phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos// bdag gzhan byang chub ma thob bar// snying nas nye bar skyabs su mchi// zhes brgya rtsa gcig brjod la/ bla ma dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu tshud par mos pa kun rdzob kyi skyabs 'gro la bslabs nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul chos kyi dbyings/'gro mkhan rang gi sems/ 'gro thabs de'i byed las te/ de dag gdod nas stong pa nyid du ro mnyam pa yin lugs kyi rang ngor bzhag pa don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro'i rgyas thebs par bya'o// gnyis pa theg pa dman pa las khyad par du byed pa sems bskyed pa la gnyis/ smon sems bskyed pa/ 'jug sems la blo sbyong ba'o// dang po ni/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la snying gi dkyil nas snying rje dung ba re bsgom zhing / de rnams kyi don du tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo bla ma sgrub pa la brtson pa chen pos 'jug par bgyi'o snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces brgya rtsa brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'phral yun bde ba dang ldan cing de'i rgyu dge ba la spyod par smon pa'i byams pa/

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 305sdug bsngal dang bral zhing de'i rgyu mi dge ba la mi spyod par smon pa'i slong rje/rtag tu bde ba kho na dang mi 'bral bar smon pa'i dga' ba/ thams cad kyang phan tshun ma gcig pa'i bu ltar chags sdang gi blo dang bral bar smon pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med bzhi rgyud la bskyed de/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig ces lan bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'grub brjod/ de ltar smon 'jug gi bdag nyid can kun rdzob dang / bdag dang sems can gdod nas ma grub par mtshan rtog dmigs pa kun dang bral ba don dam byang chub kyi sems zung du 'jug pa la bslab bo// gsum pa bsags sbyong /sbyang gnyis ku'i mchog dang phul du gyur pa bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang dang mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas 'dud cing phyag 'tshal/ ngag gus pas bstod dbyangs sgrog yid gus pas gzhan du rnam par mi g.yeng bar rtse gcig tu 'dud par mos la/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang //bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces tshig re dang phyag re sbrags pa brgya rtsa gcig bzhi pa rgyud la yon tan skye ba'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa tshogs bsags kyi phul du gyur pa maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ rin po che la sogs pa'i maṇḍal skyon med pa dang / tshom bu'i rgyu 'byor na rin po che dang sman 'bru/ ma 'byor na 'bru gtsang ma dri bzang gi rlan gyis gsher ba 'du byas la/ yig brgya brjod cing maṇḍal phyi ba dang / tshom bu so bdun ma bkod cing spyi ltar 'bul/ de'ang gnas skabs sogs kyis lcogs na so bdun ma'am tshom bu bdun ma lta bu brgya rtsa 'bul grub na shin tu legs la/ ma

306 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigalcogs na de dag ji tsam nus pa dang / grangs 'dzin sa gzhi spos byug gam//bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi// dge tshogs dang bcas ri gling nyi zla sogs// kun bzang mchod sprin bsam yas sprul byas te// bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can la 'bul// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog/ ces pa la grangs bzung yang rung ste gang ltar brgya rtsa gcig bya/ gzhung las maṇḍal re dang bskor ba bzhi re sbrags par gsungs kyang lag len tu stabs mi bde bas maṇḍal grub rjes su/ na mo da sha dis kā la sarba ratna tra yā ya/ na ma pra dakṣa/ su pra dakṣa/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes dang sman bla'i gzungs thung 'don bzhin du rten la bskor ba brgya rtsa bya/ khang khyim gyi go yul dog pa lta bus dngos su bskor ba mi 'grub na yid kyis bskor ba byas par mos la/ gong gi sazungs sngags brgya rtsa brjod/ mthar tshogs rten las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung / bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bsal/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i skal ba can du byas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos la bdag gzhan rten dang bcas pa mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/ de'ang mkha' khyab kyi zhing khams rgya mtsho blos blangs shing sprul te sgo gsum gus pas bstod phyag bskor ba bcas 'bul ba phyi'i maṇḍal/ rang gzhan gyi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa bcas 'bul ba nang gi maṇḍal/ 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i spros pa gzod nas zhi ba'i rang ngo la mnyam par 'jog pa gsang ba'i maṇḍal rnams lhan cig tu 'brel bar bya'o// lnga pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba la mchog tu bsngags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug pad dkar zla ba'i steng // bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ston zla'i mdog/ rdo rje dril 'dzin dar dang rin chen brgyan// zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs// thugs kur zla steng hūṃ mthar yig brgyas bskor// bzlas par rgyud bskul 'od 'phros

༄za/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 307don gnyis byas// sa bon sngags las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung // sku lus nang gang zhabs kyi mthe bong las// babs te tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kun bkrus// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon dri ma'i tshogs// dag cing byang nas gsal stong 'od skur gyur// zhes mos la yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ skyabs gnas bdag la brtser dgongs mdzod// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum gyis// mi dge gang bgyis mthol lo bshags// zhes bshags pa lan gsum brjod pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i gnang ba stsal/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum gyi ngo bor gyur par mos/ de'ang lha gsal gdab pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi nyes ltung la 'gyod pa drag po skyed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa bcas yid rtse gcig pas sngags bzla ba gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang nyes ltung gi bya ba mi bgyid par dam bca' ba nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs te bzhi po tshang bar byas pa'i mthar/ sbyang bya'i sdig ltung sbyong byed kyi gnyen po/ sbyong mkhan rang gi sems rnams gdod nas ma grub par lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/ drug pa ku su lu'i (sā li'i tshogs gsog ni/ gsal 'debs pa'i tshig ngag tu brjod pa dang 'brel bar 'don sgom chabs cig tu bya ba blo dman rnams la 'char bde bas/ de ltar na/ mdun mkhar bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po la// mgron rigs bzhis bskor sprin phung gtibs ltar bzhugs// rang sems dbyings thon rdo rje rnal 'byor ma//dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa'i sku ru gyur// bem po'i thod pa phyag g.yas gri gug gis// bregs te rang byung thod pa'i skyed pur btsugs// de nang sha rus til 'bru tsam du bsil// me rlung sbyor bas zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho// nam mkha'i khyon gang mchod sprin zad mi shes// mgron rigs so so'i bzhes rgur

308 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'achar bar gyur// thugs las mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med spros// dkon mchog rtsa gsum sri zhu'i mgron rnams la// gus pas 'bul lo tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shog/ dpal mgon chos skyong yon tan mgron rnams la// 'bul lo las dang dngos grub 'grub par mdzod// 'gro ba rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams la// sbyin pas sdug bsngal kun zhi bde ldan shog/ sde brgyad 'byung po lan chags mgron rnams la// bsngos pas zhi ba byang chub sems ldan shog/ kun kyang rigs 'dus bla ma'i ye shes kyi// sgyu 'phrul rol pa cir yang snang ba ste// lus kyi mchod sbyin phul bas dgyes shing tshims// 'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog/ rang sems 'khrul pas bsgribs pa'i gzhan dbang las// kun brtags gnyis su snang ba'i chos rnams kun// gdod nas mi dmigs spros bral nam mkha' ltar// yongs grub de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su a// zhes lan gcig gam gsum mam bdun la sogs par 'bul lo// de ltar bskol ba dang maṇḍal sbrags pa gcig tu byas pa'i sngon 'gro brgya phrag lnga po thun re re'i khongs su bar ma chad par nyams su blangs te rab tshogs rdzogs shing sdig pa dag pa'i rtags legs par ma mthong ba'i bar du'am/ tha na zhag bdun las mi nyung bar bya ba ni gzhung gi dngos ston yin la/ gal te sngon 'gro re re bzhin 'bum phrag la sogs pa bsag par spro na/ thog mar skyabs 'gro/ de nas sems bskyed sogs so so la bungs len cing thun re re'i khongs su gzhan rnams kyang ma chad tsam byas pas chog go/gnyis pa sgom bzlas bya ba la gnyis/ phyi dkyil spyi bor bsgom pa/ nang dkyil snying gar bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ rten gyi mdun du bla gtor dkar zlum pad 'dab bzhi pa mtshams su thebs ril gyis mtshan pa rgyan spros can bkod pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka /ragan bka' srung sde dgu'i gtor 'bul dmar gtor thebs ril mtshan pa dang / mchod pa rnams gsar du

308 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'achar bar gyur// thugs las mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med spros// dkon mchog rtsa gsum sri zhu'i mgron rnams la// gus pas 'bul lo tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shog/ dpal mgon chos skyong yon tan mgron rnams la// 'bul lo las dang dngos grub 'grub par mdzod// 'gro ba rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams la// sbyin pas sdug bsngal kun zhi bde ldan shog/ sde brgyad 'byung po lan chags mgron rnams la// bsngos pas zhi ba byang chub sems ldan shog/ kun kyang rigs 'dus bla ma'i ye shes kyi// sgyu 'phrul rol pa cir yang snang ba ste// lus kyi mchod sbyin phul bas dgyes shing tshims// 'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog/ rang sems 'khrul pas bsgribs pa'i gzhan dbang las// kun brtags gnyis su snang ba'i chos rnams kun// gdod nas mi dmigs spros bral nam mkha' ltar// yongs grub de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su a// zhes lan gcig gam gsum mam bdun la sogs par 'bul lo// de ltar bskol ba dang maṇḍal sbrags pa gcig tu byas pa'i sngon 'gro brgya phrag lnga po thun re re'i khongs su bar ma chad par nyams su blangs te rab tshogs rdzogs shing sdig pa dag pa'i rtags legs par ma mthong ba'i bar du'am/ tha na zhag bdun las mi nyung bar bya ba ni gzhung gi dngos ston yin la/ gal te sngon 'gro re re bzhin 'bum phrag la sogs pa bsag par spro na/ thog mar skyabs 'gro/ de nas sems bskyed sogs so so la bungs len cing thun re re'i khongs su gzhan rnams kyang ma chad tsam byas pas chog go/gnyis pa sgom bzlas bya ba la gnyis/ phyi dkyil spyi bor bsgom pa/ nang dkyil snying gar bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ rten gyi mdun du bla gtor dkar zlum pad 'dab bzhi pa mtshams su thebs ril gyis mtshan pa rgyan spros can bkod pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka /ragan bka' srung sde dgu'i gtor 'bul dmar gtor thebs ril mtshan pa dang / mchod pa rnams gsar du

༄༅/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 309bsham/ thun bzhi rer bcad pa'i thun thog ma'i 'gor sngon 'gro bsags sbyong /sbyang gi rim pa de dag grangs gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig tsam re byas pa'i tshar gcig grub na legs la/ de ltar gyi tshe ku sā li'i tshogs gsog grub mtshams mngon rtogs la 'jug de dag mi lcogs pa'am thun gzhan rnams kyi 'gor skyabs sems ni/ phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum 'dus pa//bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rgyal la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir//rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog bsgrubs nas// zhi sogs 'phrin las rnam ba'i yis//'gro rnams bde la 'god par bya// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi 'don sgom du bya/ rang yi dam gang mos su gsal gdab par gsungs kyang / spyi tsam du/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i spyi bor padma 'dab ba'i lte ba dang lnga'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kā wā tsi 'dus pa'i ngo bo mahā gu ṇa dang / bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po dbyer med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/gzi brjid kyi dpal rab tu 'bar zhing / zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ 'gro la chags pa'i spyan zur phyogs bcur gzigs shing 'dzum pa'i 'od kyis yid 'phrog pa/ dbu skra kham ser cung zad li ba'i lcang lo me tog gi phreng bas spras pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas utpal rgyas pa'i yu ba zung /bzungananas snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba'i steng du rgyal yum gyi pusti shes rab ral gris mtshan pa/ g.yon chos 'chad kyi rgyas padmo rgyas pa'i yu ba snyan gyi thad kha bye ba'i steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa gur gum gzhon nu'i kha brgyan dang bcas pa la nor bu dbang rgyal dang gser gyi rdo rje sman mchog gser mdog

310 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigagis g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du mtshan pa dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub du mas mdzes shing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// phyogs kyi padma 'dab bzhi la/ mdun du lha mo dkar mo rin po che'i pi waṃ sgyur ba/ g.yas su ser mo bya rgod kyi rkang gling sgyur ba/ rgyab tu dmar mo mi rkang gling bu sgyur ba/ g.yon na ljang mo dngul dkar gyi me long ston pa/ bzhi ka yang bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can 'dzum sgeg 'gying mdzes mnyen lcug 'khril ldem rked par rin po che'i me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing dbu skra lcang lo sil ma mu tig dmar po'i lan tshar dang bcas pa/ sku smad dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang ldan pas gar stabs g.yo ba'i tshul gyis gtso bo la bde stong gi mchod pa rgyun mi chad par 'bul bar gyur/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dang / bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po la phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad mnyam med sprul pa'i skyes mchog mahā gu ṇa dbyer ma mchis pa la lha mo bzhis bskor ba sprin dpung gtibs pa bzhin spyan drangs spyi bo'i gtso 'khor la thim par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyi nyer spyod bdun/ nang 'dod yon lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi rol mos mchod par mos/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa// kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis// mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya chen yongs bkod de// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mchos mchod// ces brjod/ maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma'am bdun ma ci rigs 'bul/ bsdu na gong gi tshigs bcad kho nas 'bul/ snying khong rus pa'i gding (gting nas dad mos kyi shugs drag tu bskyed la/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gang rung ngam/ bsdu na/dus gsum rgyal kun gsang ba gcig bsdus pa// bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu

༄༅khyin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 311thog par// snying khong rus pa'i gding /gting nas gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlob (brlab pa dang // mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pa dang / bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// chos rje sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so//bdag gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la blo gros rgyas te 'gro ba sems can thams cad la phan thogs nyi zla ltar 'byung bar gyur cig smras tshad mngon shes su gyur cig sbyar tshad sman du gyur cig btang tshad phan par gyur cig mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol//zhes lan bdun la sogs par gsol ba drag tu gdab pas/ spyi bo'i gnas bzhi las 'od 'phros lha mo bzhi la phog thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul/ rang gang 'dod kyi dngos grub ster bar bsam/ slar yang thugs la nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ brtan g.yos bsdus pa'i snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma'i bcud dang / sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i tshul du phyag mtshan bum par thim/de nyid 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa yar lud/ rang gi spyi bo nas lus kyi phyi nang du chi li li song bas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/ slar rim gyis lus thams cad bdud rtsis ngang chil gyis gang / dbang bzhi thob/ sku bzhi'i sa bon mngon du byas par bsams la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la gus pas sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/oṃ āḥ: mahā gu ru gu ṇa sarba sidhi hūṃ dzaḥde wa ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng sa ma ya dzaḥ& baṃ ho/ zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla/ de'ang dbang bzhi'i skabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis thog mar spyi bo'i nang gang / lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin

༄༅khyin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 311thog par// snying khong rus pa'i gding /gting nas gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlob (brlab pa dang // mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pa dang / bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// chos rje sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so//bdag gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la blo gros rgyas te 'gro ba sems can thams cad la phan thogs nyi zla ltar 'byung bar gyur cig smras tshad mngon shes su gyur cig sbyar tshad sman du gyur cig btang tshad phan par gyur cig mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol//zhes lan bdun la sogs par gsol ba drag tu gdab pas/ spyi bo'i gnas bzhi las 'od 'phros lha mo bzhi la phog thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul/ rang gang 'dod kyi dngos grub ster bar bsam/ slar yang thugs la nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ brtan g.yos bsdus pa'i snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma'i bcud dang / sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i tshul du phyag mtshan bum par thim/de nyid 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa yar lud/ rang gi spyi bo nas lus kyi phyi nang du chi li li song bas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/ slar rim gyis lus thams cad bdud rtsis ngang chil gyis gang / dbang bzhi thob/ sku bzhi'i sa bon mngon du byas par bsams la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la gus pas sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/oṃ āḥ: mahā gu ru gu ṇa sarba sidhi hūṃ dzaḥde wa ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng sa ma ya dzaḥ& baṃ ho/ zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla/ de'ang dbang bzhi'i skabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis thog mar spyi bo'i nang gang / lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin
