312 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigarlabs zhugs/ snying ga yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lte ba sogs lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi sgrib pa dag ye shes kyi byin rlabs zhugs par mos la re re bzhin du sems yun ring du gtad cing thun re la'ang dmigs pa tshang ba brgya phrag la sogs pa bskyar nas bya'o// thun mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge ram̐ yo khaṃ gsum 'phros/ ram̐ yo khaṃ/lan gsum/ ram̐ las me byung dngos po'i nyes skyon bsregs// yo las rlung byung mtshan ma'i bag chags gtor// khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin dri ma bkrus// rma su bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shurnyonya haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las bdud rtsi rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba'i byang sems dkar por gyur/āḥyis rakta 'khor ba yongs bsgral byang sems dmar por gyur/ hūṃ gis gtor ma 'dod yon lnga'i phung po snod bcud nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ hrīḥs mchod rdzas thams cad mtshan bcas der 'dzin gyi rnam rtog thams cad dang bral ba'i gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mnga' (mngar reg 'jam phun sum tshogs par gyur/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ku'i 'od zer gyis mgron rnams spyan drangs par bsams la badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod/ sa ma ya st+waṃ gyis gdan phul bas spyi bo'i bla ma'i 'khor du mgron thabs kyi lha rnams sprin btibs (gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i spu gu'i 'od zer gyis sman raka /rag)gtor ma'i bcud drangs te bzhes nas zag pa med pa'i bde bas thugs rgyud tshim par gyur/ oṃ āḥlha badzra gu ru gu ṇa de wa ḍā ki sa pā ri wā ra mahā rarba pañtsa a mṛ ta mahā rakta mahā ba li ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 313las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa rigs bdag bla ma sman rgyal yi dam lha tshogs/ sman gyi drang srong rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag cag snying nas nye bar skyabs su mchi'o// gsol ba 'debs so//khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu dpag tu med pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag cag la sogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyams chags /chag nyes ltu nga bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te/myur du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnas skabs su chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen bsam pa thams cad 'grub cing / khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi'i tshig don ma lus pa khong du chud nas/ lus can mtha' dag phan bde'i dpal la 'god nas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/lus la bde ba dang ngag la nus pa dang sems la rtogs pa phul du byung ba 'char zhing / rang gzhan gyi nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi zhing tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas/ khams gsum dbang du 'dus/ log 'dren tshar gcod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ da lta nyid du gnas mchog 'di nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes rgyas par lan gsum/ bsdu na tshar gcig brjod la bstod pa ni/ na mo gu ru/ gang gi sku yi gsang chen mchog/ dngos po kun khyab bde ba che// rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i dbyings// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i skur phyag 'tshal// gang gi gsung gi gsang chen mchog/ sgra grags kun khyab gzhom bral ba// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrogs// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i gsung phyag 'tshal// gang gi thugs kyi gsang chen mchog/ spros pa kun

314 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigabral bde ba che// shes rab pha rol phyin la gnas// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i thugs phyag 'tshal// rgyab ba kun kyang 'dren pa khyed// khyed las gzhan pa'i skyob pa ni// 'gro ba kun la 'ga' ma mchis// de phyir khyed la skyabs su mchi//byis pas khyed mtshan ma thos pa'am// thos kyang gus par mi bsten pa// de las snying rje gzhan med pas// brtse bas khyed kyis rjes su zung /zungasan/ /khyed kyi mtshan thos skyabs song bas// de ni nam yang srid mtshor yin// de phyir mig chu g.yo bzhin du// snying nas dus spun gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog/ gsang chen khyed skur ro gcig pas//de ring kho nar mngon sum du// mkha' khyab 'gro bas thob par shog/ ces pa'i mthar/ las byang ltar/ hūṃ/ rigs 'dus bla ma rgyal ba'i gtso//sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ badzra muḥs mgron thabs kyi lha rnams gshegs/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro bzhi po 'od du zhu nas gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po thugs dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu ste rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsum thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par gyur/ ces mos la mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba na las byung /byang ltar/ hoḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs bsngo smon bkra shis bcas brjod par bya'o// slar yang thun la 'jug pa na gtor mchod rnams kha gsos nas/ skyabs sems nas bkra shes kyi bar bskyar/ srod thun gtor 'bul grub ma thag par dam can sde dgu'i gtor 'bul re'ang bya ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis grangs dus kyi tshad gang rung rdzogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/snga ma'i bsnyen pa grub nas thun gcod tshul gong dang 'dra ba las/ skyabs sems tshad med bdag bskyed yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i bar gong ltar la/ de nas/ rang gi mgo gyen bstan snying padma 'dab ma lngar gyes pa'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs

༄7khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 315nas/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar brjod la gsal 'debs/de nas gus pa chen pos gsol 'debs tshigs bcad lhug tshar ci rigs brjod/ bla ma'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dngul chu'i mdog lta bu'i mthar rma āḥmai badzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas bskor du dkar phrom mer 'khod par gsal la bzlas pa byas pas/ sngags phreng de nyid 'od zer gyi rnam par bla ma'i zhal nas yar phyin/bdag bskyed kyi zhal nas thon/ 'od zer mchod pa'i sprin rum du gyur pas phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du khyab/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum srung ma dang bcas pa mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ 'od zer 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag 'od zer gyi phreng ba rang gi snying ga nas byung / bla ma'i thugs kur zhugs te hūṃ mthar sngags phreng du gyur nas 'khod par mos la bzla/ slar yang zhal nas 'thon pa sogs 'khor ba'i bzlas pa rtse gcig tu bya/ thun 'jog pa na lha sgom sngags bzlas stong nyid gsum la 'khrul pa sel ba'i kha skong du dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya/ nus pa brtan byed rten 'brel snying po bcas lan gsum bzla/ gong ltar gsol 'debs 'dod gsol bcas lan gsum byas/ bla ma rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po sogs brjod la snying ga'i lha/ 'od du zhu/ mnyam bzhag smon lam/ bkra shis bcas bya/ thun mtsham/sa su gtor 'bul spro na bya chog la/ de ltar gyi tshe/ gdan phul bas mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos/ nongs bshags brtam bzhugs mthar rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya ba las gzhan 'dra'o// 'di la 'bru 'bum la sogs pa grub par bya zhing phyi sgrub rgyun khyer 'dod na'ang 'di nyid la bya ste snga ma thun mong dang / phyi ma khyad par ba'i sgrub thabs su shes par bya'o// long skabs chung ba sogs kyis snga phyi gnyis sbrel nas nyams su/ len

316 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigapar 'dod na/ thun gyi phyed cha yan gyi dkyil bzlas bsgom gtor 'bul sogs byas la/ gtso bo rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po thugs dgyes pa chen pos rang gi spyi bo nas mar byon/ rang gi snying mgo gyen bstan padma 'dab ma lngar gyes pa'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/ bla ma'i thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs bzlas sgom dang / thun bsdu tshul gong smos ltar bya'o// gsum pa las kyi kha bsgyur ba ni/ phyi sgrub kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sgo nas bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa/las tshogs khrus chu gzhan la byin rlabs/ sngags mdud/ lam srung rnams ni rtsa ba'i gzhung du gsal ba ltar skabs su gang bab lag tu len par bya'o//'di dag kyang bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang sbyar na/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyong /sbyang bsnyen pa/ phyi dkyil nye bsnyen/ nang dkyil sgrub pa/ las bzhi'i gsol gdab sgrub pa chen po'i tshul yin la/ de bzhi po rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len dang yang don gyis 'byor pa yin no// phyi sgrub zla ba gcig byed na sngon 'gro zhag bdum/ phyi dkyil bdun phrag gnyis/ nang dkyil zhag bcu tsam bya/zhag bdun las mi byed na/ sngon 'gro zhag gsum/ phyi dkyil nang dkyil thun stod smad du 'brel ba zhag bzhi/ bar rnams dang de dag las lhag pa grub na rig pas 'phrul bar bya'o//gnyis pa nang sgrub dgos 'dod kun 'byung nyams su len pa la gnyis/thun mong ba sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba dang / khyad par rig pa'i ye shes rigs lnga la brten te rgyud chen bzhi'i nges don gnad kyi nyams len no// dang po la gnyis/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad/ go don shes bya'i gnad do// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim mo// dang po ni/ tshogs bsags dang sems 'dzin gyi rten du sman bla'i sku brnyan lta bu'i rten dang

316 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigapar 'dod na/ thun gyi phyed cha yan gyi dkyil bzlas bsgom gtor 'bul sogs byas la/ gtso bo rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po thugs dgyes pa chen pos rang gi spyi bo nas mar byon/ rang gi snying mgo gyen bstan padma 'dab ma lngar gyes pa'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/ bla ma'i thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs bzlas sgom dang / thun bsdu tshul gong smos ltar bya'o// gsum pa las kyi kha bsgyur ba ni/ phyi sgrub kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sgo nas bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa/las tshogs khrus chu gzhan la byin rlabs/ sngags mdud/ lam srung rnams ni rtsa ba'i gzhung du gsal ba ltar skabs su gang bab lag tu len par bya'o//'di dag kyang bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang sbyar na/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyong /sbyang bsnyen pa/ phyi dkyil nye bsnyen/ nang dkyil sgrub pa/ las bzhi'i gsol gdab sgrub pa chen po'i tshul yin la/ de bzhi po rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len dang yang don gyis 'byor pa yin no// phyi sgrub zla ba gcig byed na sngon 'gro zhag bdum/ phyi dkyil bdun phrag gnyis/ nang dkyil zhag bcu tsam bya/zhag bdun las mi byed na/ sngon 'gro zhag gsum/ phyi dkyil nang dkyil thun stod smad du 'brel ba zhag bzhi/ bar rnams dang de dag las lhag pa grub na rig pas 'phrul bar bya'o//gnyis pa nang sgrub dgos 'dod kun 'byung nyams su len pa la gnyis/thun mong ba sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba dang / khyad par rig pa'i ye shes rigs lnga la brten te rgyud chen bzhi'i nges don gnad kyi nyams len no// dang po la gnyis/ nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad/ go don shes bya'i gnad do// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim mo// dang po ni/ tshogs bsags dang sems 'dzin gyi rten du sman bla'i sku brnyan lta bu'i rten dang

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 317mchod pa ci 'byor ba bsham/ phyi sgrub sngon du ma song na sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams ci 'grub bya/ song na thun dang po'i mgo lta bur sngar bshad pa'i sngon 'gro rnams tshar re btang grub na legs/ spros pas ma lcogs na dmigs su dgos pa'ang ma yin no// gang ltar bde ba'i gdan la lus gnad bcas te/rang tha mal pa'i ngang nas hūṃ zhes brjod pas rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ sku mdog mthing ga mdangs dang ldan pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba dang / g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsi sman gyis gang ba bsnams pa sprul pa sku'i cha byad can/ sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis klubs par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/thugs kur hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer a ba dhū ti'i lam brgyud/ bshang sgo nas 'og tu thon pa yi ge ram̐ dmar por gyur/de 'od du zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer dhū ti'i lam brgyud chu so nas thon pa nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje chen po zhig tu gyur/ de phyogs bzhir 'phel te cher song ba'i rwa steng ma rnams gyen tu langs pa las rdo rje'i rtsig pa shin tu brtan pa/ rwa rtse steng du bsnol ba las rdo rje'i gur khang tog dang bcas par grub pa las/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis phyi rol thams cad zhu zhing 'dres pas srubs dang bar mtshams med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rwa gur gyi steng gi char sna tshogs padma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi gdan la bzhugs par mos la/ phyi sgrub tu bshad pa ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sgom pa'i tshig rnams lan gsum la sogs pa brjod cing /sems can la snying rje drag tu bsgoms pa'i rkyen gyis/ nam mkha'i lha tshogs

318 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigathugs rje'i dbang gis rang gi mdun du byon/ de dag gi 'od zer rang la phog pas sdig sgrib mtha' dag dag nas rang lus lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar shin tu gsal zhing brtan pa la/ mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyang rang nyid la thim ste gnyis su med par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar tt+waṃ ser po/ gsang bar hrīḥljang gus mtshan pa'o// de yan chad sngon du 'gro ba'i don yin no// de nas rang gi snying rtse mo gyen du bltas pa padma 'dab brgyad du gyur pa'i ze'u 'brur zla ba la hūṃ yig mthon ka chen po'i kha dog can/de zhu ba las bee ḍūrya yi lhung bzed kyi nang du baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i steng du pad zla la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ mthing ga de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsal nas bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma'i skur gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ de thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad thugs ka nas hūṃ sngon po'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig lhung bzed dang bcas pa la thim ste 'od du zhu ba las bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ sku mdog mthing ga mdangs dang bcas/zhabs skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba dang g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsi sman gyis gang ba bsnams pa/ sprul pa sku'i cha byad can/ sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis klubs par gsal ba'i phyag g.yas a ru ra rnam par rgyal bas g.yon lhung bzed kyi bdud rtsi dkrugs pas thig le 'od zer gyi tshul du phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi padma'i 'dab ma la 'phros/ thams cad kyang hūṃ las lhung bzed hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsal/ 'phags nga/ mchod byin rlabs bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla

— ༄༅/byinarlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 319cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa brgyad/ zhal nang du bstan te bzhugs par gyur/ de dag gi sku'i snang ba las 'od zer dkar po rang gi spyi bor 'phros/oṃ dkar por gyur pa'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas te yongs su gyur pa las/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ gsung gi snang ba las 'od zer dmar po mgrin par 'phros/āḥdamar por gyur pa'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas te yongs su gyur pa las/bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ yon tan gyi snang ba las 'od zer ser po lte bar 'phros/ āoṃ /lha ser por gyur pa'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas te yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin dang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gsum ga'ang sprul sku'i cha lugs pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'phrin las kyi snang ba las 'od zer ljang dmar gsang gnas su 'phros/ don gnyis byas te yongs su gyur pa las rta mgrin dbang gi 'khor lo dmar la ljang ba'i mdangs can phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan pa/ zhabs dor thabs pad nyi'i gdan la 'gying ba/ thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa dngas pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su gsal bar gyur/ de dag las 'od zer gyi snang ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas bla ma smin pa'i rgyal po rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing // bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// e hya hi bha ga lhan mahā kā ru ṇi kā dṛ shya hoḥs ma ya hoḥs ma ya st+waṃ/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag

320 ༄khyagayu thog snying thigacag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang //'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ mdun gyi nam mkhar padma'i gdan la bzhugs par mos/ oṃ badzra ambha nas/ shapta pra tītstsha swāhās mchod/ thugs rjes kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// sogs dang /chos sku nam mkha' sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥye shes kyi 'khor lo dam tshig pa la thim ste gnyis su med par gyur/ sngar spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha la dmigs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī shri hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i bdud rtsis spyi bo nas blugs te dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dgachu lhag spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan cing dbang lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de ltar yan lag bzhi ldan gyis lhar bskyed pa de nyid/ gsal la ma 'dres pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa nam mkha'i ngos su 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu/gcig dang du ma las 'das shing gar yang khyab pa chu'i zla ba lta bu ste khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i rnam pa gsal ba/ rang gi ming rus mtshan ma'i bla dwags spangs te gdod ma nyid nas sku lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs 'dus bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma dngos yin cing / de'i yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa bdag la yod do snyam du nga rgyal brtan pa/ de ltar bskyed pa'i snang ba thams cad rang gi sems/ sems nyid gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin gyis stong /stong pa'i rang mdangs gsal ba lhun grub tu shar/ de gnyis kyang ya bral tha dad ma yin par gdod nas zung du 'jug pa don dam rang byung gi sman bla sku

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 321gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid du shes pa rnam dag dran pa rnams la bslab cing ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de la mi gnas na ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyong gi tshul du/ spyi bo'i rnam snang sman gyi bla ma las sku'i snang ba dkar po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ gzugs kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ bde ba'i nyams rgyud la skyes/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas par mos la mnyam par bzhag pa 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ mgrin pa'i snang ba mtha' yas sman gyi bla ma las gsung gi snang ba dmar po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ 'du shes kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsal ba'i nyams rgyud la skyes/sor rtog ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ lte ba'i rin 'byung sman bla las yon tan gyi snang ba ser po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ tshor ba'i phung po'i rtog sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/mi rtog pa'i nyams rgyud la skyes/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ thugs ku'i mi bskyod sman bla gtso 'khor las thugs kyi snang ba sngon po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ rnam shes kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ stong pa chen po'i nyams rgyud la skyes/ me long ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ gsang gnas nas don grub sman bla'i ngo bo rta mgrin dbang gi 'khor lo las 'phrin las kyi snang ba ljang gu 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag ye shes rab 'byams kyi dbang chen thob/ dbyer med zung 'jug gi nyams rgyud la skyes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas par mos la thun gyi phyed yan du ting nge 'dzin de dag ci nas su bsgom pa ni bskyed rim dngos gzhi'o//gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ lus gnad chos bdun nam drang por bslang /

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 321gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid du shes pa rnam dag dran pa rnams la bslab cing ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de la mi gnas na ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyong gi tshul du/ spyi bo'i rnam snang sman gyi bla ma las sku'i snang ba dkar po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ gzugs kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ bde ba'i nyams rgyud la skyes/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas par mos la mnyam par bzhag pa 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ mgrin pa'i snang ba mtha' yas sman gyi bla ma las gsung gi snang ba dmar po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ 'du shes kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsal ba'i nyams rgyud la skyes/sor rtog ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ lte ba'i rin 'byung sman bla las yon tan gyi snang ba ser po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ tshor ba'i phung po'i rtog sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/mi rtog pa'i nyams rgyud la skyes/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ thugs ku'i mi bskyod sman bla gtso 'khor las thugs kyi snang ba sngon po 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ rnam shes kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ stong pa chen po'i nyams rgyud la skyes/ me long ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ gsang gnas nas don grub sman bla'i ngo bo rta mgrin dbang gi 'khor lo las 'phrin las kyi snang ba ljang gu 'phros/ lus thams cad du khyab/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i rtog sgrib dag ye shes rab 'byams kyi dbang chen thob/ dbyer med zung 'jug gi nyams rgyud la skyes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas par mos la thun gyi phyed yan du ting nge 'dzin de dag ci nas su bsgom pa ni bskyed rim dngos gzhi'o//gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ lus gnad chos bdun nam drang por bslang /

322 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigangag gnas (gnad rlung rang bab tu bzhag sems gnad gzhan tu ma yengs par thog mar bla ma dang rigs lnga so so dbyer med la mos gus dungs pa re sngon du 'gro bas dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/spyi bo'i rnam snang mos gus kyi rkyen gyis 'od du zhu/ thig le dkar po rgya sran tsam pa 'od zer dkar lhag lhag 'phro ba/ me long la nyi zer phog pa bzhin lta bas mi bzod pa zhig tu gyur pa la sems gtad de ci gnas su bsgom/ de nas 'od de je gsal je che la song khong pa'i nang thams cad khengs pa dang /lus kyi nang thams cad kyang thig le dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang /de la ting nge 'dzin byed na snang ba thams cad kyang 'od dang thig le dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la sems gtad de bsgom/ de'i tshe sgom mkhan sems kyi ngo bo la bltas pas bsgom bya'i thig le dang sgom mkhan gyi sems gnyis su ma grub pa'i stong gsal rig pa'i snying po can/ ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba nyams su myong zhing brjod pa dang bral ba de'i ngang du bzo bcos kyi rtog pas ma bslad par bskyangs pas goms pa na ngo bo stong nyid du sang nge rnam pa 'ode dang thig ler (le'ulam me/ de gnyis dbyer med shel gong dang 'ja' tshon ltar go ba'i blo bzo ma yin par gding /gting nas rtogs pa'i nges shes la 'pho 'gyur med par ma gyur gyi bar du bskyar bar bya'o// des 'gres te/ mgrin pa'i lha 'od du zhu/ thig le dang 'od zer dmar po/ lte ba ser po/ snying ga mthing ga gsang ba ljang gu rnams la sbyang spel ci nus bya zhing / thun gyi phyed man chad rdzogs par bya/ thun mthar rang lus lhar snang ba'ang stong nyid du bsdus te mnyam par bzhag cing / de las ldang ba na nam mkha' la sprin ldang ba ltar zung 'jug sgyu ma'i lha sku bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ snang pa lha/ grags pa sngags/ rtog tshogs chos nyid kyi rol par mos te bsngo smon spyi ltar bya zhing

—— ༄༅khyenarlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 323spyod lam la 'jug go/ de dag gi skabs su bying rmugs byung na de dag gi dbang du ma shor ba dang / nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa gang skyes kyang de la ma zhen pa dang / sems 'phro gnas gang byed kyang bzo bcos dga' sdug mi bya bar gang shar ngos zin par byas la rang bab kyi ngang du lhod kyis glod la bzhag par bya'o// gnyis pa go don shes bya'i gnad ni/ phyi ltar dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten phyogs bzhi dbus lnga nas gang 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhar snang ba ni mtshon pa'i dpe/ nang ltar rang lus spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar sman bla rigs lnga rang bzhin lhun grub tu bzhugs pas gang bsgom pa de ltar snang ba ni mtshon tshul gyi rtags/ gsang ba bde gsal mi rtog stong pa zung 'jug lnga po mtshan ma'i sgom pa la brten nas mtshan ma med pa'i tshul du skye ba mtshon bya'i don/ de dag kyang de kho na nyid chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i klong du gdod nas ro mnyam pa ni gnas lugs kyi gshes su grub pa ste rgyas par rtsa ba'i gzhung las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa nang sgrub kyi nyams len khyad par ba zhal gdams dngos grub kyi rdzong bu las gsungs pa ni/rten mchod gong smos de tsam gyis chog sngon 'gro spyi dang bye brag kyang bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra ba las/ skabs 'dir phyi dkyil kyang sman bla longs skur bsgom dgos pas/ rang tha mal pa'i sogs nas/ bdud rtsi sman gyis gang ba bsnams pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i cha lugs can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ sogs srung 'khor/skyabs sems rdzogs pa'i mjug gsang bar hrīḥljang gus mtshan pa'o/ zhes pa'i bar 'don bsgom du bya/ spyi bor oṃ las sku'i rig pa'i ye shes sku mdog dkar po g.yas sman gyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas gsung gi rig pa'i ye shes dmar po g.yas padma/ snying ga'i hūṃ las thugs kyi rig pa'i ye shes sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ lte ba'i tt+waṃ las yon tan rig pa'i ye shes ser po

324 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagayas rin po che/ gsang gnas kyi hrīḥlas 'phrin las rig pa'i ye shes ljang gu g.yas rgya gram/ snying ga'i dbus su rigs 'dus kun bzang sman pa'i rgyal po mthing ga g.yas sman mchog rnam par rgyal ba 'dzin cing / g.yon pa rnams bdud rtsi sman gyis gang ba'i lhung bzed mnyam gzhag (bzhag gi stong du bsnams pa/ mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i cha lugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zhabs skyil mo krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ de dag gi thugs kur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rigs lnga so so'i sa bon dang / rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po'i thugs kur hūṃ mthing gsal so so'i sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas bskor du gsal bar gyur/ zhes mos la/ thog mar snying ga'i thugs rdor sems rig pa'i ye shes kyi thugs ku'i hūṃ sngags phreng dang bcas pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ oṃ āḥbadzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi bya/ thun mthar sman gyi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags ni/ rma āḥ: swāhā a mṛ te (ta dzī banti lha ṣa phyo sarba sirnyi hūṃ hoḥswāhā/zhes brgya'am nyer gcig bzla/ dngos su 'byor pa dang sogs sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ rnam shes rnam dag me long ye shes sku// mthing gsal rdo rje sman gyi lhung bzed bsnams// thugs mchog mi bskyod rig pa'i ye shes che//'gro ba'i zhe sdang 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdor sems rig pa'i ye shes khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las dpag tu med pa mnga' bas/ bdag la bde gshegs thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs shing / rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba dung dung pa lan brgya rtsa gcig btab pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od mthing gsal phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang / sman gyi rig 'dzin dang /

༄7khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 325drang srong mngon par shes pa mnga' ba thams cad rdor sems rig pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ de rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung ltar gtibs nas bzhugs pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar yang de rnams rang gi thugs kur bzhugs pa'i rig pa'i ye shes la dbyer med du thim/ de nyid kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las/ rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud bee ḍūrya las grub pa'i yi ge'i rnam par snying ga'i rtsa 'khor thams cad khyab/ zhe sdang gis bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang / des bskyed pa'i nad gdon dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus pa khong du chud par gyur/ zhes mos/ des 'gres te/spyi bo'i rnam snang rig ye'i thugs ku'i oṃ sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥburnya gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes dang thun mthar dngos grub sdud sngags bzla/ mchod pa dang bstod pa ni/ gzugs phung rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes sku// dung mdog 'khor lo sman gyi lhung bzed bsnams// sku mchog rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes che// 'gro ba'i gti mug 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs gsol gdab sngar ltar la/ bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bshad pa sku'i rgyud kyi tshig don/ 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros/ rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par spyan drangs/rang gi spyi bo'i rig ye la bstim(bstims / bshad pa sku'i rgyud zla shel las grub pa'i yi ge'i rnam par spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad la khyab/ gti mug gis bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang / des bskyed pa'i nad gdon dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bshad pa sku'i rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus par khong du chud par mos/ de bzhin du/ lte ba'i rin 'byung rig ye'i thugs kha'i hṝ (shā yig sngags phreng bcas pa la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥratna gu ru gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ/ zhes

326 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigadang thun mthar dngos grub sdud sngags bzla/ mchod cing bstod pa ni/ tshor ba rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku// gser mdog rin chen sman gyi lhung bzed bsnams// yon tan rin 'byung rig pa'i ye shes che// 'gro ba'i nga rgyal 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das rin 'byung rig pa'i ye shes khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs/ bde gshegs thams cad kyi yon tan gyi byin rlabs/ man ngag yon tan rgyun /rgyudakakyi tshig don/ 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rin 'byung rig ye'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi lte ba'i rig ye la bstim(bstims / man ngag yon tan rgyud gser zhun las grub pa'i yi ge'i rnam par lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad la khyab/ nga rgyal gyis bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang / des bskyed pa'i nad gdon dag yon tan gyi byin rlabs zhugs/ man ngag yon tan rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus par khong du chud par mos/ de nas/ gsang ba'i don grub rig pa'i ye shes kyi thugs ku'i hrīḥsngags phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥkarma gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/zhes pa dang thun mthar dngos grub sdud sngags bzla/ mchod cing bstod pa ni/'du byed rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku// ljang gsal rgya gram sman gyi lhung bzed bsnams// 'phrin las don grub rig pa'i ye shes che// 'gro ba'i phrag dog 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das don grub rig pa'i ye shes khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs/ bde gshegs thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs/ phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud kyi tshig don/ 'od zer ljang gu 'phros/don grub rig le'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi gsang ba'i rig ye la bstim(bstims1/ phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud g.yu zhun las grub pa'i yi ge'i rnam par gsang ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad la khyab/ phrag dog gis bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang / des bskyed pa'i nad gdon dag 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs zhugs/phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus pa khong du chud par mos/ de nas

༄༅/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 327mgrin pa'i mtha' yas rig pa'i ye shes kyi thugs ku'i āḥdang sngags phreng la dmigs te oṃ āḥpadma gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes pa dang thun mthar dngos grub sdud sngags bzla/ mchod cing bstod pa ni/ 'du shes rnam dag sor rtog ye shes sku// dmar gsal padma sman gyi lhung bzed bsnams// gsung mchog mtha' yas rig pa'i ye shes che// 'gro ba'i 'dod chags 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das mtha' yas rig pa'i ye shes khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs/ bde gshegs thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs shing / rgyud chen bzhi'i tshig don la mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bsgyur/ 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ mtha' yas rig ye'i rnam par spyan drangs/ mgrin pa'i rig ye la bstim/bstims / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen rab gzungs dang spobs pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu thams cad padma rā ga las grub pa'i ā li kā li'i rnam par mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad la khyab/ 'dod chags kyis bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang /des bskyed pa'i nad gdon dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang mi 'phrog pa'i spobs pa thob par mos/ de nas snying dbus rigs 'dus kun bzang sman pa'i rgyal po'i thugs ku'i hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥphyu badzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes dang thun mthar dngos grub sdud sngags bzla/ mchod cing bstod pa ni/ ma rig rnam dag rang byung ye shes sku// bee ḍūrya 'od sman mchog lhung bzed bsnams//rigs drug khyab bdag kun bzang sman gyi bla// 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das rig 'dus kun bzang sman pa'i rgyal po khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs nas/ bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs yongs rdzogs zhugs shing /bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud chen ba'i'i tshig

328 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigadon chen ces bsgyur/ 'od zer kha dog sna lnga phyogs bcur 'phros/ rigs 'dus kun bzang sman pa'i rgyal po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ snying dbus sman bla la bstim/bstims / 'od du zhu ba las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nas pa'i rang bzhin rgyud chen bzhi po rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i yi ge'i rnam par lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad du khyab ma rig pas bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang / des bskyed pa'i nad gdon dag byin rlabs yongs rdzogs zhugs/ rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa'i tshig don ma lus pa khong du chud par mos/ phyi ma gnyis kyi bzlas bsgom gzhung nas ha cang mi gsal yang lha bsgom par gsungs pa dang / sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras kyi 'brel las chad du mi rung bas shugs kyis thob pa yin no// thun 'jog pa na/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba yang rim gyis 'dus te nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bas mos la mnyam par bzhag slar sgyu ma lta bu'i gzugs kyi skus 'gro ba'i don byed par mos la ldangs shing / gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang khyer so gsum gyi grub mtha' lam du bslangs shing bsngo smon shes brjod kyis mtha' brgyan te spyod lam la 'jug go/ 'di dag gi skabs su srod thun gyi mjug lta bur dam can sde dgu'i gtor chog tshar re thon na legs la/ yang na gtor ma'i lhan thabs tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs ltar gtso 'khor kun la thun mong du 'bul yang chog go/ phyi ma ltar na phyi sgrub ltar 'bul gtor sogs sngon nas bkod cing gtor ma byin brlab phyi sgrub ltar bya'o// 'dir shes par bya ba'i gnad cung zad bkod na/ rang tha ma'i /mal pa'i ngang nas ngag tu hūṃ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis lha skur dran pa tsam byas te gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni bya rgyud kyi nyams len dang sgo mthun pa ste/ spyir bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod med rtsod gzhi che'ang / rnying ma rang lugs la khyad par bdag gi rnal 'byor bzhed par ma

༄7khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 329zad/ bdag bskyed mi bzhed pa'i phyogs la'ang sngags dang phyag rgya sogs kyis gzhi lus byin gyis brlabs par bshad pas skabs 'dir yang gzhi lus byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir lhar dran pa tsam las bskyed rim dngos gzhi ma yin pa'i phyir 'gal ba med/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa sogs kyi rjes ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ de'i 'od zer gyis rang lus lhar dran pa'i gsal snang sngar las gsal zhing brtan par bsgom pa spyod rgyud kyi nyams len/ ye shes pa rang la bstims nas gnas lngar 'bru lngas rgyas gdab pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nyams len/ thun mong bar snying mgo thur du blta ba blos /glos gyen du bslang ba'i padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus dang 'dab mar rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed tshul gyis sman bla dgu dang / de bzhin gnas gzhan gyi lha bsgom pa dang / de rnams la sems 'dzin pa dang / bskyed rim la ltos pa'i rdzogs rim lha sku bde gsal stong nyid du bsgom pa dang / khyad par ba la gnas lngar rigs lnga'i bzlas sgom bya ba bla med kyi nyams len yin pas/ don du rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len thams cad stan thog gcig tu tshang ba'i gdams pa khyad par can yin par rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba'i gnad lhug par bkrol te bka' stsal to//'di la bsnyen sgrub las gsum du dbye na/ sngon 'gro dang bskyed rim ni bsnyen pa/ rdzogs rim sgrub pa/ khyad par ba las la sbyor ba'i don yin cing / spyir nang sgrub dngos gzhi thun mong gi bskyed rdzogs de dag yin pas snga ma'i ting nge 'dzin brtan nas phyi ma phyi ma la 'jug pa sngags spyi'i lugs yin kyang / deng sang 'brel 'jog dang grangs bsnyen lhur byed pa dag gis nang sgrub zla gcig lta bu byed na thun mong ba la zhag bcu/ khyad par ba la zhag nyer gcig byas pa'i khongs su rigs lnga gtso bo dang bcas pa cha snyoms te re re la 'bum phrag re/ dngos grub sdud sngags re re bzhin stong phrag lhag re 'gro bar bya/

330 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigade'ang khyad par ba la thun re re bzhin bzlas bsgom tshang ma khyug tsam 'gro bar byas nas grangs bsag bya skabs su bab pa de nyid la gtso bor bton pa'am/de tsam ma lcogs na gnas lnga'i lha rdzogs par bsgom/ thog mar rdor sems rig ye'i bsnyen grangs ma rdzogs par de kho na bzlas pas mchod bstod sogs bya zhing / gzhan rnams thun mjug tu bzlas pa bdun gsum tsam bya ba las/mchod bstod gsol 'debs rnams bskyur/ de nas rdor sems rig ye'i bsnyen pa khyug tsam las mchod bstod gsol 'debs bzhag la rnam snang yig ye'i bzlas pa mchod bstod sogs bya ba rigs 'gres kyis bzlas grangs rdzogs par bya zhing / zhag grangs de tsam mi lcogs na/ thun mong ba zhag gsum/ khyad par ba zhag bdun te/ bcu phrag gcig gi khongs su 'grub par bya'o//gsum pa gsang sgrub skal ldan myur 'dren nyams su len pa la gsum/bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ zung 'jug gi ngo sprod de/ de la phyi ma gnyis rdzogs rim sku gsum rang shar cha lag dang bcas pa las shes par bya/ 'dir bskyed pa'i rim pa bshad pa la'ang gnyis/ thun mong phyi'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa dang / khyad par lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'o//dang po ni/ de'ang gsang sgrub 'don bsgom sbrags mar bkod pa ni las gzhung dngos grub bang mdzod nyid yin la de nyid bltas chog tu bsdebs pa las byang bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu las ji skad bshad pa ltar lag tu bstar bas khyab pa las/ sbyor ba bsham bkod kyi skabs/ dam tshig gi sku brnyan rab gnas ldan pa/ dkyil 'khor spros bcas rdul tshon dang ras bris/ spros med tshom bu la brten pa'i gtor mchod bkod pa'i khyad par ji ltar 'byor pa rgyas spros su bshams/ dngos gzhi thun dang por brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas phyi gtor bsngos pas kun tshims ltar phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la

༄za/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 331gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo/ 'byung po rnams la gtor ma byin bden pa bdar la bskrad/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ rang 'dra'i khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs rigs thams cad lcags ri chen po'i mthar ded par bsam zhing / gu gul gyi dud pa btang / rol mo dang bcas nas mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor brtan par bsgom/ de nas bzung ste mtshams dam par bcad cing de'i spang blang spyi ltar bya/ skyabs sems nas bcom rjes bsdu'i bar tshig rjes su don dran pa'i 'don bsgom sbrags te bya dgos pa'i bsgom don las byang gi tshig ris las gsal ba ltar la/ bskyed rim dngos gzhi'i thog mar gal che ba/ chos thams cad stong nyid spros bral gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje bskyed pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rang rtsal rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer bsgom pa rgyu'i ting 'dzin te de gsum ni 'chi bar skye gsum gyi srid pa sbyong zhing / sku gsum gyi gsos /gsol 'debs par byed pas chad du mi rung ba'i don gal po che yin/ rgyu'i rdo rje de las e sogs rim par spros te snod gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/ gdan gyi steng du rdo rje nyid hrīḥdamar byu ru'i mdangs lta bu/ phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa mthing ser dmar ljang rnams su gyur pa'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus te dbus su rdo rje dang gri guga'adab bzhir gri gug re rer gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rta mgrin yab yum/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dbu gtsug bla ma rigs lnga bcas gsal ba'i thams cad kyi thugs kur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed gshags tsam gyi steng du/ bla ma rdor sems la hūṃ/ rnam snang la oṃ/ rin 'byung la swā/ snang ba mtha' yas la āḥ don grub la hā/ yum lnga la rim bzhin skyi lī rmā ṭwāṃ (dzākatī/ rta mgrin yab yum la hrīḥdang ma/ mkha' 'gro bzhi po la ha ri ni sa/

332 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thig thams cad kyang spus bris pa lta bu so so'i rang mdog 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba/ gzhan yang steng gi cha la bka' brgyud bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin bzhin gtibs par bsam/de'ang bdag dang mdun du bshams pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas dang bcas pa sems nyid stong pa'i rang mdangs 'khrul pas tha dad du brtags kyang /don gyi ngo bo ro mnyam du rdzogs par shes pas snang srid thams cad gcig dang tha dad las 'das pa'i rang byung lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gdod nas grub pa'i rtogs pa klong du ma gyur kyang mos sgom gyi nges shes brtan par bya'o// de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis med du gyur pa la/ rang lus tha mal gyi rnam pa du mas phyag 'tshal zhing /lha rnams kyang dgyes pas brda'i lan stsal ba dang / rang nyid rta phag yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas lha'i mchod rdzas du ma thogs te mchod cing dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtshos bstod par bsams la de dag gi 'phrin las rnams dal bar btang / de'i rjes 'brel du dbang blang ba ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa'i ye shes yab yum la mos gus dung pa byas nas bdag la dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer sna lnga bde ba'i rang bzhin can du 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyings brgyud/ thugs kur rjes chags kyi mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar lhung ba'i sbyor mtshams nas/dngul chu mu tig dri med zhu ba'i khu ba lta bu dang chi li li rgyun mi chad (pa )babs/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ thog med nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dri ma'i rnam par nag nu ru ru ded/ ba

༄༅/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 333spu'i bu ga dang 'og sgo nas thon/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i 'og tu song /lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa'am/ phru ma phus btab pa ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du gyur pa las/ bdud rtsi de nyid mar log lte ba'i rtsa 'khor man gang ba bum dbang / snying ga man chad gang ba gsang dbang / mgrin pa man chad gang ba shes rab ye shes/ spyi bo man chad gang bas dbang bzhi thob lus zag med kyi bde bas gang ba la sems ci gnas su bzhag go/bzlas pa la gnyis/ dngos grub sgrub par bde chen gyi bzlas pa dang /thugs dam bskul ba spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'o// dang po ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs srog las sngags phreng mu tig dmar po bstar la brgyus pa bzhin du byung gsang gnas nas brgyud/ rang gi spyi bo'i rta mgo'am tshangs bug nas zhugs/rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar zhugs/ phag zhal gyi spyi bo nas thon/ spyi bo'i bla ma'i yum gyi bha ga nas zhugs/ zhal nas thon yab kyi zhal du 'khor ba las 'od zer mtha' yas mu med pa 'phros pas/ spyir 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kun la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ sngags phreng nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig rang la thim pas dngos grub rnam pa gnyis thob/ rang nyid rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pa'i nga rgyal lhag par brtan pas spyi sngags/ oṃ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥlha swāhā/ st+waṃ rmā āoṃ rpā tī// hrīḥmaḥha ri ni sa:tsitta hrīng hrīng sarba sirnyi sa ma ya/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥzhes pa bzla ste grangs tshad phye ba'o// de nas nye snying bzla ba'i skabs/ gtso bo'i thugs srog las sngags phreng bee ḍūrya'i phreng ba lta bu byung ba dang / 'od kyis 'gro ba'i zhe sdang sgrib pa sbyang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs la mnyes mchod phul bas de'i byin rlabs bsdus/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi dngos grub thob/ rang nyid rdor sems rig pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur par

334 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigamos pas/ oṃ āḥbadzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes pa 'bum phrag bzla/ 'khor rigs bzhi so so dang sbyar ba'i ting nge 'dzin de yis rigs 'gres te nang sgrub khyad par bar bshad pa'i sngags bzhi po khri phrag re bzla/ rta mgrin gyi thugs ku'i sa bon las sngags phreng dmar po rang gi zhal dang yum gyi zhal brgyud/de'i gsang ba nas rang gi gsang bar zhugs/ snying gar thim pa'i 'od kyis spro bsdu sngar bzhin byas la/ dme ba ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng sarba siddhi dzaḥphyu baṃ hoḥzhes pa'ang khri'am 'bum ci 'grub bzla'o// gnyis pa ni/ rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyi spyi bo nas 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku la phog mchod pas sku mnyes par byas/sku'i dngos grub bsdus/ sems can thams cad kyi lus sgrib sbyangs/ lus dbang du bsdus nas/ slar spyi bor thim par bsams la sngags snga ma rnams bzla/ yang mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung la phog mchod pas gsung mnyes par byas/ gsung gi dngos grub bsdus/ sems can gyi ngag sgrib sbyangs/ ngag dbang du bsdus nas/ slar mgrin par thim par bsams la bzla/ thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing gsal 'phros/ bde gshegs kun gyi thugs la phog mchod pas thugs mnyes par byas/ thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus/ sems can gyi yid sgrib sbyangs/ yid dbang du bsdus nas/ slar thugs kur thim par bsams la bzla'o// de'ang thun bzhir bcad pa'i thun gyi dngos gzhi bde chen gyi bzlas pa bya 'ing /thun smad sum cha tsam spro bsdu'i bzlas pa dang / thun mthar dngos grub sdud sngags nyer gcig tsam bzlas la dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum gsum brjod pas lhag chad bskang zhing brtan par bya/ gtor mchod byin rlabs gong du song bas 'thus pas gtor 'bul dngos ni/ hūṃ hrīḥrgyal ba kun dngos bla ma sman gyi bla// sku lnga'i bdag nyid gtso 'khor ma lus

༄༅/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 335rnams// gshegs byon skye 'bri 'khrul rtog mi mnga' yang // 'gro rnams tshogs rdzogs mchod gtor bzhes phyir gshegs// lha rnams kyi rdo rje'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas dgyes par gyur/ oṃ āḥ&/ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu rṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ& swāhā/ st+waṃ lī āoṃ rpā tī/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dharma pā la sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ ambha/ pā ṭwāṃ/ pukhye/ dhū pe/ ā lo ge garnye/ni wi byu/ shapta pū dza hoḥrū pa/ shasta/ garnye/ ra sa/ sparsha pū dza hoḥmahā sarba pañtsa/ mahā rakta/ mahwa ba li ta/ mahā māṃ sa/ mahā rakta/ mahwa ko ni ri ti bo rnyi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ lha hrīḥ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang // chos skyong dam can nor lha gzhi bdag sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das 'khor 'das mgron// zag med bde skyed gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes// gtor ni chags med ma ni kun la khyab// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde legs yon tan gter// ma tshangs spangs pa'i mchod sprin bla med rnams// mkha' khyab bsngos pas don gnyis lhun grub shog ces dang /las byang gi/ hūṃ hoḥ skye med dbyings las sogs mchod bstod gsol gdab mdor bsdus/ hūṃ/ rigs 'dus bla ma sogs gsham gyi nongs bshags mgron thabs kyi lha rnams rten la brtan bzhugs/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon shes brjod bcas bya zhing / dran shes dang ldan pas spyod lam so sor ye shes sgyu ma'i rol par lam du khyer ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bslab bo// slar thun la 'jug pa na gtor mchod kha gsos/ brgyud 'debs nyin re tshar re tsam gyis chog srung 'khor yang tshig tu brjod ma brjod gang byas kyang rung la dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs bskyar mar bya/ skyabs sems nas bcoms shis brjod kyi bar sngar ltar chad lhag med pa bya ba las/ bstod

༄༅/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 335rnams// gshegs byon skye 'bri 'khrul rtog mi mnga' yang // 'gro rnams tshogs rdzogs mchod gtor bzhes phyir gshegs// lha rnams kyi rdo rje'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas dgyes par gyur/ oṃ āḥ&/ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu rṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ& swāhā/ st+waṃ lī āoṃ rpā tī/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dharma pā la sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ ambha/ pā ṭwāṃ/ pukhye/ dhū pe/ ā lo ge garnye/ni wi byu/ shapta pū dza hoḥrū pa/ shasta/ garnye/ ra sa/ sparsha pū dza hoḥmahā sarba pañtsa/ mahā rakta/ mahwa ba li ta/ mahā māṃ sa/ mahā rakta/ mahwa ko ni ri ti bo rnyi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ lha hrīḥ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang // chos skyong dam can nor lha gzhi bdag sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das 'khor 'das mgron// zag med bde skyed gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes// gtor ni chags med ma ni kun la khyab// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde legs yon tan gter// ma tshangs spangs pa'i mchod sprin bla med rnams// mkha' khyab bsngos pas don gnyis lhun grub shog ces dang /las byang gi/ hūṃ hoḥ skye med dbyings las sogs mchod bstod gsol gdab mdor bsdus/ hūṃ/ rigs 'dus bla ma sogs gsham gyi nongs bshags mgron thabs kyi lha rnams rten la brtan bzhugs/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon shes brjod bcas bya zhing / dran shes dang ldan pas spyod lam so sor ye shes sgyu ma'i rol par lam du khyer ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bslab bo// slar thun la 'jug pa na gtor mchod kha gsos/ brgyud 'debs nyin re tshar re tsam gyis chog srung 'khor yang tshig tu brjod ma brjod gang byas kyang rung la dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs bskyar mar bya/ skyabs sems nas bcoms shis brjod kyi bar sngar ltar chad lhag med pa bya ba las/ bstod

336 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigapa'ang las byang dang gsang sgrub kyi tshig gnyis res mos sam gang rung res chog bsnyen tshad kyang gong smos ltar grub na mchog yin la/ don du spyi sngags gtso bor bzla/ de'i bcu cha rdor sems rig ye/ de'i bcu cha 'khor bzhi/de'i bcu cha dngos grub sdud sngags/ rta phag gang 'grub bam 'khor bzhi dang 'dra ba yin la/ sgrub pa grol khar tshe sgrub dmigs bzlas ci 'grub/ dngos grub sdud sngags stong phrag gcig 'gro bar bya'o// de'ang thog mar spyi sngags sogs so so'i grangs ma sogs bar de nyid la bungs len cing thog mtha' gzhan rnams cung zad re bzla/ gsang sgrub zla gcig lhag tsam byed na bdun gsum la spyi sngags/ bdun gcig la 'khor sngags/ zhag gsum tshe sgrub/grol ba'i nang mor sman gyi dngos grub sdud sngags stong phrag gcig 'gro bar bya'o// de la tshe sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba lnga'i bcud kyi dwangs ma/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa bkrag dang gzi brjid thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu dang byin rlabs thugs rje thams cad/'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam pa chi li li byung / spyi gtsug gi rdo rje sems dpa'i kā pa lar bsdus/ de nas phyir lud/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rtsa 'khor rim gyis brgyud/ lus kyi nang bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang bas 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe thob par bsams la sngags sham bu can bzla'o//srod thun la gtor 'bul dang / mchod bstod gsol gdab zin nas dam can sde dgu'i gtor 'bul/ tshogs mchod rta bro'i bar du bya zhing / dngos grub len chog bskyur nas mchod bstod sogs rjes chog byas pas 'grub pa yin la lhag ma sgrub pa grol gyi bar phyir mi btang bar dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub tu snod du bsags la khebs kyis bkab/ chad brtan rta bro rnams nub re

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 337bzhin ma grub na'ang chog dus bzang dang thog ma sgrub pa la 'jug skabs/grol nyin rnams la rtsa gsum mdangs skongs/ dam can skong ba sogs rgyas par grub na shin tu legs so// de ltar sgrub pa grub nas sad kyisang grol rgyu'i do dgong nas mchod gtor rnying pa gso zhing gsar pa bzang du bsham/tshogs mchod gang 'byor rgyas par bstar/ dngos grub kyi dam rdzas dkar mngar sha chang sogs kyang 'du byas te ting 'dzin spro bsdus 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud yang yang bsdus nas bdag dang sgrub rdzas la bstim/bstims1/grol ba'i thor thun las byang gi bsnyen pa'i skabs mdun bskyed sgrub rdzas kyi go sar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brtan (brten par bcas pa bdag bskyed las (byang )bzhin dang me long ltar phyis te bzlas pa rnams khyug tsam bya zhing / dngos grub bsdu sngags gong du grangs 'thems na stong phrag 'gro nges byas la/ gtor 'bul tshogs 'khor rta bro yan bya zhing lhag ma'ang rgyab tu btang / chad mdo'i skabs chos skyong gi gtor ma'ang phyi rol tu 'bul bar bya'o// de nas dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrad cing / srung ba'i 'khor lo gsal gdab/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul te byin dbang /dbab cing nyams chags (chag bshags pa dang tshig (yig brgya brjod/'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas te spyi sngags la dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags btags pa brgya rtsa tsam brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas lnga nas yig 'bru phyag mtshan thig le dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ rang gi gnas lngar thim pas sku gsum thugs yon tan 'phrin las mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par thob par mos la dngos grub len pa'i tshig brjod cing / gtor chen gnas lngar gtugs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas la longs spyad/ de nas mchod bstod sogs rjes chog bya zhing ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang la bsdu/ mgron thabs kyi lha rnams brtan bzhugs dang bsdu ldang bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o//

338 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigade nas sbyin sreg las kun myur 'grub ltar bsnyen pa'i kha skong du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs/ bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha gcig 'bul/ gal te sreg blugs mi 'grub na bsnyen sgrub kyi bcu cha bsnyen pa rang gis kha skong bsgrub pa'i skabs nyid du grub par bya dgos so//gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa gsang sgrub srog dril stan thob /thoganagacig ma ni/ spros med kyi nyams len yin pas dkyil 'khor gtor mchod gang yang mi dgos shing bsgom bzlas kho na bya ba yin pas/ de'i tshul zhal gdams mchog gi bde lam las 'byung pa nyid bklag chog tu bsdeb na/ na mo/rigs 'dus bde gshegs sogs skyabs 'gro/ nam mkhas khyab pa'i sogs sems bskyed/ skyabs gnas bdag la sogs kyis sdig pa bshags/ stong pa'i ngang las snang srid kun// rang byung dbang gi gzhal yas khang // de dbus padma zla nyi'i steng // bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su// rta mchog yab yum sku mdog dmar// dbu gtsug rta mgos rta skad 'tsher// dbang sdud gri gug phyag g.yas phyar// bdud bzhi'i khrag bkang thod pa g.yon//bdud bzhi'i steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs// rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor//de nyid cha lugs yab 'dra la// spyi gtsug phag gdong ngur sgra sgrogs// gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// bcu drug lang tsho chags pa'i nyams// nu ma bha ga rgyas pa'i tshul// bskal pa'i me dbus bzhugs pa yi// spyi bor padma nyi zla'i steng // rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems// mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// chos nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje g.yas// zag med bde rgyas thod pa g.yon// gcer bu rin chen rus rgyan spras// khro 'dzum 'gying bag skyil krung gi/ pang du rang rig yum gyis 'khyud// sngo sangs gzhon tshul chags pa'i nyams// rab mdzes yid 'ong gri thod 'dzin// byin rlabs gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs// rang lus stong gsal 'od kyi dngos// dar dmar gur phub

༄༅/byin rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 339lta bu'i dbus// dbu ma 'od kyi sbu gu ni// phyi dkar nang dmar mda' smyug tsam// de nang spyi bo la sogs pa'i// gnas lngar 'od kyi thig le lnga// dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu'i dbus// oṃ āḥshā dang swāhā rnams// gnas lnga'i rang mdog 'od du 'bar// yum gyi dhū tī'i gnas lnga ru// 'od kyi thig le kha dog lnga// āoṃ lī rmā rpā two gyis mtshan// kun kyang gsal stong 'od du 'bar//gdod nas dam ye dbyer med pa'i// rang byung rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor phye//ngagarlung gzhom med sngags kyi sgra// rtogs tshogs rang byung ye shes dbyings//bza' btung tshogs mchod smra brjod kun// bstod gsol spyod lam ye shes rgyan// gang shar sku gsum rol pa'o// zhes gsal gdab cing nges pa'i shes pa brtan pos nus na bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor dang / gong smos bde chen bzlas pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ oṃ āḥlha swāhā/ zhu lī māṃ bī two/ zhes grangs mi bzung bar yid kyis bzla/ rlung sbyor mi nus na bar rlung tsam gyi ngang yid bzlas ngag bzlas gang rung gas chog mthar spro bsdu'i bzlas dmigs kyang sbyar zhing ngag bzlas 'bum phrag lnga'am bcu 'gro bar bya/ rig pa'i ye shes re re nas sger du bsgrub na gang sgrub de'i gnas su dmigs pa gtad la de'i thugs srog spro bsdu bya ste/ dper na/ nyon mongs gti mug zhi zhing shes rab che bar 'dod na rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes sger du bsgrub ste/yab yum gyi spyi bo'i thig le dkar po yig 'bru dang bcas pa la sems gtad cing / oṃ lī/ zhes bzlas pas thig le yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi sku mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sku'i dngos grub bsdus/ 'gro ba'i gti mug dang lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ lus dbang du bsdus/slar 'dus pas 'gyur ba med pa sku'i dngos grub thob/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du gyur par mos/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre/ 'on kyang spyi sgrub kyi khongs su sgos sgrub rnams 'du bas dmigs pa'i spro bsdu so sor sbyar zhing

340 ༄zagayu thog snying thigabazlas pa dril sgrub ltar byas na da lta'i nyams len la stabs bde'o// thun mthar lha mi dmigs par bzhag cing / zung 'jug gi skur ldangs te bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ gsang sgrub snga ma'i gsham du 'di nyid zhag grangs gang 'grub bya/ spyir phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa khyad par ba rnams de dag so so'i rgyun gyi nyams len la zab cing stabs bde bar snang ngo // nang sgrub kyi lus dkyil ni/ thun mong ba lus la lha bkod pa tsam las/ rdzogs rim thun mong ma yin pa'i smin byed du 'gro ba'i lus dkyil dngos ma yin te/ 'di tsam rnal 'byor rgyud du'ang snying ga'i bdag 'jug la dgongs pa'i lus dkyil tsam po ba zhig gsungs pa dang sgo mthun pa'i phyir/ gsang sgrub kyi lus dkyil ni/ lha nyid sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster//zhes pa ltar ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ger bsgoms pa'i zab mo'i lus dkyil phra thig thogs bskyed rim la ltos pa'i rdzogs rim rnams dang sgo mthun pas khyad par du 'phags pa'o// bskyed rim kun la mos pa dang lha'i rnam pa bsgoms pas grol bar bsgyur bas de dag shin tu brtan pa gal che/ de'i rgyu mtshan kyang lam byed bzhi tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ de'ang bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa la 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsang gsum 'phrin las dang bcas par mos shing / zhen pa 'bras bu lam byed/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa yid la byed pa rnam pa lam byed/ sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor de de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dngos su mos pa mos pa lam byed de ltar rtog cing mos pas lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis rlob (brlab par 'gyur ba byin rlabs lam du byed pa'o// gsang sgrub ni bla med kyi bskyed rim thun mong ma yin pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa yin pas bla med spyi'i bskyed rim dang khyad par snga 'gyur rnying ma'i lugs kyi rim pa dang po'i go don chags pa gal che bar snang ngo //

༄zakhyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ tshi1bzhi pa dril sgrub ye shes 'khor lo ni/ na mo/ rigs 'dus bde gshegs sogs skyabs sems lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang nas/ oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzña na badzra swā bhā wa ātpa kokhya haṃ gas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing ga mdangs dang bcas pa/ zhabs skyil krung / g.yas a ru ra/ g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsi sman gyis gang ba/ mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs/ longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i cha lugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gas bzhugs pa'i snying me tog pad ma sngon po kha bye ba'i steng du/ a las zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snod bcud sman dang rin po che thams cad kyi nus pa ro bcud bsdus/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bla ma rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' sman rgyal sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje/ g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/gnyis ga'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras shing / khro 'dzum 'gying bag bde stong nyams kyis dgyes bzhin par gyur/ dngos su 'byor dang sogs sho lo ka gcig gi gsham du/ oṃ badzra ambha nas/ shapta/ rū pa shapta gadhe ra sa sparsha bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ zhes mchod/hūṃ/ chos sku'i bla ma spros med khyab gdal ngang // longs spyod rdzogs sku bde chen rol pa'i dbyings// sprul sku gang la gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad//rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal rdo rje 'dzin// kun bzang 'gyur med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gags med tshangs dbyangs gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod//

342 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigamatha' bral dri med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// lus bde ngag nas sems rtogs byin gyis rlobs// zhes bstod/ hūṃ/ rigs 'dus rgyal ba rdo rje sems// rang rig chos sku'i bla ma la// sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs//sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhu/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab// bla ma'i thugs kur rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa tshon gang ba'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed gshags tsam gyi steng du/ hūṃ yig bee ḍūrya'i mdog can spus bris pa tsam gyi mthar/ sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog yi dam lha'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba thams cad la zag pa med pa'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad bsdus/ tshur 'dus rang gi thugs kur thim pas 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen po rgyud la skyes par bsam/ oṃ badzra gu ru gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ/ zhes bzla/ slar yang thugs kha'i sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa gyen du byung / yab kyi zhal nas thon/yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi thugs rgyud mnyes par byas/ yum gyi gsang gnas nas thon/ yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas zhugs/ thugs kur 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad la bzla/ thun 'jog khar sman gyi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags tshar kha shas kyang bzla bar bya'o// 'chi ba bslu zhing tshe bsring na/thugs kha'i bla ma yab yum tshe dpag med dmar po tshe bum 'dzin par gsal ba'i thugs kha'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros 'khor 'das snang srid thams cad kyi tshe bcud dang / rang gi bla tshe yar ba thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer dmar po'i tshul du bsdus phyag gi tshe bum la thim/ de la gsol ba dung pa btab pas/ tshe bum lud de bdud rtsis lus kyi nang gang nad gdon sdig sgrib dang / gdon gyis byad du bcug pa thams cad dag ba spu dang dbang po'i sgo rnams su nyug nyug thon pa las/ gser gyi rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis

༄7khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 343gtams/ 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par bsams nas sngags sham du/oṃ badzra ā yudzñā na hūṃ zlo/ zhes bzlas pas 'chi ltas thams cad bzlog par 'gyur zhing / tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob par gdon mi za bar gsungs so// thun mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab la/snang srid dag pa'i 'khor lor gyur// rang la thim zhing rang nyid kyang // snying ga'i bla ma nyid la thim// de yang rim 'dus chos dbyings klong // slar yang skad cig gzugs kyi skus// 'khor ba ji srid 'gro don bya// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/ dpal ldan bla ma sogs dge bsngo bya'o// 'di na nyams rtags gsal byed ltar na/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bsnyen sgrub rgyas pa sngon du song nas spog chog gi tshul du 'di la gnad du bsnun pas grub pa'i rtags mthar byung ba'i tshul du gsal zhing / 'on kyang phyi nang gsang sgrul /sgrub kyi don dngos su tshang ba'i dril sgrul ni min pas/ snga ma rnams sngon du song rung ma song rung rgyun gyi nyams len 'jug bde snying por dril ba zab cing byin rlabs dang ldan pa'o//lnga pa 'phrin las kyi sbyor ba ni/ phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub pa sngon du song nas/ 'chi bdag bdud 'joms ltar tshe sgrub pa dang / mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sgos sgrub/ dam can sde dgu/ lha sman gyi pra sgrub la sogs pa'ang spro zhing nus na gzhung gsal ltar bya zhing / de la tshe sgrub ni de'i bcas bshams la las byang mngon rtogs mchan gsal ltar kha bsgyur rang gzhung dmigs bzlas tshe 'gugs sbyar ba ma gtogs gzhan las byang gis khog dbub gsang sgrub thun mong ba ltar byas pas 'grub/ dam can sde dgu la de'i rten bsham/ bdag bskyed las byang dang mdun bskyed rang gzhung btang la dmigs bzlas mchod bstod gtor 'bul sogs bya zhing de dang pra sgrub la chags med rin po ches mdzad pa'i zin dang yig cha lung rgyun bcas bzhugs par snang ba ma zad/

344 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigagazhung zhal gsal bas 'dir rgyas par ma spros so// phyi nang gsang dril bzhi po de'ang snga ma snga ma sngon du song nas phyi ma phyi ma la 'jug pa dang / de'ang so so'i grangs tshad mthar dbyung ba sogs ni mchog yin la yid la 'thad cing lag tu len gang bde ba de nyid khol 'don du bsgrubs kyang mi rung ba med do//phyi sgrub bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul/ nang sgrub sman bla'i bskyed rdzogs kha tshang /gsang sgrub rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor/ dril sgrub nyams len rgyun khyer re re nas rang rkang tshugs pa yin pa'i phyir ro// snyan brgyud gsang sgrub zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje la nye brgyud du bab pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi don tshang ba'i spros med rgyun gyi nyams len zab mo'i mthar thug tu gdams par mdzad cing / 'brel 'jog la gzhan nyams su ma lon kyang 'di nyid zhag bdun la sogs pa ched du nyams len bgyis kyang shin tu legs la/ 'on kyang bskyed rim ma 'byongs pa'am mi gsal ba lta bu la cung zad bsgom dka' ba ltar snang bas 'dir dkyus su ma bris kyang gzhung nyid du ches gsal bas lhan thabs mi dgos par snang ngo // nyams len la ched du spro ba'i gang zag 'jig rten gyis mgo bo ma 'khor bar/ mi tshe stong zad du btang mi bra ba snying la rus pa yod pa dag gis ni bskyed rim la bsnyen sgrub sngon du song nas/ rdzogs rim sku gsum rang shar la 'jug ste tshe gcig gis 'gro kun 'tsho mdzad rigs 'dus bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par bya zhing / de'i khrid /khrodakasrol gyi rgyun phul du byung ba'ang bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs la bzhugs pa yin no// zab mo'i bla sgrub phul du byung ba 'di nyid cung zad tsam bsgrubs pas rtags byin rlabs yid ches pa byung ba skyes chen mang po'i gsung gi rgyun las gsal zhing / de'ang rje g.yu thog pa nyid kyis gsung las/ dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams chung // nga mthong nga ming thos pa nyung // mthong

344 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigagazhung zhal gsal bas 'dir rgyas par ma spros so// phyi nang gsang dril bzhi po de'ang snga ma snga ma sngon du song nas phyi ma phyi ma la 'jug pa dang / de'ang so so'i grangs tshad mthar dbyung ba sogs ni mchog yin la yid la 'thad cing lag tu len gang bde ba de nyid khol 'don du bsgrubs kyang mi rung ba med do//phyi sgrub bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul/ nang sgrub sman bla'i bskyed rdzogs kha tshang /gsang sgrub rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor/ dril sgrub nyams len rgyun khyer re re nas rang rkang tshugs pa yin pa'i phyir ro// snyan brgyud gsang sgrub zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje la nye brgyud du bab pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi don tshang ba'i spros med rgyun gyi nyams len zab mo'i mthar thug tu gdams par mdzad cing / 'brel 'jog la gzhan nyams su ma lon kyang 'di nyid zhag bdun la sogs pa ched du nyams len bgyis kyang shin tu legs la/ 'on kyang bskyed rim ma 'byongs pa'am mi gsal ba lta bu la cung zad bsgom dka' ba ltar snang bas 'dir dkyus su ma bris kyang gzhung nyid du ches gsal bas lhan thabs mi dgos par snang ngo // nyams len la ched du spro ba'i gang zag 'jig rten gyis mgo bo ma 'khor bar/ mi tshe stong zad du btang mi bra ba snying la rus pa yod pa dag gis ni bskyed rim la bsnyen sgrub sngon du song nas/ rdzogs rim sku gsum rang shar la 'jug ste tshe gcig gis 'gro kun 'tsho mdzad rigs 'dus bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par bya zhing / de'i khrid /khrodakasrol gyi rgyun phul du byung ba'ang bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs la bzhugs pa yin no// zab mo'i bla sgrub phul du byung ba 'di nyid cung zad tsam bsgrubs pas rtags byin rlabs yid ches pa byung ba skyes chen mang po'i gsung gi rgyun las gsal zhing / de'ang rje g.yu thog pa nyid kyis gsung las/ dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams chung // nga mthong nga ming thos pa nyung // mthong

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 345thos dran reg dad pa la// byang chub bla med myu gu bskrun// bskal par bsags pa'i sdig pa sbyangs// tshe 'di'i mi mthun bar chad zlog rang 'tshengs gzhan 'tshengs gnyis ka 'tshengs// de yi rjes su slob tshad 'tshengs//nga la log lta'i sems can yang // gnod byed bde bar 'brel ba'i phyir//bde nas bde bar 'dren par bya// 'di la the tshom yod re kun// lar rang la blo (glo1snying gtad nus na// gsol ba phur tshugs 'debs nas na// the tshom yid gnyis spong nus na// tshe gcig skyabs gnas re ba na// de ma thag tu sgrib gnyis srab// dngos nyams rmi lam nga 'phrad nas// gnas skabs mthar thug lam mchog ston// ces dang / bla ma gzhan la gsol ba mi tshe ril por btab pa bas/ kho bo la lo ru btab pa bsod nams che/ gzhan la lo ru btab pa las kho bo la zla ba ru btab pas bsod nams che/ gzhan la zla bar btab pa bas kho bo la zhag dang za ma dang skad cig thang cig tsam btab pas byin rlabs ches myur te/ 'di mi bden par gda' na kho bo ngas sems can bslus pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bdag gi mgo bo asne ku'i dog pa bzhin du tshal par khos shig gsungs pa ltar/ spyir thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthus snyigs dus kyi gdul bya la rje btsun 'di nyid thugs rje dang byin rlabs khyad par 'phags pa dang / sgos su bla sgrub 'di byin rlabs shin tu myur ba'ang / de nyid kyi gsung las/ sgrub pa dang 'grub pa dus mnyam gyi byin rlabs med na snyigs ma'i skye bo 'dod thag nye zhing snying rus chung bas nyams len yun bsring mi nus shing / kho bo'i srog sgrub 'di nyid gang zag dad can gyis ma yengs par zhag bdun bsgrubs na/ rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du bdag gis zhal legs par bstan nas/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan par bgyi ba dam bca' yin no// zhes pa bden gsung bsru ba med pa'i seṅge'i sgra dbyangs chen po bsgrags pa la the tshom med pa'i yid

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 345thos dran reg dad pa la// byang chub bla med myu gu bskrun// bskal par bsags pa'i sdig pa sbyangs// tshe 'di'i mi mthun bar chad zlog rang 'tshengs gzhan 'tshengs gnyis ka 'tshengs// de yi rjes su slob tshad 'tshengs//nga la log lta'i sems can yang // gnod byed bde bar 'brel ba'i phyir//bde nas bde bar 'dren par bya// 'di la the tshom yod re kun// lar rang la blo (glo1snying gtad nus na// gsol ba phur tshugs 'debs nas na// the tshom yid gnyis spong nus na// tshe gcig skyabs gnas re ba na// de ma thag tu sgrib gnyis srab// dngos nyams rmi lam nga 'phrad nas// gnas skabs mthar thug lam mchog ston// ces dang / bla ma gzhan la gsol ba mi tshe ril por btab pa bas/ kho bo la lo ru btab pa bsod nams che/ gzhan la lo ru btab pa las kho bo la zla ba ru btab pas bsod nams che/ gzhan la zla bar btab pa bas kho bo la zhag dang za ma dang skad cig thang cig tsam btab pas byin rlabs ches myur te/ 'di mi bden par gda' na kho bo ngas sems can bslus pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bdag gi mgo bo asne ku'i dog pa bzhin du tshal par khos shig gsungs pa ltar/ spyir thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthus snyigs dus kyi gdul bya la rje btsun 'di nyid thugs rje dang byin rlabs khyad par 'phags pa dang / sgos su bla sgrub 'di byin rlabs shin tu myur ba'ang / de nyid kyi gsung las/ sgrub pa dang 'grub pa dus mnyam gyi byin rlabs med na snyigs ma'i skye bo 'dod thag nye zhing snying rus chung bas nyams len yun bsring mi nus shing / kho bo'i srog sgrub 'di nyid gang zag dad can gyis ma yengs par zhag bdun bsgrubs na/ rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du bdag gis zhal legs par bstan nas/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan par bgyi ba dam bca' yin no// zhes pa bden gsung bsru ba med pa'i seṅge'i sgra dbyangs chen po bsgrags pa la the tshom med pa'i yid

346 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaches dang ldan pas rab bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len/ 'bring bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas bsgom/ tha ma'ang 'brel 'jog dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor tsam re g.yar dam du 'cha' bar byas na 'bad rtsol med par don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur ro// gang gi lhag pa'i bka' drin thugs rje'i stobs// mos pas bsngags dang rab brtags tsam min par// da lta'ang skye bo kun la mngon sum pa// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu thog pas// gdul bya spyi la gso ba rig pa dang // thun mong min la lam zab snying thig gis// gangs can skye dgu mtha' dag phyam gcig tu// lta na sdug pa'i zhing du dbugs dbyung mdzad//zab mo bdag lta'i khongs su chud min kyang // mun la snang ba ji bzhin kun mkhyen rje'i// bka' drin la brten ci nus bkrol ba la// nongs gyur rtsa gsum srung mar bcas la bshags// 'di bris dge bas ma gyur skye dgu kun//rigs 'dus bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung ste// nyes las rnam grol bee ḍūrya yi 'od// bla med sman pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog/ces pa 'di'ang khyab bdag 'khor lo sdom pa bkra shis zur mang gi seṅge'i khri 'dzin bstan 'dzin sgrub brgyud dge legs nyi ma'i zhal snga nas skyes dang bcas yun ring nas bskul ma gnang ba dang / nye char thams cad mkhyen gzigs rigs kun bdag po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sman gyi nor bu bkra shes pa'i grangs ldan sogs gya nom pa'i skyes dang bcas rjes su gnang ba las/ sngar yang rje nyid la bka'i gnang ba dang dka' ba'i gnad la bka' 'dri zhib mor zhus te/ sman bla gnyis pa bstan pa'i nyin byed kyi bka' brgyud 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan kurma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho 'phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos/ lta na sdug gnyis pa dpal kun spungs pa'i yang khrod tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dga' tshal du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// / /

༄༅khyen rlabs bla sgrub nyams su len pa'i zin bris/ 347oṃ su sti/ phyag na padmo thub bstan rgya mtsho yi// thugs bskyed mtha' bral kun gsal yangs pa'i klong // gang 'dul 'phrin las nyin byed 'od snang gis// bstan 'gro phan bde'i padmo ci yang 'dzum// kun gzigs yon tan chos kyi rgya mtsho yis// legs gsungs snyan brgyud dmigs rim gsal ba'i gzhung // 'jam mgon mi yi rnam rol 'khor los sgyur// khri srong gnyis pa de mo rgyal bas bskrun// grangs med tshogs pa'i bsod nams chu gter rum//spangs rtogs rin chen gdengs ka dbyings su bteg/ bshad sgrub dgos 'dod nor bu'i 'byung gnas che// sku gsum klu yi dbang po thob phyir bsngo//zhes 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i rin chen gter gyi mdzod las khol du phyung ba sman rgyal g.yu thog rje'i snyan brgyud kyi bla sgrub phyi nang gsang ba'i dmigs rim so sor gsal ba 'di nyid rab tshes sa byi lor gzhung sa mchog nas par gzhi gsar bskrun mdzad skabs smon tshig tu chos kyi seng ges spel ba dge// par 'di lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling du bzhugs// sarba maṅgā lam̐// / /

348༄khya// g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ngo bo rang rig chos kyi sku// rang bzhin lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs//thugs rje 'gag med sprul pa'i sku// dbyer med bla ma snying dbus rol//de la 'dir bla ma sman rgyal gyi bsnyen sgrub byed par 'dod na/ rigs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor du smin khrid nod cing / spyi bye brag gi dam tshig dang ldan par byas te/ rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs shing / bkra shis pa'i dben gnas sogs su rang nyid nye bar bste ba'i sgrub khang du dri bzang pos chag chag gdab la/ rigs 'dus rtsa ba gsum gyi sku sogs spyi dang bye brag gi rten gsum dgram/ mtha' skor du lhung bzed dang rin po che'i snod du a ru gdong lnga pa dang / gur cu li dzā sug ka sogs bzang drug ga bur tsan dan dkar dmar sogs sman sna tshogs dang / gzhan yang rin po che'i rigs gang 'dzom bsham/ steng du 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs mchod pa'i rdzas ci 'byor yang dgram/ gtor ma so sor mthong rgyun ltar dang / phyi nang gi mchod pa tshogs kyi yo byad bcas 'du byas la/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge zhing /sman gyi bla'i dus chen tshes brgyad dam/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs gang rung la bcom/ gdan gyi 'og tu g.yung drung dang ku sha bting ba'i steng bag phebs par 'dug la/ snying rje chen po'i ngang nas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal sogs la bsams te/ skyabs su 'gro ba nas bzung sngon 'gro chos lnga'i

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho/ 349bsags sbyong ji bzhin grub na rab/ tha ma'ang zhag bdun las mi nyung ba bya dgos pa sogs thog mtha'i 'grel bshad snyan brgyud kyi rnam bshad du gsal bar brjod zin pas der shes shing / skabs 'dir bsnyen pa'i yi ger /ge cung zad bshad par (pa la/ spyir mtshan nyid rgyu'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gang gi lam du zhugs kyang / kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang mi 'bral ba ni 'jug sgo bla na med pa ste/ de la smon 'jug gnyis las/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du rigs 'dus bla ma bsgrub par bgyi snyam pa smon sems/ 'jug sems ni/ gzhan don du snying rje chen pos gzhi bgegs dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod tshogs 'bul ba sbyin pa/ mtshams dam du bcad de/ phyi nang gi rgyu 'grul bsrungs shing ngag bcad pa dang / steng nas thog 'bab/ 'og nas mtsho rdol ba sogs 'gal rkyen ci byung yang mtshams mi grol zhing / dam bca' mthar ru phyin pa tshul khrims/thun bzhi sogs dang po'i dam bca' las mi 'da' bar dka' spyad drag pos bsnyen sgrub rim gnyis zab mo dang du len pa bzod pa/ thun dang thun mtshams rnams su lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral bar sgo gsum dge ba la bkol zhing / le lo zil gyis gnon pa brtson 'grus/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i rten dang brten pa'i rnam par gsal ba la shes pa sdud cing / tha mal gyi kun rtog zil gyis gnon pa las mi g.yel ba bsam gtan/ bskyed rim bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa sgom mkhan gyi shes rgyud tha mal pa'i rang rgyud ma yin par/ sems nyid don dam pa'i gsal cha rang bzhin lhun grub tu 'char ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste drug gi don las mi 'da' ba 'jug pa'i sems bskyed dang / de dag thams cad blo 'das spros bral gyi dran pas rang sar zin pa ni/ don dam sems bskyed kyi tha snyad shes na mdo sngags zung 'jug theg pa chen po'i gnad don yang dag pa yin no// de nas

350 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigadakar gtor bsngos la sgrub pa'i sdong grogs byed pa'i 'phrin las bcol/bgegs gtor bsngo zhing phyi rol du bskyal/ de'i zhor du mtshams tho bsangs la/ hūṃ hrīḥ 'gyur med rdo rje'i ngang nyid las// mdun rten skad cig dran rdzogs su// rgyal chen sde bzhi sde dpung bcas// gsal ba'i bdag mdun thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros ri rab phyogs bzhi nas// rgyal ba'i bka' nyan rgyal chen bzhi// dpal mgon bdun cu'i dpung dang bcas// spyan drangs dbyer med brtan par bzhugs// badzra sa ma dzaḥ i badzra arbhe sogs kyis mchod/rghaṃ/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi ni// don la sangs rgyas yin mod kyang // rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i sde dpon tshul// rgyal chen 'khor bcas mchod cing bstod//phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad srungs// sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol//zhes 'phrin las bcol nas rten la bzhugs/ ye dharma'i me tog 'thor/ sgo bsdams shing rgyu 'grul bcad/ mal du zhugs nas srung 'khor bsgom/ don la bsrung bya srung byed skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral zhing gdon bgegs bden med du shes par bya'o// de nas ḍā dril dang bcas byin 'bebs yid tshim par bya/ bskyed rim dngos gzhi'i don ni/ de yang sbyong bar byed pa'i gzhi ni sems can rnams kyi khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad tshang pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid gdod nas rang chas su yod kyang skabs su tshogs brgyad dri mas bsgribs te yod pa la khams sam rigs zhes brda tsam bstan la/ sbyang bya de'i rtsal gyi rang ngo rang gis ma rig pa phyi gzung ba dang nang 'dzin pa'i sems gnyis 'dzin du rnam shes 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang gis don la med kyang yod par kun tu brtags pa'i khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos kyis bde gshegs snying po la sgrib byed du gyur pa thams cad do// sbyong byed mtha' yas kyang khyad par gyi myur lam 'di thabs mkhas kyis gzhi 'bras kyi gzhugs tshul dang mthun pa'i
