༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho/ 351rim pa gnyis las 'dir bskyed rim gtsor ston pa yin la/ sbyangs 'bras lam 'di goms stobs kyis glo bur sems kyi dri ma dag pa dang / ngo bo rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i chos sku'i yon tan gzhi la ji ltar yod pa mngon du gyur pa'o// de'i phyir rgyu 'bras kyi theg chen thun mong yongs grags kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum ku'i go don lhongs shing 'bras bu'i lam sngags kyi tshul 'di la 'di'i phyogs tsam ma shes na rim pa dang po'i gnad shes par mi 'gyur bas gnad 'di shes pa gal che'o// 'o na lam bskyed pa'i rim pa la 'jug sgo gang yin snyam na ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum ste/ dang po ni/ chos rnams mi dmigs spros dang bral// skye med stong gsal nam mkha' che// zhes pas chos spyi skad tsam du 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad spros bral stong pa nyid do//zhes pa dang / 'dir rang sems skye med spros bral nam mkha' lta bu brten pa'i gzhi dang bskyed pa'i rtsa ba med pa pho mo ma ning byad dbyibs kha dog thams cad bral ba dngos po'i mtha' la mi gnas shing / cang med gtan med du'ang ma lhung ba'i sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ba chos nyid ji lta ba'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhag pas/ 'chi ba chos kyi skur sbyong zhing chos rnams rtag par lta ba dang / gzugs med khams dag par byed pas de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba'o// de'i nga rgyal gzung ba ni/ oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa atpa ko3 haṃ/ zhes stong ba nyid ye shes rdo rje chen po'i rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o zhes pa'i don no// de ltar ma rtogs sems can la// mi zad snying rje kun khyab bsgom// zhes pas chos nyid 'od gsal stong chen de'i rang mdangs 'gro drug yongs la snyoms pa'i snying rje chen por zung du 'jug pas chad lta dang gzugs khams sbyong zhing grol/ mchod pa'i ye shes gzhal du med pa'i rol rtsal gyis bar srid longs skur rdzogs pa'i gzhi 'ding bas kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba'o// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi// ngang nas 'gro

352 ༄zagayu thog snying thig don bsgrub pa'i phyir// rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer 'gyur// zhes pa stong nyid snying rje dbyer med de'i ngang nas 'gro don sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir rang rig rdo rjer snang bas rgyu zhes te pha ma'i mngal du 'jug ka ma'i srid bcas kyi shes pa dang 'dod khams sbyong zhing / skye ba sprul skur smin byed rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ces so// de ltar ting 'dzin gsum gyis bskyed gzhi'i khog phug nas rgyal ba rigs 'dus kyi rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin rgyu'i ting 'dzin gyi thabs de nyid las ma dag pa'i snod bcud ri rab khang khyim la sogs 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang du byin gyis brlab phyir rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa bsgom pa ni/ rang rig gser gyi rdo rje de las e yo ra su ko ram̐ sbya rnams chad de e las nam mkha' chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su yo sogs gnas 'gyur te 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi steng du ddhi yongs su gyur pa las dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi la sogs pa'i byang chos sum cu rtsa bdun gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang dag pa sbyor ba'i ngo bo ye shes kyi gzhal med khang yongs rdzogs bsgom zhing / 'di rim gyis pa'i dbang du byas nas rdo rje'i cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa ste/ rang rig rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa bsgoms pas sbyang gzhi'i yid thugs rdo rjer dag gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad sdong 'dam ma bzhi zla nyi bdud bzhi'i steng du phyag mtshan rdo rje de nyid gnas 'gyur te hrīḥm ha ri ni sa bsgoms pas sbyang gzhi'i dag /ngag gsung rdo rjer rdzogs/ yi ge de rnams las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rdo rje gri gug tu gyur pa de nyid gnas gyur te skad cig dran rdzogs su dpal rta mchog dbang chen sku mdog dmar po rgyan dang cha lugs sogs rnam pa yongs su rdzogs pa bsgoms pas sbyang gzhi'i lus sku rdo rjer smin pa ste rdo rje'i cho ga gsum zhes so// de'ang mngal skyes dang sbyar na dang pos khams dkar dmar tshogs pa la bar do'i rnam shes/ gnyis

352 ༄zagayu thog snying thig don bsgrub pa'i phyir// rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer 'gyur// zhes pa stong nyid snying rje dbyer med de'i ngang nas 'gro don sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir rang rig rdo rjer snang bas rgyu zhes te pha ma'i mngal du 'jug ka ma'i srid bcas kyi shes pa dang 'dod khams sbyong zhing / skye ba sprul skur smin byed rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ces so// de ltar ting 'dzin gsum gyis bskyed gzhi'i khog phug nas rgyal ba rigs 'dus kyi rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin rgyu'i ting 'dzin gyi thabs de nyid las ma dag pa'i snod bcud ri rab khang khyim la sogs 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang du byin gyis brlab phyir rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa bsgom pa ni/ rang rig gser gyi rdo rje de las e yo ra su ko ram̐ sbya rnams chad de e las nam mkha' chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su yo sogs gnas 'gyur te 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi steng du ddhi yongs su gyur pa las dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi la sogs pa'i byang chos sum cu rtsa bdun gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang dag pa sbyor ba'i ngo bo ye shes kyi gzhal med khang yongs rdzogs bsgom zhing / 'di rim gyis pa'i dbang du byas nas rdo rje'i cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa ste/ rang rig rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa bsgoms pas sbyang gzhi'i yid thugs rdo rjer dag gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad sdong 'dam ma bzhi zla nyi bdud bzhi'i steng du phyag mtshan rdo rje de nyid gnas 'gyur te hrīḥm ha ri ni sa bsgoms pas sbyang gzhi'i dag /ngag gsung rdo rjer rdzogs/ yi ge de rnams las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rdo rje gri gug tu gyur pa de nyid gnas gyur te skad cig dran rdzogs su dpal rta mchog dbang chen sku mdog dmar po rgyan dang cha lugs sogs rnam pa yongs su rdzogs pa bsgoms pas sbyang gzhi'i lus sku rdo rjer smin pa ste rdo rje'i cho ga gsum zhes so// de'ang mngal skyes dang sbyar na dang pos khams dkar dmar tshogs pa la bar do'i rnam shes/ gnyis

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho/ 353pas khu khrag rnam shes gsum 'dres nas mer mer po sogs 'gyur (gyur nas mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga nyams su myong ba/ gsum pas 'byung ba byer sdud kyis lus yongs su grub cing dbang po rnams rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa sbyong la/'bras dus su bde gshegs rnams gang 'dul sprul skur bzhengs nas lhums su zhugs pa dang / bltams pa'i mdzad pa ston pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// de ltar rtog tshogs thams cad lha'i skur rdzogs dgos pa'ang phung po lnga rigs lnga/ khams lnga yul lnga nyon mongs lnga ye shes lngar 'gyur dgos pa'i phyir du rten dang brten pa yongs su rdzogs pa bsgom pa'o// dag pa dran pa ni/sku mdog dmar po ni 'gro la rjes su chags pas dbang gi 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i brda/ zhal gcig ni chos sku jig le nyag gcig mtshon byed/ spyi gtsug rta mgos mtshan pa ni chos nyid rang sgra sgrogs shing myur ba'i brtson 'grus kyis 'gro rnams theg chen gyi sar skyel ba mtshon/ thabs snying rje chen po dang /shes rab stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i phyag gnyis/ srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i zhabs gnyis/ kun rtog gcod cing khams gsum dbang du sdud phyir dbang gi gri gug rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bde ba skyong phyir thod pa/ye shes chen pos bdud dpung bcom nas 'khor ba dbang du sdud phyir khrag gis bkang ba/ dus gsum thogs med gzigs phyir spyan gsum/ skye shi cod nas gcod phyir mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ brlang por spyod pa dang zhi bas mi 'dul ba rnams 'dul phyir shin tu khro ba'i nyams ldan/ gshegs pa lnga dang gshegs ma bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi gar dgu ste sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/dgod pa/ drag shul/ 'jigs rung / snying rje/ rngams pa/ 'i ba ste sku gsung thugs kyi gar dgu'o// mkhyen pa'i stobs bcus gti mug 'joms phyir glang chen pags pa'i stod g.yogs/ dpa' gtum drag po'i las kyis zhe sdang bcom phyir stag sham smad du dkris pa/ byang sems kyis 'dod chags

༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho/ 353pas khu khrag rnam shes gsum 'dres nas mer mer po sogs 'gyur (gyur nas mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga nyams su myong ba/ gsum pas 'byung ba byer sdud kyis lus yongs su grub cing dbang po rnams rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa sbyong la/'bras dus su bde gshegs rnams gang 'dul sprul skur bzhengs nas lhums su zhugs pa dang / bltams pa'i mdzad pa ston pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// de ltar rtog tshogs thams cad lha'i skur rdzogs dgos pa'ang phung po lnga rigs lnga/ khams lnga yul lnga nyon mongs lnga ye shes lngar 'gyur dgos pa'i phyir du rten dang brten pa yongs su rdzogs pa bsgom pa'o// dag pa dran pa ni/sku mdog dmar po ni 'gro la rjes su chags pas dbang gi 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i brda/ zhal gcig ni chos sku jig le nyag gcig mtshon byed/ spyi gtsug rta mgos mtshan pa ni chos nyid rang sgra sgrogs shing myur ba'i brtson 'grus kyis 'gro rnams theg chen gyi sar skyel ba mtshon/ thabs snying rje chen po dang /shes rab stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i phyag gnyis/ srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i zhabs gnyis/ kun rtog gcod cing khams gsum dbang du sdud phyir dbang gi gri gug rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bde ba skyong phyir thod pa/ye shes chen pos bdud dpung bcom nas 'khor ba dbang du sdud phyir khrag gis bkang ba/ dus gsum thogs med gzigs phyir spyan gsum/ skye shi cod nas gcod phyir mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ brlang por spyod pa dang zhi bas mi 'dul ba rnams 'dul phyir shin tu khro ba'i nyams ldan/ gshegs pa lnga dang gshegs ma bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi gar dgu ste sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/dgod pa/ drag shul/ 'jigs rung / snying rje/ rngams pa/ 'i ba ste sku gsung thugs kyi gar dgu'o// mkhyen pa'i stobs bcus gti mug 'joms phyir glang chen pags pa'i stod g.yogs/ dpa' gtum drag po'i las kyis zhe sdang bcom phyir stag sham smad du dkris pa/ byang sems kyis 'dod chags

354 ༄zagayu thog snying thiga'ajoms phyir dar dpyang / phrag dog 'joms phyir mi lpags/ nga rgyal 'joms phyir thod skam lnga'i nang du khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dbu rgyan/ sems byung 'du byed lnga bcu dag phyir thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal/phyin drug mtshon phyir phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ye shes kyi mes srid gsum sreg pa mtshon byed me dpung kha dog lnga'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ khams dkar dmar gyi dri ma dag ste thabs shes gnyis med mtshon phyir nyi zla'i gdan/ bar chad bgegs dpung las rgyal bas bdud bzhi'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// yum dang sbyor ba bde stong dbyer med ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa yin no// 'khor du snang ba'ang gtso bo'i gdul bya'i sgo dang bstun nas rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las kyi rol/ mo tsam las tha mi dad cing / gzhal yas khang rten dang brten pa lha dang bcas pa gtso bo'i cho 'phrul 'gag med ye shes kyi rnam pa bde gsal stong pa'i sgyu 'phrul kho na las gshed gdos bcas rang rgyud par mi lta'o// de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol mchod bstod sogs snyan brgyud kyi rnam bshad du spros pas 'dir ma bris/ mnyam gzhag (bzhag dang rjes spyod thams cad du gsang sgrub las/rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i ngang la gnas par gsungs pas/ dang po sku yongs rdzogs kyi rnam 'gyur lam gyis bsgom/ de nas dbu dang phyag zhabs sogs sku yongs rdzogs gsal/ de'ang rnam pa gsal ba sgyu ma lta bu'i bskyed rim la goms pas chad ltar mi gol/ gnyis pa skyo ba'i tshe rnam dag dran pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi ngo bor rtsal du shar bas rtag ltar ma (mi gol ba'i gnad dam pa'o// gsum pa nga rgyal ni skyon kun zad yon tan kun tshang ba'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo rta mchog rol ba de nyid nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal bzung / nga rgyal lhang nge ba de la 'dzin med kyi shes pas zin na yang dag pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin par gsungs so// de nas

〉〉g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho/ 355bzlas dmigs ni/ spyi bo'i rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung / gsang gnas nas thon/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum phag mo'i padmar song /de'i spyi bo nas yar song / spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum gyi gsang gnas nas zhugs te/ yang sngar bzhin 'khor/ 'od zer mu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros sangs rgyas rnams mchod pas mnyes/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus rang la thim/ sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rtsa ba gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ rang rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i ngo bor bltas te/ snang ba lha grags sgra dran rtog chos nyid kyi rol par bzla/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi mgrin thugs ka rnams su zla ba padma nyi ma'i gdan la oṃ āḥlha gsum gsal la/de'i mtha' skor du spyi bo'i oṃ la sngags phreng dkar po/ mgrin par āḥl dmar po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ la sngon po rnams kyis bskor ba la sems gtad de bzlas pa ni bsnyen pa/ yang skabs su rang gi spyi mgrin snying ga gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum phyogs bcur 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs la phog mchod pas mnyes shing gsang ba gsum gyi dngos grub bsdus/ sems can rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te dbang du bsdus/ slar 'od zer rang gi gnas gsum du thim par bsam/ de las 'od zer spro ba nye bsnyen/ 'od zer des phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te rang la bstim/bstims / slar 'phros rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyi las nyon bag chags thams cad sbyangs nas/ rtsa ba gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod pa ni sgrub pa'o// snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas/ sgra grags thams cad gsung / dran rtog thams cad thugs su thag bcad de bzlas pa kho nar brtson par bya'o// yang mjug tu sman gyi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags dmigs ni/

356 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigathugs ga'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud dbang du bsdus par dmigs la/ rma āḥ& swāhā a mṛ ta dzī wanti lha ṣa byo sarba sirnyi hūṃ hoḥsogs ci nus dang / yang tshe sgrub byed na/ rtsa ba gsum gyi sku las 'od zer dmar por 'phros pas 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma skye 'gro'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad dang / sras bcas rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te spyi bo'i bla ma'i phyag gi thod par thim/ de khol zhing lud pa rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo sogs nas rim bzhin 'khor lo bzhir brgyud de bdud rtsis lus gang nas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku grub par bsams la/ badzra ā yu ṣe hūṃ tram̐/ zhes bzlas pas dus min 'chi ba bslu zhing / tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'grub par gdon mi za'o// thun mtshams rnams su tshe 'gugs byas kyang rung ngo // de lta bu'i bskyed rim gyi khyer so gsum dang skad cig kyang ma bral bar bya dgos te/ slob dpon chen pos/ ma yengs ting 'dzin ldan pas bzla// gzhan du yengs par gyur pa na//bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byung // zhes gsungs pa la nan tan bya'o//phreng ba ni bho dhi tsi tas las kun 'grub par gsungs pa ltar rung la phreng thag bu mo mgo gtsang zhig gis bkal te dgu sgril bya ba dgongs 'dus las gsungs/ mtheb srin gyi steng nas 'dren la mi la mi bstan par 'gom yug mi gtong zhing phreng bar byin rlabs gang rung byas la phreng ba rigs 'dus kyi lha tshogs su dmigs la bzla'o// mjug tu dbyangs gsal byed rten snying yig brgya bcas lan gsum gyis brtan bzhugs byas la mchod cing bstod nas mjug bsdu/ thun re re bzhin las byang sngar ltar bsdu rim par bya'o//gzhan yang mtshams skabs 'dir bsnyen pa ma grol bar du pho zag (zags nyes /ltems)log bzhi bsdam dgos te/ dang po pho ba'i rgyu chos 'chad dbang bskur srung ba byin rlabs rim gro rten 'brel sogs mi bya/ tshogs dang mchod

༄7g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dngos grub rol mtsho/ 357lhag sogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzas phyir mi gtong / gnyis pa zag (zags pa'i rgyu gzhan dang phan tshun gdong mi 'phrad ngag mi smra/ phyi nang mi 'grul yo byad phar gtong tshur len khab tsam 'ang mi bya/ khyad par rang gi zas gos snod spyad spyad 'phro gzhan la spyod du mi 'jug gzhan gyi rdzas rang gas mi spyod/ nyams rtogs rtags mtshan mi bshad/ gsum pa ltems pa'i rgyu mgo lus gos skra dang gdong lag mi bkru/ skra sen mi 'dreg mal stan mi sprugarang mal du gzhan mi gtong / khyad par khyi dang bud med sdom nyams sdig can mtshams 'og tu mi 'jug cing sgrub khang du mi gtong / 'di gsum btang na ye shes pa'i lha khros/ dngos grub yal/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas mi gtong / phyags dar mi bya/ bzhi pa log pa'i rgyu ltar snang nyi tshe'i gzhan don gyi rnam pas g.yeng ba dang / bstan bcos rtsom pa lha 'dre rten bzhengs/ yi ge 'dri /'bri ba sogs dran na bdud dang rgyal po'i bar chad du shes par bya/ rang nyid zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo'i 'khri ba ma zhugs par gzhan don du dmigs la mal stan drod ma yal bar byas te bsgrub dgos pa'o// mtshams g.yog bud med dang byis pa chung ngu zhe sdang dug lnga rags pa sna thung ba blo mi thub pa/ kha mang ba/ pho yugs mo yugs dam nyams dam log grib can dme bo mdze bshan nad gcong can gtsang sbra chung ba nya pa mgar rkun sogs kyi rigs mi bsten/ brten na bar chad mang du 'byung zhing bkra mi shes/ gnyen dang nye ba yon bdag gal chen sogs na tsha shi chad zas nor ster pa'i ngo dga'i dbang du mi gtong / bdud kyi cho 'phrul yin par shes par bya/ dmigs 'og med pa sgrub khang du byung ba dang / khyad par phar mthong na mtshams ral ba yin pas nyes pa shin tu che/ tshur mthong na mtshams bug pa dang / thun bzhi chags pa dang mi mang 'phrad pa dang bya bas g.yeng ba rnams ni mtshams 'khyams pa yin/ skye ba 'dir dngos grub mi thob

358 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigapar gsungs so// gzhan yang spang blang gi rim pa rnams bsnyen yig rgyas pa rnams las shes par bya'o// mtshams grol nyin dngos grub len zhing rgyal thor mchod bstod byas la gshegs gsol bya/ rim pa bzhin bla ma dang / grogs dam tshig dang ldan pa 'phrad par bya/ grub na sbyin sreg bsnyen pa'i kha bkang sogs bya/zhes pa'ang bla sgrub bsnyen yig cig dgos zhes 7gong sa'i bla sman pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho nas bskul ngor rmongs pa rgan po 'jigs bral chos kyi seng gis gzhung don ji lta bar smras pa'o// / /oṃ su ste/ phyag na padmo thub bstan rgya mtsho yi// thugs bskyed mtha' bral kun gsal yangs pa'i klong // gang 'dul 'phrin las nyin byed 'od snang gis// bstan 'gro phan bde'i padmo ci yang 'dzum// rigs 'dus bla ma'i sgrub thabs yongs kyi bcud// gcig dril bsnyen yig dngos grub rol ba'i mtsho// 'jam mgon mi yi rnam rol 'khor los sgyur// khri srong gnyis pa de mo rgyal bas bskrun// grangs med tshogs pa'i bsod nams chu gter rum//spangs rtogs rin chen gdengs ka dbyings su bteg / bshad sgrub dbos 'dod nor bu'i 'byung gnas che// sku gsum klu yi dbang po thob phyir bsngo//zhes rigs 'dus dril sgrub kyi bsnyen yig 'di bzhin/ rab tshes sa byi lor gzhungs mchog nas par gzhi gsar bskrun mdzad skabs smon tshig tu chos kyi seṅges spel ba dge / par 'di lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling du bzhugs// //

359༄༅// g.yu thog snying thig las byin rlabs bla ma sgrub pa'i chos skor sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od zhes bya ba bzhugasaso/g.yuthog snying thig byin rlabasabla sgrub lasakha byang bzhugasaso/e ma ho/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// gnas lnga'i mchog gyur gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal// dug gsum nad sel sman rgyal kun bzang dang // dbyer med gu ṇas phyi rabs dus kyi mthar// bskal pa'i cha nyams 'byung ba'i bcud shor bas// dug lnga'i me 'bar ngan spyod sdig la spyod// lha srin 'khrugs pas sna tshogs nad kyi rigs// bsam gyis mi khyab ming 'dogs mi shes pas// skye 'gro bde ba'i skabs med skyob phyir du//'bum phrag gso rig yang bcud gzhung 'grel las// yang snying snyan brgyud med thabs med rnam gsum// de yi sman bla'i mchod sgrub bstod gsum ste//de la phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang sgrub// sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od las// thun mong bskyed rdzogs man ngag bka' srung skor// kun gyi thun mong thog mar lo rgyus ni// gdul bya nges shes 'dren byed lcags kyu yin//bde chen klong yangs skal ldan smin par byed// blo chung don dbang mdor bsdus de don tshang // rdo rje'i rgya mdud dam tshig gsang sngags srog/ bskyed rim phyi nang gsang ba dril sgrub dang // mkha' 'gro'i sgos sgrub rigs lnga'i

360 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigamangon rtogs bsdus// zhal gdams gnyis bcas gsang sgrub rtsa ba yin//skal ldan mchog thun dngos grub 'dod kun sgrub// phyi gtor las gzhung sman gtor lhan thabs ni// mgron rigs kun tshim dngos grub kun 'byung byed//rdzogs rim yang zab mkha' 'gro'i srog snying ni// skal ldan tshe gcig mngon sangs rgyas 'dod sgrub// ngo sprod 'khor 'das rang sar grol nyams longs/gegs sel lam rtags gsal byed gsol 'debs ni// bskyed rdzogs thun mong man ngag byin rlabs 'jug/ 'chi bdag bdud 'joms lhan thabs sbyin sreg dang // srung 'khor dpe'u chung bdag gzhan tshe bsring zhing // las myur 'jigs las skyob byed man ngag yin// pra sgrub rjes gnang rgab 'dre mnan pa gsum// 'gro ba spro bskyed las sbyor dpe'u ris gnyis// mdangs bskang gsol ka sngags byang srog thig ste// spu gri dug ngar gnam lcags thog dang 'dra// bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon cha yin// spros bcas man ngag las tshogs zhal byang gsal// thugs rje'i nyi 'od chos tshan sum cu lnga// rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs srog gcig dril 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i srog sgrub mthar thug yin// skal ldan las 'phro can gyi snying la chongs thabs kyis rku zhing drin can khyad du gsod// brgyud pa mi 'dzin nyams su mi len cing // snod med dam tshig nyams la sus byin pa'i// dpon slob snying khrag dam can sde dgus 'thung //

360 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigamangon rtogs bsdus// zhal gdams gnyis bcas gsang sgrub rtsa ba yin//skal ldan mchog thun dngos grub 'dod kun sgrub// phyi gtor las gzhung sman gtor lhan thabs ni// mgron rigs kun tshim dngos grub kun 'byung byed//rdzogs rim yang zab mkha' 'gro'i srog snying ni// skal ldan tshe gcig mngon sangs rgyas 'dod sgrub// ngo sprod 'khor 'das rang sar grol nyams longs/gegs sel lam rtags gsal byed gsol 'debs ni// bskyed rdzogs thun mong man ngag byin rlabs 'jug/ 'chi bdag bdud 'joms lhan thabs sbyin sreg dang // srung 'khor dpe'u chung bdag gzhan tshe bsring zhing // las myur 'jigs las skyob byed man ngag yin// pra sgrub rjes gnang rgab 'dre mnan pa gsum// 'gro ba spro bskyed las sbyor dpe'u ris gnyis// mdangs bskang gsol ka sngags byang srog thig ste// spu gri dug ngar gnam lcags thog dang 'dra// bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon cha yin// spros bcas man ngag las tshogs zhal byang gsal// thugs rje'i nyi 'od chos tshan sum cu lnga// rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs srog gcig dril 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i srog sgrub mthar thug yin// skal ldan las 'phro can gyi snying la chongs thabs kyis rku zhing drin can khyad du gsod// brgyud pa mi 'dzin nyams su mi len cing // snod med dam tshig nyams la sus byin pa'i// dpon slob snying khrag dam can sde dgus 'thung //

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun selathugasarje'izhi'od/ 36sde waku g.yuthog snying thig lasabyin rlabasabla ma sgrub pa'i chosaskor sdug bsngal mun sel thugasarje'i nyi 'od cesapa'i thog mar lo rgyusadage ba'i lcagasakyu zhesabya ba bzhugasaso/na mo gu ru ratna sirnyi sarba hūṃ/ nyi zla lha dbang lhun po ltar// thub bstan nyin byed lta ba'i mun nag 'joms// mkhyen spyan stong yangs bzhi yi bang rim brtan// 'dod dgu kun 'byung mtshungs bral gu ṇar 'dud// phyi ltar rigs lnga'i grub mchog sprul ba'i sku// nang ltar dug gsum nad sel sman pa'i rgyal//gsang ba kun 'dus drug pa kun tu bzang // dbyer med gu ṇar snying nas gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal rnams ma lus ngo bo khyed bzhed cing // nam mkhas gar khyab khyod kyi phrin las khyab// skyabs kyi skyabs mchog zhing 'dir bsams bzhin du// g.yu thog ces byar sprul la skyabs su mchi// phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas gangs can skye 'gro rnams// 'dul phyir spyan ras gzigs dbang bskul ba las// chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po pad 'byung dam pa parje btsun birlub dang //zla 'od gzhon nu zhes byar khyod sprul mdzad// gzhan snang nad kyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir// 'phags dang gangs can ljongs su khyod kyis ni// 'tsho byed gzhon nu dpa' bo me lha skyes bu dang// gu ṇa rje yon tan mgon po zhes byar bstan des bdag skyongs sheg/ grangs med zhing du grangs med sprul pa yis// grangs med 'gro la grangs med chos ston pa// grangs med 'gro ba ma lus 'dren byed pa// grangs med rgyal ba'i sprul mchog khyod las su// mdo rgyud du mar lung bstan rgyal ba'i sras// khyod kyi mtshan tsam thos dang dad pa la'ang // ma lus

362 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigargyal bas byin gyis brlabs nges na// snying nas tshul bzhin bsgrub na smos ci dgos// kun la ma grags snyan brgyud byin rlabs can// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba bde myur lam// yid dpyod rang bzos bsre ba'i bslad ma zhugs// bla med rgyud sde'i nges don bla sgrub 'di// skye ba skye bar grangs med du mar yang // dam pa mchog 'dis 'bral med rjes bzung ba'i// ru mtshams dzñā na dha ri zhes pa bdag/ brtse chen bzod bral skye phyir 'bri bar spro// nye ba'i nye lam zab gnad mthar thug mchog/ nying khu'i nying khu yang zhun thugs kyi bcud// gsang ba'i gsang bar mkha' 'gro'i srog spel bar// lhag bsam lhag par skyes pa'i bka' gnang zhus// chu bo che la gru gzings ji bzhin du//mi bzad sdug bsngal mtsho las thar 'dod dang // 'dir yang dgos dgu yid bzhin thob 'dod na// ded dpon bdag gi rjes su 'ju ga par rigs//de yang phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i mtshan brjod par dka' ba g.yu thog zhabs kyi spyan sngar/ rje de nyid kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba ru mtshams su skyes pa'i sum ston ye shes gzung ba bdag gis sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas lan grangs du mar zhabs la gtugs shing mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas pa la brten nas/ gzhung dang gdams pa'i zab bcud bka' lung phyag len lhag ma med pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du pha phogs su phog 'phyugs gol med pa'i gnad zab mtha' dag ni bstan/ nyams khrid zab rgya bar ni ston/ thugs kyi sras dam par ni dbang bskur ro// mtshungs pa med pa'i rje btsun bla ma dam pa de nyid drug pa kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang dngos su kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par zhe thag pa nas thag chod cing / de'i byin rlabs kyis bdag kyang stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i gnas lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba phyin ci ma log pa zab

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 363cing phra ba yang ji lta ba bzhin bde blag nyid du rtogs pas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yang dag par 'grigs la/khyad par du yang gso ba'i gzhung lugs thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rgyud sde bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa'i bka' gtad ni kho bo gcig pu las gzhan du ma gnang zhing / kho bo la brgyud pa gang thug tshad ni 'khor ba ma stongs bar du rang don btsan sa zin nas gzhan don gso bar rigs pas sems can la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang ba byed par 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan yang dgyes bzhin du mdzad do// dus re zhig gi tshe/ gtsang gi tshong 'dus 'gur mor/ btsad po jo dar yab sras rnams kyis rin po che pa dpon slob brgya lhag tsam spyan drangs/ sman dang sgra'i bshad pa mdzad do//dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab la ṭī ka thugs rtsom dang / rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i khrid bskyangs pa'i chos bzhi zla ba lnga btegs/ de rnams legs par tshar nas dga' ston gyi nyin par/ btsad pos tshogs kyi mchod par 'os pa'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med par rgya chen bshams/ drung du gser bre chen gcigadangul bre gnyis/ chibs ngang pa khyung gshog gis 'go byas pa'i chibs bzang po lnga/ chibs rol drug/ ja sogs dgu/ chos ltang / mdzo g.yag 'bri/gos yug dar yug man tri'i yug ka dan/ kyi 'bi/ 'jam phrug bubs longs pa re re bzhin dgu tshan re phul/ za 'og yug gnyis/ chos gser 'bum tshar gcig g.yu dmar nyi ma khram gshog sras mo lha mdzes ma'i mgul du btags nas phul/ bu slob spyi pa la'ang gtang rag bsnyen bkur/so sor gral 'byed/ spyi kha la 'bul ba phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa grub kyin 'dug de'i dus su/ drung nas rtsa ba'i yon bdag rnams la/ sman lha gsang sgrub kyi dbang dang bka' srung chos skyong gi rjes gnang drang srong brgyud pa'i byin 'bebs/ dngos grub sman 'byed kyi cho ga zhi khro dang / kye rdo rje dang /

364 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigardo rje phur pa la sogs kyi bka'/ bla ma gzhan gyis zla ba gcig la mi zin pa mang po sta gon nas bzung ste cho ga lhag chad med par gtsang sing nge ba mdzad/de'i nyin nyi ma gteng mar bzung bar 'dug ste/ thams cad kyis rin po che'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar can du ma dang / khyad par sprul sku'i bkod pa cho ga gang mdzad de'i lha skur mthong ba dang / rgya nag gi dzo gi /kikasngo bsangs a ru ra'i sdong po'i bsil grib la sku rgyab brten/ shing lo'i na bza' can/ khri snyan rwa dung 'bud pa mthong ba dang / paṇḍi ta'i cha lugs gtsang ma can dge 'dun 'ding lhung dang / 'khar gsil ka pā li thogs pas bskor ba dang / rnal 'byor pa smug nag ral pa'i thor cog can/ spyan rtsa dmar ba ras nag po'i bcar dang / rus rgyan gyis spras shing ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ ras gos gyon pa'i bud med lngas thod par chang 'dren pa dang / g.yu bya ne tso shin tu mdzes pa zhig gis gso dpyad thogs med du 'chad pa la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pas yid 'phrogs te ma tshor de dang dus gcig tu nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la/ 'ja' 'od kha dog sna lnga 'od zer gyi dra ba dpes mi mtshon pa'i gur phub/ sngon chad tshor ma myong ba'i dri zhim po'i spos kyi ngad khor yug tu khyab/ me tog kha dog lnga ldan 'dab ma bzhi pa nas bcu drug pa'i bar gyi char chen po 'bab pa la byis pa rnams rtse zhing 'dzin/ lha yi rol mo zab cing snyan pa rgyun chags su sgrogs pa'i sgra la bya dang ri dwags rnams kyang yengs/ khyad par btsad po'i gzhis ga'i lcags ri nang tshun chad du/ a ru ra gser mdog rlon pa'i char babs pa la mi rnams sus 'thob rtsod pas/ chu tshod gcig gi yun tsam na chad song / der rin po che'i zhal nas khyed rnams rtsod pas dam sel gyi grib kyis lha rnams cung zad bros pa yin/ gzhan a ru ra 'dzad med cig dang / sman gzhan yang ci 'dod yong ba la gsungs/ a ru ra kun gyi nang nas che shos snyim pa kha sbyar

364 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigardo rje phur pa la sogs kyi bka'/ bla ma gzhan gyis zla ba gcig la mi zin pa mang po sta gon nas bzung ste cho ga lhag chad med par gtsang sing nge ba mdzad/de'i nyin nyi ma gteng mar bzung bar 'dug ste/ thams cad kyis rin po che'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar can du ma dang / khyad par sprul sku'i bkod pa cho ga gang mdzad de'i lha skur mthong ba dang / rgya nag gi dzo gi /kikasngo bsangs a ru ra'i sdong po'i bsil grib la sku rgyab brten/ shing lo'i na bza' can/ khri snyan rwa dung 'bud pa mthong ba dang / paṇḍi ta'i cha lugs gtsang ma can dge 'dun 'ding lhung dang / 'khar gsil ka pā li thogs pas bskor ba dang / rnal 'byor pa smug nag ral pa'i thor cog can/ spyan rtsa dmar ba ras nag po'i bcar dang / rus rgyan gyis spras shing ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ ras gos gyon pa'i bud med lngas thod par chang 'dren pa dang / g.yu bya ne tso shin tu mdzes pa zhig gis gso dpyad thogs med du 'chad pa la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pas yid 'phrogs te ma tshor de dang dus gcig tu nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la/ 'ja' 'od kha dog sna lnga 'od zer gyi dra ba dpes mi mtshon pa'i gur phub/ sngon chad tshor ma myong ba'i dri zhim po'i spos kyi ngad khor yug tu khyab/ me tog kha dog lnga ldan 'dab ma bzhi pa nas bcu drug pa'i bar gyi char chen po 'bab pa la byis pa rnams rtse zhing 'dzin/ lha yi rol mo zab cing snyan pa rgyun chags su sgrogs pa'i sgra la bya dang ri dwags rnams kyang yengs/ khyad par btsad po'i gzhis ga'i lcags ri nang tshun chad du/ a ru ra gser mdog rlon pa'i char babs pa la mi rnams sus 'thob rtsod pas/ chu tshod gcig gi yun tsam na chad song / der rin po che'i zhal nas khyed rnams rtsod pas dam sel gyi grib kyis lha rnams cung zad bros pa yin/ gzhan a ru ra 'dzad med cig dang / sman gzhan yang ci 'dod yong ba la gsungs/ a ru ra kun gyi nang nas che shos snyim pa kha sbyar

༄/sdug bsngal munaselathugasarje'inyi'od/ /modu tsam zhig gser btso ma'i mdog ltar 'od du 'bar zhing rje'i sku pang du babs pa las/ de nyid sras la gnang ste/ 'di kho bo la lha tshangs pas byin par 'dug phyis 'byung du 'di la gsol ba btab/ khrus gsol ba'i chu 'thungs na dgos 'dod 'byung zhing nad sel ba/ sman gyi nor bu rin po che yin te khyod bong mgo ba 'dis nya ra mi yong ngam/ 'on kyang gces spras yang dag gyis la chongs gsungs/ der bu slob rnams kyi a ru ra rnyed tshad phyogs gcig tu bsags nas bgos pas/ tshong 'dus kyi bre bco lnga bco lnga dang phul phyed re thob/ btsad po'i lcags ri nang na gang yod kyi mi dang / phyi nas gsar du rgyugs pa'i mis kyang mang du thob ste/ thams cad ya mtshan zhing dad pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur to// de'i dus su bdag gis zhus pa/ 'di lta bu'i ltas ngo mtshar can yong ba'i rgyu rkyen ci lags zhus pas/ 'di lta bu yong ba'i rgyu ni ma go'am/ kho bo phyi ltar rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa 'gran zla med pa ste/ rgya gar du mu stegs de tsam btul nas nang pa la bcugabod dbus gtsang du yang da lta 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul kho bo la 'gran pa/ra sus spobs/ nang ltar grub pa thob tshul yang / rkang mgyogs la sogs thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad thob pa ni/ deng sang gangs can pa snang ba ma dag pa thams cad kyi snang ngor gsal ba 'di dag yin la/ gsang ba ltar rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa lus pa med pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang khyad par cung zad tsam yang med pas/ mchog gi dngos grub thob bam ma thob the tshom za bar byed la/ khyad par rgya gar du 'tsho byed gzhon nu/ gu ru padma/ dpa' bo/ pha dam pa/ birlu ba/ skyes bu me lha/ bod du srong btsan sgam po/ dwags po lha rje rnams kho bo yin cing /rgya gar gyi grub chen gzhan thams cad dang kho bo'i rtogs pa nus mthu rdzu 'phrul mnyam pa yin la/ zhing khams 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs pa'i mthar/ lus kyi

366 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaphung po 'di ma spangs par sman gyi bla mi bskyod rgyal po'i zhing khams su 'gro ba khyod kyis da rung ma rig gam gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ 'o na rje nyid rten skya bor bzhugs/ sras pho mo yum dang bcas pas lan pa lags sam/ gdul bya phrin las 'gro don 'di las rgya che zhing snyan pas sa steng thams cad khyab pa zhig 'ong thang ba la zhus pas/ khyod kyi snang ngor ma mthong bas/ kho bo'i gdul bya'i tshad bzung nus pa yang ma yin/ spyir sems can las zad pa la sangs rgyas kyi mthu rdugs zer ba ltar gdul bya snang ba ma dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmag dpung byo nas/ steng nas sangs rgyas kyi char phab/ 'og nas sangs rgyas kyi sa g.yos 'byung / bar na sangs rgyas na bun ltar gtibs/ nang nas sangs rgyas kyi thang btang / phyi nas sangs rgyas kyi 'byar lums byas kyang / der sangs rgyas mthong ba dang chos zhu ba'i skal ba can byed mi nus te/ 'phags pa thosas med kyis byams mgon spyi bor bzhag nas bstan pas/ mi bying (byings kyis ma mthong / rgan mo las ngan cung zad srab pa 'ig gis/ khyi mo stod khog gson po zhe sdang gi dbang gis phyogs bcur zug pa/ khog smad rul myags 'bus g.yeng ba zhig tu mthong ba dang / rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// zhes pa ltar/ nam mkhas gar khyab bde bar gshegs pa'i skus gang bar bzhugs thag chod kyang / sgrib pa ma dag pa rnams kyis mthong bar ma nus pa las/sangs rgyas bsam pa ngan nas sku ma bstan pa ga la yin/ kho bo gcig pur ma zad rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu dang / bod kyi mar mi la sogs pa la yang grub pa thob pa'i rtags med pa'am/ ma bstan pa min kyang / skal ba dang ldan pa re re tsam ma gtogs/ phal smyon pa'am/ las dad can mi dge spyod par mthong ba dang 'dra ste/ mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong ba ltar ro// de la/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khrud cing // 'gro ba'i sdug

366 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaphung po 'di ma spangs par sman gyi bla mi bskyod rgyal po'i zhing khams su 'gro ba khyod kyis da rung ma rig gam gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ 'o na rje nyid rten skya bor bzhugs/ sras pho mo yum dang bcas pas lan pa lags sam/ gdul bya phrin las 'gro don 'di las rgya che zhing snyan pas sa steng thams cad khyab pa zhig 'ong thang ba la zhus pas/ khyod kyi snang ngor ma mthong bas/ kho bo'i gdul bya'i tshad bzung nus pa yang ma yin/ spyir sems can las zad pa la sangs rgyas kyi mthu rdugs zer ba ltar gdul bya snang ba ma dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmag dpung byo nas/ steng nas sangs rgyas kyi char phab/ 'og nas sangs rgyas kyi sa g.yos 'byung / bar na sangs rgyas na bun ltar gtibs/ nang nas sangs rgyas kyi thang btang / phyi nas sangs rgyas kyi 'byar lums byas kyang / der sangs rgyas mthong ba dang chos zhu ba'i skal ba can byed mi nus te/ 'phags pa thosas med kyis byams mgon spyi bor bzhag nas bstan pas/ mi bying (byings kyis ma mthong / rgan mo las ngan cung zad srab pa 'ig gis/ khyi mo stod khog gson po zhe sdang gi dbang gis phyogs bcur zug pa/ khog smad rul myags 'bus g.yeng ba zhig tu mthong ba dang / rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// zhes pa ltar/ nam mkhas gar khyab bde bar gshegs pa'i skus gang bar bzhugs thag chod kyang / sgrib pa ma dag pa rnams kyis mthong bar ma nus pa las/sangs rgyas bsam pa ngan nas sku ma bstan pa ga la yin/ kho bo gcig pur ma zad rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu dang / bod kyi mar mi la sogs pa la yang grub pa thob pa'i rtags med pa'am/ ma bstan pa min kyang / skal ba dang ldan pa re re tsam ma gtogs/ phal smyon pa'am/ las dad can mi dge spyod par mthong ba dang 'dra ste/ mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong ba ltar ro// de la/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khrud cing // 'gro ba'i sdug

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 367bsngal phyags kyis sel ma lags// zhes gsungs/ rnam pa gcig tu na dug gsum 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhis gdungs pa sel ba la gso ba rig pa'i sman dpyad kho na gal che bar go/de'i phyir sems bskyed rnam par dag nga sa kun nas bslangs nas gso dpyad kho na gtso bor ston/ chos gzhan rnams kyang gtso bor ma ston pas/ dus ngan da lta'i skabs su gso dpyad 'di dam chos min pa ltar kun gyis mthong bas kyang lan/ rnam pa gcig tu sirnyi rnam gnyis lus thog 'dir thob/ yi dam rnams kyis lung bstan rjes su gnang ba byin pa la brten nas/ gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyud dang byin rlabs khyad par cung zad med pa'i gso dpyad kyi bstan bcos bcoms tshar ba'i rjes su rigs gsum mgon po la phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras kyis bskor ba la lha dpag tu med pas mchod pa 'bul ba dang bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ rigs kyi bu a la la bstan bcos chen po 'di ma 'ongs pa na lus can thams cad kyi skyabs bla na med pa/ gong na med pa phul du 'byung (byung bar 'gyur zhing 'di nyid bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs thams cad bkra shes bde legs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang gzhan dag la rgya cher ston par byed pa de dag kyang rgyal sras thams cad kyi thu bor 'gyur ro// skye ba 'di nyid la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur/ tha na gzhung 'di'i tshig bzhi'i tshigs su bcad pa re tsam blo ru zin pa dag kyang / slar 'khor bar ltung bar mi 'gyur zhing / thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang bar 'gyur/de ltar na spel bar bya ba'i dus la bab pa ni/ snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma zhig lung ston par 'gyur gyi/ de ma byung gi bar du su la yang bstan par mi bya'o//skyes bu khyod nyid kyang ma bcos pa'i spyod pa shugs 'byung 'gag med du skyongs

368 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigashig/ tshul 'chos kyi spyod pas 'khrul snang gi 'khor ma sdud cig/ tshe 'di'i che (tshe thabs ma bsgrubs par ma lus can rnams la phan ci thogs la 'bad cig/ khyod skye 'gro gang gis mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / dran pa dang/reg pa dang / khyod la dad pa dang sdang ba thams cad bde ba nas bde bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro// khyod nyid bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdung 'tshob yin pa'i phyir/ gang gi spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dbus su sgom par byed pa de dag gi rgyud la de ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dngos su 'jug par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs lung bstan rgya cher mdzad pa'i skabs su/ kho bos yan lag bdun pa'i mchod pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ltar yid kyis sprul nas mchod/ mgur bka' rgya ma na yod pa ltar smon lam rlabs chen mang po btab/ de'i mthun 'gyur yang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i yi dam rnams kyis mdzad/ de nas lha tshogs de rnams thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mo yum dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das sman rgyal sprul sku'i cha lugs su gyur/ sku las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma phyogs bcur 'phros 'jig rten thams cad snang bar byas/ tshur 'dus mdzod spur thim ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa yab yum 'khril sbyor du gyur/ de yang 'od du zhu kho bo'i snying gar thim pa'i snang ba byung ma thag tu lus zag med kyi bde bas gang / sems gsal stong spros bral nam mkha' dngas pa'i dkyil lta bu las ma g.yos pa bzhin du/ ting nge 'dzin bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa las ldangs pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing khams dpag tu med par bgrod nas chos zhu ba dang / sems can dpag tu med pa bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po la bkod pa dang / skad cig

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 369ma'i bskal ba dang / bskal pa skad cig mar byin gyis brlabs pa dang /stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug nus pa dang / sems can skye ba dang / 'chi 'pho ba dang / rang rang gi ji ltar bsams pa thog tu shes pa sogs 'bad rtsol med par gyur to// de ltar na yang lung bstan ltar sbas tshul gyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i phyir/ sa 'ur rdo 'ur gyis gdul bya zang zing ma bsdus pa yin no// lar rang bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'khor bsdus nas chos la gzud par gsungs kyang / snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus ngan 'di lta bu'i skabs su/las smon dad pa 'dzom pa'i slob ma zhig yin na/ bcos pa'i tshul 'chos sna tshogs kyis ma brid kyang / bla ma de'i mtshan thos pa'am gsung thos pa tsam la 'gyur med kyi dad pa tshud par 'gyur la/ de la blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos phyin pas phan yang thogs te/ bla ma bzang por mthong ba'i shugs kyis gdams ngag zab mor mthong / de mthong bas nyams len ma byed byas kyang nyams len byas pas phan thogs mi yong ka med yin/ yang bla ma la dad pa skye mi de dag gsol ba ngang gis 'debs pa zhig yong / de la byin rlabs 'jug pa rten 'brel chos nyid yin/ las smon dad par ma 'dzom na gsar 'grogs sam u tshugs kyis dpon slob des mi phan mgo g.yogs re las mi yong ste/slob dpon gyis slob ma'i skyon kho na gar 'dug myul/ slob mas bla ma de bzang por ma mthong bas dad pa gting nas mi skye/ de ma skyes pas gsol ba mi 'debs/ ma btab pas byin rlabs mi 'jug de la yon tan gsha' ma mi skye ba yang rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin/ des mi phan gyi steng du gnod pa yong /dper na nye gnas dge slong legs pa'i ka rmas/ ston pa sangs rgyas lo nyer lnga'i bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin bsten kyang / mdzad spyod tha ma la gzhan snang brid pa'i tshul 'chos sam/ sgyu ma mkhan tsam las dad gus skad cig kyang ma skyes pas gson po sa gas nas dmyal bar ltung ba lta bu'o// dus ngan deng

370 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigasang ni ston pas lung bstan pa ji skad du/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na snyad dam chos la btags nas bstan ba'i khur yod pa skad du smra zhing / gting du 'jig rten 'di'i phun tshogs kho na las bsam rgyu cung zad med pa'i skye bo rgyal ba'i gsung la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs bzung nas mi dge ba phra mo la 'dzem pa ltar byed cing / mnar med kyi las bsogs pa'i las kham po che la til tsam yang mi 'dzem/ chags sdang sos 'bigs su mdzad pa'i dgon pa 'debs pa/ lha khang brtsigs pa/ grong dang nya ma sdud pa dag la dge sbyor gyi mthil byed pa dag gis 'jig rten gang de mgo reg byed pa gzhan yang / rung shar byi ba'i ngang tshul can shin tu mang ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de'i tshe nang yi bstan pa phal cher nub pa nyid do zhes gsungs pa'i dus su slebs gnang ngo // de ltar yin na tshul 'chos kyis dgon pa gzhan brid cing mgo bskor bas 'dus pa'i slob pa de/ yun ring 'grogs pa'i tshe na so so skye bo skyon gyi gang po (gong bu yin pas skyon cung zad mi yong ba'i skabs med cing / de mthong ma thag tu kho snying nas dad pa log pas dpon slob gnyis ka 'di phyir phung la sbyor te/ mi dge ba'i sa bon 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bas tshe 'di'i rang 'dod phugs su bcug nas slob ma dang yon bdag 'gugs thabs sna tshogs pa bdud kyi las su rigs par bya'o gsungs/'o na bstan bcos chen po 'di ma 'ongs pa na mkhas su re ba dang snying la srog bdag 'byung po zhugs pa las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzem zhing / chos brgyad kyi 'gong bo phugs su bcug nas tshul 'chos kyi 'bag ris phyir ston pa rnams kyi rtog pa 'og 'gyu la gang shar gyi rang bzo mang po bsres te/ tshig tu 'grigs 'grigs 'dra la/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa rtsa ba nas chad pa'i 'dra min mang po 'byung / de'i dus su 'jig rten zhe phugs su bcug kha chos rdzu'i sgo nas bsdus pa'i grwa pa dkor zan dmyal ba'i gzhi byed rgyu rnams kyang mi nag gi dad

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 371zas 'ju dka' zos pas/ dge sbyor 'phral la 'grib slob gnyer 'tsheng med sad sud byas pa tsho nyon mongs pa'i grogs su song nas dug lnga mi nag las rags/ slob dpon ngan pa dug sbrul lam byi la lta bu de'i mig ltos 'gos pas rang rgyud sa rengs rdo rengs song ste/ chos byas pa'i skyed kyi dod du/yar bla ma dkon mchog la mos gus/ bar mched grogs la dag snang / mar sems can la snying rje/ nang du skyo shas dang zhen log rnams je chung je phra la song / tshangs spyod kyi khrims bsrung bar nyan na yang khyi la yang spyod pas mdog rang yang zhan pas ham pa/ yang rnyed tshad zos pas skrangs pa tsam du brgyags pa/ mig sa la mi phebs shing 'gro ba'i rkang shed tshun ga'an las che ba/ las su dkor za/ chags sdang sgom/ chos dang gang zag gzhan la sgro skur 'debs/ rang thams cad mkhyen par mthong nas gzhan thams cad bong bu 'ba' zhig tu mthong ba rnams kyis/ nged kyi slob dpon gyi grub mtha' dang phyag len 'di dag khyod kyis ma go zhes/ dang por tshig rtsod mjug tu khyi rgan rus la ma 'cham pa ltar 'dzings nas gsod res byed de bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren byed pa 'byung / sngags par 'dod pa phal cher yang dang por rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mi 'tshol bar/ su byung gang rnyed ming btags gcig la gtugs/ bar du dbang dang gdams pa yongs su rdzogs par mi zhu bar/ phyag len za chog phran tshegs la nyan/ mthar bsnyen sgrub las mthar bskyal nas bskyed rdzogs la dbang 'byor ba mi byed par mi tshe grong chog las rgas/ cung zad re khom na bsam ngan gyis ngan sngags sgrub/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig bsrung snyam gyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs ma mthong bas 'jol nyog tu spyad/ sngags la rang gar zhugs pa'i nyes pa la mi brtsi bar ma thob kyang zhu mi byung na dpe cha mthong tshad bka' lung yod de zhes rgyud 'chad/ rigs 'chol byin rlabs yal ba'i ltar snang gi chos kyi phabs spel/

372 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagasar rnying bka' gter gyi chos byin rlabs can dkrugs/ gzu lums ras chod kyis bcoms pa dang / gter brdzu mang po byed/ la las rang gas bka' lung sngar thob myongs kyang / bsnyen sogs dag par byed pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ dbang chog kyang zhu mkhan rnyed na des chog pa zhig byas/ der bshad rgyu rdzun/ 'tshong rgyu dbang dang bla/ byed rgyu zog zang zing gi ched du gsang sngags gnyan po rnams sgrog chos gang zab dang gang gnyan thams cad la yang zol byas/ thang mar brdal me'i stobs kyis gnam la rdo rje'i phreng chad/ sa la dkyil 'khor gyi bris yal/ bar du rakta'i mtsho skam/ dbang gi chu bo chad/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa nub/ dam tshig la khong sel bcug rdo rje'i nang dme dar bas ma dang dam can ma dgyes te/ dbugs chad ma khad du rdo rje dmyal bar nag tim gyis 'gro ba'i grabs ma thogs pa byas/ kho rang du ma zad kha lag dang zas dang chos kyis 'brel tshad grib ma phog pa lung pa gcig gi chu mnyam du 'thungs phyin phung la sbyor ba byung / sgom chen par 'dod pa phal yang / rang nyid snod dang ldan par byas nas/ bla ma mtshan ldan zhig la/ gdams pa bcud dang ldan pa gcig nyams khrid rdzogs par zhus/ gegs sel dang bogs 'don gzhan la re mi dgos pa zhig byas/ tshe 'di blos btang / gyong lto rgyab la bskur/ dman pa'i sa 'dzin/ hrul po'i gos gyon/ ri dwags rmas ma ltar ri'i bu dang / na bun gyi gos byas nas zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos bzhin du bla ma la gsol ba rgyun mi chad du btab nas 'khor ba dang gnyis 'khrul thag da lan nas thag chod pa zhig mi byed par/ dang por na so gzhon ring hor 'dra'am phyags (phyugs rdzi'am/ ar po sogs g.yog la mi tshe rgas su bcug de nas 'bri klog tsam yang mi shes par/ gti bong bu las thug /mthug pa/ go ba lug las chung ba / u tshugs glang las che ba zhig byas/ sgom byung gi shes rab rdol

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 373nas/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid rim mam/ rang gi dge sbyong la yon tan yod med dang / yar skyed byung ma byung gol sar lhung ma lhung shes pa pha ri la zhog gsol 'debs shog bu kha re shes pa de yang brjed du bcug sa 'og gi 'phyi ba bzhin du dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa bkag gsal cha med pa'i zhi gnas brtan po/ mgo la dbyug pa phog pa'am/ brgyal ba'am gnyid mthug po la song ba lta bu'i nag tham la bsgom du bzung nas zhen pas/ mtho shos rnams skye mched mu bzhi'i phal cher bskal par gnyid mi sad pa'i klu sogs dud 'gror skye ba byung / la la ri khrod du bsdad cung zad rig pa dwangs pa'i rtsal rnam rtog 'og 'gyur sna tshogs su 'phros pas ngos ma zin/ dge sbyor nyams len gyi rtsis ma slebs pa/ yang yang mthu brtas pa'i stabs su gyur te/dang po ri la mi skye skyel rnams kyang / dam bca' rnam rtog yin/ rnam rtog la ngos bzung med zer zhing / dang po'i rnam rtog de bden pa med pa/ phyis kyi rnam rtog bden grub yin pa skad/ ri la sgrub pa byed 'phro bshol te/ kha cig rgyal khams bskor/ kha cig thos bsam la rgas nas 'jug kha cig ni 'dus byas kyi dge ba phran tshegs khag che bar mthong nas tshul 'jug lam 'phrang 'chos pa/ bskor ba gsog pa/ sgrub brgyags bskul ba sogs la rgyugs la/kha cig sgom la yid ma ches pas/ lag len za chog bslab/ bsnyen sgrub dang dbang bskur len/ kha cig gtum mo cung zad bsgoms pas drod tsag tsam skyes pa'i nub re'i rmi lam zin pa la mngon par zhen pa'i nyams snang phra mo grub rtags su ngos bzung nas gzhan la 'chad cing ston par rigs/ kha cig ni ting nge 'dzin 'phel bde ba'i dus su/ bdud rgyal dga' rab dbang phyug gis bar du gcod nas phyi rol 'bul pa longs spyod zang zing sprin ltar gtibs/ zas nor srog dang bsdos pa'i yengs med grub thob bam sprul sku'i snyan grags sa 'ur rdo 'ur 'byung ba/ srung skud/ gtor dbang / bgegs

374 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thig bskud la sogs pa byin rlabs gzhan las che ba/ 'gras na mthu byed ma dgos par myur du bdag gis 'grub pa 'dra 'byung / 'di'i dus su lam rtags yon tan dang bdud kyi bar chad gnyis ngo mi shes par rlung gi 'ur rtser mang ngo //bar chad 'di rnams thams cad kyi dus su/ dang por gcig pur sgrub pa byed dus la/ nyams len bzang ngan 'bring gsum g.yel du song yod de/ rang gi snang ba la/ g.yeng ba rnams dang dge sbyor 'dres yin 'dug na/ de gcig pur bsdad pa dang mang khyur phyin pa khyad par mi gda'/ sa gcig tu gab kyang dgos pa med snyam pa 'byung ngo // de ni rtog pa rkun bu ngos ma zin pa phub ma'i 'og gi chur rgyug ces bya ba/ bar gcod thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste/g.yengs pas mi gnod par 'dug snyam rdo ba'i rnam rtog de ga rkun ma ngos ma zin la shor ba yin te/ lam du khyer mi shes pa 'byung / skabs skabs su rnam rtog gi ngo bo ye gdod ma nas chos sku yin/ ye shes yin snyam nas blo la blo nges shes spyod rgyas 'debs re byin 'jog pa 'byung / sgrub pa mthar skyel skyel 'phro bzhag rnam rtog 'go ma non gyi rjes su 'brangs pa ste/ sgom chen pa'i bar chad kyang yin/ khebs su che na bod yul gyi rje mid /mi la yab sras dang /rgya gar gyi grub chen phal gyis 'dzam bu gling gi nor thams cad bsdus/ mchod rten dang dgon pas sa stengs su lam mi thar bar 'debs/ zam pas chu mi mngon pa 'dzugs/ chang tshul gyis sprang po gzhan nas sgo yon rdzong mi dgos par rang 'dzugs pa sogs byed/ thang la kun gyi gtso bor chags sdang med pa'iganas su byed pa rang la bsngags par 'dug kyang byed mi nyan par sgom chen par ming btags/ shes pa rgab rdzis khyer/ steng la 'dre zhugs pa ma tshor bar/ bsdad na 'gro snying 'dod/ phyin na bsdad snying 'dod/ kha nas nged rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa nges med yin/ gang shar lam 'khyer yin/ zhes zer lag len la rang 'dod pa'i thog tu ma babs na nyams len dang 'bral

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 375nas ri dwags rgyar tshud pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal 'char/ bla ma dang mched grogs kyis gros phan par smras na/ lan gnyis gsum la mi nyan/ bzhi lnga phan btud na dgra ru mthong nas/ de nyid mthong ba tsam la zhe sun pa'i snang ba skye ba sogs 'byung ngo // skye bo phal pa rnams kyang bskal pa'i cha nyams 'byung ba'i bcud shor/ mi rnams kyi za thang kyang bri ba'i dus su/ dbul zhing phongs pa'i dbang gis gtso bo gros med lkog nor la dga' bas yul gyi srid 'chor/ des 'dun ma zhig nas nang 'khrugs 'ong / stag shar dpa' med tshe lo za 'thung la dga' bas g.yul ngor dgra mi thub de dgra 'dul g.yo dug mna' za khrel med la re/ mo btsun mdzangs med de gnyid dang lkog zas la dga' bas/ ma tshor bu lon bsogs de rdzun dang phyi dus la re/ bu mo khrel/ med 'phyor dang byi shor la dga' bas nal phrug ngo zo byed/ des pha ming 'khrugs pa la bskyel/ 'go ba'i lha lnga yang / gnod pa'i 'dre lnga 'gugs/btsun pa ngo tsha med nag po chang dang gnyid la dga' bas sdom shor dam nyams byed/ der sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rkang 'dren su 'phrad nyams grib kyis phung /de 'dra ba'i dus ngan la slebs pa'i dus su 'khon rgyu dgra dang 'tsham/ mdza' rgyu gnyen dang 'dzings/ khrel dang ngo tsha zhig ya rabs kyi mig 'gran dor/ma rabs kyi spyod ngan 'gos/ byed rgyu ni gsod res/ bsam rgyu ni zhe sdang /smra rgyu ni tshig rtsub/ gon rgyu khrab phub/ thogs rgyu mtshon cha/ gsog rgyu ni sdig pa/ myong rgyu ni sdug bsngal/ nub ni lto la dur brgyags byas/ nang lto la ni sha zas byas/ lab gang smra kha chems byas te/ nyin mi dal/ mtshan mi gnyid par bsags pa'i nor/ nye ba'i gnyen/ 'grogs pa'i grogs/ gsos pa'i bran/ rang gi lus tshun 'khrugs pa'i phyogs su btang nas/ dme 'thab/dug 'dzings/ mna' za/ drug 'thung / dam med las khrel med la phud kyang / tshe 'di'i dgra la zad dus med pas gcig nas gnyis su ldang ba rten

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 375nas ri dwags rgyar tshud pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal 'char/ bla ma dang mched grogs kyis gros phan par smras na/ lan gnyis gsum la mi nyan/ bzhi lnga phan btud na dgra ru mthong nas/ de nyid mthong ba tsam la zhe sun pa'i snang ba skye ba sogs 'byung ngo // skye bo phal pa rnams kyang bskal pa'i cha nyams 'byung ba'i bcud shor/ mi rnams kyi za thang kyang bri ba'i dus su/ dbul zhing phongs pa'i dbang gis gtso bo gros med lkog nor la dga' bas yul gyi srid 'chor/ des 'dun ma zhig nas nang 'khrugs 'ong / stag shar dpa' med tshe lo za 'thung la dga' bas g.yul ngor dgra mi thub de dgra 'dul g.yo dug mna' za khrel med la re/ mo btsun mdzangs med de gnyid dang lkog zas la dga' bas/ ma tshor bu lon bsogs de rdzun dang phyi dus la re/ bu mo khrel/ med 'phyor dang byi shor la dga' bas nal phrug ngo zo byed/ des pha ming 'khrugs pa la bskyel/ 'go ba'i lha lnga yang / gnod pa'i 'dre lnga 'gugs/btsun pa ngo tsha med nag po chang dang gnyid la dga' bas sdom shor dam nyams byed/ der sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rkang 'dren su 'phrad nyams grib kyis phung /de 'dra ba'i dus ngan la slebs pa'i dus su 'khon rgyu dgra dang 'tsham/ mdza' rgyu gnyen dang 'dzings/ khrel dang ngo tsha zhig ya rabs kyi mig 'gran dor/ma rabs kyi spyod ngan 'gos/ byed rgyu ni gsod res/ bsam rgyu ni zhe sdang /smra rgyu ni tshig rtsub/ gon rgyu khrab phub/ thogs rgyu mtshon cha/ gsog rgyu ni sdig pa/ myong rgyu ni sdug bsngal/ nub ni lto la dur brgyags byas/ nang lto la ni sha zas byas/ lab gang smra kha chems byas te/ nyin mi dal/ mtshan mi gnyid par bsags pa'i nor/ nye ba'i gnyen/ 'grogs pa'i grogs/ gsos pa'i bran/ rang gi lus tshun 'khrugs pa'i phyogs su btang nas/ dme 'thab/dug 'dzings/ mna' za/ drug 'thung / dam med las khrel med la phud kyang / tshe 'di'i dgra la zad dus med pas gcig nas gnyis su ldang ba rten

376 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thiga'abrel gyi chos nyid yin la/ de'i ngang la mi tshe zad nas med de/ 'chi ba slobs dus dmyal ba'i grong khyer chen po grub nas/ 'phral phugs gnyis ka sdug bsngal srog rlung can g.yang la lcebs pa'am/ phye ma sleb /lebakamar me la mchongs pa lta bur 'byung rkyen de rnams la brten nas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma thams cad thugs khros/ nam mkha'i lha dran nas sa 'og lto 'phye yan chad kyi snang srid sde brgyad rang dbang med par 'khrugs/ de rnams kyi kha rlangs dang ma mo rnams kyis nad rkyal kha phye nas nad kyi char phab/mtshon gyi dru bu brkyang / thun gyi ser ba 'brub ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams su nad kyi du ru ka zhes bya nad rigs bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang sman pas ming 'dogs mi shes pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'ongs nas ma rnams glo bur du mi bzod par byed cing / gzhan yang mu ge dang / phyugs nad dang /dus ma yin pa'i char dang / than pa dang / rlung nad thog gsha' zhud sogs char rlung 'tshubs pa lta bus skye bo rnams la bde ba'i go skabs med pa 'byung /de'i dus su sman pa byin rlabs nyams pa'i stobs kyis gso dpyad kyang dar la ma smin pa 'byung ste/ gzhung che ba rnams ni slob dpon gyis 'chad mi nas te/slob ma'i don du rang gi bya ba stabs gcog mi phod do// slob mas kyang nyan mi nus te/ nyin gcig gi las stabs sam/ nub gcig gi gnyid stabs ma bcag dka' ba ma spyad/ phyag rten ma shor bar gzhung lugs thams cad shes par 'dod/ za ba las mid pa rings/ mgo ma 'tshos pa nas mig tshil 'dod/ khu ba ma 'thungs pa nas tshig ma snyabs/ slob long med pa nas brin pa zhig 'dod/ gzhung chen glegs bam mthong bas 'jigs skrag skye zhing /dpe chung lung med shog dril gar 'dug 'tshol/ der gzhung che ba 'chad nyan nub pa'i dbang gis/ thur ma dang gtar sreg sogs kyi gal che ba'i phyag len dang / rin po che sogs kyi smar khrid ni rgyun chad/ sman gyi ngo sprod lag len/

376 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thiga'abrel gyi chos nyid yin la/ de'i ngang la mi tshe zad nas med de/ 'chi ba slobs dus dmyal ba'i grong khyer chen po grub nas/ 'phral phugs gnyis ka sdug bsngal srog rlung can g.yang la lcebs pa'am/ phye ma sleb /lebakamar me la mchongs pa lta bur 'byung rkyen de rnams la brten nas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma thams cad thugs khros/ nam mkha'i lha dran nas sa 'og lto 'phye yan chad kyi snang srid sde brgyad rang dbang med par 'khrugs/ de rnams kyi kha rlangs dang ma mo rnams kyis nad rkyal kha phye nas nad kyi char phab/mtshon gyi dru bu brkyang / thun gyi ser ba 'brub ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams su nad kyi du ru ka zhes bya nad rigs bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang sman pas ming 'dogs mi shes pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'ongs nas ma rnams glo bur du mi bzod par byed cing / gzhan yang mu ge dang / phyugs nad dang /dus ma yin pa'i char dang / than pa dang / rlung nad thog gsha' zhud sogs char rlung 'tshubs pa lta bus skye bo rnams la bde ba'i go skabs med pa 'byung /de'i dus su sman pa byin rlabs nyams pa'i stobs kyis gso dpyad kyang dar la ma smin pa 'byung ste/ gzhung che ba rnams ni slob dpon gyis 'chad mi nas te/slob ma'i don du rang gi bya ba stabs gcog mi phod do// slob mas kyang nyan mi nus te/ nyin gcig gi las stabs sam/ nub gcig gi gnyid stabs ma bcag dka' ba ma spyad/ phyag rten ma shor bar gzhung lugs thams cad shes par 'dod/ za ba las mid pa rings/ mgo ma 'tshos pa nas mig tshil 'dod/ khu ba ma 'thungs pa nas tshig ma snyabs/ slob long med pa nas brin pa zhig 'dod/ gzhung chen glegs bam mthong bas 'jigs skrag skye zhing /dpe chung lung med shog dril gar 'dug 'tshol/ der gzhung che ba 'chad nyan nub pa'i dbang gis/ thur ma dang gtar sreg sogs kyi gal che ba'i phyag len dang / rin po che sogs kyi smar khrid ni rgyun chad/ sman gyi ngo sprod lag len/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 377rgan rabs rmongs pa'i ngag rgyun ma dag pa rnams ni ri bong gi cal ltar kun tu dar/ mig 'bras del gsum la sogs pa'i man ngag phran tshegs rnams la yang mi mkhas pa'i mkhas khyad byas nas mi re'i rang bzo re bsres te/ tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma bzhin du bslad/ bka' lung byin rlabs myong khrid zab mo ni ming yang mi grag gzhan gyi lad mo'am/ nad pa rgan goms rgyab phyogs ltos tsam/ yig nag re re bltas shing sman pa'i rtags tsam bzung nas/ 'bem rgyus med la 'ol tshod mda' 'phen nam/ dgra gnyen 'dres ma'i gseb tu rdo char phab nas dgra la mi phog gnyen la phog pa mkhar rje la re ba dang / yang gnyen bsad pa sangs nas stabs legs dus dgra re tsam gsod pa ste chad pa ltar lag nyes su mi gsod pa rnams gdon dang sngon las la khag bkal/ srin bus zos rjes kyi yi ge gar stabs legs gsos nas/ khrel ngo tshar 'khyer nas/ngedagazhung rgya mi shes bshad rgyud med kyang nad thog tu phan thogs 'di 'dra byed pa yin zhes mgrin pa brgyangs nas smra ba 'byung ste shes pa yang min/ mi shes pa yang min/ sman pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam ni sa 'og nas grog tshang rdol ba ltar yul khams kun tu khyab/ la la bdud nyid sman pa'i cha lugs su bsgyur nas mi srog phye ltar 'gam/ sman pa sna sbyangs nges med kyi steng du chags sdang me ltar 'bar zhing / byang sems snying rje dang bral bas nad pa 'byor ldan myur du 'tsho ba yang / yon la brtsegs pa'i phyir nad dkrugs pa dang sman log gtong bar byed cing / nad pa 'tsho 'phro la yang rang ma mgu na myur du gsos pa las yun sbyong dga' ba'i sems bskyed go log go/ snyigs ma'i nang nas kyang snyigs mar gyur pa'i spyod ngan thams cad chang langs pa bzhin bdo/ khyad par sman dpyad dam pa'i chos su mi brtsi zhing / sman pa'i dpon slob dam tshig bsrung mkhan med pa'i dus ngan 'byung / de ltar gso rig bstan pa ming gi lhag mar gyur pa'i dus su nad drag pos lus gzir te/

378 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadabugs chad khar sman bzang pos slebs nas 'chi bdag bzlog pa'am/ me tog nyi mas rnyid pa la chu bsil bran nam/ me stag phra mo thabs kyis gsos pas mthar me chen 'bar ba ltar rgyal bas bsngags pa'i gzhung bzang bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di nyid dus gsum sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyi dpung dang / bdag gi smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ yul mtha' dbus kun tu dar nas/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa nyin mor byed cing / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phan thogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// de la phyi ltar gnas lnga la mkhas pa maṇa chen yin par yang /nyid kyi gsung las/ gangs can gyi khrod kyi g.yu thog mgon// 'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes bzung bas// nang dang gtan tshigs sgra rig dang // bzo dang gso ba rig pa yi// tshig don kun la mkhas par gyur// rgya gar 'phags yul lan drug phyin// ma hā rā dza'i mchod gnas byas// mu stegs ston pa dregs pa can// dpon slob lnga brgya rig pas bcom// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byas// rdo rje gdan du slebs pa'i tshe// paṇa chen mang po'i tshogs dpon bgyis// mkhas pa 'tshogs pa'i gtsug rgyan yin// rang 'dod mi shes drang gtam lags// zhes gsungs pas/ gnas lnga kun la ma rmongs mkhas gyur kyang // nga rgyal dang bral gso ba gtso bor ston// byams dang snying rje che ba'i lag rjes yin// nga yi bu kun mtho 'dod drag /grags 'dod spongs// snying rje che na gang byas chos su 'gro// snying rje ngo bo gdod nas stong pa nyid// zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin// ngang nas thog med pha ma sems can la//drin lan phyi dal mi bzhag 'phral mar gzhal// dge ba gang byas dmigs med dge rtsa bsngo// nga ni mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'gro// zhes gsungs/ grub pa'i dbang phyug pa'i zhal gyis bzhes pa yang / zhing 'di'i gdul bya phal che

378 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadabugs chad khar sman bzang pos slebs nas 'chi bdag bzlog pa'am/ me tog nyi mas rnyid pa la chu bsil bran nam/ me stag phra mo thabs kyis gsos pas mthar me chen 'bar ba ltar rgyal bas bsngags pa'i gzhung bzang bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di nyid dus gsum sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyi dpung dang / bdag gi smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ yul mtha' dbus kun tu dar nas/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa nyin mor byed cing / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phan thogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// de la phyi ltar gnas lnga la mkhas pa maṇa chen yin par yang /nyid kyi gsung las/ gangs can gyi khrod kyi g.yu thog mgon// 'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes bzung bas// nang dang gtan tshigs sgra rig dang // bzo dang gso ba rig pa yi// tshig don kun la mkhas par gyur// rgya gar 'phags yul lan drug phyin// ma hā rā dza'i mchod gnas byas// mu stegs ston pa dregs pa can// dpon slob lnga brgya rig pas bcom// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byas// rdo rje gdan du slebs pa'i tshe// paṇa chen mang po'i tshogs dpon bgyis// mkhas pa 'tshogs pa'i gtsug rgyan yin// rang 'dod mi shes drang gtam lags// zhes gsungs pas/ gnas lnga kun la ma rmongs mkhas gyur kyang // nga rgyal dang bral gso ba gtso bor ston// byams dang snying rje che ba'i lag rjes yin// nga yi bu kun mtho 'dod drag /grags 'dod spongs// snying rje che na gang byas chos su 'gro// snying rje ngo bo gdod nas stong pa nyid// zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin// ngang nas thog med pha ma sems can la//drin lan phyi dal mi bzhag 'phral mar gzhal// dge ba gang byas dmigs med dge rtsa bsngo// nga ni mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'gro// zhes gsungs/ grub pa'i dbang phyug pa'i zhal gyis bzhes pa yang / zhing 'di'i gdul bya phal che

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 379ba'i don tshar nas/ dag pa'i zhing gzhan du theg khar zhal snga nas grwa bu slob yon bdag la sogs lha mi'i tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbus chos dang 'jig rten dga' ston bsam las 'das pa gnang ba'i rjes su/ thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gong nas rdo rje'i mgur bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po gsungs pa'i nang nas 'di yang gsungs pa/ kwa ye gson dang skal ldan kun//legs par gson dang 'jig rten mi// lhag par 'dir 'tshogs lha mi rnams//khyod sngon chad ma nyan dgu nyan yang // 'khrul tshig cal col lung ma bstan//de ring nyan pa don chen yin// sngon chad ma bltas dgu bltas kyang // 'khrul snang rdzun gyi ri mo yin// de ring ltos dang sgrib gnyis dag/ mi nga ngo khyod kyis ma shes na// nga bde gshegs kun gyi pho nya yin// lus can rnams kyi skyabs mgon yin// brtan g.yo shes byas gar khyab tu// nga yi lus ngag yid kyis khyab// sgyu lus gzugs kyi phung po yin// yi dam lha tshogs ngo bo grub//snyigs ma gdos bcas rang sar dag/ 'ja' tshon lta bur ngos bzung ste//chu zla'i gar bzhin cir yang 'char// ngag grag stong brag ca'i glu dbyangs las// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrog/ gang la gang 'dul chos char 'bebs// sems can smin grol lam la 'god// sems gsal stong spros bral gnyug ma'i ngang // bde chen khyab la rgyun chad med// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas// sgros mtshan rang sar thim nas gda'// nga skad cig gcig gis bye brag 'byed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhing khams brgya ru dus gcig 'gro// sangs rgyas brgya dang dus gcig 'jal// sprul ba brgya yang dus gcig 'gyen// sems can brgya ni dus gcig 'dren// zad par zil gnon thams cad 'grub// the tshom med par mos gus bgyi// som nyi med par gsol ba thob// rang snang ma dag rab rib kyis// de dag thams cad ma mthong yang // kun gyi mthun snang grub pa la// nang dug gsum gyi rnam

380 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigartog sems kyi nad// phyi rlung mkhris bad kun lus kyi nad// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sman gyi gsos// sman pa zer na nga la bgyi// chos bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur blo nas 'chad// mu stegs rgol ngan rigs pas bcom sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs// mkhas pa zer na nga la zer// lha dpal gyi ril phyin pa'i tshe// mi rgod jag pas bar du bcad// lta stangs gcig gis thams cad rengs// grub thob zer na nga la zer// nub phyogs o rgyan yul du phyin pa'i tshe// sha za mkha' 'gros gnam lcags phab// sdigs mdzub gtad pas mkha' 'gro 'gyel// grub thob zer na nga la zer// siṅgā'i gling du phyin pa'i tshe// gru rdzing chu bo'i dbus su zhig/ bya bzhin 'phur nas grogs kyang bsgral// grub thob zer na nga la zer// ka la tshal du phyin pa'i tshe//dug sbrul kha rlangs mun ltar gtibs// snying rje bsgoms pas myur du zhi//grub thob zer na nga la zer// stag gzig yul du phyin pa'i tshe// sog po'i dmag dang 'phrad pa'i dus// brag ri phar thal tshur thal phug/ grub thob zer na nga la zer// bal yul 'phags pa shing kun tu// bon dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa'i tshe// nyin phyed bar du nam mkhar bsdad// grub thob zer na nga la zer// rdo rje gdan nas gangs can ljongs// nyin lam gcig la bcad nas 'ongs// gnas 'dir me tog skyes su khyer// grub thob zer na nga la zer//gtsang gi tshong 'dus 'gur mo ru// rta bdun rgyal po btson du bzung // sman rgyal gser mdog char tu phab// grub thob zer na nga la zer// lar de 'dra brjod pas zad mtha' med// sems la rang dbang thob pa'i mi// sa chu me rlung lha 'dre sogs// brtan g.yo'i dgra yis brdzi mi nus// mkha' la 'phur na bya las mgyogs// chu la 'dzul na thogs rdugs med// ri bo 'bigs na gnam lcags thog/ me dpung dbus su me lha yin// dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams chung // nga mthong nga ming thos pa nyung // mthong thos dran

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 381reg dad pa la// byang chub bla med myu gu bskrun// bskal bar bsags pa'i sdig pa sbyangs// tshe 'di'i mi mthun bar chad bzlog/ rang 'tshengs gzhan 'tshengs gnyis ka 'tshengs// de yi rjes su slob tshad 'tshengs// nga la log lta'i sems can yang // gnod byed bde bar 'brel ba'i phyir// bde nas bde bar 'dren par bya// 'di la the tshom yod re kun// lar rang la blo snying gtad nus na// gsol ba phur tshugs 'debs nus na// the tshom yid gnyis spong nus na// tshe gcig skyabs gnas re ba na// de ma thag tu sgrib gnyis srab// dngos nyams rmi lam nga 'phrad na// gnas skabs mthar thug lam mchog ston// da lta bzhugs dang slad kyis byon// bu dang slob mas de ltar dgongs// re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs// da ni mi bskyod gnas su 'gro// zhes sogs dang / sman pa rnams la sgos kyi bka' rtsal (stsal yang bka' rgya ma na lar gsal zhing / shin tu zhib par zhus lan gyi tshul du gnang nas/ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa drug pa la/ 'ja' 'od me tog gi char phab/ lta'i (lha'i rol mo la sogs ltas ngo mtshar can dpag tu med pa'i spyan 'dren dang bcas nas/sku lus de nyid ma spangs par/ la las seng ge/ la las khyu mchog la las khyung chibs par mthong ste/ bya rgod gnam 'phang gcod pa ltar je mtho je mthor mkha' spyod du gshegs te/ zhib par rnam thar du shes so//de ltar mkhas grub 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba sprul pa'i skyes mchog dam pa 'di/ srid zhi kun gyi dpal yin kyang / khyad par lus can mi na par gnas par 'dod pa dang / na ba gso bar 'dod pa thams cad thugs brtse bar dgongs pa la gnyis te/ gso rig kho na gtso bor ston tshul dang / de'i gnad kyang phyi rabs skal bar ldan pa rnams la thugs kyi nying khu zab mo bla sgrub gdams pa'i tshul gnyis las/

382 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadang po ni shog dril skor gsum las/ kho bo g.yu thog mgon po ni// lo brgyad lon nas sman dpyad bskyangs// thugs ka chos kyi 'khor lo nas//gso dpyad rin chen gter byung ste// phyi rabs rjes 'jug gso ba'i phyir//zhes pa dang / bdag 'dra g.yu thog mgon po ni// mi lo bdun cu rtsa drug tu//rin chen gso dpyad rgyud thos pas// kun ta'i zhing du lcang lo nag po'i rgyud//wā rā nā sīr yan lag brgyad pa dang / so ma rā dza phan pa'i mdo dang ni//rin chen spungs pa zhes bya ku mu ta// reg pa rtsa mdo srog skyabs ti /ṭīkaka thos// sing ga gling du zla zer dkar nag dang // bdud rtsi bum pa che chung 'bring gsum thos// rgyal po'i khab tu bstan bcos brgyad pa dang //'khrungs dpe che chung rdo rje sbyar ba'i rgyud// gser gling khab tu phyin pas rgyud bzhi thos// srog chags sgrol ba sgrol ma gser gyi gzo// sha khrag 'tsho ba snying rje med pa'i rgyud// dus las 'byung ba nyi zla kha sbyor rgyud// gro ga'i 'debs pa 'jam dpal yab yum rgyud// ngo bo zhal bstan sprul pa rna tsos mdzad// rgyud dang gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab gsungs// bse sgrom 'chings 'khres ro bkra'i le'u dang // ro bkra bsil lung 'byung ba so so'i rgyud// rtsa mdo chen po snying po bstan pa'i rgyud// lus kyi rnam gzhag bdud rtsi'i thim (them yig dgu// rig pa rtsa brgyad rgya yi smra chung dang // gu na sha kra bam po sum brgya thos//ka la'i tshal du lha mo nyid dang mjal// zhus lan skor gsum gdams ngag kha 'thor dang // rma rtsi'i gdams pa 'chi med bcad 'byor thos// be ta'i gling du lha mos dngos grub gnang // thang la shing skyes khams gsum po dang // ngo bo gso dpyad sgrol ma skor gsum thob// nyi shu gcig la dkar po'i yul nas 'ong // nyi shu gnyis la bod yul dbus su slebs// lha mo'i rgyud bskul sum cu bzhi la phyin// rgyal po'i chad pa dug sbrul glang chen dang // stag gzig dom dred me chu tshom rkun la// skad cig ma nyid lha mo'i rjes su bzung // gso

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 383dpyad rnams kyi dpe don spyan drangs nas// gang nas chen po shangs kyi dpal skyer slebs// bu dang slob ma 'du ba'i smon lam btab// ces pa dang / yang de nyid las/ kho bo g.yu thog mgon po zhes bya ba// sum cu rtsa bzhir rgya gar yul du phyin// mkhas grub rnams dang mjal zhing gsung thos nas// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal phreng dngos dang mjal// yan lag brgyad dang lcang lo nag po'i rgyud// bsil zer gnad dang rgyud rigs bcu drug lnga// de la sogs pa zab gsal gdams pa rnams// ma nor so sor bdag gis kun thos nas// rang bzhin mkha' 'gro ma khyod gsung thos bzhin// bar chad mi 'byung gsol ba btab pa yin// bu slob sems can 'dren pa'i lung bstan gsungs// lus sems gdungs pas lha mo'i gsung sgos rnams// dad dang gus pas yi ge'i ris su bris// phyi rabs skye bo'i gso sman cha lag tu// an tsam cha gcig rgya gar yul du bzhag/ bka' rgya btab pas lung bstan cig gis rnyed// de nas drang srong tsa ra ka la sogs// kun dang mjal nas gdams pa sna tshogs thos// bla ma bsten dang gso dpyad bskyangs pa yis//mi lo mang du 'jig rten khams 'dir bsdad// kun gyi rtsod med g.yu thog mgon por grags// bu slob don du shog dril skor gsum bkod// da ni zhing gzhan 'pho yang 'gyod pa med// chos 'di dpal gyi mgon po rnams la gtad// ces gsungs so//de nas gnyis pa phyi rabs skal ldan rnams la zab mo bla sgrub gdams tshul dngos gzhi'i lo rgyus ni/ dpon slob phyed dang sum brgya lhag tsam skyid grong du/ rgyal po lha btsun gyis spyan drangs/ zla ba bzhi'i chos bzhi btegs/sman dpyad la sogs pa zab chos dpag tu med pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ der 'bul ba phyag rdzas blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba thams cad/ phyogs de'i dge 'dun pa thams cad spyan drangs nas/ rang rang so so gang la 'dris pa'i

384 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigathugs dam mdzad par gsol/ zhag mang por bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pas mchod/ sprang po nad pa nyam chung sogs la yang zang zing gi dngos po gang la gang 'dod/ khyad par sman gyi sbyin pa rlabs ches dbugs 'byin par mdzad do// rjo bo'i drung du smon lam mdzad pa'i dus su kun gyis mthong bar/jo bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po nyi 'od gsal ba'i dkyil nas/ zag pa med pa'i rang sgra yi ge drug pa dang / lha ṣa dzre'i gzungs di ri ri sgrog pa byung / 'od de dang dri zhim po'i ngad kyis skyid rong lung pa khyab/ slar rin po che ba'i(che'i dbu'i gtsug tu thim par gyur pa dang / dus mnyam du sa chen po rab tu g.yos/ de'i tshe rje nyid zhal rog par yug gcig bzhugs rjes/sum ston 'dir shog gsungs/ drung du phyin pas/ 'o skol pha bu 'grogs nas kyang yun ring rab song / gdams pa yang lto tshil snying khrag tshun sbyin pa yin/da ni kho bo yang zhing gzhan du 'gro bar nye bas/ da dung 'dri rgyu yod na 'dri ba'i dus yin gsungs/ der kho bo gsung byon ma thag tu snying stong pa snyam du byed cing / dbugs kyis byang khog brgyangs/ sems rtab rtab par gyur nas ci yang zhu ba ma byung ba la/ de tsam yang skrag mi dgos/ yar long yod dus le lor mi shor ba'i dri sa yod dus ma dris na/ med dus 'gyod kyang phyis /'phyis pas smras pa yin gsungs/ der phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ gdungs pa'i dag khungag mang po shor skabs su/ dran med du brgyal ba yang byung / der rin po che'i zhal nas/ bu slob grangs las 'das kyang / nga'i brgyud 'dzin sum ston khyod la re ba yin/ da lta ngu na rten 'brel 'phyugs pas ma ngu bar/ sems bskyed rgya chen pos gsol ba thob/ dri rgyu ci yod ces yang yang gsungs/ der bdag gis kyang phyag dang maṇḍal phul nas zhus pa/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ dam chos kyi 'byung gnas/dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag 'dod kun 'byung ba'i nor bu/ ma

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 385rig mun sel gyi sgron me/ khams gsum sems can gyi skyabs gnas/ gcig por gyur pa'i rin chen nyid/ zhing gzhan gyi gdul bya la dgongs nas thegs na/ spyir zhing mchog 'di'i sems can/ sgos bod khams kyi skye bo/ khyad par bdag cag bu slob tu gtogs pa rnams dang / nad kyis gdungs pa rnams kyi skyabs gnas/ phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing / gsol ba 'debs yul gyi bla ma rin po che ni gang du btsal/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa ni su la zhu/ zhes yus dang bcas nas zhus pas rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid bla ma la rag las shing / tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob pa yang bla mar mos gus kho na la brten nas 'byung la/ lam zab mos gus la ma brten par sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba bka' mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad dgongs pa mthun/ bla ma la dbye na/ snang ba brda'i bla ma dang / rang sems dngos kyi bla ma gnyis/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bde gshegs bka'i bla ma/ kun khyab rang byung gi bla ma'o// dang po ni rang gi sems nyid sangs rgyas su ngo sprod mkhan gang yin pa'o// gnyis pa ni de yi bla ma nas rdo rje 'chang gi bar ro// gsum pa ni/ bka' mdo rgyud/ lung man ngag thams cad de/ po ti dang glegs bam gyi tshul du bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ slob dpon nag po khro med ces grags so// bzhi pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur pa thams cad de/ dper na gzugs su snang ba thams cad kyi ni ngo bo la ltos dang / snang tsam nyid nas snang stong dbyer med yin/ zhes brda'i sgo nas ngo sprod par byed pa ste/ dri la sogs pa kun 'gre'o// gnyis pa rang sems dngos kyi bla ma zhes gong du bshad pa de dag gi/ de las gzhan pa yang / rang gi sems kyi rang rtsal las byung ba ma gtogs don logs su grub pa rdul phra rab tsam yang med la/ sems ngo kho rang gnas rung 'gyu rung / de'i ngo bo la de nyid rang gas ma yengs pa'i ma

386 ༄7ོg.yu thog snying thigabasgoms par dran pa'i rgyang so yud de btsugs nas ltos dang / gzung 'dzin chags sdang gi snang ba rang sar grol na/ don dam gnas lugs kyi gdams pa mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ro// des bla ma thams cad kyi rgyal po/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs nang nas ston pa'i slob dpon rang gi sems 'di la dus gsum dus med tha mas cad 'du 'bral yod ma myong bas khyod la logs su med la/ mya ngan las 'da' bya 'da' byed dang bral bar shes par bya'o//rgyun de'i phyir gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos snang dmigs shes byas khyab tshod thams cad bla mar ma gyur pa rdul tsam yang med la/ bla ma rang sems sangs rgyas gsum la/ bzang ngan spang blang byung na bdag dang dngos por bzung pa yin te/ srid pa 'phel bar byed pa'i sa bon kho na'o gsungs la/ yang zhus pa/ de lta bu'i don khong du ma chud pa rnams la/ thabs zab mo'i sgos rim gyis dkris te/ lam bla ma nyid la brten nas 'bral med nyams su len pa'i tshul ji ltar bgyi lags zhus pas/ de ni khyod kyis zhus pa shin tu legs so// gong ltar ma rtogs shing / dad gus dam tshig brtson 'grus snying stobs dang ldan pa'i gang zag snod ldan la/ thun mong ma yin pa bla ma'i sgrub thabs zab mo bstan par bya'o// de yang bla ma gcig bsgrubs pas bla ma thams cad 'grub pa/ yi dam gcig bsgrubs pas yi dam thams cad 'grub ste/ de bzhin mkha' 'gro sogs sgrub pa'i gnad ma shes na/ lha tshangs pa'i tshe tsam thub kyang re re nas sgrub kyin mi zin la/ gzhan thams cad kyang bla ma gcig pu la 'dus pas/ bla ma gcig pu sgrub pa la rab tu 'bad pa gal che gsungs/ de nyid nyams su blangs pas yun ci tsam nas 'grub zhus pas/ bla ma nam 'grub pa'i tshe na rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa/ byin rlabs nam zhugs pa'i tshe na thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa 'char/ rtogs pa nam shar na 'khor ba rang sar grol nas gtan gyi so nam tshar/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 387thob pas 'grub myur bul yang / sgrib pa chen po bsags pa'i mi ni chos 'di rna bas thos par yang mi skye la/ sgrib shas 'bring dang tha ma'i bsags lugs kyis shes gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ de ltar na rigs kyi bdag po drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang zhag kha yar bsgrub pa gcig gis thob par rang dka' 'am zhus pas/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob ma zhig la/ gnad dang ldan pa'i gdams pa zab mo sbyin nas/ dpon slob gsha' ma zhig 'grigs na gsang sngags thabs che bas/ skad cig lag pa brkyang bskum la 'grub pa yang mang ste/ji skad du/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la rten 'brel 'char ba gang // bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// zhes dang / gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang // bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don yin cing / khyad par nged rang lugs kyi bla sgrub 'di/ bla sgrub gzhan las byin rlabs che thag chod pa zhig yin/ bla ma gzhan la gsol ba mi tshe ril por gang btab pa bas/ kho bo la lo ru btab pas bsod nams che/ gzhan la lo ru btab pa las kho bo la zla ba ru btab pas bsod nams che/ gzhan la zla bar btab pa bas kho bo la zhag dang za ma dang / skad cig thang cig tsam btab pas byin rlabs ches myur te/ 'di mi bden par gda' na/ kho bo ngas sems can bslus pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bdag gi mgo bo a rdza ku'i dog pa bzhin du tshal bar khos shig gsungs/ der yang zhus pa/ bla ma yi dam thams cad ngo bo gcig yin cing gcig bsgrubs pas thams cad 'grub par gsungs pa ltar na/ thugs rje dang phrin las la khyad par che chung ni yang mi 'thad/ nged rang gi bla sgrub gzhan las myur ba 'byung ba'i rgyun rin po che'i thugs rje gzhan pas phul du 'byung ba stabs ci lags sam zhus pas/ sangs rgyas thugs rje la che chung khyad par med kyang gdul bya
