388 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'adul ba'i tshe so so'i las smon gyis kha bsgyur ba ste/ mdor na lar yang sangs rgyas thams cad 'khor dang / sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las zhing khams mnyam par bshad pa med/ des sangs rgyas la bzang ngan byung ba ga nas 'gro/rgya bod kyi grub thob rnams kyang / sku tshe sogs rnam thar gcig tu nges pa med/'gro don la dgongs pa grub pa thob pa mnyam/ chos thams cad smon lam gyis kha bsgyur nas/ gang zag la sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos kyis ma thul na/ 'khor byang chub sems dpas btul ba dang / byang chub sems dpas mi thul na so so skye bos btul ba dang / bla mas mi thul ba rnams slob mas btul ba'i tshul grangs mi lang ste/ khyod rang thos pa chung ba yin/ kho bo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bas thabs khams thugs rje lhag pa ma yin kyang / de rnams kyi spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ gong du bshad pa ltar smon lam rgya chen zur du btab pa yin/ da lta smon lam de'i 'bras bu longs spyod pa ste/ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol//dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing // zhes pa ltar bsgrub pa dang 'grub pa dus mnyam gyi byin rlabs med na snyigs ma'i skye bo 'dod thag nye zhing snying rus chung bas nyams len yun bsring mi nus shing / kho bo'i srog sgrub 'di nyid gang zag dad can gyis ma yengs zhag bdun bsgrubs na// rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du/ bdag gi zhal legs par bstan nas/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan par bgyi ba dam bca' yin mod gsungs/ der shin tu dga' zhing mgu nas phyag dang bskor ba dpag tu med pa byas/ maṇḍal mang po phul/ de lta bu'i gdams pa bdag la thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus/ de lta bu'i gdams pa rtsa ba gsum gyi srog gcig tu bsgrubs nas/ da lta sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gdon mi za bar zhu bar 'dod na/ gsang sngags bla med zab chos kyi che ba dang / ma 'ongs pa na

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 389zab chos 'chal du mi gzhug pa'i bka' srol 'dzugs pa'i phyir/ zla ba gcig gi bar du nyin zhag phrugs re'i khongs su/ brkyang phyag bskor ba/ maṇḍal/gsol 'debs/ tshogs mchod rnams stong phrag re re las mi nyung ba phul/bar mtshams su yig brgya ngag mi dal bar bgrang / bla ma dang mchod gnas la bsnyen bkur/ ma nus pa la sbyin gtong / 'chi nges kyi srog bslu/ gtsug lag khang gi zhig gsos/ rgyal ba'i bka' sgrog pa/ lam 'phrang bcos pa sogs bgyi/ de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon snu dza dang / gser gyi maṇḍal phul nas zhus shig sbyin par bya'o gsungs/ der sa thob pa'i dga' ba tsam byung nas phyag sogs bka' gnang ba las lhag tsam bsgrubs te/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis lon pa'i tshe/ sa zhing gang yod btsongs nas rta ru bsgyur/de dus gser kha rdol ba dang dus mtshungs byung ste/ rta rnams gser du bsgyur bas gser srang phyed dang nyis brgya lhag tsam khugs pa las/ gser srang ngo (do ma gtogs drung du phul/ gser zho bzhi rang gis byas/ gser srang phyed do a tsa ra mahā dzñā na tsarya bya ba rgya gar lho phyogs be ta pa zhig la phul nas rigs sngags kyi sbyor ba byed du bcug ste/ zhang snye mo'i lha lcam de ba dpal 'dren zhes bya ba lo bcu bdun lon cing bud med rin po che'i rigs yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa de gsang yum du phul/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod nas/ gsol ba btab pas/ gnam lo rgyal po rta'i lo spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu la gsang ba'i bka' rnams gnang / de nas rim gyis gdams pa rnams lhag ma ma lus par nyams khrid du rdzogs par gnang ba la brten nas nyams myong phul du byung ba skyes pa nas bzung ste/ de nas kho bo dzñā na dha ri yang btsan sa zin no//e ma ho/ a la la/ de nas phyi rabs don du gsungs pa las/ gang byon rang bzo ma 'dres par zin bris su bris/ rin po che'i drung du zhu dag

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 389zab chos 'chal du mi gzhug pa'i bka' srol 'dzugs pa'i phyir/ zla ba gcig gi bar du nyin zhag phrugs re'i khongs su/ brkyang phyag bskor ba/ maṇḍal/gsol 'debs/ tshogs mchod rnams stong phrag re re las mi nyung ba phul/bar mtshams su yig brgya ngag mi dal bar bgrang / bla ma dang mchod gnas la bsnyen bkur/ ma nus pa la sbyin gtong / 'chi nges kyi srog bslu/ gtsug lag khang gi zhig gsos/ rgyal ba'i bka' sgrog pa/ lam 'phrang bcos pa sogs bgyi/ de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon snu dza dang / gser gyi maṇḍal phul nas zhus shig sbyin par bya'o gsungs/ der sa thob pa'i dga' ba tsam byung nas phyag sogs bka' gnang ba las lhag tsam bsgrubs te/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis lon pa'i tshe/ sa zhing gang yod btsongs nas rta ru bsgyur/de dus gser kha rdol ba dang dus mtshungs byung ste/ rta rnams gser du bsgyur bas gser srang phyed dang nyis brgya lhag tsam khugs pa las/ gser srang ngo (do ma gtogs drung du phul/ gser zho bzhi rang gis byas/ gser srang phyed do a tsa ra mahā dzñā na tsarya bya ba rgya gar lho phyogs be ta pa zhig la phul nas rigs sngags kyi sbyor ba byed du bcug ste/ zhang snye mo'i lha lcam de ba dpal 'dren zhes bya ba lo bcu bdun lon cing bud med rin po che'i rigs yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa de gsang yum du phul/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod nas/ gsol ba btab pas/ gnam lo rgyal po rta'i lo spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu la gsang ba'i bka' rnams gnang / de nas rim gyis gdams pa rnams lhag ma ma lus par nyams khrid du rdzogs par gnang ba la brten nas nyams myong phul du byung ba skyes pa nas bzung ste/ de nas kho bo dzñā na dha ri yang btsan sa zin no//e ma ho/ a la la/ de nas phyi rabs don du gsungs pa las/ gang byon rang bzo ma 'dres par zin bris su bris/ rin po che'i drung du zhu dag

390 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thig dang / bka' gnad zhus pas/ bka' rgya gdams/ chos bdag la gtad/'gro don 'byung ba'i smon lam btab bo//g.yu thog snying thig las/ byin rlabs bla ma sgrub pa'i chos skor sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od ces pa'i thog mar lo rgyus nges shes 'dren byed dge ba'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba/ rje 'di nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor yun rings blangs shing / mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa/ dzñā na dha ris nyung ngur bsdus te bkod pa yin la/ bka' rgya'i yig chung zur na yod pa ltar snod min the tshom log lta can la zur tsam yang bshad par mi bya'o//e ma ho/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi// mkhyen brtse nus pa gcig tu gyur pa'i gzugs// zhing 'dir mtshungs bral gu ṇar yongs shar ba// de la bdag sogs sems can skyabs su mchi// bdag gis dus dang srid pa thams cad du// mgon po khyed nyid mnyes pa'i rgyur gyur nas//dmyal ba'i mer yang the tshom mi 'jug cing // lus srog longs spyod kun gyis khyod mchod shog/ gal te khyod nyid mi mnyes gyur pa nas// bla med byang chub thob kyang 'dor ba dang // skad cig 'bral med khyed nyid brten nas kyang //sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem byed shog/ i thaḥ sarba maṅgā lam̐//kha/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dbang chog bde chen klong yangasazhesabya ba bzhugs( pa'i dbu phyogasalagasaso/na ma (mo ratna gu ru/ 'dir bla ma rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par thob/ bsnyen sgrub them/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal

390 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thig dang / bka' gnad zhus pas/ bka' rgya gdams/ chos bdag la gtad/'gro don 'byung ba'i smon lam btab bo//g.yu thog snying thig las/ byin rlabs bla ma sgrub pa'i chos skor sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od ces pa'i thog mar lo rgyus nges shes 'dren byed dge ba'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba/ rje 'di nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor yun rings blangs shing / mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa/ dzñā na dha ris nyung ngur bsdus te bkod pa yin la/ bka' rgya'i yig chung zur na yod pa ltar snod min the tshom log lta can la zur tsam yang bshad par mi bya'o//e ma ho/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi// mkhyen brtse nus pa gcig tu gyur pa'i gzugs// zhing 'dir mtshungs bral gu ṇar yongs shar ba// de la bdag sogs sems can skyabs su mchi// bdag gis dus dang srid pa thams cad du// mgon po khyed nyid mnyes pa'i rgyur gyur nas//dmyal ba'i mer yang the tshom mi 'jug cing // lus srog longs spyod kun gyis khyod mchod shog/ gal te khyod nyid mi mnyes gyur pa nas// bla med byang chub thob kyang 'dor ba dang // skad cig 'bral med khyed nyid brten nas kyang //sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem byed shog/ i thaḥ sarba maṅgā lam̐//kha/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dbang chog bde chen klong yangasazhesabya ba bzhugs( pa'i dbu phyogasalagasaso/na ma (mo ratna gu ru/ 'dir bla ma rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par thob/ bsnyen sgrub them/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 391'byor pas/ slob ma snod ldan rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ mchog gi dbang bskur ba'i tshul/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi/ rjes so//dang po ni/ gnas grogs spyod dus sgrub chos phun sum tshogs pa 'dzom pas/ sin byur dang byang sems dkar dmar dri bzang bsres pas byugs pa'i maṇḍal gyi steng du/ rab dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs/ 'bring padma 'dab bzhi phyogs mtshon/ tha ma'ang nas kyi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su/ khri'i steng du bum pa mtshan ldan mgul chings kha rgyan dang ldan pa'i nang du bum rdzas tshang ma blugs la bzhag de'i mdun du 'bru'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du chang bzang po la a mṛ ta sbyar bas bkang / me long gtsang mas kha bcad pa'i steng du/ bsil sman gyi gtso bo ga bur/ drod sman gyi gtso bo shing kun/ 'du ba snyoms pa rnam rgyal gser mdog don snod nad sel bzang po drug bzhaga'adi'i mtha' la gzhung gtor lnga/ sman raka phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bshams/ sku rten tsa ka li dang cod pan/ dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ stod smad kyi gos dang rgyan/ gzhung gi po ti/ gtar sreg sogs kyi cha dpyad (byad rnams kyis bskor/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma rgyud dag pa sta gon byas la/ slob dpon gyis bskyed rdzogs kyi las gzhung ji lta bar bsrang / bsnyen pa gso/ bdag 'jug blang ngo //gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang gi rim pa ni/ spyir chos thams cad bsdu na rnam pa gsum ste/ gang sbyang ba'i gzhi dang / gang gis sbyangs pa'i gnyen po dang / ji ltar sbyong ba'i thabs so// sbyang gzhi ni/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad de/ lus ngag yid gsum du 'dus so// sbyong byed ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad de/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum du 'dus la/ de'i don nyams su blang thabs thams cad zab mo bla ma rigs 'dus kyi dbang la brten nas/ bskyed rdzogs gsum du 'dus pa nyid do// de la bzhi ste/ phyi

392 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadang nang dang gsang ba dang / de kho na nyid kyi dbang ngo // 'di dag kyang bskur thabs dang / dam tshig dang / ma thob pa'i skyon/ thob pa'i 'bras bu/yon 'bul ba/ gtad rgya bstan pa drug gis bsdus te/ dang po phyi yi dbang bskur ba ni/ cod pan/ bum pa/ dbu rgyan/ gos rgyan/ sman raka gtor tshogs/ rdzas dang cha dpyad/byadaka/ phyag mtshan no// nang gi dbang ni gu ru sman rgyal/ rig pa'i ye shes/ rigs lnga/ rgyal ba rigs kyi bdag po/ rta phag mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes lnga dang bcas pa dang / drang srong dang bka' srung gi dbang ngo // gsang ba'i dbang la/byang chub sems kyi dbang / rig ma brtul zhugs kyi dbang / rig pa ye shes kyi dbang ngo // de kho na nyid kyi dbang la/ lta ba/ sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu/ thams cad kun gyi rdzogs dbang ngo // de nas bskur thabs kyi rim pa'i lag len ni/ las kyi sems dpa' zhig gis/ slob ma rnams gzungs chu'am/a mṛ ta lta bu'i chus khrus bya ru gzhug nang du 'jug pa'i gong du bgegs gtor btang / gu gul gyis bdug thun rdzas kyis bgegs bskud/ de nas yol ba'i phyi rol du gral la 'khod de/ maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar pa'i phan yon rgyas par bshad/ de nas gsang sngags bla med la spro ba bskyed de/ theg dman gyi nyes dmigs bshad do// kye ho nyon cig rigs kyi bu// bskal ba grangs med du ma ru// 'bad kyang grol bar mi 'gyur zhing // byang chub sgrub la gtan gyi gegs// theg pa dman pa'i lam yin la//u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar// sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byon pa dang // shin tu ches cher rnyed dka' la// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' 'o// gang gas tshe 'dir mchog thob pa'i// lam rnyed gyur pas skal ba bzang // dbul pos rin chen gter rnyed de// byes su stor ba'i

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 393bu rnyed pa'i// byis pa gang dag cher dga' nas// sdug bsngal kun las rnam grol zhing // bde chen 'gyur med go 'phang mchog/ yud kyis ster la cis mi spro// zhes brjod la slob ma rnams/ gsang sngags bla med kyi lam zab mo rnyed pa re dga'/ re legs/ re 'tshengs/ re spro snyam pa byed du gzhug de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ phyogs dus dkon mchog gsum 'dus pa// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rgyal la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod du 'jug de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog bsgrubs nas// zhi sogs phrin las rnam bzhi yis// 'gro rnams bde la dgod /'god par bya// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// 'khor bas mnar ba bdag la gzigs// bde chen rgyal ba'i grong mchog tu// de ring bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum de nas gnang ba sbyin te slob dpon gyis/ bu nyon dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis// gsang chen bla med gsungs pa yi// bdud rtsi'i mchog de ngas byin gyis// snod dang ldan par da gyur to// zhes brjod mig dar bcings/ me tog de nas rtog pa bsdu ste/ rnam g.yengs rtog pa'i dba' rlabs rnams// legs par bsdus te nyan par bya// bde gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs ni// yid gzhan yengs la 'jug mi 'gyur// zhes brjod/ de nas sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'dzin//bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis//dus 'di nas ni byang chub bar// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rigs 'dzin gsang sngags bla med kyi// sdom pa ma lus bdag gis gzung // sems can 'gyur med bde la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod du gzhug de nas gsang ba bsgrags pa ni/ gnas gsum dri yi thig le bya/ snying gar rdo rje

394 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigabazhag nas/ oṃ badzra tsitta āḥ zhes zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ bodhi tsitta hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po gyen du langs pa re re bsams la/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ gsang chen dam tshig rdo rje mchog/ bu khyod spyi bor bzhag pas ni// rdo rje'i sku du (ru khyod nyid 'grub// 'gyur med ye shes mchog tu 'gyur// gzhan du smras na de lta min// zhes brjod/ ye shes kyi rdo rje spyi bor bstim mo// de nas dam chu blud pa ni/ kye kye bu khyod bdag la nyon// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i byin thob nas// phyi nang gsang ba khyad par gyi//dam tshig mtha' dag bsrung nus sam// zhes brjod/ slob mas/ lcags la gser 'gyur rtsi bzhin du// gtso bo drin las de ring bdag/ bde ba che la reg pa na// bka' las nam yang 'da' re kun// zhes brjod gzhug pas mna' bkag ste/ nang mchod lce thog tu blugs spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ 'di ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu// 'thungs nas dam tshig ma bsrungs na// mnar med dmyal bar khyod sreg cing // bsrungs na dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur//badzra a mṛ ta sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob mas gdong g.yogs bcings pa'i spyi bor bla ma'i phyag bzhag ste/ oṃ āḥlha badzra ātpa kokhya hūm̐/zhes brjod rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rjes sna khrid nas yol ba'i nang du 'khrid/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du zhugs/ gtso bo'i mdun du 'dug par bsam/ bla mas gtso bo'i sngags bzlas shing / phyag spyi bor bzhag srob (slobakams snyim pa me tog gis gang ba bla ma la gtor/ pra tī tstsha badzra hoḥ zhes bla ma la 'thor ro// de nas gdong g.yogs phye ste/ slob dpon gyis/ gdod nas rang gsal ye shes mig/ ma rig ling thog gis bsgribs pa// do nub rdo rje'i spyan du dbye// dkyil 'khor 'di ltos don chen thob// badzra dzñā na tsakṣu pra be sha ya a/ zhes brjod de dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo sprad nas/ slob dpon gyis/ gsang chen rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir//

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 395lan gcig mthong ba tsam gyis kyang // grangs med bskal pa'i sdig pa 'dag/sngags tshul spyod na smos ci dgos// zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes dbab/gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas me tog dang bcas pa'i snyim pa thal mo sbyar nas/ kye ho bcom ldan rdo rjes 'dzin// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod// rang la gnas pa'i ye shes mchog / do nub rang sar dbab tu gsol// zhes brjod du gzhug de nas dpon slob gnyis gas rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba/ char drag tu babs pa tsam du byung / slob ma la sib sib thim par bsams nas/ slob dpon gyis byin 'bebs chen mo'i dbang rol mo sgra dang bcas pa gyer/ gu gul/ sha chen/ yungs kur/ byi la'i brun cung zad dang bcas pa'i dud pas bdug co sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i nas sam/ bdud rtsi gtor/ lus la gar/ ngag la sngags/sems ting nge 'dzin sogs/ ye shes phebs par rtags 'byung ngo // gal te des ma phebs na dmigs pa'i 'gro bzlog zhal shes ltar byas pas nges par phebs so// de nas cod pan ming gi dbang bskur te/ dar sna lnga'i cod pan me tog dang bcas pa'i mig btsums te/ dkyil 'khor shar phyogs nas dbus su dor la/ bdag gis me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe re rabs grangs med nas// rjes su bzung ba'i yi dam lha// gang yin de la 'bab par shog/ pukhre pra tī tstsha hoḥ zhes dor gang la bzla ba'i yi dam du phog de'i rigs la gras pa'i gsang mtshan brtag de nas slob dpon gyis cod pan slob ma'i spyi bor btags la 'di skad brjod do// sngon tshe 'brel lha'i byin gyis brlabs// bar chad bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags// chos grags rgyal ba'i zhing du 'gro// cod pan ming bcas dbang thob shog/ pukhre pra tī tstsha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas bum dbang ni/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge ddhi cig gsal/ de las 'od zer

396 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'aphros/ rgyal ba mchod/ tshur 'dus tram̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/snod bcud rnam dag rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed/ mchod bstod bzlas pa 'dod gsol byas rjes lha rnams 'od du zhu/ bum chu dang dbyer med du bsam/ de nas bum dbang bskur te/ slob ma'i dmigs pa ni/bum pa de phyi rin po che las grub pa bum pa tshad ldan nang ye shes kyi lha'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu ba'i bdud rtsis gang ba spyi bo nas blugs pas/ thog med dus nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags thams cad bkrus/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje bdud rtsi chu'i rnam pas lus gang la/ snod bcud lha ru dag pa'i bum dbang thob par bsam/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag bum chu spyi bor blugs la / rol mo bcas pas slob dpon gyis 'di skad do// rma spros bral chos sku'i 'khor yu ga bum pa zlum// nang ni ye shes lha yi bdud rtsis gang // skal ldan bu la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas//sgrib gnyis rab bkrus rigs lnga'i dbang rdzogs shog/ oṃ buddha badzra ratna padma kurma mu tra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ hūṃ tt+waṃ hrīḥ.aḥ zhes brjod do// de nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni/ rin chen prog zhu rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan snying por bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ snod kyi 'jig rten phyogs bzhi dbus lnga gnas 'gyur/rdo rje la sogs pa'i khang pa lngar byas/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i bzhugs gnas/byin rlabs kun 'byung bya ba bzhugs gnas thams cad la ma rmongs pa dbang bsgyur ba'i ye shes kyi sku dang ldan par bsams la/ 'di skad do// hūṃ 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen padma dang // rgya gram sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas rin chen 'od// rab mdzes rin chen prog zhu'i dbang bskur bas// sku lnga rigs lnga ye shes lnga dbang shog/ rma badzra burnya ratna padma kurma gurba ṭwāṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ ces brjod de nas gos rgyan gyis dbang bskur zhing dam tshig don la bsam bcug ste/ hūṃ phreng ba snyan cha mgur chu (cha do shal dang // dbu rgyan se mo do dang

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 397gdu bu dang // stod smad gos rgyan mdzes pa'i dbang bskur bas// mi brjed gzungs thob bdud dpung zil gnon pa// mi snyan skyon bral ye shes dbyings su 'khod// dbyings rigs yongs 'brel sna tshogs sprul skur 'char// thabs shes dbang ldan gsang sngags rmad du byung // chos kyi khrel ldan nyon mongs tsha grang skyob// snying po'i chos 'khor bskor phyir gdu bu ste// rtags la brten nas don mthong dbang thob sheg/ rma sarba ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ ches brjod/de nas sman raka gcor tshogs dang rnga bo che'i dbang bskur te/ tshig gi don bsam bcug la/ hūṃ rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi dang // 'khor ba dbyings su grol ba'i rakta mchog/ 'dod yon lha mos brgyan pa'i gtor tshogs dang // grag stod /stong sgra 'byin rnga chen dbang bskur bas// rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam dbyings su bskang // dam can bka' srung dbang sdud bran du khol// dgra bgegs log rtog bdud dpung thal ba rlogs// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro 'dul dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥ bhū sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta/mahā rakta bha lo ta/ ḍā ma ru/ sarba putstsha sa ma ya/ a bhi ṣiñtsa sirnyi ā be sha ya a a/ zhes rim par spyi bor bskur ro// de nas sman gzhong (gzhung sman dang cha dbya da /byad kyi dbang bskur te/ rdo rje slob dpon rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i sku gu ṇa de nyid/ sangs rgyas sman bla'i skur gyur pa de nyid la/ rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa'i nang pa'i 'khor dang / rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong gi 'khor dang / tshangs pa brgya byin lha yi 'khor/ mahā de ba la sogs phyi pa'i 'khor/ 'byung ba lnga'i sman gyi lha mo dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bsgoms pa'i sman rgyal gyi spyi bo snying ga lte ba gsang gnas bzhi nas/ rig pa'i ye shes bzhi dang / mgrin pa nas yid las skyes 'od dpag med kyi rnam 'phrul yid las skyes kyis zhu chen mdzad/ rig pa'i ye shes bzhis rgyud bzhi rim pa bzhin du

398 ༄zagayu thog snying thigalung phog rjes su gnang bka' gtad de/ bzhi po de dag kyang yig 'bru mthing dkar ser ljang gi rnam pa nam mkha' nas char ltar babs/ rang gi snying ga nas spyi bo lte ba gsang gnas rnams su thim pas/ de'i tshig don rgyud la bkra lam skyes bar bsam/ de'i rjes su 'khor tshogs de rnams thams cad kyis kyang / rang rang gi lugs kyi gso ba'i gzhung lugs thams cad kyang phogade'ang dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge dkar dmar 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas pa rang la thim/ mthar 'khor thams cad yid las skyes la thim/ de yang rang gi mgrin par 'od dmar por zhu nas thim pas/ rgyud bzhi'i don ma lus pa khong du chud/ tshig 'chad pa la thogs pa med pa'i nga rgyal la bzhag de nas rig pa'i ye shes bzhi sman rgyal la thim/ de yang rang gi spyi bo nas 'od du zhu ba spyi bo nas thim pas/ chu la chu bzhag bzhin dbyer med du thim par bsams la/rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgor bzhag nas/ gso dpyad mthong bshad kyi dpe lung thob par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad du/ 'gro lnga ma rig dug lnga'i rgyu las ni//rlung mkhris bad kun ldan 'dus nad lngas gzir// de dag ye shes lnga dang sman sbyor lngas// rgyud dang 'bras bu lnga lnga'i nad sel ba// rig pa'i ye shes lnga las byung gyur pa'i// rgyud chen sde bzhi mjug don bcas pa lngas// bco brgyad cha lag dang bcas gso dpyad kyi// gzhung gdams ma lus kun 'dus dbang bskur bas// tshig don ji bzhin rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥbhū a mṛ ta hri da ya aṅgā aṣṭa gu hya/ u pa de sha tant+ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/zhes rgyud slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag bshad dkrol skyongs shig bya'o// de nas ka pā la me long sman dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag tshig don bsam du bcug la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad do// ka pā la ni phyi snod 'jig rten khams// sa chu me rlung sman

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 399rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi// bdud rtsis gang ba nang bcud sems can te// sha khrag drod dbugs sman du ma gyur med// me long bsil drod so sor 'char ba'i brda// nyon mongs chags sdang gis bskyed tsha grang nad// thabs shes ga bur shing kun sman gyis sel// gti mug tsha grang 'dres pas chags sdang thob/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug a rus 'du ba snyoms// pha rol phyin drug bzang po drug la 'dzom// snang srid 'khor 'das bdud rtsi chen po'i klong // ma lus sman gyi dbang mchog 'di bskur bas// rgyu 'bras nad rnams kun sel dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥ: sarba a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes spyi bor gzhag go/ de nas nang mchod de lce thog la blugs pas/ rang lus kyi nang 'gro ba rigs drug gis gang ba/ bdud rtsi 'thungs pas rgyu 'bras nad las grol bar bsam/de nas gtsag bu sogs cha dpyad (byad rnams rim gyis gtad cing tshig don bsam du bcug la/ hūṃ ye shes gtsag chas dug gsum rnag khrag dbugs//gtum mo'i me btsas gzung 'dzin zug gzer bsreg dran pa'i skam pas rnam rtog mde'u 'byin// shes rab mtshon gris bdag 'dzin sha ro bcad//nyams myong skyung bus nyon mongs rus skyon brdar// bskyed rdzogs thur mas ma rig rab rib dang // snang log rang 'khrul snying rlung sel bar byas// snyan brgyud cha dpyad (byad kun 'dus dbang bskur bas// rgyu 'bras nad yul 'byin pa'i dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥbhū badzra pu ka ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas phyag mtshan re re bzhin dbang bskur la/ tshig don bsam du bcug la 'di skad do// rma chos dbyings sman gyi 'khor los gti mug nad rgyun gcod// hūṃ me long ye shes rdo rjes zhe sdang brag ri 'joms// swā mnyam nyid yid bzhin nor bus nga rgyal dbul phongs sel// āḥsor rtog padma'i bcud kyis chags srid /sredakarang sar grol// hoḥbya grub rgya gram brjid pas phrag dog rlung dmar 'gyel// stong nyid lhung bzed nang du bde chen bdud

400 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigartsis gang // ma rungs tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gri gug thod par bcas/dpal ldan rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan dbang bskur bas// dug lnga'i dgra bcom rigs lnga'i rten dbang mchog thob shog/ oṃ āḥdharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas nang ltar lha dbang bskur ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūṃ rigs 'dus sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' drin gyis// bla med phyi dbang rdzogs par thob//da ni bla med nang gi dbang // bdag la bka' drin stsal du gsol// ces lan gsum bzlas la bcug/ de nas slob dpon gyis// sku rten re re nas slob ma'i spyi bor bskul zhing / de la dmigs rten byas nas/ don la ting nge 'dzin gyi lha so so'i spyi bor/ dpon slob gnyis gas rtse gcig tu bsams nas 'di skad do// hūṃ thugs sprul mi bskyod rig pa'i ye shes mthing // mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs rdo rje ling bzed bsnams// rtsa rgyud ston mdzad me long ye shes dang // zhe sdang rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥbadzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa'i ye shes slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying gar lhan gyis bzhugs par bsam zhing /oṃ sku sprul rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes dkar// mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs 'khor lo lhung bzed bsnams// bshad rgyud ston mdzad chos dbyings ye shes dang //gti mug rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥbudha gu ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/āḥgasung sprul mtha' yas yid las skyes pa dmar// mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs padma lhung bzed bsnams// rgyud kyi zhus chen sor rtog ye shes ngang //'dod chags rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥpadma gu ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ swā yon tan rin 'byung rig pa'i ye shes ser// mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs rin chen lhung bzed bsnams// man ngag rgyud ston mnyam nyid ye shes ngang // nga rgyal rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥratna gu ru a bhi

༄zajug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 401ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ ho:phrin las don grub rig pa'i ye shes ljang // mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs rgya gram lhung bzed bsnams// rgyud phyi ston mdzad bya grub ye shes ngang /phrag dog rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥkarma gu ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/de nas/ rigs kyi gtsor gyur bcom ldan sman rgyal mthing // mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs sman mchog lhung bzed bsnams// don gnyis mthar phyin ye shes lnga rdzogs dpal// dug lnga rgyu 'bras nad sel dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥmahā gu ru lha ṣa rdzu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas rigs kyi bdag po sman rgyal spyi gtsug tu slar thim mo// de nas/ hrīḥm chags padma'i rigs kyi rnam rol las// ma rungs gdug pa kun 'dul khro bo'i sku// gnyis med rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyar// dbang chen rta mchog dpal gyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥpadma nta krita badzra kro dha gya shrī tha/ burnya ḍā ki ni kā wā tsi a bhi 'dzi hūṃ/ zhes brjod rang la thim/ rta phag yab yum du gsal/ de nas/ rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs// ye shes ḍā ki phrin las bzhi sgrub ma// mthing ser dmar ljang gri gug thod pa 'dzin// sde bzhi ḍā ki dbang mchog sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥbhū buddha ḍā ki ni/ badzra ḍā ki ni/ ratna ḍā ki ni/ padma ḍā ki ni/ kurma ṭā ki ni/ sarba ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnas bzhir thim par bsam/ de nas lha rnams kyi sku gsung thugs nan tan gyi dbang bskur te/dbang rten ni/ oṃ dkar/ āḥdamar/ hūṃ mthing gsum/ 'khor lo/ padma/rdo rje rnams kyi lte bar bris la/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim ste/ dkar gsal 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan// 'dab brgyad padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan// mthing mdog rdo rje rgya gram hūṃ gis mtshan// bde gshegs sku gsung thugs mchog phyag rgya yis// skal ldan bu la nan tan dbang bskur bas// sgo gsum tha mal 'dzin pa rang sor dag/ snang grag rigs su ye shes rol dbang shog/ oṃ āḥs burnya kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod

402 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigapas bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid du gyur pas lcags la ngar blud pa ltar byin rlabs kyi ngar thogs pa yin no// de nas ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur te/ dbang rten ni man shel dngos po gcig nyi zer la 'phyar ba'i 'ja' 'od la ngo sprad nas bskur te/ hūṃ kun gzhi sems dang nyon mongs yid rnam shes// sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur bag chags spangs//me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya ba grub// ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog thob gyur cig/ rma āḥlha dzñā na pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa kli/ zhes shel mgor bzhag la/ chos dbyings rnam dag spros bral shel lta bu las rang rtsal mi 'gags ye shes lngar 'char ba ni 'di lta bu nyid do// zhes ngo sprod/ de nas brtan pa'i phyir rten 'brel snying po dang bkra shis kyi tshig brjod do// de nas drang srong brgyud pa'i byin 'bebs kyi dbang ni/ rin po che'i snod gtsang mar dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma la sman bzang po sna tshogs btab/ 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ gzhan yang rang rang mnyes pa'i mchod sprin du mas nam mkha' gang bar bsams shing / drang srong rnams kyi bris sku rab gnas can rang rang gi skur bskyed la/ spyan drang (drangs ba ni/ hūṃ (23tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag dang tha skar bu// brgya byin rgyun shes bu dang nabs so skyes// thang la 'bar dang rkang pa gnyis spyod pa// 'drob skyod (skyong me bzhin 'jug dang lus nag dang // rgya skag sna dang mda' mchog lan tshwa'i bdag/ dpal phreng dang ni nyi ma'i snying po dang // lhas skyob g.yon phyogs dang ni shing khyer dang // ljang son bu dang bram ze gzhon nu sprin// rin chen sgo de shan dang gzhon nu srid// 'drob skyod /skyong mu khyud 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad thugs su chud// tshe la dbang bas bcud len dngos grub brnyes// gzhan rigs sngon shes byams ldan drang por bsrang // khyed rnams rang rang bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog nas// tshad med

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 403'gro la dpag med thugs rje yi// rdzu 'phrul chi /che bas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'od 'chang la sogs sman gyi lha mo dang // mngon shes pa yi dngos grub ster mdzad pa// sman gyi rigs 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs rnams kun// sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ma 'da' bar// rings pa'i tshul gyis spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// e hye hi sa ma ya dzaḥ sna tshogs rin chen padma'i gdan la bzhugs// sgo gsum spro dga' gus pas phyag kyang 'bul//dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// ma rig nyams chags sdig sgrib gnong 'gyod bshags// dge la yi rangs zab don chos 'khor bskor// 'gro ba ji srid gnas pa de srid bzhugs// kun kyang bla med byang chub rgyur bsngo'o// zhes pas mchod/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho mgron rnams kyi/ ljags 'od kyi sbu gus gsol bas/ thugs rgyud bde bas gang bar bsams la/ tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs lha'i sman pa mngon par shes pa lnga dang / drang srong chen po rnams kyi zhal du ba lo ta sarba pū dza khā hi/ oṃ āḥ:/zhes pa dang / gzhan yang sman gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams dang /sman gyi bka' srung lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum dang / mi'am ci la sogs pa'i dam tshig la gnas pa thams cad kyi zhal du i rda ba li ta gritna khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma gsos la 'bul/ arbhe sogs kyis mchod/ de nas yang gtor ma gsos la/ slar yang byin gyis brlabs nas/ sman gyi byin 'bebs shing /dbang bskur bya ba ni/ hūṃ chos dbyings spros dang bral ba'i klong yangs nas//'gro don 'dod dgu'i gar bsgyur gtso dang 'khor// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i nad sel bde gshegs gtso// sngon med sman pa'i byin rlabs dus 'dir phob /phobs / / rigs lnga sku lnga rig pa'i ye shes lnga// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba yab yum rnams// 'gro lnga dug lnga'i nad las grol ba'i phyir// dus 'dir byin rlobs sman pa'i bcud phob cig/ lha dang drang srong phyi nang sde bzhi'i 'khor//

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 403'gro la dpag med thugs rje yi// rdzu 'phrul chi /che bas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'od 'chang la sogs sman gyi lha mo dang // mngon shes pa yi dngos grub ster mdzad pa// sman gyi rigs 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs rnams kun// sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ma 'da' bar// rings pa'i tshul gyis spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// e hye hi sa ma ya dzaḥ sna tshogs rin chen padma'i gdan la bzhugs// sgo gsum spro dga' gus pas phyag kyang 'bul//dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// ma rig nyams chags sdig sgrib gnong 'gyod bshags// dge la yi rangs zab don chos 'khor bskor// 'gro ba ji srid gnas pa de srid bzhugs// kun kyang bla med byang chub rgyur bsngo'o// zhes pas mchod/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho mgron rnams kyi/ ljags 'od kyi sbu gus gsol bas/ thugs rgyud bde bas gang bar bsams la/ tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs lha'i sman pa mngon par shes pa lnga dang / drang srong chen po rnams kyi zhal du ba lo ta sarba pū dza khā hi/ oṃ āḥ:/zhes pa dang / gzhan yang sman gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams dang /sman gyi bka' srung lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum dang / mi'am ci la sogs pa'i dam tshig la gnas pa thams cad kyi zhal du i rda ba li ta gritna khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma gsos la 'bul/ arbhe sogs kyis mchod/ de nas yang gtor ma gsos la/ slar yang byin gyis brlabs nas/ sman gyi byin 'bebs shing /dbang bskur bya ba ni/ hūṃ chos dbyings spros dang bral ba'i klong yangs nas//'gro don 'dod dgu'i gar bsgyur gtso dang 'khor// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i nad sel bde gshegs gtso// sngon med sman pa'i byin rlabs dus 'dir phob /phobs / / rigs lnga sku lnga rig pa'i ye shes lnga// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba yab yum rnams// 'gro lnga dug lnga'i nad las grol ba'i phyir// dus 'dir byin rlobs sman pa'i bcud phob cig/ lha dang drang srong phyi nang sde bzhi'i 'khor//

404 ri'iogayu thog snying thigarang las mi gzhan sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams// bdud rtsi sman gyi dngos grub ster la dbang // gnas dus rdzas la bdud rtsi'i byin phob cig/ snang ba ma 'gags skye med chos dbyings klong // rang rtsal ma 'gags padma'i rigs las 'khrungs// bde chen gar gyi rol pa'i dngos grub stsol// rta mchog yab yum byin rlabs 'dir phob cig/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i phrin las bzhi la dbang // bdud bzhi zil gnon tshad med bzhi yi dngos// gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib pa sbyong mdzad bzhis// 'khor lo bzhi la dus 'dir byin phob cig/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba// legs nyes dpang mdzod dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol// gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs//chos skyong dam can tshogs kyis byin phob cig/ sngon tshe rgyas sras gu ṇa'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srog gi snying po phul// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub ster nus rnams// dam las ma 'da' dus 'dir byin phob cig/ e ma e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// spro dga' bkra shis pho brang a la la// bla ma'i byin rlabs char rgyun si li li// yi dam dngos grub rgya mtsho me re re// mkha' 'gro phrin las glog ltar khyugs se khyug/ khro tshogs hūṃ phaṭa 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// chos skyong dgra bo'i srog la rubs se rub// rig 'dzin drang srong sprin ltar thibs se thib// sna tshogs lha mo'i glu dbyings kyu ru ru// rnam mang mchod pa'i bkod pa lings se ling // dri zhim spos kyi dud pa thu lu lu// rab snyan lha yi rol mo khro lo lo// sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub chi li li// bdud rtsi sman gyi char pa sha ra ra//'dir gshegs gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlobs// skal ldan bu la dbang mchog bskur du gsol// sku yi dbang bskur byin rlabs lus la zhugs//lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par mdzod// gsung gi dbang bskur byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par mdzod//thugs kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs sems la zhugs// yid kyi nad gdon sdig

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 405sgrib dag par mdzod// sku gsung thugs dbang lus ngag yid la rdzob// sgrib gsum dag nas sku gsum mngon gyur shog/ kā ya wā ka tsitta a dhiṣṭha na a rnyiṣṭha te a bhi ṣiñtsa kli/ zhes brjod cing / tsaka li slob ma'i mgo la reg cing / de rjes gtor ma de nad med sman gyi bdud rtsi 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsams la/ dngos grub thob pa'i slad du dam la gnas pa rnams la byin pas lus kyi nang bdud rtsis gang / lha tshogs thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob nas skal ba mnyam par bsam mo// de nas thog mar rtsa gsum sgril ba'i bzlas lung dang rjes su chos skyongasrog lung byin/ de nas sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i dmar gtor byin gyis brlabs/ rang rang sngags kyis bsngos pas sku gzugs tsa ka li dang bcas pas slob ma la bka' srung gi dbang bskur ro// de yang slob ma mthu stobs kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje dregs pa ma lus dbang du sdud/ zil gyis gnon/bran du khol ba zhig la bka' srung rnams bran du ster gtor ma g.yon/ tsaka li re re zhing g.yas su bskur la/ 'di skad do// hūṃ hūṃ nga ni rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal// khro bo kun gyi che btsan te// khams gsum srid gsum za bar nas//bka' las 'da' byed brlag par byed// bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pas// chos skyong dam can thams cad dang // khyad par bdud 'dul 'khor dang bcas// dpal ldan e ka dza ṭī ma// gza' bdud chen po rā hu la//mkha' 'gro ce spyang mchu dmar ma// gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag dang //dam can srog gi spu gri'i tshogs// srin po khrag gi ral pa can// bdud mo ro zan bya rgod mgo/ las mkhan hab se 'khor dang bcas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' yis ni// khyed rnams 'di yi bran du bskos// byin pa'i zas zo bskul na rgyug/ bcol ba'i las rnams gang yin yang // ma 'gyangs myur du 'grub par byos// sman gyi bstan pa thub par srungs// gal te dam las 'da' byed

406 ༄zagayu thog snying thigan// bdud du phob /phobs la gshed ma gyis// bka' bzhin bsgrubs na sdong (sdongs grogs mdzod// dregs pa'i rtsal dbang thob gyur cig/ oṃ mahā kā la sarba du mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod gtor ma de slar chos skyong la'ang 'bul lo// dbang 'di rnams gnas pa'i phyir du bkra shis brjod do// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gsum pa bskur ba'i phyir du dbang rten ni/ bla ma la 'bul ba'i yum dang / slob bu rang nyid kyi rten gnyis mtshan dang ldan pa btsal/ smin par byas nas/ bla ma yab yum gnyis yol ba'i nang du bzhugs/ slob bus yol ba'i phyi nas dag pa'i maṇḍal dang / lus longs spyod thams cad phul nas/ gdong dar bkab nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye ho rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bde chen po// brtse chen dmigs med thugs rje yis// bdag la gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ston// bde chen dngos grub gsang dbang stsol// ces lan gsum bskor ba dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla mas yol ba bsal la/ gsang ba'i dam tshig phog mig phye/ yum gyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan la/ bu ltos kun bzang yum gyi mkha'// ma lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// gang gas mthong bas sdig pa 'dzad//dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas yin// zhes gsungs nas/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'i lha ngo sprod do// de nas yol ba btang la/ bla ma yab yum sbyor ba byas pa'i mtshams nas/ bde ba'i sgra 'od zer dang bcas pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras rta phag yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kur phyag chen gyi mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ yum gyi dmar cha yang de ltar bsams nas byang sems dbab/ de nyid padma las skyinas slob bu'i lces dngos su len pa'am/ ka pā lar/mngar gsum ga bur/ tsan dan bdud rtsi sbyar te/ slob bu'i ngag tu bskur te/ oṃ phung khams skye mched gdod nas lha ru dag/ byang sems dkar dmar

406 ༄zagayu thog snying thigan// bdud du phob /phobs la gshed ma gyis// bka' bzhin bsgrubs na sdong (sdongs grogs mdzod// dregs pa'i rtsal dbang thob gyur cig/ oṃ mahā kā la sarba du mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod gtor ma de slar chos skyong la'ang 'bul lo// dbang 'di rnams gnas pa'i phyir du bkra shis brjod do// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gsum pa bskur ba'i phyir du dbang rten ni/ bla ma la 'bul ba'i yum dang / slob bu rang nyid kyi rten gnyis mtshan dang ldan pa btsal/ smin par byas nas/ bla ma yab yum gnyis yol ba'i nang du bzhugs/ slob bus yol ba'i phyi nas dag pa'i maṇḍal dang / lus longs spyod thams cad phul nas/ gdong dar bkab nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye ho rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bde chen po// brtse chen dmigs med thugs rje yis// bdag la gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ston// bde chen dngos grub gsang dbang stsol// ces lan gsum bskor ba dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla mas yol ba bsal la/ gsang ba'i dam tshig phog mig phye/ yum gyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan la/ bu ltos kun bzang yum gyi mkha'// ma lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// gang gas mthong bas sdig pa 'dzad//dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas yin// zhes gsungs nas/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'i lha ngo sprod do// de nas yol ba btang la/ bla ma yab yum sbyor ba byas pa'i mtshams nas/ bde ba'i sgra 'od zer dang bcas pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras rta phag yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kur phyag chen gyi mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ yum gyi dmar cha yang de ltar bsams nas byang sems dbab/ de nyid padma las skyinas slob bu'i lces dngos su len pa'am/ ka pā lar/mngar gsum ga bur/ tsan dan bdud rtsi sbyar te/ slob bu'i ngag tu bskur te/ oṃ phung khams skye mched gdod nas lha ru dag/ byang sems dkar dmar

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 407bde chen bla na med// dri med bdud rtsi rgyun gyi dbang bskur bas// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dbang thob shog/ bodhi tsitta mahā su kha a dhi ṣiñtsa hoḥces blud de/ bla ma yab yum sbyor mtshams nas yi dam lha tshogs zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar 'dres pa bde ba chen po'i rgyun babs/ rang gi lce thog nas byon/ lus kyi nang rtsa 'khor nas rim gyis brgyud de/ lus thams cad zag med kyi bdud rtsi bde ba chen pos phril gyis gang las rlung gi rgyu ba chad/ ye shes kyi rlung 'ba' yig tu song bar bsam/ de'ang bla ma yab yum gyi lus kyi bum pa las/ byang sems kyi chu rgyun byung nas/ lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag bkrus pa cini bum dbang / lce thog tu bzhag dus la/ gtsang sme'i rtog pa bral zhing / de nyid kun gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pas gsang dbang /de'i ro myong bas lus sems la bde bas khyab pas shes rab ye shes/ de gsum ga'i ngo bo gnyis med du mngon du mthong ba ni dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas brtul zhugs rig ma'i dbang la brten nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur te/ slob mar mig dar bkab/ dag pa'i me tog dang bcas pa'i maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin//'khor lo bde chen bde ba'i mchog/ khyed kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis//gsum pa'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/de nas slob dpon gyis mig dar phye la/ phyag rgya'i lus gos dang phral nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs par bstan/ phung khams skye mched kyi lha ngo sprad la/ yum gyis 'di skad brjod/ kye hoḥ tshe 'dir mchog gi skal ba can// phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas kun// kho mo'i padma 'di las byung //'di ni chos dbyings yum gyi mkha'// lus kyi dkyil 'khor bde chen yin//cho ga bzhin du bsten spro'am// zhes brjod/ slob mas spro lags zhes brjod/de nas las rgya chas su zhugs la/ bla mas slob ma la sbyin te/ hūṃ mtshan ldan

408 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabakra shis shes rab yum// 'gyur med bde ster yid 'ong ma// bde ba'i mchod pa chen po gyis// 'khor lo'i gnas bzhir dbab gzung ldog/ bkram las chos nyid don rtogs byas// kun bzang dgongs pa bla med pa// da lta khyod la mngon sum du// 'char 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// smin grol dbang mchog bskur thob shog/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu hya dzñā na mahā su kha bhañdza mo kṣa ho//zhes brjod pas nyon mongs pa ye shes su shar nas/ shes rab dbyings kyi yum la dbang thob par bsams/ de nas slob bu las rgyar bcas pa yol ba'i phyi rol tu gdan 'bol zhing / bag tsha ba med pa'i gnas su bskyal nas/gnyis ka lhar gsal/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa gtso bo gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi gsal gdab/ lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ khams dkar dmar gyi rgyun chi li li byon/ spyi bo nas 'khor lo bzhi la rim gyis babs par bsams la/ dang por 'o byed pa dang / gdong pad 'jib/ brang skyes 'phur/ bde ba'i gnas thams cad du rol rtsed sna tshogs pa la brten nas gnyis ku'i khams cung zad g.yos te/ lus sems bde phril gyis nyams su myong ba ni/ byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par babs pas/ tshor ba btang snyoms las bye brag phyed pa 'byung bas dga' ba'i ye shes so// rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i skad cig ma yengs pa de'i ngo bo la/ rang ngo shes tsam gyi dran pa brtan cing / de ga'i ngang la phyam gyis glod nas cung zad ngal gsos shig snying gi bu zhes bya/ de nas 'dug stangs gang yang rung bas/yum gyi mkhar rdo rje dal bus bcug la/ ha cang mi drag par bsrubs pas/byang sems snying gar dbab ste/ sngar gyi bde ba bas kyang cher dga' ste/gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pas/ mchog dga'i ye shes skyes te/rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma yin pas nyams myong de ngos zin tsam gyi ngang la chil gyis bzhag la/ ngal gsos shig snying gi bu zhes bya/ de nas srub pa

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 409dang bsrubs pa'i sbyor bas byang sems lte bar dbab/ zag bcas kyi bde ba'i tshor ba ci yang 'gags/ zag med kyi bde ba dngos su ma skyes pa'i bar der zhen sred bde bas zos pas dga' bral gyi ye shes te/ rnam par nyid /shar pa'i skad cig ma yin pas/ ngo shes par gyis la/ de ma'i ngang la tsan /btsan gyis zhog cig ces brjod/ yang bsrubs pas byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtser byon pa'i nus pas/ yum yang bde ba dpag tu med pa skye/de'i rang gshes kyi steng du bcas bcos med par lhan gyis bzhag pas/sems dang sems 'byung thams cad zag med lhan cig skyes par thim pas/'bad rtsol dran bya dran byed kyi 'jug pa thams cad dang bral bas/ bde stong gnyis su med par ngo 'phrod pas/ gzhi 'bras dbyer mi phyed cing dus gsum dus med thams cad du 'pho 'gyur med par rtogs pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi dga' ba ste/ mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig ma yin no// de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po ste/ da lta'i shes pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ bdag ga'an gnyis su mi rtog la/ rang gsal ngo bos stong pa'i mdangs lhang nge ba de dag yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig snying gi bu zhes ngo sprad do// de nas thag /thig le phyir ma 'phos par/ gzung ldog dgram pa'i sbyor ba bslab ste mas bstan gyi dga' bzhi ngo sprad par bya'o// de yang dga' ba dang po la zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum 'gags/ dga' ba gnyis pa la/'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags/ dga' ba gsum pa'i dus su/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun 'gags/ dga' ba bzhi pa'i dus kyi nyams myong blo las 'das pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa sems can gyi sems/ dngos po'i gnas lugs de ngo shes par gyis shig de'i ngang la zhig cig 'di lta bu ngo 'phrod nas rnam rtog gang skyes pa thams cad 'dis

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 409dang bsrubs pa'i sbyor bas byang sems lte bar dbab/ zag bcas kyi bde ba'i tshor ba ci yang 'gags/ zag med kyi bde ba dngos su ma skyes pa'i bar der zhen sred bde bas zos pas dga' bral gyi ye shes te/ rnam par nyid /shar pa'i skad cig ma yin pas/ ngo shes par gyis la/ de ma'i ngang la tsan /btsan gyis zhog cig ces brjod/ yang bsrubs pas byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtser byon pa'i nus pas/ yum yang bde ba dpag tu med pa skye/de'i rang gshes kyi steng du bcas bcos med par lhan gyis bzhag pas/sems dang sems 'byung thams cad zag med lhan cig skyes par thim pas/'bad rtsol dran bya dran byed kyi 'jug pa thams cad dang bral bas/ bde stong gnyis su med par ngo 'phrod pas/ gzhi 'bras dbyer mi phyed cing dus gsum dus med thams cad du 'pho 'gyur med par rtogs pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi dga' ba ste/ mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig ma yin no// de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po ste/ da lta'i shes pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ bdag ga'an gnyis su mi rtog la/ rang gsal ngo bos stong pa'i mdangs lhang nge ba de dag yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig snying gi bu zhes ngo sprad do// de nas thag /thig le phyir ma 'phos par/ gzung ldog dgram pa'i sbyor ba bslab ste mas bstan gyi dga' bzhi ngo sprad par bya'o// de yang dga' ba dang po la zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum 'gags/ dga' ba gnyis pa la/'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags/ dga' ba gsum pa'i dus su/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun 'gags/ dga' ba bzhi pa'i dus kyi nyams myong blo las 'das pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa sems can gyi sems/ dngos po'i gnas lugs de ngo shes par gyis shig de'i ngang la zhig cig 'di lta bu ngo 'phrod nas rnam rtog gang skyes pa thams cad 'dis

410 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigalam du khyer cig 'di dus su ngo 'phrod pa de brjod med du bskyangs na/ de las gzhan pa'i nyams len zab mo yod re dkon mchog dpang / do nub skal ldanakhyed rnams la kun tu bzang po sman rgyal gyi dgongs pa lag bcangs su sprad pa yin pas/ 'khor ba las btsan thabs su grol bas shin tu spro dga' chen po mdzod/ rjes nyams bskyed du gzhug go/ de nas rig pa ye shes kyi dbang ni slob mas/ rang gi bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig phul nas zhu ba/ kye ho bka' drin 'khor med bla ma la// lus dang longs spyod mchod par 'bul//bde chen 'gyur med gzhal yas 'di// yang dag snying pos bdag la stsol//zhes lan gsum du zhu'o// de nas dbang rten rdo rje dril bu lag tu gtad/mdun du me long la man shel gyi gzugs 'char du bcug bskur tshig ni/ hūṃ rang rig ye shes bde chen klong // gsal la ma 'gags 'dzin rtog bral//thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug/ 'dir ma 'dus pa'i chos gzhan med//tshig tu brjod bral brda yis mtshan// 'gyur med thugs mchog dbang bskur nas// bskur dus dus gsum dus med mchog/ slob dpon rang sems dri ma med// blo 'das rang grol snod ldan bu// dkyil 'khor zung 'jug phyag rgya che//'jug tshul rang sar rang 'jug ste// ngo bo gang mthong dmigs dbye ba//lam la goms 'jug dbang thob pa'o// 'di ni gsang ba'i dbang mchog pas//bstim nas mnyam nyid ye shes che// 'khrul dang grol ba'i bar gyi chos// ma lus rang gi sems la rdzogs// gsal la ma 'gags 'dzin pa spangs//bsgribs dang ma bsgribs 'di la med// 'di la bstan bya ston byed bral//gnas 'gyu bying rmugs 'phro rgod dang // bde gsal mi rtog la sogs pa//gang shar gang snang de nyid la// bzang ngan 'dam ga ma byed par// rang bab bzo med gshis la zhog/ gal te rtag chad mtha' bral sogs// ched du 'bad na gang bsgom pa// dug sbrul gtses pa dag dang mtshungs// thog ma

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 411med nas mtha' med par// srid par lhung ba gang yin pa// gshes la 'khrul na bcos pas len// de phyir rang gi rig pa las// ye shes gzhan du 'tshol 'dod pa// snying la gdon chen zin pa yin// man shel can gyis bsgyur ba ltar// sna tshogs 'char yang rang rig ni// bde ba che las g.yos pa med//de phyir rang rig ye shes ni// dbang mchog skal ldan bu la bskur// spang blang med par thob gyur cig/ oṃ āḥmai dzñā na pañtsa sarba dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing don ngo sprod/ de rnams brtan pa'i phyir rab gnas dang tshogs ston bya'o// de nas de kho na nyid la dbang zhu ba'i slad du/ slob mas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'am/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e ma ho/ kun bzang rang sems bla ma la// ka dag klong yangs maṇḍal 'bul// lta sgom spyod 'bras zab mo'i dbang // kun rdzogs khyab gdal bskur du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ dbang rten mdun gyi bar snang gi dkyil du bltar bcug la bskur tshig ni/ hūṃ ltos shig skal ldan snying gi bu// bar snang yangs pa'i dkyil du ltos// stong gsal rang mdangs mtha' dbus bral// zhen 'dzin yul med bde ba che// phyogs lhung mtha' bral lta ba'i mchog/ kun byed kun grol khyab gdal la// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs dbang bskur// thob med tshul gyis thob gyur cig/ a ti ho/de nas bsgom ba'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten mar me zhig gtad la bskur tshig ni/ hūṃ stong nyid mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa// sgoms shig sgoms shig ma sgoms shig/ rlung gis mi bskyod mar me ltar// gsal stong 'dzin med dbang thob shog/ a ti ho/ zhes brjod la ngo sprad/ de nas 'bras bu'i dbang ni/a mṛ ta sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi slob dpon gyi khyor ba re'i tshad kha ru bzung / khong du ma mid pa'i bar du dbang rten byas nas/ bskur tshig ni/ e ma ltos shig

412 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaskal ldan bu// rang sems chos sku 'gyur med ltos// smra bsam brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das// mkhur bkang smra brjod byed bzhin no// gang yang ma grub stong chen ngang // 'gyur med gdeng ldan 'bras bu mchog/ 'di las gzhan du ma re zhig/ rang chas lhun grub dbang thob shog/ a ti ho/ zhes pa'i ngang las/ phaṭaḥ ces brjod du bcug mkhur ba bdud rtsis gang bas smra mi shes pa ltar/ 'bras bu sku gsum yang tshig dang don las 'das par ngo sprad do// de nas spyod pa'i dbang ni/ dbang rten slob dpon nam/ gzhan lus kyi gar stabs byas la/ bskul tshig ni/ hūṃ nyon cig skal ldan snying gi bu//stong nyid ye shes rol ba las// dgag sgrub med pa'i spyod pa shar// ci byas 'gro don dbang thob shog/ a ti ho/ zhes ngo sprad do// rol mo sgrog de nas chos rnams kun rdzob dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur te/ dbang rten padma 'dab drug gi steng du/ shel gyi mchod rten bang rim dgu pa dang /rdo rje dril bu gtad de/ bskur tshig ni/ kli theg sgo bsam mi khyab dang blo yi khrid thabs yin// chos rnams sems la sha rdzogs rdul tsam ga la yod//sems nyid bden gnyis dbyer med mthar thug chos sku dngos// kun khyab dum bur bcad pa de ring khyab gdal lo// da ni bu khyod rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med pas// gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro rnams bde la bkod//phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi dam ldan zhing // skal ldan slob bu'i tshogs la zab mo'i de nyid ston// chos kyi rgyal tshab dam par khyod kyi dbang bskur ro//rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde thob shog/ oṃ āḥbhū badzra dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas slob ma rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob tu gyur par bsam/ rab gnas bkra shis kyi cho ga bya'o// rjes kyi bya ba la/ dam tshig srung sdom gyi bslab bya bstan pa dang / dbang ma thob pa'i skyon/ thob yon 'bras bu/ yon 'bul ba rnams dang / gtad rgya ni gzhan du shes par bya'o//

412 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaskal ldan bu// rang sems chos sku 'gyur med ltos// smra bsam brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das// mkhur bkang smra brjod byed bzhin no// gang yang ma grub stong chen ngang // 'gyur med gdeng ldan 'bras bu mchog/ 'di las gzhan du ma re zhig/ rang chas lhun grub dbang thob shog/ a ti ho/ zhes pa'i ngang las/ phaṭaḥ ces brjod du bcug mkhur ba bdud rtsis gang bas smra mi shes pa ltar/ 'bras bu sku gsum yang tshig dang don las 'das par ngo sprad do// de nas spyod pa'i dbang ni/ dbang rten slob dpon nam/ gzhan lus kyi gar stabs byas la/ bskul tshig ni/ hūṃ nyon cig skal ldan snying gi bu//stong nyid ye shes rol ba las// dgag sgrub med pa'i spyod pa shar// ci byas 'gro don dbang thob shog/ a ti ho/ zhes ngo sprad do// rol mo sgrog de nas chos rnams kun rdzob dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur te/ dbang rten padma 'dab drug gi steng du/ shel gyi mchod rten bang rim dgu pa dang /rdo rje dril bu gtad de/ bskur tshig ni/ kli theg sgo bsam mi khyab dang blo yi khrid thabs yin// chos rnams sems la sha rdzogs rdul tsam ga la yod//sems nyid bden gnyis dbyer med mthar thug chos sku dngos// kun khyab dum bur bcad pa de ring khyab gdal lo// da ni bu khyod rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med pas// gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro rnams bde la bkod//phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi dam ldan zhing // skal ldan slob bu'i tshogs la zab mo'i de nyid ston// chos kyi rgyal tshab dam par khyod kyi dbang bskur ro//rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde thob shog/ oṃ āḥbhū badzra dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas slob ma rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob tu gyur par bsam/ rab gnas bkra shis kyi cho ga bya'o// rjes kyi bya ba la/ dam tshig srung sdom gyi bslab bya bstan pa dang / dbang ma thob pa'i skyon/ thob yon 'bras bu/ yon 'bul ba rnams dang / gtad rgya ni gzhan du shes par bya'o//

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 413de nas gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ rab gnas bya/ tshogs kyi nyams chags bskang / tshe 'gugs bkra shis brjod/ dmigs med bsngo bas rgyas btab bya/smi: shu rghaṃ//ga g.yuthog snying thig gi bsgrub kyi don dbang mdor bsdusabazhugasaso/dril sgrub kyi rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams/ rigs 'dus dbang kun 'dus pa'i sgron me bskur bar 'dod pas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas bsham/ sku rten dgram (bkraman/ 'bru sna/ spos sna/ dkar gsum/mngar gsum/ sman sna tshogs las byas pa'i gtor ma rin po che 'bar ba'i gzugs kyi zur me ris spras pa'i sku logs la a ru ra gser mdog gi gzugs dang / 'khor gyi padma 'dab bzhi/ tshe ril dang bcas pas bskor/ de la sha mar gyi rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs pas spras/ sku rten tsa ka li gzugs/dar sna'i gur dbub/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhag drang srong dang sman gyi lha mo'i dkar gtor sman snas bran pa zhig dang / bka' srung gi gtor ma dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa zhig bsham/ de nas slob dpon gyis las gzhung bsrang / bzlas pa bya/ bdag 'jug blang / slob ma rnams khrus byas/dag pa'i me tog dang bcas pa'i maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa lan gsum bya/ slob dpon gyis slob ma rgyun bshags bya ru gzhug skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sdom pa 'bogs/ ye shes pa dbab/ de nas dbang bskur dngos ga'i ni/ slob dpon kyis dmigs pa gsal gdab ste/ gtor ma phyi gtor ma la nang gzhal yas khang du/ bla ma rigs 'dus sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang yab yum 'od zer gyi phung po rab tu 'bar ba snang la rang bzhin ma grub par bzhugs

414 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigapar bskyed la/ de'i spyi bo nas oṃ dkar po 'od dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i spyi bor thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du ngo sprad/ sku bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang thob/ sprul ba'i sku mngon du byas so// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gsung las/ āḥdamar po 'od dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang dbang thob/ sgra grag tshad thams cad yi dam lha'i gsung du ngo sprad/ ngag bzlas pa byed pa la dbang thob/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byas so// gtso 'khor gyi thugs ka nas kli mthing ga 'od dang bcas pa byung / slob ma'i snying gar thim/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dran rtog thams cad ye shes kyi rol par ngo sprad/ lam pho nyas bgrod pa la dbang thob/ chos kyi sku mngon du byas so// gtso 'khor gyi sku gsung thugs las hrīḥyig dang 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la dus gcig tu thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs zhugs/tshig dbang rin po che thob/ snang srid gdal ba chen po chos skur ngo sprad/lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byas par bsams la/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du gtor mas reg cing / rol mo dang bcas pa'i bskur tshig ni/ hūṃ gnyis med chos dbyings dag pa'i klong yangs nas// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun// sngon gyi dam bcas thugs dam bdag bskul nas// mkhyen brtse'i nus pas bdag la byin gyis rlobs// phyi ni dam rdzas gtor ma rgyan dang ldan// ro bcud phun tshogs sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// nang ni ye shes lha yi gzhal yas khang // bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs// skal ldan bu la dbang mchog bskur du

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 415gsol// lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa ma lus dag/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas kyang // ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog thob par shog/ oṃ āḥbhū gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥzhes brjod/ de nas drang srong gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ srang /drang srong rnams la bsngo zhing dngos grub blang / slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ phyogs bcu'i lha dang drang srong mngon shes dang ldan pa rnams dang / sman gyi lha mo thams cad char bab pa ltar thim par bsams la/bskur tshig ni/ kli rgyal ba kun 'dus sman rgyal bka' yi 'khor// lha dang drangasrong phyi nang sde bzhi po// sngon gyi zhal bzhes thugs dam dran mdzod la//skal ldan bu la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// car mthong mngon shes nad ngos zin pa dang // snang srid sman gyi rol par 'char 'gyur zhing // mthong thos dran reg nad pa'i tshogs rnams kun// ma lus bde la 'god pa'i dbang thob shog/ sarba a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥlha/ zhes brjod/ de nas bka' srung gtor ma rnams dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rang rang la bsngo zhing / dam tshig bsgrag chos skyong gi bstod pa gang 'os byas la/ slob ma mthu stobs bdag por bsams pa'i bran du sprad (sprad par bsams la/ gtor ma mgo 'am nad pa'i lag tu gtad la/ chos skyong gi srog rtsa thams cad la rang dbang bsgyur bar bsgom du bcug la/ bskur tshig ni/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma'i bka' bsrung zhing // dam las mi 'da' sman gyi bstan pa skyong // gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs// dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas bzhes// khyed rnams rgyal sras 'di yi bran nyid du//de ring rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis gzung // lus la grib bzhin 'grogs la phrin las sgrubs// ma hā kā la sarba tsitta sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod de/

416 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagator ma chos skyong la bsngo zhing lha tshogs thams cad la mchod bstod 'dod gsol bya/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ rjes mi mngon par bya'o//dril sgrub dbang zab mo gud du sbas pa zin bris byas pa'o// sarba maṅga lam̐/ shu rghaṃ//nga / g.yuthog snying thig gi bla sgrub kyi dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya mdud bzhugasaso/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba sa ma ya sidhi hūṃ ho/ 'dir rigs 'dus rgyal ba bla ma sman rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang dang gdams pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyis dam tshig bsrung ba'i rim pa ni gsum/ phyi nang gsang ba'o// dang po blo gzhag drug gzung bya gnyis/ shes bya gsum mo// de dag ni slob dpon la sangs rgyas kyi blo gzhag de'i gsung la drang srong gi gsung / gso dpyad la dam pa'i chos su mched grogs spun gyi blo/ nad pa la bu tsha'i blo/ rnag khrag la khyi phag gi blo gzhag pa dang drug go/ gzung bya gnyis ni/ sman gyi brgyud pa'i rig 'dzin rnams bka' srung du bzung la gsol mchod bya zhing re ltos bya/ cha dpyad (byadakarnams yi dam gyi phyag mtshan ltar bzung ste mi 'bral bar bcang ngo // shes bya gsum ni/ sman rnams dgosa'adod 'byung ba'i nor bu/ rig 'dzin mchod rdzas/ nad rnams sel ba'i bdud rtsir shes par bya'o// gnyis pa nang gi ni/ rtsa ba gsum/ yan lag nyer lnga/ spyi'i bcu gcig de'i srung thabs kyi rim pa ni/ sku'i dam tshig tu rdo rje slob dpon dang / mched lcam dral la bsrung ste/ brdeg 'tshog dang / rku 'phrog brnyas sems/ skur 'debs/ thugs dang 'gal ba rnams bsrung / gsung gi dam tshig ni/dbang thob nas yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bsrung ste/ sku'i dam tshig tu

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 417bskyed rim bsgom/ gsung gi dam tshig tu snying po bgrang / thugs kyi ni ting 'dzin 'phro 'du bya ba dang thugs dam bskang ba sogs rab tu chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyang / 'bring nyin mtshan lan gsum gsum la thun gcig mi bcagatha ma nyin zhag phrugs re lan re mi bcag par bsrung bar bya'o// thugs kyi dam tshig tu bsrung bya ni/ sgrub rdzas phyag mtshan thams cad dam tshig ma 'dres pa la gsang ba dang / sbyor sgrol gyi phyag len gsang ba dang / khyad par sman gtor rakta sogs gong gi mchod rdzas gsang ba dang / rtsa ba'i snying po gsang ba dang / phyag rgya mtshon dpe gsang ba dang / phrin las dang mdzad spyod gsang ba dang / sgrub thabs kyi man ngag gsang ba dang / mdor na bla ma dang mched sring tshang ma/ chos spyod la sogs gsang bar 'os pa rnams shin tu gsang ba dang / bla ma mched kyi phyir du/ man ngag gam/ gnyer du gtad pa kun bskal pa 'jig kyang gsang / zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o// rtsa ba'i dam tshig 'di dag ma bsrungs na/ bskal ba lngar rdo rje dmyal bar skye bar rgyud sde thams cad las gsungs so// de nas yan lag gi dam tshig nyer lnga bsrung ba dang / shes par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga la/ phung po lnga dang / 'byung ba lnga/yul lnga/ dngos po lnga/ ye shes lnga/ rigs lnga yab yum ye sbyor chen por shes par bya'o// spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/ ka dag klong yangs bde ba chen po'i rtsis zin pa'i ngang nas/ sbyor ba dang / sgrol ba dang / ma byin len/rdzun du smra/ tshig brlang po lnga po 'gro ba'i don du spyad par bya'o// mi spong ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog lnga ni ye nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du rtogs par bya zhing / mi spong ba dang rang sar grol lo// bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/ rdo rje rigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / rin po che'i rigs dang / padma'i rigs dang / las kyi rigs dang lnga po de rnams bsgrub/ ting nge 'dzin le lo med

418 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigapar brtson pas bsgrub par bya'o// dang du blang pa'i dam tshig lnga ni/ dri chen/dri chu/ dmar chename sa yin/ byang sems dkar po/ padma rakta lnga/ 'dzin rtog med par blang zhing spyod do// de ltar yan lag gi dam tshig nyams na mnar med dmyal bar skye bar rgyud nas gsungs so// rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi bor 'khur zhing / thun mong spyi'i dam tshig tu bka' zur tsam yang mi gcog pa dang / bla med theg pa mchog mi spong ba dang / thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mi yengs pa dang /sngags dang chos spyi la the tshom spangs pa dang / mched lcam gdung sems kyis bskyang ba dang / sems can thams cad snying rjes drangs pa dang / nyon mongs pa rang dgar mi gtong ba dang / theg pa dang chos kyi kha zin ches nas gzhan la mi smod pa dang / le lo gnyid dang chang dbang spang ba dang / lta spyod zung du 'brel bas bsnyen sgrub mthar dbyung bar bya'o// gsang ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de yang gdod ma nas rang byung chos sku'i ngang du rtogs pa de las mi 'da' bar bsrung ngo // gzhan yang bde ba'i dam tshig tu thig le srog las gces pa yungs 'bru tsam yang ma nyams par bsrung / gsal ba'i dam tshig tu rlung gi rnal 'byor la 'bad/ mi rtog pa'i dam tshig tu/ chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par gzhag dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ dran du med pa'i dran pa ma yengs tsam rgyang so btsugs nas shes bzhin gyi mel tshe bsrung ba gces so// de'ang / dam tshig rnams ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin// zhes pa dang / mi gtong phyir na dam zhes bya// zung du 'jug pa dam zhes bya// yang na de nyid bka' bcag na// mnar med gnas su tshig par 'gyur// zhes dang / rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na// bsgrub pa thams cad log par 'gyur// yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs pa'i// 'bras bu mang du mthong bar 'gyur// zhes sogs

418 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigapar brtson pas bsgrub par bya'o// dang du blang pa'i dam tshig lnga ni/ dri chen/dri chu/ dmar chename sa yin/ byang sems dkar po/ padma rakta lnga/ 'dzin rtog med par blang zhing spyod do// de ltar yan lag gi dam tshig nyams na mnar med dmyal bar skye bar rgyud nas gsungs so// rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi bor 'khur zhing / thun mong spyi'i dam tshig tu bka' zur tsam yang mi gcog pa dang / bla med theg pa mchog mi spong ba dang / thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mi yengs pa dang /sngags dang chos spyi la the tshom spangs pa dang / mched lcam gdung sems kyis bskyang ba dang / sems can thams cad snying rjes drangs pa dang / nyon mongs pa rang dgar mi gtong ba dang / theg pa dang chos kyi kha zin ches nas gzhan la mi smod pa dang / le lo gnyid dang chang dbang spang ba dang / lta spyod zung du 'brel bas bsnyen sgrub mthar dbyung bar bya'o// gsang ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de yang gdod ma nas rang byung chos sku'i ngang du rtogs pa de las mi 'da' bar bsrung ngo // gzhan yang bde ba'i dam tshig tu thig le srog las gces pa yungs 'bru tsam yang ma nyams par bsrung / gsal ba'i dam tshig tu rlung gi rnal 'byor la 'bad/ mi rtog pa'i dam tshig tu/ chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par gzhag dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ dran du med pa'i dran pa ma yengs tsam rgyang so btsugs nas shes bzhin gyi mel tshe bsrung ba gces so// de'ang / dam tshig rnams ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin// zhes pa dang / mi gtong phyir na dam zhes bya// zung du 'jug pa dam zhes bya// yang na de nyid bka' bcag na// mnar med gnas su tshig par 'gyur// zhes dang / rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na// bsgrub pa thams cad log par 'gyur// yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs pa'i// 'bras bu mang du mthong bar 'gyur// zhes sogs

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 419gsungs pa'i don la nges shes bskyed nas dam tshig bsrung / sdom pa la 'bad pagal che'o// gal te nyams na phyir bcos pa ni/ sku'i dam tshig 'gal ba dang / na rag la brten pa'i phyag dang bskang tshig gis bshags/ gsung gi dam tshig 'gal ba na yig brgya 'bum bsnyen byas pa las bshags/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa na/ bla ma mnyes bya lta bas bshags/ thun mong du/ spang blang du bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags nar ma la brtson pa gnad yin no// shu rghaṃ//ca/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya mdud lasazhal gdamasagasal ba'i sgron me bzhugasaso/drang srong dharma swā mis sbyar ba'o/ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ thog mar gsang sngags bla med kyi chos sgo dbang gis 'byed dgos pas dbang bskur thob dgos pa ni ji skad du/ snod ldan skal bzang skyes bu yis// tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog thob phyir// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// gus pas dbang mchog rdzogs par zhus// zhes gsungs so// dbang ma thob pa'i skyon ni ji skad du/ dbang bskur ma thob sngags 'chang dang // bsten sgrub las la 'jug pa kun// gdon chen snying la zin pa yin// 'dod pa'i 'bras med dmyal bar sreg/ ces gsungs so// dbang thob nas dam tshig srog las gces par bsrung dgos te/ ji skad du/ dbang thob dam tshig ma bsrungs na// ḍā gis khrag 'thung thur du 'gro// yid la mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung //mi bzod sdug bsngal skyed par byed// ces gsungs so// dbang thob pa'i 'bras bu ni ji skad du/ bla ma mchog la mngon sum du// dbang rdzogs thob pa'i rnal 'byor ni// rgyal pa kun gyi sras su 'gyur// 'gyur med bde chen go 'phang thob// ces gsungs so// dbang thob nas yon 'bul dgos te/ ji

420 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigaskad du/ dbang thob bla ma sangs rgyas la// rang lus bu dang chung ma dang //rgyal srid longs spyod yon du 'bul// ma phul dbang gi 'bras bu med// ces gsungs so// de rnams kyi skyon yon khong du chud cing / spang blang tshul bzhin byed pa'i slob ma dam ldan la/ bka' lung gdams pa'i gnyer gtad de/dbang bskur rdzogs par byas pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ gri thod/ sgom thag sku rten/ rgyud sde bskyed rdzogs kyi po ti/ sman dang cha dpyad (byad rnams lag tu gtad nas 'di skad brjod/ hūṃ hoḥ kun 'dus rgyal ba bla ma lha tshogs kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las rnams// tshe 'dir thob dang 'gro ba kun 'dren phyir// dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnyer gtad do// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam ljon shing dang // 'dod 'jo'i ba dang rang gzhan re skong ba'i// rgyal ba'i bka' gsang zab mo'i gnyer gtad do// gtad do gnyer ro bka' 'di thub par srungs// seng ge'i 'o ma snod ngan ji bzhin du// dam med rnams la bka' 'di shor ra re// ngo bstod gzhogs slong nor phyir shor ra re// kha 'jam khrid mkhas bslu phyir shor ra re// kun 'dus rgyal ba sman rgyal bka' 'di ni//snying gi nor dang mig gi 'bras bu bzhin// khyad par bla ma chos la log par blta// rtog ge ba dang the tshom can la gsang // hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang // chos skyong bka' srung thams cad bsten cing sgrub//bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin las mthar skyel ba dang // 'gro ba'i zhe sdang rgyu 'bras nad gsos shig/ bshad pa sku yi rgyud kyi bka' gnyer gtad// 'gro ba'i gti mug rgyu 'bras nad gsos shig/ man ngag yon tan rgyud kyi bka' gnyer gtad// 'gro ba'i nga rgyal rgyu 'bras nad gsos shig/ phyi ma phrin las rgyud kyi bka' gnyer gtad// 'gro ba'i phrag dog rgyu 'bras nad gsos shig/mjug don yongs su gtad pa'i bka' gnyer gtad// 'gro ba'i 'dod

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 421chags rgyu 'bras nad gsos shig/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig bka' gnyer gtad// skal ldan ma lus bde chen lam la drangs// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dam tshig bka' gnyer gtad// rtag tu sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bstan par tshugs// sman dang cha dpyad /byad kun gyi bka' gnyer gtad// gang la gang phan nad pa'i don mdzod cig/ bdag gis bka' 'di khyod la gtad pa yis// gzhung dang phrin las kun gyi 'go thon nas// bka' srol mi nub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas// sems can ma lus bde la 'god par thog/ ces brjod nas bdud rtsi byin/ rab gnas bya/ rol mo dang bcas pas bkra shes brjod par bya'o//de nas dam tshig spyi'i zhal gdams zur du gdams pa ni/ sku'i dam tshig tu sku chags par byed pa la sku rten rab gnas can gyi thang sku'am lugs sku 'bral med bcang / rus rgyan/ skra tshab/ kha ṭwāṃ/ rdo rje bcang / gsung chags par byed pa la bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa rgyud cha lag dang bcas pa/rab tshig don lhag chad med par blor 'jug 'bring zla re la tshar re sgrog cing gus par byed/ de yi don la bsam/ tha ma yang lo re la tshar gsum gsum sgrog cing de'i don la bsam/ dril bu/ g.yer kha/ rkang dung / gling bu/thod rnga bcang ngo // thugs kyi dam tshig tu bskyed rdzogs kyi ting 'dzin 'bral med du bsgom/ byin rlabs can gyi bdud rtsi sman ril/ gser mdog zur lnga pa ma nyams pa dang / snying po gser gyis bris pa bcang / yon tan gyi dam tshig tu bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams ngag dang rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa snod ldan la 'chad cing spel lo// phrin las kyi dam tshig tu nad pa drag 'an bar ma thams cad la nye ring med pa'i phan ci thogs par bya/ sman dang cha dpyad /byadaka'ajom par bsag bka' srung rnams la gsol mchod rgyun du bya'o//dam tshig 'di rnams rang dang / grogs dang bla ma gsum gyis mi khrel bar
