422 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigadran shes bzhin dang ldan par dus rgyun du bsrung / dam tshig bsrung mi nas pa dang / lo gcig nyung mtha' byas pa'i sgrub pa'i khas len mi byed/ gser zho gang las chung mtha' byas pa'i 'bul ba med pa dang / chos 'di nyams su mi len cing / brgyud pa mi 'dzin cing / tshod yod dang the tshom dang yid gnyis byed pa la bstan na/ bstan pa'i byar ba dam can sde dgu 'khor dang bcas pas dpon slob gnyis ku'i snying khrag de ma thag tu 'thungs la bar mtshams med pa'i dmyal bar ltung bar gyur cig bka' 'di ma 'chal zhigabaka' bzhin sgrubs shig bka' 'das sgrol zhig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ i thi: dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya mdud kyi zhal gdams gsal byed sgron me rdzogs so//cha/ g.yuthog snying thig zab mo bla sgrub lasaphyi sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bzhugasaso/mahā gu ru lha ṣa dzhai rā dza gu ṇa na mo/ tshe gcig lus gcig la dngos grub rnam gnyis the tshom med par thob par byed pa byin rlabs bla ma'i sgrub thabs kun dang thun mong ma yin zhing / zab pa las kyang ches zab pa yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i srog snying 'di la bzhi ste/ phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/dril sgrub las mtha' 'o// dang po la dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par mthun rkyen bsags/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram/ gtor mchod ci 'byor bsham/sgo gsum rnam g.yeng spangs nas/ rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis nyams len la 'jug par bya'o// de yang dri bzang pos byugs pa'i maṇḍal gyi steng du/ padma 'dab bzhi dbus dang lnga bris pa'am/ 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bzhugs/ de'i mdun du a ru ra gser mdog

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 423dang / bzang po drug la sogs pa'i sman sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs dar sna tshogs kyi spyan gzigs dgram/ de nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po dang / mtshungs med kun (gu ṇa)dbyer mi phyed pa sku gzugs de dang tha mi dad par mdun gyi nam mkhar mtshan dpe 'od kyi phung por bzhugs par bsams la/ zhe thag pa nas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi re ltos dung pa zhig bya zhing skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig re brjod pa dang / lhan cig phreng rdog re bskyur la brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o//mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la snying rje dung pa re bsgom 'ing / de rnams kyi don du tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa dang / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes pa'i tshig brjod cing phreng ba bskyur ba brgya rtsa gcig sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sogs kyi tshig brjod/ don bsams bzhin par phreng ba bskyur ba tsam yang gang lcogs shig bya/ bdag gi lus grangs med du sprul nas gus pas 'dud par bsam ste/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// sogs kyis tshig brjod cing phyag brgya rtsa gcig bdag gzhan gyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad dang / lus longs spyod mtha' dag ri rab gling bzhi mtsho dang nyi zla mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs nas/ tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'i maṇḍal re 'bul ba dang / sku rten la bskor ba re sbrags te brgya rtsa gcig bla ma nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer med par spyi bor bsgom/ sngags phreng gi 'od zer spro bsdu dang / sku'i nang nas bdud rtsis gang bas zhabs kyi mthe bong nas 'dzag cing bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa la dmigs nas yig brgya brgya rtsa gcig re/ sngon 'gro brgya phrag lnga pa thun gcig gi khongs su bar ma chod par nyams su blangs pa'i rjes su/ ku su lu'i tshogs gsog ltar/ rang

424 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagi rnam par shes pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsams pa'i spyi bo nas bton/ gri gug gis thod pa bcad pa'i nang du lus dum bur byas pa rgya khyon nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsams te/ mgron bzhi la tshim par 'bul ba ni sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa ste/ zhag bdun las mi nyung zhing / sdig pa dag pa'i rtags ma byung bar du bya'o// de nas dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang yi dam gang mos su gsal btab pa'i spyi bor padma 'dab bzhi lte ba dang lnga'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kā wā tsi 'dus pa'i ngo bo mahā gu ṇa dang bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla beeḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po dbyer med sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gzi brjid kyi rgyal po dpal rab tu 'bar zhing zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ 'gro la chags pa'i spyan zur phyogs bcur gzigs shing / 'dzum pa'i 'od kyis yid 'phrog pa/ dbu skra kham ser cung zad li ba'i lcang lo can me tog gi phreng bas spras pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng nas utpal rgyas pa'i yu ba nas bzung nas snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba'i steng du/ rgyal yum gyi pus ti shes rab ral gris mtshan pa/ g.yon chos 'chad las padma rgyas pa'i yu ba bzung ba snyan gyi thad kur kha bye ba'i steng du/bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ gur gum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang bcas pa la/nor bu dbang rgyal dang gser gyi rdo rje sman mchog gser mdog gi g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du mtshan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub du mas mdzes shing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la mdun du lha mo dkar mo rin po che'i pi wang bsgyur ba/ g.yas su ser mo bya rgod rkang gling bsgyur ba/ rgyab tu dmar mo rkang gi gling bu bsgyur ba/ g.yon du ljang mo dngul dkar gyi me long ston pa/ bzhi ga'ang bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ 'dzum sgeg 'gying mdzes mnyen lcug 'khril ldem/ rked par rin

424 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagi rnam par shes pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsams pa'i spyi bo nas bton/ gri gug gis thod pa bcad pa'i nang du lus dum bur byas pa rgya khyon nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsams te/ mgron bzhi la tshim par 'bul ba ni sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa ste/ zhag bdun las mi nyung zhing / sdig pa dag pa'i rtags ma byung bar du bya'o// de nas dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang yi dam gang mos su gsal btab pa'i spyi bor padma 'dab bzhi lte ba dang lnga'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kā wā tsi 'dus pa'i ngo bo mahā gu ṇa dang bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla beeḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po dbyer med sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gzi brjid kyi rgyal po dpal rab tu 'bar zhing zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ 'gro la chags pa'i spyan zur phyogs bcur gzigs shing / 'dzum pa'i 'od kyis yid 'phrog pa/ dbu skra kham ser cung zad li ba'i lcang lo can me tog gi phreng bas spras pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng nas utpal rgyas pa'i yu ba nas bzung nas snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba'i steng du/ rgyal yum gyi pus ti shes rab ral gris mtshan pa/ g.yon chos 'chad las padma rgyas pa'i yu ba bzung ba snyan gyi thad kur kha bye ba'i steng du/bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ gur gum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang bcas pa la/nor bu dbang rgyal dang gser gyi rdo rje sman mchog gser mdog gi g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du mtshan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub du mas mdzes shing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la mdun du lha mo dkar mo rin po che'i pi wang bsgyur ba/ g.yas su ser mo bya rgod rkang gling bsgyur ba/ rgyab tu dmar mo rkang gi gling bu bsgyur ba/ g.yon du ljang mo dngul dkar gyi me long ston pa/ bzhi ga'ang bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ 'dzum sgeg 'gying mdzes mnyen lcug 'khril ldem/ rked par rin

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 425po che'i me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing / dbu skra lcang lo sil ma mu tig dmar po lan tshar dang bcas pa/ sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang ldan pas/ gar stabs g.yo ba'i tshul gyis gtso bo la bde stong gi mchod pa rgyun mi chad par 'bul bar bsam/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dang /bcom ldan sman pa'i rgyal po la phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba/yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad mnyam med sprul pa'i skyes mchog mahā gu ṇar dbyer ma mchis pa la lha mo bzhis bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i gtso 'khor la bstim/ phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ maṇḍal dbul(dbu / snying gi dkyil/ rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu gdab par bya'o// bla ma'i gnas bzhi las 'od 'phros/ lha mo bzhi la phog thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul/ rang gang 'dod kyi dngos grub ster bar bsam/ slar thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/brtan g.yos bsdus pa'i snod bcud thams cad kyi dwangs ma'i bcud dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i tshul du phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang du thim/ de nyid 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa yar lud/ rang gi spyi bo nas lus phyi nang du chi li li song bas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ slar yang rim gyis lus bdud rtsis ngang chil gyis gang / dbang bzhi thob sku'i sa bon sngon du byas par bsam la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la gus pa'i sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ oṃ āḥrgyu mahā gu ru sarba sirnyi phroṃ dza de wa ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring sa ma ya dzaḥ rgyu baṃ hoḥ zhes mi skyo ba'i bar du bzlas pa bya/ thun mtshams su gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa sngags la ba li ta btags la

426 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadabul/ 'dod gsol bya/ rjes su gtso 'khor gyi spyi bo nas 'od du zhu rang la thim nas dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang la ci gnas bzhag dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo/ rjes dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab bo// yang na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang yi dam lhar gsal ba'i snying ga gyen du ldog la/ padma 'dab ma lngar gyes par bsam/ de'i steng du mtshungs med gong ltar bzhugs par bsams la/ thugs kur a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ dngul chu'i mdog lta bu'i mthar/ oṃ aḥs badzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di rnams dkar ram mes bskor bar bsam/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sngags phreng 'od kyi rnam par bla ma'i zhal nas yar phyin/ rang gi kha nas tshur 'khor/ yar thon dkon mchog mchod/ sems can gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snying ga nas tshur byung / bla ma'i thugs kur byon nas slar yang zhal nas thon pa sogs 'khor ba'i bzlas pa bya'o// zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i sgo nas bla ma la gsol ba gdab par 'dod pas/ dang po zhing dang dngos po bsam pa gsum// gcig tu bsdus te gsol ba gdab/bar chad gsum dang bral gyur nas/ gang 'dod 'bras bu myur du 'byung bya ba yin pas/ steng gdon zhi bar 'dod na/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma rta mgrin du bsgom/ maṇḍal yang khro bo dpag tu med pa 'bul/ 'jig rten khams kyi sems can thams cad kyang khro bo dpag tu med pa 'bul/ 'o ga gdon zhi bar 'dod na bla ma phyag na rdo rje bsgoms la/ maṇḍal khyung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'bul/ rang yang de bzhin du bya'o// mo gdon zhi bar 'dod na bla ma rje btsun ma phag mor bsgoms la/ maṇḍal khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'bul/mo gdon lam du slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// nyon mongs pa zhe sdang zhi bar 'dod pas/ bla ma slob dpon padmar bsgoms la/ maṇḍal sems can gcig la gcig phan btags pa/ byams

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 427snying rjes gzhan phan thams cad bla ma la 'bul/ slob dpon padmas sbyor sgrol gyi las byas pas tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob pa lags so// rang gi byams pa dang snying rjes sems can thams cad la phan pa byas pa thams cad 'bul/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi byams pa dang / snying rjes sems can thams cad la phan btags pa thams cad kyang 'bul lo// rang sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rjes phan btags pa thams cad 'bul lo// bdag gi zhe sdang lam du slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byas la gsol ba gdab bo//'dod chags zhi bar 'dod na bla ma rgyal po ind+ra bhu tir bsgoms la/ maṇḍal rang sems can thams cad kyi lha'i bu dang bu mo dpag tu med par bsams la 'bul/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang du bsams la 'bul/'dod chags lam du long (slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gti mug zhi bar 'dod na bla ma slob dpon zla bar bsgoms la/maṇḍal chos 'chad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang rtog pa thams cad 'bul/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi don byed pa'i rtog pa thams cad kyang 'bul lo// gti mug lam du long (slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// mkhal ma na na mkhal ma rnam par snang mdzad du bsgoms la/ maṇḍal long kha'i khams kyi drod sman thams cad dang zas drod can thams cad 'bul lo// smon lam btab nas bla ma stong pa nyid du bsgom/ pho ba'i yul tsho na na mtsher pa snang ba mtha' yas su bsgoms la/ maṇḍal drod sman dang sman drod can dang zas drod can thams cad 'bul lo// smon lam gdab bla ma stong par bsgom/ pho mchin na na mchin pa rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms la/ maṇḍal rigs thams cad 'bul/smon lam gdab/ rdo rje sems dpa' stong pa nyid du bsgom/ snying na na snying

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 427snying rjes gzhan phan thams cad bla ma la 'bul/ slob dpon padmas sbyor sgrol gyi las byas pas tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob pa lags so// rang gi byams pa dang snying rjes sems can thams cad la phan pa byas pa thams cad 'bul/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi byams pa dang / snying rjes sems can thams cad la phan btags pa thams cad kyang 'bul lo// rang sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rjes phan btags pa thams cad 'bul lo// bdag gi zhe sdang lam du slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byas la gsol ba gdab bo//'dod chags zhi bar 'dod na bla ma rgyal po ind+ra bhu tir bsgoms la/ maṇḍal rang sems can thams cad kyi lha'i bu dang bu mo dpag tu med par bsams la 'bul/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang du bsams la 'bul/'dod chags lam du long (slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gti mug zhi bar 'dod na bla ma slob dpon zla bar bsgoms la/maṇḍal chos 'chad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang rtog pa thams cad 'bul/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi don byed pa'i rtog pa thams cad kyang 'bul lo// gti mug lam du long (slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// mkhal ma na na mkhal ma rnam par snang mdzad du bsgoms la/ maṇḍal long kha'i khams kyi drod sman thams cad dang zas drod can thams cad 'bul lo// smon lam btab nas bla ma stong pa nyid du bsgom/ pho ba'i yul tsho na na mtsher pa snang ba mtha' yas su bsgoms la/ maṇḍal drod sman dang sman drod can dang zas drod can thams cad 'bul lo// smon lam gdab bla ma stong par bsgom/ pho mchin na na mchin pa rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms la/ maṇḍal rigs thams cad 'bul/smon lam gdab/ rdo rje sems dpa' stong pa nyid du bsgom/ snying na na snying

428 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigarin chen 'byung ldan du bsgoms la/ maṇḍal sbrang rtsi la sogs pa me tog gi rigs dang 'bru thams cad 'bul lo// snying gi nad 'tsho bar smon lam gdab/glo ba na na bla ma don yod grub par bsgom/ maṇḍal bsil sman gyi rigs su gtogs tshad 'bul/ smon lam gdab/ bla ma stong pa nyid du song bar bsgom/mig na na mig bla mar bsgoms/ mig gzugs kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar mo me long bsnams pa zhig bsgoms/ sman thams cad kyang gzugs kyi lha mor bsgoms la/ maṇḍal la gzugs kyi gtogs tshad 'bul/ smon lam gdab/stong pa nyid du bsgoms/ mig gi nang la bug pa zhig yod par bsgoms la/nad thams cad bug pa phug nas phar song bar bsam mo// sna na na dri'i lha mo la mchod pa 'bul la/ smon lam btab cing stong par bsgom/ lce na na ro'i lha mo la mchod pa maṇḍal 'bul/ smon lam gdab/ stong par bsgoms/ rna ba na na sgra'i lha mo la mchod pa dang maṇḍal 'bul/ smon lam gdab cing stong par bsgom/ lus la reg bya'i lha mo bsgoms la/ maṇḍal dang mchod pa dbul/gsol ba gdab cing stong par bsgom/ de bar chad zhi reg bya'i lha mo de 'od du mer gyis song bar bsams la/ bde lhan ne ba la bzhag go/ thams cad des 'gres la dge sbyor thams cad du bzhag pa dang / bde ba lhan ne ba la bzhag go/ ba'i 'phrin las so// rgyas pa la bzhi las/ tshe rgyas pa la bla ma tshe dpag med tu bsgoms la/ maṇḍal dang rang sems can thams cad 'chi ba med par bsams la 'bul/ smon lam 'di la spel tshig gi man ngag btags te spel ba'i 'dug pa spel bar bsgoms/ gdab/ longs spyod rgyas par 'dod na/ bla ma sangs rgyas nam mkha' mdzod du bsgoms la/maṇḍal dang rang sems can thams cad kyi lus dang longs spyod 'dzad pa med pa nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes par bsams la 'bul/ smon lam gdab spel bar bya/ / dbang thang rgyas par 'dod na/ bla ma 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por bsgoms la/ maṇḍal rang dang 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad du

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 429byas la 'bul/ smon lam spel bar bya/ gdab/ 'khor rgyas par 'dod na/ bla ma bstan pa'i gtso bo ru bsgomasarnam par rtog pa mi rgyu dgu rgyu thams cad dbulal/maṇḍal sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la 'bul/ gang 'dod kyi smon lam gdab/ de yan chad rgyas pa'i 'phrin las yin no// dbang la bla ma dbang phyug chen por bsgoms la/ bla ma skyes pa dang bud med gos nor rdzas gang dbang du 'du bar 'dod pa dbul/ smon lam spel bar byagadab/ drag po la bla ma dmag dpon rin po cher bsgoms la/ maṇḍal lo ku'i khams thams cad mtshon gyis gang bar bsams nas/ tshar gcod par 'dod pa de tshar gcad par bsam mo// las tshogs la khrus chu bya ba la bum pa gtsang ma zhig gi nang du rin po che dang / mngar gsum dang 'bru blugs la/ bum pa rghaṃ las gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ de'i steng du paṃ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng na bla ma bzhugs par bsam/ rang yi dam du bsam/ bum pa'i gzungs thag nas 'then la/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o byas nas gsol ba btab pas/gzungs thag la sngags 'khril nas song bas/ sngags bzlas pas gzungs thag 'khril nas song par bsam/ bla ma'i thugs gar thim pas/ bla ma bdud rtsir ltem gyis song bar bsams la/ de nas longs spyod do// byin brlab bya ba la/ lag pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed la/ de ru bla ma bsgoms la/ bla ma'i spyi bor nad pa la byin rlabs byed na nad babs che bar kai nag po 'ig bsams la/ de kli la bsdu phyir dor bar nad sos par bsam mo// brgyud pa rnams bsams la thim par bsam/ nad pa la lag pa cab cab byas pas nad de bde 'bol 'bol bar bsam mo// sngags mdud byed pa la mdud pa gsum byas la mdun gyi nam mkha' la bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rnam pa lag mthil du hūṃ dngul chu'i mdog lta

430 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabu zhig bsams la/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros/ nad dang sdig sgrib thams cad sangs song bar bsam mo// lnga sku gsung thugs kyi tshul du byung nas mdud pa la thim par bsams la gsol ba gdab/ lam srung ni/ rang thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams khengs pa zhig bsams la/ de'i khog pa nas yar 'gro rdo rje lu gu rgyud du bar bsams la 'gro ba'o// lhi/ja/ g.yuthog snying thig bla ma nang sgrub dgosa'adod kun 'byung bzhugasaso/de nas nang ltar bsgrub pa ni/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa la/ bde ba'i stan la 'dugaskyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs gzhan dang 'dra ste/ rgyas bsdus ci rigs su bya'o// rang tha mal pa'i ngang nas ngag tu yi ge kli zhes brjod pas/ skad cig gis sman bla zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing ga mdangs dang bcas pa/zhabs skyil krung / g.yas a ru ra/ g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsi sman gyis gang ba/ chos gos dang sham thabs sam/ yang na rgyan du mar ldan pa'i bzhugs tshul shin tu gsal ba zhig tu gsal bar gyur/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ga'i hūm̐ las 'od chad/ a wa dhū tī nas bshang lam du byon/ yi ge ram̐ gcig tu gyur/ ram̐ de 'od du zhu bas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig la sogs rang gi blo yul dang bstun pa zhig bsgom/yang thugs ku'i kli las 'od chad/ dhū tī brgyud chu so nas thon/ nyi ma'i steng du ltem gyis zhu bas sna tshogs rdo rje chen po zhig tu gyur/ de phyogs bzhir 'phel te/ cher song ba'i steng ma rnams dkrong langs pas/ rdo rje'i rtsig pa mtho dman ran mnyam pa zhig la steng gi ra gnyis po rang gi steng nas tshur

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 431byung / rdo rje'i gur khang thog tu bsgom mo// phyi'i nyi ma'i 'od kyis rdo rje phyed pa yan chod zhu bas/ phyi thams cad zhal ba byas pa bzhin du song / ra gur chen po de'i steng du/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa/ dpang po'i tshul du mdun gyi nam mkhar padma sna tshogs pa la bzhugs pa la/ skyabs 'gro rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgoms pas/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje'i dbang gis mdun du byon/ de'i 'od zer rang la rdzog pas/ me long g.ya' dag pa la byad shar ba bzhin/ rang lus lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur/ mdun gyi lha yang lus dang grib ma'i tshul du thim ste gnyis su med par gyur de nas bdag mdun gsal ba las/ gnas lngar yo āḥbhū trī hrīḥbasam/ snying gyen du bltas pa'i dbus su/ padma dang zla ba la hūm̐ mthing ga zhig tu gyur/ de zhu ba las lhung bzed chen po zhig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i nang du be las bdud tsi'i rgya mtshor mos/ de'i steng du padma zla ba la hūm̐ zhig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus sman blar gyur/yang 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ mang po byung / rang gi snying gar sib sib thim ste/ zhu ba las byung ba'i sman blar gyur pa'i g.yas kyi a ru ra rnam par rgyal bas/ g.yon lhung bzed kyi bdud rtsi dkrugs pas/ thig le 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pas/ gang gi padma'i o rgyan gyi padma 'dab brgyad la/ rgyal mtshan brgyad la sogs pa la/ lha brgyad kyi rim pa bzhin dkrong bskyed bya/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying ga chos 'khor padma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa la sman bla dgu bsgom/ sku'i snang ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ mtshogs ma'i spyi bor hūṃ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa la/ bcom ldan 'das rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis sprul sku'am/ longs skur bsgom/ yang gsung gi snang

432 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigab las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su snang ba mtha' yas/ yang sman bla'i yon tan gyi snang ba las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rin chen 'byung gnas/ yang sman bla'i 'phrin las kyi snang ba las 'od zer dmar ljang 'phros/gsang gnas bde skyong du rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor dkrong bskyed bya/de ltar lha thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs gsal bar bsgoms/ ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod rgyas gdab dbang bskur ba la sogs gang byed bya'o gsungs/ lha de rnams gsal ba'i ngang du ci gnas mnyam par bzhag go/ de nas klad pa bde chen gyi nang du/ thig le 'od kyi rang bzhin mi chung tsam/ me long nyi ma'i rtsar bzhag pa bzhin/ dkar lhag lhag 'od 'phro ba 'od zer blta mi bzod pa zhig bsam/ de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la ma yengs par bya'o// de bzhin du gnas bzhi pa la'ang 'gre'o// de rnams la shes pa gsal na bde stong gi ye shes ting nge 'dzin skye'o// de rnams re re nas 'od je gsal du/ khong pa'i nad thams cad dang lus kyi nang kun thig le'i rang bzhin gsal ba la brten cing / 'phro rgod bying ba med pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag de dag kyang rang bzhin grub pa med pa/ gdod nas stong pa nyid du shes par bya'o// bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la shes pa lhod glod la gzhag sheg sheg mer mer gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs la gzhag sems 'phro na'ang thong / gang shar ngos zin par gyis/ sdod na'ang sdod/ bying rmugs steng por ma shor zhing zhan pa ma byed/ sems kyi ngo bo gang la yang gtad gzung med par/ chu bcad rang thag bzhin tshom mer zhog lam du bor ba'i rdo ba bzhin khros se ling nge/ bdag tu ma bzung / dngos po'i mtshan ma med par khros se zhog bsgom bya sgom byed med par thun bzhir bya'o//bla ma gong ma gong ma'i gdams pa khyad par can nyams su blang rgyu de las med

432 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigab las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su snang ba mtha' yas/ yang sman bla'i yon tan gyi snang ba las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rin chen 'byung gnas/ yang sman bla'i 'phrin las kyi snang ba las 'od zer dmar ljang 'phros/gsang gnas bde skyong du rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor dkrong bskyed bya/de ltar lha thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs gsal bar bsgoms/ ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod rgyas gdab dbang bskur ba la sogs gang byed bya'o gsungs/ lha de rnams gsal ba'i ngang du ci gnas mnyam par bzhag go/ de nas klad pa bde chen gyi nang du/ thig le 'od kyi rang bzhin mi chung tsam/ me long nyi ma'i rtsar bzhag pa bzhin/ dkar lhag lhag 'od 'phro ba 'od zer blta mi bzod pa zhig bsam/ de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la ma yengs par bya'o// de bzhin du gnas bzhi pa la'ang 'gre'o// de rnams la shes pa gsal na bde stong gi ye shes ting nge 'dzin skye'o// de rnams re re nas 'od je gsal du/ khong pa'i nad thams cad dang lus kyi nang kun thig le'i rang bzhin gsal ba la brten cing / 'phro rgod bying ba med pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag de dag kyang rang bzhin grub pa med pa/ gdod nas stong pa nyid du shes par bya'o// bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la shes pa lhod glod la gzhag sheg sheg mer mer gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs la gzhag sems 'phro na'ang thong / gang shar ngos zin par gyis/ sdod na'ang sdod/ bying rmugs steng por ma shor zhing zhan pa ma byed/ sems kyi ngo bo gang la yang gtad gzung med par/ chu bcad rang thag bzhin tshom mer zhog lam du bor ba'i rdo ba bzhin khros se ling nge/ bdag tu ma bzung / dngos po'i mtshan ma med par khros se zhog bsgom bya sgom byed med par thun bzhir bya'o//bla ma gong ma gong ma'i gdams pa khyad par can nyams su blang rgyu de las med

〉〉/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 433do// nyams len kyang de las med kyang / bshad pa dang bstun 'di bzhin 'ong / phyi nang gsang ba gsum de kho na nyid du bshad pa las/ dang po ni dpal ldan 'bras spungs bya ba de/ phyi mchod rten gyi rnam pa la/ nang lha khang du yod pa/ de yang rang gang mos kyi dkyil 'khor du snang ba yin gsungs/de'ang skabs 'dir/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs de/ mchod rten gyi dbyibs rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa/ nang sman lha rigs lnga'i khang pa yod pa/ shar sgo phye bas rnam snang sman bla'i lha tshogs su snang ba/ nub sgo phye bas 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs su snang ba/ byang sgo phye bas don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs su snang ba/ lho sgo phye bas rin 'byung gi lha tshogs su snang ba ste/ de thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga'i snang ba las byung ba ste/ sku'i snang ba gzhal yas khang rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs su yin te/ zhes sogs dkyil 'khor dag pa dang sbyar ro// de nas sman bla gcig pu bsgoms pas rigs lnga gar bsgom par 'gro ste/ rgyal ba gcig bsgoms sangs rgyas kun gyi ngang bya ba yin/ lnga po de'ang gang 'dod kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du snang ste/rnam snang gzhal yas khang du blta bar 'dod na/ shar sgo phye bas chog de bzhin du gang 'dod kyi sgo phye bas gang 'dod 'grub cing snang nas 'ong ste/rang gang 'dod sems kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba de yin no// gnyis pa bsgom nyid nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ rang gi lus la sbyor te/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa bzhin/rang lus kyang phyi yi dam sman bla'i ngo bo la/ rgyu 'byung ba bzhi las grub pa'i/'bras spungs kyi shar sgo phye bas/ rnam snang sman bla'i gzhal yas khang lha tshogs dang bcas pa snang ba bzhin/ rang gi shar sgo klad pa bde chen gyi 'khor lo phye bas sman bla'i sku'i lha tshogs yod/ lho sgo sprul pa'i 'khor lo na/ sman bla yon tan gyi lha tshogs yod/ nub sgo longs spyod 'khor lo na/ sman bla gsung gi lha

434 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigatshogs yod/ byang sgo bde skyong gi 'khor lo na/ sman bla 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs yod/ sgo bzhi po de phye bas/ rang bzhin gyi sman bla mi bskyod pa chos nyid kyi zhal mthong ste/ de rnams kyang gang 'dod sems kyi snang ba ste/ sngar bzhin lha thams cad rigs lngar 'dus/ rigs lnga sman blar 'dus te/ snang mtha' sman bla gsung gi snang ba/ snang mdzad sman bla sku'i snang ba/ rin 'byung sman bla yon tan gyi snang ba/ rdor sems sman bla thugs zag med kyi ye shes/ don grub sman bla phrin las kyi snang ba'o// gsum pa ni bde gsal mi rtog stong pa dbyer med pa dang lnga'o// de dag kyang 'od zer gyi snang ba lnga/rang gnas lnga'i lha tshogs la brten nas skye ba ste/ sku'i snang ba dkar po chos dbyings ye shes/ spyi bo bde chen du sman bla'i tshogs dkar po bsgoms pa las bde ba skye/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ gsung gi snang ba 'od zer dmar po sor rtog ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod du sman bla'i tshogs dmar po bsgom zhing gsal ba nyams su blangs na gsal ba skye/ gsang dbang thob/ yon tan 'od zer ser po las mnyam nyid ye shes/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na/ sman bla'i tshogs ser por bsgoms pa las mi rtog pa'i don bsgoms te/ yid ma dag pa dag par byed pa/ dbang gsum pa thob pa yin/ thugs kyi rdo rje sngon po las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ snying ga chos 'khor du sman bla thugs kyi lha tshogs bsgoms pa las brten nas mi rtog pa'i don stong par bsgoms te/ lus ngag yid gsum ga'i ma dag pa dag par byed pa/ dbang bzhi pa yin no// 'phrin las snang ba 'od zer ljang gu las bya grub ye shes/ gsang gnas bde skyong du smanabla phrin las kyi lha tshogs bsgoms pa las bde ba'i rang bzhin nam lha'i rnam pa la brten nas/ dbang bzhi ye shes lnga sman bla rigs lnga'i lha tshogs bde sogs bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum chos kun dbyer mi phyed pa/ zung 'jug gi don skye med don gyi stong nyid gang zag gi rgyud la sbyor zhing nyams su

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 435blangs pas phrin las thams cad 'grub bo// bzhi yin/ steng ma des 'grub/de bas lhag pa med do// de rnams hril dril bas sman bla rigs lnga/ dbang bzhi/ bde gsal mi rtog stong pa dbyer mi phyed pa/ ye shes lnga la sogs pa thams cad zung du 'jug pa ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'i gdams ngag khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ thun mong ma yin pa sman bla'i bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis stan thog gcig tu bsgom pa/ thun gcig tu dril nas/ skad cig la thams cad sgom lugs bya ba de lags so// gong ma'i zhal nas/ gdams pa 'di las zab pa med cing / 'di bsgoms na rtags mi 'byung ba mi srid/khyed rang yang sgoms dang rang gzhan mngon sum du mthong bar rtags shig ma byung na ngas bslus pa yin gyis/ sgom sgrub la 'bad pa gyis gsungs/ 'di gzhan la bstan pa ni med gsungs nas dbu snyung mdzad do// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gdams pa/ gang zag gcig stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i chos shin tu zab pa rdzogs so//nya/ g.yuthog snying thig zab mobla sgrub lasagasang sgrub skal ldan myur 'dren bzhugasaso/de nas gsang ba ltar bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang /rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / zung 'jug gi ngo sprod do// dang po ni/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas bzang por sku rten dgram/ sman rag gtor ma sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bsham/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dang / phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo/ 'byung po rnams la gtor ma byin bden pa bdar la

436 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigabaskud/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ rang 'dra'i khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bgegs rigs thams cad lcags ri chen po'i mthar ded par bsam zhing / gu gul gyi dud pa btang / rol mo dang bcas nas mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor rgyas par bsgom/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon du 'gro bas mchod rdzas so sor byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs kyi zhing du gyur pa spyan drangs nas/ bsngo ba'i bar gyi bcu rnam dag tshar gsum bya'o//dngos gzhi sku bskyed pa ni/ shu n+ya tā'i sngags kyis chos kun stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang nas/ e yi ram̐ sum̐ kau ram̐ rnams las rim pa bzhin du/ kun gyi sgo 'byed pa nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor rakta'i rgya mtsho zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ rus pa'i ri rab/ bskal ba'i me dpung rnams rim pa bzhin du bsgom/ de'i steng du hūṃ kha dog lnga ldan yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas mtshan nyid yongs su tshang ba'i dbus su/ baṃ las padma 'dab ma bzhi dbus dang lnga'i lte bar ma las nyi ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bdud bzhi gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan gyi stong du/ yi ge hrī:dwangs ma byu ru'i mdog lta bur bsam/ 'dab ma bzhi la nyi ma dang ro'i steng du/ ha ri ni sa bzhi mthing ser ram/ dmar ljang 'od dang bcas pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ dkon mchog mchod sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lha dang / snod gzhal yas khang byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje dang gri gug 'dab ma bzhir gri gug re re bsam/de yang 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las skad cig gis chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul gyis/rang nyid dbang gi lha mchog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kur 'dzin pa/ dbu gtsug rta myo go ljang gu rta skad 'tsher zhing zhabs

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 437g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs rol pa'i pang du/ yum rdo rje phag mo khro 'dzum dbu steng phag zhal can/ nu ma bha ga rgyas pa chags pa'i nyams can gyi thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khril zhing / yab yum gnyis ka yang dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rnam par 'gying zhing /gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan par bzhugs pa'i spyi bor/ padma'i sdong po 'dab ma bzhi dbus dang lnga'i steng gi lte bar gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog mthing gsal zhag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du/ yum rdo rje dbyings phyug pa sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ga'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras te kho 'dzum 'gying ldem sgeg pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsam/ mdun gyi 'dab nga gnyis ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes sman rgyal rnam snang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de bzhin dbyings phyug ma dkar mo gri thod/ gnyis ga'ang gong gi 'gres so// g.yas kyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes sman rgyal rin 'byung ser po 'al gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rin chen dbang rgyal thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud zhabs/ yum rin chen dbyings phyug ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ku'i rgyab kyi 'dab ma la/ gu ru sman snang mtha' sku mdog dmar po zhal rgyal rig pa'i ye shes snang mtha' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas padma thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ padma dbyings phyug ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ g.yon gyi

438 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'adab ma la/ gu ru sman rgyal don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgya gram thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ yum las kyi dbyings phyug ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rang gi mdun sogs pad 'dab bzhir rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing ser dmar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kur bsnams pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan sogs mkha' 'gro'i chos thams cad tshang ba/ gar stabs dang ldan pas bzhugs par bsam/ gzhan yang steng gi cha la bka' brgyud bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin bzhin gtibs par bsam/ de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ oṃ āḥrgyu/ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wā ra/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa bzhin du byon par bsam/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bstim/ oṃ āḥbhū badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wa ra'i sngags sham dus ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ zhes dang / a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥgadan dbul ba dang / phyag rgya bya/ rang nyid rta phag yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas lha'i mchod rdzas du ma thogs te mchod par bsams la/ oṃ nas wā ra'i bar gyi sngags sham du/ ambha sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rū ba shapta sogs kyis nang mchod/ bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū tsa hoḥs gsang mchod/ mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta/ mahā rakta/mahā ba li ta khā hi khā hi/ sman rag gtor gsum du ru ti sarba mā ra ya khā nyis bsgral mchod/ te te kli te na hūṃ ti phu spa ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ gis glu gar rang bab sems kyi rang gsang la/ blta ru med pa'i tshul gyis blta ba/ de kho na nyid kyi

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 439mchod pa'o// de nas/ oṃ rnam dag chos sku'i klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i skur ston pa// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul// mtshan dpes brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// āḥbade chen zag med klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i gsung ston pa// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrogs// 'gag med rol par phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ khyab gdal spros med klong yangs su// ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs ston pa// rang rtsal ting 'dzin bsam mi khyab// kun tu bzang la phyag 'tshal bstod// swā ka dag zab gsal klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i yon tan ston// chos kun ji bzhin ma 'dres gzigs// 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal bstod// hā lhun 'byams rig pa'i klong yangs nas//ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las ston// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yis// 'khor ba dong sprug (sprugs phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa//rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas mchod cing bstod// sku gsum rang ngo shes par shog/ ces pas bstod pa'i rjes su/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa'i ye shes yab yum la mos gus dung pa byas nas bdag la dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer gyi sgra dang 'od zer sna lnga bde ba'i rang bzhin can du 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ thugs kur rjes chags kyi mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar lhung ba'i sbyor mtshams nas/ dngul chu mu tig dri med zhu ba'i khu ba lta bu ngang chi li li rgyun mi chad babs/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs thog med nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dri ma'i rnam par nag nu ru ru ded/ ba spu'i bu ga dang 'og sgo nas thon/dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i 'og tu song / lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa'am/phru ma phus btab pa ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du gyur pa las/ bdud rtsi de

440 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiganyid yar log lte ba'i rtsa 'khor man gang ba bum dbang / snying ga man chad gang ba gsang dbang / mgrin pa man chad gang ba shes rab ye shes/ spyi bo man gang bas dbang bzhi thob lus zag med kyi bde bas gang ba la sems ci gnas su gzhag de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ chu zla'am 'ja' tshon ltar bsams te/ spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum gyi bla ma'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng mu tig dmar po bstar la brgyus pa bzhin du byung gsang gnas nas song / rang gi spyi bo'i rta mgo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar zhugs/ phag zhal gyi spyi bo nas thon/ spyi bo'i bla ma yum gyi bha ga nas zhugs/ zhal nas thon yab gyi zhal du 'khor ba las/phyir 'gro ba'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kun la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ nang du 'dug pa'i tshe/ rang nyid rigs 'dus rgyal po'i ngo bo nga rgyal brtan par byas la bzlas so// oṃ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi hūm̐/ rma āḥbhū swāhā/ sum̐ lam̐ mi paṃ haṃ/ hrīḥmaḥhaḥriḥniḥsaḥ tsitta hring hring sarba sirnyi sa ma ya/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ zhes gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi'i snying po'o// nye ba'i snying po ni/rma āḥbadzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ gu ru rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥbuddha gu ru gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ/ gu ru rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥratna gu ru gu ṇa sidhi hūm̐/ gu ru rin 'byung rig pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥpadma gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ gu ru snang mtha' rig pa'i ye shes/ rma āḥkarma gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/gu ru don grub rig pa'i ye shes/ de ba ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring sarba sirnyi dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥ rta phag yab yum gtso 'khor gyi'o// oṃ āḥbhū swāhā/ a mṛ ta dzi ldan ti lha ṣa rdzu sarba sirnyi hūṃ hoḥ zhes sman gyi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags so// 'di dag gi spyi sngags la bye ba/ nye snying gi gtso bo la 'bum/'khor la khri/ sman gyi dngos grub bsdu sngags la stong sogs ma yengs par

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 441bzlas/ skabs su ting nge 'dzin spro bsdu'i thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rang nyid rtsa ba gsum du gsal ba'i spyi bo nas 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros/bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku la phog mchod pas sku mnyes par byas/ sku'i dngos grub bsdus/ sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi sbyangs/ lus dbang du bsdus nas/ slar spyi bor thim par bsams la bzla/ yang mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung la phog mchod pas gsung mnyes par byas/ gsung gi dngos grub bsdus/ sems can gyi ngag sgrib sbyangs/ ngag dbang du bsdus nas/ slar mgrin par thim par bsams la bzla/ thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing gsal 'phros/ bde gshegs kun gyi thugs la phog mchod pas thugs mnyes par byas/ thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus/ sems can gyi yid sgrib sbyangs/ yid dbang du bsdus nas/ slar thugs kur thim par bsams la bzla/ tshe sgrub tu byed na 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten khams kyi 'byung ba lnga'i bcud dang dngas ma/nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa bkrag dang gzi brjid thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu dang byin rlabs thugs rje thams cad/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par chi li li byung / spyi gtsug gi bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i ka pā lar bsdus/ de nas phyir lud/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/rtsa 'khor rim gyis brgyud/ lus kyi nang bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang bar bsams la sngags sham du/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe kli sgyi/ zhes bzlas na 'chi ba bsru zhing tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro// thun mtshams su sman rag gtor tshogs byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa ba gsum spyan drangs la/ bzhugs su gsol ba dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa phul la/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus bzhes par bsams la snying po'i sham du/ mahā sarba pañtsa/ mahwa rakta/

442 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigamahā ba li ta/ sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis dbul 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ bstod pas bstod/ rjes spyod lam thams cad du/ rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dren pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i ngang la gnas pa'am/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa la gnas par bya zhing / dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas byin rlabs 'jug pa dang / zhugs pa'i rtags phyi nang gsang ba rnams dang / gsang sgrub srog sgril spros pa nyer bsdu ni zhal las shes par bya'o//sarba maṅga lam̐/ shu rghaṃ/ta/ g.yuthog snying thig bla ma dril sgrub yeshesa'akhor lo bzhugs so/na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs yang gsang bla ma'i dril sgrub dus rgyun khyer gyi nyams len ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du song bas/ shun+ya tā'i sngags kyis chos kun stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las pad sdong zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rang nyid sman rgyal mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ rang gi snying me rtog padma sngon po kha phye ba'i steng du/ a las zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du rdo rje sngon po kli gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snod bcud sman dang rin po che thams cad kyi nus pa ro bcud bsdus/ tshur 'dus kli la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bla ma rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' sman rgyal sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje/ g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 443pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ku'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras shing / khro 'dzum 'gying bag bde stong nyams kyi dgyes bzhin par bsam de nas phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ gsol ba snying thag pa nas gdab/ hūṃ rigs 'dus rgyal ba rdo rje sems// rang rig chos sku'i bla ma la// sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhu// zhes brjod/ bla ma'i thugs kur rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa tshon gang ba'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed gshags tsam gyi steng du/ hūṃ yig bai ḍūrya'i mdog can spus bris pa tsam gyi mthar/ sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog yi dam lha'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi zag pa med pa'i mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad bsdus/ tshur 'dus rang gi thugs kur thim pas 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen po rgyu da la skyes par bsam/ slar yang thugs ku'i sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa gyen du byung / yab kyi zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi thugs rgyud mnyes par byas/ yum gyi gsang gnas nas thon/ yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas zhugs/ thugs kur 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad la/ oṃ badzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags ma byung bar du bzlas/ thun 'jog khar sman gyi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags tshar kha yar bzlas mchod bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ 'chi ba bslu zhing tshe bsring na/ bla ma yab yum tshe dpag med du bsam/ thugs ku'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros/'khor 'das snang srid thams cad kyi tshe bcud dang / rang gi bla tshe yar ba thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer dmar po'i tshul du bsdus phyag gi tshe bum la thim/de la gsol ba dungs pa btab pas/ tshe bum lud de bdud rtsis lus kyi nang gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib dang / gdon gyi byad du bcug pa thams cad

444 ༄zagayu thog snying thigadag ba spu dang dbang po'i sgo rnams su nyug nyug thon pa las/ gser gyi rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis gtams/ 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par bsams nas sngags sham du/ oṃ badzra ā yu two na kli ṭwāṃ/ zhes bzlas pas 'chi ltas thams cad bzlog par 'gyur zhing / tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob par gdon mi za'o// smi/ maṅgā lam̐//tha/ zab mobla sgrub lasamakha' 'gro myur mgyogasabazhugasaso/'khor mkha' 'gro'i sgos sgrub ni/ skyabs sems tshad med sngon du song bas/ rang rta phag yab yum gyi spyi bor bla ma bsam/ klad pa dung khang du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo/ mgrin par padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo/thugs kur rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo/ gsang gnas su las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs su rol par bzhugs par bsam/ mkha' 'gro bzhi las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs phrin las la mnyes mchod phul te de'i byin rlabs bsdus/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas/ dkar pos nad gdon zhi/ ser pos tshe bsod rgyas/ dmar pos khams gsum dbang du sdud/ mthing gas dgra bgegs log rtog tshar gcod/ ljang gus gang 'dod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bsam/ ḍā ki bzhi ga'i thugs kur rang gi sa bon re re 'od dang bcas pa bsams nas/ gnyis ku'i sogs 'gre'o//mdun gyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje

༄/sdug bsngal mun selathugasarje'inyi'od/ 44du wadabyings kyi dbang phyug ma mthing ga gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na bsnams pa la/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du rin chen dbyings phyug ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa bzhugs pa'i bar 'gre'o//rgyab kyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes snang mtha' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa la zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du padma dbyings phyug ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa bzhugs pa'i bar 'gre'o// g.yon gyi 'dab ma la gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rgya gram thugs kur 'dzin cing /g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa la/zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum las kyi dbyings phyug ma ljang gu gri thod sogs 'gre'o// rang gi mdun sogs padma 'dab ma bzhir/ rdo rje/rin chen/ padma/ rgya gram/ las kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing ser dmar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kur bsnams pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan sogs khro mo'i chas thams cad tshang ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas bzhugs par bsam/gzhan yang steng gi cha la bka' brgyud bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam lha tshogs/'og gi cha la chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin bzhin gtibs par bsam/ de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros/rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ oṃ āḥlha badzra gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wā ra badzre sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa bzhin du byon par bsam/ dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥganyis su med par

446 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabastim/ oṃ nas sa pā ri wā ra'i bar gyi sngags sham du sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan zhes dang / a ti pu ho pra ti dza ho/ gdan 'bul ba dang phyag rgya bya/ rang nyid rta phag yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas lha'i mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ nas sa pā ri wā ra'i bar gyi sngags sham du yalha sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rū pa shapta sogs kyis nang mchod/ bodhi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hos gsang mchod/ mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta mahā rakta/ mahā ba lo ta khā nyis sman raka /raganagator gsum/rū tra sarba mā ra ya khā his bsgral mchod/ te te kli te na kli/ de phu spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gis glu dang gar mchod/ rang babs sems kyi rang gsal la blta rgyu med pa'i tshul gyis blta/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas/ oṃ/ rnam dag chos sku'i klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i skur ston pa// sna tshogs sprul bas 'gro ba 'dul// mtshan dpes brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod//āḥbade chen zag med klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i gsung ston pa//brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrog/ 'gags med rol bar phyag 'tshal bstod//hūṃ/ khyab gdal spros med klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs ston pa//rang rtsal ting 'dzin bsam mi khyab// kun tu bzang la phyag 'tshal bstod//swā/ ka dag zab gsal klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i yon tan ston//chos kun ji bzhin ma 'dres gzigs// 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal bstod//hā/ lhun 'byams rig pa'i klong yangs nas// ma lus rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ston// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyis// 'khor ba dong sprug /sprugs phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus dang // rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod// sku gsum rang ngo shes par shog/ ces pas bstod pa'i rjes su/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa'i ye shes yab yum la mos gus dung dung (dungs dungs pa byas nas/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 447bdag la dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mtshams nas 'od zer gyi sgra dang / 'od zer sna lnga bde ba'i rang bzhin can 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ thugs kur rjes chags kyi mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi bha gar lhung ba dang / sbyor mtshams nas dngul chu'am mu tig dri med zhu ba'i khu ba lta bu rgyun mi chad par ngang chi li li babs/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs thog med nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i rnam par nag nu ru ru ded/ ba spu'i bu ga dang 'og sgo nas thon/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i 'og tu song /lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa'am/ phru ma phus btab pa ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du gyur pa las bdud rtsi de nyid yar log lte ba'i rtsa 'khor man gang bas bum dbang / snying ga man chad gang bas gsang dbang / mgrin pa man chad gang bas shes rab ye shes/ spyi bo man gang bas dbang bzhi ba thob/lus zag med bde bas gang ba la sems ci gnas bzhag de nas bzlas (bsdus pa bya ba ni/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ chu zla'i 'ja' tshon lta bur bsams te/ spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum gyi bla ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba mu tig dkar po bstar la brgyus pa lta bu byung / gsang gnas nas thon/ rang gi spyi bo'i rta mgo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas thon/ yum gyi zhal nas thon/ phag zhal gyi spyi bo nas thon/ spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum gyi bha ga nas zhugs/ zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal nas zhugs nas 'khor ba las phyir 'gro ba'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang nyid rig 'dus rgyal ba'i ngo bor nga rgyal brtan par byas la bzla'o// oṃ badzra mahwa gu ru sarba gu ṇa siddhi hūṃ/ oṃ

448 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thiga.āḥmai swāhā/ rmu lam̐ rmi phroṃ ṭwāṃ/ hrīḥmaḥhaḥriḥniḥsaḥtsitta hring hring sarba sirnyi sa ma ya dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ zhes gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi'i snying po'o//nye ba'i snying po ni/ oṃ āḥbhū badzra gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ gu ru rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥburnya gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ rnam snang rig pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥratna gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ gu ru rin 'byung rig pa'i ye shes/oṃ āḥpadma gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ gu ru snang ba mtha' yas rig pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥkarma gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ gu ru don grub rig pa'i ye shes/ de wa ḍā ki ha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring / sarba sirnyi dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ rta phag yab yum gtso 'khor gyi'o// oṃ āḥrgyu swāhā/ a mṛ te dzi wanti bhi ṣa rdzu sarba sirnyi hūṃ hoḥswāhā/zhes sman gyi dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags so// 'di dag ni spyi sngags la bye ba/nye snying gi gtso bo la 'bum/ 'khor la khri sman gyi dngos grub bsdu sngags la stong sogs ma yengs par bzlas/ skabs su ting nge 'dzin gyi spro bsdu'i thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rang nyid rtsa ba gsum du gsal ba'i spyi bo nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku la phog slar mgrin par thim par bsams la bzlas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing gsal 'phros/ bde gshegs kun gyi thugs la phog thugs mchod pas mnyes/ sems can gyi yid sgrib sbyangs/ yid dbang du bsdus/ thugs kur thim par bsam/ tshe sgrub tu byed na 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma'i bcud/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa bkrag dang gzi mdangs thams cad phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad dang / 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par chi li li byung / spyi gtsug gi bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i ka pā lar bsdus/de nas phyir lud/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rtsa 'khor rim gyis

༄khya/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 449brgyud/ lus kyi nang bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang bar bsams la sngags sham du/oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe hūṃ rghaṃ zhes bzlas nas/ 'chi ba bslu zhing tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro// thun mtshams su sman raka /rag gtor tshogs byin gyis brlab bo// rtsa ba gsum spyan drangs la bzhugs su gsol ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa phul la/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus bzhes par bsam zhing / snying po'i sham du mahā sarba pañtsa mahā rakta mahwa ba sla ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ bstod pas bstod de/ rjes spyod lam thams cad du rnam pa gsal ba/rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'i ngang la gnas pa'am/ rdzogs rim gyis skabs su bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa la gnas par bya zhing / dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas byin rlabs 'jug pa dang /zhugs pa'i rtags phyi nang gsang ba rnams dang / gsang sgrub sogs dril sgrub spros pa nyer bsdu ni zhal las shes so// lho/da/ g.yuthog snying thig masgrub mkha' 'gro myur mgyogasabazhugasaso/'khor mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sgos sgrub ni/ sems bskyed tshad med sngon du song nas/ rang rta phag yab yum spyi bor bla ma bsam/ klad pa dung khang du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo/ mgrin par padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo/thugs kur rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo/ gsang gnas su las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu/ gri thod 'dzin pa g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs rol pas bzhugs par bsam/ mkha' 'gro bzhi las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las

450 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigal mnyes mchod 'bul/ de'i byin rlabs bsdus/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas/ dkar pos nad gdon zhi/ ser pos tshe bsod rgyas/ dmar pos khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ mthing gas dgra bgegs log rtog tshar gcod/ ljang gus gang 'jod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bsam/ ḍā ki bzhi ga'i thugs kur/ rang rang gi sa bon re 'od dang bcas par bsam/ oṃ āḥbadzra gu ru ha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring / sarba sidhi hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pas/ lus la bde drod/ ngag la nas pa/ sems la rtogs pa khyad par can 'char zhing /phrin las bzhi la thogs pa med pa/ ḍā ki thams cad sprin bzhin 'du/ tshe 'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par the tshom med/ thun mtshams su tshogs dang gtor ma la brtson par bya/ spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig la gnas par bya/ ḍā dril/ rkang dung / ka pā la/ kha ṭwāṃ/ me long rnams 'bral med du bcang ngo // phrin las tha dad gang 'dod ḍā ki ri re la dmigs pa sgos su gtad/ de'i 'od zer spro bsdu bya'o// mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sgos sgrub/ mdor bsdus shin tu zab pa/ snod min la gsang ngo //na/ byin rlabasabla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugasarje'i nyi 'od lasarigasalnga'i mngon rtogasabasdusapa bzhugasaso/sku rig pa'i ye shes sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sman gyi 'khor lo/ g.yon bdud rtsi sman gyis gang ba'i lhung bzed mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams shing skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o// gsung gi rig pa'i ye shes dmar po g.yas padma/ g.yon lhung bzed/ thugs kyi rig pa'i ye shes

〉〉/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 451mthing gsal/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon lhung bzed/ yon tan rig pa'i ye shes ser po/ g.yas rin po che/ g.yon lhung bzed/ phrin las rig pa'i ye shes ljang gu/ g.yas rgya gram/ g.yon lhung bzed/ lnga po yang mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs longs sku'i cha lugs can/ sku smad la dar gyi sham thabs dang ldan pa'o// rigs kyi gtso bor gyur pa kun bzang sman rgyal ni/ sku mdog sngo bsangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sman rgyal gser mdog dang /g.yon lhung bzed/ zhabs skyil krung / longs sku'i cha lugs kyis bzhugs par bsams la/ bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i bsgom bzlas bya'o// smi/shu rghaṃ/pa/ g.yuthog snying thig gi bla mnang sgrub kyi zhal gdamasadangosagrub kyi rdzong bu bzhugasaso/nang sgrub kyi zhal gdams snyan brgyud zur du gab pa ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra la/ stong ba'i ngang las rang nyid sman rgyal longs skur gsal gdab pa'i snying gar gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes kyi thugs gar yi ge hūṃ mthing ga sngags phreng dang bcas pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ rang sngags ci nus bzlas shing / thun 'jog khar dngos grub sman bsdu tshar 'ga' bzlas/de nas mchod cing bstod de 'dod gsol ni/ khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las dpag tu med pa mnga' bas/bdag la bde gshegs thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs shing / rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba dung dung /dungs dungs pa lan brgya rtsa gcig btang bas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od mthing gsal phyogs

452 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabacur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang / sman gyi rig 'dzin dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa mnga' ba thams cad/rdor sems rig pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ de rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung ltar gtibs nas bzhugs pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/'gro ba thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar yang de rnams rang gi thugs kur zhugs pa'i rig pa'i ye shes la dbyer med du thim/ de dag kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las/ rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud bee ḍūrya las grub pa'i yi ge'i rnam par snying gi rtsa 'khor thams cad khyab par bsam pa yang yang bsgoms pas zhe sdang gis bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang / des bskyed pa'i nad dag thugs kyi byin rlabs 'jug co rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus pa khong du chud par the tshom med do// de bzhin du spyi bo/ lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams kyi rtsa 'khor dbus su/ gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rnam snang / rin 'byung / snang mtha'/don grub rnams la/ gong ltar 'don pa bsgyur la/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ man ngag rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma rnams kyi tshig don rtogs pa'i dngos grub zhus pas/ji ltar 'dod pa de bzhin du 'grub par gdon mi za'o// shin tu gsang bar bya'o//rig pa'i ye shes rigs lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ sku'i rig pa'i ye shes sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sman gyi 'khor lo/g.yon bdud rtsi sman gyis bkang ba'i lhung bzed mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams shing / zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o// gsung gi rig pa'i ye shes dmar po/ g.yas padma/ g.yon lhung bzed/ thugs kyi rig pa'i ye shes mthing gsal/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon lhung bzed/ yon tan rig pa'i ye shes ser po/ g.yas rin chen/ g.yon lhung bzed/ phrin las rig pa'i ye shes ljang gu/ g.yas rgya gram/ g.yon lhung bzed/ lnga po'ang mtshan dpe'i rgyan

452 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabacur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang / sman gyi rig 'dzin dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa mnga' ba thams cad/rdor sems rig pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ de rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung ltar gtibs nas bzhugs pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/'gro ba thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar yang de rnams rang gi thugs kur zhugs pa'i rig pa'i ye shes la dbyer med du thim/ de dag kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las/ rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud bee ḍūrya las grub pa'i yi ge'i rnam par snying gi rtsa 'khor thams cad khyab par bsam pa yang yang bsgoms pas zhe sdang gis bskyed pa'i rtog pa dang / des bskyed pa'i nad dag thugs kyi byin rlabs 'jug co rgyud kyi tshig don ma lus pa khong du chud par the tshom med do// de bzhin du spyi bo/ lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams kyi rtsa 'khor dbus su/ gu ru sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes rnam snang / rin 'byung / snang mtha'/don grub rnams la/ gong ltar 'don pa bsgyur la/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ man ngag rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma rnams kyi tshig don rtogs pa'i dngos grub zhus pas/ji ltar 'dod pa de bzhin du 'grub par gdon mi za'o// shin tu gsang bar bya'o//rig pa'i ye shes rigs lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ sku'i rig pa'i ye shes sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sman gyi 'khor lo/g.yon bdud rtsi sman gyis bkang ba'i lhung bzed mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams shing / zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o// gsung gi rig pa'i ye shes dmar po/ g.yas padma/ g.yon lhung bzed/ thugs kyi rig pa'i ye shes mthing gsal/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon lhung bzed/ yon tan rig pa'i ye shes ser po/ g.yas rin chen/ g.yon lhung bzed/ phrin las rig pa'i ye shes ljang gu/ g.yas rgya gram/ g.yon lhung bzed/ lnga po'ang mtshan dpe'i rgyan

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 453rdzogs longs sku'i cha lugs can/ sku smad dar gyi sham thabs dang ldan pa'o//rigs kyi gtso bor gyur pa/ drug pa kun bzang sman rgyal ni/ sku mdog sngo bsangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas sman mchog gser mdog dang g.yon lhung bzed/ zhabs skyil krung longs sku'i cha lugs kyis bzhugs par bsams la/ bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i bsgom bzlas bya'o// maṅgā lam̐/pha/ g.yuthog snying thig gi bla ma gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdamasamachog gi bde lam bzhugasaso/gsang sgrub zhal gdams stan thog gcig ma ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ rang rta phag yab yum du bsgoms pa'i nang stong ra'i lus kyi dbus su/rtsa dbu ma 'od kyi sbu gu phyi dkar nang dmar mda' smyug tsam gsal btab pa'i nang gi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsang gnas rnams kyi thad du 'od dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu re re bsams pa'i dbus su/ rim pa bzhin du/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ mthing ga su ser po/ hā ljang gu/ re re bsam/ yum gyi dhū tī'i gnas lngar/ rmu lam̐ mo paṃ /bī tī lnga bsam/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu rigs 'dus rang rig bla ma rdo rje 'chang gu ṇa bzhugs par dmigs/ 'od zer spro bsdu sngar dang 'dra bar byas la/ oṃ ā :: swāhā/ sum̐ lam̐ paṃ py-i /bī spyo/ zhes pa bzlas shing / rig pa'i ye shes re re nas sgos su sgrub na/ gang bsgrub sgrub pa de nyid kyi gnas su dmigs pa gtad/ 'od zer spro bsdu bya/ oṃ sogs gsang sgrub de'i thugs srog gi yi ge gcig pu de nyid bzlas pas myur du 'grub par the tshom med do// 'di ni yang gsang thugs kyi nying khu/ gud du sbas pa'i zab gnad bla na med pa'o//

454 ༄zagayu thog snying thigapha/ khrosama'i gsang sgrub bzhugasaso/mkha' 'gro ma khros ma nag mo'i gsang sgrub las/ sman sgrub dang mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ltas brtag pa bstan pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ bshags sdom mthar phyin par byas te/ gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar/ phag mo'i tshogs mchod ji ltar 'byor ba bshams nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor/ mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo lha mo khro 'dzum ma/phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa zhig bsgom/ sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti (te ha ri ni sa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas zhag bdun bcu bzhi/ nyer gcig tshun la bud med chas bzang thogs nas/ rang la phyag dang bskor ba bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / nyi ma shar ba dang / mos gus byed na grub pa'i rtags yin/ de nas bu mo dang khye'u gtsang ma gang rung la sman dang 'bru gang byed bla ma'i zhal shes bzhin bya'o// de nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gsol 'debs byed/ gang dmigs lo ma 'bras bu bcas pa 'byung ngo // ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba 'debs so// mkha' spyod kyi gtso mo la gsol ba 'debs so// bsod nams dpal 'dren ma la gsol ba 'debs so// chos kyi sgron ma la gsol ba 'debs so// kun tu bzang mo la gsol ba 'debs so// yum chen mos byin gyis rlobs shig 'du 'bral med par thugs rjes gzung/zhes gsum/ bdun/ nyer gcig rnams brjod do// 'di mtshan ldan ma la brgyud pa yin/ sarba marga lam̐//

454 ༄zagayu thog snying thigapha/ khrosama'i gsang sgrub bzhugasaso/mkha' 'gro ma khros ma nag mo'i gsang sgrub las/ sman sgrub dang mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ltas brtag pa bstan pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ bshags sdom mthar phyin par byas te/ gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar/ phag mo'i tshogs mchod ji ltar 'byor ba bshams nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor/ mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo lha mo khro 'dzum ma/phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa zhig bsgom/ sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti (te ha ri ni sa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas zhag bdun bcu bzhi/ nyer gcig tshun la bud med chas bzang thogs nas/ rang la phyag dang bskor ba bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / nyi ma shar ba dang / mos gus byed na grub pa'i rtags yin/ de nas bu mo dang khye'u gtsang ma gang rung la sman dang 'bru gang byed bla ma'i zhal shes bzhin bya'o// de nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gsol 'debs byed/ gang dmigs lo ma 'bras bu bcas pa 'byung ngo // ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba 'debs so// mkha' spyod kyi gtso mo la gsol ba 'debs so// bsod nams dpal 'dren ma la gsol ba 'debs so// chos kyi sgron ma la gsol ba 'debs so// kun tu bzang mo la gsol ba 'debs so// yum chen mos byin gyis rlobs shig 'du 'bral med par thugs rjes gzung/zhes gsum/ bdun/ nyer gcig rnams brjod do// 'di mtshan ldan ma la brgyud pa yin/ sarba marga lam̐//

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 455ba/ byin rlabasablamasman rgyalagyi sgrub thabasalasagrub chen mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud gsang sgrub bzhugasaso/na mo gu ru/ grub chen mahā gu ṇa'i gsang sgrub ni/ tho rangs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya// rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas sngon du btang / su bha was stong bar sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ lha so so dang mthun pa'i srung 'khor bsgom/ de'i dbus su rang yi dam gang yin gyi mngon rtogs bsgom/ yi dam 'di yin gyi nges pa med na/ pad zla'i gdan la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsgom/ de'i spyi bor 'ja' 'od gur khung gi dbus su/ rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i grub chen mahā gu ṇa sku mdog dkar po zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa dbu skra ral ba'i thor tshugs can la me tog sna tshogs kyi phreng bas bcings pa/ dbu skra lhag ma cung zad thur du 'phyang ba/phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi pus mo'i steng du bzhag pa la shel dkar gyi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ mthe bong la utpa la'i yu ba 'khril pa/ snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba'i steng du/ rdo rje dang dril bus mtshan pa/ phyag g.yon pa thugs kur padma dkar po'i yu ba 'dzin cing / snyan gyi thad kur kha phye ba'i steng du/ gser gyi bum pa 'chi zad kyi bdud rtsis gang ba kha rgyan che bas me tog kha phye ba'i steng du/yid bzhin gyi nor bu brgyad bzhog ma dang a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ gos 'gang dkar po'i sku 'gag dang mon rgya 'ching ba ber dmar ser la mtshal dang gser gyi thig les spras pa/ g.yi dkar gyi thul ba

456 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigal gos chen dmar po'i gong rgyan btags pa gsol ba/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa 'dzum gyis bzhad pa/ de'i phyogs bzhi'i padma'i steng du/ shar du sman gyi lha mo dkar mo shel gyi pi wang brdung ba/ lhor sman gyi lha mo ser mo sba gar gyi gling bu 'bud pa/ nub tu sman gyi lha mo dmar mo bya rgod kyi gling bu 'bud pa dang / byang du sman gyi lha mo ljang gu mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis pi wang dang gling bu sogs 'gre'o// phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i mda' dar la/ dngul gyi me long dang / rin po che'i chun 'phyang gis spras pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyang / lang tsho dar la babs pa bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/dkar 'dzin dang chu 'dzin rgyas pa/ kha dog sna tshogs kyi na bza' gos su gsol ba/ rin po che du ma'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ dbu skra cung zad thor gtsug me tog gi phreng bas bcings pa/ g.yu chung dang me tog gi phreng bas lan tshar can thams cad bzhi ka yang zhal gtso bo la phyogs pa 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'o//gtso bo'i thugs kur pad zla'i steng du/ sangs rgyas sman gyi rgyal po rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa la/ phyogs bzhi'i pad zla'i steng du/drang srong rig pa'i ye shes bzhi/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa/ phyag g.yas a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba thugs kur 'dzin cing / g.yon pa sman gyi lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// sangs rgyas sman rgyal gyi thugs kur zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po/ shar du rnam snang dkar po/ lhor rin 'byung ser po/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po/byung du don yod grub pa ljang gu/ thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs spyi dang mthun pa'o// rdo rje 'chang gi thugs gar hrīḥlas khro kho rta mgrin dmar po khro bo'i cha byad can bzhengs pa/ dbu'i gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher ba/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 457rngog ma dang dbu skra me ltar du 'bar ba/ spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing yum la 'khyud pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dgra bgegs mnan pa dor stabs su bzhugs so// de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo g.yas gri gug yab kyi phrag pa la phyar ba/g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa yab kyi mgul du 'khyud pa/zhabs g.yas yab kyi sku la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba'o// thod skam thod rlon rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o// zhi ma khro bo'i rnam pa can no// phyogs bzhi'i pad nyi'i steng du/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi sku mdog rgyan cha lugs spyi dang mthun pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du/ hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar g.yas skor du/ rma āḥlha/ badzra gu ru padma gu ṇa ā yur dzñā na sidhi hūṃ gis bskor ba las/ 'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer lta bur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sangs rgyas byang sems thams cadaspyan drangs/ rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar bstim zhing / dzaḥs baṃ hoḥlan 'ga' brjod/ slar yang rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/bum chus dbang bskur/ so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par gyur/slar yang thugs ku'i sngags phreng rnams 'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer lta bu 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad dang / 'byung ba lnga'i sman thams cad dang / snod bcud kyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas bdag nyid la thim pas/ mthu dang nus pa bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/de rnams la gling bzhi ri rab yan lag bdun pa/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin du mas mchod cing / gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sman gyi rgyal po'i gsol 'debs so// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// chos rje sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// 'dod gsol gang 'dod sbyar/lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/

458 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigarang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas/ dbang bzhi thob cing rgyud bzhi smin par bsam/ rtsa sngags ci mang 'dren no// 'phro 'jog dus mchod bstod gang shes byed cing lha tshogs bdag la thim/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kyang bdag la thim/ bdag nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas thugs ku'i sa bon la thim/sa bon kyang 'od du zhu nas nam mkhar 'ja' yal ba ltar bsams la skye med spros bral so so rang rig bde ba chen po la mnyam par bzhag go/ zhes dge ba'i rtsa ba bla med byang chub tu bsngo'o// tshul 'di nyid thun bzhi'i srod tho rangs ma chag par byas na/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad rtsol med du 'byung zhing / bar dor mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/zab chos 'di ni chos rje mnyam nyid rdo rjes/ snying dang 'dra ba'i slob ma re re tsam ma gtogs 'tshal bar ston na/ mgon po rdo rje bdud 'dul 'khor bcas kyis bar du gcod pa 'byung bas/ snying gi dkyil du sbos shig nyu hya/rgya rgya/ zhes zab rgya/ gab rgya/ sbas rgya/ chos skyong rnams kyis srungs shigasmi/gong gi mchod bstod kyi skabs su phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa shes pa dang / bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ ces sogs dang / ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku// zhes sogs/ sman bla'i bstod pa gang shes dang / rta mgrin gyi bstod pa ni/ hrīḥlas byung ba'i rta mchog dpal/ drag po rta skad bzhad pa yis// khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud// gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// ces brjod do// maṅga lam̐//

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 459ma/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi phyi gtor bsngosapa kun tshim bzhugasaso/gu ru de wa ḍū ki ni sarba na mo/ rgyal ba kun 'dus sman rgyal gyi// gsang sgrub sngon 'gro'i phyi gtor ni// snod rin po che la sogs pa/ bcud gtsang sbyar cha gsum bshamagator ma gong ma la dkar gsum mngar gsum dang 'og ma la sha khrag la phud chang gis bran/ / skad cig gas rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal btab la 'di ltar bsngo/na mo phyogs dus dkon mchog ma lus la// bdag gzhan nye bar skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed do// bla med byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ su bhā wa shuddhāḥ sarba dharmāḥs bhā wa shurnyo3 haṃ/ rdzas rnams mi dmigs stong par gyur// zlo las rin chen snod yangs su// oṃ zhu lha rdzas gtor ma mchog/zag med bde bskyed mkha' mnyam gyur// oṃ āḥ bhū/ lan bdun nam nyer gcig brjod nas rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ dbyangs snyan dang bcas te/ mgron rnams spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs/dam tshig dran mdzod ci nus mchod cing bstod// rang rang mthun rdzas bshams bzhes yongs tshims nas/ bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ arbhe sogs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharmā ṭwāṃ ārya nutpan na tā ta oṃ āḥrgyu phaṭa swāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te (ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā (tadakaṇa utna te spa ra ṇa i (hikarma/ a pā tram̐ puṣṭha dhū pe ā lo ke garnye ni bibyu shapta āḥji/ de sogs brjod la rol mo sgrog la ārya zhes bya ba bklag go/ ga ga nas gri ṭā rda /gro ṇḍa ta ba li rya (lo hye swāhā/ hūṃ dkar phyogs mngon par skyong ba'i dam tshig can// tshangs dang brgya byin phyogs skyong gtsug lag srung //gza' dang rgyu skar lha klu sde brgyad tshogs// gzhi bdag gnas bdag grong

460 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabadag gnyug mar gnas// steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'khod pa thams cad la//'dod yon mi zad mchod sbyin gtor ma 'bul// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// bar gcod kun zhi 'dod don ma lus sgrubs//ya hi gtsu ces rol mo bsgrags la rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ snying rje'i mgron rnams snying ga'i 'od kyis bos par bsam/ a ṇi su tri bre du sarba sa ta dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥ sa ta pra ti dza ho/ a kā ro/ gong gi sngags kyis/ hūṃ srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal ba'i gnas yan gyi// 'gro drug skye 'gro sems can ma lus la// bdud rtsi yid bzhin gtor ma 'di bsngos pas// sdug bsngal kun bral bde bas tshim gyur cig/de nas bgegs gtor ni/ hūṃ nga ni dbang chen rta mchog dpal// khro rgyal rang skad cig gis rta mgrin yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas bgegs rigs thams cad bkug par bsam ste/ ma lus kun gyi rje/ bdud rigs ma lus bran du khol// tshur shog gtor long (longs bka' nyon cig/ byi na /bi nā ya ka sarba ju ta bhyo/ sarba pre ta ka a kursha ya dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sa ma ya na ra kun badzra kli phaṭa/ hūṃ byi na /bi nā ya ka khams gsum bdag po dang // dga' rab dbang phyug sprin sgrol mchu can sogs// rnal 'byor dngos grub bsgrub la bar gcod pa'i// log 'dren bgegs kyi rigs gyur thams cad la// phyogs mtshams nye ring gang nas 'ongs kyang rung // sngon gyi lan chags bu lon yod na yang // mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di long /longs bral bar gyis// gdug pa'i sems spongs zhi dul ldan par byos// rang gi lus dag /ngag yid la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba snying nas spongs// gal te bden pa'i bka' las khyod 'da' na// dam tshig nyams te rdo rje dmyal bar skye// sdig las sdug bsngal dge las bde ba 'byung // rgyu las 'bras bu bsru med dran gyis la// sgo gsum bag yod sdom la gnas pa dang //
