༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 465lnga rab gsal ba// las rnams kun byed nam mkha' mdzod// de nyid thod par 'od du zhu// phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab// ces pa nas/ pukhre/ṅgha pe/ ā lo ke garnye/ nee wi byu/ shapta pū dza me gha oṃ āḥlha/ zhes gsum mam lngas phyi mchod me tog sogs lha rdzas su byin gyis brlabs/ rū pa/ shapta/gadha/garnyen/ ra sa/ sparsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥrgyu/ zhes gsum mam lngas nang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs byin gyis brlabs/mahā/ mi sa/ rakta/ tsitta/ go ro tsa na/ ki ni ri ti bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ zhes brjod rol mo bsgrag par bya/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i yo byad ma lus pa mtshan bcas der 'dzin dang bral zhing zag med bde bskyed nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam par bsams la byin gyis brlabs/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i bcu rnam dag gi sgo nas sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa ni/ hrīḥbla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// seng khri pad sdong nyi zla'i steng du bzhugs//bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus phyag rtag tu 'tshal// dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang bas mchod// nyes ltung nyams chags /chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags// dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang // gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bzhin du// mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes gang bsags byang chub bsngo// 'khor ba dong sprug /sprugs bde chen mchog thob shog/ ces brjod/ de nas sku bskyed pa ni/ kli chos rnams dmigs med spros bral ba// skye med stong gsal nam mkha' che// oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3 haṃ/ de nyid ma rtogs sems can la// mi bzad snying rje kun khyab bsgom// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi// ngang nas 'gro don bsgrub pa'i phyir// rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer gyur// de las e 'phros nam mkha' che// yi 'phros rlung gi dkyil 'khor te//

466 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigar /roka'aphros rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khrugs// sum̐ las zheng chen sa gzhir brdal//ki las rus chen ri rab steng // ram̐ las bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar// de dbus sna tshogs tram̐ 'phros te// yongs gyur ye shes gzhal yas khang // khyams sgo rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs// de dbus padma 'dab ma bzhi// zla nyi bdud bzhi'i ro gdan steng // hrīḥm ha ri ni sa rnams// dbus dang 'dab bzhi so sor gsal// de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod// sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs// tshur 'dus rdo rje gri gug gyur// de nyid gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su// rta mchog yab yum sku mdog dmar// dbu gtsug rta mgos rta skad mtsher('tsher / / dbang sdud gri gug phyag g.yas phyar// bdud bzhi'i khrag bkang thod pa g.yon// bdud bzhi'i steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs// rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor// de nyid cha lugs yab 'dra la// spyi gtsug phag gdong ngur sgra sgrogs// gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// bcu drug lang tsho chags pa'i nyams// nu ma bha ga rgyas pa'i tshul// bskal ba'i me dbus bzhugs par bskyed// mdun sogs phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la// rdo rje rin chen padma dang // las kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa bzhi// mthing ser dmar ljang 'od phung 'bar// g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rus pa'i rgyan mdzes khro 'dzum 'gyings// brkyang bskums gar stabs ro steng bzhugs// spyi bor pad sdong 'dab bzhi la// nyi zla'i gdan steng lte dbus su// rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems// mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// chos nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje g.yas// zag med bde rgyas thod pa g.yon// tshe sgrub skabs su zag med bcud gang tshe bum g.yon zhes bsgyur ro// gcer bu rin chen rus rgyan spras//khro 'dzum 'gying zag /bag skyil krung gi/ pang du rang rig yum gyis 'khyud//sngo sangs gzhon tshul chags pa'i nyams// rab mdzes yid 'ong gri thod 'dzin/tshe sgrub kyi skabs su rab mdzes gri gug tshe bum 'dzin/ mdun sogs phyogs bzhir rnam

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 467snang dang // rin 'byung mtha' yas don yod grub// rig pa'i ye shes rigs bzhi po// dkar ser dmar ljang sku mdog can// rang rang yum sbyor phyag mtshan ni// 'khor lo la sogs phyag g.yas bsnams// g.yon sogs cha lugs gtso ltar bskyed// srog snying re re snying gar bsam// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed tsam bsam/ de'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa'/ rnam snang / rin 'byung / snang mtha'/ don yod grub pa rnams (rim )bzhin/ hūṃ oṃ spya aḥhā/ yum lnga la rim bzhin du/ sum̐ lam̐ paṃ py-i tī/ rta mgrin dang phag mo gnyis la rim bzhin du/ hrīḥdang maḥ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rim pa bzhin/ ha ri ni sa: rnams spus bris pa tsam rang rang gi sku mdog gi rang bzhin 'od zer 'phro ba gsal bar bsgoms/ gzhan yang yi dam mkha' 'gro dang // chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// sman gyi bka' srung ma lus pa// sprin dpung 'khrigs pa lta bur bsgom// de ltar bsams pa'i/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kur hūṃ/ gnas gsum so so nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa dkyil 'khor ba'i ye shes kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drang /drangs pa ni/ de nas snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ni//gdung ba'i sems kyis 'di skad bskul// kli hrīḥ chos dbyings spros bral ngang nyid las// rigs 'dus rgyal ba sku bzhengs 'tshal// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ āḥbhū gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa mā dza e bye hi/ zhes brjod sprin dpung gtibs pa ltar byon par bsam// de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i// gsang chen dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag bzhin// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya

468 ༄zagayu thog snying thigatiṣṭhachu/ zhes brjod/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ hrīḥbla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum// byin rlabs dngos grub 'phrin las kyi// 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor bu la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// na mo a ti pu hoḥpra tī tstsha hoḥ zhes brjod de nas phyi mchod 'bul/ hūṃ me tog bdug spos mar me dri// bshes gtsang rol mo la sogs pa// kun 'byung nam mkha'i mdzod las byung // spyan sogs tshim phyir mchod par bzhes// ambha/ pa ṭwāṃ/pukhre/ juspru/ dī paṃ/ gan nee/ nee wi byu/ shapta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye oṃ āḥrgyu/ arbhe sogs brjod/ nang mchod ni/ lce sogs dbang lnga'i me tog ste// gsur chen dri mchog zhun chen me// dri chen dri chu bshos dang byug/thod rnga rkang gling rol mo mchog/ dus gsum sku gsum dug lnga ni// ye shes lnga yi ngang du mchod// snang srid 'khor dang mya ngan 'das// bde chen rab 'byams klong du mchod// rū pa/ shapta/ garnye/ ra sa/ sparsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥ:/ rū pa sogs brjod/ gsang mchod ni/ hūṃ thabs shes zla gsang thig le las// dkar dmar bde chen ye shes rdzas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// gnyis med ngang du 'bul gyis bzhes// bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ bo dhi sogs brjod sman raka (rag gtor/dbyangs bcas gus pas 'di skad bskul// hrīḥ co brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman// dug lnga ye shes lngar gyur pa// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos//ye shes lnga rdzogs grub rdzas bzhes// oṃ āḥbhū mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥsman mchod ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni// hūm̐ hrīḥ rang sems skye med chos sku ngo sprod pa'i// bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mchog thun dngos grub dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i// brgyud pa'i bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 469rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// phung khams skye mched gdod nas rnam dag pa'i// rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// dam tshig can la 'gyur med bde ster ba'i// ma sring mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// rgyal ba'i bstan srung zhing bcu sgrol la brtson//chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// skyabs mgon dpung gyur mchod 'os rtsa gsum lha// rang snang dag pa'i gtso 'khor lha rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mchod pa'i mthus// khams gsum yongs sgrol 'khor ba dong sprug /sprugs shog / oṃ āḥrgyu mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrīḥ'akhor 'das phyi nang gsang ba shes bya dang // shes byed las 'das dam tshig rdo rje che// thabs shes mtheb srin phyag rgya'i cho ga bzhin// myong (myang na dngos grub ma lus thob phyir myong //kā ya wā ka tsitta sirnyi oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbhū sogs brjod/ rakta 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ bhan dha mtshan ldan 'bar ba'i snod// bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i snying khrag bcud//rnam rtog 'khor ba dbyings sgrol phyir// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod//mahā rakta la khā hiḥ mahā rakta sogs brjod cing / ba lo gtor ma mchod pa'i phyir// hūṃ snod bcud gtor mar lhun gyis grub// gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs// 'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan pa'i// bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod rtsa ba'i sngags sham du/ ba li ta btags gtor bsngos bya// kli hrīḥ rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma sman gyi bla// sku lnga'i bdag nyid gtso 'khor ma lus rnams// gshegs byon skye 'bri 'khrul rtog mi

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 469rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// phung khams skye mched gdod nas rnam dag pa'i// rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// dam tshig can la 'gyur med bde ster ba'i// ma sring mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// rgyal ba'i bstan srung zhing bcu sgrol la brtson//chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// skyabs mgon dpung gyur mchod 'os rtsa gsum lha// rang snang dag pa'i gtso 'khor lha rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mchod pa'i mthus// khams gsum yongs sgrol 'khor ba dong sprug /sprugs shog / oṃ āḥrgyu mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrīḥ'akhor 'das phyi nang gsang ba shes bya dang // shes byed las 'das dam tshig rdo rje che// thabs shes mtheb srin phyag rgya'i cho ga bzhin// myong (myang na dngos grub ma lus thob phyir myong //kā ya wā ka tsitta sirnyi oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbhū sogs brjod/ rakta 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ bhan dha mtshan ldan 'bar ba'i snod// bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i snying khrag bcud//rnam rtog 'khor ba dbyings sgrol phyir// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod//mahā rakta la khā hiḥ mahā rakta sogs brjod cing / ba lo gtor ma mchod pa'i phyir// hūṃ snod bcud gtor mar lhun gyis grub// gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs// 'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan pa'i// bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod rtsa ba'i sngags sham du/ ba li ta btags gtor bsngos bya// kli hrīḥ rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma sman gyi bla// sku lnga'i bdag nyid gtso 'khor ma lus rnams// gshegs byon skye 'bri 'khrul rtog mi

470 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigamanga' yang // 'gro rnams tshogs rdzogs gtor mchod bzhes phyir gshegs//oṃ āḥ rgyu/ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrgyu swāhā: rlu lam̐ mi paṃ spyoḥ hrīḥmaḥha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: dharma pā la sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: arbhe pa ju (ju3pukhre dhū spa (pe ā lo ke garnye ni wirya /byu1shapta pū dza hoḥ rū pa/ shapta/gadhe/ ra sa/ sparnye pū dza hoḥ mahā sarba pañtsa/ mahwa rakta/ mahā ba li ta/mahwa mi sa/ mahā rakta/ mahā ki ri ni ri ti/ bo rnyi tsitta mahā su kha ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ rgyu hrīḥ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang // chos skyong dam can nor lha gzhi bdag sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das 'khor 'das mgron// zag med bde bskyed gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes// gtor ni chags med ma ni kun la khyab// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde legs yon tan gter// ma tshang spang ba'i mchod sprin bla med rnams// mkha' khyab bsngos pas don gnyis lhun grub shog/ de nas glu gar don gyis mchod// hrīḥ skye ba med las thams cad skyes// skye tsam nyid nas skye bral ba// 'du 'bral med pa'i rdo rje'i glu// nyams dbyangs rang grol ye shes mchod// oṃ te te hūṃ/ te na hūm̐/ te phu spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ te te sogs brjod gus pa yis// bstod cing dbyangs bcas 'di skad do// hūṃ chos sku bla ma spros med khyab gdal dang //longs spyod rdzogs sku bde chen rol ba'i dbyings// sprul sku gang la gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad// rigs 'dis bla ma sman rgyal rdo rje 'dzin// kun bzang 'gyur med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gag med tshangs dbyangs gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// mtha' bral dri med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// lus bde ngag nus sems rtogs byin gyis rlobs// rnam shes gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed lnga// 'dod khro gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog lnga// chos dbyings me mnyam sor rtog bya ba grub// rang dag rang grub rang gsal rigs rnams lnga//

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 471nam mkha' sa chu me rlung 'byung ba lnga// rnam dag phung lnga dang bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// lam lnga gdan thog gcig tu bgrod pa las// sku lnga tshe 'dir thob par byin gyis rlobs// snang stong dbyer med rta mchog yab yum sku// sna tshogs sprul sku rigs bzhi mkha' 'gror bcas// chos byed skyong mdzad dam can bka' srung bstod// phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzad du gsol//zhes bstod phyi nang gsang ba yi// sgrub pa gang byed bzlas pa bya// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab// rgyas pa ni phyi sgrub nang sgrub gsang sgrub rnams kyi zhal gdams su bcas pa sogs las tshogs su yod pa ltar bya'o// oṃ āḥs badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi skyuḥ yi āḥrgyu swāhā: thu lam̐ paṃ py-i spyoḥhrīḥm ha ri ni saḥ tsitta hring hring sa ma ya dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥsarba sirnyi āḥrgyu āḥzhes gtso 'khor thams cad dril ba'i sngags bzlas pa'am/ sngags gong ma gnyis bzlas so// oṃ āḥrgyu swāhāḥ a mṛ ta dzi wanti lha ṣa dzī sarba sirnyi hūṃ hoḥsman gyi dngos grub bsdu sngags so// hūṃ ho: skye med dbyings las 'gag med rtsal shar ba// mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro 'dul rtsa gsum lha// rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren gnyis med bzhugs// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig bshags bstod cing bskul// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bzlas brjod ting 'dzin bsgoms// mi mthun phyogs rnams kun zhi 'dod dgu rgyas// rang snang dbang bsdus log 'dren dgra bgegs thul// mchog thun dngos grub dus 'dir myur stsol mdzod// 'di ni skabs su bstod pa dang gtor bsngos kyi gsham la'ang sbyar ro//de nas tshogs kyi yo byad bsangs sbyangs nas byin rlabs spyan drangs shing / dang po tshogs phud mchod par phul// bar pas bshags bskang tha ma ni// dgra bgegs bsgral la lhag ma btang / bzod gsol lha gshegs dge rtsa bsngo// bkra shis brjod cing dkyil 'khor bsdu// rtsa gsum gtor ma

472 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadangos grub blangs// chos skyong gzhi bdag gtor ma ni// chad mdo bstan skyong dam sri mnan// rdzogs rim la ni gnas par bya// rol mo dang bcas pa'i ltar ro// hūṃ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ku'i sa bon las// ram̐ yo khaṃ 'phros tshogs rdzas bsregs sbyangs bkrus// / oṃ āḥbhū gis ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// 'dod yon lha mos tshogs rdzas sprin dpung gtibs// mahā ga ṇa tsakra sarba pha la hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas spyan drangs te/ hūṃ rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams// thugs dam thugs rje'i brtser dgongs la//tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes slad du// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa mā dzaḥ bkod legs rab mdzes khri la bzhugs// bdag gzhan gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang mchod dgyes par bzhes// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// sa ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod tshogs phud phul/hrīḥ mdzes ldan dri zhim ro ldan zhing // 'jam 'khril glu gar bde bas mchod// ma tshang med pa'i tshogs phud 'bul// bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol// ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas nyams chags /chag bshags/ hūṃ thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur pa// chags (chag nyams 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa// tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// buddhā badzra ratna dang // padma kurma'i thugs dam rnams// gti mug zhe sdang nga rgyal dang // phrag dog bden 'dzin 'thabs pa'i tshul// kun gzhi ka dag klong yangs su// ye nas skye 'gag spros mtshon bral// kun rdzob rang sems rgyal ba dang // bshags bya bshags byed gnyis su med// oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa/tiṣṭha ṭī ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu ralto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/sarba siddhi sme pra ya tstsha sarba kurma su tsa me/ tsi haṃ shrī yo ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga lhan sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzre bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa tā āḥ zhes

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 473yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ de nas tshogs bstab thugs dam bskang // hrīḥgasang chen rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas ma tshang med// rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam gnyan po bskang //rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig/ oṃ āḥ rgyu badzra sa twa āḥs ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod tshogs du ma dgra bgegs dmigs/ 'gugs zhugs jigazhug lha dbye rnam shes spar// 'di yang rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o// bsdu na lhar gsal bas/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa gsum lha tshogs bka'// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin bden pa'i mthus// mi bzad grangs med sprul pa'i khro tshogs rnams// glog ltar myur bskyod dgra bgegs da lta khug/dbang med rten 'dir bstims la lha dang phrol// zhing bcu ldan pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs 'di// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su gnas spar ro//gzugs phung da lta skad cig brlag par bya// zhes tshig don dran pa lta ldan du hur phyung ste/ phur bu btab la 'di skad brjod// hūṃ bcom ldan khro rgyal he ru ka/ srid gsum dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed// phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'debs// dam nyams thal ba rdul du rlog/ gnod byed rū tra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ rgyu gnod byed bsgral ba'i lnga phung 'di// rigs lnga khro rgyal 'al du bstabs// chos kyi dbyings su bzhes nas kyang // log rtog tshar gcod dngos grub zhu// kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ skabs 'dir bdud rtsi bsang bas bran//hūṃ dug lnga sman gyur 'bru mchog bcud// bdud rtsi dam pa dpa' bo'i rdzas//dza gad ro mchog stong ldan pa// zag med bde bskyed mchod 'bul bzhes//mahā dza gad khā hi/ zhes brjod gzigs thabs gzhan dang 'dra// bsdu na slob mas tshogs bteg ste// kye rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// snang srid 'khor 'das ro mnyam pas// gsang chen bde ba'i longs spyod che// the tshom spangs te bzhes par mdzod// ga ṇa tsakra mahā su kha hoḥzhes pas 'dren

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 473yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ de nas tshogs bstab thugs dam bskang // hrīḥgasang chen rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas ma tshang med// rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam gnyan po bskang //rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig/ oṃ āḥ rgyu badzra sa twa āḥs ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod tshogs du ma dgra bgegs dmigs/ 'gugs zhugs jigazhug lha dbye rnam shes spar// 'di yang rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o// bsdu na lhar gsal bas/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa gsum lha tshogs bka'// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin bden pa'i mthus// mi bzad grangs med sprul pa'i khro tshogs rnams// glog ltar myur bskyod dgra bgegs da lta khug/dbang med rten 'dir bstims la lha dang phrol// zhing bcu ldan pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs 'di// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su gnas spar ro//gzugs phung da lta skad cig brlag par bya// zhes tshig don dran pa lta ldan du hur phyung ste/ phur bu btab la 'di skad brjod// hūṃ bcom ldan khro rgyal he ru ka/ srid gsum dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed// phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'debs// dam nyams thal ba rdul du rlog/ gnod byed rū tra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ rgyu gnod byed bsgral ba'i lnga phung 'di// rigs lnga khro rgyal 'al du bstabs// chos kyi dbyings su bzhes nas kyang // log rtog tshar gcod dngos grub zhu// kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ skabs 'dir bdud rtsi bsang bas bran//hūṃ dug lnga sman gyur 'bru mchog bcud// bdud rtsi dam pa dpa' bo'i rdzas//dza gad ro mchog stong ldan pa// zag med bde bskyed mchod 'bul bzhes//mahā dza gad khā hi/ zhes brjod gzigs thabs gzhan dang 'dra// bsdu na slob mas tshogs bteg ste// kye rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// snang srid 'khor 'das ro mnyam pas// gsang chen bde ba'i longs spyod che// the tshom spangs te bzhes par mdzod// ga ṇa tsakra mahā su kha hoḥzhes pas 'dren

474 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigal slob dpon gyis// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'dod yon ma dman rol pa che// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa// dri med rgyas byed yid la spyod//a la la hoḥ bskang rdzas byin rlabs bskang ba gnyis 'don/ ces blangs so//rnal 'byor pho mo tshogs la rol// de nas lhag ma kha chus bran// 'bru gsum byin rlabs tshig gis bsngo// oṃ ā sa: lha rigs 'dus rgyal ba ma lus pa'i//bka' dang bstan pa srung byed pa'i// lhag la dbang ba'i tshogs rnams kun//lhag mtshod 'di long /longs phrin las sgrubs// u tsi ba li ta bhakṣa si swāhā/zhes brjod rol mo bsgrag par bya// de nas bzod gsol tshig don rnams//gus pas me tog snyim gang gtor// gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do//hūṃ rang rig bla ma rgyal ba'i gtso// bde chen tshad med thugs rjes dgongs//bdag cag byis pa'i rang bzhin la// lhag chad nor 'khrul bzod par bzhes//oṃ āḥ lha gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni kā ya wā ka tsitta sa ma ya a a a āḥ lha rnams rten yod bzhugs gsol bya// rten med rang bzhin gnas su gshegs// hoḥsems can don mdzad rgyal dang sras// thugs rje smin grol chos 'khor bskor//rang bzhin gnas su gshegs mdzad nas// slar yang brtse bas 'byon par mdzod// badzra muḥ zhes brjod de nas dge ba bsngo// hoḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba rnams// ma lus dmigs med gcig bsdus nas// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs// mkha' khyab 'gro bas thob par shog / de ma thob kyi gnas skabs su// bar chad med par dal 'byor thob// bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su bzung // bka' bzhin sgrub la nan tan shog/ chos rnams sems su blo thag chod// sems nyid chos skur rang ngo shes// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang bag chags zhig/ goms 'dris brtan pa thob par shog/ces brjod bkra shis tshigs bcad kyang // rig pa'i ye shes rigs lnga yi//bstod pa'i dus su 'don pa bsgyur// chos kyi dbyings las byung ba'i bkra shis

sku'io/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 475mchog / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dang // chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shes kyis// dge legs dpal 'byor gang la myur thob shog/ ces so// dkyil 'khor mtha' nas dbus su dril// phyi nang gsang ba lnga tshan lnga yi chos// rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor che la rdzogs// rab 'byams brten (brtan g.yo kun la yongs khyab pa// gnyis med chos dbyings rol ba'i dbyings su sdud// sarba burnya maṇḍal/ swa bhā wa ātpa ko3 haṃ/ de nas rtsa ba gsum gyi gtor ma de// bdud rtsi chen por bsam byas la// dngos grub blang phyir 'di skad do// hūm̐ hoḥ bde chen klong yangs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// bla ma sman rgyal rigs 'dus thugs dam can// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las byin chen po// dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥlha sarba sidhi sa ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod gtor ma bgo la bza'// dam tshig nyams dang dbang ma thob// bya khyi sprang po la mi sbyin// de nas chos skyong gzhi bdag gi / gtor ma phyir khyer phud bran la// byin brlab dam can tshogs la bsngo// rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad do// hūṃ bhyoḥ rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang // padma 'byung gnas gu ṇa dbyer med kyi// spyan sngar bka' srungs dam can rgya mtsho dang // 'jig rten dregs pa'i lha 'dre ma lus 'dul// khyad par gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs//sman rgyal rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang // rdo rje 'da' dka'i mna' chu blud pa'i tshe// gsang chen sgrub mchog nyams su len rnams kyi// bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam//bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam// rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam// dam nyams srog rtsa gcod par ma chad dam// dam ldan bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam// nyan bshad phrin las spel bar ma chad dam//rgyud bzhi gces par bsrung bar ma chad dam// sngon tshe khas blangs dam las

476 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigam 'da' bar// sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces brjod bshal chus bstan ma skyong ba ni// hūṃ bhyoḥ dgung sngon mtho dang gangs ri mtsho// spang gshongs nags 'dabs sogs gnas pa'i// ma sring bstan ma bcu gnyis po// sman gyi bstan pa srung ba yi// khas blangs dam bcas dran par gyis// rang rang mthun pa'i mchod pa 'bul// ming sring gdung sems rgyun ma bcad// bdag gi 'khor srungs rkyen bzlog cig/ bcol ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod//ces brjod gtor gzhung kha sbub la// ri rab tu gyur de 'og tu// dgra bgegs ma lus mnan par bsam// hūṃ dpal chen 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams// khros shing rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas// gnod byed ma lus thal bar rlog/ de yis mi thub gang yang med// gnod byed thams cad mā ya ra nan//ces brjod bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi/ ngang la 'bral med gzhag par bya//de ltar las byang mdor bsdus pa// rang gzhan tshe 'dir mchog bsgrub phyir//bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun las// rang bzo slad /lhad kyis ma bslad par//'khyer bder zur du bkol ba yin// 'khrul na bla ma lha la bshags// dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog/ 7 mtshungs med rdo rje 'chang chen sman rgyal gu ṇa yi// thugs kyi bcad babs sras mchog sum ston gyis// bka' yi gnang ba zhus nas gsar rnying cho ga dang // mi 'gal chog 'grigs mdzad pas bsdus pa yin// smi:tsa/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi bdud rtsi sman ma lhan thabasabazhugasaso/sman mchod ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni// kli hrīḥ rang sems skye

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 477med chos skur ngo sprod pa'i// bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mchog thun dngos grub dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i// brgyud pa'i bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// phung khams skye mched gdod nas rnam dag pa'i// rang lus yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// dam tshig can la 'gyur med bde ster ba'i// ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ma lus la//rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtses dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// rgyal ba'i bstan srung zhing bcu sgrol la brtson// chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// skyabs mgon dpung gyur mchod 'os rtsa gsum lha// rang snang dag pa'i gtso 'khor khyed rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mchod pa'i mthus// khams gsum yongs sgrol 'khor ba dong sprug (sprugs shog/ oṃ āḥrgyu mahwa sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi// de nas dngos grub blang ba ni// hrīḥ'akhor 'das phyi nang gsang ba shes bya dang // shes byed las 'das dam tshig rdo rje che// thabs shes mtheb srin phyag rgya'i cho ga bzhin// myong bas dngos grub ma lus thob phyir myong // kā ya wā ka tsitta sirnyi oṃ āḥrgyu/ shu rghaṃ//tsa/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi gtor ma'i lhan thabasatshogasaganyisamyur rdzogasabazhugasaso/las gzhung dngos grub rgya mtsho yi// phrin las gtor ma'i lhan thabs ni//

478 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigahūṃ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma sman gyi rgyal// sku lnga'i bdag nyid bla ma gtso 'khor rnams// gshegs byon skye 'bri 'khrul rtog mi mnga' yang 'gro rnams tshogs gsog gtor mchod bzhes phyir gshegs// badzra sa ma dzaḥpadma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ na mo a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ ambha sogs/ dhū pe swāhā/mahā sarba pañtsa swāhā/ mahwa rakta swāhā/ mahā ba li ta swāhā/ mahā paṃ sa swāhā/mahā rakta swāhā/ma hā kau ni ri ti la swāhā/ bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha gu hya pū dza ho/oṃ āḥbhū badzra mahā gu ru sarba i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbhū swāhā/ māṃ lam̐ mi bye /bī hye hri ma ha ri ni sa tsitta hring hring / sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ mahā kā la badzra tsitta hūṃ phaṭa i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ e ka tsa ti ma mo ro ru baṃ hūṃ bhyo/i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ke ta ke ta swāhā/ i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rā hu la sa ma ya hūṃ bhyo/ i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ḍā ki ni tsitta rakta sa ma ya hring hring dza i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rakṣa tsitta mahā i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ badzra sā dma sa ma ya/ i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rakṣa rakṣa badzra sa ma ya i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dun tsitta ka ya i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tri shaṃ rbad bhyo gang kur i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dharma pā la sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhu me pa ti i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūṃ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang // chos srung dam can nor lha gzhi bdag sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das 'khor 'das mgron// zag med bde skyed gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes// gtor ni chags med ma ni kun la khyab// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde legs 'dod yon gter// ma tshang spangs pa'i bla med mchod sprin rnams// mkha' khyab bsngos pas don gnyis lhun grub shog/ shu rghaṃ//

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 479tsha/ byin rlabs sgrub lasartsa ba gsum gyi mdangasabaskang 'od kyi dra ba bzhugasaso/gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba sirnyi ho// kun 'das rgyal ba rtsa gsum gyi//dbang thob dam ldan rnal 'byor pas// nya stong dus bzhi bsnyen sgrub dus//lha tshogs thugs dam bskang bya'i phyir// dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor bri//dkon mchog sku gsung thugs rten dgram// sman raka (rag gtor ma spyan gzigs bsham// khyad par thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas// tshil chen dud pa zhun chen me// dbang lnga'i me tog zhal zas tshogs// tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong dang // zal le 'bri dang zhun chen mdangs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams// 'byor ldan bag dro mdzes pa bsham// bdag nyid rtsa gsum las gzhung bsrang // tshogs 'khor bsang sbyangs byin brlabs nas// spyan drangs tshogs phud bshags bskang skabs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//mkha' khyab sprin spungs (phung 'khrigs ltar bsam// gsur chen gtong zhing rol mo'ang sgrog/ gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do// kli hrīḥ bskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang // yang dag lta ba klong du gyur bas bskang // ma bcos yeng 'khrul skyon bral bsgoms pas bskang // blang dor tshul bral shugs 'byung spyod pas bskang // rang bcas phyogs lhung med pa 'bras bus bskang // hrīḥ gsang chen lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor na//kun 'dus rgyal ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam can// rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang // yab yum gnyis su med pa'i thugs dam bskang // rnam shes zhe sdang sems mkha' gnas gyur pa'i// rnam snang rig ye yum bcas thugs dam bskang // tshor ba nga rgyal khrag chu gnas gyur pa'i// rin 'byung rig ye yum

480 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabacas thugs dam bskang // 'du shes 'dod chags drod me gnas gyur pa'i//mtha' yas rig ye yab yum thugs dam bskang // 'du byed phrag dog dbugs rlung gnas gyur pa'i// don grub rig ye yab yum thugs dam bskang // hrīḥdon gyi dbyings la bskang yul lha tshogs la// bskang ba'i rdzas dang bskang rdzas mi dmigs kyang // rig rtsal ma 'gags ma rig 'gro don phyir// bla med tshogs mchod 'dod yon du mas bskang // hūṃ thugs dam gnyen (gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// rtsa ba yan lag stong sbyar sman mchog dang //bdud bzhi 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta dang // rmad byung 'dod yon dam rdzas gtor chen dang // ltag sprod rnga sgra gsur chen rkang chen dung // zhun chen mar me dbang po'i me tog dang // tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong zal le 'bri// rnam dag bam chen 'bru bcud stong sbyar chang // phyi nang gsang mchod zhal zas tshogs mchod kyis// bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskangs gyur cig/hrīḥ bde chen gar gyis rol bas 'gro rnams 'dul// dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang // bde stong zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pas 'khril// yum mchog rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang // zhi ba'i las sgrub bdud 'joms rdo rje'i rigs// mi 'gyur rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang // rgyas pa'i las sgrub bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma// re skong rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang // dbang gi las sgrub khams gsum re ba skong // chags med padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang // mngon spyod las sgrub phrin las thogs med ma// 'gro 'dul las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs//྅:thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman mchog dang // bdud bzhi 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta dang // rmad byung 'dod yon dam rdzas gtor chen dang // ltag sprod rnga sgra gsur chen rkang gling dang // zhun chen mar me dbang po'i me tog dang // tsa ra mkha' lding

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 481shel gong zal le 'bri// rnam dag bam chen 'bru bcud dza gad bcud// phyi nang gsang mchod zhal zas longs spyod kyis// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur cig/ hūṃ hrīḥ chags med dag pa'i brgyud pa ngo sprod phyir//mkha' 'gro dpal ldan phreng ba'i thugs dam bskang // chos nyid don dam gnas lugs mngon gyur phyir// 'gro mgon mahā gu ṇa'i thugs dam bskang //snang srid 'khor 'das rgyas 'debs rang grol phyir// sum ston ye shes gzung gi thugs dam bskang // rgyal tshab rmad byung 'gro don mthar phyin pa'i// paṇa chen gzhon nu gtsang stod sangs rin dang // mkhas btsun ring rdor don rgyal dkon mchog skyabs// dpal ldan 'tsho byed 'tsho byed rin chen dang //bsod nams dbang phyug rnal 'byor chen po'i mtshan// ri khrod zhig po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang // mchog thun dngos grub mnga' brnyes mnyam rdor sogs// 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang // byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa'i//drang srong theg rim dgu dang rgyud sde bzhi'i// pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med rgyud la sogs// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang // dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams gnas yul dur khrod skyong // ging dang ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang // zhing skyong phyogs skyong sha za 'bum phrag tshogs// ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang // chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang //gzugs sku drag po'i cha lugs sna tshogs kyis// bstan pa srung zhing dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i// chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang //sngon tshe rgyal sras gu ṇa'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas sman gyi dngos grub ster// bod khams skyong pa'i sman mo brtan ma'i tshogs// gzhi bdag srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang // hūṃ thugs dam gnyen /gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman mchog dang //

482 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabadud bzhi 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta dang // rmad byung dam rdzas gtor ma chen po dang // ltag sprod rnga sgra gsur chen rkang gling dang // zhun chen mar me dbang po'i me tog dang // tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong zal le 'bri// rnam dag bam chen 'bru bcud dza gad bcud// phyi nang gsang mchod zhal zas longs spyod kyis// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur cig/ rnal 'byor bdag cag g.yar dam sor stsal cig/ mchog thun dngos grub thams cad 'dir stsol cig/ ces brjod rnal 'byor pho mo rnams// bskang rdzas ngar btags spyan gzigs thogs// dkyil 'khor 'chams shing thugs dam bskang // de nas bshags pa'ang 'di ltar bya// mkha' mnyam rgyal ba yid kyis dmigs// kye hoḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams lha// 'gro 'dul sman rgyal rtsa gsum skur ston dang // rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam rnal 'byor sogs// dbang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol// bdag gis sngon 'das 'khor ba thog med nas// ma rig bag chags 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis// slob dpon sangs rgyas gsung du drang srong sogs// blo bzhag drug dang gzung bya'i dam tshig gnyis// shes gsum phyi yi dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// rdo rje mched lcam bka' 'gal lta ba log/ brdeg btsog rku 'phrog ngan sems gnod sems bsgom// dbang thob lha la sngags dang phyag rgya bcad// bla med theg pa khas blangs dam bca' g.yel// gsang ba bcu sogs gsang mchod dam tshig rnams// dam med la bsgrags mnyam 'dres bla ma bslus// rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// yan lag dag la shes bya'i dam tshig ni// phung po 'byung ba yum dbang ye shes lnga// spyad bya sbyor sgrol ma byin rdzun tshig lnga// mi spong chags 'khro /khro rmongs rgyal phrag dog lnga// dang blang dri chen dri chu dmar chen dang // byang sems gnyis te nyer lnga'i dam 'gal bshags// bla ma'i bka' gcog (bcag theg spangs thun bzhi

482 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabadud bzhi 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta dang // rmad byung dam rdzas gtor ma chen po dang // ltag sprod rnga sgra gsur chen rkang gling dang // zhun chen mar me dbang po'i me tog dang // tsa ra mkha' lding shel gong zal le 'bri// rnam dag bam chen 'bru bcud dza gad bcud// phyi nang gsang mchod zhal zas longs spyod kyis// bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur cig/ rnal 'byor bdag cag g.yar dam sor stsal cig/ mchog thun dngos grub thams cad 'dir stsol cig/ ces brjod rnal 'byor pho mo rnams// bskang rdzas ngar btags spyan gzigs thogs// dkyil 'khor 'chams shing thugs dam bskang // de nas bshags pa'ang 'di ltar bya// mkha' mnyam rgyal ba yid kyis dmigs// kye hoḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams lha// 'gro 'dul sman rgyal rtsa gsum skur ston dang // rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam rnal 'byor sogs// dbang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol// bdag gis sngon 'das 'khor ba thog med nas// ma rig bag chags 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis// slob dpon sangs rgyas gsung du drang srong sogs// blo bzhag drug dang gzung bya'i dam tshig gnyis// shes gsum phyi yi dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// rdo rje mched lcam bka' 'gal lta ba log/ brdeg btsog rku 'phrog ngan sems gnod sems bsgom// dbang thob lha la sngags dang phyag rgya bcad// bla med theg pa khas blangs dam bca' g.yel// gsang ba bcu sogs gsang mchod dam tshig rnams// dam med la bsgrags mnyam 'dres bla ma bslus// rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// yan lag dag la shes bya'i dam tshig ni// phung po 'byung ba yum dbang ye shes lnga// spyad bya sbyor sgrol ma byin rdzun tshig lnga// mi spong chags 'khro /khro rmongs rgyal phrag dog lnga// dang blang dri chen dri chu dmar chen dang // byang sems gnyis te nyer lnga'i dam 'gal bshags// bla ma'i bka' gcog (bcag theg spangs thun bzhi

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 483yengs// mchog la the tshom mched lcam thugs dkrugs dang // 'gro la brtse bral nyon mongs rang gar spyod// theg pa'i kha 'dzin ches gzhan smad pa dang //gnyid chang le lo'i dbang shor lta spyod gnyis// zung du ma 'brel bsnyen sgrub mtha' ma 'chol// thun mong spyi yi dam 'gal mthol zhing bshags// 'khor 'das chos rnams rang rig byang chub sems//dza/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi rdzogasarim sku gsum rang shar bzhugs so/na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ye// 'dir zab mo rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal gyi rdzogs rim zab mo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying gung /gud du phyung ba 'di/lus lha skur 'char ba rtsa sbyong ba'i khrid// ngag sngags su 'char ba rlung sbyong ba'i khrid// sems chos skur 'char ba thig le sbyong ba'i khrid gsum las/dang po la phyi lha sku/ nang stong ra/ gsang ba rtsa 'khor gsal gdab par bya ste/rang phag mo/ spyi bor bla ma yab yum nang phru ma phus btab pa'am dar dmar gyi gur khang phub pa lta bu'am/ so sen ba spu'i khung tshun stong sang nge / dmar yang nge/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba gsal bar bskyed// de'i lus kyi dkyil drang por/ rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba 'od kyi rang bzhin mda' smyug gam/ sba lcag tsam khong stong ka ba btsugs pa ltar/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du tal (dal gyis zug par bsam/ de la rtsa'i 'dab ma gyes tshul ni/ spyi bor sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin par bcu drug snying gar brgyad/lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gdugs kyi yu ba la rtsib ma zug pa'i tshul du drang shad de zug pa thams cad kyi nang stong pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can bsam/ de'i g.yas g.yon du rtsa ro rkyang gnyis smyug rid (ring lta bu/ kha dog dmigs

484 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigayul du gang bde la yar sne spyi bo nas gug ste sna bug gnyis la zug mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi dbu ma la zug pa yi ge cha'i dbyibs can bsam/ dbu ma'i yar snang /snar khams byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dngul chu g.ya' dang bral ba'am/ mu tig dri med lta bu bde ba'i rang bzhin can dkar 'od 'tsher zlum 'dril ba sgong lta bu'i dbyibs can bsam/ lte 'og sor bzhi rtsa gsum 'dus mdo'i nang du/ a shad gtum mo'i me kha dog rgya skag gi me tog ltar dmar ba/ 'od til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ reg bya lcags sreg dmar po las tsha ba/ dbyibs zangs kyi mo khab ltar phra ba/ rtse mo spu rtse rlung bskyod ltar myur bar khyug khyug 'bar ba sor bzhi tsam bsgom/ rlung kha sbyor bzung bas ro rkyang gnyis rgyu ma phus btab pa ltar ta ra ra song / lte 'og gi sum mdor me la sib kyis thim pas/ me sngar bas brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis cher song /de'i tsha ngar spyi bo'i byang sems kyis ma bzod par/ mar la nyi ma phog pa ltar zhu la khad thigs la khad du song bas/ bde lhan lhan mer mer phril phril skyes par bsam/ de'i dus su lus gnad tsog pu lus 'khyud la rkang pa bsnol/sgal pa bsrang / mgrin pa dgug dpung pa brgyang / lce ya rkan la cung zad sbyar/ mig nam mkha' la 'gyur med bgrad/ lag pa mnyam gzhag (bzhag3lte 'og tu btsir la/ thun bzhir brgya las mi nyung ba bsgom/ thun mtshams su rtsa mdud thams cad grol zhing / gegs sel bogs 'don gyi 'khrul 'khor zab mo bya ste/ sdom tshig ni/ dang po rtsa nang rlung ro sbyang // g.yas dang g.yon dang mdun gsum du// 'jam ring rdzogs pa gsum gsum 'bud// de nas dal bus rngub byas la// lte 'og mnan zhing thur sel 'then// dang po lus kun khyab par 'phur// de nas rked pa g.yas g.yon bskor// ro stod g.yas gcu g.yon gcu byas// mgo bo bskor zhing lag pa sprug/ rkang pa brkyang bskum drag tu bya// 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams re re la// chun bton

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 485dar drag yun ring 'bad// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin bskyed// rtsa zug rlung zug ldang gyur na// 'bebs chung 'bebs bstan tshad ldan la/ dmigs pa rlung sbyor gong ltar la// lag gnyis langs te nam mkhar 'phyar// spyi 'go 'bebs brten steng nyid du// shugs can stobs dang dus gcig tu// lag gnyis pus mo'i steng du dgab// langs nas sngar bzhin yang yang rdebs//rlung khug re dang thun re la// ci tsam nus pa 'bad byas nas// thabs lam yon tan ma lus skye// gegs dang bar chad khams 'dus sel// drod la bogs 'don 'khrul 'khor ni// rlung sbyor dmigs pa gong 'dra la// khyad par bdag gzhan snang ba kun// me dpung rab tu 'bar bar bsgom// lus 'di tsog pur 'dug byas te// rkang gnyis bsnol ba'i mthe bong la lag gnyis bsnol nas g.yas g.yon bzung // mig gnyis bar snang dkyil du gtad// rked par g.yas skor g.yon skor ni// chun ldan drag tu bya ba gces//lus drod me bzhin 'bar bar 'gyur// thig le 'chor ba 'dzin pa'i gnad//rlung ni phyi ru rdzogs par phu// thub tshad 'dar phril mnan par bya// de dang dus gcig lag pa gcig/ kha sbub phyir bkan gshog ltar brkyang // shugs ldan mun rtsal thig le zin// rlung de ma thub nang 'jug tshe// rdzogs par rngub la de ma thag/ hūṃ ring dbugs kyis khyol chod pa// dril bu'i sgra 'dra nyer gcig sdud// de dus lus gnad rkang pa brkyang // gshibs pa'i mthe bong lag gnyis 'then// tshang ra rgyab 'phul lus kun ni// thang sha bcad la mgo yang dgug/ 'dren la 'di las zab pa med// de rjes kha sbyor rlung bzung la//seng ge rnam grol byas pas khrems// rjes la rlung bzung lus rgyab 'phur//zhes pa rnams phyag len ltar bya'o// skabs su ni dbu ma gsal btab la/lus kyi rtsa thams cad zug par bsams nas/ me dpung dang bstun te lus sbyong bya/ skabs su stong ra dang me dmigs bsgoms la/ lus sbyong bya/

486 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigaskabs su rtsa dbu ma dang po rta rnga tsam gsal btab nas rlung bzung bas/ gro sog mda' smyug sba lcag lag ngar/ zho 'dod /mdong tsam sogs rim gyis je cher song / lus kyi nang gang / de nas je cher rgya cher nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsams pa'i ngang las rlung bzung / 'di rnams nyams su blangs pas lus kyi gar khyab cos khyab/ rtsa thams cad kyi mdud pa rang sar grol ba'i nang du/ tshig ma med pa'i byang sems kyi bdud rtsis gang nas/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog thams cad zag med bde bar shar/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob ste/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char bas gsang sngags bla med kyi khyad chos mthar thug pa'o// de rnams kyi lus lha skur 'char ba rtsa sbyong ba'i khrid tshar ro//gnyis pa ngag sngags su sbyor ba rlung gi rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ las dang po pas rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas pa zhi ba la bslab pa/ cung zad goms pas bar rlung dang bum can la bslab pa/ goms stobs che ru song nas/drag rlung gi sbyor ba bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ mun khang shin tu nag pa/ khang pa mthongs su dkar cha mi mngon pa'i gseng bug dang ldan par stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi stegs bu sor bzhi pa'i steng du dpyi 'go phab/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bya/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur brla khug gi snying rtsa non par btsir/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ mgrin pa cung zad dgur/ dpung pa phyir 'gyed/ gru mo rtsib logs la sbyar/ lag pa thang sha chod par brgyangs/ mig gnyis smin mtshams su mtho gang tsam gzhal ba'i thad ku'i nam mkha' la mig 'bras mi 'gul/ rdzi ma mi g.yab par hrig ger bltas la/ dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa yid la mi bya bar/ zhag bdun las mi nyung bar gnas par bya ba ni sngon du 'gro ba'o// de nas lus gnad lta stangs de'i ngang nas/rang gi dbugs sna nang du 'jug pa/ oṃ yig dkar po dung gi phreng ba lta bu

486 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigaskabs su rtsa dbu ma dang po rta rnga tsam gsal btab nas rlung bzung bas/ gro sog mda' smyug sba lcag lag ngar/ zho 'dod /mdong tsam sogs rim gyis je cher song / lus kyi nang gang / de nas je cher rgya cher nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsams pa'i ngang las rlung bzung / 'di rnams nyams su blangs pas lus kyi gar khyab cos khyab/ rtsa thams cad kyi mdud pa rang sar grol ba'i nang du/ tshig ma med pa'i byang sems kyi bdud rtsis gang nas/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog thams cad zag med bde bar shar/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob ste/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char bas gsang sngags bla med kyi khyad chos mthar thug pa'o// de rnams kyi lus lha skur 'char ba rtsa sbyong ba'i khrid tshar ro//gnyis pa ngag sngags su sbyor ba rlung gi rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ las dang po pas rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas pa zhi ba la bslab pa/ cung zad goms pas bar rlung dang bum can la bslab pa/ goms stobs che ru song nas/drag rlung gi sbyor ba bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ mun khang shin tu nag pa/ khang pa mthongs su dkar cha mi mngon pa'i gseng bug dang ldan par stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi stegs bu sor bzhi pa'i steng du dpyi 'go phab/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bya/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur brla khug gi snying rtsa non par btsir/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ mgrin pa cung zad dgur/ dpung pa phyir 'gyed/ gru mo rtsib logs la sbyar/ lag pa thang sha chod par brgyangs/ mig gnyis smin mtshams su mtho gang tsam gzhal ba'i thad ku'i nam mkha' la mig 'bras mi 'gul/ rdzi ma mi g.yab par hrig ger bltas la/ dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa yid la mi bya bar/ zhag bdun las mi nyung bar gnas par bya ba ni sngon du 'gro ba'o// de nas lus gnad lta stangs de'i ngang nas/rang gi dbugs sna nang du 'jug pa/ oṃ yig dkar po dung gi phreng ba lta bu

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 487dkar nar gyis byung / snying gar sleb ma thog tu a yig byu ru'i mdog ltar gyur/ phyir rgyu ba'i tshe hūṃ yig bee ḍūrya'am mthing bzang po'i phreng ba ltar sngo khyug ge song / nang du zhugs pa dang gnas pa sogs sngar ltar dmigs te/zhi ba rdor bzlas zhag ci rigs par nyams su blangs pas/ ro rkyang nas rgya ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i rtags su du ba dang smig rgyu dang / srin bu me khyer la sogs pa'i rtags bcu 'char bar 'gyur zhing /mthar goms pa na/ dbu mar zhugs nas brtan par 'char bar 'byung ste/rang gi ye shes mngon sum du mthong bar byed do// de la cung zad goms pa na bar rlung la bslab ste/ lus gnad lta stangs sngar dang 'dra ba la/ dmigs pa ni sngar ltar/ phyi rnal 'byor ma/ nang stong ra/ de'i dbus su dbu ma ro rkyang a shad kyi me dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ 'og sgo'i rlung rgyab phyogs su gyen la 'then na/ lte ba man gyi rlung mdun phyogs su phul ba thun bzhi dang /spyod lam rnam pa thams cad du sbyang bas drod sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing / khyad par khams 'dzin pa dang 'dren 'grems pa la dbang thob par 'gyur/ bum can la bslab pa ni/ lus gnad lta stangs sngar ltar la/dmigs pa ni nang gi me lce de lte ba'i thad ka bar ta le 'bar/ me tsha ba'i ngar gyis spyi bo'i byang sems de rang dbang med par bde ba'i rang bzhin du zhu/thigs pa mu tig lta bu dkar kreng kreng chad me'i steng du sor sgra dang bcas pa lhung / de lhung ba tsam gyis me tsha ru song / me tsha ba tsam gyis thigs pa mang du 'dzag de 'dzag pa tsam gyis lus sems bzod glags dang / tshugs thabs med pa'i bde ba phril li li skyes par bsams nas/ rlung ro bsal/ phyir rdzogs nas kyang nang du mi rngub par mnan/ dmigs pa de lte 'og tu gtad/phyi ru mnan mi bzod cing 'pho bar gyur pa na/ nang du dal bus si ri ri rngub/shugs rdzogs pa dang mchil ma thigs pa gcig dang sbrags te/ lte 'og tu hril

488 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagyis mnan/ cung zad ma goms bar du 'og rlung 'then pa sngas na rlung log ldang bas steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung so la bzhag pa gnad yin/ drod cung zad skyes nas steng rlung mnan tshar ba dang 'og rlung yang bskum ste/ rlung stong thog kha sbyar bzung mi thub pa dang dmigs pa me la gtad nas song gis btang / phyir ci thub mnan/ mi thub nges pa dang nang du dal bus rngub/thun 'jog khar lus sbyong bya/ de lta bu thun re la brgya las mi nyung bar bya'o//goms stabs brtan du song nas/ bum can tha ma tsam khegs shing / rlung log sogs kyi 'phrang las grol nas/ drag por gcun pas yon tan myur du skye ba ni/ lus gnad gong du bshad pa'i me thab drug chings byas nas/ dmigs pa lus kyi phyi rje btsun ma/ nang stong pa me'i rang bzhin/ dbus su dbu ma g.yas g.yon ro rkyang / rtsa 'khor rim par gsal btab/ dmigs pa ma gsal bar du rlung mi bzung / dmigs pa yang dang po thams cad lam pa zhig bsgoms nas/ dngos gzhi gang 'dod pa'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus las ma yengs rtse gcig tu dril shes pa dang / phal cher rtsa gsum 'dus mdor ma yengs par sems gtad pa shin tu gces pa'i gnad yin no// de'ang bde ba shas chung na me lte ba/ snying ga spyi bo'i bar du spar zhing / spyi bo'i haṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun rtsa 'khor rnams la rim gyis babs shing / lus thams cad du bal la snum thim pa bzhin yongs su khyab/ drod bde ba lhan lhan/phril phril/ 'bol 'bol/ mer mer/ chil chil skyes/ bde ba'i ros sems myos/ brgyal la khad du bsam/ de'ang drod rtags phyi ma ma skyes par lte ba'i me lce ring du mi gtong / dmigs skor snga ma la ma 'dris par phyi ma la mi spo/me lce ring du spar ba'i tshe yang sor bzhi las ring du btang na gegs ldang /yon tan skye ba bul lo// drod la bogs chung na phyi nang snod bcud thams cad bskal ba'i me dpung chen por dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsams pa'i ngang

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 489nas/ lte 'og tu lcags sreg tsha tsha 'phro ba sgo nga tsam zhig las/ mar me tsam zhig kha dog lnga skyes/ rtse mo spu rtse rlung gis bskyod pa ltar khyug khyug 'bar ba/de'i 'od kyis lus tshig pa tsam drod che lam lam 'ur 'ur skyes par dmigs nas rlung kha sbyar nas/ sngar bshad pa'i 'khrul 'khor thun bzhir 'bad pas/bde drod bla na med pa dang po skye/ bar du brtan/ mthar dbang thob par gyur la/ drod bogs 'bon 'di ma gtogs pa/ dmigs pa 'di rnams thams cad la rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud/ phyir ci thub mnan/ ma thub pa dang nang du rdzogs par rngub ste/ lte bar skyur/ 'og rlung 'then/ g.yas g.yon dbus su bcag rked pa bskor/ ro stod gcu/ lus thams cad si li li sprugs/ nam mkha' la 'phar zhing brdab/ de nas ma thub pa dang sangs kyis phyir phud cal ci thub mnan/ ngal ma gsos pa sngar ltar bskyal/ thun re re la brgya tshar re bya/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye zhing / gang skyes thams cad la chags zhen med pa gnas lugs kyi ngang nas bskyangs pas bcos min sems kyi ngo bo/gdod ma'i ye shes rang chas su zhugs pa'i ngo bo rjen par shes par 'gyur ro//'byung lnga'i rlung dbang thob pas/ zad pa zil gnon nus shing / sems la dbang bsgyur bas spyan dang mngon shes 'char/ nang du dwangs ma brtan pas khams kyi zas la sred pa spangs/ lus la bde drod 'bar bas/ gos kyi 'dun pa bral/ zhen pa rang logs su 'gro bas/ tshe 'di la blo mi 'juganyams rtogs 'khor yug tu 'char bas mnyam gzhagatubazhag rjes thob 'dres/rgas dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa spang zhing bkrag mdangs yang rtsal rgyas pas mthong tshad kyi snying du sdug rnam rtog rang dbang 'dus pas lha 'dre mi gsum bran du 'khol/ 'du ba rang sar snyoms pas tsha grang gi nad mi 'byung / rdos /gdos bcas rang sar dag pas/ 'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub par 'gyur ro//

490 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'adi dag ni lam thams cad kyi rmang rdo'am/ dngos gzhi yin pas 'khor ba la zhe sun cing / tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ shi gson med par 'bungs la sgoms shig sgoms shig gtum mo bsgom pa'i tshe drod skye bul ba'am/ rnal 'byor pa sgom sran chung ba'am/ gos dkon pa rnams la/ rdzas kyi gtum mo mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa zab mo ni/ g.yag rog po dar sgang shi ma thag gi mkhris pa drod ma yal ba'i nang du/ drod sman pho ba ris khyor gang blugs la skam pa dang / bod sga/ pi pi ling khyor ba phyed phyed/ shing tsha thun gsum/ sug spel/ ka ko la/ shu dag rgya tsha/ ze tsha/ kha ru tsha/ sngo lce tsha'i me tog dbyi mong lo ma'i khaṇḍa/ spru ma'i 'bru/ dzā ti rnams thun re re/ go bo'i pho ba'am sha gang rnyed/ spyang ki'i mkhris pa'am sha bya rgod kyi mkhris pa'ang rnyed na rab/ 'di rnams rtsi bzhin 'thag a rag bzang po dang bu ram sbyangs pas ril bu lug ril tsam dril/ dgos dus su rdog po re chang bzang ngam/ a rag gis phul la bsten/ 'di rgyun du bsten na grang ba'i nad gzhi yul 'bud/ zhag bdun bsten na ras phud/ zla gcig bsten na lo gcig drod brtan no// smi:lus me dpung bzhin du 'bar bar 'gyur ro// glo bur du ras 'bud pa'am/ kha ba gshags dgos pa byung na/ phyi nas drod skyes pa'i rdzas ni/sman sga skya ma rul ba/ drod sman hril 'jong gnyis khyor ba re/ g.yer ma khyor ba phyed/ ze tsha thur 'go gsum/ lan tshwa thur 'go gang / shing tsha bzang po mtheb tshigs tsam gcig btsan dug mtheb chen tsam gcig 'di rnams zhib par btags/ a rag gam chang snying (rnying khu ba gar mo dang gar sla zho tsam sbyar/ snod bzang por blugs nas/ zhag gcig dros par bsnyal/ de nas lus chang gis bkrus te/ dbang po'i bu ga dang / rmen pa yod sar mi byug gzhan lus khyab par byug de bskams pa dang / mar rnying gis bsku

490 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thiga'adi dag ni lam thams cad kyi rmang rdo'am/ dngos gzhi yin pas 'khor ba la zhe sun cing / tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ shi gson med par 'bungs la sgoms shig sgoms shig gtum mo bsgom pa'i tshe drod skye bul ba'am/ rnal 'byor pa sgom sran chung ba'am/ gos dkon pa rnams la/ rdzas kyi gtum mo mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa zab mo ni/ g.yag rog po dar sgang shi ma thag gi mkhris pa drod ma yal ba'i nang du/ drod sman pho ba ris khyor gang blugs la skam pa dang / bod sga/ pi pi ling khyor ba phyed phyed/ shing tsha thun gsum/ sug spel/ ka ko la/ shu dag rgya tsha/ ze tsha/ kha ru tsha/ sngo lce tsha'i me tog dbyi mong lo ma'i khaṇḍa/ spru ma'i 'bru/ dzā ti rnams thun re re/ go bo'i pho ba'am sha gang rnyed/ spyang ki'i mkhris pa'am sha bya rgod kyi mkhris pa'ang rnyed na rab/ 'di rnams rtsi bzhin 'thag a rag bzang po dang bu ram sbyangs pas ril bu lug ril tsam dril/ dgos dus su rdog po re chang bzang ngam/ a rag gis phul la bsten/ 'di rgyun du bsten na grang ba'i nad gzhi yul 'bud/ zhag bdun bsten na ras phud/ zla gcig bsten na lo gcig drod brtan no// smi:lus me dpung bzhin du 'bar bar 'gyur ro// glo bur du ras 'bud pa'am/ kha ba gshags dgos pa byung na/ phyi nas drod skyes pa'i rdzas ni/sman sga skya ma rul ba/ drod sman hril 'jong gnyis khyor ba re/ g.yer ma khyor ba phyed/ ze tsha thur 'go gsum/ lan tshwa thur 'go gang / shing tsha bzang po mtheb tshigs tsam gcig btsan dug mtheb chen tsam gcig 'di rnams zhib par btags/ a rag gam chang snying (rnying khu ba gar mo dang gar sla zho tsam sbyar/ snod bzang por blugs nas/ zhag gcig dros par bsnyal/ de nas lus chang gis bkrus te/ dbang po'i bu ga dang / rmen pa yod sar mi byug gzhan lus khyab par byug de bskams pa dang / mar rnying gis bsku

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 491mnye 'phur sub byas na lus drod kyi phung bor 'bar zhing / nub re la ras rlon dgu dgu bskam par 'gyur nus shing / shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa yin no// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ gtum mo kho na bsgom pa la dge sbyor gyi mthil bya/ gos ras rkyang bsten/ tha ma yang zhag re la rlung theb brgya re ma chags par bsgom/ gzhan spyod lam thams cad du bar rlung ma chags par bzung ba la brten nas/ rlung bcu zin pa'i yon tan yar 'phel du son pa'i rmi lam 'od gsal sgyu lus sogs kyi rtsal rang 'byangs zhar byung du 'byung la/'on kyang myur du drod tshad zin pa'i phyir/ gnad zab mo'i nyams len no//thun mtshams su nyin mo'i snang ba zas za ba dang / gos gyon pa dang / 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug gi spyod lam thams cad du/ nga gnyid du song 'dug rmi lam yin nges snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dung dung (dungs dungs pa btang nas rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam pa dang ngag tu 'ang bzlas/ nub nyal khar mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gyi lte bar/ padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar/gu ru snang mtha' rig pa'i ye shes yab yum tshon gang ba'i thugs kur/ a yig byu ru'i mdog can gcig bsam/ 'dab ma bzhi la a nu ta ra bzhi kha dog gang bde langs nas yod par bsams/ yum gyi bde bas mchod/ snying nas dung /dungs ba'i gsol ba btab nas/ bdag rmi lam zin par byin gyis rlobs/ rmi lam la rmi lam du zin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rmi lam sprul sgyur 'byongs pa/ rmi lam yang spangs shing de kho na nyid gtan la phebs par/ zhar brjod pas/ bla ma yab yum gyi sku las 'od dmar po nyi ma shar ba lta bu byung / rang gi lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od dmar pos gang / phyir 'phros snod gzhal yas khang dang / bcud lha dang lha mor byin gyis brlabs/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la mnyes mchod phul/ tshur 'dus rang gi bla ma'i thugs kur thim/ a 'od dang bkrag

492 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigamadangasagazi brjid cher song ba'i ngang la khab mig la skud pa 'dzud pa ltar/rig pa rtse gcig tu gtad/ gnyid du thib thib 'gro khar rmi lam yin ngos zin par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa lan nyer gcig tsam bya/ dran pas 'dzin bzhin par gnyid pas zin par 'gyur ro// gal te ma zin na/ bdag mos gus zhan/ sgrib pa mthug dran 'dun rtsol ba chung bas lan/ da ni cis kyang zin par bya'o snyam du rang nyid gnad la dbab/ gsol ba mchi ma 'khrugs pa snying nas gsol ba mang du btab la sngar ltar nyal/ de 'dra lan 'gas ma zin na/ bla ma rnams spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor dbus su dmigs pa spros pas zin/ zin 'phro la sad na/mig kha ma phye bar dmigs pam yengs pa'i ngang du glod bzhag pas sad 'byams las grol bar 'gyur ro// de ltar zin pa la brtan pa thob nas/ sbyangs spel bsgyur ba sogs kyi gnad zab mo ni/ de nas rmi lam nam 'dod zin pa 'gyur zhing / rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes pa'i nges shes brtan pa dang / nyin par nga gnyid du song 'dug da lta'i snang ba 'di gang bsgyur du btub dgos snyam pa'i bsam pas/ me dang chu dang g.yang sa rnams la rmi lam gyi mes mi tshig chus mi khyer/ g.yang la mi lhung snyam nas/ de rnams la thogs rdugs med par bsres par bsams/ de nas gcan gzan dang 'dre srin la sogs gang la'ang de dang 'dra bar sems pa'i 'dun pa drag po bar ma chad du bsgom zhing / nyal khar sngar gyi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag nas gnyid du log pa dang / rmi lam zin pa'i dus nyin par sbyangs pa ltar rtsal sbyang ngo // de bzhin du nyin par phyi nang snod bcud kyi dngos po gang mthong gang snang / 'di rmi lam ma yin/ rmi lam la gang byas btub snyam du bsams nas/ chu me ru bsgyur nas/ me chu ru bsgyur ba sogs/ gang dang gang gi gnas lugs de las/ dngos po gzhan rigs mi gcig pa brgya stong du mar bsgyur ba dang /

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 493skad cig re re bzhin du'ang sems can gang mthong yi dam lhar bsgom pa dang /de'ang gcig las grangs med du sprul pa dang / gdon 'dul ba la rgyal po la rta mgrin/ gza' la phyag rdor/ klu la nā ga rakta sogs/ rang rang gi gnyen por bsgoms nas btul/ gdon gyi rmi lam la yang / khyi la spyang ṣka/ spyang ki la stag stag la seng ge la sogs dang / gzhan yang dud 'gro gang mthong ba de nyid kyi gnyen por gang 'gro bsgoms nas 'dul zhing / zhing khams gang 'dod blta ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la chos nyan pa dang / nyi zlar zhon nas gling bzhir blta ba sogs/ gang dang gang mthong bar 'dod pa de dang /der bya ba la sogs su sprul nas phyin par bsams la blta/ de la ma gsal na/rang gi mal sa de nyid gang blta ba 'dod pa der bsams nas dran 'dun drag po btang / nyal khar sngar gyi dmigs pa la sems gtad nas/ dang por blos bcos pa'i don spyi'i tshul cig car yang goms par byas pas rim gyis je gsal je gsal song nas/ mthar ji lta ba bzhin du gtan la phebs /phabakashing / rmi lam zin yang sprul bsgyur gyi rtsal chung ba ni/ rlung nus chung bas lan no// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ rlung rtsol la rtse gcig 'bad pa gal che/ nyal kha'i dmigs pa gang gtod kyi sar/ rlung sems kha sbyor dril nas 'dzin pa dang / sa 'og tu 'dzul ma thub na/ rlung thams cad thur du phud nas gcun pa dang / nam mkha' la gyen du 'phur ma nus na/ rlung sems gyen du gcun/'phred la 'phur ma thub na rlung sems thad kur gcun pa yang zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa'o//'od gsal gyi gdams pa ni/ gzhan dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ba las/snying gi rtsa 'khor dbus su padma 'dab bzhi dbus dang lnga'i lte bar/ nyi gdan la gu ru rdor sems sman rgyal rig pa'i ye shes/ yab yum mthing gsal tshon gang pa'i thugs kur hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od bcas bsam/ 'dab ma bzhi la a

494 ༄zagayu thog snying thiganu tar 'od bcas bsam/ 'od gsal zin par gsol ba btab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ snod bcud la phog thams cad sngon por zhu/thugs kur thim/ 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la mnyes mchod bul/ 'od sngon por zhu/ rang gi thugs kur thim nas/ sems phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos pa'i ngang nas/ hūṃ la sems gtad nas nyal bas/ gnyid srab mthug gang la'ang nyin par dge sbyor rtsis sleb pa la 'od gsal zin pa zer/ de nyin zin brtan goms 'dris byas te/ mtshan mo'i rmi lam snang ba nyin mo'i dge sbyor dang bsre/ nyin mo'i dge sbyor rmi lam dang bsre/ de bzhin sang bar do'i 'od gsal dang bsre'o// sems ngo rjen par 'phrod/ gang shar nyams len du 'khyer shes/ de nyid 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi chos sku dang / chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur bsre ba ni/ 'chi ba'i dus su tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad rim gyis 'gags/ bar do'i snang ba ma shar bar du/dud pa lta bu sngo bun bun pa dang / smig rgyu lta bu sngo phrig phrig pa dang / srin bu me khyer ltar dmar tsig tsig pa dang / me 'bar ba ltar dmar lam pa'i snang ba 'byung / de rnams ni sa chu me rlung gcig la gcig thim rtags yin la/rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i dus su thams cad stong pa 'od gsal chos kyi sku gsal stong / nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil lta bu/ blo las 'das shing ngos gzung med pa/ rgyal yum kun tu bzang mo'i dgongs pa mngon sum du 'char bas/ de ngos zin par bya'o// ngos zin pa tsam gyis de nyid du grol lo//lar nyin par gyi dge sbyor rmi lam du mi sleb na/ bar do'i dge sbyor gyis sleb pa re thag chad pas/ nyin mtshan ci 'dres byed dgos te/ lam chod rmi lam gyis 'dzin thag chod pas ston zhes gsungs so//sgyu lus kyi gdams pa ni/ gnas dben sar sems bskyed/ sgyu lus 'byong ba gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/ me long du rang gi gzugs 'char du

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 495bcug la/ de la bstod smad bsnyen bkur 'phrog bcom brdung bsad la sogs pa'i stangs ka mang du byas pas/ mi (me long gi gzugs de la dga' mi dga' med/ de bzhin du chos brgyad kyi snang ba thams cad sems kyi rang gzugs kho na las gzhan du rdul tsam ma grub ste/ rmi lam gyi snang ba'am/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis rdel bu shing bu la sngags btab nas/ mi bden bzhin du sprul pa ltar/ snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med snyam du bsam/ sgyu mas sprul pa'i skyes bu la/ sgyu ma'i bstod smad byas pa la/ sgyu ma'i chags sdang byed don mi 'dug pa la/ sngar 'khrul 'dugad ni chos thams cad bden med yin/ sgyu ma yin snyam dran 'dun drag po 'khor yug tu btang / de rmi lam dang bsre/ de nyid sang bar do dang bsre dgos la/ sgyu ma snang ba rmi lam dang 'dres pa/ de brtan nam brtag pa'i phyir phyogs ris med pa'i rgyal khams 'grims la/ tsha grang skyid sdug gi snang ba shar ba la/ chags sdang rang tshan pa skye mi skye/ de la 'dzin pa zhugs ma zhugs brtag skabs su tho co'i spyod pa smyon pa ltar byas la/ mi rnams kyis phya /'phya smod dang / brdung brtag tubardeg lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul/ lus kyi na tsha sogs gang la yang chags sdang bden zhen med pa snang la 'dzin med du phyam phyam du 'gro na/ de nyid kyi rang rtsal sbyang zhing / gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos thams cad la bzang ngan spang blangs med pa sgyu ma lta bu shar na 'byangs pa yin/ chags sdang gi ror (bor shor na ri khrod dben sar phyin nas sngar ltar du bsgom/ bogs 'don pa la yul gyi ltad mo sna tshogs blta/dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro na gang yang bya zhing / gong du 'phel ba la gnod bya gang yang mi bya bar ri khrod du stan dang ma bral bar bsgom pa kho na gal che'o//bogs chung na rlung nus chung ba lan pas/ rlung 'jam tsub kyi sbyor ba la 'bung ba gal dang gnad che'o//

496 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigabar do'i gdams pa ni/ nyin par gyi snang ba thams cad srid pa bar do'i snang ba yin snyam du yid la bsam/ ngag tu brjod/ de rmi lam dang bsres la rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad kyang bar do yin pas 'dzin sbyong spel bsgyur bya/ khyad par nyi ma zla ba'i 'od med par rlung 'od zer lnga'i lam dang /lus dngos po gang la'ang thogs rdugs med par/ nyi zhur la lag pa g.yug pa ltar thal thal 'gro ba dang / res 'ga' zad mi shes pa'i mun par 'gro ba dang / tshud pa dang / res snang ba thams cad za 'og kha phye ba ltar bkra lam lam 'char ba dang / gang bsam pa yud kyis sleb pa dang / mgo brnyan gzugs kha dog mi 'dra ba'i zhi khro lha 'dre mang po mthong ba dang / ris gnon snyam byed pa dang / chus khyer snyam byed pa dang / nam mkha' la bya sgro rlung gas bskyod pa ltar/ chal chal 'gro ba dang / res 'ga' char rlung drag pos ded pa snyam byed pa dang / 'ur sgra chen pos dngangs shing skrag pa byung ba dang /'jigs shing yid du mi 'ong ba du mas ded pa dang / zag bcas kyi mngon shes 'char ba dang / nye du la sogs rang gas phar mthong lab smras kyang /tshur mig gis mi mthong lab lan mi smra ba dang / dri tshor bas zas kyi go chod pa dang / skyid sdug gi snang ba gang 'char thams cad da lta dang mi 'dra bas/ tsha reg grang reg zug rngu 'char nub gzhan las mang ba zhig byung bar bsams la/nga shi ba yin par 'dug srid pa bar do'i snang ba yin par 'dug bar dol bar do ngo shes par bya/ bar do dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par bya/ snyam du bsams nas nyin snang la dge sbyor ngos zin par yi dam lha'i skur ldang bas/phrag dog mig ser spangs nas/ pho mo sbyor ba byed pa mthong tshad thams cad bla ma yab yum du bsgom/ lha khang dang mi'i khang pa brag khung dang shing nags/ne'u gseng la sogs gnas skyid po gang mthong yang zhen chags spang bas/ skye gnas 'dom pa sogs bar dor gang dgos kyi gdams pa rnams/ rang gi

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 497dge sbyor mtho dman dang sbyar ba'i nyams len la rtsal sbyong de rmi lam dang 'dres shing / gdams pa 'di rnams yid la tshig don 'dris par byas pas deng sang bar do tshegs med du 'grol ba thob la/ da lta goms 'dris ma byas na/ bar do grol bar mi srid pas/ nyin mtshan 'dres pa'i dge sbyor bya/deng sang bar do ma bsres kyang / rang 'dres su 'gyur bar the tshom med/'pho ba'i gdams pa ni/ rlung cung zad goms pa'i gang zag gis/rang lus rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bo'i (bor bla ma snying gar rta mgrin gsal btab nas/ dril sgrub kyi bzlas pa cung zad bya ba ni sngon 'gro'o// de nas dngos gzhi ni/ sbyang ba dang 'pho ba gnyis las/ sbyang ba ni lus rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor bla ma/ nang stong ra/ dbus su dhū tī zang thal/ 'od kyi sbu gu khong stong ka ba btsugs pa ltar bsgom mo// de'i snying gar sems kyi ngo bo mu tig mig med rdog po gcig tu gyur par bsam/ lus gnad ni/ me thab drug chings sam/ rnam snang chos bdun bya/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum dang sbrag (sbrags nas/ 'byin pa'i dus su sems kyi ngo bo de mda' 'phangs pa lta bu rgyang gis song / spyi bo'i bla ma la thim/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i sku las yungs kur thur du 'dril ba ltar/ dkar hri li li bsam/ snying gar lhan gyis sleb/ gnas pa'i bar snying gar 'od 'phro bar bsam/ de'ang 'byin pa'i man ngag ni/ hi ka ring por dbugs kyis khyol tshad pa brjod/zad khar ka zhes brjod/ rlung phyir mnan/ mig gyen la blta/ rgyu 'bas sbyar/ 'og rlung gyen la ci thub 'then no// ma thub na nang du rdub /rngubakacing / dmigs pa ma yengs par bya'o// de ltar thun re ci nas nyams su blangs pas/ spyi bo spangs sam mgo na/ gtsug tu chu ser 'dzag pa dang / za zhing tsha ba sogs byung na/ zhag re la dmigs pa ma brjed tsam gyis choga'apho ba ni/ rna ba'i 'ur sgra dang / mig btsir ba'i 'od med na/ nges par

498 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thig 'chi bas 'pho zhing / gsod pa'i gshed ma dang 'phrad pa'i rgyal po'i chad pa sogs la/ de'i rtags med kyang 'pho ste/ phyi nang gi chags zhen thams cad spang / lus kyis nas na tsog pu/ mi nus na gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcugamago byang du gtad/ dmigs pa gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba la/ dbugs nang du 'jug tshe thur du 'bab pa de mi bsams par/ snying gar sems kyi ngo bo mu tig mig med gsar ba re gsal btab kyin/ dbugs 'byin tshe bla ma'i sku la bstim pa lan bdun brgyad byas/ rjes sems dang bla ma dbyer med du je mtho je mtho steng phyogs kyi nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i bar song / blo nus zad tshe nam mkha' dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam/ de la 'pho ma nus na/yang yang de ltar gsal btab pas mkha' spyod du the tshom med par 'pho bar 'gyur ro// 'pho ba'i zhal gdams 'phyugs med phyag len ma smi/grong 'jug gi man ngag ni/ steng rlung 'og tu drongs/ 'og rlung gyen du drongs/ khyab byed kyi rlung la rang dbang thob nas nyams su blangs te/ sbyangs pa la las sbyor gnyis so// dang po ni/ yi dam kyi maṇḍal gzhung bzhin bshams pa'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan nang du mthing byugs la sngon por bya/de'i dkyil du dngul lam/ dung brdar ba'i kli yig dkar po skye mched gsal ba gcig bris/ bskyed rim gsal ba'i snying gar hūm̐ gcig gsal btab/rlung phyir phud la rlung dang 'grogs te rnam shes hūṃ gi ngo bo de sna nas rgyangs kyis song thod pa'i hūṃ la thim pas/ de bkrag mdangs gzi 'od rgyas par bsam/ de ltar yang yang byas pas/ rang nyid khams zi tham pa dang / thod pa drod skye/ 'tshag pa dang 'phar ba sogs 'byung / de nas khab sogs dngos po gang rung la dmigs pa gtad/ rlung phyir mnan pas 'phar ba sogs 'byung / de nas sbrang ma dang bya sogs kyi ro ma rul ba la dmigs pa gtad pas 'gul ba byung na/ las la sbyar ba ni ro gtsang ma nad yams dang

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 499gcong yun ring gis shi ba ma yin zhing / rigs rgyud dang ldan pa khrus bya rgyan gdags/ dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag byang sems dkar dmar thigs pa gcig sna bug g.yas g.yon du blugs/ de nas ro dang sna sprad/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas sngar ltar hūṃ song nas/ ro'i snying ga'i hūṃ la thim par bsam pa yang yang byas/ ro la rnam shes 'pho/ grogs kyis lus zungs gso/ ro rnying pa drin bsags pa'i phyir bsreg rdzas bdun tshigs sogs bya'o// smi/gsum pa yid chos skur 'char ba thig le sbyang ba'i khrid la gnyis te/rlung la goms pas nyams su len pa dang / ma goms pas nyams su len pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni dbang thob dam tshig ldan/ bskyed rim gsal/ sems ngo shes bum pa can gyi rlung rab kyi tshad khebs pa'i rnal 'byor pas gyen rgyu dang thur sel bsres pa'i rnal 'byor la bslabs te bya rgod kyi rkang ngam/ smyug ma las byas pa'i sbu gu sor bzhi pa sbom phra mdzub mo tsam 'jam la gsang pa zhig zhun chen dang byi tang ku'i phye ma bsres pa byugs te/ srin po'i lam la gnad sar bzhugs/ lus gnad me thab drug chings bya/ dmigs pa ni phyi rje btsun ma/ nang stong ra/ dbus su dhū tī 'od kyi sbu gu mda' smyug tsam/ phyi gsal nang gsal/ spyi bo tshangs bug nas gsang gnas kyi bar du zang thal du drang por zug pa'i yar mar gyi sna bug pa ha re yod par bsam/ de nas snod bcud thams cad 'od ltar ltem gyis zhu/ tshur 'dus gsang gnas kyi rtsa bug nas zhugs/ spyi bor rtsa bug nas rgyun mi chad par/ khra bun nu nu thon nas 'gro bar dmigs nas rgyu zhabs sgal ba la sbyar/ lus nywa bzhi bsgrim/ mig gyen du ci nus bgrad/ 'og rlung thub tshad 'then/ steng rlung sna bug nas drag tu bus te/ phyir tsam chags mnan/ mnan mi bzod mgo 'dar zhing khams zi khyoms pa na nang du rngub ste/ snod bcud thams cad 'od lngar zhu/spyi bo nas zhugs/ gsang gnas kyi bu ga nas sa gzhi'i gting thug bar khra

500 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabun nu nu 'gro bar bsam pa la/ mig thur du bgrad/ lus kyi phyi nang gi rlung thams cad thur du shed yod tshad mnan/ 'og rlung sgra bcas su shor yang mi skyon no// de ltar thun bzhir 'bad nas sbyangs pas/ 'og rlung bskum dus sna sgor thur sel gyi dri ma mnam/ steng rlung mnan dus sna nas spos dri rngubs pas/ 'og sgor mnams na 'byongs pa yin no// de nas lus gnad rlung sbyor dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ba las/ lcam pa'i spu gu myu gu mtho gang / rdo rje'i sbubs su sor bzhi tsam bcug rlung gyen du 'then tshe nang du nub pa dang / thur du mnan tshe phyir rgyangs kyis 'gro na bde rlung 'byongs pa yin/de nas rab rma bya'i sgro rkang / 'bring lcags kyi sbu gu/ tha ma smyug ma'am/ shing lha ba can gyis nang gi lha ba bton pa la rgyu byas/ ring thung mtho gang / sbom phra gro sog tsam/ 'jam la gsang ba bya ste/ nang du rgyus pa'i skud pa drangs/phyir bton pa de khar bldad la/ spu gu'i kha la bkram/ gsang gnas su bcug la/ rgyus pa bton/ sbu gu bzhag la/ rlung mnan pas gsang sgor spu 'gul na 'byongs pa yin/ 'o ma rang gi sha drod tsam bsros la snod par bu lta bu la/ snod kyi kha rdo rje shong tsam du blugs/ mtshams su spra tshil dus /dul/ma'am/ rwa (ra yi nang tshil bldad pas bsdam/ dbugs ma shor ba bya/ de nas rlung ro sngar ltar drangs pas/ 'o ma sna bug tu dkar rgyang rtser drangs pa dang / rlung mar mnan dus sngar gang 'thung gi tshad 'byin pa nas pa ni/steng 'og 'dres pa'i rtags yin pas/ de'i dus su gzhan lus kyi dmar cha len par nus so// brtson 'grus dang ldan na yun ring mi thogs par/rtags 'char ba ni the tshom bral pa'i gdams pa'o// nas pa 'di tsam thob phyin/ rang lus thabs ldan sogs sngon du ma song yang / 'og sgo'i nyams len la 'jug par bya'o// de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rten btsal bar bya ste/ phyag rgya ma padma can sogs rig ma brtag thabs bsam gyis mi khyab

༄7/sdug bsngalamunaselathugasarje'inyi'od/ 501kyang / 'dir bla ma'i zhal gdams snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa ni/ bu mo de'i gzugs mthong ba/ skad thos pa/ dri tshor ba/ lus la reg pa tsam gyis/bde ba khyad par can skye zhing / gsang sngags kyi chos la mos pa/ nyams len can gyi rnal 'byor mthong ba tsam gyis 'dzum pa sogs spro ba'i rnam 'gyur ston na/ rgan gzhon gang yin kyang / nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba'i grogs su bsten par byas la/ mthong thos dran reg la bde ba mi skye zhing / sngags kyi chos blor mi shong na rgan gzhon gang yin yang spang bar bya'o// dam du bya ba yang / gtso bo nang du dkar cha brtan na/ rtsa dang ldan pa'i rig ma rang shugs kyis dbang du 'du ba chos nyid yin la/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gugs pa'ang / sngon gyi las dang smon lam gyi dbang gis dang po mthong ma thag tu/ bde ba'i ngad kyis bltas pas/ 'dzum pa sogs dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang mi ston na/ ji ltar 'bad kyang don mi grub la/ dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston na thabs la mkhas pa gang gis kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro//phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyi 'gros zab mo sgrig mi shes par sgrub pa phran tshegs la zhugs nas man ngag la yi chad byed pa rnams/ go ma chod par rang gis byas nas len tsa yi dam lha la 'ded pa dang 'dra'o// de nas gnas dben par rten de smin par byas la/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'dod pa nyams pas/ yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched lhar gsal/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang padma byin gyis brlabs pa'i bu ga hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis mtshan pa/ dhū tī 'od kyi sbu gu spyi bo na gsang gnas bar zug par bsams pa'i yab kyi yar sna khams dkar po haṃ gis mtshan pa'i ngo bo bde ba'i rang bzhin dngul chu lta bu dkar chi le ba/ yum gyi yar snar drod bde ba dbyer med kyi ngo bo rakta dmar cha byu ru'i rdog po lta bu dmar chi le ba bsam/ de nas chags pa'i me lce lte ba nas 'bar/ snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bor me reg reg thug pas/ khams

502 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadakar dmar la me reg pa lta bur zhu/ me gseb tu thig le'i rgyun bar ma chad par chi li li babs/ de babs pa tsam gyis me lce brgya 'gyur gyis tsha ru song /de song ba tsam gyis khams dkar dmar zhu ste/ lus bde bas mer mer phril phril gang bar bsams nas/ dang po phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta zhing bde ba bsgom/ de nas dri bzang byugs te dri la snom zhing bde ba bsgom/ de nas ka ra bu ram sogs khar 'jibs la lce 'jibs te ro myong zhing bde ba bsgom/de nas chags pa'i gtam dang yid du 'ong ba'i glu dbyangs sogs sgra la nyan cing bde ba bsgom/ de nas gdan gyi steng du gcer bur 'dug la/ nu ma 'phur ba g.ya' za ba'i gnas rnams su reg 'phur sen mo gdab/ 'khur ba drud 'o byed/ lce mchu nu ma 'jibs/ gsang gnas gnyis reg par byas la nang du mi gzhug par g.yas g.yon steng 'og thams cad du khrus drud pa dang /padma'i stod kyi lce yod par rdo rje'i rtse mo'am/ thabs kyi gung mos bsdur bas/rtsa sna myur du rnyed pa'i dgos pa dang rten 'brel yod/ de thams cad la bde ba gang skyes ngos bzung / de'i ngang la mnyam par gzhagatubazhag thig le 'chor ba 'dra na rol rtsed 'phro gzhag 'dzin 'dren 'grem la 'bad/ de ltar zhag kha yar nyams su blangs pas/ yum gyi gdong dmar tshal gyis 'gro zhing / chags pa'i gtam dang rngams pa'i stabs kyis tshig smra/ skad dang lus 'dar/ thabs la tshur 'khyud cing / sbyor ba byed ring ba dang padma las g.ya' chu 'dzag pa na/ phyag rgya sga'i steng du gan rkyal bzhag mkhal khung gnyis su dru bu khu tshur tsam re bzhag dar gyis bsdam/ bshang lam du phying pa 'khru ma dril ba snum la btsos pa rdo rje tsam zhig gzhug de nas padma'i nang du gang mos dkrugs pas/ rtsa sna rno hrud hrud brkyangs nas 'ong / de nyid rdo rje sbu gur btsud nas/ phyir ma shor bar dal bus bsrubs pas/ bde stong gi ye shes rjen par 'char/ de'ang rdo rje nang du zhugs pa dang / bshang lam gyi

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 503phying ba 'byin pa bsgrag cing 'di'i dus su/ rdo rje 'jug pa ma mkhas na/las rgya tshe'i dus byed pa'ang 'byung bas gzabs/ skabs su phyag rgyas spyod/skabs su gnyis kus spyod/ skabs su thabs cig pus spyod/ rus sbal gyi nur 'gros ltar dal bus bya/ bde ba chung na bsrubs/ che na ngal gso zhing /bde ba'i ngo bo ngos zin pa'i ngang la gzhag dbang gi skabs su bshad pa ltar dga' bzhi'i ye shes ngos zin par bya/ 'chor ba 'dra na/ sngar bshad pa'i 'dren 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor bya/ de'ang goms shas chung ba rnams kyis dga' ba gsum pa tsam las dma' ba mi 'bebs/ de'ang bab ma thag tu 'dzin/ bzung ma thag tu 'dren/ drangs ma thag tu 'gram/ 'bebs 'dzin sbrag(sbrags 'dren 'grem sbrag /sbrags so/ cung zad goms pas ni bde ba rdzogs nas bzung ba dang / 'dren 'grem tsho bya/ goms pa thob pas ni padmar phab nas yum gyi dmar cha dang lhan cig tu yang 'dren nus la/ rang gi dkar cha ni/ bde ba'i rtsal rdzogs pa dang / de'i ngang la lhod kyis glod nas/ ngo thog tu bzhag pas/ 'dzin 'dren 'gram /'grem pa 'grub/ nus pa thob pas gzhan gyi dmar cha 'dren/ yum gzhon mdzes ma nad med lang tsho dar la bab cing / rtsa bzang ngan mkhur chos dmar smug sha 'byin dang /khyad par nu ma mkhregs shing / lus drod dang skom dad che ba btsal/ de'i dmar cha zla dus su 'bab pa'i tshe/ dri mi zhim pa bsnams pa dang / kha dog ser nag dkar ba ni 'dren du mi rung / chos khu 'am mtshal khu lta bu 'bab pa'i dus su drangs/ nas pa shin tu che/ khrag 'bab pa'i dus ma yin yang drang du btub/ 'dren dus phyag rgya la/ lcam pa dang g.yer ma'i thang gis lcags phye dang tsan dan dmar po sbrang sbyar ba'i ril bu ded pa zhag gnyis btang / rang nyid khab len bzang po dang / a ru ra gser mdog tsan dan dkar po bu ram sbyar ba'i ril bu chang zhim pos phul la btang / gnyis ka kha
