504 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigazas bzang pos lus zungs bskyed/ de nas bde ba'i rol rtsed du ma bya'o//rtsa kha phye ba dang rdo rje padma'i steng du phul/ yum bde ba'i skad 'tsher ba na/ chu 'thung sbyor ba'i skabs ltar lus gnad lta stangs rlung sbyor ma 'phyugs pa hūm̐ gi sgra dang bcas pas drongs shing rdo rje 'go 'khyog pa dang / lus chi chil gyis 'byung / yum mi bzod pa'i rnam 'gyur byed na 'drongs pas dgram par bya'o//'dren dka' na gsang ba'i sbu gu sngar bshad pa ltar bcug la/ las su rung ba'i rdo rjes/ 'o ma 'dren pa ltar drangs la 'grem par bya'o// mtshan ldan gcig gis dmar cha 'drongs na/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'grub/ lus 'ja' lus su 'gro/ kun bzang gu ru sman rgyal gyi dgongs pa snyigs te/mkha' spyod du skye ba 'di nyid la 'gro bar gdon mi za'o// gnyis pa rlung gi sbyor ba la goms stobs chen po med kyang thabs la mkhas pas 'phral 'phral du rim gyis bslabs nas/ gsum pa'i nyams len la 'jug par bya'o// de'ang dbang thob dam ldan bsnyen sgrub thengs/ lhar gsal sems ngo shes pa'i gang zag tshe blos btang / bla mas ci gsung sgrub pa/ byang chub don du gnyer ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ dben pa'i gnas su thun mong du thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams song nas/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi stegs bu dang ldan pas/lus tsog pu pus 'khyud/ tshigs bsrang / mgrin pa dgug nam mkhar lta bas 'dug lus yi dam/ nang stong ra/ dbus su dhū tī/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar khang stong / zang thal ka ba btsugs pa ltar gsal btab/ yar sna spyi bor dkar cha dngul chu g.ya' bral lta bu/ bde ba'i rang bzhin can ngang chi le ba bsam/ mar sna gsang gnas su dmar cha mtshal cog la ma lta bu drod dmar chi le ba drod kyi rang bzhin bsam/ snying gar rlung sems kyi ngo bo g.yu drug dmar kha dog shin tu legs pa las grub pa'i kli tshon gang ba zhig bsam/ de nas sna bug nas dbugs de phyir 'byin pa'i tshe/ spyi bo'i dkar

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 505cha la phog pas tal gyis song / klad kor des khams dkar cha khab kyi skud pa 'dren pa ltar rang dbang med par drangs/ dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang sbrags nas/ dkar na ra ra bde ba dang bcas par song / gsang gnas kyi dmar cha dang 'dres/ yang dbugs phyir rngub pa'i tshe/ zhabs kyu de'i lcags kyus dmar cha bsdus/ drod dang bcas pa dmar chi li li drangs/ spyi bo'i dkar cha dang 'dres pa las bde ba dpag tu med pa rang skyes pa la sems bskyed/ sems bskyed de'ang dmigs pa smad du gtad pa'i tshe bde bas thig le 'chor ba snyam byed cing / stod du gtad pa'i tshe smad kyi bde nyams yal/stod du bde phril gyis skyes na cung zad 'byongs pa yin pas/ de nas rang rta mgrin du gsal/ mdun du bu mo yid du 'ong ba zhig tu gsal btab nas/phan tshun chags pa'i gtam sna tshogs smra ba dang / blta zhing 'dzum pa la semasagatad/ de la chags pa lam gyis skyes pa dang / rim pa bzhin du 'o dang 'khyud pa nas sbyor ba byed pa'i bar du bsgoms la/ thig le snying ga tsam du phebs pa'i tshe/ sems nam mkha' ltar rgya bskyed pa'i ngang du cir yang mi rtog par lhod kyis glod nas bzhag bde nyams yal ba dang sngar ltar du bsgom/ sems glod pas bde nyams yal dka' zhing badzra zhi bar ma nus na/sngar bshad pa'i 'dren gyi 'khrul 'khor bya/ de rjes seng ge rnam grol gyis dgram mo// bde ba khol bur 'gril ba'i 'dres pa dka' na rlung ro 'phud la phyir mnan/ ma bzod na nang du rngub steng 'og kha sbyar te gan rgyal du 'dug ste/ rkang lag bzhi rang sar bskum zhing thad kur shed dang ldan par shad kyis brkyang ba dang / rgyab bstan kha nas ci thub 'phar/ de ltar brkyang bskum yang yang bya/ rlung mi thub na phyir btang la yun ring mnan/ ma thub na sngar bzhin kha sbyor bzung / 'di ni phyogs 'dril gyis bde ba rang sar 'grem par 'gyur zhing / sngar ma 'grem pa'i gegs yod na gong du bshad pa'i 'bebs

506 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigachen rtsa zug rlung zug thig le'i zug 'dzems par byed pa de la 'bad pas grol bar 'gyur ro// de nas rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i ngo thog tu 'jog pa'i rtsis dang ma bral par/ lag pa'i 'du byed kyis rdo rje dal bus gsor/ mgrin pa tsam du thig le dbab pas yid dga' tung byung ba dang / lhod kyis glod bde ba de ga'i ngang du ma bcos par phyam gyis bzhag ste/ bde ba zhi nas rdo rje cung zad gsor/ mgrin par sleb tshe sngar dang 'dra/ de lta bu'i lan lnga lnga'i mtshams su 'dren 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor gsum gsum bya/ 'di dus mgrin pa las dma' bar mi dbab ste/ zhag bcu/ de nas snying ga tsam phab ste ngang la bzhag bde ngad yal tshe phab la lan gsum gyis bar mtshams su/ 'dren 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor tshar bzhi bzhi bya/ snying ga las dma' ba mi dbab pa zhag bcu/ de nas lte ba tsam phab pa'i ngo thog tu glod/ bde ngad yal tshe phab la lan gnyis gnyis song ba'i mtshams su 'dren 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor lan lnga lnga bya/ de las dma' bar mi dbab pa la zhag bcu/ de nas gsang gnas kyi sbu na gu'i mtshams tsam sleb par phab ma thag tu 'dren 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor tshar bdun bdun byas/ rjes phyag chen la mnyam par bzhag de las dma' ba la mi phab pa la zhag bcu/ de nas rdo rjes rtse mo ru phab nas phyir ma 'phos pa la 'dren 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor tshar gsum bya ste/ nangs par sder ma gtsang mar chu bzhag nas bltas pas/ byang sems dar skud phra mo dang /yungs kur lta bu'am/ yang na dngos su mi mthong yang / shing bus btegs pa na ba thag gi tshul du nar nar byung na thig le ma 'chings pa'i rtags yin pas/ mgrin pa tsam 'bebs pa sogs rim gyis bslab pa'am/ zhag grangs sogs sngar bshad pa ltar bskyar/ rtsa bzang na snga ma'i zhag grangs rnams them pa dang 'ching nus la/ ngan na ma 'chings bar du yang yang 'go nas bskyar la bya'o// 'di la goms nas rig ma rgan pa'am/ bu tsha mang du skyes pa gcig

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 507la blta reg 'o 'khyud byas te/ bde phril byung ma thag tu lhod kyis glod bde ngad yal ba dang / gong ltar bya ba gsum gsum gyi mtshams su 'dren 'grem 'khrul 'khor tshar re bya ba zhag bdun/ de nas rdo rje padma'i kha la reg pa tsam reg bya ba bde ba snying gar phebs te/ sngar las dga' ba na/ de las dma' ba mi dbab pa ngos bzung zhing ngal gso/ bde nyams byung nas padma la reg tsam reg tsam spyod/ de lta bu lan gnyis gnyis kyi mtshams 'dren 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor lan lnga lnga bya ba zhag bdun/ de nas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje padmar bcug la/ rang nyid ngo thog tu bzhag nas phyag rgyas dal bus spyod/ de ltar byang sems phebs sngar bas cher dga' ba'i tshe/ de ma thag tu phyag rgya dang ma bral ba la spyod 'phro bshol/ kli bung ba'i skad tsam kha dang sna phyed ma nas ring du bton te/ ngag gi nas pa ma rdzogs par/ bgrang ba ngal gsos par lan bdun byas pas rdo rje ngar 'chor/ de ma thag tu phyag rgya dang bral te/ 'grem gyi 'khrul 'khor tshar bdun bdun byas te/ rjes phyag chen gyi ngang nas rlung bum pa can tshar gsum gsum bsgom pa zhag bdun/ de nas rdo rje'i rked pa tsam phab ma thag tu hūṃ ring btud ma gsum/ ha ring btud ma gsum brjod de/ rdo rje ngar shi ma thag phyag rgya dang bral la/ 'dren 'grem tshar bdun bya/ rjes phyag chen gyi ngang nas rlung bum pa can tshar lnga bsgom/ nang par chu la byang sems mi 'dzag cing rang lus bde bas khyab/bde yul dran ma thog rdo rje las su rung / 'dren 'grem byas ma thog tu rdo rje ngar 'tshor zhing / bde bas sems tshim par byung na/ phyag rgya ma gzhon mdzes mtshan ldan btsal la/ sgrub pa chen mo rgyun mi 'chad du bya/ chu la byang sems 'dzag pa dang sbyor ba lan 'ga' byas rjes rdo rje las su mi rung / bde nyams mi skyen/ rtsa ngan pa yin pas rang lus kyi skabs sogs 'go nas bskyar/lar rang gi nyams la rang gis 'dres shes pa zhig gal che/ dbang dang rigs

508 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigargyud spel ba gegs sel/ bdud rtsi ril bu rnams kyi dus ma gtogs pa/rnam pa thams cad du thig le yungs 'bru tsam yang ma shor zhing bde nyams gang skyes ngos zin pa gal che/ dbang dus sogs byang sems gtang ba'i dus bzhir srid 'phel gyi dgos na/ rgya tsha/ mdze tsha/ tsha la/ star bu/ lan tshwa/bul tog mtshur nag rnams cha mnyam zhib btags/ sbrang rgod chu bcad pa cung zad tsam gyis 'go bsdus/ ril bu sran chung tsam bya/ skam thag chod pa dang / snod bzang por bcad byang sems pho kha rang du nor bu padma nas byung ba'i bug par ril bu re bcug nas/ padmar phab na srid chags mi srid shin tu zab/ gser zho phyed gtun bzang por rtsi bzhin 'thag de la spyin sran ma tsam zhig dang / chu sgong skogs gang blugs nas/ ma skam bar du gnur/skam pa dang chang bzang po sgong skogs bzhi blugs/ gla tsi thun gcig dngul chu sran ma tsam gcig tshil ma zhig pa btags la btab/ lud tsha mo'i 'og tu zhag gcig mnan/ yakta chad rjes lto stong la byin na gtan du chad/ sems bskyed rnam par dkar pas kun nas blangs te rigs rgyud 'jog na/ phyag rgya dam ldan mdzes gzhon lang tsho dar bab la/ khrag mtshal mdog dri med 'bab pa chad nas zhag bzhi song ba'i dus su/ rang nyid byang sems yun ring du ma nyams par srod la khams ma btang par rgyun ring du spyad pas chu ser gyi snyigs ma phyir 'byin/ tho rangs sems bskyed dang srung 'khor mi rtog pa bsgom/lhar gsal/ yum gyi padma gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ padma nyi zla'i steng yi dam gyi sa bon bsam/ rang gi 'od zer spro bsdus rgyal ba thams cad zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kur bdud rtsir zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas padma'i nang gi yig 'bru de la thim par bsams la bungs bskyed la btang /rjes gzhal yas khang sgo bcad/ khro bos bsrung bar bsam/ 'gro don 'byung ba'i smon lam btab/ yum zas skom bcud can bsten/ spyod lam gzabs/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 509zla ba steng ma'i zla mtshan ma byung na chags pa yin no// rim pa 'og ma 'di ni/sngar rlung gi rnal 'byor dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa la ma goms kyang 'di nyid nyams khrid du bskyangs pas ji bzhin 'dod pas 'grub ste/ dpes mtshon na mtha' chen po'i mthar g.yang sa chen po yod pa'i steng du rta rgyug pa ni thang steng nas g.yang sa ngos su sa mtshams bzhi lnga tsam bcad la/ rta des sa mtshams dang po tsam rgyug la tshur log pa yang yang bya/ de nas gnyis pa/ de nas gsum pa sogs rim gyis ma sleb pas/ mthar g.yang gi rtse nas kyang phyir ma thal ba log nus te/ bsgom pa ma yin goms pa yin/ goms pa klong du gyur pa yin/ zhes pa'i don de shin tu zab pas gsang bar bya'o// rnal 'byor pa sbyangs stobs zhan pa dag gis rdzas kyi sgo nas thig le bsrung ba ni/ga pur tshwa la bsregs pa'i thal ba/ lug mig sum cha mnyam pa ra'i 'o ma sbyar ba'i ril bu sran ma tsam gsum gsum zhogs snga mo lto stong zla gcig tsam bsten na thig le mi 'chor/ bde ba nyams che'o// yang na tang spyin bu'am zangs rtsi dkar po'am sngo 'byar rtsi zhes bya ba sdong bu khru gang tsam/ sdong 'bras tshi can gzhan la 'byar ba'i 'bras bu thun gcig btags/ 'o ma khyor gang la btab nas bskol/ grang ba na zho ru chags pa de zos na thig le 'dzag mi srid do//goms pa thob nas rlung sbyor 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa gang yang mi dgos te/bde nyams gang skyes kyi steng du glod nas bzhag pa nyid kyis 'grub ste/ bsod nams dang dad brtson snying stobs ldan pa'i spyod yul lo// rgan pa dang / ma ning dang / rtsa shin tu ngan pa dag gis grol lam la brten par bya ste/ dbang thob cing dam tshig ldan/ phyi nang gi bsnyen sgrub thengs pas/ bde ba'i stan la rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs drang po bsrang /dpung pa phyir dgye/ mgrin pa dgug lce mchu rang babs su ba'ag mig bar snang gi dkyil du mig 'bras mi 'gul bar hrig ger bltas la/ rnam

510 ༄zagayu thog snying thigartogs 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyad/ ma 'ongs pa'i sdun mi bsu/ da lta ba la rtsi bgrangs mi bya bar rnam rtog gang skyes bkag la bzhag thun mtshams su bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms/ gsol ba phur tshugs snying nas gdab/ zla ba gcig lus gnas lta stangs sngar dang 'dra/ rig pa legs par sgrims/ srang du gcur/ ma yengs par gcun te/ rnam rtog 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyad/ma 'ongs pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da lta ba la rtsi grangs mi bya/ dgra la zhe sdang /gnyen la brtse gdung sogs rtog pa ci mang spel/ sems skad cig kyang gnas su mi 'jug pa yun du bcug thun mtshams su gsol ba gdab/ zla ba gcigade nas lus lta stangs sngar dang 'dra ba la/ ched du spro yang mi spro/ ched du bsdu yang mi bsdu/ rnam rtog gang skyes ngos zin tsam/ ma yengs pa tsam la lhod kyis glod/ shig gis bsheg tsog ge bzhag tsang gis bskyur/ thun mtshams su gsol ba gdab/ zla ba gcig de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/de rjes dmigs skor 'di gsum gyi dus su sems gnas pa dang / spro ba dang rang sor bzhag pa gsum gyis ngo bo bzang ngan/ mtho dman/ ring thung /che chung / dkar nag sogs dbye ba e 'dug legs par cod bcad/ phyi rol snod kyi 'jig rten 'byung ba lnga las grub pa dang / nang bcud kyi sems can 'byung ba lnga las bskyed pa dang / gsang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs su 'char ba 'di rnams gcig gam tha dad/ tha dad na so sor 'byed mkhan de su zhig na dus nam gyi tshe tshul ji ltar/ gcig tu mthong mkhan/ gang snyam du cod legs par bcad/ cod gcod mkhan de'i mkhan po/ de'i mkhan po sogs brgyud ma nas brgyud mar drag tu ded nas bltas pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gas sems su thag chod/ sems kyi ngo bo ye gdod ma nas/ skye 'gag gnas bral mtha' dbus spros pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ gshes cir yang ma grub pa/ mdangs sna tshogs su 'char ba 'char

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 511bzhin du 'char mkhan gzhi rtsa bral ba/ smra bsam shes brjod blo'i yul/thams cad las 'das ba'i rig ba gcer bu lhang nge ba/ rgyan khros se ba zhig la snang ba phyi ru ma lus/ rig pa nang du ma lus/ ye shes zang thal du ma lus/nyon mongs ngan te spang rgyu spong mkhan bral ba/ ye ji bzhin pa'i gnas lugs de mthong rgyu med pa'i tshul gyis gnas lugs de mthong / nyams myong rig pa'i ye shes 'gyur med blo'i gting du 'char bas/ de nyid 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug lus ngag yid spyod kun du so ma/ lhug pa/ ma bcos pa/ rang mdangs bzo med du lhod de/ rjen khros se ba'i ngang la ma yengs tsam bskyangs pas/ tshe 'dir kun bzang gi dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa the tshom med pa ste yid chos skur 'char ba'i khrid tshar ro// shu rghaṃ/mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa ni// rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchogarig ma rje btsun mar bskyed la/ yum gyis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yab kyi gsang gnas/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/nor bu dmar po oṃ gyis mtshan cing / bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par bsam/yab kyis yum gyi padma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze 'bru dkar po la as mtshan zhing / bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na/ badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3 haṃ/ zhes so// sgrub pa 'di la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang gi phyag rgya ma gzhan gyis spyad na dngos grub 'gyangs/ thig le'i gegs su 'gro bas/ snod ldan blo khel nges yin na/ gdams pa bya/ de min sgrub gnas dben pa dang / mtshams dam par byas la gzhan gyis mi mthong bar sba'o// smi: sarba marga lam̐//

512 ༄zagayu thog snying thigawa/ masgrub sdug bsngal mun sel gyi ljokhuspyol 'khor gyi rtsa chig bzhugasaso/na mo gu ru/ grub chen mahā gu ṇa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal la/lo // rig 'dzin gsang sngags rgyal mtshan gyi phyag dper 'dug bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel las//gsang dbang shes rab mun sel gyi// dbang don nyams len rtsa rlung gi/'khrul 'khor rtsa tshig 'di ltar ro// dang po rtsa nang rlung ro sbyang // gnyis pa rang lus dag par sbyang // gsum pa lus kun khyab par 'phur// bzhi pa rked pa g.yas g.yon bskor// lnga pa ro stod g.yas g.yon gcu// drug pa mgo bo g.yas bskor ro// bdun pa lag gnyis res mos sprug brgyad pa rkang gnyis brkyang bskum bya// sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi 'khrul 'khor rim pa ni// dgu pa zla ba btson du bzung // bcu pa rkang mtheb brkyang 'then 'dren// bcu gcig rkang mtheb phyi 'dren bya// bcu gnyis sor bcu ltag bsnol 'dren//bcu gsum seng ge rnam rol bya// bcu bzhi seng ge rtsal sprug 'bebs// bco lnga sgrim glod lus kun sprug/ bcu drug yon tan kun rdzogs bya// bcu bdun rigs lnga mkha' la dbab// bco brgyad bka' rgya'i 'debs bya'o//na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni hūṃ/ bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel gyi// zab lam 'khrul 'khor zin bris ni// zas skom zhu rjes me nyi yis// ma dros srod dang tho rangs dang // snga dro'i dus su dben sar bsdad// mi khyis ma mthong bgegs bskrad bya// srung 'khor bsgoms rjes 'khrul 'khor ni// rlung ro sbyong ba'i lus gnad ni// tsog pur rkang bsnol sgal tshigs bsrang // lag gnyis pus 'khyud sna gnyis nas// zhi drag ma ning gsum gsum 'bud// gnyis pa lus 'dul 'jam rlung bzung // sems skyil khu tshur pus steng nas// gyen

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 513gzhal nu steng khu tshur ni// brkyang bskum bsnun pa gsum rjes su// g.yas g.yon lag pa re mos su// bshud rjes mdun rgyab mgo rked dang // rkang gnyis brkyang bskum re mos su// lag gnyis thal mo gyen thur bshud//gsum pa rlung bzung mgo lus kun// lag g.yas phur bsrub yongs rdzogs bya//bzhi pa rlung bzung skyil krung tsog / lag gnyis pus 'khyud rked pa ni//g.yas g.yon brgya brgya bskor zhing bsdig / lnga pa skyil krung rlung bzung nas//lag gnyis sor bsnol spyi bor bkab// gru mo brgyangs la ro stod nyid//g.yas gcu g.yon gcu nyer gcig bya// drug pa lus gnad skyil krung la//rlung bzung lag gnyis pus mo bkab// mgo bor g.yas g.yon nyer gcig bskor// bdun pa skyil krung rlung bzung nas// lag pa g.yas g.yon res mos dang // zur du yang ni mgo bo la// phyi skor spyi gtsug bdun bdun sprug /brgyad pa skyil krung rlung bzung dang // lag gnyis khu tshur snying gar bsnol//rkang gnyis brkyang bskum zung 'jug ste// lag grangs bcu bcu lan gsum bya//dgu pa pang dkyil lag gnyis so// mig thad mdun khar shad brkyang dang //dus mnyam drag rlung phyir bus la// khug pa bdun par nang sdud spang // bcu pa rkang gnyis brkyang ba yi// lag gnyis mtheb mdzub rkang mtheb gnyis//so sor bzung la hūṃ ring ni// drag la yun ring lan bdun drangs// dmigs pa byang sems me stag nyid// rlung bskyod nam mkhar song ba ltar// spyi bo nas 'thon nam mkhar 'phor// bcu gcig rlung bzung rlung 'khyab rjes// rkang gnyis bar du rkang gang bzhag / lag pa sgyid nang so so nas// phyir byung mtheb mdzub rkang mtheb bzung // dmigs pa gong ltar gsal ngang nas//ha yi stong 'dren lnga re dang // nang 'dzin pho rlung lhang sgril gyi// 'dren pa lnga la re mos bya// bcu gnyis lag gnyis sor mo bsnol// ltag khung bkab la gru mo gnyis// mdun brgyangs mgo dgug rkang pa gnyis// pad skyil rlung gnad

514 ༄zagayu thog snying thigaha drag pos// stong 'dren bdun ni brtson pas drangs// bcu gsum rdo rje skyil krung bcas// rlung bzung steng 'og nywa bzhi bsgrim// lag gnyis gru brgyangs mtheb gnyis kyis// rna ba gnyis mnan gung mdzub gnyis// mig mnan srin mdzub mtheb srin gyis// kha sna bkag la g.yas g.yon du// lan ni bdun bdun bskor rjes la// skyil krung bshig btab has 'don zhing //lag gnyis sor brkyang zung 'phong sprug bcu bzhi sems skyil khu tshur gnyis//pus steng brgyangs la rlung bzung nas// khu tshur gyen bsgreng nu steng gnyis//gcig bsnun lan gnyis nam mkhar brgyang // 'bebs bstun g.yas 'gyings g.yon 'gyings rjes// lag gnyis pus bkab g.yas g.yon gcu//sprug cing gong ltar lan lnga bya// bco lnga sems skyil khu tshur gnyis// pus steng bzhag la rlung bzung sprug / pyi /phyi rlung bus la stong pa sprug / re mos lan grangs gsum gsum bya// bcu drug 'bebs khung 'bebs gdan khar// rang lus rdo rje rtse lnga bsam// rlung bzung lag gnyis pus khar bkab// 'phong bteg g.yas 'gyings g.yon dbus 'gril// khu tshur gyen gzhal nam mkhar bsgrengs// g.yas g.yon g.yon dbus brgyangs rjes su// 'bebs bstun lag gnyis dbyi zur du// so sor rdo rje khu tshur gnyis// kha gyen la bstan lag gnyis bsgrim// de ltar gyen bsgreng thur phab gnyis// rlung 'then re la lnga re gdab// phyi 'bud nang 'dzin ngal med par// nyer lnga gdab rjes rlung ngal gso// de ltar stong rtsa'i bar du ni// nyed lnga brgya rtsa gnyis stong dang // bzhi stong brgyad brgya stong rtsa brtsegs// de ni gegs sel rlung kun 'gre// bcu bdun rlung bzung gan rkyal bya// yan lag bzhi po zur nyid la// gru mo pus mo bkug la bsgrim// nam mkhar bla ma bzhugs pa la// sems gtad gyen du 'phag cing gdab// lan grangs bcu yi bar du 'bar// bco brgyad rlung bzung skyil krung tsog / lag gnyis khu tshur nu steng du// brkyang bskum

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 515'bebs bstun nyer gcig rjes// ha 'don 'khrul 'khor gong ltar du// nyer gcig 'bebs pas rtsa rlung gi / gegs rnams ma lus sel bar 'gyur// de rjes skyil krung bum can ni// gsum lnga bdun la sogs pa 'byung // 'di ltar phyog len ma 'phyugs par// nyams blangs rtsa rlung thig le yi// dgongs pa rdo rje rnam gsum nyid// tshe 'dir mngon 'gyur the tshom med// rjes 'jug slob ma'i don phyir du// drang srong bsod nams ming can gyis// bskul ba'i nyi zla grags pa yis// zin bris yi ger bkod pa dge/ sarba marga lam̐// smi/ /zha/ g.yuthog snying thig byin rlabs sgrub kyi chosaskor lasango sprod 'khor 'dasarang grol chen mo bzhugasaso/na mo ratna gu ru sarba sirnyi kli/ de ltar nyams len thams cad kyi ngo sprod gcig tu dril ba/ 'khor 'das rang grol gyi gdams pa ni/ gang zag skal ldan che (tshe 'dir bla med byang chub thob par 'dod pas/ rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal gyi dbang rdzogs par thob dam tshig ldan/ bskyed rdzogs rim pa tshul bzhin nyams su len pa de nyid kyis/ snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad lnga tshan lnga'i rang bzhin du ngo sprod pa shes na/ 'khor ba ma spangs rang sar grol nas tshe gcig lus gcig la byang chub thob par 'gyur ro// de yang dang po rkang grangs bstan/ bar du ngo sprod/mthar rgyud thog tu bkal nas nyams su blang thabs bstan pa dang gsum las/dang po ngos gzung ba ni/ sku lnga/ ye shes lnga/ phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/mtshon byed lnga'o// chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ mngon par byang chub sku/

516 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigami 'gyur rdo rje'i sku'o// ye shes lnga ni/ chos dbyings ye shes/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so// phung po lnga ni/ gzugs kyi phung po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po/tshor ba'i phung po/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ 'du byed kyi phung po'o// 'byung ba lnga ni/ nam mkha' sa chu me rlung ngo // mtshon byed lnga ni/ mthing ga dkar po/ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu'o// ngo sprod par bya ba ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ bye brag rnam grangs rgyu dang mtshan nyid la sogs rgyas par bshad na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / don mdor bsdus na/ phyi nang snod bcud byed las gsum du 'dus shing / 'khor ba pa'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten khams/ nang bcud kyi sems can gyi rigs/ byed las 'khrul ba'i bya ba 'ba' zhig la spyod pa'o// 'jig rten 'das pa'i phyi snod zhing khams dang gzhal yas/ nang bcud sems can gyi ye shes kyi lha dang 'phags tshogs/ byed las brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las las 'gro don la spyod pa'o// de thams cad rnal 'byor ba rang nyid la tshang ste/snod lus bcud sems/ byed las 'du shes dang 'du byed kyi lu gu rgyud la spyod cing ngo ma sprad cing / ma 'phrod na 'khor ba pa ngo sprad cing / 'phrod na mya ngan las 'das pa'o// ngo sprad pa de 'phrod par byed pa/ yang gang gis sprod na/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas sprod/ gang la sprod na/ bla med byang chub sgrub pa don du gnyer ba'i skal ldan la sprad/ ji ltar sprod na/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sprod do// sprod pa'i yon tan ni/ myang 'das thob/ ma sprad pa'i skyon 'khor ba nas mi thar bas/ nges par ngo sprod pa gal che'o// de yang ngo sprod pas 'phrad pas nyams su len pa dang / do (ngo 'phrod kyang nyams su mi len pa dang / ngo sprod pas ma 'phrod pa dang / ngo sprad pas 'phrod pa ni/rang ngo rang gas shes pa'o// 'phrod pas nyams su mi len pa ni/ rang ngo rang

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 517gis shes nas 'khrul ba'i rjes su mi 'brang ba'o// ngo 'phrod pas nyams su len pa ni/ go yul du lus nas rang gi rgyud thog tu mi phebs pa'o// ngo sprod pas ma 'phrod pa ni/ tshig rna bar thos pas blo 'dred de/ don yid la ma nges pas/ nyams su len rgyu med/ dper na snam bu bzo nyes pa dang 'dra/ ngo ye nas ma sprad pa ni/ snam bu bzo ma byas pa dang 'dra ste/ snam bu de mkhas pa'i lag tu slebs nas/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'byung la/ lan gcig bzo nyes pa ste/ bcas bcos byar mi btub pa dang mtshungs te/ ngo sprod btab lam thebs pas/ lta spyod ya bral du song na grol dus mi 'byung ngo // des na ngo 'phrod par gdab/ thob nas rang rgyud ngang 'dres par nyams su len par byed pa gnad che/ngo sprod dngos ni/ dang po sku lnga la phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ phyi'i sku lnga ni/ rigs lnga las byung ba'i sku lnga ste/ rig pa'i ye shes sku'i rigs las byung ba'i sku rnam par snang mdzad/ rig pa'i ye shes gsung gi rigs las byung ba'i gsung snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs kyi rigs las byung ba'i thugs snang ba mtha' yas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dad pa'i rigs las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' snang ba mtha' yas/ yon tan gyi rigs las byung ba'i yon tan snang ba mtha' yas/ rin 'byung gi rigs las byung ba'i rin 'byung snang ba mtha' yas/ 'phrin las kyi rigs las byung ba'i 'phrin las snang ba mtha' yas/don grub rig pa'i ye shes so// nang gi sku lnga ni/ cho 'phrul rtags kyi sku lnga ste/sku'i cho 'phrul las byung ba'i lam rtags kyi sku 'khor lo/ de 'gre bar/gsung padma/ thugs kyi rdo rje/ yon tan gyi rin chen/ phrin las kyi sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ gsang ba'i sku lnga ni/ gdul bya sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku lnga ste/ sngar bstan pa'i chos sku la sogs pa lnga'o// de ltar sku lnga po gzhan zhig nas byung ba ma yin zhing / rnal 'byor rang gi lus ngag

518 ༄zagayu thog snying thigayid gsum la tshang / ji ltar tshang na/ phyi sku lnga lus la tshang ste/ khams kun chang (tshang ba rgyun gyi thig le rnam par snang mdzad/ khrag dang chu ser mi bskyod pa/ sha rin 'byung / pags pa bkrag mdangs snang ba mtha' yas/skra dang ba spu don grub/ nang gi sku lnga ngag la tshang ste/ skad kyi snang ba lhang nge grag pa 'khor lo/ tshig 'bru mi bskyod pa/ snyan par smra ba padma'o// don bstan pa ston zhing / dbugs kyi rta las byung ba rgya gram mo// gsang ba'i sku lnga sems la tshang ste/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ snang ba rig byed du snang ba sprul sku/ de gsum kha'i dbyings mi g.yo mi 'gyur ba rdo rje'i sku/ mkhyen brtse dang ldan pa mngon par byang chub sku dang / de ltar na phyi nang gsang ba'i sku thams cad rdzogs shing rang la tshang bas/ gzhan nas btsal du med pa'o// ye shes lnga la phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ phyi'i ye shes lnga/ chos dbyings ye shes/ me long / mnyam nyid/ sor rtog bya grub/ nang gi ye shes lnga ni/ shes pa bsdus pa ye shes/ shes pa 'phro ba'i ji lta bar mkhyen pa'i/ ji snyed pa gzigs pa'i/ mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes gsang ba'o// ngo bo ka dag gi ye shes/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi ye shes/ thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes/ mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i ye shes/mngon sum rang snang gi ye shes te/ de ltar ye shes rnams kyang gzhan gang nas ma byung / rang la rang chas su tshang zhing / ji ltar tshang ba ni/ chos dbyings ye shes ni/ rang gi sems nyid la mtha' dbus med pa'o// me long lta bu'i ye shes/ sems kyi snang cha la ma bsgribs par snang la rang bzhin ma grub par gsal ba'o// mnyam nyid ye shes sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa'o// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/gang la gang 'dul gyi chos thams cad sems nyid kyi klong du rim pas ma 'dres par so sor gsal ba'o// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ 'bad rtsol dang bral

518 ༄zagayu thog snying thigayid gsum la tshang / ji ltar tshang na/ phyi sku lnga lus la tshang ste/ khams kun chang (tshang ba rgyun gyi thig le rnam par snang mdzad/ khrag dang chu ser mi bskyod pa/ sha rin 'byung / pags pa bkrag mdangs snang ba mtha' yas/skra dang ba spu don grub/ nang gi sku lnga ngag la tshang ste/ skad kyi snang ba lhang nge grag pa 'khor lo/ tshig 'bru mi bskyod pa/ snyan par smra ba padma'o// don bstan pa ston zhing / dbugs kyi rta las byung ba rgya gram mo// gsang ba'i sku lnga sems la tshang ste/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ snang ba rig byed du snang ba sprul sku/ de gsum kha'i dbyings mi g.yo mi 'gyur ba rdo rje'i sku/ mkhyen brtse dang ldan pa mngon par byang chub sku dang / de ltar na phyi nang gsang ba'i sku thams cad rdzogs shing rang la tshang bas/ gzhan nas btsal du med pa'o// ye shes lnga la phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ phyi'i ye shes lnga/ chos dbyings ye shes/ me long / mnyam nyid/ sor rtog bya grub/ nang gi ye shes lnga ni/ shes pa bsdus pa ye shes/ shes pa 'phro ba'i ji lta bar mkhyen pa'i/ ji snyed pa gzigs pa'i/ mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes gsang ba'o// ngo bo ka dag gi ye shes/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi ye shes/ thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes/ mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i ye shes/mngon sum rang snang gi ye shes te/ de ltar ye shes rnams kyang gzhan gang nas ma byung / rang la rang chas su tshang zhing / ji ltar tshang ba ni/ chos dbyings ye shes ni/ rang gi sems nyid la mtha' dbus med pa'o// me long lta bu'i ye shes/ sems kyi snang cha la ma bsgribs par snang la rang bzhin ma grub par gsal ba'o// mnyam nyid ye shes sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa'o// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/gang la gang 'dul gyi chos thams cad sems nyid kyi klong du rim pas ma 'dres par so sor gsal ba'o// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ 'bad rtsol dang bral

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 519zhing / chos kun sems nyid kyi rang gzhag rang grol rang la rdzogs pa'o//shes pa btus pa'i ye shes ni/ gdul bya'i bsam pa mkhyen cing / gzhan don khong du chud pas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin shes pa 'gyur ba'o//spros pa'i ye shes ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin lhun gyis grub par shes pa'o// ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ bdag gi dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs shes te/ rang don rtog pa las 'khrul ba'i rgyu zad pa'o// ji snyed pa gzigs pa'i ye shes ni/ rang don tshad la phabs nas gzhan don thugs rje'i rol bas 'dzad pa med pa'o// mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes ni/ rang gzhan ma lus pa'i don mdzad pa thams cad mthar phyin pa'o// ngo bo ka dag gi ye shes ni/ ma rig pa'i ming tsam yang med cing grangs las 'das pa'o// rang bzhin lhun grub kyi ye shes/ mi skye mi 'gag par/ci'i ngo bo spang mi dgos shing / yul thams cad nges pa med pa'o// thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes/ rang gi gsal ba'i bdag nyid can las/ rang bzhin shugs kyis thugs rje 'gag pa med par 'char ba'o// mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i ye shes ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid kyi rtsa ba chod po'o// mngon sum rang snang gi ye shes de dag thams cad gzhan gang nas kyang ma byung zhing rang la zhugs/ rang las 'char rang las gnang ba las kyang / rang gi mngon sum du bltar yod/spyod du yod/ bteg tu yod/ lam gyi 'char sgom 'gags par/ 'phel zhing tshad dang bcas pa yod/ de ltar yod pa de/ byas byung can yin nam zhe na/de ni ma yin te/ ye gdod ma nas yongs la khyab cing / gsal stong dbyer med du 'pho 'gyur med pa'o// phung po lnga la phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ phyi yul gyi phung po lnga/ nang yul can gyi phung po lnga/ gsang ba der 'dzin gyi phung po lnga/ de dag kyang rang la tshang ste/ phyi yul gyi phung po/ gzugs sgra dri ro

520 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigareg bya lnga po rang las byung / nang yul can gyi phung po/ mig rna ba/ sna/lce/ lus lnga ni rang la yod/ gsang ba der 'dzin gyi phung po dbang shes/myong byed kyi tshor ba lnga yang rang la yod/ rang las byung ste/ de ltar na rang la gnas skabs su byung ba ma yin/ ye nas tshang zhing de dag kyang spang blang las 'das pa'o// 'byung ba lnga la phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ phyi'i 'byung ba lnga ni/nam mkha' la sogs pa lnga/ nang gi ni/ sems nam mkha'/ khrag chu/ sha rus sa/ drod me/ dbugs rgyu ba rlung ngo // gsang ba'i 'byung ba lnga ni/sems kyi ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa stong pa nam mkha'/ sems kyi rang bzhin ma sgrib/ gsal zhing tshor ba rags pa dang bcas pa me/ yongs la khyab cing gsher 'byin pas chu/ sems kyi rnam pa 'gyur med ma 'gags pas rlung /de rnams kyang dbyings gcig gi ngang du gnas shing g.yo ba med pa ste/ de ltar yang mthar rang las byung / rang la gnas/ rang gi klang las ma 'das shing / spang lan las 'das te spo mi 'tshal zhing / blang mi 'tshal te ye nas yod pa'o// mtshon byed lnga ni phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ phyi mtshon byed dkar po la sogs kha dog lnga/ nang gi mtshon byed lnga la/ rus pa la sogs dkar po'i mdog can/ skra la sogs spu rtags kyi rim pa sngon po'i mdog can/mkhris pa la sogs ser po/ sha khrag la sogs dmar po/ kha rlangs la sogs rlung gi rgyu rngub ljang gu/ gsang ba'i mtshon byed/ sems kyi 'phro rtog dga' ba la sogs/ spo ba dkar po'i mtshon byed/ chags pa dang sred pa'i 'du shes dmar/ spang len 'phrod 'jug gi rnam pas/ bye brag 'byed pa sngon po'i/rtog pa phra rags sbom pa la sogs ṅku/ 'du 'phrod dpag tu med pa ljang gu/gting mi g.yo bar gnas pa ser po'i mtshon byed de/ de ltar mtshon byed thams cad kyang / rang las byung zhing rang snang gi bya rgyu tsam las/ gzhan nas byung ba ma yin pa'o// de bas na/ da (de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i lnga

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 521tshan lnga la/ 'khor 'das gang yang ma tshang ba med cing / thams cad tshang ba ste/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor ba rang la thams cad tshang zhing yongs su rdzogs la/ de dag mngon shes pas/ phan tshun yul dang yul can du phyed/ de dag spang blang gi 'dzin pa zhugs pas bcings/ bcings pas 'khor bar 'khor zhing grol dus med pas sdug bsngal ba'o// de dag kyang bla mas ngo sprad de/rang la yod pa rang gis go zhing rtogs par byas pas/ 'khor 'das thams cad rang la tshang ba thag chod/ gzhan nas ma byung ba thag chod/ ye gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa gdeng thob/ spang blang dgag sgrub re dogs la sogs pa gnyis 'dzin gyi mtha' las 'das pa thag chod pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis ngo 'phrod par bya'o// de ltar ngo 'phrod pas 'khor bam spangs gnas su dag cing / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog la sogs rang sar grol nas/ ye shes lnga la sogs par gyur pas te/ de yang rnal 'byor pa yid kyi sgrib pa byang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi yon tan thob/gzugs kyi phung po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ chu'i khams mā ma kyi'i rang bzhin du gnas dag zhe sdang me long lta bu'i ye shes grol te/sangs rgyas rdo rje rigs kyi thugs 'khrul ba med pa thob nas/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed par 'gyur/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi yon tan thob/ 'du shes phung po bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas nyid du byang chub/ me'i khams gos dkar mo nyid du gnas dag 'dod chags so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas padma rigs kyi gsung 'gag pa med pa chos kyi sgra dbyangs thob nas/ 'gro don byed par 'gyur ro//lus kyi sgrib pa byang nas sangs rgyas thams cad sku'i yon tan thob/ rnam shes phung po bcom ldan 'das sku 'gyur ba med pa rnam par snang mdzad du byang chub/nam mkha'i khams chos kyi dbyings phyug mar gnas dag gti mug chos

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 521tshan lnga la/ 'khor 'das gang yang ma tshang ba med cing / thams cad tshang ba ste/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor ba rang la thams cad tshang zhing yongs su rdzogs la/ de dag mngon shes pas/ phan tshun yul dang yul can du phyed/ de dag spang blang gi 'dzin pa zhugs pas bcings/ bcings pas 'khor bar 'khor zhing grol dus med pas sdug bsngal ba'o// de dag kyang bla mas ngo sprad de/rang la yod pa rang gis go zhing rtogs par byas pas/ 'khor 'das thams cad rang la tshang ba thag chod/ gzhan nas ma byung ba thag chod/ ye gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa gdeng thob/ spang blang dgag sgrub re dogs la sogs pa gnyis 'dzin gyi mtha' las 'das pa thag chod pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis ngo 'phrod par bya'o// de ltar ngo 'phrod pas 'khor bam spangs gnas su dag cing / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog la sogs rang sar grol nas/ ye shes lnga la sogs par gyur pas te/ de yang rnal 'byor pa yid kyi sgrib pa byang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi yon tan thob/gzugs kyi phung po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ chu'i khams mā ma kyi'i rang bzhin du gnas dag zhe sdang me long lta bu'i ye shes grol te/sangs rgyas rdo rje rigs kyi thugs 'khrul ba med pa thob nas/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don byed par 'gyur/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi yon tan thob/ 'du shes phung po bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas nyid du byang chub/ me'i khams gos dkar mo nyid du gnas dag 'dod chags so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas padma rigs kyi gsung 'gag pa med pa chos kyi sgra dbyangs thob nas/ 'gro don byed par 'gyur ro//lus kyi sgrib pa byang nas sangs rgyas thams cad sku'i yon tan thob/ rnam shes phung po bcom ldan 'das sku 'gyur ba med pa rnam par snang mdzad du byang chub/nam mkha'i khams chos kyi dbyings phyug mar gnas dag gti mug chos

522 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadabyings ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'gyur ba med pa chos kyi sku thob nas 'gro don byed par 'gyur ro// la la'i skabs su rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ rnam snang gi sku thob pa'ang gsung / gnas 'gyur gyi khyad par tsam las don gyi dgongs pa la khyad par med/ lus ngag yid gsum ga'i sgrib pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi che ba'i yon tan thob/ tshor ba'i phung po bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan du byang chub/ sa'i khams sangs rgyas spyan mar gnas dag nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid ye shes su gnas grol te/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yon tan thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas 'gro don byed par 'gyur ro// nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag nas sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi yon tan thob/ 'du byed phung po bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa nyid du byang chub/ rlung gi khams dam tshig sgrol mar gnas dag phrag dog bya grub ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas las kyi rigs kyi phrin las thogs pa med pa 'grub na/ 'gro don byed par 'gyur ro//de ltar ngo sprad cing 'phrod par bya'o//ngo 'phrod nas rang gi rgyud thog tu bkal zhing / nyams su len thabs bstan pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rab kyi rab ye grol chen por nyams su blang /rab kyi 'bring gas rang grol chen po nyams su blang / rab kyi tha mas yongs grol chen por/ 'bring gi rab kyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad dbyer med chen po/ 'bring gi 'bring gis kun rdzob don dam zung 'juga'abring gi tha mas kyang spang blang med par/ tha ma'i rab kyis bskyed rdzogs gnyis med chen por nyams su/ tha ma'i 'bring gis bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu/ tha ma'i tha mas blang dor gang bder/ ngo 'phrod pa'i gnad kyis zin par byas la nyams su blang / mdor na snang srid 'khor 'das bdag gzhan phan tshun/ bzang ngan re dog spang blang nye ring btang gzhag sogs gnyis

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 523chos thams cad kyi 'dun pa phral la/ ye shes rol ba kun rdzogs 'khor 'das rang grol chen por nyams su blang ngo // de'ang nyams su blang zhes bya ba/ rang la med pa zhig gzhan nas btsal te rnyed pa dang / de nyid 'chang zhing sgre log byed pa lta bu ma yin te/ 'khor zhes pa ye shes lnga la sogs pa thams cad gdod ma nas rang la rang chas su tshang bar yod pa la/ sngar rang ngo ma shes pas 'khrul 'khor du 'khor/ zhes bya ba las/ 'das zhes bya ba 'khor bar 'khor ba nyid kyi tshe rang gi ngo la bltas pas/ rtag chad/ mtha' dbus/yod med bden rdzun sogs/ mtha' bzhi mtha' brgyad kyi mu mtha' smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul blo thams cad las 'das pa nyid do// rang zhes bya ba ni/deng phyin chad chos kyi sku rang la rang chas su yod pa/ gsal gzhag med par ngo shes bzhin gdeng thob par byed pa las/ log tu rdul phra rab tsam yang ngo sprad du med pa'o// grol zhes pa 'bras bu yid smon gyi dus su ma lus par/gang shar ngos zin phan chad/ de nyid du ye shes rang snang rol ba'i rtsal gsum gzhi thog tu rdzogs pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi 'ching ba thams cad rang zhi rang dag rang yal rang grol du 'gyur ba'o// chen po zhes pa 'di lta bu'i gang nas sprad rgyu yang med/ nyams su blang rgyu yang med/ lta ba 'khor 'das rang grol mthong yul las 'das pa/ sgom pa 'khor 'das rang grol nyams las 'das pa/ spyod pa 'khor 'das rang grol bya byed las 'das pa/ 'bras bu 'khor 'das rang grol blang dor las 'das pa/ smin grol 'khor 'das rang grol skad cig smin cing grol ba/ bskyed rdzogs 'khor 'das rang grol/mtha' las 'das pa/ lam brgya 'khor 'das rang grol/ lhun gyis grub pa'o//gong na chen po de lta bu'i gnad kyis zin pa la/ nyams len mthar thug zer ro// de dag kyang 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang thams cad kyang / ming tsam/rtags tsam ma gtogs/ ye gdod ma nas grub ma myong la/ lam gyi theg pa'i

524 ༄g.yu thog snying thiga'abad rtsol/ nyams len thams cad kyang / ming tsam/ brda tsam/ rtags tsam las/ 'di'o zhes grub la myong / 'bras bu sku gsung thugs gzhi sku lnga'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / ming tsam/ brda tsam/ rtags tsam las/don du grub ma myong zhing / myong ma myong zhes pa yang blo las 'das pa/ blo las 'das ma 'das kyang smra bsam brjod kyi yul ma yin pa las 'das so// 'di na 'khrul ba la 'khrul ba rnam rtog la gnyis log mnan nas/ mtha' bral dang zung 'jug sogs/ zhe 'dod kyis bsgrubs pa'i lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa ni/nam yang 'khor ba las thar bar mi 'gyur zhing / gnas lugs kyi don de zhe 'dod blo yul tshig tshogs las 'das pa'i phyir ro// don hril gyis dril na lta sgom spyod 'bras 'khrul grol sogs snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus la/ sems kho rang gi gshis la kho rang gis 'tshol rtogs byas pa'i tshe yod med bden rdzun gcig tha dad rnyed ma rnyed/ ltos chos spros pa rdul tsam yang mi rnyed/ brjod rgyu rnyed rgyu med ma rnyed snyam mkhan shes rig rang log rang gshed la phab nas brtags pas/brtags zhen gyi gzhi rtsa yal/ brtags bya'i yul dor/ rtogs byed kyi mkhan po brlag grub mtha' spros pa'i blo las brgal/ dran bsam thams cad skad cig la lar sangs/ snang ngor wa le/ shar tshad rig ngor wa le yal 'char gzhi ci yang med pas dang sang nge ba la dran rig cir yang ma 'gags kun tu 'char ba/ shar yang gzhi med du rang dag pas ka dag btsal rgyu ma grub stong log gis shes pa dang / 'tshol mkhan ma grub stong log gis shes pa dang /'tshol mkhan lta byed kyi rig pa/ hrig ge ba dbyer med de/ brjod bral skad cig la gzhi med du rang mdangs/ shes bya sa le ba la/ shes byed 'dzin pa dag med shes rang log mi yul bral bas/ khud bral ngos gzung rnam par cir yang ma mthong / ma mthong snyam pa yang ma mthong / gzhi med tsam du

— gyi/sdugabasngal munaselathugasarje'inyi'od/ da 525'dzin pa'ang ma rnyed/ ma rnyed pa'ang ma rnyed bzhin wa le ba bar snang dag pa'i dbyings ltar ngos gzung med par rang mdangs su ngang gis gnas pas/gang du yang rgya ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung mtha' dbus gang ci'i ngo bo yang ma grub/ rang rig dran pa dngos med du rang grol dran brlag 'gro 'ong gsal ba bsam brlag yeng bral/ ma bsgoms don dang 'du 'bral med pas/ ming tshig gi bsam brjod blo 'das chen por rtog med tshul du rtogs na 'phrod pa ste/'phrod nas ye ji bzhin pa'i shes lugs la/ ye ji bzhin par bskyangs pas/ye ji bzhin par mthong bar 'gyur ba'o// 'di lta bu'i gnad ma tshang rig na/gnyis snang 'gyur ba rjes med dang / mtshan snang rmi lam bag chags dran pas ma zin nas/ mi bden pa la bden cha 'dzin pa'i snyems rtog phra mo ldang yang /dran pa dang / gnyid sad rjes/ gzhi med kyi gdeng gis zin na/ rang grol du 'gro zhing skyon med do// o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ gnam lcags sta re me 'bar bas// dug sdong rtsad gcod mes bsregs pa'i// thal ba rlung khyer su zhig 'jigs// spros chod gdeng las ma bcos shig / bcos na thug med mgo 'khor 'gyur// snyems chod sprin grol chos dbyings dang // ye shes nyi shar nub mi srid//cesapa dang / sā ra has gal te gtses na dug sbrul gtses pa kho nar zad/ces gsungs pa ltar ro// yang snying bla med gsang chen 'di lta bu dang ma mjal na/ nyan rang byang sems gsum 'khor ba bltas par byed/ spyi yog sde gsum bzang rtog bltas par byed/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi don la yid dpyod sbyor/ a ti dang phyag chen phal gyis don blor bzhag nas/ go yul la gtsor byas pas kha 'byams/ nges don spyi'i snyan brgyud kun nas/ bdag gis chos phar bshad kyang / chos kyis bdag tshur ma rtogs rnam bshad kha bsdus su song / gal te bdag med du rtogs kyang / rtogs mkhan kho rang lta byed cod ma chod/ gal te mkhan po rtsad chod kyang gzhi ngos ma zin/ gzhi

526 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamed tsam du shes kyang mi shes rang gshed la ma phebs/ brjod blo'i mthar lhung ste/ yod med rtag chad mtha' bral/ zung 'jug gang rung zhig la nges shes dang / bcas pa'i 'dzin pa rang gis ma tshor bar 'jug brjod rgyu re rnyed pas brjod bral gyi don ma mthong / cod ma chod/ gting ma rtogs te/ ma tshor yid byed kyi ngar 'dzin dug ro khong du langs pa dang 'dra bas/ ro langs byed lta sgom la shi log 'ong bas/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi la ngoms pa med pa'i gus pas gdung /btung bar bya'o// ngo sprod 'khor 'das rang grol zhes bya ba/ sum ston chen po'i ngo sprod chen mo ji lta ba la/ snon phri rang bzo ma bgyis pa/ tshig nyung ngur bsdus pa/ skal ldan grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ dam med dang nyams khrid ma tshar ba dang /chos 'di'i brgyud pa mi 'dzin pa rnams la/ dpe tsam yang bstan par mi bya ste/ dam can sde dgus bka' 'di srungs shig sarba marga lam̐/ shu rghaṃ// za/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi 'byung ba lusa'akhrugs/kyi gegab/(phyir bzhugs/so/na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ 'dir kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang rdzogs par thob nas/ dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bas/ grol lam bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa la/ gegs sel ba'i rim pa bzhi ste/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gegs sel ba dang /ting 'dzin sems 'khrugs kyi gegs sel ba dang / bar chad bdud kyi gegs sel ba dang / de rnams thun mong gi gegs sel ba'o// dang po 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gegs sel bsal ba ni bco lnga ste/ rluX / mkhris/ bad2 kun/

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 527lda4na/ 'asdus/ tsha 6ba/ grarjo ba/ khraragachu drar/ gasnyan/ sgrani/ gzor/ rmo/sdugi/ thorjo ci'o/ / 'di rnams kyang nad rtags re re dang / bcos thabs re re bstan te/ dang po rlung gi nad rtags ni/ rtsa mgyogs rung dal rung /mnanan mi bzod stong / chu sngo zhing sla la dri rlangs dang ro chung / lbu ba che/dmar ser du 'dug kyang ku ya med la dngas/ g.yal mnge ba dang / gnyid yer/ sems 'phyo/ grang shum byed/ rus tshigs khol/ gzer 'pho 'dar/kha gcig /cig la stod du 'tshangs/ nu thad brang dkyil dang / rgyab kyi tshigs pa drug bdun mnan mi bzod/ zas bcud med dang / 'khyags pa/sems las/ 'khru skyug khrag zag /zags pa dang / snying gar dmigs pa gtad drags pa dang / rig pa gcun drags pa sogs kyis bslang zhing /bsku mnye gsur dud/ drod bcud 'phrod pa ni/ lus kyi stod smad phyi nang gang du byung yang rlung 'phel ba'i nad las ma 'das/ 'di dag zas dang spyod lam gyis bcos pa ni/ sha rnying gi tshod ma/ sgog btsong gi tshod ma/ bur chang /lug sha mar rnying / glum nye'u/ 'bri yi 'o ma/ sha chen gyi thug pa/ zan skam gyi chod ma/ rus pa tshon po'i skyo tsha sogs bsten/ gnam mi mthong zhing /bser bu med pa'i sar me 'od la/ lo mar ram/ til mar ram/ zhun chen nam rtsi mar/ dzā ti sbyar bas bsku mnye bya/ smra ba mang po dang / sems las bskyung / tshig mi snyan pa rnams rna bar mi sgrog yid 'ong grogs dang 'grogs par bya'o// sman bcos ni/ rus rnying sgog skya bu ram chang du gdus pa'i thang btang / yang na sga/ dzā ti/ go snyod/ bu ram/ sre long gdus thang gtang /mi rus tshon po'i thang / sgog skya bran pa btang / sgog skya phul gang gtubs la chu phul gang la 'o ma phul gang du gdus/ khu ba rang la ma thim tsam gyi tshig ma bzhag khu ba dron mo btang / a gar nag po/ dzā ti/ li shi shing kun/

528 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig kha ru tsha/ sman sga/ snying zho sha btsan dug a ru gser mdog cha mnyam/kun gyi phyed skyes dar ma'i sha btang / bu ram sbyar ba'i ril bu sran ma tsam gsum lnga bdun sogs sman nad mi ldang tsam bur chang gis phul la btang /sga drod sman hril 'jong / go stod/ sgog skya/ dzā ti/ btsan dug cha gnyis/sha chen de rnams kun gyi phye ma sum cha/ kham bu star lha(ga ba ru ra'i tshi gu/zar ma/ sro ma/ ka tang bi ra zhes pa'i sngo gang bu reg ma thag tu 'thor ba'i nang gi 'bras bu rnams gang 'byor btab pa'i phye ma ril bu gang rung bu ram chang ngam rus thang gis phul nas btang na/ rlung nad thams cad la phan/khyad par stod 'tshangs kyi nad rigs thams cad la/ ar nag dzā ti/ li shispos dkar rta so ma/ ru rta/ snying zho sha a byag tsher sngon/ ko byi la/gser mdog gi mjug ma rnams thun bzang ba re/ btsan dug thun tshad/ sha chen mtheb tshigs ma rul ma sungs pa'i gsar pa de dgos so tsam zhib btags/ bur chang ngam/ rus thang gis phul la btang / sman zhu mtshams su rdo rje rba rlabs bya'o// yang na dpa' bo ser po lug ril tsam/ gser mdog gi mjug ma sum cha gcig dzā ti nas tsam/ pi ling rdog po lnga/ 'di rnams nyi zer dang /me sgra dang chu sgra med pa'i sar zhib btags thun gcig gar chang gis 'phul la btang / sman zhu mtshams su rba rlabs byas na phan/ yang / tsher sngon thur 'go gang / dzā ti/ li shi ar nag btsan dug nas tsam re/ thar nu thun chung nge ba zhig zu rtsa thun phyed/ shug tsher sran ma tsam phye ma bya/ chu grang gas phul nas btang na stod 'tshangs sel lo// yang rtsa gres ma'i rtsa lo gang byung yang / rdza gtsang mar cung zad yibs su bcug pa chag pa gang / sran ma nag po rdog po nyer gcig 'di rnams thang du bskol nas btang na/ grod pa cung zad sbos pa'i nyams byed cing / thur sel byung na/ rlung thur du phebs te shin tu phan no// gsur dud kyi dud pa yang yang btang / dpyad ni/ stod

528 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig kha ru tsha/ sman sga/ snying zho sha btsan dug a ru gser mdog cha mnyam/kun gyi phyed skyes dar ma'i sha btang / bu ram sbyar ba'i ril bu sran ma tsam gsum lnga bdun sogs sman nad mi ldang tsam bur chang gis phul la btang /sga drod sman hril 'jong / go stod/ sgog skya/ dzā ti/ btsan dug cha gnyis/sha chen de rnams kun gyi phye ma sum cha/ kham bu star lha(ga ba ru ra'i tshi gu/zar ma/ sro ma/ ka tang bi ra zhes pa'i sngo gang bu reg ma thag tu 'thor ba'i nang gi 'bras bu rnams gang 'byor btab pa'i phye ma ril bu gang rung bu ram chang ngam rus thang gis phul nas btang na/ rlung nad thams cad la phan/khyad par stod 'tshangs kyi nad rigs thams cad la/ ar nag dzā ti/ li shispos dkar rta so ma/ ru rta/ snying zho sha a byag tsher sngon/ ko byi la/gser mdog gi mjug ma rnams thun bzang ba re/ btsan dug thun tshad/ sha chen mtheb tshigs ma rul ma sungs pa'i gsar pa de dgos so tsam zhib btags/ bur chang ngam/ rus thang gis phul la btang / sman zhu mtshams su rdo rje rba rlabs bya'o// yang na dpa' bo ser po lug ril tsam/ gser mdog gi mjug ma sum cha gcig dzā ti nas tsam/ pi ling rdog po lnga/ 'di rnams nyi zer dang /me sgra dang chu sgra med pa'i sar zhib btags thun gcig gar chang gis 'phul la btang / sman zhu mtshams su rba rlabs byas na phan/ yang / tsher sngon thur 'go gang / dzā ti/ li shi ar nag btsan dug nas tsam re/ thar nu thun chung nge ba zhig zu rtsa thun phyed/ shug tsher sran ma tsam phye ma bya/ chu grang gas phul nas btang na stod 'tshangs sel lo// yang rtsa gres ma'i rtsa lo gang byung yang / rdza gtsang mar cung zad yibs su bcug pa chag pa gang / sran ma nag po rdog po nyer gcig 'di rnams thang du bskol nas btang na/ grod pa cung zad sbos pa'i nyams byed cing / thur sel byung na/ rlung thur du phebs te shin tu phan no// gsur dud kyi dud pa yang yang btang / dpyad ni/ stod

༄/sdug bsngal mun selathugasarje'inyi'od/ mthu wa'atshangs tsha ba dang 'dres pa'i rigs la/ nyin phyed kyi dus su brang gi dkyil dang / rgyab kyi tshigs pa drug bdun la chu mda' bya/ khrag gzer dang 'dres na gzer sar 'jib ru bya/ rlung rkyang pa la/ dbyug pa la ltag 'then/ me btsa' gang yang 'phrod/ 'bebs la sogs skabs dang bstun no//mkhris pa'i nad rtags ni/ rtsa phra mgyogs grims/ chu dmar ser / dri dang ro dugs/ spu ba phra ser sangs sla/ kha kha/ skom dad che/ mig sprin ser ram dmar/ gzer mi 'pho/ lus tsha bas gdung / khyad par mgo na/ lud pa tshwa bro/ lce la bad kun chags/ zas spyod 'khrugs dang drod kyis slong /bsil ba 'phrod pa 'byung / 'di la zas spyod kyis bcos pa ni/ ba ra'i zho dar ram/ khur mong gi tshod ma/ chu bsil lam/ bskol grang ja dang chu grogari dwags dang ba lang / ra gzhon gyi sha gsar/ ba mar gsar pa/ 'bras thug chag tshe'i thug pa sogs btang / nyin gnyid mi log 'khrugs pa'i bya ba spangs la/ bsil sar bsdad/ sman ni tig ta tsam tshogs/ gser gyi me togadug mo nyung / bong nga dkar po/ g.ya' kyi ma/ gang ga /ga chung / hong len/ a ru ra rnams cha mnyam bskol ba'i thang la/ dom mkhris kyis gtsor byas pa'i mkhris sna tshogs tshad kha tshar btab pa'i bskol grang gung gnyis bsten pas phral du phan no// mgo dang ro stod na ba shas che na/ dpral rtsa phye dang sgang rtsa gtar/ pho mchin dang rgyab na ba shas che na/ ru thung snod kha gtar/ rgyu long snod kha na nas mkhris pa 'khru zhing na ba dang / mkhal rked na zhing sbrid na/ long rtsa byin gzhug gtar/ spyir mkhris nad kyi rigs thams cad dang / sgos su snod du babs pa'i mkhris nad kyi rigs thams cad la gser bshal btang ba ni/ tsha la bzang po thur 'go phyed me la btul/btsan dug bzang po sran ma tsam/ dur byid rkang shun phral ba mtheb tshigs tsam pa gnyis/ dan rog lce shun phral ba gsum/ thar nu ba chur btsos thim

530 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigamatheb tshigs tsam zhig chu rtsa lug ril tsam pa rnams rtsi bzhin btags nas dong ga'i thog lnga'am bdun chur sbangs pa'i khu ba des ril bu sran ma tsam du dril la lto bshal ji bzhin btang / lcag dang log gnon gzhan dang 'dra/btsan dug gi log byung na/ tshwa khu byin par bya'o// grang mkhris la/ rtags gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/ zas spyod drod shas che tsam la/ gnod par mi tshor la/ bsil ba bsten pas phan pa mi tshor ro// khyad par bshang gci kha dog dkar po 'byung / pho mchin sogs na/ zas mi 'ju/ chu mar nag 'dra ba'am/ ser dugs sla ba 'byung ste/ 'di la phag ril dud pa ma shor ba bsregs pa'i thal bas gtso bo bya/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ pi pi ling /rgyam tsha/ gser gyi me tog bur dkar gyi 'khor gyis bskor la/ chu skol gyi rta byas gtang / yang na 'jam 'bras/ mon sga/ tsi tra da byi tang ga a ru gser mdog pi pi ling / rgyam tsha/ gser gyi me tog ka ra rnams kyi phye ma/chu skol gyis phul la btang / tshigs pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa la me btsa' bya'o// pho ba ltem zhing phan pa dka' na sman chu sogs kyis skyug drang ngo //bad kun 'phel ba'i rtags ni/ rtsa bying la dal/ chu dkar la rnyog dri dang ro chung / lus sems lci/ sgyid pa skyur/ kha mngal/ zas mi 'ju/ dang ga zhan/ pho ba dang mkhal rked mi bde/ tshigs mtshams lhod pa dang / nyen skran lcags dreg sogs grang ba'i nad rigs thams cad bskyed do// 'di la zas spyod kyis bcos pa ni/ nya dang g.yag rgod/ lug dang gcan gzan gyi shasbrang rtsi 'bru rnying gi zan/ chang nar son/ chu skol sga chab la sogs yang rtsub dro ba sbyin/ sga skya/ a ru ra/ rgya tsha/ pi pi ling / pho ba ris/ bal dkar lo ma rnams kyi bskol thang tshan mo btang / tsha ba gsum/ tshwa sna gsum/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ shing tshwa/tsha1/ ka ko la/ bur dkar cha mnyam phye ma/ dbyi mong / gdus thang tshan mos phul la thun chung yun ring zhogs par bston/

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 531pho khar nyen chags na zas mi 'ju/ 'khru skyug byed pa dang / skran du 'gril nye na/ rdo thal khyor ba gang / shing tshwa(tshan/ sman chen/ thar nu/ a ru ra dang bzhi po cha mnyam zho dang sbyar nas sla ngar dud pa ma shor bar bsregs thal khyor ba phyed/ pho 'gron gsum sol mer bsregs thal rgya tsha ze tsha gtso byas tshwa sna tshogs tshad dang / sga drod sman hril 'jong / me tog lce tshwa /tsha ba/ dbyi mor srub ka thun re re/ star bu mtheb chen tsam/ go bo dang rgod brun mtheb tshigs tsam re re/ spyang ki'i pho ba rnyed na'ang dum zhig btang / 'di rnams rtsi bzhin btags la sbrang gis 'go bsdus/ ril bu sran ma rlon pa tsam lnga lnga/zhogs pa chu skol phul la gtang / cung zad snyi ru mngon na/ spra bas skran steng tshos par bsreg zhig nas lto bshal gyis sbyang / pho khar nyen nam/ lcags dreg la bsags nas skran du ma 'gril tsam las ni/ pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang po sdud mang du bya/ de rjes dur byid/ spyang tsher ri sho gsum gyi rtsa ba mtheb chen tsam re gdus pa'i thang la shu dag rgyam tsha/ pi pi ling / sga skya rnams thun re'i tshad phye ma btab kyin 'thung / skyug mer na dum zhig bsran bskyed/chu khol ngad yal tsam yog tshad btung la/ bya'i sgro'am sor mos skyugs legs pa drang (drangs / rjes la zas spyod gzabs pas 'tsho/ bad kun de mkhris pa dang 'dres na/ mgo na pho mchin mi bde/ brang tsha zhing chu skyur dang mkhris khu skyug stod khams na/ ma nu/ sle tres/ kuṇḍa ka ri/ 'u su/ star bu/ a ru ra/ ru rta rnams kyi thang yang btang / mtshogs gsang dbye/ stod tsha ba che na lag pa'i rtsa la gtar/ pho ba mi bde na/ gong ltar skyug pa drang /drangs /se 'bru/ ma nu/ 'u su/ star bu/ bal dkar me tog tig ta/ pi pi ling/utpal/ cong zhi/ a ru ra/ ka ra/ de rnams kyi phye ma chu skol gyis phul la bsten/ bad mkhris 'dres pa'i chur skyugs pa la/ phyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i cong zhi drug pas (pa shin tu phan no// ri dwags kyi sha gsar dang / mdzo zho

532 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigachag tshe sogs sbyin/ bad kun de khrag dang 'dres nas smug por gyur te/ pho mchin ro stod mgo sogs na/ khrag rul dud khu skyug gam 'khru/ nad ni ldang dub che/ phan pa dka' na/ tsha ba che dus gtar dang bsil sman sbyar/ tsha grang 'thab dus bsil drod mnyam pa'i ltag sprod bsten/ grang ba la babs dus drod la bsgor/ de yang smug por gzhir bzhag gi nad la pho ba mi bde na/bad kun gyi bcos shas cher bya/ de bzhin mchin pa la khrag rgyu ma la mkhris pa/ long la rlung shas cher bcos pa bya'o// spyir 'gro ba'i sman ni/ bse yab/se 'bru/ ma nu/ 'u su/ utpal/ pi pi ling / gser mdog rnams cha mnyam la/ rlung mkhris shas che na tig ta ba sha ka bsnan/ grang ba shas che na/ bal dkar/ sman sga/ bur dkar bsnan/ chu skol gyis phul la gtang / zhi dka' na/ cong zhi mdzo 'o la 'dam btags nyin gcig bya/ de grib skam byas pa'i khyor gang steng du/ gur gum/ gi wang / gla rtsi/ pri yang ku ste mchin tshad sel ba'i sman bzhi ste/ tig ta/ bong nga dkar po/ gser gyi me tog dom mkhris te/ mkhris tshad sel ba'i sman bzhi/ brag zhun/ lcags phye/bya 'phur leb/ khur mong rtsa ba ste/ pho tshad sel ba bzhi/ skyu ru ra/ ba sha karu rta/ ma nu ste khrag tshad sel ba bzhi/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ utpal/dug mo nyung ste/ tsha ba spyi sel bzhi/ cu gang / ka ko la/ sug spel/ dzā ti ste sman gyi mthun sdeb bzhi/ gser mdog pi pi ling / se 'bru/ li shi ste 'du ba cha snyoms pa bzhi/ gangs thigs/ lug ru dmar po/ mi'i sog thal/ dri chen te smug po'i gsang sman bzhi rnams thun bzang ba re/ rtsa la 'khrid pa'i rgyal mo ka ra thun bzhi/ 'di rnams rtsi bzhin btags pa'i phye ma/ 'u su'i bskol thang gis phul nas/ gung gnyis la thun chung yun bsrings nas bsten na smug po'i tsha grang 'thab pa dang / rnying (rnyings tshad/ 'khrugs rnying /dug gi nad rigs thams cad la bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur ro// nad rnying shin

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 533tu phan dka' ba la/ dngul chu dul ma/ mu zi ser po/ hong len rtsa ba/ chu rtsa ste/ nad rnying zhen pa 'gog par byed/ sbyor ba 'di la zla shel bdud rtsi'i myu gu zhes bya ste/ drang srong rgyun shes kyi gdams pa'o// de rnams ma grub na/cong zhi khram khrum brdungs pa bre gang / lcags dreg khram khrum brdungs pa phul do/ ma nu/ 'u su star bu gsum thur 'go re/ phye ma rtsi bzhin btags pa sbrang rtsi phul phyed dang bsre/ de dang cong zhi lcags dreg rnams bsregs te zhogs pa re la khyor ba re/ chu skol gyis phul nas rgyun btsugs/ cong zhi'i dam tshig tu/sha mo/ mar nag lo tshod/ shing thog sngo'i rigs rnams thams cad 'dzem/dri ma 'gags na lo tshod la mar sdor bzang po btab la btang / nyung ma'am la phug brdar ba'i tshod ma btang / des phan par 'gyur/ de yang ma grub na/cong zhi khram khrum brdungs pa kho na lo 'khor du bsten pas smug po'i nad la zab/ smug ser 'thab pa la ni/ lcags dreg gcig pu bsten pas nad slong sdud/ zhi sbyong thams cad byed/ myur du phan par the tshom med do// zas skom ni bsil drod snyoms pa bsten/ khrag tshod/ mar rnying / la phug zwa/ dwa ba/sne chod/ mar nag zho chang ma langs pa/ shing tog ma smin pa/ sha ma tshos pa/tshig pa/ khengs po'i zas rigs rnams 'jom/ spyod lam snyoms shing ma 'khrugs par gnas par bya'o//ldan pa'i nad ni/ rlung mkhris bad kun sogs nad rigs bco lnga po 'di rnams kyi nad dang nad rtags gnyis gnyis 'dres pa la zer/ de yang rlung mkhris ldan pa'i nad la/ sman dang zas skom bsil la bcud pas bcos te/ ri dwags/ ba lang / ra na gzhon gyi sha mar gsar/ 'bras thug sre long / sog yu/ gzhug chung gdus khu la/ sgog skya/ go snyod/ spod du bran pa'i skyo tsha btang / nas dkar gyi chang glum la/ tig ta dang a ru ra mang po chu la sbangs pa'i khu bas bsings pa skom du btang / ma nu bzhi thang la/ go

534 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasnyod dang gser gyi me tog btab nas gdus thang dro 'jam yang yang btang /ar nag sle tres/ cu gang / dzā ti/ ru rta/ li shi gser gyi me togasug smel/ ka ko la/ bzang drug sle tres/ kuṇḍa ka ri/ sgog skya'i thal ba/go stod/ bur dkar rnams cha mnyam pa'i phye ma sre long gsar pa'i thang gis phul la btang / dzā ti/ ru rta/ li shi gser gyi me tog ka ra'i phye ma btang / mar gsar la gla rtsi btab pa'i bsku mnye bya/ rlung dang bad kun ldan pa'i nad la/ zas skom dro la bcud pas bcos te/ lug dang g.yag rgod gcan gzan dang / khyim bya'i sha dang / sha khu chang zhim nar son/ 'bri mar 'bru mar byin/ sgog btsong tshod ma la tsha ba gsum gyi spod bran la btang /sman ni ma nu bzhi pa la tsha ba gsum dang sre long gsar pa btab pa'i gdus thang tshan mo yang yang btang / yang na bca' lha/ rgyam tsha/ pi pi ling a ru ra/ dzā ti'i thang btang / yang na tsha ba gsum/ rus bcud gsum ste/sman dgu'i thang btang / mgo lci zhing 'thom na/ phag thod ji tsam rnyed pa dang / nya rus/ 'u su/ bca' lga gdus pa'i thang btang / phan dka' mgo 'khor na/ ltag pa'i sdud sgo/ spyi gtsug mtshogs gsang la me btsa' bya/shing kun gyi chab mig btang / rlung dang khrag tu ldan pa'i nad rigs la/ dzā ti/ ru rta/ ma nu/ skyu ru ra'i thang yang yang btang / yang na ma nu bzhi pa la/ru rta btab pa'i thang yang btang / sman dang zas spyod kyis rlung nad gso zhing / gang gzer ngos kyi rtsa gang rgyas la khrag shed dmad pas 'tsho'o de nas bad mkhris ldan pa'i nad la zas skom bsil drod snyoms pa bsten/ ma nu/'u su/ pi pi ling / tig ta/ bal dkar lo ma'i thang yang btang / g.ya' kyi/ ngang pa gser sgong / ri 〈 spyang tsher/ dur byin gdus pa'i thang gis skyug drang (drangs / cong zhi/ khron bu/ bal dkar thang gis phul nas yun du bsten pas phan/ bad kun dang khrag tu ldan pa phal cher/ smug po dang

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 535bcos 'dra zhing / gzhan du skyugs drangs pa dang / gtar ga bya'o// mkhris pa dang khrag tu ldan pa'i nad la ni/ gtar ga dang bshal ga bur la sogs bsil gyi sman bstud par bya'o//de nas 'dus pa'i nad ni/ bad smug dang / gyur pa'i dug dang / ma smin tsha ba sogs yin zhing / ngo bo rlung mkhris bad kun gsum 'dus pa ste/rtags kyang gsum gsum 'dres pa ston/ bcos tshul ni/ nad rigs gsum ga'i bcos bya dgos kyang / tsha shas che ba dang grang shas che ba'i bcos gnyis su 'dus pa las/ rtsa chu na lugs khrag mkhris dang 'dra ba la/ phyi sha lpags (pags mi bde na/ bsil ba'i byug pa dang / 'jib ru chu lums bcings lums kyis bcos/ nang don snod mi bde na/ gtar ga dang bsil sman bshal gyis bcos/ bar rtsa rgyus mi bde na/ gtar bsreg rtsa sbyong rlangs lums kyis gdon no// 'dus nad gzhir bzhag la/ rtsa chu nad rtags bad rlung dang 'dra shas che ba la/ phyi sha lpags (pags mi bde ba la/ drod lums drod byug me btsa' bya'o// don snod la drod kyi phye ma ril bu/ lde gu sman mar sbyar/ bar rtsa rgyus la rtsa sbyong chu tshan dang rngul 'don bya/ de thams cad la spyi 'gro'i gzhi sman 'di nyid gal che la/ shas gang che bar kha bsgyur ni mde kha gdags so// de la a ru ra gser mdog brag zhun dngas ma'i khaṇḍa/ cong zhi thun gsum rgyal po/ bzang drug thun bzang re blon po/ ma nu ru rta se 'bru gsum btsun mo/ pi pi ling rgyam tsha 'u su sras/ sga skya rgyal mo ka ra 'bangs yin pas/ rgyal po'i phyed dang mnyam pa'i blon po/ btsun mo sras 'bangs rnams btang nas/ kha sgyur gang dgos skabs dang sbyar ba shin tu phan pa'i sbyor ba yin no//de nas tsha ba'i nad bcos pa ni/ nad rtags dang bcos thabs spel mar ston pa ni/ chu mdog dmar ser rnyog cing ku ya mthug co phra 'ing

536 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigamagyogs la spun/ mgo dang tshigs dus nywa bzhi na/ lus brtse/ grang shum byed/ ba spu ldang / rkang lag brkyang bskum mang / me dang nyi ma la dad/ phyi tshad che/ rmi lam za zi mang / sems las che/ zas mi 'dod/ lce skya la/rlung 'brum dmar tshim mang ba ni/ ma smin pa'i tsha ba yin pas/ thog ma nas bsil sman dang / gtar bshal byas na tsha ba 'thor 'gro bas spang / drod bcos byas na tshad ro 'bar bas 'dzem/ zas ni 'bras thug chag tshe'i tshod ma/ ri dwags kyi sha gsar/ chu grog phye thug sogs bsil 'jam yang ba bsten/ skom du chu skol btang zhing thub tshad 'thung / spyod lam bsil ba'i sar nyin gnyid spangs la/ mthun pa'i grogs dang bcas te 'dug sman ni/ma nu/ sle tres/ kuṇḍa ka ri/ sga skya bzhi po cha mnyam gdus thang dro 'jam yang yang btang / grang shum chad/ lce steng 'brum chung dmar po zhi/ skom dad che/gzer yod na khol tsher 'dus/ lce mchu so la dreg nag chags/ lus la rngul dri mnam rtsa 'phrang du song / dbang po g.yung na smin pa yin pas/ de ba/gser gyi me tog par pa ta/ ga pur/ a ru ra lnga'i gdus thang btang /des phan dka' na/ de'i steng du tig ta/ hong len zil ba can/ gang ga (ga chung / bong nga dkar po bsnan pa'i grang mo btang / des kyang tsha ba ma chogs na ga bur thun log gi steng du/ a ru ra gser mdog gla rtsi/ cu gang /bong nga dkar po/ tsan dan dkar po lnga thun tshad re/ ka ra dkar po thun bzhi zhib btags gangs chus phul la gung gnyis btang / stod lci zhing gzer na/ lag pa'i rtsa la gtar/ mgo na na mtshog gsang dbye/ dpral rtsa gtar/pho long na ba dang / 'khru na bsil ba'i bshal btang / zas skom drod can gyi rigs thams cad spang bar bya'o// rlung gi rims thams cad la/ phag ril/sgog skya/ srad dkar/ snya lo'i rtsa ba/ kyi lce dkar po lnga'i rtsa ba cha mnyam/so sor dud pa ma shor bsregs thal/ ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma chang gis phul na

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 537mchog tu phan/ ri thang mtshams su bdud rtsi dang 'dra'o// de nas ri thang mtshams kyi 'phrang ni/ chu mdog dmar yang dwangs la sla/ ku ya med dam srab/ dkrugs na lbu ba che/ dri dang bro ba med/ chu bungs che/ skra rtsa seng /lce dmar zhing skam la tsub/ mig har/ gnyid mi khug phyi tshad che/ khyad par rlung gsang brdzis na mnan mi bzod/ rtsa myur du rgyug kyang mnan mi bzod par sbug stong par 'byung / de dus zho smin pa bu ram btab pa cung zad byin/ sga/ dzā ti/ go snyod gsum gdus pa'i thang dro 'jam btang na nangs par lce rlon pa dang / shes pa gsal du song / kha zas rim gyis glod/tsha bas che ba la/ mdun rgyab kyi rlung gsang la me btsa' bya/ tshad gzhug lus kyis dogs na/ sman bsil la thun chung ba yun bsrings nas gtang zhing /kha zas bsil bcud kyis lus zungs gso'o// rlung kha mnan par bya'o//rgyas pa'i tsha ba ni/ thog ma nas smin pa ste rtsa mkhrangs /mkhrang 3/'dril mgyogs/ chu dmar ser dri ro ku ya che la gar/ gzer brtan lus shed 'chor/ lce la bad kun mthug lus la rngul gyi dri mas khyab/ glo lu/lud pa dmar ram/ rnag dang dud khu sogs/ tsha (tshwa bro ba 'byung / skom la dad/ rig pa nyog pa 'byung ste/ 'di smin par sgug na tsha bas sro/ga la rgol bas ga bur sogs bsil sman sbyar ba sman gyi chu/ rtse chung thog babs su gtar ba dpyad kyi chu/ kha zas yan (yin la gtad pa zas kyi chu/ bsil sar dal bar bsdad pa spyod lam chu/ chu bzhi sprugs pas myur du ldog pa la/bsil ba'i bshal gyis nad dbyung bar bya zhing / ri thang mtshams su shin tu bsgrim pa gal che'o//de nas stongs pa'i tshad pa ni/ nad rtags gzhan rnams tsha ba dang 'dra ba la/ rtsa myur la stong / chu dmar la dwangs/ bungs che zhing lbu ba dmar/khyad par bsil bsten pas tshad rtags cher 'gro/ rlung gsang bye ba sogs

538 ༄7g.yu thog snying thiga'abyung / 'di la bsil dang gtar gas ded na gshin rje'i lag tu gtod pas/'di la dang po bur zho dang / go snyod bsku mnye bya/ gsur dud sogs kyis nyams dmad nas/ rjes su rde'u drod bcud kyi sbyor ba dang / tshabs che rlung gsang la me btsa' yang bya/ sman ni/ ar nag li she ru rta/ shing kun/kha ru tsha/ spos dkar/ gu gul/ sgog skya/ go stod/ sman sga/ snying zho sha rnams thun bzang ba re/ dzā ti rdog po re/ 'di rnams kyi phye ma rus rnying chang du gdus pa'i khu ba tshan mo'am/ bur chang gis phul la btang na mchog tu phan no// yang rlung tshad 'thabs pa la/ lug gi gzhug chung lnga'am bdun khram khrum du brdungs pa dang / lug thong tsher gyi bal tshi can bsed pa spar ba gang chang zhim nar son du gdus pa'i khu ba la brag dreg dmar po thun bzhi/ga bur thun log cu gang / gur gum/ gla rtsi/ gser mdog thun tshad/ dzā ti sran ma tsam/ ka ra thun gnyis/ 'di rnams phye ma byas pas bran la btang /gos kyis byibs la rngul dbyung / zas bsil bcud btang bas sel lo//gab pa'i tsha ba ni/ gting du tsha ba gab pa la/ nad rtags tsha bar mi mngon pa de ngos 'dzin pa ni/ rtsa dal la gting grims/ chu sngo dkar ldog pa skyen/ ku ya mthug cing ling gis 'dril/ sman dpyad zas spyod 'phral du 'phrod pa ltar snang yang / bstud na gnod/ khyad par pho ba/ mkhal ma/ snying gsum la tsha ba zhugs na/ khrag rlung dang nor nyen che bas/ zhib tu brtag par bya'o//bcos thabs ni gzhung las/ gab tshad grang ba'i 'go /mgo phur drod kyis bshu// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar se 'bru lnga pa sogs drod kyi phye ma dang /de dang mthun pa'i zas spyod bsten pas/ dang po bad rlung la slebs pas phan snyam byed/ bar du bad rlung thal bas phan gnod med/ tha ma gting tshad la slebs nas gnod pa tshor ba 'byung / de'i dus su nang nas bsil sman dang bsil zas bsten/ phyi nang dpyad ni/ snying la gab na snod kha gtar/ pho

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 539bar gab na ru thung gtar/ mkhal mar gab na byin gzhug gtar/ lus spyir gab na gsum ga gtar ro// sbyongs sogs skabs dang sbyar ro// de rnams kyi spyi 'gro la phan pa'i sman sbyor ni/ dang po bad rlung gi 'go (mgo phur bshu ba'i skabs su/ se 'bru/ shing tsha/ pi pi ling / sug smel/ sga skya/ bal dkar me tog bur dkar cha mnyam phye ma chu tshan gyis phul la btang / yun du bsten/ tsha ba skye mngon pa dang / tsan dan dkar dmar/ gur gum/ cu gang / li shi utpal/ gi wang / 'bras bu gsum/ hong len/ pi pi ling /ka ra rnams cha mnyam pa'i steng du/ snying la gab na/ dzā ti snying zho tha pho mchin la gab na brag zhun/ pri yang ku/ mkhal mar gab na/ gla rtsi/ bong nga dkar po/ mkhal ma zho sha lus spyir gab na/ tig ta/ spang rtsi rdo bo thun re bsnan la/ thun chung ba re chu tshan gyis phul nas yun ring du bsten pas mchog tu phan no//rnying /rnyings tshad ni yun ring du lon pa ste/ nad rtags ni/ gdong snum/ skabs su rngul/ chu ldog pa dka'/ log na ku ya mthug dri dang bro ba che/ kha dog la nges pa med/ skabs su gzer phran ldang / shes pa dang lus lji(lce / stod khengs skabs su mgo dang rus tshigs na/ rtsa phra la gting grims/rlung dang bsdongs na skabs su lus brtse/ ba spu ldang / rus tshigs khol/rlung gsang mnan na mi bzod/ chu lbu ba che/ 'di la zas spyod ni/ bsil drod snyoms pa la/ bsil shas cung chung ba bsten/ sman ni/ tshad rnying kyang pa yin na 'bras bu gsum/ rlung dang bsdongs na sle tres tig ta'i grang thang gung gnyis la zhag mang du yun bsrings la btang / de rjes mang gtar nyung du dbyung / de nas phye ma ni/ tshad rnying kyang pa la/ bsil sman tshogs tshad kyi steng du ga bur bsnan pa'i phye ma thun chung yun bsrings la bsten/ rlung dang bsdongs pa la ga bur thun log tsan dan dkar dmar/ cu gang / gur

540 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagum/ gla rtsi/ gser mdog ka ra phye ma/ lug gi gzhug chung rus pa lnga bdun chang du gdus pa'i khu bas phul na thun chung chung re gung gnyis la btang / gos dron pos byibs la/ rngul ci mang 'don/ spyir snying (rnyings1tshad nang nas phyir 'don pa ni/ ga bur/ cu gang / tsan dan dkar po/ gla rtsi/ gser mdog ka ra cha mnyam pa'i phye ma thun gcig sngo sne'u rgas pa gdus pa'i thang gis phul nas btang bas/ rngul rnams phyir phul bar byed/phyi nas 'dren thabs ni/ shug pa tsher ma can/ bal dkar lo ma/ mtshe/mkhan skya/ 'om bu gla ril rnams khram khrum brdungs la bre re re/ sne'u ral ba can bre do/ de rnams chu mang por btsos te/ khu ba rang la thim pa'i tshe rdo leb rgya chen po me la bsregs pa'am/ rde'u mang po sla ngar brngos pa bting ba'i steng du bkram/ de steng phyar ba btings la/ nad pa nyal du bcugagos dron pos lcibs/ rngul gang byung phyi zhing yang yang 'don/ rjes zas spyod gzabs/ de ltar byas pas rkang lag zha 'khums su gyur pa/ snying (rnyings tshad lus la zhen pa thams cad sel lo// yang tshad gzhug 'don dka' na sbyang bya ste/ a ru ra mchu snyung bco lnga/ ba ru ra rdog po gsum skyu ru ra de dang mnyam/ lcum rtsa mtheb chen tsam gnyis/ dur byid mtheb chen tsam/ 'di khram khrum brdungs nas gtsang mar blugs/ ba chu ma rul ba phul gsum gyi nang du mnye zhing btso/ phul gang du skams pa dang / sbrang rtsi bzang po khyor ba do blugs pa'i dwangs ma/ sgong skogs re nam phyed kyi dus su btang / lto ba 'khrog na chu skol yang yang btang / pho kha mi bde na yos dugs byas pas 'khru ru yong / nyin par 'bras sam/ phye thug sogs zas skom 'jam po btang zhing / nam phyed khrus sman btang / de lta bu'i rgyun bshal lus zungs dang sbyar nas yun bsring / rjes zas spyod gzabs pas tshad rnying yul nas 'byin/yang na smug po gso ba'i skabs su bshad pa'i mang sbyor chen po'i steng du/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 541dngul chu dug phral dang / mu zi gser 'dra/ ga bur gsum bungs cher btab/ 'dam btags snag tsha'i mdog tu ma song bar du byas nas ril bu dril te bsten pas snying (rnyings tshad 'joms/ tig ta'i sman chang yang mchog tu phan no// bcos gzhan gang byed kyang / skabs su skabs su rtsa sbyongs btang ba gnad yin no//rnyogs tshad ni tsha ba chu ser dang bsdong ba yin te/ tsha ba'i rtags spyi'i steng du/ rtsa 'dar chu rgya bshal/ mig chu dang / rkang bol zob pa dang /snying 'phar/ rtse chung rdeb/ dbugs rgod pa sogs chu ser gyi nad rtags 'byung / bcos thabs ni/ dang po 'bras bu gsum/ chu ser sman gsum/seng ldeng / sgron shing / skyer ba'i bar shun/ spyi zhur 'di rnams cha mnyam pa'i thang dro 'jam yun bsrings la bsten/ de rjes stod smad bar gsum gang mi bde ba shas che'i rtsa la mang gtar nyung du dbyung / rtsa sbyong dang chu lums yun bsring / de nas seng ldeng gi sman mar dang / dngul chu ril bu ltag pa sprad la bsten/ ba'i rnam lnga'i sman mar yang sbyar/ mdor na chu ser dang tsha ba'i sman gtso cher bya'o//grang ba'i nad ni spyir stod smad phyi nang gang la'ang / bad rlung gi nad yin pas rtags dang bcos ka yang de bzhin bya'o// bye brag tu/ mkhal rked smad kyi grang ba la/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar gyi steng du/ da byid kyi sha gang rnyed/tshwa sna tshogs tshad/ tsha ba lnga/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ dzā ti/ shing tsha/ ka ko la/sbrul sha lug dang g.yag gi mkhal ma/ mkhal ma go yu/ mkhal ma zho sha'abras sna gsum/ btsong gi rtsa ba/ 'di rnams kha tshar btab la/ a rag bzang po dang / bu ram sbyar ba'i sman rta byas la btang / gcan gzan gyi sha gang rnyed bza'/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa rked la dkri/ 'ba' cha brngos pa dugs bya'o// gzer mig byung na me btsa' bya'o// khyad par lhang par rde'u

542 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigachags pa la bshig pa'i gdams pa ni/ ze tsha sgo nga gang / rgya tsha thun gsum las mi nyung ba/ mtshur dkar nag mtheb tshigs tsam re/ rgyam tsha/ kha ru tsha/ze tsha/ rwa tsha/ tsabs ru tsha/ thal tsha/ tsha la dul ma/ ya ba'i ra/ byang gi bul tog 'di rnams gtso byas tshwa sna tshogs tshad thun bzang ba re/ sga skya/ pi pi ling / dbyi mong / tsi tra ka thun log re/ pho ba ris thun gsum/ se 'bru/shing tshwa(tshan/ sug smel/ mkhal ma zho sha 'jam 'bras/ lcam pa'i 'bru/gla rtsi/ a ru ra'i rtse mo thun tshad re/ glo yul gyi sdig pa bubs gcig so bya'i gre ba dang / pho ba mtheb tshigs tsam/ so bya'i sgro gzhob thun gnyis/ go bo'i pho ba dang brun thun log re/ bong thor nag po'i lag mig /rmiganagayas pa brdar ba ser tsam bsregs pa thun lnga/ gser gyi bye ma thun gnyis/ star bu thun bzhi/ dung thal/ 'gron thal/ sbrul sha gsang ba sman gcig ces bya ba ste/ pho la mo rdel mo la pho rdel 'di tsho thun bzang ba re/ rgya rtsang (rtsangs gi sha mtheb tshigs tsam/ 'di rnams rtsi bzhin btags pa la/ bu ram gyi ril bu sran ma tsam dril la/ chang bzang pos phul la/ ril bu gsum gsum sum yar du btang du btang / nya phag gi sha ci thub za/ dpyad 'di ltar yun bsrings pas/ rde'u'i rigs thams cad zhu zhing zhig nas chu lam du 'byung bar 'gyur ro// rde'u 'khrul zhig chen mo zab/ grang ba'i bye brag gi nad rigs la/ yul grang sar stan srab mo la tsog pur 'dug yun ring ba'am/zas bcud med dang / spyod lam 'khrugs pa sogs kyis bshang lam du srin bu dkar zhib khab rtse 'dra ba mang du 'phel te/ dgongs ku'i dus su 'dug mi tshugs pa'i za 'phrug dang / tsha zug cher skye/ tshabs chen gzhang kha lug pa dang / khrag tu 'dzag pa'ang srid/ 'di la zas spyod drod bcud kyi rigs bsten/ gzhang lug na/ phag rkang snum ldan rnying pa me la bsros pa'i dugs bya/ sgog gcig ma/ dwa ba'i rtsa ba/ thang phrom 'bru/ bca' lga/ pho ba ris/

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 543byi tang ga thar nu rnams cha mnyam/ ra tshil btul ma'am mar rnying ngam/phag tshil rnying pa gsum gang rnyed la sbyar/ bal dang bsres pa'i ring (reng3bu mtheb chung gi rtse tsam bshang lam gzhug go/ gal te des ma phan na/ byi tang ga khyor ba gang zhib btags mar sbyar ril bu lto stong la sran ma rlon pa tsam gsum gsum rgyun bsrings nas zos na phan no// shin tu gso dka' na/thar nu bzang po dgun stod brkos pa skam rlon gang rnyed mtheb tshigs tsam zhib btags/ chang nying khu khyor ba gsum la btso/ khu ba rang la thim pa dang /lan tshwa thun gsum dang / byi tang ga rdog po nyer gcig zhib btags bsres pas thun gsum du bcad de/ srod/ nam gung / tho rangs gsum chang gis ded la btang / nang 'khrog na chu skol yang yang btang / des gzhang srin thams cad 'khru bar 'gyur ro// rjes la zas spyod gzabs/ smi:lus la drod ye mi phebs pa'i rigs la ni/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su bshad pa'i rdzas kyi gtum mo de bsngags shing / lar grang ba'i nad rigs thams cad/ bad kun skya bo dang / rlung nad gso ba'i skabs dang / 'khrul 'khor sdeb shes par byas la bcos pa shin tu gal che'o//khrag gi nad ni phyi nang stod smad gang na yang / slong rkyen zas skom kha skyur lan tshwa ha cang thal ba las 'byung zhing / spyod lam dal bor 'dug 'phro la/ drag shul byas pa dang / brdabs brdungs/ mtshon phog pa sogs kyis bskyed/ na lugs la/ khrag gi nad gsar rnying las/ gsar pa phal cher rtsa grims la drag chu dmar ku ya dang rlangs pa che/ skom la dad/ mig dmar/gzer ba brtan/ shas gang che'i phyogs kyi yan lag lci zhing sbrid/ nangs snga lce la bad kun mthug mchin dri ro rgyab na/ tshabs che na dbugs thung / sna khrag dang so khrag mod cing lud pa khrag tu 'ong / nad stobs chen rtags thams cad tshang ba/ 'bring dang tha ma des shes so// de la zhag tu sgug long
