544 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigamed pa'i khrag nad stobs chen la/ de ma thag tu gtar lang (long yod na/tig ta/ skyu ru/ hong len/ ba sha ta ba le ga spang rtsi do bo/ re skon rnams kyi thang gung gnyis la yang yang btang / rjes nad stobs dang sbyar nas/rtse'u chung / sgang rtsa/ drug 'go ru thung la sogs pa gtar/ de rjes ma nu thun bzhi/ ru rta thun gsum/ ka ra thun tshad phye ma rtsi dang 'dra bar byas te/mdzo mo shing gdus pa'i thang gis phul la btang / des ma chogs na/ gur gum/ cu gang / gi wang / ga bur/ tsan dan dmar po/ ru rta/ skyu ru ra/hong len/ mtshal dkar/ rgyal kur rnams phye ma byas la thun re/ mjo /mdzo cher dang ma nu'i thang gis phul la btang / phan dka' 'am/ khrag bshal dgos na/ tsha la thun gsum bsregs pa'i thal ba/ dan rog dug lce bton pa bdun/ thar nu ba chur btul ba mtheb tshigs tsam/ re lcag lcum rtsa/ chu rtsa/ dur byid thun log re/ rgyam tsha lug ril tsam/ srad dkar 'bru thun gcig byang khra rdog po lnga/ sdig srin thun re/ gla rtsi thun tshad/ mtshal dkar thun bzang ba zhig star zhun thun tshad/ 'di rnams rtsi bzhin btags la/ a ru ra rtse snyung / skyu ru ra/ btsod/ mdzo mo shing / ma nu/byang bul/ lho sga rnams kyi thang tshan mo hub res phul la btang / des rtsa ltos sbyong dbyung / log non rjes gcod spyi dang mthun/ slong rkyen gyi zas spyod ring du spang bar bya'o// khrag gi na tsha rnying pa la/ rtsa chu nges med du ston srid pas/ gab rnyings dug tshad bad smug gi skabs sogs dang 'khrul 'khor sdeb shes par bya'o// gtso bor dpyad mchog gtar ga kho na shis pas/ lus zungs khrag mdog dang sbyar shes par bya'o// sna khrag ma chod pa la smin mtshams dbyug bcos bya ba'am/ spra bas bsreg sna nang du re lcag phye ma bal 'dab la dgram/ de reng bu byas te khengs pa brdzang / mgo ro stod thams cad chu grang gis rgyun bran/ nang nas sna khrag kho rang sla ngar brngos pa'i phye ma

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 545de/ dom mkhris dang mi mkhris gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i mkhris sna tshogs tshad dang / brag gi mtshe/ mkhan skya/ skyer shun/ sran ma'i me tog spru ba'i 'bru rnams gdus pa'i thang gis phul nas btang / rtse chung g.yas g.yon gyi 'go dang dpung 'go dbugs kyis gar sleb tu me btsa' gdab/ tshabs chung ba la/ sgro sungs kyi phye ma yos tshig chig thang gis 'phul la btang / mngal khrag 'byams pa la/ rgyal kur bzang po chang gis phul la btang / yos tshig thang yang btang / rta lpags pa'i thang yang btang / mtshal dkar dom mkhris rgyal kur gsum/ rgya chos /tshos zhu mkhan gyi khu ba phyung ba'i khaṇḍa la btab nas ril bu lug ril tsam/ chang gi snying khus phul na mi phan mi srid do//de nas chu ser gyi nad rigs bcos pa ni/ nad rigs mang yang chu ser dkar nag gnyis su 'dus/ dkar po'i rigs thams cad kyang grang ba dang bsdongs la/ nag po'i rigs thams cad kyang tsha ba dang bsdong / gdon rgyab sa bdag klu gnyan gyis byed/ tshabs che ba rnams mdze nad dang 'bring po dreg grum/ thams kyang (tha ma me dbal/ glang shu bas ldag za phrug mgo lus kyi rma rnams nyes pa tha (mtha' dag skyed par byed do// rtags ni spangs sbos/shu thor/ dmu rdzings/rdzing 3/ smin ma byi/ sha ro sha 'phrig tsha tsag za sbrid/grang thig mig rtsa 'gyur ba la sogs 'byung / de dag kun la phan pa'i gnyen po ni/ 'byor ldan rin po che la brten pa dang / dbul phongs gang 'byor la brten pa'i tshul gyis gso ba'o// dang po ni/ gser zho gang thog mar lhad dang phral/ de rjes sbyang shog (gshog tu brdung bar byas/ de nas tsha brdungs bya ste shin tu zhib par btags/ de nyid a ru ra gser mdog gcig nag mtshur sbu /lbu ba thun gsum/ rgya tshas gtsor byas tshwa sna tshogs tshad thun re/ star zhun thun gsum/ byang bul thun bzhi gdus pa'i dwangs ma lan gsum bkru/ mu zi gser 'dra dul ma gser gyi ljid dang mnyam ldan/

546 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigatsha la sum ldan/ til nag gi 'bru thun bzang re/ zar ma thun gsum rtsi bzhin du btags la/ rnyed na zar ma'i mar khu/ ma rnyed na mar nag gi 'phang lo bya/ ras gtsang ma dang sol 'dag gis tshul bzhin du dril la dal bus bskam ste/ mu zi dri ma sogs (sangs kyi bar du har sbud mi bya bar ga le gnyug bsrings la bsreg tsos nas gser thal de dang tsha ba gsum/ tsha /tshwakyesna gsum la sogs pa lan tshwa'i rigs rnyed tshad/ star bu thun bzang gsum dang bcas pa gdus pa'i khu ba dwangs mas yun ring du btsos te/ gser sreg byed kyi gnyen po'i thal ba dang ma bral gyi bar du'o// de nas slar yang lan tshwa sogs kyi dri ma yang ma dag gi bar du chu gtsang gis legs par bkrus te/gser thal dri ma gzhan bral te/ chang gi phabs lta bu/ sman gzhan thams cad kyi nus pa bskyed pa'i rgyal po bla na med pa gong na med pa'o// gser thal zho gang / dngul chu zho gang / mu zi ser po dul ma zhi /zhonagang / lhan cig lcags sder gyi nang du me che chung 'tshams pa la bzhu zhing legs par dkrugs pa snag tsha 'dres pa ltar rdo gzhong drod ldan du snga dro gcig 'thag shing kun/bong nga nag po/ gu gul nag po/ shu dag a ru ra gser mdog ru rta bzang po zho re re/ bzang drug lhad med thun log steng / stag sha chu ser sman gsum/ nus pa can gyi bdud rtsi/ zangs thal/ seng ldeng khaṇḍa thun gsum gsum/ 'di rnams so sor rtsi bzhin 'thag go/ de nas thams cad bsres/ lo brgyad chus 'dam thag ('thag nyi ma gsum byas/ rgya snag lta bur gyur tshe/ gla rtsi 'brum bu can thun bzang ba gnyis chu la sbyangs te bsres/de nas ril bu sran chung tsam dril nas/ sman lto dang sbyar te yun bsrings nas bsten na/ mdze nad dreg grum gyis gtso byas chu ser gyi nad rigs thams cad dang / stang (stengana'og gi gdon thams cad 'joms/ khong srung du bsten 'gos nad thams cad srung bar 'gyur ro// de ltar ma lcogs na btsan

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 547dug 'bri tshil ma/ sha chen dul sungs med pa/ pi pi ling ljid mnyam/ chang bzang pos 'dam btags byas pa'i ril bu sran chung tsam dril bas/ chu ser gyi nad grang shas can thams cad la phan/ bcan (btsan dug a ru ra gser mdog seng ldeng khaṇḍa/ spos dkar rta so ma cha mnyam/ lo brgyad dri chus 'dam btags byas pa'i ril bu bsten na/ chu ser tsha shas che ba rnams la shin tu phan no// khyung lnga mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yun ring du bsrings nas bsten na yang mdze nad la shin tu phan no// mu zi gser 'dra dul ma dang /a ru ra rgya gar ma cha mnyam sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i ril bu cha bskyed nas btang na mdze la mchog tu phan/ seng ldeng dang / dri chen dang / bse zho'i sbyor sde yang phan pa ni gzhung gzhan du shes par bya'o// sa rlan dang kha char na bun shas che zhing nyi ma shar chung ba'i sar/ zas bcud med zos pa'am/ lus sbyangs sam/ lus kyi bya ba drag po mi byed par/ dal bur 'dug pa sogs la/chu ser gyi nad/ chu nad ces bya ba 'byung ste/ nad rtags ni/ sha spob cing skrangs sob tu 'gyur nas ldir ba'am/ yang na sha pags 'thom skam mdog sngo/dang ga 'grib/ zas kyang pho bas mi 'ju/ gnyid yer ba'am/ steng shod che/lus cha nas lji/lci / dbugs rgod/ snying rdab/ yan lag zha rengs 'khums pa dang / stod 'tshangs la sogs pa 'ong / 'di rigs drod bcos 'phrod kyang / nad rtags rtsa chu tsha ba ston pa yang 'ong bas/ zhib tu ma brtags par/gtar ga dang ga bur btang ba sogs byas na phung bas/ lags (legs par blo zhib pa gal che/ nad 'di thal na/ mdze dang / dreg grum dang / dmu 'or skya rbab sogs su 'gro nyen yod pas bsgrim/ bcos thabs ni/ dang po se 'bru thun gsum/ sug smel/ shing tshwa(tshan/ pi pi ling thun bzang zhigakha che gur gum thun bzang gnyis/ bur dkar thun gsum rnams phye ma rtsi las zhib par btags la/ nangs snga mo chu skol gyis phul ba thun re btang ba rgyun

548 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig bsring ba gal che/ de nas mkhris pa dang / 'khrugs rnying gi nad gzhi tshabs chen snga gong nas yod pa re re tsam ma gtogs pa chu nad kyi rigs stod smad phyi nang gang du byung yang / btsong bu'i tshod ma tshos par btsos la g.yag lug mdzo'i ol mdud dang / wa sha gang rnyed dang zhib tu brdungs la btab/mar dang lan tshwa yang ran par btab nas 'grangs ran tsam ster/ nya shagacan gzan sha rta bong gi sha sprang rtsi dug med nas rnying gi zan/ chang zhim rgyab med bsten/ zas skom dang sman thun chung ba yun bsrings nas/ snga ma zhu rjes ting ma btang ba gal che'o// thun che na 'ju dka' zhing nad sna tshogs skyed par 'gyur bas spang / des ma zhi na chu ser gyi 'phrul bshal btang ste/ sngon 'gro la mkhan dkar/ sbang ma chu 'jam bsros pa'i khrus byas/rjes spang spos kyi phye ma mar khur sbyar bas/ lto ba ma gtogs bsku mnye them par bya'o// legs par 'phur zhing legs par bsrub/ sngon du 'gro ba'i sman ni/ sga tig nag po'i khaṇḍa lug ril tsam gsum/ ze tsha/ gtsang g.yer/byang bul thun log re/ 'bu skyogs dung 'dra rdog po bcu gcig 'di rnams zhib btags ril bu dgu byas te/ rab sha ba'i sha khu/ 'bring nags kyi 'obs kyi sha khu/ de ma rnyed na/ za'i rtsa lo brdungs khus phul la/ ril bu gsum gsum srod kyi dus su btang ste/ zhag gsum song nub ril bu rdzogs pa dang / dngos gzhi'i sman ni/ sga tig khaṇḍa lug ril tsam pa bzhi dang / thar nu bzang po dgun stod brkos pa mtheb chen tsam pa zhib btags ba chu khyor ba gsum dang bsres te khu ba rang la thim pa dang / dan rog lce shun phral ba gsum/ a ru ra'i rtse gsum/ dur byid thun gsum/ spos dkar rta so ma/rgya tsha/ sdig srin/ ba dmar chu'i khaṇḍa rnams bzang ba thun re/ mtshal dkar thun phyed byang ba dmar khra rdog po lnga/ 'di rnams rtsi bzhin du btags la/ ril bu sran ma phos pa tsam du dril la/ nub mo zwa tshod phor gang ster/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 549srod dus ril bu lnga dang / mar lug ril tsam/ chang gar ma hung /hubakagacig gis phul la btang / gos dro bar bya/ zug gar skyes su rde'u brngos pa'am/ yos dugs bya/ skyugs na rdo grang ske la bdug cing / gdong la chu lcag brdeg ma phigs na/ ril bu thun chung la grangs mang bar bskyar/ lcag ni mi gtong ba gnad yin/ rlung stobs chen skyes na gsur gyis bdug mdzo mar gyis bsku mnye bya/ sha chen rul sungs med pa thug pa bskol ba'i skyo tsha bsten/ sbyangs rjes gcod pa ni/ 'bras sam phye thug shin tu tshos shing thon par bskol ba'i sla se ba thengs 'ga' ster/ de rjes 'bras sam phye thug mar gsar sdor ldan dang / btsos zan sla mo 'grangs tsam sbyin/ bsran bzod na zhag 'ga' skom la 'dzem/ bsran mi bzod na sha chen rul sungs med pa'i thang ngam/ 'bras chos par bcos pa'i thang ngam bsnur te/ mar gsar cung zad btab pa gdus pa'i dwangs ma sla mo'am/ thang tshan mo yang yang blud/des kyang shin tu bsran mi bzod na/ da trig 'bru'i shun pa 'u su/ se 'bru lcam pa'i 'bru rnams khram khrum brdungs pa'i thang gi dwangs ma grang du bcug la skom du bsten/ de rjes sha gsar gyi tsho khu sogs zas skom bsil drod snyoms la 'ju sla zhing / bcud dang ldan pas lus zungs gso ba gal che/ 'phrul bshal 'dis ni/ spyir chu ser gyi nad rigs thams cad dang / khyad par dmu 'or skya rbab dang / dreg grum chu nad la mchog tu phan pa'i gdams pa'o//'phrul bshal lus zungs kyis mi lcogs pa rnams la/ sga tig khaṇḍa cha gnyis kha che gur gum a ru ra gser mdog gnyis cha re re zho la btegs nas ma 'byugs pa byas la/ phye ma ril bu gang bde/ mar gsar mar khu hub res lto stong la phul te btang / chu ser tsha ba pags la mched pa'i me lce 'khor lo la/me dbal zhes grags pa la thog mar dngul chu zho phyed/ mu zi ser po dul ma zho phyed gtun drod ldan la snga dro cig 'thag de steng du byang ba dmar khra rdog po

550 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigalnga/ rgya tsha thun bzang ba cig a ru ra gser mdog gcig gi sum cha/btsan dug bzang po sran ma tsam gnyis/ thar nu bzang po mtheb tshigs tsam gnyis/ ba chu'i khaṇḍa thun gnyis/ rtsi bzhin btags pa'i ril bu sran tshod rim pas bskyed la chu skol gyis 'phul btang / rtsa lto'i sbyangs thebs nas sman 'phro bcad la chu skol gyi lcag mang du btang / rjes zas spyod la gzabs/ phyi nas byug pa ni/ brag zhun dud pa/ lham mthil gyi dreg pa/ rkang rus rnams dang / mi khyi phag gi brun/ spyang brun chu rtsa stag shā kyi lce dkar po'i rtsa ba/ra dug rtsa ba/ mu zi ser po/ shu dag gla rtsi/ tsan dan dmar po/ spru ma'i rtsa ba/ 'di rnams gang 'byor la/ thar nu dud pa ma shor ba bsregs pa'i dud sol yal/ re lcag rtsa ba/ bre ga'i 'bru rnams dpung chen bzang / de rnams rtsi bzhin btags pa la/ lo brgyad dri chu'am/ ba chu la sbyar nas byugs/ tsha dbal chogs nas shu ba song dus/ spos dkar mar nag la bzhu ba/ sug pa/ btsan dug thar nu rnams dud pa ma shor ba phye tshig tsam bsregs pa'i phye ma bsres nas byug cing nyi ma la bsregs pas phan/ shu ba phan dka' ba la/ thar nu/ bul tog chu rtsa/ mu zi/ lan tshwa/ dud pa/phabs/ mar rnying sbyar ba byugs nas nyi ma la bsreg yang sngo'i tsha ba gsum/ra dug pa/ thar nu/ chu rtsa/ shog sngon gyi thal ba rnams mar dang sbyar nas byug pas phan/ yang na spos dkar mar nag la shu dag yung ba/ rams/thal ka rdo rje rnams phye ma btags pa byug yang thal ka rdo rje/ g.yer ma/sbur ba/ dri chen/ chu rtsa mar nag dang sbyar nas byug pas phan/ yang na byang ba/ mu zi/ bul tog thar nu/ chu rtsa/ phag tshil rnying pa sbyar ba byug pas phan/ yang na g.yer ma/ pi pi ling / thar nu/ spru rtsa/ mu zi/ lan tshwa mar sbyar byug pas phan no// thor pa dkar nag gi rigs gang yin kyang dngul chu zho gang / mu zi dul ma zho gang dang lhan cig gtun dro 'jam bral ba snga dro cig

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 551'thag de la btsan dug a ru ra zho phyed re bsres te/ skam btags nyi ma phyed byas nas/ rna 'bru re re chang zhim hub res phul nas btang / rngul dbyung na shin tu phan no// 'dis gag lhog gzer gsum/ rims nad gzhan thams cad dang / srin glang thabs kyang sel lo// gser thal ma 'dzom yang /gong gi dngul chu'i sbyor ba kho nas/ chu ser gyi nad rigs du ma 'joms/sbrang rtsi dug can cha yis goms pa zos na'ang / chu ser gyi nad rigs phal la phan no// rus la zhen pa'i chu ser gyi nad rigs phal che ba ni/ sbrang chang mchog tu shes shing / seng ldeng gi sman mar yang bsngags so//gnyan gyi nad ces bya ba ni/ rang gi lus la snod /gnod bya bcu yod pa'i lus zungs kyi nang nas/ khrag gang du gnas pa'i sar/ lhan cig skyes pa'i srin bu zangs kyi mdog can/ shin tu phra ba mig gi 'bras bu ltar mi mngon pa bdun mchis pas/ skad cig yud tsam la spyi gtsug nas zang mthil yan chad kyi lus zungs bdun po'i sar rgyu nus pas/ rnam par ma gyur na lus zungs kyi grogs su 'gyur la/ dus gdon zas spyod kyis rkyen pa'am/grib dang gzhan na ba la 'bags nas 'gos pa sogs kyis bskyed de/ srin khros lus la zos pas/ gag lhog gzer gsum ya ma dang / 'bras kyi rigs nywa log 'khru skyug pho log glang thabs la sogs pa'i nyes pa rnams bskyed pas/rgyu mtshan des na/ dkar mngar zos na de'i nus pas srin gyi gsos su gyur nas/ nad pa'i lus la gnod la/ dug rigs rnams nus pa rno bas/ srin myur du gsod thabs dang ldan pas dug rigs thams cad gnyen po la btang ba'o// de la gnyan rigs gang yin yang / phan che la gnod pa mi skyel ba'i sman sbyor 'ga' zhig bsten par bya'o// de la kun gyi spyi 'gro/ btsan dug 'bri tshil ma/ shu dag nag po bzang chen/ gla rtsi 'brum pa can gsum/ dus su btus pa'i bzang chen/ zho la btegs na ljid mnyam ste/ mdog 'gyur

552 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaba'i mtshal dang bcas pa/ dang por so sor rtsi bzhin 'thag de nas bsres te snga dro gcig skam btags byas/ de nas lo brgyad chus 'dam btags bya/de nas lo brgyad chus bran cing snga dro gcig 'dam btags legs par byas la/ril bu sran ma chung tsam byas te/ rab gnas byas la snod bzang por bcang ngo // dgos dus nad stobs lang tsho sman lto che chung dang sbyar nas btang bas/gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa phyogs med du 'joms/ rims nad klad gzer dang mkhris pa rtsar rgyug srin glang thabs thams cad kyi gnyen po bla na med pa'o// sman nad che na gla rtsi'i thang btang / des ma chogs na pi pi ling gi thang btang /ca des kyang ma chogs na byang tsha bzang po khyor gang / brag skya ha bo thun gnyis zhib btags chang sbyar khar blugs nas/ gdungs skor byas na thub nges so// gnyan bshal du byed na/ ril bu nyer gcig steng du/ thar nu bzang po mtheb tshigs tsam gnyis lo brgyad chu la btul ba dang / chu rtsa mtheb tshigs tsam gnyis/ re lcag de'i phyed/ dan rog gsum/ dur byid lug ril tsam gnyis/ sngon bu thun gnyis rnams zhib par btags/ dri chus ril bu sran chung tsam dril nas/ gu gul thang gis dbul/ lto sbyong ji bzhin btang ngo // gnyan rtsa la byer ba dang / drag pa dka' na/ ril bu nyer gcig la/ byang ba nag po gcig khra bo brgyad/ rgya tsha/ mtshal dkar/sdig srin/ thod le kor/ tsha la'i thal ba rnams thun re bsnan/ phye ma ril bu gang rigs rtsa sbyong ji bzhin btang bas shin tu phan no// thang phrom dkar po'i myu gu sa nas sor bzhi 'phags pa dang / rta lpags ser po gnyis cha mnyam rlon pa'i dus su sngo bsub byas nas grib ma la skam/ de nyid gser mgur mo'i zho gang cung lhag tsam la/ gla rtsi thun gcig bsres te/ chu skol gyis ded nas gos kyis byibs/ sman nad che na tsha (tshwanamar ster ba'am/ skyo tsha mar sdor can ster/ ra tshil gsur dud bya/ mar khus mdun dang rgyab

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 553gzhung legs par byugs nas shed kyis 'phur/ 'di yang gnyan dang srin nad kyi rigs su gyur tshad la shin tu phan no// yang na thang phrom dkar po'i khaṇḍa lug ril tsam/ stag sha bzang po/ ba bla/ gla rtsi rnams kyang thun bzang ba re zhib btags thun gcig byas la/ chu skol gyis ded nas btang / sman nad byung na sngon ltar bsal/ gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad sel lo//khyad par lce 'bam zhes bya ba/ lce la gnyan zhugs pa'ang 'joms pa'i rdo rje bla na med pa'o// khyad par gag pa'i rigs la/ sngar gyi gnyan bshal btang rjes/ rgya tsha/ li shi thar nu/ khron bu/ stag sha shu dag mtshal thal/ rdo thal/ pi ling / dur thod sol mes dkar thul bsregs pa rnams sog sbubs kyis gre bar btab/ khrag 'gags yin na lce rtsa gtar zhing / skrangs pa rnams lce zor gyis gshags/ lhog pa'i rigs la/ sngar bshad pa'i sman de rnams gang gcig gi gnyen pos gsod par bshad/ de rjes tsha grang bstun/gtar bsreg gang 'os kyis rjes bcad/ khyad par lhog rgod thog babs su byung ba la/ rta bla'i ro mgo sug ma nyams pa mar gyis dril la khyur mid byas na shin tu phan/ lag len shes na 'dzin pa gcig pus kyang thub/ rang nyid lcags kyi bya khyung me 'bar ba rwa dang mchu sder gnam lcags ngar ma las byas pa/ lhog pa sogs gnyan nad 'joms par bsams nas/ oṃ nag po kā la rakṣa rbad rbad sod sod byung phyung spu gris zang zang lcags kyu'i sder mos gnod byed 'byung bo'i snying la zo zo/ nā ga byi ma sod/ nā ga byi ma ling sod swāhā/zhes smra ba bcad nas ma yengs par bzlas btab pas gnyan gyi rigs thams cad 'di gcig pus thub/ phyi nas brag zhun btsan dug spyang brun/ phabs/shu dag de lcag bya brun/ sngo lcags kyu/ thar nu/ mu zi/ spru rtsa/ dud pa ral ba can/ mkhan pa/ spang gi zwa tshod kyi rtsa ba rnams brdungs nas byis pa'i chu dang sbyar nas byug pa yang yang bskyar zhing byug de nas gnyan rlung

554 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigadang bsdongs te/ byer zhing gsod dka' ba'i rigs la/ sha sbyor ni/ skyes pa dar ma grir shi ba'i sha rul sungs med pa/ bya rgod 2 te lo'i sha phag nag sha pya shud kyi sha sbal nag sdig nag spur nag dri can gyi sha g.yag sgur thor cog can gyi sha nya sum ba'i sha na bun bu mo'i sha bya rog gi shasre mo'i sha 'di rnams sha chen gtso bo yin pas thun che zhing / 'og ma rnams cha mnyam pa'i steng du/ rgya tsha dang shing kun bungs che na bzang / gla rtsi shu dag dri phyin tsam/ zhib btags phye ma ril bu gang 'os/ chang zhim mam/ chu skol gyis phul nas btang na/ ba mo la nyin mor byed pa bzhin 'joms so yang na ming can nag po ste/ 'ug pa lag pa'i sbyor sde yang bsngags so// dgun stod kyi thar nu sa ma 'khyags pa'i lo ma skam dus brkos pa'i rtsa ba ma rul ma sungs ma 'khyags par skam/ de nyid phye ma rtsi bzhin btags pa/ bre gang la ra mchin gsar pa mtheb chen tsam lnga gzhug chu gtsang bre gsum blugs nas rdza bum du kha chod dam par bcad/ ma 'dregs shing khu ba rang thim par btso/de grib skam byas te zhib par btags/ slar yang cha bzhir byas te/ cha gcig mdzo'i 'o ma/ cha gcig ba chu/ cha gcig lo brgyad chu/ cha gcig chang la so sor sngar bzhin btso/ khu ba thim nas so sor grib skam bya/ skam nas bsres te/ kha tshar la chu rtsa'i khaṇḍa thar nu'i sum cha/ re lcag khaṇḍa thar nu'i bzhi cha/ sngon bu'i khaṇḍa lnga cha/ khron bu'i khaṇḍa drug cha/ 'di dag khaṇḍa ma grub na dngos btang / mdze tsha'am/ tsha la'am/ byang bul gang rnyed drug cha/gur gum/ gla rtsi/ gu gul/ gi wang / dom mkhris sdor 'debs tsam/ rgya tsha tshwa 'debs tsam/ shug tsher can/ spang spos/ be skyes re ral/ stag sha ba/gri sha ra dug spang gi gur gum/ 'di rnams brgyad cha re zhib btags phye ma ril bu gang rung lus stobs sman lto dang sbyar nas btang na/ gag lhog gzer gsum srin dang glang thabs ma zhu gsar rnying gnyan gyi rigs thams

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 555cad 'joms te bla na med pa'o// gal te sman 'og ma rnams ma 'dzom na/gong du bshad pa'i thar nu gzhom 'dul thams cad tshar ba de nyid/ lo brgyad chus ril bu sran rlon tsam du dril la snod bzang por bcangs/ nad stobs lang tsho sbyar nas btang ngo // yon tan gong 'dra/ ldi/de nas srin nad tsha grang gdon sogs gang yin yang / slong rkyen phal cher gnyan dang 'dra ba la/ bar pa ta khong lhog nag po 'di myur du ma bcos na/ zhag bdun tshun la 'chi bas/ 'di la bcos gtso bo phur mong nag po'i rtsa ba lo ma gla rtsi mang po btab nas blud pas 'joms so// srin nad thun mong du ni/ sgog skya/ byi tang ga gres ma'i 'bru/ ma ru tse/ phur mong dud pa ma shor ba bsregs pa'i thal ba/ thang phrom 'bru/ gla rtsi rnams thun tshad re/btsan dug sran ma tsam phye ma ril bu gang 'os chu skol gyis phul na phan/ yang na bying bying thu lu/ dwa ba'i rtsa ba/ ma ru tse/ sro lo dmar po'i rtsa ba lang tang tse/ gla rtsi rnams cha mnyam pa'i phye ma btang / yang na bse sbur/ byang khra bying bying thu lu gsum/ cha mnyam nas gri rtse gang btang / yang srin glang thabs la lham mthil gyi dreg pa bkrus khu la/ tshwa btab nas btung na phan/yang na sla ngar tshwa nag hrug se brngos la/ lo brgyad chu blugs nas 'thungs na phan/ yang gres thag rul ba zhib tu brdungs la/ sla ngar bskol ba la/ la phug skam po tshag tsam gyi phye ma btab nas btang na phan/ yang na gres ma'i me tog dang 'bras bu gang rung thun lnga zhib tu btags/ lo brgyad chu khyor ba bzhi la sbyar/ de nyid sla ngar tshwa nag hrug ma song bar du brngos pa'i steng du sor sgra ldan par blugs nas/ sbu khrug khol ba de blud nas/ srin nad kyi rigs tsam yin pa 'joms/ yang na da lis lo ma dpung chen chur gdus pa'i thang tshan mo yang phan/ yang na shu dag nag po'i chig thang mang po btang na phan/ yang na/ na gi dang gla rtsi mar dkar sbyar ba'i ril bu btang na phan/

556 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigayang na g.yer ma/ bya phur leb/ gla rtsi btang na phan/ yang na spru ba dkar nag gang rnyed kyi rtsa ba'i thang dpung chen btang na phan/ yang stag ma'i me tog thun tshad gsum/ gla rtsi zhad tsam bsres pa 'o mas phul na phan/ yang stag chung ba'i lo ma'i khaṇḍa la/ shug pa 'bus khyer gyi rgyags pa'i phye dang / gla rtsi bsres pa btang bas phan/ yang sngon la zhag gcig gnyis sgog chab byin nas/ thang phrom dkar po'i rtsa ba dgun stod brkos pa skam po lung thang tsam/gla rtsi thun bzang ba gcig btang / sman nad byung na skyo tsha dang / drod slan /sman 'jong mo'i thang btang / zhi dka' na tshwa mar btang / de pho log sogs srin nad kyi rigs thams cad la phan/ yang shin tu zab ba'i bka' rgya ma ni byang gi lan tshwa bzang po/ ba tsha dang bul tog grang shel sogs kyi lhad ma zhugs pa phul gang tsam sla bar brngos/ de la tshwa dang mnyam du nas 'bru gcig bskyur bas/ yos dang sol ba'i bar nag thul gyis tshig pa dang /yang nas 'bru gcig bskyur te tshig pa dang / yang bskyur te tshul de lta bu/nas 'bru bco lnga sol bar tshig pa dang / thar nu bzang po mtheb chen tsam phyed dang gnyis tsam zhib par btags la/ tshwa brngos te li sder nang du byo bas ngang khungadakam yal ba'i steng de nyid du lo brgyad pa'i chu bzar nas gar sla zho tsam la/ thar nu'i phye ma bsres nas ma skam bar du 'thag de nyid snod bzang por bcangs nas/ nam dgos thur 'go re chu skol gyis phul nas btang na/ khong du zhu long med par srin dang glang thabs ma zhu dug thabs thams cad the tshom med par 'joms so// srin bsnyol ba ni/ go snyod thur 'go gang sla ngar tshag thon pa bsregs te/ sbang skam chab mig gis phul nas btang na zab/ dngul chu mu zi rgya tsha btsan dug gla rtsi dwa ba'i rtsa ba/ cha mnyam phye ma gri rtse re re byin na srin nad kun la phan/ yang sman chen dang li shi cha mnyam phye ma rna 'bru re re/ chang ngam chus phul na/ srin dang gnyan rigs gzhan yang
