༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 557sel/ sman 'tshol long gang yang ma byung na/ snod gang la babs pa'i gsang la dbyug pa bya ba dang / rba rlabs 'debs pa kha sbub tu bzhag nas/ rdog rdzis kyis bcag pa sogs byas la/ de rjes srin sman btang nas/ so srin la lcags sreg gis bsreg yang na dkar gong nas tsam brdungs pa ras su gtums pa'i thun gcig mar khu la btsos te smyug thur gyi rtse la bskyon nas/so gang na'i sa ru btsir la yun bsring / yang na srin gyis zos pa'i so khor stong khab rtses brus te/ btsan dug shing kun/ thang phrom 'bru/ byi tang ga gla rtsi/ rgya tsha rnams ril bu sran chung tsam byas la/ gzhug kha spra tshil gyis gcod/cis kyang ma phan na/ thang phrom dkar po/ ra khrag rgya khrag gla rtsi/ gu gul/gna' ba'i rwa gzhob/ shing kun rnams sman nad ldang bar btang / so rtsa lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i yar zur gyi so rtsa rna drung / srin lag gi rtse mor me btsa' bya/ khrag shas che na gtar ba bsngags/ re lcag pa'i rtsa ba mar khur bcos nas/ nag chil song ba re byas nas so bar btsir na yang phan/ srin gyi bye brag ya ma'i nad rigs gang yin kyang / gla rtsi/ ru rta/ byi tang ga byi dug pa/ lang thang tse'i 'bru rnams cha mnyam pa'i phye mar 'o dang sbyar bas thigs pa nyal khar sna bug tu blugs/ des ma phan na/ mu zi/ gu gul/ shu dgagla rtsi/ btsan dug shing kun/ byi tang ga sha ba'i tshil lang thang tse'i 'bru/ ma ru tse rnams cha mnyam pa'i phye ma rnams phan/ ras rgas po dras pa'i nang du dril/ sna nas me 'bar ba'i dud pas snar bdug yang na bong nga nag po/ byang ba nag po/ shu dag nag po/ gu gul nag po cha mnyam zhib btags ril bu sran chung tsam bsten/ tshabs chen skra bzhar la/ 'khyug par rngab ru btsugs/ ra'i glo ba/ chang gi glum klad/ rta sbangs spru rtsa/ stag ma'i lo ma/ phur mong / gna' ba dang gla ba'i klad pa/ khrag rnyed na rab/ gzhan yang dug sna tshogs tshad/ srin sman tshogs tshad rnams bsres pa'i 'byar na

558 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasar glan te/ de steng ras sam pags bus gtums/ khrag ya ma nag po yin na/ gur gum bcu gsum pa btang / rtse chung dang mur gong gtar/ sna bshal gtsug bshal bya/ rlung ya ma la 'khyug rtsa bsreg kun la phan pa ni btsan dug bzang po rdza bum du du ba ma shor ba bsregs pa'i sol ba cha lnga/ gla rtsi/ shing kun/ lang thang tse/ byi tang / phye ma sleb (leb khya bo/ sgog gcig ma/ gla ba'i klad pa/ ra rog dar ma'i khrag rnams cha re re zhib par btags/ phye ma ril bu gang rigs btang na shin tu phan no// thang phrom dkar po'i myu gu'am/ me tog 'bru/ rtsa ba gang rnyed lung thang tsam/ ra khragagla rtsi/ lang thang tse/ byi tang ka rnams thun phran re re/ sha ba'i mjug ma gdus pa'i thang gis phul btang na phan/ rang nyid pha dam pa bsgoms nas/oṃ mu ne mu ni sod/ dzi rdza sod/ gnyan ya ma sod/ gdon ya ma na ba sod/srin bu ya ma na ba sod/ ces bzlas pa'i sngags chu na sa ru blus ste/ byug pa bya'o// yang bya shing rta ma rigs gsum gang rnyed kyi sha sha ba'i mjug ma/skyung ma'i sha mu zi nag po/ gla rtsi rnams cha mnyam/ bong nga nag po zhad tsam zhig de rnams zhib btags phag tshil gyis sbrus la mtheb tshigs tsam ras su gtums/ zangs snod du chu la gdus shing btsir ba'i khu ba na ngos kyi sna bug tu blugs pas shin tu phan no// yang gla rtsi/ shing kun/ ra 'o'am/ mar dkar mar khu sbyar ba snar blugs/ yang na 'dre pad ku'i 'bru'am/ lo ma ra 'o'am/ lo brgyad chus sbyar snar blugs/ phan pa dka' na/ 'khyug sar gtsags la sngar bshad lums bya/ btsan dug mar nag la btsos te sol bar song ba'i mar khu sna dang rna ba na phyogs su blugs na yang phan/ sgog gcig ma dang btsan dug cha mnyam brdungs pa'i 'dag pa/ kham tshig gi nang bkang nas 'khyug rtsa la brlan(glan / chu bur shar tshe phan no//de nas gzer gyi nad rigs la/ khrag gzer ni/ zas tsha skyur rno ba'i

558 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasar glan te/ de steng ras sam pags bus gtums/ khrag ya ma nag po yin na/ gur gum bcu gsum pa btang / rtse chung dang mur gong gtar/ sna bshal gtsug bshal bya/ rlung ya ma la 'khyug rtsa bsreg kun la phan pa ni btsan dug bzang po rdza bum du du ba ma shor ba bsregs pa'i sol ba cha lnga/ gla rtsi/ shing kun/ lang thang tse/ byi tang / phye ma sleb (leb khya bo/ sgog gcig ma/ gla ba'i klad pa/ ra rog dar ma'i khrag rnams cha re re zhib par btags/ phye ma ril bu gang rigs btang na shin tu phan no// thang phrom dkar po'i myu gu'am/ me tog 'bru/ rtsa ba gang rnyed lung thang tsam/ ra khragagla rtsi/ lang thang tse/ byi tang ka rnams thun phran re re/ sha ba'i mjug ma gdus pa'i thang gis phul btang na phan/ rang nyid pha dam pa bsgoms nas/oṃ mu ne mu ni sod/ dzi rdza sod/ gnyan ya ma sod/ gdon ya ma na ba sod/srin bu ya ma na ba sod/ ces bzlas pa'i sngags chu na sa ru blus ste/ byug pa bya'o// yang bya shing rta ma rigs gsum gang rnyed kyi sha sha ba'i mjug ma/skyung ma'i sha mu zi nag po/ gla rtsi rnams cha mnyam/ bong nga nag po zhad tsam zhig de rnams zhib btags phag tshil gyis sbrus la mtheb tshigs tsam ras su gtums/ zangs snod du chu la gdus shing btsir ba'i khu ba na ngos kyi sna bug tu blugs pas shin tu phan no// yang gla rtsi/ shing kun/ ra 'o'am/ mar dkar mar khu sbyar ba snar blugs/ yang na 'dre pad ku'i 'bru'am/ lo ma ra 'o'am/ lo brgyad chus sbyar snar blugs/ phan pa dka' na/ 'khyug sar gtsags la sngar bshad lums bya/ btsan dug mar nag la btsos te sol bar song ba'i mar khu sna dang rna ba na phyogs su blugs na yang phan/ sgog gcig ma dang btsan dug cha mnyam brdungs pa'i 'dag pa/ kham tshig gi nang bkang nas 'khyug rtsa la brlan(glan / chu bur shar tshe phan no//de nas gzer gyi nad rigs la/ khrag gzer ni/ zas tsha skyur rno ba'i

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 559rigs bsten drags pa dang / spyod lam drag shul 'khrugs can gyis bslang bas/ 'di la ma nu dang ru rta'i thang mang du btang / tig ta/ skyu ru ra/ ba sha 1 hong len gyi thang mang du btang / des ma phan na gang gzer ngos kyi rtsa gtar/ tshabs chung ba la ma nu bzhi thang btang / na sar chu lcag brdeg rdo grang glan/ khong du mtshon khrag lhung ste gzer na/ thar nu/ dur byid/ dan rog mchu stung /snyung 3/ sngon bu cha mnyam/ tsha la/ star bu/ byang bul/zhug pa lag pa'i me tog/ rgya tsha rnams kyis kha bsgyur la/ ma nu ba'i thang gis phul nas btang bas shin tu phan/ smi:gnyan gzer la rtsa spun la rtsub/ ba spu ldog 'khun drag dbugs thung / grang shum byed/ chu yi ku ya 'khrugs/ glo lu/ lud pa khrag gam dud khu'am/ ser po 'bab/ nu mchin gzer/ mgo bo na/ 'di la skyes pa dar ma'i sha chen thun gsum/ spang gi gur gum thun bzhi/ thar nu thun drug chu rtsa thun gsum/ re lcag thun gcig 'dzin pa thun tshad gcig rtsi bzhin btags nas/ phye ma ril bu gang rigs chu skol gyis phul/ lag len lto sbyongs spyi dang 'dra/ des gzer 'go cung zad gcig (cig ma chogs na/gtarag dang ga bur sogs gang dgos bya'o// de ma grub na/ lo brgyad chu phul gang la/ dge slong gtsang ma'i brun mtheb tshigs tsam 'dres par dkrugs te dwangs su bcug pa'i dwangs ma de la/ gla rtsi thun bzang ba gcig btab la btang / rngul dbyung shin tu zab/ lbiḥrlung gzer ni/ zas skom bcud med/ spyod lam bser bus bus pa dang / grang shum byed/ chags pas dub pa dang / lto chags/chag / gnyid chags(chag / mya ngan sems las sogs kyis bskyed de/ chu sngo/ rtsa stong /gnyid med/ grang shum byed/ chad pas dub pa dang / khyad par gzer mi brtan par 'pho/ rlung gsang rnams kha bye/ mnan mi bzod/ skra rtse /rtsa

560 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigaseng / lus brtse/ lce dmar la rtsub/ skabs su 'dar/ dgongs mo tho rangs shin tu na/ dbugs stod du 'tshangs/ shugs ring 'byin/ 'di la sman ni/ btsan dug 'bri tshil ma thun tshad gcig dzā ti rdog po gcig a ru ra gser mdog thun gnyis/ kha ru tsha/ shing kun thun log re/ sha chen bzang po kun dang mnyam/ zhib btags bu ram gyis ril bu sran chung tsam du dril la/ chang bzang po'am/ dus rnying tshon po brdungs pa'i thang gis phul la/dgongs dang tho rangs btang / rlung gsang thams cad dang / gzer sar dkar gong chang bran brngos pa'i dugs sam/ 'ba' cha brngos pa'i dugs bya/phying ba snum ldan bsros pa'i steng du/ chab rdo bsros pa'i dugs bya/ lan tshwa ldan pas gtums nas mar nag tu btsos pas bdug bsku mnye gsur dud la 'bad/ des ma phan na/ me btsa' bya/ sgog skya'i sman mar dang btsan dug sman mar dang / rus chen sman mar sbyar/ zas skom spyod lam dro la bcud pas bcos/ smi:de nas rma bcos pa ni/ mgo bo'i rma rigs tshabs che chung gang yin kyang / cong zhi bzang po thun drug gangs thigs bzang po dang / mtshal dkar bzang po cha re/ ka ra dkar po mang na dga'/ phye ma thur 'go re/ chu grang gis phul la btang bas phan/ yang na de steng dom mkhris/ gur gum/spos dkar rta so thun log re/ gi wang gla rtsi thun tshad re/ me tog lug mig nag po/ tsher sngon a wa/ brag spos 'bri rta /tanas 'dzin/ stag sha ba/ myu gu shing / khur mong me tog rnams thun gnyis gnyis/ mdung rtse/ bye 'gokhab len/ nya phyis/ mdze tsha/ ze tsha/ rdo zho thun re bsnan nas/ zhib par btags te thun bzang re sbal rgyab bzang po mdzang /'dzeng dkar ram dkar gong la mdzo mo'i 'o mar brdar ba'i khu ba dmar po sgong skogs res phul nas btang / rma kha la yang 'debs/ 'di ni shin tu zab pa'i lag len ma

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 561yin/ yang na zi ra dkar po/ brag spos/ a wa/ zhing mu la skyes pa'i srad chung ma/ stag sha ba rnams brdungs la ras khug gtsang mar blugs la/ ba tsha med pa'i chu la khu ba thon par sbangs pa'i dwangs ma thur 'go re lhag tsam lto stong la btang / ra gzhon gyi sha ster/ shin tu phan no// lar mgo chag sman thams cad la sbyin bsres na phan no// yang mgo rma la/ pa yag pa'i myu gu/ti gu lam skyes/ stag sha ba ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma btab/ tshabs chen de steng dom mkhris dang / gur gum bsnan/ tsha ba ma chogs na/ de steng ga pur bsnan/ gnyan skyes na gla rtsi bsnan/ sha ro skyes na mtshal thal dang / ldong ros dung thal bsnan/ chu ser dang khrag ngan skyes na/ tsha la bsregs thal dang / mdze tsha bsnan/ sha smyon skyes na/ rgya tsha byang ba bsnan pa zab bo//yang sngo kon pa gab skyes/ seng ge sder mo/ co ga mgo sman/ stag sha dom mkhris kyi phye ma/ rma thams cad la phan/ yang utpal ser po/ khur mong me tog myu gu shing / stag sha tsha la'i thal ba rma kun la phan/ yang stong ri zil ba/ stag mo kha yan/ 'bri rta (tanas 'dzin/ ka ra sbyar bas rma khong gnyis kur btang bas shin tu phan/ yang na myu gu shing / khur mong / a'u tsi/nas (nad ma sgyid ma/ sran chung ma/ lug mur rtsa ba/ dom mkhris sbyar bas rma sman zab/ yang nas /nadakam rigs gsum gyi lo ma/ sngo sga'i lo ma/ khur mong / myu gu shing / dom mkhris/ rma sman zab/ yang na thar nu/ myu gu shing /grib skam byas pa'i lo ma cha gsum/ dom mkhris gur gum cha re'i phye ma/mgo'i rigs kyi rma rnams thams cad la bsngags/ yang bong dkar lo ma/brag spos/ ldum bu re ral/ tsher sngon dom mkhris rnams mgo rma la zab/yang co ga mgo sman/ stag sha sbad dkar mgo rma la phan/ yang brag spos/'bri rta (tanas 'dzin/ sgro ba'i lo ma/ spra ba lu gu rnams rma sman zab/ yang nas /nad ma sgyid ma/ ra zho/ lug zho/ a'u tsi/ bsod nams seng ge

562 ༄zagayu thog snying thigasdum ga bur/ rma bya bcad 'byor/ rma sman zab/ a bhi ṣa zhes kyang bya/ cu gang sgog bsil ma zhes kyang bya/ g.ya' gro ma de nyid/ 'bri ku ratna/ tsher sngon/ chu rtsa/ sngo tsha ba gsum gyi khaṇḍa/ dom mkhris/ gur gum/ tsha la btab na rma sman gyi mchog yin/ ske dang byang khog yan lag rma rnams la/ nang nas rma gsar pa'i dus su/ ga bur/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ gi wang / dom mkhris/ gla rtsi/ gur gum/ mtshal dkar/ li ga dur/ stag sha brag sbos(spos / a wa/ utpal ser po/ myu gu shing / spos dkar rta so ma/ smyug lo kha 'bus/ ka ra rnams kyi phye ma chus phul na phan/ yang 'del pa sbyar pa/mdung shing / som /gsom shing rnams kyi lo ma myu gu/ thang chu pags pa/bar shun ka ra rnams kyi phye ma byas te/ gung gnyis la chu grang gis phul nas btang / skom pa'i dus su chu grang gang 'dod blud pas chog ste/ skrangs 'phel tsha ba rgyas pa'i dus su btang / chu 'thung shin tu zab/ yang myu gu shing gi khaṇḍa lug ril tsam/ chu grang gis phul btang na phan/ chu 'thung zab/yang gangs thigs/ sbal rgyab/ mdung rtse/ mtshal dkar/ gur gum/ dom mkhris/ gla rtsi/ gi wang / stag sha gyu gu shing / ka ra/ chu 'thung zab/yang rnam par myu gu / stag sha utpal ser po/ tsher sngon/ ka ra rnams kyi phyi (phye ma/ chu 'thung zab/ yang spyi zhur/ myu gu shing / stag sha mdzo mo shing /seng ldeng / dom mkhris/ ka ra/ chu 'thung zab/ gur gum/ rgya tshos khaṇḍa/dom mkhris/ gi wang / stag shu hong len/ myang rtsi spras/ ka ra sbyar ba'i chu 'thung zab/ rma chas ni/ dbyar sho mong (mang 1/ dgun ther ma la bya/dbyar mi rul ba dang / dgun mi 'khyags pa gal che'o// de yang byin nywa ma gtogs pa'i nywa rnams la drod/ sgab rtsa long rtsa ma gtogs pa'i rtsa rnams la bsil/ sgyid khung chu ba ma gtogs chu rgyus thams cad la rlan dang ma bral ba'i bcos bya/ rma tshad che chung la sbyar ba'i sbang ma bro ba che chung ci rigs kyi

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 563lums ni/ rma gsar zhag gsum la med thabs med/ tha ma rnag tu shor ba'i rigs rnams la/ tshabs che na khong du ga bur btang / gang nye'i rtsa la gtar/de nas skem sbyar/ skem sman ni/ mu zi gser 'dra dul ma gser lta bu phug ron gyi sgo nga tsam khram khrum brdungs te/ 'bri mar bzang po khyim bya'i sgong tsam bzhi ldan du/ me chung la gnyug bsrings la dkrugs shing bskol bas/mar dang mu zi dbyer med du 'dres pas/ bu ram smug po'i mdog gam/khrag mdog tu song dus/ sbrang rtsi phul gang / zangs thal thun lnga/ dung /'gron bu/ dur thod/ sha ru/ phur yog thal ba/ bzang drug spos dkar/dom mkhris/ bse ru/ rgya ru/ kha sha'i ru rnams kyi phye ma kha tshar btab nas lto stong la chu skol gyis phul btang bas/ rnag chu thams cad skems so// tsha ba che na/ brag zhun/ seng lding gi thang gis gso/ rma 'bras thabs su song ba la/mi'i rkang 'go tshon mo/ mi'i nywa sha chu gnas nya sha spru rtsa/ re lcag mkhan skya/ phug ron gyi brun/ mchil pa'i brun/ byi ba'i brun dang sha bubs/ lca ba'i 'bru/ go snyod/ sga skya/ 'bam po/ ba lu'i lo ma/ thar nu/ chu rtsa/btsan dug shu dag mu zi/ lan tshwa/ phabs rnams zhib par btags/chang bzang po'i glum klad dang sbyar/ hreb yod sar mthug par byug cing /snal mas bcings/ sman skam pa chang bran nas yang yang bskyar bas hreb rang sar zhi ba'am/ rnag tu khug nas 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// rma rigs phyogs med du 'tsho ba'i sman ni/ khur mong rtsa lo/ myu gu shing / thar nu'i lo ma/ spyi zhur/pa yag lo ma/ ti gu lam skyes/ brag spos/ ser po rgu drus/ brag lcam/ na ga tshan/ ldum bu/ a'u tsi/ utpal ser po/ stag sha stag mo kha yan/ rgyan 'brum/ stong zil/ bong dkar lo ma/ tsher sngon/ rtsi stag mo/ dar ya gan/nas (nad ma'i rigs thams cad/ sho mong /mang kye/ gab skyes/ seng ldeng /ti gu'i rtsa ba/ yu mo mde 'byin/ co ga mgo sman/ 'bu sug /su hang rnams

564 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagang 'dzoms bsags te/ khaṇḍa tshul bzhin byas nas/ dom mkhris dang /gur gum/ tshal tsam rnyed/ kha tshar btab nas grod pur btsa' dgos dus/rma tshad dang spel ba'i ril bu rmar bcug pa'i/ gso dpyad thams cad kyi rgyal po bla na med pa/ gong na med par 'gyur ba med pa yin pas shin tu zab/ rma 'bras ma gtogs rma rigs thams cad la nya phag gi sha dang / dul sungs/tshwa /tshanaskyur/ lan tshwa/ me nyi/ chags spyod/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khrugs pa'i bya ba thams cad 'dzem/ rma tshad kyi dbal chog (chogs nas/ ra na gzhon gyi sha dang / chang rgyu zhim po nyung ngu ran tsam btang / mdzo zho btang /rma tshad chen po yod ri na/ chu zan ran tsam dang / chu 'dur skam (skom du bsten par bya'o// sbiḥde nas dug gi nad rigs gso thabs ni/ btsan dug la tshabs chung na/pi pi ling gi thang yang yang blud kyang phan/ sho mo'i rtsa ba dang yos tshig gi thang yang phan/ dri chen dri chu sbyar ba ci mang byin nas skyug tu bcug na phan/tshabs che ba la gson khrag btang / rjes dug dbal bsdu bsad sbyong ba'i cho ga bya ba'am/ yang na lan tshwa bzang po khyor ba gsum/ brag skya ha bo thun log zhib btags/ chang gar ma la sbyar nas so bar blugs te/ phyar ba'i nang du bcug ste/ zur bzhi nas nam mkhar bteg cing sa gzhir brdeg de nas thag par bcug nas/ gdung bskor byas pas skyug go/ yang na dri chen dri chu byin nas de ltar bya/ cung zad dbugs lon nas sbyongs sman btang / 'di ma shes par/ a ru ra dang / bong nga dkar po dmar po gla rtsi sogs/ btsan dug tshabs chen byung ba la dang po nas btang na/ dug tshad de pho ba nas rang dbang med par srog rtsar ded de/ gshin rje'i lag tu gtad do// tshabs chen ma byung na a ru ra'am/ bong nga dkar dmar/ gla rtsi/ lo brgyad dri chu rnams re res thub pa yin/ rang nyid rma bya bsgoms nas/ dug gtong zos

564 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagang 'dzoms bsags te/ khaṇḍa tshul bzhin byas nas/ dom mkhris dang /gur gum/ tshal tsam rnyed/ kha tshar btab nas grod pur btsa' dgos dus/rma tshad dang spel ba'i ril bu rmar bcug pa'i/ gso dpyad thams cad kyi rgyal po bla na med pa/ gong na med par 'gyur ba med pa yin pas shin tu zab/ rma 'bras ma gtogs rma rigs thams cad la nya phag gi sha dang / dul sungs/tshwa /tshanaskyur/ lan tshwa/ me nyi/ chags spyod/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khrugs pa'i bya ba thams cad 'dzem/ rma tshad kyi dbal chog (chogs nas/ ra na gzhon gyi sha dang / chang rgyu zhim po nyung ngu ran tsam btang / mdzo zho btang /rma tshad chen po yod ri na/ chu zan ran tsam dang / chu 'dur skam (skom du bsten par bya'o// sbiḥde nas dug gi nad rigs gso thabs ni/ btsan dug la tshabs chung na/pi pi ling gi thang yang yang blud kyang phan/ sho mo'i rtsa ba dang yos tshig gi thang yang phan/ dri chen dri chu sbyar ba ci mang byin nas skyug tu bcug na phan/tshabs che ba la gson khrag btang / rjes dug dbal bsdu bsad sbyong ba'i cho ga bya ba'am/ yang na lan tshwa bzang po khyor ba gsum/ brag skya ha bo thun log zhib btags/ chang gar ma la sbyar nas so bar blugs te/ phyar ba'i nang du bcug ste/ zur bzhi nas nam mkhar bteg cing sa gzhir brdeg de nas thag par bcug nas/ gdung bskor byas pas skyug go/ yang na dri chen dri chu byin nas de ltar bya/ cung zad dbugs lon nas sbyongs sman btang / 'di ma shes par/ a ru ra dang / bong nga dkar po dmar po gla rtsi sogs/ btsan dug tshabs chen byung ba la dang po nas btang na/ dug tshad de pho ba nas rang dbang med par srog rtsar ded de/ gshin rje'i lag tu gtad do// tshabs chen ma byung na a ru ra'am/ bong nga dkar dmar/ gla rtsi/ lo brgyad dri chu rnams re res thub pa yin/ rang nyid rma bya bsgoms nas/ dug gtong zos

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 565par bsam zhing / oṃ bha su rde ho/ na mo sha ha ka la gu gri bhi smar/ zhes bzlas te sman gang btang la btab na mchog tu phan/ sha nad dang / sha dug gi rigs rnams la dang po byung ma thog tu a ru ra/ bong nga dkar po/ 'om bu/bye'u la phug ldum bu re ral rnams/ lo brgyad chu la lcags snod du btsos pa'i khu ba grang mo yang btang / de rjes thang de la dur byid/ dan rog thar nu/ khron bu/ sngon bu thun log re bsnan/ ras su gtums nas btsos pa'i khu bas thang bshal btang ngo // 'di bris dge ba gang des/ pha mas gtso byas bdag dang sems can rnams// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /de nas thor bu'i nad ni/ phran tshegs sna tshogs pa zhig ste/ de'i rtags dang bcos thabs kyang spel mar ston te/ thog mar 'khru ba'i nad ni/ pho ba'i me drod nyams shing ma zhu ba'i rtags la/ zas zos ma thag la na zhing sbo 'khrog dang sgrog pa sogs grang rtags ston pas/ de la se 'bru dang drod sman pi pi ling thun bzang po re re/ sug smel dang shing tshwa (tsha thun tshad/ bur dkar thun gsum zhib btags chu skol tshan mo hub gsum gyis phul/ zhigs par btang / tsha shas cung zad 'dug na gur gum bsnan/ ha cang grang shas che na drod sman pho ba ris/ sga skya/ rgya tsha/ rgyam tsha/ kha ru tsha/ la la phud/bya rgod brun dang go bo'i brun/ go bo spyang ki'i pho ba rnyed na'ang btang bur dkar thun gsum gong gi steng du bsnan nas btang bas me drod skyed cing ma zhu ba 'ju/ mdor na tsha 'khru grang 'khru'i rigs 'byed gang dgos te/ chu gtsang phor gang nang du 'khru ba'i dri ma thur 'go gang dal bus bzhag pas/ chu'i gting du 'gro na tsha 'khru yin la/ chu'i steng du ling nge sdod na grang 'khru yin te/tsha 'khru la dom mkhris/ gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / bong nga dkar po/gla sgang / re skon/ ba le ka rnams thun bzang ba re/ rgyal kur thun bzang ba

566 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thig gnyis/ phye ma thun re gung gnyis la chu skol grang gis phul nas btang / yang na/ da trig ka ped/ tha rams(ram / mon cha ra/ smag dang / a ru ra gser mdog rgyal kur sbyar nas btang bas chod/ skom la btung ba gzhan mi gtong bar/ chu ma rul ba bskol grang zhag ma lon pa la cong zhi shin tu zhib par btags pa'i phye ma thur 'go gsum tsam btab pa byin/ lar ni tsha 'khru la snod kyi tshad bam zhi bar 'khru gcod drag po btang na/ rgyu long 'gril ba dang / tsha glang 'khyim nas zug gzer ldang zhing mi rung bas/ gong du bshad pa'i mkhris phye bdun pa sogs kyi tsha ba bsad rjes 'khru gcod btang ba gnad che'o// tsha grang gang yin kyang thun mong du gcod pa ni/ 'bras thug tshos par btsos par tshwa cung zad btab/ de la gtsod kyi khrag thun bzang ba gcig zhib par btags pa'i dro 'jam yang yang sbyin/ nad tshabs chung ba la brag skya ha bo'i rtsa ba'am me tog gi thang gcig pus kyang chod/ me tog bya rkang lo btsan gyi thang gis kyang chod do// zas skom ni grang 'khru la lug sha'am 'bri g.yag gi sha nya sha gsar pa/ 'bras thug zan dron/ chang zhim po ran par btung /tsha 'khru la sha'i rigs btang ba sngas na dmar por 'gyur bas 'dzem/ ram bu'i zan dang skyo tsha/ 'bras thug btsos zan phye thug sogs btang / 'khru skyug gi sman dang / gang btang yang bungs chung la grangs mang btang ba gnad yin/ rgyu gzer gyis khrag tu 'khru ba la/ bad smug gi khrag rul dud khu sogs 'khru ba dang / rgyu nad rnying nas zas mdog 'khru ba'i rjes la/ khrag tu 'khru ba sogs ni rang rang gi gzhung du blta bar bya'o// skyugs pa bcos pa ni/skyugs pa'i nad ni rigs mang yang / ma zhu bas skyugs pa ni zas gang zos dang lbu sob skyug sgreg sbos pho ba na ba sogs 'byung bas/ de la rgyam tsha/ sga skya/ a ru ra gsum cha mnyam pa'i thang btang / yang drod sman pi pi ling bsnan pa'i thang btang / phan dka' na se 'bru bzhi pa'i steng du/ sga skya dang

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 567kha ru tsha bsnan pa btang / spyi 'gro ni 'bras legs par bkrus pa'i khu ba pu shel tse dang sbrang rtsi btab/ nyung bar yang yang btang bas phan/ yang na sngo sog pa kya'i (sog ka pa'i 'bras bu rgya tsha bu ram sbyar ba btang / yang na 'bras yos khyor ba gang btab pa'i steng du se 'bru pi pi ling / sga skya rnams thun re zhib par btags/ sbrang rtsi thur 'go gang btab nas ran tsam chu skol gyis phul nas btang / phan dka' na ske stong dang lhon gsang la me btsa' bya/zas skom 'ju sla ba ran tsam btang ngo // gdon dang bad smug sogs kyis skyugs pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// 'khru skyug gnyis ka byed cing / byin pa nywa log gi rigs la/ khong du khyim bya mtshal lu'i ze ba'am ze khrag phag rog gi sna/ sbrul dang ngur ba'i sha rta gseb kyi rta bon/ rdo dreg dmar po/ gla rtsi rnams zhib btags dri chu dang sbyar la gtong ngo // lug sha'i tshod ma la shing kun dang tshwa sna rigs tshogs tshad btab nas btang ngo // sre long gi thang btang / nywa gang log sar lug rkang mar rnying la sogs mar gyis bsku mnye shin tu drag po bya'o// rkang lag drag tu brkyang ba dang bskum pa mang po bya/phan dka' na mtheb chen bzhi'i sen mo la spra ba nas tsam gyis bsreg rgyab kyi tshigs pa drug pa dang bol gong la me btsa' bya'o// de nas mes tshig tshabs che ba la/ khong du ga pur/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ gur gum/ gi wang / dom mkhris kyis gtsos pa'i mkhris sna tshogs tshad/ gla rtsi rnams kyi phye ma chu grang ngam rang gi dri chus 'phul nas btang / rma khar dom mkhris/ nya mkhris/sbal ba'i khrag rnams rma tshabs dang sbyar nas gdab/ yang na byang bul/ brag spos/ bre gu gser thig gi phye ma btab/ nya mkhris kyis gtso byas pa'i chu la gnas pa'i mkhris sna gang rnyed/ ga pur/ cu gang / gur gum/ hong len/byang bul/ brag spos/ chu rtsa rnams gdab/ yang na bul tog mi rus bsregs pa'i thal ba/ rgya snag na zho sbyar ba byug yang na li khri chu gtsang la

568 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigasbyar ba byugs pas shin tu phan no// chu tshan sogs kyis tshig na brag zhun/sog thal dang / ra'i mar gsar pa gang rung dang sbyar ba byugs nas nyi ma la ran par bsro/ yang na nub mo/ ga pur/ cu gang / gur gum/ mtshal/gla rtsi/ dom mkhris/ li khri/ bre gu gser thig chu rtsa/ rgyal kur rnams sbyar btab nas dar gyis dgab/ rma chas ni chu rug brdungs pa dang zho btsags glan/ skrangs na dri chur sbyangs pa byug zas ni/ ra dang / ba lang dang /ri dwags kyi sha mar gsar btab pa'i btsos zan/ sings po dang / chu bsil sogs bsil ba bsten no//yang khong du khab dang mde'u sogs lcags kyi rigs shor na/ a ru ra cha gsum/ ba ru ra cha gnyis/ skyu ru ra cha gcig rdo khab len rnams thun gcig rtsi bzhin btags pa'i phye ma srin bal bsed pa bal gyi 'dab ma gcig tsam du chu phor chung gang tsam la sbyangs nas khong du gtang / sngas dang gdan 'jam zhing 'bol ba'i steng du gan rkyal du 'gul ba dang 'jur ba ye ma byung bar nyal nas srin bal gyis gril nas bshang lam du 'byin par byed do//yang na ri bong gi spu dang / bya rgod kyi 'doms spu gang rung dang / bag phye sla ngar ser tsam brngos pa dang 'o ma bsros pa'i thug pa nangs ma gsum yang btang / a ru ra tsha la dul ma bag tsam re yang btang ngo // zas gzhan mi gtang / btung ba yang cung zad tsam la bsten te 'byin no//yang gre bar nya rus sogs dus pa dang gra ma zug na/ ras sam bal dar gzing gang rung gre bar thar tsam bsdams nas dar skud btags la/mid par ldad do shes tsam mid nas ske'i mtha' rnams khu tshur gyis shed ran tsam brdung ba'i rnam pa bya zhing / ske phar log tshur log bzhi lnga tsam bya/ de nas sngar gyi dar skud la 'then pas 'byung nges so// yang sha gsar gre bar thar tsam la gong bzhin dar skud btags kyang 'byung ngo //

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 569yang sdom dang sdig pa khong du song na/ srad ma dkar po'i rtsa ba ram pa'i rtsa ba cha mnyam pa'i zhib btags chang dang sbyar ba btang bas phan/ mis bdag byed pa'i rta phyugs sogs kyi khong du kha brgyad pa dang / 'dzag bsdam pa sogs kyi sems can khar shor bas sbos na/ tsha dang mar bsres pas khar bcug pas/ kha cag cag byed na mod la 'tsho'o// phyugs ci sbos kyang mjug snying bsregs pas phan no//yang rna bar srog chags shor na mkhan skya'i lo ma gdus pa'i khu ba blugs na phan no// yang btsod kyi khu ba blugs na rna bar lug shig bor na nyal khar chang gar ma ran tsam rna bar blugs na 'byung ngo // ra shig bor na g.yer ma'i chu blugs so//yang mig kha bas phyid pa la/ gla rtsi shu dag nag po thun re cha mnyam zhib btags/ sna bug gnyis su bud la yud tsam nyi mar blta/ rang gi dri chu bar pas mig 'khru/ khong du rgyal kur/ sug smel/ bu ram rnams mar gyi mar khu 'tshod pa la btab nas btang bas phan no// mig du bas phyid na gi wang gi phye ma sna nas 'bud nas nyi ma yud gcig blta/ sha gsar dmar pos yang yang phyi zhing du ba la 'dzem mo// rkang pa dang lag pa kha bas phyid pa la/ chu grang gi nang du tshugs tshad bgrangs pas phan no//bud med kyi bu ma thon na/ rma a ka pa/ bi ka pa/ zhes yi ge dbu can phreng gcig bris pa spyi bor btags/ mar la bzlas nas khong du btang /des kyang thon dka' na/ khyo de'i spu ngan gzhob/ dur byid/ yu mo mde'u 'byin/ rgya tsha/ sum gyi brun rnams cha mnyam pa'i phye ma gar chang gis phul nas btang / rgyu zhabs su byi khung shar lta'i tshang sa bsros pa la chang gas kha phru btab pa'i dugs bya'o// des thon nges so// yang na khyi'i 'bras bu'i thang btang / yang na bya go bo'i gre ba dang / rgya ru thal tshan nang du cung zad

570 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigabarngos pa zhib btags chang gis phul btang / phyi nas byi khung shar lta'i sa phul bzhi/ lug gi ril ma phul bzhi/ bya rog gi brun phul bzhi/ phabs phul bzhi rnams chang la bcos pa'i tshan mo/ phad bu'i nang du blugs pas yang yang bsro zhing lan mang du bskyar bas rked pa man la dugs bya'o//yang bud med bu ro ma thon na/ chang zhim po'i glum dra tshags la btsir ba'i glum klad phul pho la/ bca' sga'i phye ma khyor ba phyur ba zhig rgya (rgyal kur gdar gcig zhib btags bsres pa ci nus zos pas phan no// khyo'i skra bsregs pa'i gzhob chang dang sbyar bas kyang phan no// phyi nas gang gi dugs kyang bya/ bu btsas rjes gang gi khrag ma chod na/ 'doms bar du 'om bu'i du ba btang bas phan no// rkang lag gi nya srad bu phra mos bsdam/ khong du dom mkhris thun gsum/ gzhan yang mkhris sna tshogs tshad thun re/ gum gum/rgyal kur thun che ba re/ zhib btags chang gis 'phul la btang / dom mkhris dang rgya chos kyang btang / lar bud med zla mtshan ma chod pa la rkang pa'i long bu'i nang gi rtsa la spra rdog gsum bzhag na chod par 'gyur la/ khong du rgya tshos kyi thang gar mo la dom mkhris thun log btab nas btang bas chod nges so//mi chus khyer ba zin pa kha sbubs su bzhag la/ steng nas mis mnan pas kha dang sna bug nas chu mang po 'byung ngo // yang na mi shed yod pa zhig gis de'i rkang pa gnyis nas bzung ste/ phrag pa la bkal te mgo zhabs log nas kha sbub tu phar 'gro tshur 'gro bya/ des kyang chu rnams phyir 'byung zhing / yang na brag gi thog nas mgo mjug slog la kha sbub tu bzhag pas 'byung ngo // phyi nas bsku mnye bya/ gsur dud rlung bcos bya'o// mi 'gags pa thag pa gcod pa dang / btsan thabs su lhod kyis mi glod par dal bus dbugs phra mo nar gyis phyir 'gro ba'i thabs bya'o// yang na de'i kha spa bas mnan nas

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 571rim gyis dbugs 'gro ba'i thabs bya'o//lag pa'i gru mo bud na/ dpung pa nas gcig gis yar 'then/ gcig gis mar lag ngar nas nar nar 'then la sman pa'i lag mthil gyis mi drag par dal bus lag tshod myul rung nang du phul bas tshud do// de nas phying bas bsdams nas mgul du btags la/ sgul bskyod sogs mkhas par bya zhing don mtshams su me btsa' yang bya/ dpung pa bud na thag pa ring ba zhig lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas btags la/ nad pa'i mchan 'og tu dru bu che chung ran pa zhig bcug la yar 'then/ gzhan gcig gis thag pa'i sne nas thad kur/mar thang gis 'then la thag pa'i dkyil du ber ga brdeg ma tshud na cung zad g.yas g.yon gcu ba sogs byas nas slar yang dbyug pas bsnun pas nges par tshud do//mkhrig ma'i tshigs bud na/ sa steng khod mnyam zhing mkhregs pa'i kha ru phying ba bting la/ de'i kha ru lag pa kha sbub tu bzhag nas/ steng nas rkang pas rnam gyis mnan/ sor mo rnams kyang 'then pas tshud cing / tshud nas zhag 'ga' na me btsa' byas pas rjes su bud long mi yong ba yin no// zhes pa thor bu'i nad gso thabs 'di nyid/ sum ston chen pos mdzad 'phro lus pas zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje zhes g.yu thog pa'i rnam 'phrul gang de nyid kyis mdzad pa yin no// mgi lam̐//'a/ byin rlabasabla sgrub lasagasang ba bar chad bdud kyi gegasasel bzhugasaso/gegs sel gyi cha lag zur rgyan/ rang gi spyi bor padma 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad

572 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thiga'adus pa'i bdag nyid mahā gu ṇa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ gzi brjid kyi dpal rab tu 'bar ba'i sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po dang dbyer med ma mchis pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas a ru ra'i sdong po 'bras bu sum ldan dkur brten pa/ g.yon na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa gur gum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan can bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ sku la dar dkar po'i na bza' mchin kha'i ska rags/zhabs rjen phyed skyil gyis bag dro'u re bzhugs pa'i mdun du lha mo dkar mo rin po che'i pi wang bsgyur ba/ g.yas ser mo bya rgod rkang gi gling bu bsgyur ba/rgyab tu dmar mo mi rkang gi gling bu bsgyur ba/ g.yon du ljang mo dngul dkar gyi me long ston pa thams cad kyang snyan cha 'khrol ba/ sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phrob ('phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sman skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥlha baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ oṃ mahā gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ bdag gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la gro (blo gros rgyas te/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad la phan thogs nyi zla ltar 'byung bar gyur cig smras tshad mngon shes su gyur cig sbyar tshad sman du gyur cigabatang tshad phan par gyur cig mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i rgyun khyer gyi bla sgrub zhogs pa tho rangs snga bar ma chags par nyams su blangs pas bar gcod bdud kyi gnod pa'i gegs thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro//ya/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi lam rtagasagasal byed nor bu'i sgron me bzhugasaso/na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ kun 'dus rgyal ba bla ma sman rgyal gyi dkyil

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 573'khor du/ dbang thob dam ldan bsnyen sgrub bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i gang zag la/ lam rtags kyi rim pa ni gnyis te/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi'o// dang po la phyi sgrub kyi rtags ni/ 'khor ba la skyo ba rang dbang med par skyes nas/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la blo gting nas log pa dang / bla ma dang dkon mchog la bcos min gyi mos gus skyes nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa la blo chig chod du 'gro ba dang / byin rlabs zhugs pas lus la bde ba/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa chags/ sdig sgrib nad gdon dag pa'i rtags/ rmi lam du khrus byas pas/rnag khrag skyug cing 'khru ba dang / srog chags lus la thon cing gos dkar dri med gon pa dang / nyi zla 'char ba dang / ri rtser phyin pa dang / mkha' la thogs med du 'phur ba/ mchod rten la 'dzeg pa/ khri gdan mthon po la 'dug pa/ skye bo du mas phyag dang bskor ba byed pa dang / mi du mas bsnyen bkur byed pa sogs 'byung ngo // nang sgrub kyi rtags ni/ de'i steng du sgrub khang du byin che/ bag dro/ mtshams dang dge sbyong las 'bral mi phod/ rmi lam rno ba mngon shes lta bu 'byung / lha sgom shin tu gsal zhing / bzlas pa la skyo dub med pa/ zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin rtsol med du 'char ba dang / 'jig rten lha 'dre'i gzugs mthong ba dang / sgrub khang du 'od dang 'od zer 'byung zhing / skabs su sman dang spos kyi dri ngad bzang pos khyab cing / bdud rtsi khel (khol ba sogs 'byung / gsang sgrub kyi rtags ni/ de rnams kyi steng du ni/ lus phyi nang gi srin bu spang ba dang / lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang / sa 'og gi gter mthong ba dang / bkres skom gyi snang ba shas chung ba dang sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba med pa dang / bdud dang dgra la nyam nga med cing /ngag gi bden tshig 'grub pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin dbang du 'du bas/zas nor char ltar 'bab pa sogs 'byung / dril sgrub kyi rtags ni/ gong ma

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 573'khor du/ dbang thob dam ldan bsnyen sgrub bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i gang zag la/ lam rtags kyi rim pa ni gnyis te/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi'o// dang po la phyi sgrub kyi rtags ni/ 'khor ba la skyo ba rang dbang med par skyes nas/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la blo gting nas log pa dang / bla ma dang dkon mchog la bcos min gyi mos gus skyes nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa la blo chig chod du 'gro ba dang / byin rlabs zhugs pas lus la bde ba/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa chags/ sdig sgrib nad gdon dag pa'i rtags/ rmi lam du khrus byas pas/rnag khrag skyug cing 'khru ba dang / srog chags lus la thon cing gos dkar dri med gon pa dang / nyi zla 'char ba dang / ri rtser phyin pa dang / mkha' la thogs med du 'phur ba/ mchod rten la 'dzeg pa/ khri gdan mthon po la 'dug pa/ skye bo du mas phyag dang bskor ba byed pa dang / mi du mas bsnyen bkur byed pa sogs 'byung ngo // nang sgrub kyi rtags ni/ de'i steng du sgrub khang du byin che/ bag dro/ mtshams dang dge sbyong las 'bral mi phod/ rmi lam rno ba mngon shes lta bu 'byung / lha sgom shin tu gsal zhing / bzlas pa la skyo dub med pa/ zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin rtsol med du 'char ba dang / 'jig rten lha 'dre'i gzugs mthong ba dang / sgrub khang du 'od dang 'od zer 'byung zhing / skabs su sman dang spos kyi dri ngad bzang pos khyab cing / bdud rtsi khel (khol ba sogs 'byung / gsang sgrub kyi rtags ni/ de rnams kyi steng du ni/ lus phyi nang gi srin bu spang ba dang / lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang / sa 'og gi gter mthong ba dang / bkres skom gyi snang ba shas chung ba dang sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba med pa dang / bdud dang dgra la nyam nga med cing /ngag gi bden tshig 'grub pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin dbang du 'du bas/zas nor char ltar 'bab pa sogs 'byung / dril sgrub kyi rtags ni/ gong ma

574 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigade rnams kyi steng du/ rab rtsa ba gsum sku dngos su mthong / gsung gi gnang ba thob/ mi dang mi lab pa ltar 'byung / pi wang dang / gling bu dang / snyan pa'i glu dbyangs thos/ me tog gi char bab/ 'od kyi dra ba 'ja' tshon dang spel bas/ nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa 'byung / dngos nyams rmi lam du sa chu me rlung rtsi shing nags tshal skye 'gro sems can thams cad kyi gzugs dang / sgra'i rnam 'gyur la brten nas/ nang du rang mngon shes tal tal 'char ba dang /yid la thol skyes gang byung dag tu smras pas/ ji lta ba bzhin du 'grigs pa dang / dngos nyams rmi lam du rang gi bla ma'ang grogs mched dam/ pha mes rgan rabs 'ongs nas/ nad ngos 'dzin tshul/ zas dang spyod lam sman 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba/ sa phyogs 'di na yod/ dbyibs kha dog ro nas zhu rjes phan gnod sdeb pa la sogs 'di ltar yin no// de yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhung 'di skad ces pa'i nang du gsal/ zhes bslab pa dang / ri la khrid nas sngo sman rnams ngo sprad pa 'byung / sbrang ma dang / khye'u ri dwags sogs kyi lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur du ma bstan nas/ rang gi blo la nges shes skye ba'i slob dpon bla na med pa 'byung ba dang / la lar nad pa'i cha lugs su snang la/rang gas bcos byas pas nad pa de nyid na lugs dang / sngar 'di byas bshad pa nyid ngam ngam shugs shugs kyis blo bskyed thon pa'i slob dpon bla na med pa 'byung zhing / sman bsod khyad par du che/ bshad tshad mngon shes/sbyar tshad sman/ btang tshad phan par 'byung / sman gyi lha mo dang drang srong ma bsgrubs par yang 'khor zhing / gtam smras pa dang / snyan grags kyis sa steng khyab pa dang / khyad par du bla ma la mos gus/ sems can la snying rje/mched grogs la dag snang / nang du nyams myong / shes rab me ltar 'bar bzhin 'phel nas/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i snang ba rgyas par 'gyur zhing / mtshungs bral gu ṇa nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 575'du shes pa dang / rgyud bzhi sogs rgyal ba dngos kyi bka' dang khyad par spu tsam yang med pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas/ skyabs gnas de las bzang ba logs su med par shes par 'byung / de tsa na bla ma yi dam mang po'i zhal mthong / lung ston/ byin gyis brlabs/ rtogs pa phul du byung ba skyes/las dang nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa dag par 'gyur ro// 'di rnams las go ldog pa ni bar chod (chad kyi rtags yin la/ rtags gang ma byung na/sgrib pa shas ha cang che ba'am/ rang gi dad brtson zhen pa yin pas/ 'bad pa gal che'o// rtags 'di rnams la yang bzang rtags ngan rtags ltar snang ba/ngan rtags bzang rtags ltar snang ba/ bzang yang bzang / bzang rtags su yang snang ba ngan yang ngan/ ngan rtags su yang snang ba/ mu bzhi po 'di brtag dka' bas/ bzang rtags snang ba'i tshe dga' spro dang / ngan rtags snang ba'i tshe zhum 'tsher mi bya bar gnas lugs mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du phyam gyis glod nas nyams len la thang lhod ma shor bar byas pas lam du 'gro bar the tshom med do// blo bya sgro rlung gis bskyod pa ltar rang tshugs mi thub/ rkyen gyis bsgyur sla ba'i mi rigs la ni/ sgrub pa gang yang mtha' skyol ba dang /bar chad med pa shin tu dka' bas/ blo gting yangs shing blo thag chod pa dang / snying rus snying stobs che zhing skyong dka' na rang tshugs zin pas gangayang bde legs su 'grub bo//gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi lam rtags ni/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ rtsa thig rlung la gnad du bsnun pas/ steng 'og gi sgo la brten pa'i chags grol gyi lam ji ltar nyams su blangs kyang / phyag len la ma 'byugs pa zhig byung na/ ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar 'jug gnas thim gsum gyi rtags 'di rnams 'byung ngo // de'ang dbang po'i mngon sum du nyams su myong ba/ rtog pa bral zhing rtags ma nor ba nam mkhar 'char te/ du ba lta bu/

576 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasmig rgyu lta bu/ me stag lta bu/ mar me dang / nam mkha' sprin med dang /rin chen 'od 'bar dang / zla ba nyi ma/ sgra gcan/ glog thig le dang /snod bcud kyi rnam pa du ma dang / sku'i bar du nges pa dang ma nges pa'i rtags du ma 'byung ba srid de/ bsam gtan gyi man ngag gis sbyang zhing / nyams byung rgyal du btang bas chog ste/ nye bar bstan pa dbang bo'i mngon sum mo//de rjes su ni 'di rnams 'byung ste/ 'di la gsum/ lus nyams/ mthong snang / sems nyams so// lte bar drod skye/ de nas snying ga tsha ba dang / mgo na ba dang / ya thod 'gog pa snyam byed/ mig na/ gtsug tor za ba dang 'phrig pa sogs 'byung / lus 'khor ba snyam byed/ smin mtshams lu zhing gcu/cung zad thal na kha yo mig yo dang / ngo phar sdud tshur sdud byed pa yang 'byung ste/ mthong snang ni/ dang po stong gzugs g.yas g.yon nas 'gro ba las/rlung 'jug 'dod pa'i dus su dal bar gnas pa dang / gang nas byung yang mdun du 'khor yang / shin tu nye zhing ngo thog tu 'bab pa snyam byed/ de nas rtags dngos ni/ rab la 'od dkar po kha dog lnga'am drug gi bdag nyid 'og steng du 'khor zhing 'gro ba la/ sku dang thig le sogs 'dus nas 'khor ba dang / dbu ma'i mthong snang sbrul nag po dang / rā hu la'i rnam pa lus la mig mang po can dang / spyang khyi'i rnam pas spyi bo dang smin mtshams su rmugs pa 'byung / 'bring la 'od dkar po kha dog gcig dang / gsum dang bzhi sogs ci rigs 'byung / 'od dkar po ni ci tsam mang ba nas rtag tu 'khor zhing byung na bzang / sku dang thig le la sogs mthong snang rags pa tsam 'jug pa dka' ste bcing ba sla/sems nyams ni rlung sems spyi bor 'dus nas 'pho bar 'dug snyam pa 'byung ngo // de 'jug pa'i rtags dang mi 'jug pa'i rtags gnyis te/ dang po 'od dkar po ste/ rang gi lag gang tsam gyi steng du/ 'khor zhing sdod pas/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 577mthong snang thams cad de la 'du/ lus rtag tu bsdams pa snyam byed/ skye 'gag shes pa dran bsam med pa thim thim 'gro ba dang / gnyid du song bas rkyen byas nas/ stong gsum gyi gzugs sna tshogs mthong / sgra sna tshogs thos/dri sna tshogs myong / snang srid 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar 'khor zhing / 'ur ting sil khrol dang bcas pas/ rgya mtsho'i steng du spyi gtsug tu lhung ba snyam byed 'byung ngo // gnyis pa rig pa stong sangs khyer/ 'od je mtho je mthor 'gro/ ya thod 'gog pa snyam byed na 'pho ba 'byung / 'bring gnad la 'pho ba ma byung yang / steng sgo sengs pas/ spyi bo nas yar rlung spos kyi du ba ltar 'gro/nyams thams cad stong nyams su 'char/ zas mi 'ju/ drod rkang pa nas rim pa bzhin sdud/ mthar tshe'i 'du byed 'dor bas/ 'di'i dus man ngag can gyi bla mas/ dang por 'jug pa la mkhas pas/ de nas 'chings pa la mkhas pas thal nas log gnon la mkhas pa/ 'chor na ldog pa la mkhas pa gal che zhing zhal shes so// zhugs pa'i rtags ni/ stong gzugs thams cad rang snang la thim nas/ 'od dkar po lus la a long bzhin du tshud nas 'khor ba 'byung / lus zungs thub 'dod pa'i ro tsa ba nas mi ldang / rlung rgyu ba mi tshor/ldog pa dal/ stong gzugs med par 'gro/ 'chor ba'i rtags ni/ snang gzugs sna dang spyi bo nas du ba bzhin thon 'gro/ 'jug pa'i rtags ni/ go rims (rim bzhin/ du ba la sogs rtags spyi bo dpral ba kha mtshul snying mgrin lte ba nas 'du ba 'byung ste/ rab rgyun chags su 'du ba dang / 'bring thun bcad nas 'du ba dang / tha ma bsdus nas 'du ba bsdus na 'dur mi 'dod/ sems kyi gnad ni/ yengs pa med par nyams gang bder skyong dgos te/ yengs 'khrul dang / le lo byas na 'dur yang mi 'dod la/bcings kyang mi chings so// rtags ni sa 'du na tsub pa dang / lci ba snang ba thams cad ser por mthong / ri brag khang khyim la sogs g.yo zhing / je phra je

578 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaphrar song nas/ bdag gi lus kyi cha shas gang yang rung bar thim pa byung ba dang / de bzhin du chu la kha char ser ba chu tshan 'du ba dang / me la nyi ma dang /me stag dang / glog dang / du ba dang / rlung la rlung 'tshubs pa dang / bya nag dang / sbrang ma dang / gzugs brnyan nag po lang ling mang po rgyug pa sogs dang / du ba la sogs nas bzung nas lha sku'i bar cir snang lus la thim 'ong / nam mkha' 'dus rtags/ rig nyams stong sangs la/ bde sing nge ba la sogs pa du ma 'byung ngo // 'di rnams ci tsam shugs che ba bzang mi 'dug na/ sdud pa'i thabs la 'bad/ 'chor na bzlog de ltar sdud pa las/khams stobs gyur gyi nyams ni/ sa stobs su gyur na lus lci/ 'gul snying mi 'dod/ snang ba thams cad gser dang ri dang thang dang rdul 'tshub tu mthong /sems nyams su bying shas che/ chu rlung stobs 'phel na lus shin tu grang byang khog 'khyags pa snyam byed/ mthong snang du gangs ri 'khyags mthong / kha ser bab pa mthong / sems nyams su shes pa 'dar/ rig pa mi 'chun/ smyo snying 'dod/ lus zungs mi thub/ mig gis mi theg go/ me stobs su gyur na/lus nyams su drod che zhing rngul tshig pa za/ sgom snying mi 'dod/ rtog pa 'phro/snang ba me dang me stag gam/ gcan gzan du ma mthong / rlung stobs su gyur na/ lus yang / 'gro snying 'dod/ 'gro ba mgyogs/ shes pa skad cig kyang mi gnas/ rlung 'tshub dang bya du ma mthong / nam mkha'i stobs su gyur nas/lus shin tu bde/ sems nyid nyams su stong pa shas che/ shes pa ban bun ngos gzung med/mthong snang la/ g.yang sa chen po dang / ri mthon po nam mkha' stong pa 'byung / rmi lam nyams su 'ong / 'di rnams dang rjes su mthun par yong bar 'dug go/ 'di rnams dang po nas byung nas 'byung ba dug yin pas/sa la sems gcun/ chu la lus gcun/ me la lus glod/ nam mkha' la

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 579grims glod spel/ bar du 'di rnams byung na/ phyi rlung lus gcun kyang /nang rlung rtsa la ma chud pas/ 'byung ba lnga stobs 'phel ba'i nyams yin pas/lus rtsar sdud cing / 'pho ba ma byung na dgag pa'i man ngag dgos so// tha ma nye bar byung na/ 'khor lo drug gi khams kyi dbang byas pa yin pas/ lus spyi gtsug bde chen gyi gnas su/ rlung dang byang sems dbyer med bsdus la dbu mar dbab dgos/ de dang rjes su 'brel bar/ rtsa zug rlung zug 'byung ba yang gsum ste/ rab cig car du grol te/ de rtags su rang lus skyes bu stobs chen gyis mnan te/ mgo lus med pa mtshon rtses tshogs par 'dra ba'am/ dngos su yang de 'dra'i rnam par 'gyur la/ kha cig la ce spyang gi gzugs su byas nas/ nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / sngon po dang / bya dang / sbrul dang / nya la sogs pa mang po'am/ de ngag gi sder mo rnon po'am/ snyung bu rnon pos lus kyi mgo mjug med par rmugs pa dang 'drang ('dra ba snang / 'bring / 'ga' zhig la khol bur za 'phrug byed pa dang / rim gyis 'bral ba la mthong snang tsam med pa la/ tsha tsag pa mang po yod pa 'dug ste/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis dang tshigs phran dang smod pa dang /rkang mthil lag mthil la shas cher yong bar 'dug nan ltar 'bral dka' ba'i rigs la/ zug khab rtses 'bigs pa 'dra ba la/ na thang 'byung ste/dmyal ba sogs rigs drug gi gnas sbyong 'byung ste/ 'di dus rtsub rlung drag pos bcad/ de rnams kyis rtsa mdud grol nas/ las rlung gis gang ba'i tshe/sen bar ba spu'i bu ga nas rlung 'gro ba 'byung / de rnams rgyu ba dkar dus rtsed mo la 'jug pa'i tshe/ dang po lus rtsa de nag la sbom pa ka ba btsugs pa lta bu mthong la/ bsgoms pa bzhin du je phra je phra la song nas/ ro kyang dang 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsa 'dab ci rigs pa dang po mdun du snang ba 'byung / de nas yid yul du nang nas snang ba 'byung ste/ rab la gsal nyams stong

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 579grims glod spel/ bar du 'di rnams byung na/ phyi rlung lus gcun kyang /nang rlung rtsa la ma chud pas/ 'byung ba lnga stobs 'phel ba'i nyams yin pas/lus rtsar sdud cing / 'pho ba ma byung na dgag pa'i man ngag dgos so// tha ma nye bar byung na/ 'khor lo drug gi khams kyi dbang byas pa yin pas/ lus spyi gtsug bde chen gyi gnas su/ rlung dang byang sems dbyer med bsdus la dbu mar dbab dgos/ de dang rjes su 'brel bar/ rtsa zug rlung zug 'byung ba yang gsum ste/ rab cig car du grol te/ de rtags su rang lus skyes bu stobs chen gyis mnan te/ mgo lus med pa mtshon rtses tshogs par 'dra ba'am/ dngos su yang de 'dra'i rnam par 'gyur la/ kha cig la ce spyang gi gzugs su byas nas/ nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / sngon po dang / bya dang / sbrul dang / nya la sogs pa mang po'am/ de ngag gi sder mo rnon po'am/ snyung bu rnon pos lus kyi mgo mjug med par rmugs pa dang 'drang ('dra ba snang / 'bring / 'ga' zhig la khol bur za 'phrug byed pa dang / rim gyis 'bral ba la mthong snang tsam med pa la/ tsha tsag pa mang po yod pa 'dug ste/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis dang tshigs phran dang smod pa dang /rkang mthil lag mthil la shas cher yong bar 'dug nan ltar 'bral dka' ba'i rigs la/ zug khab rtses 'bigs pa 'dra ba la/ na thang 'byung ste/dmyal ba sogs rigs drug gi gnas sbyong 'byung ste/ 'di dus rtsub rlung drag pos bcad/ de rnams kyis rtsa mdud grol nas/ las rlung gis gang ba'i tshe/sen bar ba spu'i bu ga nas rlung 'gro ba 'byung / de rnams rgyu ba dkar dus rtsed mo la 'jug pa'i tshe/ dang po lus rtsa de nag la sbom pa ka ba btsugs pa lta bu mthong la/ bsgoms pa bzhin du je phra je phra la song nas/ ro kyang dang 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsa 'dab ci rigs pa dang po mdun du snang ba 'byung / de nas yid yul du nang nas snang ba 'byung ste/ rab la gsal nyams stong

580 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagazugs rtsa nang rnams su mthong ba 'byung / de'ang bsgom zhing je phrar 'gro/mthar de rnams 'dus nas gsang ba'i 'khor lo spun gu'i mtshams su thig le sngon po zhig gi steng du/ thig le lnga'am/ sku la sogs pa'am/ sku la thig les bskor ba'am/ byang sems kyi sku'am/ rigs drug gi gzugs ci rigs pa mthong yong bar 'dug go/ rab la sku dkar po zhig gi stong du/ spyi bor dus me sngo skya mu zi'i me lta bu'i sor gang pa/ de'i dbus su dus kyi rtsa zug pa thams cad mthong bar 'dug de lta bu mthong na/ dus rtsa la srog 'jug pa'i rtags yin no// 'jug thabs ni/ zhi drag gi rlung sbyor dmigs pa dang bcas pa/sreg dus kyi rtsa la steng 'og nas bsdus pas/ dang po du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'jug cing / de nas sku dang thig le la sogs pa rgyu ring nang gi ril ma bzhin/ mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs nas/ du ba sogs spyi bor slebs pa dang / snying gar sku'i zhal lam thig le 'byung zhing / de las thal nas me la zhugs na/ srog bsdus nas 'pho ba 'byung gan 'dug de'i rtags ni rab la 'od dkar po chung ngu rtag tu 'khor zhing / spyi gtsug tu khab kyis gtsags pa 'dra ba la/ 'bring la ni/ lus nyams dang / tha ma 'phang rtses phug pa 'dra ba 'byung / steng sgo sengs nas rlung rta rnga tsam rgyun du 'gro ba 'dug ste 'di'i dus su 'pho ba dgag pa dang / yon tan gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs kyi 'bab chen gyi 'phrul 'khor dang / drag rlung la 'bad pas/ gang zag rab la thur sel log nas/ me rang 'bar log 'byung la/ 'bring la srog thur 'dres par 'byung / de'i rtags dang po thig le nag po dang / zlum po dang / zla gam dmar po lte bar 'du ba dang / de nas lcags kyi zhud zer lta bu'i me stag 'phro bar 'byung ba 'dus na rdo rje'i bu ga tsha la rtsub/ chu la grang khyug khyug pa dang / me la tsha tsag tsag rlung la grangs /grang le ba 'byung / lte bar 'dus dus lus kyi rtsa stong phrag bdun cu

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 581rtsa gnyis nas me 'jug cing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas kyang me 'bar bar mthong ste/ bsregs pa'i bskal pa lta bu nyams su myong ba 'dug de dang dus mtshungs steng nas kyang 'od 'khor lus dang sku rnams la 'jug par 'dug ste/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes bya'o// 'bring la me'i snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char/ drod chen po 'bar ba'o// gnyis pa 'di la me drod kyi rjes su/ thig le g.yo ba zhes bya ba/ lus thams cad chang gi glum langs pa bzhin/ bde sag sag khol ba 'byung / de'i rjes su rab 'bar zhes bya ba/mgo bo gru char gyis brdungs pa bzhin sku'i rtse mo nas kyang / thig le thigs pa mang po 'byung ba dang / lus kyi rtsa nang thams cad du kyu ru ru/ thig thigashar shar/ na ra ra yod pa'i snang ba 'byung ste/ me de'i khams dang skye mched rnams kyi gcig srog gcig tu 'gyur ro// de nas brtan pa'i drod ni/ lus rkang mthil nas spyi bor thug pa gang ba'i snang ba 'byung / gang zag tha ma ni srog thur 'dres kyang drod mi 'byung ste chu dang rlung gi dbang byas pa yin no//srog thur 'dres rtags ni/ rlung nor bu dang rkang mthil du 'gro/ 'og rlung bsdus pas sna sgo dri ngan 'byung ste/ 'di'i dus su gegs sel bogs 'don phyir/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan cho ga bzhin 'bral med bsten na/ 'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub pa la tshegs med par shes par bya'o// de'i rgyu mtshan yang / rtsa mdud thams cad grol lo// me drod kyis thig le zhu ba'i dwangs mas rkang pa nas spyi bo'i bar du gang bas snyigs ma thams cad sbyangs/ sa lam stan thog gcig tu chod/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa 'grub ste/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtser byang sems 'chings pas ma rig pa dag dus sbyor gcig gi stong brgyad brgya 'gags pas/ mkhyen pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes mngon du gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' mthong lam dang ldan pas sa dang po thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mthong ba'i spyan dang mngon shes ldan par 'gyur ro// de nas byang

582 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigasems gsang ba'i 'khor lo log cing / 'chings pas 'du byed dag dus sbyor gnyis kyi rlung 'gags pas sa gnyis pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gnyis kyi don nus/ byang sems gsang ba nas lte ba'i bar du log cing 'chings bas/ rnam shes dag sdus sbyor gsum gyi rlung 'gags pas sa gsum pa thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bzhi'i don nus/ lte ba'i 'khor lo 'chings pas ming dang gzugs dag dus sbyor bzhi'i rlung 'gags/ 'dod chags kyi sems dang ye shes lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dag nas/ sa bzhi pa thob ste rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten brgyad kyi don mthong zhing sprul pa 'gyed nus/ lte ba nas snying ga'i bar 'chings pas/ skye mched drug dag dus sbyor lnga'i rlung 'gags nas/ sa lnga pa thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams bcu drug mthong zhing sprul pa 'gyed nus/snying gar 'chings pas rig pa dag dus sbyor drug gi rlung 'gags pas gnyid dang tha mal gyi sems dang / khyad par gyi dga' ba dag nas drug par rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chos sku thob ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams sum cu rtsa gnyis mthong zhing sprul pa 'gyed nus/ de nas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo 'chings pas sred pa dag dus sbyor brgyad kyi rlung 'gags/ rmi lam ngag dang mchog dga' dag sa brgyad par skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob ste/ 'jig rten brgya nyer brgyad kyi don byed do// de nas mgrin pa dang / spyi bo'i bar bcings/ len pa dag dus sbyor dgu'i rlung 'gags/sa dgu pa thob ste/ 'jig rten brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug gi don byed nus so// de nas dpral ba'i 'khor lo 'chings pas srid pa dag dus sbyor bcu pa'i rlung 'gags/ sad pa'i dus kyi sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang lus rtsa dang dga' ba thams cad dag nas/ sa bcu pa dri ma med pa thob/ sprul pa'i sku thob ste/ 'jig rten lnga brgya dang bcu gnyis kyi don byed do// de nas dpral ba dang spyi gtsug

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 583bar du 'chings pas skye ba dag dus sbyor bcu gcig gi rlung 'gags/ sa bcu gcig thob ste/ 'jig rten stong nyer bzhi'i don byed/ de nas spyi gtsug tu 'chings pas rga shi'i bar du rten 'brel bcu gnyis thams cad dag nas/dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi rlung nyi khri drug brgya thams cad 'gags/ chags sems gnyid dang rmi lam sad pa dang bcas pa la dag pa'i gnas skabs bzhi rtsarlung thig le'i sems dang dga' ba bzhi dag nas sa bcu gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi sku dang / yon tan dang ldan pa/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi don byed par 'gyur ro// de ltar bla mas rtags kyi don ngo sprod/ rang gi nang nas go ba rnyed pa dang / de'i don la ma yengs par bsgoms pas/ zla ba drug gis don rtogs/ lo gsum gyis 'byung bzhi rang sar dngas nas/ the tshom med par 'tshang rgya'o// yang na steng sgo la brten pa'i grol lam nyams su blangs pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams len skye ba rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ro//de'i rtogs pa shar ba spros bral/ sna tshogs 'dod thog tu bab pa ro gcigabasgom bya sgom byed kyi 'bad rtsol dang bral ba bsgom med do// nyams myong gi na 'phar ba'i rim pa las/ chung 'bring chen pos dbye bas/ rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis su ming btags pa bzhin 'char ba rtogs par bya'o// 'di thams cad kyang gang zag gi lus kyi rtsa dang thig le gsum gyi gnas lugs mi 'dra ba dang / thog med kyi bag chags goms stabs sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis/lam rtags rim pa rim min cig car dang / rim 'char ma nges du ma 'byung /nyams ldan gyi bla ma gal che zhing / lam rtags/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don gsum 'bral med du khong du chud pa zhes so// byin rlabs bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od las/ lam rtags gsal byed nor bu'i sgron me zhes bya ba/ sum ston chen po'i gsung ji lta ba las/ yi ge nyung ngur bsdus pa/sems can la phan thogs pa rgya chen po nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig/

584 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamagi lam̐//ra/ bsgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debasabazhugasaso/na mo ratna gu ru bhyaḥ rgyal ba ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la gsol ba 'debs// nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur rnal 'byor ma// dpal ldan phreng ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mtshungs med g.yu thog zhabs//'gro ba'i mgon po mchog la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras dam pa bka' drin 'gran zla med// sum ston chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal tshab rmad byung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// dpal ldan 'tsho mdzad gzhon nu'i ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mnga' ris mkhas pa'i gtso// gtsang ston sangs rin rdor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rlabs chen spyod pa can// mkhas btsun rin rdor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i bka' la shing rta'i srol 'byed pa// don grub rgyal mtshan dpal la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i gso dpyad rgyas par mdzad// brang ti rgyal mtshan dkon mchog skyabs la gsol ba 'debs//rgyal ba'i gtsug na ngal gso mchod pa'i gnas// brangati dpal ldan 'tsho byed zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang sman blas rjes bzung 'gro ba'i dpal// 'tsho byed zur phu rig 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog gi lam la sgrub pa mthar phyin pa// rnal 'byor bsod dbang zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa can// rnal 'byor chen po'i

584 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamagi lam̐//ra/ bsgrub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debasabazhugasaso/na mo ratna gu ru bhyaḥ rgyal ba ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la gsol ba 'debs// nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur rnal 'byor ma// dpal ldan phreng ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//nyams rtogs mthar phyin tshe 'dir skye ba dang // sems can bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mtshungs med g.yu thog zhabs//'gro ba'i mgon po mchog la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras dam pa bka' drin 'gran zla med// sum ston chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal tshab rmad byung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// dpal ldan 'tsho mdzad gzhon nu'i ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mnga' ris mkhas pa'i gtso// gtsang ston sangs rin rdor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rlabs chen spyod pa can// mkhas btsun rin rdor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i bka' la shing rta'i srol 'byed pa// don grub rgyal mtshan dpal la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i gso dpyad rgyas par mdzad// brang ti rgyal mtshan dkon mchog skyabs la gsol ba 'debs//rgyal ba'i gtsug na ngal gso mchod pa'i gnas// brangati dpal ldan 'tsho byed zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang sman blas rjes bzung 'gro ba'i dpal// 'tsho byed zur phu rig 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog gi lam la sgrub pa mthar phyin pa// rnal 'byor bsod dbang zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa can// rnal 'byor chen po'i

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 585zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs 'dzin spangs nas mchog gi go 'phang thob// ri khrod zhig po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub mnga' brnyes pa'i// zur mkhar chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu bka' drin che ba sangs rgyas dngos// dkon mchog mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bla mas rjes bzung chos kyi bag chags sad// nam mkha' rin chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// snang srid zil gnon rin chen kun gyi rje// bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// padma'i thugs sras ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin// rig 'dzin dbang po'i sde la gsol ba 'debs// bka' drin mnyam med zab gter bstan pa'i bdag/ ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dug lnga'i nad sel rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dug lnga'i nad sel rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku// gar gyi dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong // mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// deng nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob par// mtshan ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing // ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bla med sngags don spyod par byin gyis rlobs//snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams sems nyid dang // de nyid rgyal ba'i thugs dang dbyer med par// 'gyur med spang thob 'bral ba'i bde ba che// bla med sman pa tshe 'dir thob par shog/ skye ba kun tu sogs/thun mong ma yin pa'i lam zab kun 'dus rgyal ba'i bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyi brgyud pa'i rim pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi char rgyun zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ yongs 'dzin dam pa buddha shrī dpon slob sogs kyis bkas bskul ba'i ngor/ g.yu thog 'bangs kyi 'tsho byed sman pa'i gling bkra shis lha steng gi sman pa chen pos pho brang du 'brug lor gus pas

586 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigabris pa'o//ra/ g.yuthog snying thig gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabasakyi chu bo zhesabya ba bzhugasaso/sarba burnya kā ya wā ka tsitta mahā gu ṇa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du song bas/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor padma 'dab ma bzhi lte ba dang lnga'i dbus su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kā wā tsi 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen po mahā gu ṇa dang / bee ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po dbyer med sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/gzi brjid kyi dpal rab tu 'bar zhing / zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ 'gro la chags pa'i spyan zur phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ dbu skra kham ser li ba'i lcang lo can/ phyag g.yas sman gyi ljon shing a ru ra'i 'bras bu sum ldan dkur brten cing / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na bdud rtsi'i bum pa gur gum gzhon nu'i kha rgyan dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dar dmar po'i na bza' dang /dar mchin kha'i ska rags can/ zhabs rjen phyed skyil du/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas byin chi li li/ bag dro 'u re bzhugs par bsams/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ mdun du lha mo dkar mo rin po che'i pi wang bsgyur ba/g.yas su ser mo bya rgod rkang gi gling bu bsgyur ba/ rgyab tu dmar mo mi rkang gi gling bu bsgyur ba/ g.yon na ljang mo dngul dkar gyi me long ston pa/ bzhi ka yang bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ 'dzum sgeg ldem 'gying mnyen lcug 'khril ba/ rked pa man rin po che dang me tog gi phreng bas rnam par mdzes shing / dbu skra lcang lo sil ma/ mu tig dmar po'i lan tshar dang bcas pa/sku smad dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol nas/ gar stabs g.yo ba'i tshul

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 587gyis bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros pas/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dang /bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la sogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad dang / mnyam med sprul pa'i skyes mchog mahā gu ṇa dang dbyer ma mchis pa sman gyi lha mo bzhis bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin spyan drangs spyi bo'i gtso 'khor la bstim/phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ maṇḍal phul/ kha tsam tshig tsam min par/ snying gi dkyil/ rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu btab pa las bla ma'i gnas bzhi las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros/lha mo bzhi la phog thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul/ rang la gang 'dod kyi dngos grub ster bar bsam/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ snod bcud brtan g.yo bsdus pa'i dngos po thams cad kyi bcud dang / sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul/'od lnga'i rnam pa bum par thim/ bum pa nas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lud/ rang gi spyi bo nas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad du chi li li babs song bas/sgo gsum gyi nad gdon sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/ slar rim par lus bdud rtsis ngang chil gyis gang / dbang bzhi thob/sku bzhi'i sa bon mngon du byas/ slar yang gtso bo 'od du ltem gyis zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas chu la chu bzhag pa ltar thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa'i nga rgyal la ci gnas su bzhagadage rtsa byang chub tu bsngo/ rjes dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab bo// mtshungs med rang gis mdzad pa'i phyi sgrub yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i bang mdzod las/ bla ma lam du khyer nas dngos grub rnam pa gnyis da lta nyid du bsgrub

588 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigapa'i tshul gzhan las ches cher zab cing byin rlabs kyang gzhan las 'phags pas na/ snod min the tshom dam med log lta can la bstan na/ rdo rje bdud 'dul dang mkha' 'gro ce spyang mchu dmar gyis/ dpon slob gnyis ku'i snying khrag tshogs su rol/ dam nyams mā ra ya tsitta khā hi khā hi/ lung bstan la brten nas zur du khyer bde bar bris// sarba marga lam̐/ shu rbha//la/ byin rlabasamasgrub lasanyamasalen rgyun khyer bzhugasaso/na mo gu ru/ grub thob mahwa gu ṇa'i yang gsang gi sgrub pa rgyun khyer gyi nyams len ni/ tho rangs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid 'dug pa'i phyogs 'di nyid bee ḍūrya'i zhing khams bde ba can du gyur pa'i dbus su/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang nyid hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'am/ tī las sgrol ma dkar mor bsgoms pa'i spyi bor bla ma dang / o rgyan chen po padma dang mahā gu ṇa dbyer med du bsgom/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang gi dbus su padma nyi zla'i gdan la hrīḥyig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bla ma mahā gu ṇa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pus mo'i steng du bzhag pa'i mthe bong la 'khril ba'i padma'i sdong po snyan gyi thad kur kha phye ba'i steng du gser gyi rdo rje dang dngul gyi dril bus mtshan pa/phyag g.yon pas me tog padma'i yu ba thugs kur 'dzin cing snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba'i steng du gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i kha rgyan la gur gum gyi kha phye ba'i me tog gsum gyi steng du nor bu rin po che shel dkar dang /

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 589bee ḍūrya dang / a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba gsum gyis kha brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor gtsug la me tog sna tshogs kyi phreng bas bcings pa/ ral pa cung zad li ba sku rgyab tu 'phyang ba/ gos chen 'gang dkar po'i na bza' dang /ber dang ber thul sbrag ma gsol ba/ mu tig sna lnga'i do shal can/ bcu drug lang tsho g.yo ba/ mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/de'i phyi'i pad 'dab bzhi la sman gyi lha mo bzhi bzhengs pa la/ shar du lha mo dkar mo bee ḍūrya'i pi wa nga brdung ba/ lho ru ser mo sba gling 'bud pa/ nub tu dmar mo bya rgod kyi gling bu 'bud pa/ byang du ljang mo mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud pa/ bzhi ku'ang dbu skra mthon mthing spyi bor bcings shing / lhag ma zar bu rked par slobs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub gsol zhing /g.yu'i lan tshar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan cha sil sil khrol khrol gyis brgyan pa/ mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa'o// yang lugs gcig la g.yas pa la mda' dar me long / g.yon pa gling bu 'dzin pa'ang 'dug go/bzhi ga'ang zhal gtso bo la phyogs pa 'od lnga'i gur khang du bzhugs pa'o//gnyis pa lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ spyi bor mahā gu ṇa'i thugs kur rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan la dbus su sangs rgyas sman bla sku mdog phyag mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa/ mdun du drang srong rig pa'i ye shes dkar po/ lhor rig pa'i ye shes ser po/ rgyab tu nub tu dmar po/ g.yon du byang du ljang gu/bzhi ga'ang zhabs skyil krung / g.yon pa rnams sman gyi lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng du bsnams pa/ g.yas rnams kyis sman mchog rgyal pos a ru ra thugs kur bsnams nas chos 'chad mdzad pa'o// dar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhal gtso bo la bstan pa'o// sman rgyal thugs kur rin po che'i khri pad zla'i steng du rdo rje 'chang la rgyal ba rigs bzhis bskor ba sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs spyi dang mthun par bsgom/

590 ༄za/g.yu thog snying thigardo rje 'chang gi thugs kur padma nyi zla'i gdan la dbus su khro rgyal rta phag yab yum gnyis ka gri thod 'dzin pa dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyi ri padma 'dab bzhi dang nyi ma'i gdan la mkha' 'gro sde bzhi bzhengs pa gri thod 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs spyi dang mthun pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de ltar lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis med du bstim/ rigs lngas dbang bskur/ so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas rang nyid bdag bskyed gang bsgom pa'i thugs ku'i sa bon las 'od zer gyis maṇḍal dang yan lag bdun ldan sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med sprul nas spyi bo'i lha tshogs la mchod/ sman gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang / gzhan yang gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ de nas spyi bo'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum srid gsum dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras thams cad kyi mthu dang nus pa bcud thams cad spel nas lha tshogs rnams la thim pas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las bdud rtsi babs pas rang gi gnas gsum la thim/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob cing / sman dang tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gcig la gcig smin nas bsam don thams cad 'grub par bsgoms la/ gong gi rta mgrin thugs kur hrīḥdamar po sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ gong bzhin mthu nas thams cad bdag la thim par bsgoms nas sngags 'di ci 'grub bzlas so// oṃ āḥgu ru padma gu ṇa a yur dzñā na sirnyi hūṃ/ rgyas par spro na sgrub thabs chen po'i sngags rnams 'thud kyang 'gal ba med gsungs so// 'phro 'jog pa'i tshe lha rnams la mchod/ gang gi drin gyis bstod/ 'dod gsol gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams la mchod/ rang gi

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 591thugs kya'i sa bon la bsdu/ sa bon 'od gsal la thim/ sems nyid spros bral bde chen gyi ngang la bzhag go/ rjes nga rgyal dang ldan pas spyod lam chos spyod bdun gyi rim pa la 'jug go/ 'di ni yang gsang gi sgrub pa yin pas slob ma dam tshig gtsang zhing blo khel ba dang snying dang 'dra ba la byin kyang /phyag rten dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo med pa la byin na/ 'di'i bka' srung mgon po bdud 'dul yab yum dang / bshan pa dam can sde bdun gyi bka' chad 'byung / dam med snying khrag 'thungs shig ces bka' rgya bsda/mas pas gzobs shig spri/ /sha/ g.yuthog snying thig gi gtor mchod 'bul ba bzhugasaso//na mo gu ru/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar ba'i rjes su gtor mchod 'bul ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge ram̐ yo khaṃ gsum 'phros/ngag tu tshar gsum brjod pas ram̐ las me byung dngos po'i nyes skyon bsregs yo las rlung byung mtshan ma'i bag chags gtor khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin dri ma bkrus/ de nas/ oṃ su bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā shurnyo3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par gyur/ de'i ngang las oṃ las bdud rtsi rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba'i byang sems dkar por gyur/ āḥrakta 'khor ba yongs bsgral byang sems dmar por gyur/ hūṃ gis gtor ma 'dod yon lnga'i phung po snod bcud nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ hrīḥmachod rdzas thams cad mtshan bcas der 'dzin gyi rnam rtog thams cad dang bral ba'i gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar reg 'jam phun sum tshogs par bsam/ de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ku'i 'od zer gyis mgron rnams spyan drangs par bsams

592 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ sa ma ya st+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/de nas sman rag gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di nyid mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i bug pa 'od kyi rang bzhin gyis bzhes pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshim nas thugs rgyud bde phril gyis tshim par bsams nas/ oṃ āḥ rgyu badzra gu ru gu ṇa de wa ḍā ki sa pā ri wā ra mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta mahā rakta mahā ba li ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa rigs bdag bla ma sman rgyal yi dam lha tshogs/sman gyi drang srong rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag cag snying nas nye bar skyabs su mchi'o// gsol ba 'debs so// khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu dpag tu med pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag la sogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyams chags nyes ltung bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/gnas skabs su chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen bsam pa thams cad 'grub cing / khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi'i tshig don ma lus pa khong du chud nas/ lus can mtha' dag phan bde'i dpal la 'god nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lus la bde ba dang ngag la nas pa dang sems la rtogs pa phul du byung ba 'char zhing /rang gzhan gyi nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi zhing tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas/ khams gsum dbang du 'dus/ log 'dren tshar gcod par byin gyis

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 593brlab tu gsol/ da lta nyid du gnas mchog 'di nyid du thun mtshams 'di nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ rigs kyi gtsor gyur ma dang / gang sku gsang chen mas bstod/ dge ba bsngo/ rjes dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab bo// bkra shis/ shu lha//sa/ gang sku gsang chen mabazhugasaso/na mo gu ru/ gang gi sku yi gsang chen mchog/ dngos po kun khyab bde ba che// rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i dbyings// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i skur phyag 'tshal// gang gi gsung gi gsang chen mchog/ sgra grag kun khyab gzhom bral ba// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra sgrogs// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i gsung phyag 'tshal// gang gi thugs kyi gsang chen mchog/ spros pa kun bral bde ba che// shes rab pha rol phyin la gnas// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i thugs phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba kun kyang 'dren pa khyed// khyed las gzhan pa'i skyob pa ni//'gro ba kun las 'gang ma mchis// de phyir khyed la skyabs su mchi// byis pas khyod mtshan ma thos pas// thos kyang gus par mi bsten par// de las snying rje gzhan med pas// brtse bas khyod kyis rjes su bzung // khyod kyi mtshan thos skyabs song bas// de ni nam yang srid mtshor min// de phyir mig chu g.yo bzhin du// snying nas dus kun gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog/ gsang chen khyed skur ro gcig pas// de ring kho nar mngon sum du// mkha' khyab 'gro bas thob par shog/ smi/ sarba maṅga lam̐/dge legs 'phel//

594 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigaha/ byin rlabasabla sgrub las/ tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'jomasakyi sgrub pa bzhugasaso/oṃ mahā gu ru badzra ā yuḥsidhi pha la kli ho// ma bcos spros med khyab gdal chos sku'i klong // rtsal snang rigs 'dus bde chen longs spyod rdzogs//gang 'dul sprul pa sman rgyal tshe dpag med// 'gyur med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol phyag 'tshal// rnal 'byor gang zhig thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis// 'chi bdag bdud 'joms tshe dbang rab bsgrubs nas// dben pa'i gnas su bkra shis sa blangs la// dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi spos kyis byugs//'dab bzhi mu khyud rdo ra me ris bskor// dbus su rin chen bum pa dmar gsal ba'i// 'o ma mngar gsum gtsang chen sbyar ba blugs// nyer lnga'i rdzas bcas dar dmar mgul bcings dang // rigs lnga 'bras can shing gi kha rgyan bshams// steng du tshe chog dpal gyi ri bo ni// nor bu'i dbyibs can rtse la rdo rje dang // 'khor lo nyi zla rin chen 'bar bas mtshan// 'khor gyi 'bar ba nor bus bskor ba la// dkar gsum mngar gsum sman spos zas rnams brgyan// mdun du mtshan ldan snod mchog ka pā lar// tshe bcud bur chang a mṛ ta sbyar nang // tshe rten nyi zla dṛ mtshan tshe ril sogs// le brgan dar gyis zhal khebs ldan pas bskor// g.yas g.yon drang srong ye shes sman mo yi//dkar gtor rtsi sman mngar gsum bran pa dang // rgyab tu bka' srung dmar gtor sha khrag brgyan// mtshams bzhi tshe 'gugs srog mda' rgod sgro'i mgul//mthing ser dmar ljang dar dang mu tig g.yu// byu ru man shel me long brgyan pa gzugs// gzhan yang dkon mchog chos skyong gzhung gtor dang // sman raka /rag phyi nang longs spyod mchod pa'i sprin// mdzes shing yid 'ong dar

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 595gyi lhab lhub sogs// bkod pa'i bye brag byin dang bkod ldan bshams//bdag nyid bde ba'i 'di'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bde chen klong yangs nas len gdan 'dug sngon 'gro nas// bcoms te dngos gzhi bskyed rim tshe dpag med 'don par bsgyur// bstod pa tshar nas bzlas pa'i spro bsdu ni// lha tshogs bgegs skyod gtso 'khor thugs kur nyi ma'i steng // srog snying dag las 'od zer phyogs bcur spros// bde gshegs mnyes mchod sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul//thugs rje byin rlabs thugs rje'i dngos grub bsdus// thugs ku'i srog snying phyag gi tshe bum thim// sngags phreng 'khor bas 'od kyis lus khyab pa// bzhi brgya'i nad dang stong phrag bgegs la sogs// las dang rkyen gyur tshe yi bar chad rnams// 'od zer ye shes me yis rab bsregs nas// gzhob thul bskal ba'i rlung gis phyir gtor te// lus nyid gser gyi rdo rje nas 'bras tsam// rab gtams gnod byed gzhan gyi mi tshugs sam// slar yang tshe 'gugs 'od 'phros phyi nang snod bcud kyi// skye 'gro'i tshe srog dpal brjid stobs mnga' ris// sman 'bru zas gos rin chen 'byung ba sogs// kun gyi bcud bsdus 'chi ba med pa yi// dngos grub dam pa bdud rtsis lus gang nas// rdo rje'i sku la nyi zla'i tshe thob bsam// de ltar spro bsdu dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang //bzlas pa gtso 'khor dril ba'i sngags gsham du// badzra bum pa sgrub pa'i gzungs thag dngabacas gtso bo'i sngags sham la 'dogs ā yu she hrī rghaṃ dṛ dza/ zhes brjod/ nyi zla brtsegs dang gos dkar gyon// ri bo la 'dzegs me tog shing 'bras 'thu//rdo rje rnyed dang bdud rtsi btung sogs 'byung // thun mtshams bstod cing tshe 'gugs mda' dar g.yab// lha tshogs thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya mchog/ sku mdog ma nges dar dang rin chen brgyan// tshe 'gugs lcags kyu tshe bum mda' dar bsnams// grangs med phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun khyab ste// stong gsum sgo gsum khams gsum srid pa gsum// lha 'dre mi gsum rnams kyi tshe

596 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigabasdus shing // khyad par bdag gi bla tshe yar dang 'khyams// thams cad yi ge dṛ yi tshul du bkug/ tshur thim 'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam// tshe yi dbang mchog ye shes bum dbang bum pa nyid// spyi bor gdan drangs tshig don dran pa yis// hūṃ hrīḥbum pa'i ngo bo spros med chos kyi sku// bum bcud rin chen bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// bum pa'i rgyan gyis 'gro 'dul sprul sku mchog/ bar chad kun sol 'chi med dbang thob shog/ oṃ āḥbhū badzra mahā gu ru ā yu she hūṃ hūṃ tram̐ dzra dzaḥsarba sidhi abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ lha dbang dpal gtor tshe chang go khrab kyis// dbang bskur dngos grub blang dang rgyas gdab rnams//tshig dang don ldan ting 'dzin brtan pa gnad// de nas tshogs lhag bkra shis dge ba bsngo// mjug gi bya sogs las gzhung de ltar ro// snyan brgyud zab gnad thugs rje'i nyi 'od las// mos pa'i gang zag lam gyi bar chad rnams//bsal phyir 'chi med tshe sgrub rgyas bsdus gnyis// sgrub thabs 'di nyid spros bcas gzhan don 'grub// bdag don spros med gsang sgrub dril sgrub kyi//nang du gsal brtan de nyid nyams blangs pas// bar chad kun zhi 'chi med dngos grub thob// de ltar tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'joms 'di// mkha' 'gro'i zab gnad bla sgrub cha rkyen te// bla ma'i gsung las ma nor legs par bkod// dge bas 'gro kun 'chi med sku thob shog/ sarba ma ma ya hūṃ/ dge legs 'phel//a/ g.yuthog snying thig gi bla sgrub kyi tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'jomasabazhugasaso/rigs 'dus rgyal ba sman rgyal tshe dpag med// mtshan dpe rgyan rdzogs sman mchog tshe bum bsnams// sngo bsangs rang rig yum sbyor ye shes bdag/
