༄7/sdug bsngal munaselathugasarje'inyi'od/ — 597'gro la 'chi med dngos grub stsol phyag 'tshal// thugs sprul mi bskyod rig ye tshe dpag med// mtshan dpe rgyan rdzogs rdo rje tshe bum bsnams// mthing mdog rang rig yum sbyor ye shes bdag/ 'gro la 'chi med dngos grub stsol phyag 'tshal// sku sprul rnam snang rig ye tshe dpag med// mtshan dpe rgyan rdzogs 'khor lo tshe bum bsnams// dung mdog rang yig yum sbyor ye shes bdag/ 'gro la 'chi med dngos grub stsol phyag 'tshal// yon tan rin 'byung rig ye tshe dpag med// mtshan dpe rgyan rdzogs rin chen tshe bum bsnams//gser mdog rang rig yum sbyor ye shes bdag/ 'gro la 'chi med dngos grub stsol phyag 'tshal// phrin las don grub rig ye tshe dpag med// mtshan dpe rgyan rdzogs rgya gram tshe bum bsnams// g.yu mdog rang rig yum sbyor ye shes bdag/ 'gro la 'chi med dngos grub stsol phyag 'tshal// gsung sprul snang mtha' rig ye tshe dpag med// mtshan dpe rgyan rdzogs padma tshe bum bsnams//mtshal mdog rang rig yum sbyor ye shes bdag/ 'gro la 'chi med dngos grub stsol phyag 'tshal// chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang // gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs rung khro bo'i sku// gar gyi dbang phyug 'chi bdag bdud dpung 'joms// rta mchog yab yum 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// rtsa gsum rang snang dag pa'i ye shes lha// ma rig 'chi bdag bdud 'joms sgyu ma'i sku// 'gyur med bde chen tshe dang ye shes kyi// dbang bskur byin rlabs tshe 'dir stsal du gsol// zhes bstod/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni/ kli dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung mchog 'dus pa'i dpal// rta phag yab yum dbang gi las mdzad gtso// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas dus la babs// steng 'og bla tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlogs// srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'i srog rtsa dmar po chod// yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams po da lta khug/ 'gre'o//

598 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigardo rje mkha' 'gro lcags kyu mthing bum 'dzin// zhi ba'i las mdzad sprul pa yang sprul bcas// 'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// shar dang shar lho'i phyogs nas tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlogs// srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'isrog rtsa dmar po chod// yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams po da lta khug/ rin chen mkha' 'gro lcags kyu gser bum 'dzin// rgyas pa'i las mdzad sprul pa yang sprul bcas// 'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// lho dang lho nub phyogs nas tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlogs// srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'isrog rtsa dmar po chod// yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams po da lta khug/ padma mkha' 'gro lcags kyu zangs bum 'dzin// dbang gi las mdzad sprul pa yang sprul bcas// 'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// nub dang nub byang phyogs nas tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlogs//srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'i srog rtsa dmar po chod// yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams po da lta khug/ las kyi mkha' 'gro lcags kyu g.yu bum 'dzin// drag po'i las mdzad sprul pa yang sprul bcas//'khor bcas thugs dam zhal bzhes dus la babs// byang dang byang shar phyogs nas tshe khug cig/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi pho nya rdul du rlogs// srog gcod lha 'dre'i mgo bo tshal par khos// dbugs len gshed ma'i srog rtsa dmar po chod// yon bdag bla tshe 'khyams po da lta khug/ ces tshe 'gugs byed/ de nas tshe dbang ni sku tsa ka li/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku mchog sman gyi bla// rig pa'i ye shes rnam snang tshe dpag med// 'gyur med sku yi byin rlabs kun bsdus la// 'chi med rdo rje tshe dbang bskur du gsol// āḥsangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog sman gyi bla// rig pa'i ye shes snang mtha' tshe dpag med//

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 599'gag med gsung gi byin rlabs kun bsdus la// 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol// hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung mchog sman gyi bla// rig pa'i ye shes mi bskyod tshe dpag med// 'khrul med thugs kyi byin rlabs kun bsdus la//'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol// sā sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan sman gyi bla// rig pa'i ye shes rin 'byung tshe dpag med// yon tan re bskang byin rlabs kun bsdus la// 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol// ho sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las sman gyi bla// rig pa'i ye shes don grub tshe dpag med//'phrin las 'gro 'dul byin rlabs kun bsdus la// 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol// hrīḥsangs rgyas ma lus kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las yongs rdzogs sman gyi bla// rigs 'dus rgyal ba bla ma tshe dpag med// byin rlabs mthar thug tshe dbang bskur du gsol// 'byung lnga rnam dag rigs kyi yum chen lnga// bcom ldan bde gshegs lnga dang gnyis med sbyor// dug lnga 'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung cham (choms la// sku lnga'i byin rlabs tshe dbang bskur du gsol// hrīḥbade chen gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog dpal// gnyis med rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor// mthu stobs gzi brjid 'chi bdag bdud chem /choms la// 'chi med rdo rje tshe dbang bskur du gsol// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi 'chi bdag bdud bzhi 'joms// phrin las bzhi sgrub rdo rje tshe 'gugs ma// phyogs bzhi mtshams dang steng 'og tshe khug la//dus bzhi dus med tshe dbang bskur du gsol// ye shes lha dbang bskur ro//de nas gtor dbang ni/ hūṃ hrīḥdapal gyi gtor chen tshe dang ye shes re//nor bu 'bar ba dgos 'dod re ba bskang // nang na rigs lnga tshe yi lha tshogs bzhugs// dbang mchog bskur bas 'chi med dbang thob shog/ e ma 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi mchog/ tshe zan yi dam lha yi pha 'bab 'di// gang gi lce yi thog tu reg ma thag/ dad pas myang na 'chi ba 'byung re kun// sra brtan ri

600 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigabo lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ chad med chu rgyun lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ gzhom med rdo rje lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ nad sel bdud rtsi lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ re skong nor bu lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ kun khyab nam mkha' lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ gsal mdangs nyi zla lta bu'i tshe thob shog/ 'gyur med chos sku lta bu'i tshe thob shog/phyag rgya chen po mchog gi tshe thob shog/ hrīḥtshe chang rigs lnga yab yum byang chub sems// snod bcud bdud rtsir gyur pa tshe yi bcud// dad pas 'thungs na tshe dbang rig 'dzin thob// skal ldan bu la byin pas 'chi med shog/ sman 'bru rin chen zas skom 'byung ba dang // 'chi med rdzas sngags ting 'dzin bcud bsdus nas// byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi 'di 'thung zhig/ bar chad kun sel ngo mtshar a la la// de nas phyag mtshan go khrab kyi dbang ni// hrīḥcis kyang mi 'gyur mi phyed mi shigs pa'i// rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen padma dang // rgya gram phyag mtshan go khrab 'di byin pas// che mchog sra brtan 'gyur med dbang thob shog/ ces tshe dbang bskur ro// de nas mi 'gyur ba'i rgyas gdab pa ni/ hrīḥsnang srid 'khor 'das rang gi sems//sems nyid stong pa ngos bzung bral// 'di la skye 'chi grub ma myong // yang dag lta ba'i rgyas gdab bo// 'khor 'das gnyis snang 'dzin rtog bral// chu dang dba' rlabs ji bzhin du// sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal yin// ma bcos bsgom pas rgyas gdab bo// gdod nas rang shar chos sku'i klong // ma bcings ma grol lhun gyis grub// blang dor dgag sgrub dbyings su zhi//shugs 'byung spyod pas rgyas gdab bo// sangs rgyas sems can dbyer med par// kun bzang rgyal ba'i klong du gcig/ sa lam 'bad rtsol ci byar yod//rang chas 'bras bu rgyas gdab bo// dang po thig le nyag gcig rgya// gnyis pa thabs shes zung 'jug rgya// gsum pa dug gsum rang grol rgya// bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya// lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya// drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya// bdun

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 601pa byang chub phyag chen rgya// rgya bdun tshe la btab gyur na// snang srid 'khor 'das dgrar langs kyang // gnod par rdul tsam mi nus na// dgra bgegs gzhan gyis smos ci dgos// shu lha/gi g.yuthog snying thig masgrub kyi sbyinasreg lasakun myur 'grubabazhugasaso/na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang //chos skyong srung mar bcas la 'dud// bsnyen sgrub kha bskang las myur 'grub//sbyin sreg mdor bsdus gsung bzhin bri// dbang thob dam ldan rnal 'byor pas// phyogs bzhi zlum po gru bzhi dang // zla gam gru gsum thab khung brtsig /dbus su padma dpe chung ltar thab khung gi thab khung dang bcas 'dab bzhi pa// mu khyud dang bcas dkar zhi ba serargyas pa dmaradabang / / ljang gu drag po lha gdan bcas pa bri// 'o ma can zhi ba'i yam shing dnga'abras can rgyas pa'i shing // mdzo mo dbang gi yam shing tsheranagadrag po'i yam shing yamashing la// dkyil 'khor sgrub khang gi shar du zhi ba'i thab/ lhor rgyas pa'i/ nub tu dbang / byang du drag po/ rtsi mar 'bru mar zhun mar bsham//dkar gsum zhi ba'i rdzas mngaragasum rgyas pa'i rdzas 'brusnadabang gi rdzasadang // zas drag po'i rdzas bsham pa ni/ sna zhi rgyas dbang gsum la g.yas su drag po'i bsreg rdzas/ g.yon du bsang chu/ mchod yon g.yas su bsham mo/ mchod rdzas dang bsang chu g.yon du sha khrag dgra bgegs gzugs// 'phrin las gang sgrub bsreg rdzas bsag / tha ma sman raka (raganagator tshogs dang // phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas bskor// snga dro zhi banyinaphyedargyas pa srod dbang dang ni// tho rangs drag po las gzhir 'jug pa'i dus// rang nyid dang / gos rgyan dang / lta phyogs sogs// las bzhi gang 'grub de dang bstun// bdag gi thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'bru gsum 'phros//

602 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigardzas rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas su gyur te/shānti/ pukhyiX/ wa / mā ra ya ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pa ni/ zhi ba la gos dkar po dri med gyon/ dung pa so la sogs pas brgyan nas kha shar du blta/ rgyas pa rgyal mtshan gos ser po rin chen brgyan kha lho/ dbang la gos rgyan padma kha nub/ drag po la gos nag zhing lpags gyon/ thod phreng dang / dur khrod rgyan sogs nag po dang kha byang du lta'o// bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrang bka' srung mchod// rdzas rnams bgegs bskud bsang bsang chu la sbyangasayi kri ti shwa ri sarba pra pya ma sho dha ya oṃ āḥrgyu brlab// de nas sku shar me sbar la// rtsa sngags bzlas shing thab kha sbar// dgang blugs gsum gyis me yang gso// thab kha bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang // de las ye shes thab kha ni// bris pa dang mthun bskyed pa'i dbus// drang srong me lha sku mdog dmar// bram ze'i cha lugs ra skyes bcibs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bgrang phreng dang // spyi blugs 'dzin pa khro 'dzum bsgom// 'od 'phros shar lho mtshams nas ni// me lha spyan drangs 'di skad brjod// hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur spyon tshur spyon me lha che//sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// gnas 'di spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ asne sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes brjod/ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni// kli gzi brjid me yi gzhal yas su// yid 'ong padma'i lte ba la// drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas// 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol// agha (asne ye sa ma ya st+waṃ/ de nas phyag 'tshal sku khrus gsol// hūṃ shar lha'i phyogs rnams skyong mdzad cing // rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung // mthu ldan bsreg bya za ba'i bdag / lha tshogs 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ asne ye na mo hūm̐/ asne'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang // bdag gzhan che ge'i tshe 'das la sogs pa'i ming 'gyur sgrib pa sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus me long dang bzed zhal dri chab bcas chab

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 603'di gsol bas// mi gtsang skyon gyi dri ma dag gyur cig / oṃ badzra mahā asne ye de wa pra na sa ta ka ra pra tī bhe swāhā/ de nas phyi nang mchod pa 'bul lo// hūṃ me tog bdug spos mar me dri// ro mchog sil snyan sman raka ltarag gtor//gzugs sgra dri ro phyi nang gsang // mchod 'bul 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes// asne ambha sogs kyis phyi mchod/ aghi ye mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta sman/asne ye mahā rakta khā ti/ rakta asne ye mahā ba li ta khā hi/ gtor ma/ de nas nang mchod dang / asne ye dhū pa sogs kyis gsang mchod 'bul lo// de nas mar khu la sogs pa bsreg rdzas rim pa bzhin du dbul/ yam shing 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang // 'bru sna phyag dang gos zung ku// dkar gsum la sogs zhal du dbul// dgang blugs tshad ldan thogs byas la// rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad brjod// hūṃ gzi brjid me lha 'khor dang bcas rnams la//'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med bsgrub pa'i phyir// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'dod yon ma tshang med// sreg blugs mchod 'bul bzhes nas dngos grub stsol//oṃ aṭi ye ram̐ de wa sarba pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod/ zhi ba'i 'phrin las thogs med ces pa la sogs las bzhi kha bsgyur ro// zhes bsreg rdzas 'dod don rgyas pa sngags byang ltar ro// zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i kha bsgyur gang byed sngags sham gdags so// nad gdon sdig sgrib shān ti ku ru swāhā/tshe dang longs spyod pukhyi ku ru swāhā/ khams gsum srid gsum wa shaṃ ku ru swāhā/dgra bgegs log lta mā ra la /ya lha phaṭaḥ zhes brjod/ 'dod don gang 'dod bya/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūṃ 'jig rten tshangs pa mgon gyi sras//me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog / shes rab me yis nyon mongs bsreg / shar lho skyong mdzad gus pas bstod// dmar ser 'od 'bar ra skyes chibs//bgrang 'phreng ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin// tshangs skud la sogs rgyan mdzes spras//khro 'dzum 'gying ldan khyed phyag 'tshal// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang //

604 ༄zagayu thog snying thigadapal grags longs spyod la sogs pa// 'phel rgyas bar chad zhi ba dang //dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// de nas me lha'i lho ba de// yangs shing rgya cher gyur pa'i nang // 'byung rim brtsegs pa la sogs pa// rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// las gzhung ji bzhin bsrangs la bskyed// chos dbyings spros bral spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal dus gsum rgyal ba te//mchod pa'i sngon du sku khrus gsol// kli chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha' la//rtsa gsum longs sprul nyi zla shar// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa las// 'khor ba sbyang phyir sku khrus gsol// oṃ āḥlha gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni abhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shiye hūṃ/ de nas me tog bdug spos phyi nang thabs shes zla gsang gsang ba zhes sogs dbang lnga/ rtsa ba yan lag bhanta tshad ldan dang // sman raka /rag gtor tshogs snod bcudagator mar klu garaskye ba med pas mchod// dngos gzhi'i sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul// hūṃ bde chen ye shes khyab gdal klong yangs dang // thugs rje ma 'gags 'gro don lhun gyis grub// kun 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs la//sbyin sreg 'bar ba'i mnyes mchod sna tshogs 'bul// blang dor med pa'i dbyings su bzhes mdzad nas// bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// mi mthun rkyen ngan lam gyi bar chad zhi// ci 'dod dngos grub ma lus myur du stsol// zhes brjod sngags byang ltar/ tshogs 'khor sngags sham du/sarba pū dza dzwa la khā hi/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi kha bsgyur 'dod gsol gong bzhin bya// mar khu la sogs bsreg rdzas ni// gtso bo ni sngags byang ltar dang 'khora'i rim par 'bul// de nas bu ram go la ni// oṃ badzra sti bu ye swāhā/zhes brjod so rtsi 'bul ba'o// de nas gos dar ras la sogs// srab 'jam yang ba'i na bza' 'bul// chos sku bla ma de rjes bstod cing rigs 'dus rgyal ba bla ma'i gsol ba 'dod don lagadab// bzod gsol ye shes lha gshegs shing ho sems can don la/ / 'jig rten me lhar gtang rag gi / bsreg rdzas gtor ma phul bya

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 605zhing // asne ga chos shar lhor gshegs// bsngo ba rgyas gdab sbyin sreg bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba yi thal// zhi rgyas chu 'thung sems can sgrib pa byang dbang gsum chu la dor// drag po mnan pa dang gtad pa dang phyaralhor rlung btags la byang du bskuragasum bya// 'di ltar 'bad pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nyams chag skong zhing sdig sgrib byang // bsnyen sgrub myur 'grub 'phrin las bzhi// gang sgrub rno ba ngar btags 'dra// sum ston gsung bzhin ma nor bris// dge bas rtsa gsum sku thob shog / sarba marga lam̐/ shu haṃ/ dge'o// bkra shis//khu/ byin rlabasabla sgrub kyi lasatshogasalas/ srung 'khor 'jigasapa kun skyob bzhugasaso/na mo gu ru/ 'khor lo mu khyud bdun bskor ba'i phyi rol du/ rta mchog gi sku bris/ mu khyud bzhi pa yangs par bya/ pad 'dab bzhi mu ran dang bcas pa la dbus su rdo rje sems dpa'/ mdun du rnam snang / g.yas su rin 'byung / rgyab tu snang mtha'/ g.yon du don grub longs sku bris pa'i thugs ka rnams su rang gi sa bon bri/ mu khyud nang ma la gu ru rdor sems kyi snying po'i mthar/ 'chang ba la rakṣa zhes dang / de'i phyi ma la rigs lnga yab yum/ rta phag mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang bcas pa'i snying po'i mthar 'chang ba la rakṣa zhes bris/ padma bzhi pa'i mu ran bzhi la/ rang rang gi snying po'i mthar 'chang ba la rakṣa zhes pa rnams sngags la go nang la bstan la bri/ de'i mu khyud phyi ma la bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lus ngag yid gsum

606 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigal byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ srung skyob dbang bskur mdzad du gsol/ rakṣa zhes bris/ de'i phyi ma la chos skyong gang byed kyi snying po'i mthar 'chang ba la rakṣa zhes bri/ de'i phyi ma la yig la go phyir bstan nas dbyangs gsal/ rten 'brel snying po'i mthar rakṣa zhes bris/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'di la rab tu gnas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bris/ sku'i mthar me ri dang rgyab kyi lte ba la/ oṃ āḥbhū swāhā/ zhes bris/ bri ba'i rdzas rab gser 'bring dngul tha ma mtshal lam rgya snag la ratna lnga brdar ba la/ bzang drug ga pur/ tsan dan dgar /dkar dmar/ gi wang / gla rtsi/ gu gul/ shu dag bdar ku ru rta/ dbu lo/ gdung rus/ a mṛ ta/ byin brlabs can tsam tshogs tshad sbyar ba byug yar ngo'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang la bri/ bsdus pa byed na sku rnams kyi tshab tu snying po bris la phyag mtshan bzhi 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir bri/gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra la/ de nas mchod gtor gzhung bzhin bshams pas gzhung bsrangs mchod gtor srung 'khor dang lha dbyer med pa bskyed pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kur dam tshig sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kur ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kur ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ hūṃ yig gi sbubs stong ba'i dbus nang dusu/ bsrung bya'i tshe srog ngo bo ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa tshud par bsam/ mchod gtor gsol 'debs/ slar lha tshogs 'od du zhu/ yig 'bru la thim par bsam/ rang sngags lan gsum bklag rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya/ las kyi kha bsgyur gang dgos bri ba dang rab gnas thams cad kyi skabs su 'don pa bsgyur bas 'grub/ de nas dar sna lngas gril/ rin po che'i ga 'ur lus kyi snying ga'am/ spyi bo'am mgrin pa gang bder bcang / 'byung bzhi'i rkyen gyis bsrung ba la gnod pa ma byung bar du 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob bo// btags tsam gyis grol ba thob/ tshe 'phos ma thag tu mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'gro bar the tshom med

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 607do// smi/rigs lngar rang rang sgos kyi snying po ni/ oṃ badzra mahā gu ru sarba gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrgyu swāhā/ rta phag mkha' 'gro sde bzhi sum̐ lam̐ paṃ paṃ tram̐/ hrīḥm ta ri ni sa tsitta hring hring sarba sirnyi sa ma ya dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥ i āḥlha badzra gu ru gu ṇa sidhi kli/ rdor sems/ oṃ āḥburnya gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ rnam snang / oṃ āḥpadma gu ru gu ṇa sidhi hūṃ/ snang mtha'/ oṃ āḥratna gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūm̐/rin 'byung / oṃ āḥkarma gu ru gu ṇa sirnyi hūṃ/ don grub/ de wa ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa tsitta hreng hreng / rta phag dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ shu rghaṃ//ge g.yuthog snying thig lasaghasman gyi pra sgrub dngul dkar me long bzhugasaso/na mo mahā gu ṇa ye/ kun 'dus bla ma sman rgyal gyi// dbang thob dam ldan bsnyen sgrub them// khyad par bla ma srog bzhin 'dzin// de yi mngon shes rtsa pra sgrub// dben gnas nyams dga' bar chad med// mthun pa'i rkyen 'dzom mtho zhing bsil// sngon chad bsnyen sgrub ma byas shing // mi shi mi gtsang med pa'i sar// sa gtsang maṇḍal khru gang la// zhal zhal bya zhing dri bzang byug / padma 'dab bzhi lte bar mthing // phyogs tshon sgo skyong bcas pa bri//de dbus pho shing stag pa ni// gcig skyes mi khyis ma 'gom pa'i// bu chung dar dkar na bza' can// g.yas pas mda' dar me long dang // g.yon pa sba gling bsnams pa la// pha wang long bu'i logs drug la// tri yig gser gyis bris byas la// mthing shog gnad sngags bris pa gril// de nyid khye'u'i thugs kur gzhug / de bzhin sgrub sngags gre bar gzhug / leb rgan hrīḥyig bris pa ni// lce yi tshab tu gzhug par bya// de nyid 'bru sna'i steng du ba'ag / mi

608 ༄zagayu thog snying thiga'agrub kha med gnad kyi rdzas// 'dul bar byed pa'i sman gsum la// a ru gser mdog rdog po gcig / a ru sha chen rdog po gnyis// de gsum rim bzhin gser dang dngul// mtshal gyis a bris shar dang lho// nub kyi 'dab ma'i dbus su bzhag / 'gugs par byed pa'i sman gsum la// rgya tsha gur gum gi wang zhes// rten rdzas bzang po drug yin la// bskyed rdzas sman sna tshogs tshad bsags// mngar gsum shing mngar dbang sdud rdzas// 'khor rdzas smyug rgod tshigs bdun gsum// ma nyams rgod sgro can gyi mda'// dar sna me long btags pa dang // gser g.yu mu tig mig med bzhag / ba li gtsang ma lnga yang bshams// 'di rnams byang gi phyogs su'o// rtsa gsum chos skyong gzhi bdag gi/ gtor tshogs sman raka (rag mchod pa gsham// zur du 'bru sna mngar gsum dang // dkar gsum brgyan pa'i sman bshos 'di//phra ldem rtse mo dgu pa dang // srin bya'i shas brgyan dpal gtor la// srin bya'i mgo nang gser dngul gyis// lha mo'i srog sngags bris nas gzhug / de nyid mda' dar bcas pa btsugs// de la de mthar sur dkar sogs// dri zhim gtsang ma'i shing gis bskor// spos kyi dud pa rgyun mi chad// ri dwags sha dang gna' ba gang rnyed tshil bu phye mar dang // shug pa'i bsang dud nyin bzhin btang //mun khang shin tu dam pa gces// rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste// las gzhung bsrangs la bsnyen pa gso//chos skyong gtor mar mnyes par byas// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab//de nas stong pa'i ngang nyid las// bde stong zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng // rang nyid bla ma sman gyi rgyal// sngo bsangs 'od zer kun tu 'phro// dar gyi sham thabs mdzes par spras// phyag g.yas sman gyi lhung bzed dang // g.yon pa sba dkar gling bu bsnams// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan// 'dzum ldan 'od kyis sems can rnams// ma lus nad las skyob par bsam// de yi

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 609mdun du sman dang ni// rin chen gzhal med khang nyid du// dbus su stag pa'i bu chung de// dung gi khye'u chung dkar po la// g.yu yi zur phud smin khyug mdzes// dar dkar go zu sku la gsol// phyag g.yas mda' dar me long bsnams// g.yon pa sba gling snyan pa 'gyur// 'dzum sgeg 'gyings ldem de nyid kyis// lha dang sman mo dbang sdud cing // snang srid thams cad gsal mthong nas// bdag la thams cad smra bar bsam// shar nas ye shes lha mo dkar// lho ru smra byed lha mo ser// nub tu snod byed lha mo dmar// byang du sman pra ster nus pa'i// sman gyi drang srong thams cad bsam// lha mo gsum ni gzhon tshul can// rab mdzes yid 'ong lang tsho rgyas// mu tig lan tshar sil bur spras// me tog spel ba'i phreng ba dang // utpal bsgrigs pa'i rked chings can// rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis spras// dar dkar go zu'i na bza' can//mtshal gyi thig phran lam se lam// mthing shun mdzes pa'i cha ga btab// rin chen gser gyi gong lhag la// g.yu yi thig phran mdzes pas spras// phyag g.yas sba gling 'gyur ba yis// sgrub pa po la mngon shes 'char// g.yon na snang gsal me long bsnams// snang srid thams cad sa ler ston// yang na sman gyi par bu bsnams// 'gro ba'i nad rnams sel bar byed// gzhan yang lha klu sman gsum gyi// mngon shes can rnams sprin bzhin gtibs// ma lus yongs su rdzogs par bsam// de nas bdag mdun gnyis ka yi// thugs ku'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// rang rang gnas nas spyan drangs nas// bsgoms pa'i rten la thim par bsam// mchod 'bul gtor bsngo bstod pa bya//bsang btang 'dod don gsol ba gdab// rang gi thugs kur tri yig las//khye'u chung lha mo gsum bcas pa'i// srog sngags phreng bas bskor ba las// so so'i srog rtsa 'od kyi tshul// 'ub 'ub tshur la 'dus par bsam// dang po bsnyen pa'i sngags 'di bzlas// oṃ tsa munta hrī dī sa ma ya dun byo/ a ma tsi ra

610 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadu ma tsi ra hri la phob/ srid pa shod/ srid pa ston/ zhes pa zhag gsum bzlas pa yis// bar snang khams kyi lha mo yis// glu dang tshigs bcad lhang lhang 'ong // de dus bdag la snang gsal gyi// mngon shes rtsa pra'i dngos grub stsol//gang dgos bdag la bslab tu gsol// zhes pa yid kyis lan 'ga' brjod//de nas gong gi sngags sham du/ bsgrub sngags 'di dag zhag gsum bzlas//mi tshig ma 'dres ma yengs gces// oṃ bsnyen sgrub dngos grub gnad 'bebs ma ma hring hring log gnon dza/ mā ma shā sha mā ma hring hring / tri mā ma/ tri'u tri'u dzaḥsrid pa ston/ zhes bzlas bu chung smra ba 'byung // de tshe dngos grub sngags 'di bzlas// oṃ sirnyi ku ru sig ma hring hring dza/ zhes bzlas 'jig rten sgra rnams thos// de tshe sngags 'di gdags/ oṃ mā ma tsa tri tsa tri tri'u dzā/ zhes bzlas 'gro ba'i bsam pa shes// de tshe dbab sngags 'di gdags so// a a/ mā ma tri tri dza/ tri dun dun dza phob/ a ti ma ti tri'u sa ma ya lhan/ zhes bzlas so so'i snying ga ru// rang gi thugs ga'i sngags phreng las// 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros// srog gi dwangs ma bkug byas nas// slar yang tshur 'dus thugs kur thim// de ltar bsgrubs pas nad pa dang // nad med gang gi don byed kyang // 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// legs nyes gang bsam lha mos ston// gal te rtags rnams 'gor ba na// khye'u chung lha mo'i snying gi dkyil//me yi g.yung drung g.yas su 'khor// rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas//'od zer lcags kyi tsha tsha ni// bu yug 'tshubs ltar 'phros pa yi// 'od kyis gdungs pas 'dar zhing bsngangs// dbang med myos te bka' sgrub bsam//skabs su ā li kā li ni// bung ba'i rnam par grangs med 'phros// lha mo'i sna nas nang du zhugs// snying sogs padma'i dbus su babs// tshe yi dwangs ma'i sbrang rtsi 'jibs// tshur byung rang gi thugs kur thim// log gnon sngags 'di drag tu bzla// rma lha ṣa rdzu de wī sarba tsitta hring hring / i ku sha sa ma ya dza/

610 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadu ma tsi ra hri la phob/ srid pa shod/ srid pa ston/ zhes pa zhag gsum bzlas pa yis// bar snang khams kyi lha mo yis// glu dang tshigs bcad lhang lhang 'ong // de dus bdag la snang gsal gyi// mngon shes rtsa pra'i dngos grub stsol//gang dgos bdag la bslab tu gsol// zhes pa yid kyis lan 'ga' brjod//de nas gong gi sngags sham du/ bsgrub sngags 'di dag zhag gsum bzlas//mi tshig ma 'dres ma yengs gces// oṃ bsnyen sgrub dngos grub gnad 'bebs ma ma hring hring log gnon dza/ mā ma shā sha mā ma hring hring / tri mā ma/ tri'u tri'u dzaḥsrid pa ston/ zhes bzlas bu chung smra ba 'byung // de tshe dngos grub sngags 'di bzlas// oṃ sirnyi ku ru sig ma hring hring dza/ zhes bzlas 'jig rten sgra rnams thos// de tshe sngags 'di gdags/ oṃ mā ma tsa tri tsa tri tri'u dzā/ zhes bzlas 'gro ba'i bsam pa shes// de tshe dbab sngags 'di gdags so// a a/ mā ma tri tri dza/ tri dun dun dza phob/ a ti ma ti tri'u sa ma ya lhan/ zhes bzlas so so'i snying ga ru// rang gi thugs ga'i sngags phreng las// 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros// srog gi dwangs ma bkug byas nas// slar yang tshur 'dus thugs kur thim// de ltar bsgrubs pas nad pa dang // nad med gang gi don byed kyang // 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// legs nyes gang bsam lha mos ston// gal te rtags rnams 'gor ba na// khye'u chung lha mo'i snying gi dkyil//me yi g.yung drung g.yas su 'khor// rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas//'od zer lcags kyi tsha tsha ni// bu yug 'tshubs ltar 'phros pa yi// 'od kyis gdungs pas 'dar zhing bsngangs// dbang med myos te bka' sgrub bsam//skabs su ā li kā li ni// bung ba'i rnam par grangs med 'phros// lha mo'i sna nas nang du zhugs// snying sogs padma'i dbus su babs// tshe yi dwangs ma'i sbrang rtsi 'jibs// tshur byung rang gi thugs kur thim// log gnon sngags 'di drag tu bzla// rma lha ṣa rdzu de wī sarba tsitta hring hring / i ku sha sa ma ya dza/

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 611sidhi sig ma tri dza/ oṃ tsa mu na ta hri dā ya/ sa ma ya dun bhyo/ a ma tsi ra du ma tsi ra/ hri dā ya phob/ srid pa shod/ srid pa ston/ mā ma tri tri dza/ ma sha ma shatsi ma tri du tri du dza/ mā ma tsa tri tsa tri tri'u dza/ sirnyi sirnyi hring ni dza/ zhes bzlas dmigs pa drag tu gzir// rna ba dal du mi ster bar// sna tshogs gtam sgrogs the tshom med// 'di ni dpag mchog dam pa'o// 'bod pa la sogs sgra skad la// tshig lan yid kyis dri ba la// ngag tu shor na sgrub pa bskyed// gzhan la ma gsang grib phog na// 'bod pa don med sgrub pa zhud//dmigs pa mi gsal mtshams lhod na// myur ba'i rtags med sgrub pa bred//ha cang rna ba dal mi ster// log gnon mi shes sgrub pa thal// sgog bcong sha chang zos gyur na// sngags kyi nus med sgrub pa stor// skyon lnga spangs nas 'bad par bsgrub// dus gsum gdung ba'i sems dang ni// snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer// kye chos kyi dbyings nas spyan 'dren na//sangs rgyas sman rgyal thugs rje'i bdag / 'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsol// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul dngos grub zhu// kye rang bzhin dbyings nas spyan 'dren na// ye shes lha mo mched gsum byon// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// sman gyi lha mo mched gsum byon// gangs dkar ti se'i gnas mchog nas// 'phrul gyi lha mo mched gsum spyon// lha yi gnas mchog dam pa nas// ye shes khye'u chung dkar po spyon// dad dang dam tshig gdung sems kyis// bu chung ma la 'bod pa ltar// lhang lhang skad kyis bdag 'bod do// gzhan yang gzhan du ma yengs par// dung dung sems kyis bdag 'bod do// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur spyon// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur spyon// brten pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur spyon// phud dang rten la da tshur spyon// dngul dkar me long mdangs la spyon// sba dkar gling 'khrol skad la spyon// phye mar 'ol sgom (skom phud la spyon// sman dang 'bru

612 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadang rin po che// sna tshogs mchod rdzas bzhes phyir spyon// sman gyi lha mo mched gsum dang // ye shes khye'u chung dkar po ni// sngon gyi dam tshig dran mdzod la// ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir spyon// kye ye shes lha shing dud pa 'dis//sman gyi lha dang drang srong bsangs// rig 'dzin mngon shes ldan pa bsangs//sman gyi lha mo mched gsum bsangs// ye shes khye'u dkar po bsangs//'dzam gling brtan ma bcu gnyis po// bod khams skyong ba'i lha sman bsangs//gangs dkar rtse yi lha sman bsangs// brag la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs//spang la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs// nags la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs//mtsho la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs// bar snang gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs//sman phran nyi khri sum 'bum bsangs// kye ye shes lha sman mched gsum la// phye mar phud dang mchod pa 'bul// sman bshos rtse rgyan mchod pa 'bul// zas phud zhal zas mchod pa 'bul// dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa 'bul//rang rang mnyes mchod thams cad 'bul// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di gsol la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// srid pa shod la srid pa ston//ye shes khye'u chung dkar po la// phye mar 'ol skom mchod pa 'bul// spyan gzigs phud kyi mchod pa 'bul// snang srid ma 'dres sa le ba// ma bsgribs mthong ba'i dngos grub stsol// hrīḥphyogs phyogs dag ni pha gi na// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// gnam sa gnyis kyi bar shed na// g.ya' dang gangs kyi mtshams shed nas// sprin dang na bun thu lu lu// 'ja' tshon sna lnga gya ma gyu//sbrang char zim bu sha ra ra// gtsang chab sngon mo me re re// dri zhim spos dang khungad chi li li// gangs dkar gnam du zangs se zangs// g.yu yi spang ljang zhong se zhong // me tog sna tshogs lam se lam// sman gyi ljon shing si li li ri dwags rtse rgyug spongs kyi srang // g.yu sbrang sngon mo di ri ri// byu ru'i 'phyar /'phyang thag rgyang se rgyang // dung gi 'phyong phur bltams se bltams// gzi

612 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigadang rin po che// sna tshogs mchod rdzas bzhes phyir spyon// sman gyi lha mo mched gsum dang // ye shes khye'u chung dkar po ni// sngon gyi dam tshig dran mdzod la// ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir spyon// kye ye shes lha shing dud pa 'dis//sman gyi lha dang drang srong bsangs// rig 'dzin mngon shes ldan pa bsangs//sman gyi lha mo mched gsum bsangs// ye shes khye'u dkar po bsangs//'dzam gling brtan ma bcu gnyis po// bod khams skyong ba'i lha sman bsangs//gangs dkar rtse yi lha sman bsangs// brag la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs//spang la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs// nags la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs//mtsho la gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs// bar snang gnas pa'i lha sman bsangs//sman phran nyi khri sum 'bum bsangs// kye ye shes lha sman mched gsum la// phye mar phud dang mchod pa 'bul// sman bshos rtse rgyan mchod pa 'bul// zas phud zhal zas mchod pa 'bul// dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa 'bul//rang rang mnyes mchod thams cad 'bul// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di gsol la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// srid pa shod la srid pa ston//ye shes khye'u chung dkar po la// phye mar 'ol skom mchod pa 'bul// spyan gzigs phud kyi mchod pa 'bul// snang srid ma 'dres sa le ba// ma bsgribs mthong ba'i dngos grub stsol// hrīḥphyogs phyogs dag ni pha gi na// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// gnam sa gnyis kyi bar shed na// g.ya' dang gangs kyi mtshams shed nas// sprin dang na bun thu lu lu// 'ja' tshon sna lnga gya ma gyu//sbrang char zim bu sha ra ra// gtsang chab sngon mo me re re// dri zhim spos dang khungad chi li li// gangs dkar gnam du zangs se zangs// g.yu yi spang ljang zhong se zhong // me tog sna tshogs lam se lam// sman gyi ljon shing si li li ri dwags rtse rgyug spongs kyi srang // g.yu sbrang sngon mo di ri ri// byu ru'i 'phyar /'phyang thag rgyang se rgyang // dung gi 'phyong phur bltams se bltams// gzi

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 613mchong ka shing ta la la// sna tshogs mchod rdzas thibs se thib// sril /sil snyan rol mo khro lo lo// snyan sgrog glu dbyangs kyu ru ru// de 'dra'i gnas la su zhig bzhugs// ye shes sman pra mchod gsum bzhugs// 'khor du lha sman grangs med bskor// dkar mo ye shes lha sman te// snang srid shes bya gsal ler ston// ser mo smra byed lha sman ma// legs nyes thams cad rna bar sgrogs//dmar mo rno mthong smra byed ma// gang dris rdzun med thig bzhin 'debs//zhal mdzes gzi mdangs ya la la// snyan pa'i gling bu lhang se lhang // rin chen snyan cha khro lo lo/// mu tig rtsa mun si li li// dar dkar na bza' mtshal thig can// mthing shun mdzes pa'i cha ga btab// gser gyi gong ras 'od 'bar la// g.yu yi rdo rje 'phar ma non// phyag g.yas sba gling khro lo lo// sgrub pa po la gsung snyan sgrogs// g.yon na snang gsal me long dang // sman rgyal gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams// snang srid ma lus gsal bar ston// 'gro ba nad kyis gdungs ba sel// dam tshig can gyi srung ma mdzad// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog rtsa gcod// 'dir spyon mthun pa'i dam rdzas bzhes// dam tshig gtsang ma 'di na tshang // dngul dkar me long 'di na gsal// sba dkar gling bu 'di na snyan// rdzas dang rten la da tshur spyon// khyod ni slob dpon brgyud kyi lha//nga ni slob bu brgyud kyis 'bod// 'bod pa'i dus su snyan ma sra// g.yab pa'i dus su spyan ma rtul// bskul ba'i dus su bang ma bul// brten pa'i dus su rgyang ma ring // lhang lhang de ni dbyangs la spyon// kye ye shes sras byed lha yi sras// khye'u chung g.yu yi zur phud can// sku mdog dkar la mdangs dang ldan// mda' dar me long phyag na bsnams// srid gsum gzigs pa'i khye'u chung // ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir spyon// mda' dar bzang po 'di na yod// phye mar 'ol skom phud la spyon// g.yu shug sngon mo'i dud la spyon//gong ma'i brgyud pa gsung gis khrol// pra mthong dngos grub myur du stsol///

614 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigasngar gyi dam tshig rjes dran mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag la thugs ma ring /'dod pa'i don rnams sgrub par mdzod// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsol//zhes brjod mda' dar g.yab par bya'o// de ltar brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas//lus dang grib bzhin 'khor bar byed// rjes kyi bya ba 'di lta ste/// dam rdzas gzhan rnams gtsang sar sba// rang min gzhan gyis mthong mi rung // srin bya'i sha dang a ru ra// bu chung g.yu dang mu tig dang // gser thig dar sna lus la bcangs// rtag tu bsrung bya'i dam tshig ni// mdze can yugs sa ro bag dang // grib kyi rigs la shin tu 'dzem// bdag gis pra sgrub sgrub po zhes// su la yang ni bshad mi rung // gzhan la lung bstan 'dod pa'i tshe//a ru ra bzhar cung zad bsreg / rol mo'i sgra dang 'byung ba'i skad// sgra skad la sogs skad kyi rigs// rnam grangs gsal bor thos par 'gyur// gzhan la bzlas lung 'bogs dgos na// rang gi sgrub la bskyar bar bya// mang po spel na byin rlabs 'chor// gsang la rang gi snying nor bya// ha cang rna ba dal mi ster// mang du smra ba bsrung 'dod na// a ru ra dang te lo'i sha/ bsreg cing sgrub rdzas chu la dor// ro la reg na lha mo rnams// dpag tshad rgyang grags tsam du 'bros// mtshungs bral gu ṇa'i gsung ngag bzhin// sum ston gyis bris lag len ma// bdag gis zhal gdams dkyus su bkod// tshig nyung bsdus las kun mkhyen shog / pra sgrub dngul dkar me long snang gsal sgron me zhes bya ba rdzogs so// sarba mgi lam̐/ shu rghaṃ//ngo / byin rlabasabla sgrub lasalhaman gyi rjesaganang ma la bu 'khor zhesabya ba bzhugasaso/drang srong dharma swā mis sbyar/ na mo mahā gu ṇa ye/ lha sman mched gsum

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 615khye'u chung gi / rjes gnang ma la bu 'khor ni// padma 'dab bzhi dbus lnga bris//de steng bum pa tshad ldan du// mngar gsum bzang drug gser mdog dang //chang bzang sbyar la blugs la bzhag / dkar gtor gtsang ma rgyan ldan la//rang rang gzugs kyi sku rten dang // mda' dar me long btags pa gzugs//ba li gtsang ma ma nyams bzhag / tha ma rtsa gsum mchod pas bskor// rang nyid las gzhung bsrang byas la// dal bus bum pa dkyil 'khor bskyed//'od zer spro bsdu byin 'bebs byas// lha zhu bum pa'i bdud rtsi de// gang 'dod dngos grub ster ba yi// 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsir bsam// dkar gtor de nyid bsang zhing sbyangs// nang du rin chen gzhal yas su// ye shes lha sman mched gsum dang // sprul pa'i khye'u 'khor bcas bskyed// spyan drangs mchod bstod bsangs dang ni// bzlas pa la sogs sngon du btang //de nas slob ma khrus byas te// gsol btab maṇḍal phul byas te// rgyun bshags skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya// kye bla ma sman pa'i rgyal// bdag cag drang srong rig 'dzin pas// lha sman mched gsum khye'u chung gi / rigs gtad byin rlabs bdag la stsol// de nas dbang bskur sbyin par byin//bum pa mgor bzhag 'di skad brjod// hūṃ chos sku khyab gdal ye stong klong yangs su// snang stong yab yum bde stong 'gyur med sbyor// cir yang ma grub cir yang ma 'gags 'char// rang snang dag pa'i cho 'phrul rtsa gsum lha//bka' srung lha dang drang srong phyi nang 'khor// ma lus chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la// 'dir gshegs skal ldan bu la dbang mchog bskur// lus ngag yid la sku gsung thugs byin phob// oṃ āḥ rgyu sarba sirnyi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/zhes brjod bdud rtsir byin pa yis// sgo gsum sgrib bral byin gsum thob//lus sems zag med bde bas gang // 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob bsam// de nas gtor ma gnas su gtugs// slob dpon sangs rgyas sman

616 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigargyal gyi// sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros// gtor ma'i nang gi lha tshogs bstim// bran la rje yi bka' bzhin du// rang dbang med par 'byung bas kyang // ye shes lha mo dkar gsal de// spyi bo'i gtsug tu thim par bsam// smra byed lha mo ser mo de// rna ba'i nang du thim par bsam no mthong lha mo ser mo de// mig gi nang du thim par bsam// ye shes khye'u dkar po de// snying gi dkyil du thim par bsam// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i lha dang sman// thams cad ma lus pa ni zhabs// che ba ri dang chung ba rdul// grangs med lus la thim par bsam// thogs med mngon shes thob par bsam/spos bsreg rol sgrogs 'di skad brjod// hūm̐ hrīḥkun 'dus rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' zhing // rnal 'byor bdag gi bran du khas blangs pa// rno mthong mngon shes ston mdzad lha dang sman// thams cad skal ldan bu la 'go bar gyis// hrīḥye shes lha mo dkar mo mngon shes can// khyed ni lha sman yongs kyi rje btsun te// skal ldan bu la mngon shes dngos grub stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur cig / lha mo ser mo bden tshig smra byed ma//khyed ni 'jig rten gsal byed drang srong che// skal ldan bu la lung bstan dngos grub stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur cig / lha mo ser mo rno mthong 'khrul med ma// khyed ni lha sman kun gyi ma mo ste// skal ldan bu la rno mthong dngos grub stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur cig / ye shes lha yi khye'u chung dkar mo ni// snang srid ma 'dres ma lus sa ler ston// skal ldan bu la cer mthong mngon shes stsol// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral 'grogs gyur cig / hrīḥmana' dang dam la mi gnas su yang med// rgyal ba'i bka' la mi brtsi su yang med// lha dang sman rnams 'di nyid bran du byin// ci 'dod sgrub cing 'gal rkyen brlag par 'gyur// zhes brjod sngags kyi rjes gnang byin// slob dpon sman rgyal thugs ka nas//

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 617'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros// lha sman 'od 'phros snying gar gtams//de nas rten rdzas dbang byin pas// ba li mda' dar me long gtad la// rol mo sgrog cing 'di skad du// hrīḥsnyan pa'i sgra sgrog gling bu dang // shes rab mtshon rno mda' bzang la// zab cing 'phra ston le brgan dang // ma 'dres gsal steng me long dang // nad sel sman mchog a ru ra// sku gsung thugs rten sgrub rdzas dang // rten rdzas skal ldan bu la byin// dam la gnas pa 'di bcangs na// bu gcig ma ni ji bzhin du// skad cig tsam yang ma yengs par//'bral med rgyun du 'grogs pa dang // legs nyes lung bstan gsal bar shog / a tri ma tri su ra de wi ta re ru pa sarba hrīḥ sirnyi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥrgyu/zhes brjod rdzas rnams lag tu gtad// de nas gtor ma lha sman rnams//rang rang gang 'dod dngos grub kyi// rdzas su byin bsam bza' bar bya//dam tshig med la ster mi rung // hrīḥdam rdzas dngos grub gtor ma 'dod yon rgyan// ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa'i nor bu yin// sman mchog gtor ma'i bdud rtsi 'di myangs pas// ting 'dzin zag pa med la spyod par shog / ces brjod dal bsdu bsngo ba bya// bkra shes tshig brjod dmigs med kyi// sa la mnyam par bzhag par bya// 'di ma thob pas lha mi 'grub// de phyir gud du sba bar bya// mtshungs med gu ṇa'i phyag len bzhin// sum ston chen po'i zin bris las// nyung ngur bsdus pa'i zab tig go / smi/ dge'o//ci/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi lasatshogs/lhaman rgab 'dre mnan thabasamathu stobasagaser gyi ri bo bzhugasaso/ha ya shrī wa la na maḥ ye shes khye'u chung dkar po dang // lha sman mched

618 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigagasum bsgrub pa la// the'u rang rna nyan mkhan po dang // dam sri bya gdong myul le dang // 'dre mo lus zungs 'phrog byed gsum// rgab 'dre yin pas mnan pa gces// ma mnan the'u brang de nyid kyis// lha mor brdzus nas rdzun tshig smra//de rtags rmi lam byis pa ni// thal mdog mang po rtses pa rmi// dam sri ma mnan sman bsod 'grib// phyi nas nor gyi char phab kyang // nang du bu lon rgyun mi 'chad/chadaka/ / de rtags don med snying mi dga'// khyim la byin med 'gro snying 'dod// rmi lam bya khyi gcan gzan dang // rgyal po'i cho 'phrul shas cher 'byung // 'dre mo ma mnan dngos nyams sam// rmi lam thig le 'dzag par byed// lus zungs ting 'dzin 'grib pa dang // sgrub pa zhud par byed pa ste// de rtags bud med shas cher mis// khams nyog bsnyen sgrub byed mi 'dod// 'di rnams mnan pa'i man ngag ni// dug shog dag la gri khrag gis//liṅgā dpe'u chung bzhin du bris// dug sna byugs la sa khung gzhug / rang nyid las gzhung tshul bzhin bsrang // pho nya bskul zhing dbug (dbugs gzhug bya// thun brab bsgral las bstab par bya// lcags khang sgo med mun gling du//'dre gsum tshud nas thar med bsam// shi skra yugs skra mdze skra yis// liṅgā mgo gzhug bsnol mar bcings// rta bon mu zi nag po dang // sgog skya dug khrag ske tshe gzhug / bya rog thod pa'i nang bcug la// re bas gril la tshon skud bsdams// mchod rten lha khang byin rlabs can// brgya lam zam pa'i 'og tu mnan// bsgrub dus drag sngags 'di nyid do// oṃ badzra kro ta hya shrī wa/ rgab 'dre ming sring gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya brnya badha hūṃ phaṭaḥ sarba dam sri st+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes brjod rang nyid rta mgrin gyi sku las rang 'dra'i khro bo'i tshogs// sprul pa yang sprul grangs med kyis// rgab 'dre rang dbang med par bkug / phyag rgya bzhis dgug mun khang bcug / de steng 'byung rim chags par bsam// 'di min sman pra sgrub byed na// dngos grub thob khar

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 619bar chad 'byung // 'dod pa mi 'grub mi 'dod 'grub// de bas 'di nyid shin tu gces// rgab 'dre mnan pa'i shog dril 'di// shin tu zab phyir gsang bar bya// tshig brgyud ma gtogs ma spel zhig / sa ma yā/ rgya rgya rgya/sgrub pa zhag gcig bya gsungs so// dam sri'i lus ni mi lus bya mgo can zhig bya/ rkang lag gnyis lcags sgrog gis bsdam/ mgo bor rdo rje rgya gram bri/ yan lag bzhi la sngags/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ khong par tri du ru sa ma ha ba shaṃ mā ra dza dzaḥ dam sri mā ra ya nan/ st+waṃ bha ya nan/ snying gar tri dza kha sprod bri/ phyi la yig mgo nang du bstan/ oṃ badzra kro ta dang / dmod mo bri/de'i phyi la dza dang khro bri/ mgo la nan/ rkang zhabs yo yo/ 'doms su phaṭa bri/yang liṅgā mo gcig bri/ rkang lag gnyis lcags sgrog khong par dun tri tri dza ru ru bha ra bho mā ra ya dza dzaḥ snying gar tri dza kha sprod bri/ 'dre mo'i lus ngag yid gsum st+waṃ bha ya nan/ yan lag bzhi la dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥmago la nan/ rkang mthil yo yo/ 'doms su phaṭa bri/ yang liṅga pho gcig la lce brang du drangs/de'i dkyil du rdo rje rgya gram bri/ rgya gram lte bar hūṃ lam̐ bri/ rgya gram phyi rol du tri dza the'u rang dam nyams kyi lus ngag yid gsum st+waṃ bha ya nan/ mā ra ya nan/de'i phyi tri sa dza/ tri pra mas ra ma tsika mā ra ya dza dzaḥ lce'i phyi rol du 'phred du the'u rang rna nyan mkhan gyi phung khams skye mched thams cad mā ra ya st+waṃ bha ya nan nan/ yan lag bzhi la dzaḥtsū baṃ hoḥ rkang mthil la yo dang /'doms su phaṭa/ de'i dpral bar rgab 'dre nan bri/ phyi rol gong dang 'dra/zhal shes zab/ mgi lam̐//chu/ dngul bre lasadrang srong ser skya'i sgrub thabasabazhugasaso/nyi ma lta bur ma rig mun pa sel// zla ba lta bur nyon mongs gdungs pa

620 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigasel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bee ḍūrya 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong brgyud pas rgyud la byin brlabs shing // lung rig man ngag shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la// ji bzhin rtogs pa'i blo gros spyan yangs la//brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed gus phyag 'tshal// sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo//gnas lnga dag la mkhas pa'i klu sgrub la// drang srong nyi shu rtsa gcig gis// sman gyi dngos grub byin nas su// gso ba'i mchog tu gyur pa yi// sman dpyad kun la mkhas bya'i phyir// drang srong mngon shes sgrub pa'i thabs// rtsa dang chu dang phyi yi yul// kun la ma ltos nad ngos 'dzin// mo dang rtsis la ma ltos par//gdon ngos mdzub tshugs 'dzin pa dang // rgyud gzhung man ngag dpe la ma ltos par// sman sbyor ma lus shes pa dang // lag len nyams la ma ltos par//gtar sreg dpyad rnams shes pa yi// sgrub pa'i man ngag gdams pa 'di//drang srong rnams kyis bdag la phul// de la sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pa las/ gtso bo ser skya spun gsum sgrub thabs 'di// dang po maṇḍal zlum po zhigacos la// de steng bum pa'i nang du ni// 'bru lnga snying po lnga spos blugs//de yi g.yas su ze'u'i nang // bzang drug bsil gsum tsha ba gsum// rnam par myu gu shing / rdo pha wang long bu/ dkar po gcig thub mdung rtse/ smug po chig thub mdung rtse dmar/ sbal rgyab dang / gtsags bu gcig dang spra ba gzhug / g.yon du grir shi nges pa'i sre long sngar mi bsad cing kho rang yang grir shi nges pa dang // rta dang ba lang sre long bsad pa'isogs// pho rog zhug pa'i mig dag dang // de rnams me long nang du ni// sman pa mkhas pa'i skus gril la// de yang dar gril tshon skud sna lnga'i ze'u dang sbrel la bzhag de nas rang spos chu nas bton la/ rang nyid drang srong ser skya phyag g.yas na gtsags bu bsnams pa/ g.yon na bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon du gcung po khye'u chung sngo skya/ phyag g.yas skam pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon snang srid me long 'dzin pa/

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 621g.yas na khye'u dmar skya ni/ phyag g.yas na ne tsos ci yang smra/ g.yon na khye'u chung smra mkhas khrid/ de yang smra bar byed pa'o// rtsa ba'i sngags ni 'di lta ste/tarya thā/ mahā bai sham tse/ ratna bee sham tse/ u ā bee sham tse/ a mṛ ta ni la/sidhi dza kli breng hūṃ spri ti swāhā/ zhes ngag bcad la stong khri bzlas/ des sre long pa 'gul ba dang / 'khyab pa dang / me long mdog 'gyur ba dang / mig 'gul ba dang // ze'u'i sman khol ba dang / mang du 'phel ba dang / ze'u 'gul ba rnams gang rung zhig mi 'ong mi srid do// mi ma yin mang po rtsa ston du 'ong / bar chad yin pas dran pas bzung la mi reg par bya'o// sngon la sre long pa 'gul na sngags 'di sham bur gdags so// tsakṣu tsag kru pra sin pre ne tse rbad rbad pra pra tsi ti/ zhes gdags so// me long mdog 'gyur 'ong /mdog ma 'gyur tshe bzlas so// me'i mdangs tsam 'ong / mi 'gyur ba dang sman ma khol na 'di bzlas/ a phroṃ ra hri bee sham ce sirnyi ghi ni bi sha tri/ zhes gdags so// sre long pa mi 'gul mi 'khrab na/ dre'u be/ tram̐ shaṃ shaṃ then mru mru/zhes gdags so// rtags sngon ma gtsor bzung la sham bus bsgyur ro//rtags ma tshang bar du bsgrub bo// rtags gsum tshang ba dang / rang khrus byas la/ rdzas dar du gril la ze'u g.yas su bcang / sre long pa dar du gril la g.yon du bcang / sngags bzhi dril la/ da dung drag tu bzlas so// gzhung drang srong ser skya 'ong ste/ khye'u chung du byas nas 'ong ngo // sman dri chil byung na drang srong yin pas tshad bya/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pas drang srong la reg byas la/ 'tsho byed kyis dngos grub zhu zhes bya'o// phug ron gyi sgo nga zhig phyag rten du 'bul lo// gseb dri byung na bar chad yin pas bgegs bskrad/sngags rim la bzlas so// de nas drang srong gi khye'u chang gnyis bdag la 'bogs te/ khong gi sras gnyis kyi rang gi rna ba gnyis su/ rang gi ci 'dod pa bshad du 'ong ngo // rang gi yid la mngon shes 'char ba dang // rna bas

622 ༄7/g.yu thog snying thigathos pa dang / mig gas gdon rnams mthong ba dang / gso ba'i shes rab phyogs med du 'char zhing rtogs pa dang / nad gdon/ mdzub tshugs 'dzin pa dang / 'tsho 'chi'i dus 'debs pa la mkhas par 'gyur ro// sman dpyad rim gro 'bogs pa la mkhas par 'gyur ro// dam tshig tu sgrub pa'i dus su sha chang / sgo nga / sgog pa/ bud med spang / gtsang sgra dang snying rje la gnas par bya/ drang srong mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa gcig yod de/ de rnams kyi nang nas/ dngos grub che la sgrub thag nye ba ni drang srong ser skya spun gsum gyi sgrub thabs 'di zab pas gsang ngo // 'on kyang 'di gtso bo yin/ drang srong gzhan rnams kyi sngags rnams shes shing grub na/ 'di'i sham bur btags pas/ 'di'i grogs su 'gyur zhing / drang srong bkrag thabs nas ston res byed pas/ ma ngon shes shin tu yang gsal lo//mi'i sre long pas mi'i rtsa rgyang nas gsal bar shes/ pa dang / rta dang ba lang gi sre long pas rang rang gi dpyad la mkhas/ mig gnyis kyis lha srin sde brgyad mthong bar byed do// gu ru nā gā rdzu nas shin tu zab par dgongs nas/ padma 'byung gnas la/ des mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan la/ des gnam steng bcu gsum ka zhu'i nang du sba/ des brang ti rgyal ba nye mkhar bus bton nas bsgrubs pas grub cing rtags thon pa'o// de nas rim par brgyud de/ brang ti 'jam dpal bzang po/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/ brang ti dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ de dag gi bu dang slob ma'i don du yi ger gab sbas ser sna spangs nas bkod pa'o// rang gi brgyud sman chu rim pa ni thob yig tu blta'o//smi:sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong bzhi yi sgrub thabs 'di// bde gshegs thugs rje can gyis gsungs// 'di yi sgrub gnas dben pa'i sar//sman gyi bla yi sku gzugs la// phyag dang mchod pa rtag tu 'bul// sa dang lci

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 623ba bsres pa yi// maṇḍal khru gang zlum po bya// gla rtsi dri bzang ba chus byug /gur gum thig le lnga byas te// dbus su rin chen bum pa bzhag / sman dang rgyan la sogs pa yang // de bzhin rim par gzhag par bya// de nas sman bla gsal bsgoms la// sngags 'di lan bdun bzla bar bya// oṃ badzra bai sha dze/mahā bee sha dze/ sa mun rda hūṃ/ de nas shar lho nub byang bzhir// drang srong ser skya dmar skya dang // sdo skya dkar skya gsal bar bskyed// gur gum thig le snying gar byug / sngags 'di khri'am 'bum du bzlas// oṃ ri shig na ga gshe su ri kre pa ye/ ra na khri pa ram̐ ni ye/ ku ri bu ma ram̐ lam̐/ de nas lha des rim bzhin ston// ma bstan na yang lan gcig bskyar// des ni the tshom med par 'ong // de nas 'gro don byed pa'i tshe// nangs par rtag tu sngags 'di brjod//oṃ shaṃ pa ri zo ri li/ paṃ pa pa ri/ gu mi pra ma yā/ de nas 'gro don 'bad de bsgrub// de nas bzhin dang 'phrad pa'i tshe// ting 'dzin 'di dang ldan gyur pas// lus la yod pa'i nad rigs kun// nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin sa ler mthong // sun ma la yang de bzhin brtag / de nas nad pa'i rtsar bsdad la//sngags 'di yid kyis lan gsum bzlas// ma yengs rtse gcig rtsa bltas pas//'tsho 'chi 'dre dang mya ngan dang // na dang mi na god kha gdon// dbang thang tshe ni ring thung dang // legs nyes rna ba'i nang du ston// de ni smra bar ma gyur kyang // rmi lam nyams snang sa ler 'byung // sman bla drang srong sgrub thabs 'di// 'phags pa klu sgrub snying pos bsdus// 'di nyid sgrub pa'i gang zag la//drang srong drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis// rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs par mdzad /drang srong gi rtsa sgrub rtag sgom mngon shes can nas brgyud la/ stod lung yog thang gi mu to tshul shes la brang ti rgyal ba bzang pos zhus/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/ brang ti dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ de nas rim par brgyud pa'o//maṅgā lam̐/

624 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigaje/ g.yuthog snying thig gi bla sgrub kyi drang srong pra sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/na mo gu ru bee ḍūrya/ bdag 'dra g.yu thog mgon po ni// rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul phyogs su// klu sgrub snying por gyur pa'i tshe// drang srong nyi shu rtsa gcig gis// sman gyi dngos grub byin nas su// rig 'dzin bcud len mnyes par byas// so so'i pra sgrub gdams pa yang // rang rang dam la 'du byas pas// sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig yod// kun gyi yang snying bcud bsdus pa// bar chod chung zhing sgrub pa sla// rdzun med mngon shes thig 'debs ni//gtso bor ser skya spun gsum yin// de yi man ngag khyad chos ni// rtsa dang chu la ma ltos par// nad dang gdon la mdzub tshugs yod// mo dang rtsis la ma ltos par// 'tsho 'chi legs nyes stong gcod yod// rgyud 'grel man ngag ma ltos par// sman dpyad rig pa klong rdol yod// de 'dra'i khyad chos sum ldan gyi// gdams pa yid bzhin nor bu 'di// las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog / sa ma yā/ rgya rgya rgya/ smi:de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes// dang po dben gnas sa gtsang zhing //ljon shing sman rnams skye ba'i ri// nyams dga' 'gong po med pa'i sar//dgos pa'i yo byad 'tshogs par bya// phyag dar khrus dang bsangs mchod dang // chu gtor bden bdar phyag gsum bya// de nas bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal bca'// zlum po khru gang sor bzhi pa// nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs de yi dbus// rin chen bum pa tshad ldan nang // 'bru lnga snying po lnga yis bkang //kha tshar ma nyams dar dkar ni// gtsang ma'i mgul chings byas la bzhag /g.yas su par bu gtsang ma'i nang // bzang drug cu gur dzā li sug ga bsil

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 625gsum ga bur gi wang tsan danatsha ba gsum drod sman nag hril sba/ / 'du ba spyi snyoms rjes su bzhag / bla rdo mdung rtse dkar dmar nag po pha thang gnyis gsum// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i rten du bsags// gtsag bu spra ba'i thum bu zhig /gter (gtar sreg dngos grub blangs phyir bzhag / g.yon du skyes pa dar ma ni// gri khar bsad pa'i sre long pa// rgyang dpyad rtsa brtag shes phyir ba'ag /de bzhin rta dang ba lang gi / sre long pho nya'i rigs dpyad ston// pho rog zhug pa'i mig gnyis kyis// lha srin sde brgyad mngon sum mthong // g.ya' bral dag pa'i me long nang // de rnams gzhug pa sman pa ni// mkhas pa'i skra yis gril te bzhag / snang srid dge mtshan ji snyed pa// rang sems me long nang du 'char// bum pa ze'u me long gsum// dar tshon sna lnga'i tshon bu sbrel// bsgrub bya lha dang sgrub pa po// mi 'bral rgyun du 'grogs par byed// dar dkar dri med gtsang ma zhig / phu /phug ron sgo nga'i phyag rten yang // de yi mdun du gzhag par bya// bzang drug sman chus mgo lus bkrus// gos dkar sman gyis bdug pa bsgo// dkar gtor gtsang ma gsum yang bsham// tsan dan ar nag bzang po drug / thun re kun dang spos dkar mnyam// bdug spos spyan 'dren dus su bsreg / dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum// bsnyen pa la yang gzhi bsnyen dang // nye bar sgrub pa'i las bsnyen po// dang po khri tsho gcig bzlas nas// 'di yi slob ma rjes 'dzin bya// gnyis pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas// sgrub pa dngos la 'jug par bya// gang yang dang po bgegs gtor btang // srung 'khor bsgom zhing gu gul bdug / de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya// khyad par nad ldan 'gro ba la// snying rje'i mchi ma byung nus par// snying khung rus pa'i gting nas bsgom// de yi sdug bsngal bsal bya'i phyir// pra sgrub nyams len dang bas bya// oṃ su bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswabhā wa shurnyo ྅ haṃ/ gnyis snang chos kyi dbyings su bsdus// ka dag

626 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigarig pa rten med de// gsal 'grib med pa'i ngang la gzhag / slar yang snying rjes kun bslangs nas// rang nyid drang srong ser skya ni// phyag g.yas ye shes gtsags bu bsnams// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs zug rngu 'byin// g.yon pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin// 'chi med rig 'dzin dngos grub ster// sngon du gcung po sngo skya ni// phyag g.yas gser gyi skam pa yis// bdag 'dzin rde'u dbyung bar byed// g.yon pa dngul dkar me long bsnams// snang srid ma 'dres gsal bar ston// g.yas na khye'u chung dmar skya ni// phyag g.yas ne tso smra mkhan 'dzin// nad gdon 'tsho 'chi lung ston byed// g.yon pa rig pa'i khye'u chung khrid// snang srid legs nyes tham sa cad sgrog / kun kyang gzhon tshul bkrag mdangs rgyas// 'dzum sgeg yid 'ong blta na sdug / dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// gnas gsum yi ge gsum tshan bsgom// hūṃ gi 'od zer spro bsdu yis// rang bzhin ka dag chos kyi dbyings// brtan g.yo kun khyab sman gyi ri// g.ya' gangs mtsho gling phyogs bcu nas// sman bla rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang // drang srong ser skya spun gsum dang // mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas// lha lam chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa ltar// spyan drangs rten la 'khor bar bsam// de yi 'od kyis rten rnams ni// bsang sbyangs dag pa nyid gyur te// ngo bo ye shes rnam rol ba// chos kun gsal 'grib med 'char ba'i// rnam pa rang rang rdzas kyi tshul// drang srong 'khor bcas 'dus par bsam // rig pa rten dang dmigs pa las// gzhan du ma yengs sngags 'di bzlas// tarya thā/ mahā bee shaṃ tse/ ratna bee shaṃ dzu/ u hā bee shaṃ tse/ a mṛ ta bi la/ sirnyi dza hūṃ breng hūm̐/ pra ti swāhā/ 'bum phrag gcig tu rdzogs pa na//'grub pa'i snga rtags mtshan ma 'char// de dus 'byung po mi ma yin// bar chod brtsam phyir nad pa yi// chas su brdzus nas rtsa ston 'ong // de la reg par mi bya zhing // dgag sgrub blang dor med pa yis// rig pa ngar bskyed stong

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 627pa dang // snying rje zung 'jug gsal snang rnams// re mos bsgom zhing drag sngags bzlas// dang por sre long 'gul ba na// rtsa sngags sham du sngags 'dis bsgyur// tsakṣu tsaka kru pra srin pra bi rtse rbad rbad bra pra tsi te/ zhes gdags me long mdog 'gyur te// me 'od lta bur 'bar ba 'byung // ze'u sman rnams lang long khol// de tshe slar yang sham bu gdags// a mṛ ta hri bai shaṃ tse/ sirnyi ghi na pi sha dri/ zhes gdags sre long mi 'khrab na// sngags gsum la yang sham bu ni// ti bu pre dri shaṃ shaṃ then then mru mru/ zhes gdags sngon la gang byung ba'i// rtags kyi sham bu gtsor bton nas// gzhan dag skabs dang sbyar la bsgyur// rdzas sna re re'i rang rtags rnams// gong ma byung la sngags 'di ci nus gzir// sre long 'gul 'khyab me long 'bar// sman khol rtags gsum rdzogs tshang nas// rang nyid khrus byas rten rdzas rnams// dar gril ze'u g.yas phyogs dang // me long la sogs pa rnams g.yon phyogs mtshan khung gdags// sngags bzhi bsgril la ma yongs bzlas// de nas drang srong dngos su byonasgrub khang du/ / saphyis kyi byung na dri ngan pas sna drangs na// 'byung pos bar chod rtsom pa'i phyir// rig pa hur phyung lta ba bsgom// bgegs bskud srung 'khor la 'bad bya// sman dri bzang pos sna drangs na// drang srong yin pas dngos grub blang // de yang khye'u chung gi tshul du yodapas/ / lag pa de la rang gi g.yon pa dar gyis g.yogs// drang srong lag pa g.yon la 'ju// g.yas pa phug ron sgo nga 'buladrang srong / / gso dpyad kun gyi rgyud gzhung man ngag la mkhas pa dang // rtsa rtags dang chu tigs dang na lugs kyi rtags pa la sogs pa// nad rtags thams cad cerab dang mthong gsal ba dang // mthong par shes pa la sogs pa'i// dngos grub gang 'dod blang bar bya// drang srong de yi khye'u chung gnyisasmra mkhas/ / bdag la rnam shes mkhan du 'bogs// de gnyis kyis ni rna gnyis su// legs nyes thams cad smra bar byed// nad pa rtsa chu ngo tshul sogs//

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 627pa dang // snying rje zung 'jug gsal snang rnams// re mos bsgom zhing drag sngags bzlas// dang por sre long 'gul ba na// rtsa sngags sham du sngags 'dis bsgyur// tsakṣu tsaka kru pra srin pra bi rtse rbad rbad bra pra tsi te/ zhes gdags me long mdog 'gyur te// me 'od lta bur 'bar ba 'byung // ze'u sman rnams lang long khol// de tshe slar yang sham bu gdags// a mṛ ta hri bai shaṃ tse/ sirnyi ghi na pi sha dri/ zhes gdags sre long mi 'khrab na// sngags gsum la yang sham bu ni// ti bu pre dri shaṃ shaṃ then then mru mru/ zhes gdags sngon la gang byung ba'i// rtags kyi sham bu gtsor bton nas// gzhan dag skabs dang sbyar la bsgyur// rdzas sna re re'i rang rtags rnams// gong ma byung la sngags 'di ci nus gzir// sre long 'gul 'khyab me long 'bar// sman khol rtags gsum rdzogs tshang nas// rang nyid khrus byas rten rdzas rnams// dar gril ze'u g.yas phyogs dang // me long la sogs pa rnams g.yon phyogs mtshan khung gdags// sngags bzhi bsgril la ma yongs bzlas// de nas drang srong dngos su byonasgrub khang du/ / saphyis kyi byung na dri ngan pas sna drangs na// 'byung pos bar chod rtsom pa'i phyir// rig pa hur phyung lta ba bsgom// bgegs bskud srung 'khor la 'bad bya// sman dri bzang pos sna drangs na// drang srong yin pas dngos grub blang // de yang khye'u chung gi tshul du yodapas/ / lag pa de la rang gi g.yon pa dar gyis g.yogs// drang srong lag pa g.yon la 'ju// g.yas pa phug ron sgo nga 'buladrang srong / / gso dpyad kun gyi rgyud gzhung man ngag la mkhas pa dang // rtsa rtags dang chu tigs dang na lugs kyi rtags pa la sogs pa// nad rtags thams cad cerab dang mthong gsal ba dang // mthong par shes pa la sogs pa'i// dngos grub gang 'dod blang bar bya// drang srong de yi khye'u chung gnyisasmra mkhas/ / bdag la rnam shes mkhan du 'bogs// de gnyis kyis ni rna gnyis su// legs nyes thams cad smra bar byed// nad pa rtsa chu ngo tshul sogs//

628 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigamathong ba tsam gyis mngon shes 'char// dir dir sgra sgrog rna bas thos mig gis gdon rnams thams cad mthong // gso ba'i shes rab phyogs med 'char//'tsho 'chi stong gcod drang thig 'debs// ci 'dod tshegs med ston par 'gyur// sgrub dus lto dkar la brten nas// sha chang sgo nga sgog btsong spang //mdze yugs dme pho sho re dang // ro bag ban de sdom nyams dang // dam nyams gdon can phyogs mi gtong // gdeng mtshams ngag bcad dben pa bsten// bzang rtags nyid la dga' mi bya// reg pa 'dod pa'i bsam pa bskyung // ngan rtags nyid la 'khu mi bya// zhum dang ngal ba ma sems par//gang byung sgyu ma rmi lam ltar// rang bzhin med pa'i blo gdeng gis// snang ba nyams kyi 'char sgo la// dgag sgrub blang dor med pas glod/sprodaka/ / rig pa ma yengs sngags bzlas shing // byams pa snying rje stong nyid bsgom// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni// bum pa maṇḍal bang mdzod gzhug / sman dang yo byad phud kyis mchod// mi la mi bstan sba bar bya//rang gi rtsa chu las shes pa ltar las kha dmar gdags// drang srong gis bshad pa'i gsang tshigarnams bshad mi rung // ro bag mdze yugs dme shor la// lag pas mi reg zas gos bsrung // lo dus yar ngo tshes bzang la// zhag bdun re yis bsnyen sgrub gso// gnas skabs rnam pa thams cad du// gsang zhing yid ches nges pa dang // the tshom log lta med pa yi// bsam pa brtan pa shin tu gces// lung dang rig gtad ma thob par// bsgrubs kyang rgyus med don spyod 'dra// sgrub pa gnad la mi mkhas na// ngal ba don med stong zad yin//dam tshig dad gus mi ldan na// bar chad log pa sgrub pa yin// snying rus blo gdeng mi ldan na// gcam bus rang nyid sma 'bebs yin// dam rdzas yo byad ma tshang na// chas med mgron la brda rgyab yin// byams dang snying rje mi ldan na// khra yis bye'u bsgug pa 'dra// de phyir sgrub pa'i gdams pa'i gnad drug

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 629gces// klu sgrub snying po'i gdams pa 'di// o rgyan padma sambha was// mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid la gdams// bsam yas gnam steng ka zhu'i nang // ma 'ongs don du gter du sbas// brang ti rgyal nye /mnyen mkhar bus bton//grub rtags rim par thon nas ni// 'gro don rlabs chen rdzogs bya'i phyir//g.yu thog zhal nas snyan brgyud 'di// phyi rabs don du khrigs su bsdebs//snying dang 'dra ba gcig la gdams// mang por spel na dngos grub yal//rang gi sgrub pa tshar nas ni// gzhan la lugs dang rig gtad sogs// yod ces tsam yang bshad mi rung // gal te bshad na sgrub pa bskyar// 'di la gab 'khrul sbas pa med// gsang ba'i gab yig dmar khrid 'di// chig brgyud bka' rgyas btab pa'i phyir// sngon chad dngos grub ma thob med// slar yang 'tshal du ma 'jug cig / sa ma yā/ rgya rgya rgya/ lho: gsang ngo //'di yi rig gtad cho ga ni// sgrub pa'i rten rnams ji bzhin bsham//slob dpon bdag bskyed bzlas pa byas// slob ma khrus byas yon phul nas//gsol ba gdab pa 'di ltar ro// drang srong sman bla rdo rje 'dzin// nyam thag 'gro la phan gdags phyir// mngon shes pra sgrub zab mo yi// rig gtad cho ga'i bka' drin mdzod// slob ma bsang sbyangs drang srong ni// ser skya spun du bskyed pa la// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim// bum pa spyi bor bzhag nas ni// rab mdzes bkra shis dbang gi bum// dam rdzas bdud rtsi chen pos bkang // snying gi bu la dbang bskur bas// log rtog the tshom dri bral shog / abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ lus kyi dri ma dag 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gzugs snang thams cad mngon sum ma bsgribs par mthong zhing rig par bsam/ sku bum pa'i dbang ngo // sngags kyi bzlas pa'i lung byin la//me tog spyi bor bzhag nas ni// rig sngags 'di ni bzlas gyur na// gso ba'i shes rab phyogs med 'char// kha dmar rno thig gtan la 'bebs// khyod

630 ༄zagayu thog snying thigakyis 'gro ba'i don gyis shig / gsung gi dbang ngo // ngag gi dri ma dag sgra thams cad thos par bsam/ me long bstan la sems ngo sprad// rang gi dri bral me long la// snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun 'char// gsal bzhag med par shes kyis la// 'khrul pa'i dbang du gtang mi bya// thugs kyi dbang ngo // yid kyi dri ma dag rang byung gi gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan brjod de ye shes skyes par bsam/ sgrub pa'i lung byin bka' bsgo bya// mi la mi bshad gsang bar gdams// rig gtad cho ga'i tho chung 'di// brjed par 'das phyir mdo tsam bkod// slob dpon mkhas pa'i phyag len dang // ngag gi rgyun 'di rtse gcig nyon// gal te 'da' bar gyur pa na// dngos grub thob pa'i skal ba med// cho ga tshul bzhin spyad gyur na// ci 'dod dngos grub 'bad med 'grub// rang gzhan don gnyis yongs rdzogs byed// sa ma yā/rgya rgya rgya/ smi:nyo/ g.yuthog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon rtogasagasal ba'i me long zhesabya ba bzhugasaso/gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la na maḥ bka' srung dam can sde dgu yi//mngon rtogs mdor bsdus rim pa ni// mchod gtor bsang sbyangs byin brlab nas// rang nyid ltar (lhar gsal mdun gyi mkhar// chos 'byung dgra bgegs pad nyi'i steng // skad cig dran rdzogs 'ja' ltar shar// snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa// bka' sdod bran 'khor tshul du bskyed// oṃ shun+ya tā sogs/ dbus su mahā kā la/ gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rab khros 'jigs rung phyag g.yas nor bus yu ba byas pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod rlon

〉〉/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 631gyi nang du bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams shing / dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol ba/ mi mgo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan te/ tsan dan gyi beng ji/beng chen rked par btsugs nas rta nag rting dkar rlung gi shugs 'chang ba la chibs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// 'khor rnams ni shar du e ka dza ṭī mthing nag rab khros zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs yongs rdzogs g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag dre'u gwa pa la zhon te/ snga sha la tshon gyi dru bu/ phyi sha la nad kyi rkyal ba btags pa/ spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan te/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor nas me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/lhor khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la sku mdog rab tu 'jigs pa'i khro gzugs sku smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba'i/ dbu dgu'i gtsug na bya rog gi mgo bos brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na sbrul zhags/ g.yon na rwa'i mda' gzhu bsnams shing / mgo lus thams cad mig 'jigs su rung bas gang ba/ sprin nag chu srin mgo dgu la zhon nas/ sde brgyad gzhan thams cad bran du khol bar bsam mo// nub tu mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ce spyang dmar mo rab tu khros pa'i gdong can khrag ral sprugs pas dgra bgegs la nad kyi char ba 'bebs pa/lus gcer bur nu ma thur du 'phyang ba'i phyag gzhi'i dang po thod khrag 'og ma gnyis kyis g.yas dgra zor/ g.yon rgyu zhags dang mi mgo 'phyar ba/ dur bya mgo dgu pa la zhon nas dur khrod ma lus kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ byang du gnon /gnod sbyin shan pa dmar po mtshal cog la'am byu ru'i mdog can/stag gi gdong pa rab khros phyag gnyis g.yas zangs gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod cing / g.yon dgra snying rgyu ma dron mo thogs pa/ tsitta'i phreng bas lus kun brgyan te g.yu 'brug zhon nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med pa dang bcas nas stong gsum myul ba'i bdag por gyur/ shar lho'i dam can srog gi

632 ༄/g.yu thog snying thigaspu gri sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros shing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can gyi srin po'i zhal rngams shing brjid par phyag gnyis g.yas sru gri/ g.yon dam nyams pa'i glo snying thogs pas dar nag 'jol ler gyon zhing / mi mgo'i phreng ba can seng ge la zhon te skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog gi bdag por gyur/ lho nub tu srin po dgra 'dul 'jigs byed dmar nag khro gtum rab 'jigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ yas kyi mche bas brang gi sten snar slebs/ mas kyi mche bas dpral ba'i dbyings su slebs pas mi ro chem chem du za zhing spyi bor spyang gdong kha gdangs nga ro sgrogs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar ba/g.yon rtse gsum dang rgyu zhags bzung ste/ mi lpags rlon pa gyon zhing ro langs mgo dgu la zhon pa/ keng rus gar byed dung phyur grangs med kyis bskor ba phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs kyi gshed ma chen mor gyur pa/ nub byang du bdud shrīnta ro zan dud mdog rab khros 'jigs rung bya mgo can mtshe gtsigs spyan dmar can khrag gi ral pa sprug nu ma 'phyang ba phyag gnyis g.yas rgyu zhags dang dgra sta 'phyar zhing / g.yon tsitta bsnams nas lcags spyang mgo dgu zhon nas dgra bgegs sgrol bar gyur/ byang shar du srog bdag hob se dug ha la'i mdog can mthing nag rab khros 'jigs rung zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ spyi bor bya khra'i mgo bo cher rgod cing / phyag dang po gnyis mdung dang dug gi rgyal ba thogs pa/ 'og ma gnyis mi mgo rlon pa dang phur ba bsnams shing /dred mo mgo dgu la zhon nas dam nyams thams cad kyi gshed mar gyur/ de dag thams cad kyang nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan/ khro ba/ gtum pa/ 'jigs pa/ rngams pa/ snying rje med cing mi sha mi khrag gsur chen gyi dri tshor ba tsam gyis bzod glags med pa/ rkan sgra rdebs pa/ skad cig re re la sprul pa yang sprul sum sprul nyi zer rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa phyogs bcur 'gyed nas pa dang / khams gsum srid gsum mtha' dag myul ba/ bstan dgra thams cad

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 633thal ba'i rdul du rlog par byed cing / rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i bka' nyan gsung sdod par gyur/ rang nyid yi dam gyi thugs ka dang / khong rnams kyi gnas gsum nas 'od 'phros rang rang gi gnas nas sngon gyi dam tshig dbang gis spyan drangs par gyur// gsur chen gyi dud pa/ zhun chen gyi mar me/thod rnga/ rkang gling / rol mo'i sgra sogs mthun rdzas rnams 'tshogs pa'i sgo nas spyan 'dren par bya'o// shulha/ dge'o//ti/ dmacan sde dgu'i mdangasabaskang dregasapa tshar gcod bzhugasaso/dharma pā la na maḥ skye med dbyings las 'gag med shar// sna tshogs skur ston mthu stobs bdag / chos skyong gtso bo sde dgu yi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa ni// dur khrod gnas chen dben pa'i sar// bsnyen sgrub nya stong brgyad sogs dus// dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi'i steng // zhing chen khrag snas cha ga chag gdab// chos 'byung rtse brgyad thod pa'i khar//dmar nag me ri 'bar ba'i dbus// lcags sam bhadhar 'bru nag gi /dpal gtor sha khrag rgyan dgu'i rtser// dmar chen tsitta'i phreng ba la// bya nag mang po lding tshul dang // nya bo sha dum tshe nyungs dang // gtso 'khor rang rang sku 'bag gzugs// gzhan yang sman gtor rakta dang // dbang lnga'i me tog gsur chen spos// tshil chen mar me don snying lnga// khyad par sku gsung thugs rten dang // mthun ldan bskang ba dgyes pa'i rdzas// bsgrub la gsol kha'i gzhung ltar bshams// zhing lpags gdugs phub yol nag bres// rgyu mas lda ldi tsittas brgyan// shin tu 'jigs rngam skyi g.ya' zhing // 'byor ldan bag dro'i spyan gzigs dang // tshogs kyi longs spyod bzang bar bshams// rol

634 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thig mo'i tshogs sgra mchod pa'i sprin// bsam gyis mi khyab dngos 'byor dang //yid kyis sprul zhing bskang ba ni// rtsa ba gsum gyi bskang bshags rjes//rigs pa gzengs bstod 'di skad do// hūṃ mahā ka la gshegs su gsol//legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol// dam can chen po gshegs su gsol//nag po chen po gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas bstan srung gshegs su gsol//rnal 'byor dgra lha gshegs su gsol// rig 'dzin srung ma gshegs su gsol//bdud 'dul dmag dpon gshegs su gsol// chos skyong 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// bye ba sa ya dpung gi tshogs// ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon// sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig dang // byams gdung brtse bas gshegs su gsol// 'jigs pa'i gnas 'dir pad nyi zla// dgra bgegs bsgyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs// gus pas phyag mchod dgyes par bzhes// bstan srung mthu rtsal dngos grub bstsol// hūṃ bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang // chos skyong chen po'i thugs dam bskang // dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang // gnod sbyin chen po'i thugs dam bskang //zhang blon chen po'i thugs dam bskang // rdo rje bdud 'dul thugs dam bskang // dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dam bskang // e ka tsa ti'i /dza ṭī'i thugs dam bskang // re ma ti yi thugs dam bskang // gza' bdud rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang // mkha' 'gro gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang // gnod sbyin dmar nag thugs dam bskang // dam can chen po'i thugs dam bskang //srin po'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang // shan ting ro zan thugs dam bskang //srog bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang // sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs thugs dam bskang // dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang // yang sprul bye ba'i thugs dam bskang // hūṃ thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang // bzhugs
