༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 637ma mo'i thun zor 'phen pa bzlog / rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gtong ba bzlog /gza' yi ki gang 'bebs pa bzlog / btsan gyi gzer thabs gtong ba bzlog / sa bdag klu yi gtad khram bzlog / bdud kyi zhags khram btab pa bzlog / mu stegs gdug pa'i ngan sngags bzlog / bande'i hom thun zor 'phen bzlog / skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa bzlog / bud med dmod zor 'phen pa bzlog / byad kha phur kha zor kha bzlog / thun bzhi'i mi kha smra mchu bzlog / byol ka chag ka mya ngan bzlog / sbyor ngan rbad 'dre bod gtong bzlog / bsam ngan mi mthun gdug tsub bzlog / lo kug zla kug zhag gag bzlog / za kug bdun zur rbad 'dre bzlog / dgra sna gyod sna byur sna bzlog / nad sna rims sna yams sna bzlog / thog babs sho rtsis babs pa bzlog / dal babs bdud babs dgra chag bzlog / nad sri mtshon sri rbab sri bzlog / dgra sri god sri ngan sri bzlog / rgan sri gzhon sri dar sri bzlog /ltas ngan glo bur ye 'brog bzlog / gshed 'khor dus min 'chi ba bzlog /rkyen ngan gnod pa'i tshogs rnams kun// dgra bgegs 'byung po'i steng du bsgyur// bzlog cig bsgyur cig sa ma ya// zhes brjod mi mthun bar chad bzlog / dam bskang mchog thob phrin las rnams// thogs med sgrub byed bka' srung gi / mdangs bskang bla ma'i gsung gi rgyun// ma nor zur du bkod pas dge / bdud dang dgra las rgyal bar shog /thu/ g.yuthog snying thig masgrub kyi bka' srung sde dgu'i ma bstod bskul gsum spu gri dug ngar bzhugasaso/na maḥ sarba dharma pā la ye/ kun 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du//

638 ༄7g.yu thog snying thig dbang thob dam ldan bsnyen sgrub thengs// lta ba'i gdeng thob rnal 'byor la//chos skyong ma bsgrubs par yang 'khor// 'on kyang dam can sde dgu yi//gtor mchod bstod bskul mdor bsdus pa// bla ma'i gsung las legs 'ongs bri// dgyes bzhin bka' gnang stong grogs mdzod// dur khrod gnas chen dben gnas su// sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma'i tshogs// sman rag mchod rdzas spyan gzigs bsham// mthun rten bskang rdzas 'dzom par bsag / bdag nyid rtsa gsum las gzhung bsrang // de nas bka' srung mnyes bya'i phyir// oṃ brjod snod bcud stong par sbyangs// āḥbarjod thod pa stong gsum mnyam// hūṃ brjod de nas dgra bgegs kyi// sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba las// ngo bo zag med bdud rtsir brlab// gsur chen dud pa rol mo dang // gdung ba'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad du// kli hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs bka' srung spyan 'dren no// stobs ldan sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bhū dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas 'dir// sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i klong // bstan bshig ma rungs bsgral ba'i phyir// bka' srung 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya st+waṃ/ kli sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin// dus las mi 'da' dam nyams snying 'byin pa// dam can chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu ho/ hūṃ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i khrag rnams mtsho chen bskyil// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog gcal du bkram// gsur chen bdug spos dud pa sprin ltar gtibs// zhun chen snang gsal mar me nyi bas gsal// rdo rje dri chu byug pa'i rdzing bu mdzes// don snying sha rus zhal zas ri ltar srungs// thod rnga rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog / rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang med// sman raka (rag gtor tshogs spyan gzigs

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 639longs spyod rnams// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bde ba'i mchog / bka' srung drag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las myur du sgrubs// rang rang rtsa sngags sham bu ru// a nas shapta'i bar/ rū pa nas sa ma ye āḥrgyu gi bar/ mahā sarba pañtsa sogs kyis bdud rtsi/ mahā rakta sogs kyis rakta/ mahā ba li tas gtor ma dgra bo'i rma sa/ tsitta rakta/ ki ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha rtsu i rda gro ṇḍa swāhā/ sarba pū dza bo dhi tsitta ga ṇa gu hya ho/de nas khyad par gyi mchod pa ni// 'brub khung nang du ling ga ni// dgra bo dngos su gsal gdab la// dbyangs kyi nga ros 'di skad brjod// hūṃ dam nyams dgra bo las ngan ma rungs 'di'i// gzugs phung mchod par 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// phyi yi dbang po rnam lnga mchod par bzhes// nang gi don snying rnams lnga mchod par bzhes// gsang ba'i bla tshe srog dbugs mchod par bzhes// klad rus rkang dang khong khrag mchod par mnyes(bzhes / / ri rab skur bzhengs gnam sa'i zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gcigs glog dmar ljang rkyongs shig / stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus thob//'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstabs so kha ram̐ khā hi// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi//gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// ma gcig e ka dza ṭī'i zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// 'gres so// gza' bdud rā hu la yi zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// mkha' 'gro ce spyang mchu dmar zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi//gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// dam can srog gi spu gri'i zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes

640 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigasheg rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// srin po ro langs 'jigs byed zhal du stobs//rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// bdud mo ro zan nag mo'i zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// las mkhan hob se nag po'i zhal du stobs// rengs par bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hi// lo dang zla bar ma bzhag myur du sod// zhag dang za mar ma bzhag myur du sod//'go ba'i lha lnga skyob pa'i lha dang phrol// sa 'dre shi gshed gnod pa'i bdud dang sprod// dam nyams pha tshan nang dme shi 'dzings thongs// ngu 'bod gnam 'debs brang brdung byed du chug/ glo bur rims nad drag po char ltar phob// snying du sdug pa'i chung ma mal du sod// yid la gces pa'i bu chung pang nas phrogs// brtsigs pa'i mkhar shig bsags pa'i nor rdzas stor// btab pa'i lo la sad ser 'bu than thongs// za ba'i zas med mu ge'i bskal ba che//mdza' ba'i mnyen phrol yi mug ga chad phob// rlung mkhris bad kun 'du ba khong nas dkrugs// khong khrag thang la skyug cing 'chi ru chug/ smyo 'bog brgyal dang gag lhog mdze 'bras thongs// brgyad cu rtsa gcig ltas ngan char ltar phob// sum brgya drug cu'i ye 'brog dgra la thongs// bdun brgya nyi shu glo bur stabs nyes thongs// rnam brgyad dus min 'chi ba dam nyams sod//stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi pho brang thob// gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas myur du chod// sa yi brten phur 'og tu drud nas chod// kha rje bsod nams za thang mtha' nas bsdus// rgan rim sdong rgan 'gyel ltar g.yas nas sod//gzhon rim me tog skam ltar mas nas sod// dar sgang brag la thog bzhin btsan thabs sod// pho rgyud me la chu bzhin 'chi ru chug/ mo rabs rtswa la zor bzhin 'chi ru chug/ ban bon sgo nga brag la brdab bzhin 'chi ru chug/ shi rgab nags la me bzhin mched du chug/ gson rgab rtswa shing sungs lar 'phel ma 'jug / pha ma pha spun tsha zhang so sor sod// bu dang tsha bo yang tsha rigs

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 641brgyud (rgyud chod// bdun brgyud cod chod thal ba rlung la bskur// sngon gyi rgyal ba rigs 'dus bka' ma bcag / rigs rabs sngags 'chang dam ldan bstan pa srungs// da lta rigs (rig 'dzin bdag gi bka' ma bkral//thugs dam zhal bzhes gnyan po dran mdzod la// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces gdab/ de nas bstod cing bsnyen bsgrubs nas//'bod rbad bsad pa'i las kha bsgyur// bskul zhing dam la gnas par bya'o//gdung pa'i yid dang snyan pa'i dbyangs// rol mo bcas pas 'di skad bstod do//hūṃ chos kyi dbyings las 'gag med skur ston pa'i// rdo rje bdud 'dul gnod sbyin chen po'i sku// 'jigs rung mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid// nor bu gri gug thod khrag dgra snying bsnams// dar nag ber gsol mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// tsan dan bing (beng btsugs rta nag rting dkar bcibs// bstan pa gnyan srung bka' yi bya ra mdzad// chos skyong yongs kyi rje la phyag 'tshal bstod// bhyo ma gcig dpal ldan e ka tsa ti (dza ṭīkam//mthing nag rab khros spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs// khro mo'i chas rdzogs phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin// dre'u rta zhon zhing tshon dru nad rkyal btags// snyan g.yas seng chen g.yon pa sbrul nag 'phyo// spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan// me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong nas dgra bgegs sgrol// dam ldan bu bzhin skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ bstan srung khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la//dud kha rab khros sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil// dbu dgu gtsug na bya rog mgo yis brgyan// g.yas g.yo /g.yon sbrul zhags rwa yi mda' gzhu bsnams//mgo lus mig dang sprin zhon kun tu myul// sde brgyad bran khol mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bdag / dam ldan skyong zhing dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// dregs pa'i gtso bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// kli gnas dang yul gyi sha za mkha' 'gro'i

642 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigagatso// rab 'jigs dmar mo ce spyang mgo dgu ma// khrag ral sprugs pas stong gsum nad kyis 'gengs// gcer bu rgyan med nu ma thur du 'phyang //phyag bzhi dang po gri gug thod khrag gdengs// 'og gnyis dgra zor sbrul zhags mi mgo phyar// dur bya mgo dgu zhon nas dur khrod myul// dam nyams srog gcod gtso mor phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ gnod sbyin bshan dmar dam nyams srog gcod gtso// mtshal mdog stag gdong zangs gri dgra snying 'debs// rgyu ma za zhing snying phreng ga sha gyon// g.yu 'brug zhon nas skad cig stong khams bskor// rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med phyogs bcur 'gyed// nyin bzhin dregs pa pho rgyud bran du khol// mtshan bzhin mo rgyud thams cad dbang du sdud// bka' 'das gshed ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ bka' srung dam can srog gi spu gri ni// mthing nag rab khros 'jigs rung rngams (rngamanapa'i zhal// spyan dmar smin g.yo skra ser gyen du 'bar// lcags kyu spu gri dgra bo'i glo snying bsnams// dar nag ber gyon mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// seng ge zhon nas stong khams ma lus myul// sprul pa yang sprul dgra srog chu bzhin 'thung // bzlog med dgra dpung nag por phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ srin po'i rgyal po dgra 'dul 'jigs byed ni// dmar nag rab 'jigs khro gtum srin po'i zhal// mche ba brang sleb mi ro zhal tu gsol// spyi bor spyang gdong kha gdangs nga ro sgrog / ral gri rtse gsum rgyu zhags nam mkhar 'phyar// mi lpags gyon nas ro langs mgo dgu zhon// 'khor du keng rus gar byed rgod pas bskor// dam nyams cod gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ shan ti ro zan bdud mo bya rgod mgo/ dud mdog mche gtsigs khrag ral phyogs bcur sprug / mi sdug nu ma brang gi ngos la 'phyangs// gcer bu mi lpags snying phreng ga sha gyon// g.yas g.yon rgyu zhags dgra sta dgra snying 'phyar// spyang mo mgo dgu zhon nas stong gsum myul// skad cig re la dgra srog 'bum 'bum

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 643gcod// rnal 'byor srung ma'i gtso mo khyod la bstod// hūṃ rgyal ba'i bstan srung las mkhan dgra bo'i gshed// srog bdag hob ze ha la nag po'i mdog /rab 'jigs khro zhal gtsug nas khra mgo rgod// mche gtsigs dug rlangs nag pos dgra bo gsod// phyag bzhi dang po mdung dang dug rkyal bsnams// 'og ma phur bu dam nyams mgo rlon za// dred mo mgo dgu bcibs nas stong khams myul// rnal 'byor grogs mdzad dgra gshed phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ kun 'dus rgyal ba bla ma'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srog gi snying po phul// sgrub po'i sku dgra sgrol bar mna' phul ba// dam can bka' srung sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po dran mdzod la// rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa bzhes// bos pa'i dus su ma thogs myur du spyon// rbad tshe mngags pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs// zhes bstod/ de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni// rang nyid rtsa gsum skur gsal ba'i// bran du chos skyong sprin bzhin 'dus// gang 'dod phrin las sgrub bsams nas// sngags rnams dril nas bzlas par bya// grangs tshad 'bum phrag gsum yin no//thu/ byin rlabasabla sgrub lasadam can sde dgu'i sgrub thabasadrag po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dgra srog dmar 'byin bzhugasaso/oṃ mahā kā la kā ya wā ka tsitta ratna sirnyi na ma/ bka' srung dam can sde dgu yi// bsnyen pa sngon du rab rdzogs nas// sgrub dus dben pa'i gnas mchog tu// sku rten dar nag ma nyams la// gri khrag tshon sbyar rang rang gi /sku gzugs bris pa'i 'phyar dar ni// rab gnas mnga' gsol byas pa dgram//

644 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagasung rten thod rnga mi rkang dung // gsang ba'i rnga sogs rol mo bsags//thugs rten gri rgod bsad skyes dar ma gri khar song ba pa'i snying // rtsa gsum ma nyams nang nyid du// mthing shog dag la gser dngul gyis// srog sngags bris la gzhug byas nas// rgod sgro ma nyams bsgron pa'i mdar// dar nag gtums la gdags par bya// bla rdo pha wang long bu la// gser gyis hūṃ tri bris pa la//gser dngul zangs lcags mu tig g.yu// byu ru man shel mig med dang //gser gyi mo khab zangs lcags bcas skud byas// srog sngags bris pa'i dar rnams gtums// ga'ur bcug la ma bral bcangs// 'di yis mi 'bral grib ltar 'grogs// gzhan yang rta nag g.yag nag dang // khyi nag bya nag ra lug nag / gson po rten gzugs ma grub na// gsob dbul yang na bris kyang rung // smyug tshal dar snas rgyan pa gzugs// rtag gtor brten gtor thun gtor dang // mchod rdzas ci 'byor bsham par bya// de nas rang nyid las gzhung bsrang // mdun du dam can sde dgu po// rje la bran bzhin gsal bar bskyed// gus btud gdung sems ldan par bya'o// spyan 'dren mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya// rang nyid yi dam thugs ka nas// sngags phreng bung ba'i rnam pa can// grangs med sngags kyi dar dir sgrog / bka' srung rnams kyi sna nas zhugs// snying ga padma kha phye ba'i// srog gi dwangs ma'i sbrang rtsi 'jibs// slar yang thon nas tshur byung ste// rang gi thugs kur thim pa las// bka' srung rang srog dbang 'dus shing // ci bcol bran bzhin nyan par bsam rang rang srog sngags dril la bzlas// thun mtshams mchod gtor bstod la 'bad//dngos nyams rmi lam snang ba la// rab tu rang gzugs dngos su ston//'bring du mi nag rta nag dang // bya nag mang po lding tshul 'khor ba dang dang //bud med mang pos 'bod pa dang // bshan pa rdo mon a tsa ra// gcan gzan mang po 'du ba dang // de rnams rang la phyag 'tshal zhing // ci bgyi'i bka'

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 645sgrub smra ba 'byung // 'od dang thug chom tshag sgra 'ong // tha ma de rnams sna re tsam// res mthong res mi mthong ba 'byung // de tshe bsnyen sgrub bskyar la 'bad// rtags rnams rdzogs nas gtang rag gam// tshogs gtor btang zhing phyi nang gi / dam rdzas gzhan la mi bstan gsang // tshogs gtor bsnyen pa rgyun mi bcad// sngar 'gras mi la snying mi bsre// dam tshig nyams la gtam mi smra// ro dang mdze can yugs grib 'dzem// bya nag khyi nag brdeg gsod spang // zla re'i dgu gtor brtson par bya// de nas bla ma'i sku dgra sogs//bstan bshig zhing bcu bsgral ba'i phyir// drag po'i las las bsgral ba ni//phung shul sa las stegs bu ni// gru bzhi brkyang khru'i tshad kyi steng // gru gsum bskum khru dpangs mtho gang // kha la nyer gcig cong gis bskor// phyi nang ro sol gri khrag byug / de steng khri steng 'bru nag gi / dpal gtor sha khrag brgyan pa bsham// dgra bo'i zag rdzas dug sna dang // gri khrag bsres pa'i liṅga ni//dpral bar rus dang snying gar dṛ// brla la bla dwags 'doms su phaṭa// rkang 'og yo bri yan lag bzhi// dzaḥs baṃ hoḥ'i gzer gyis gdab// snying gar dṛ la dgra ming dang // srog sngags sgril mar dmod bcol bri// spyi bo nas bzung g.yas skor du// yig mgo nang bstan srog sngags dang // srog than gang 'os dmod bcol bri// rang gi kha rlangs dri ma dang // grib ma ma shor gzab par bya// de nyid khrus bya gu gul bdug / dgra bo'i ming brub khung bcug la phur bus mnan// ro g.yam kha bcud dkyil du bcug / yugs skus dṛ mig phug pa yi//skud sne steng gi phur par btod// sman rag gtor tshogs mchod par bsham//dkyil 'khor mdun du gtor chung re// rgyun mi 'chad (chad pa bshams nas kyang // nyin gsum mtshan gsum dus drug tu// 'bod 'gugs tshun chod nang du dbul// thun rgyab rbad dus phyi ru 'phang // lcags zangs phye ma dkar gong dang // yungs kur yungs nag sko tshe dug / khrag sna thang phrom thun rdzas

༄7/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 647bsad rmi zhing // shing bcad don snying za sogs rmi// de tshe srog las grub pa yin// than dang sbrel nas 'bod pa ni// gang btang than gyi sha khrag dang //phung shul sa bsres than gzugs bya// thun khung nang bcug rtsa sngags kyi//gsham du 'bod pa'i sngags 'di gdags// tsitta sa ma ya hro hro dza dzaḥzhes bzlas/ sgrub dus rmi lam cho 'phrul rnams// rang gi sgrub khang gnas su 'byung // de tshe gong gi sngags sham du// sa ma ya bhyo/ dgra bo'i yul du than dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs phob phob/ ces rbad thun brab cho 'phrul rnams//rang la zhi zhing dgra la 'byung // de nas than gzugs dgra yul bskyal//bskul btang zor 'phang liṅga mnan// bskang bshags tshe 'gugs srung 'khor bsgom// bsngo ba dmigs med rgyas gdab bya// bsad las la sogs gong du bstan zin to// de ltar byas pas dgra bo la// gri 'thab dme 'dzings thog rdib dang // lo nyes nad yams ltas ngan rnams// char rlung 'tshubs ltar 'byung bar nges// rtags rnams myur du 'byung dka' 'am// rbad bsad las rnams gang byed kyang // spu gri dug ngar gzhung bzhin du// thugs dam gnad nas bskul bar bya// des ni las kun thogs med 'grub// 'di ni g.yu thog snying thig gi / bka' srung dam can sde dgu yi// sgrub thabs las sbyor drag sngags te// gnam lcags thog rgod lta bu yis// bstan pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod shog / sa ma ya na ra kun/ zhes logs su bris pa yang 'dug go / dmar gtor bsngo zhing rakta sbreng // dar 'phyar dung 'bud gos nag gyon// gsur chen btang zhing rol mo sgrog / dang po gzu dang dpang yang gzugs// gdung ba'i nga ros 'di skad do// hūṃ kun mkhyen ye shes sgrib med spyan ldan pa'i// dkon mchog chos skyong gsan cing dgongs su gsol//bden brdzun shan 'byed legs nyes ltang (stangs 'dzin pa'i// dregs pa sde brgyad gsan cing dgongs su gsal/gsol / / dkar po'i chos skyong gnyug

648 ༄7g.yu thog snying thigamar gnas pa yi// yul lha gzhi bdag gsan cing dgongs su gsol// rang rang yul nas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas bzhes su gsol// gzu dang dpang mdzod bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod//bdag gis ma nyes zag med rnal 'byor pas// kun 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor cher bzhugs nas// 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sgrub pa la// dam nyams 'di yis sgrub tu ma ster ro// dkon mchog chos skyong 'di la dpang po mdzod// dam can bka' srung ma lus ra mda' sbran// 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs rnams las la chos/chas / / dam nyams las ngan bstan bshig dgra bo 'di// rang rang las la 'bebs pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces brjod/gser skyems gtor zhing bsngo/ de nas las la bskur ba'i phyir// gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer// oṃ ka dag klong bzhugs kun 'dus rgyal ba'i tshogs// āḥthugs rjes longs sprul gang 'dul skur bzhengs shig / hūm̐ thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo 'gro don mdzod// hrīḥdus la babs po log rtog dgra bgegs sgrol// kli bhyoḥdabus nas rdo rje bdud 'dul bzhengs//gnod sbyin kun gyi sde dpon bskul// rta nag rlung gshog myur du bskyod// gri gug 'bar bas dgra srog gcod// gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dgra la phob//steng gi mi rabs cod nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la babs po sa ma ya// kli bhyoḥshar nas e ka tsa ti /ṭīkabazhengs// ma mo kun gyi sde dpon bskul// dre'u rta rlung gshog myur du bskyod// nad rkyal dgra bo'i yul du phob// ma mo'i dmag dpung dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab po sa ma ya// hūṃ bhyoḥlho nas gza' bdud chen po bzhengs// sde brgyad kun gyi sde dpon bskul//sprin nag rlung gshog myur du bskyod// sbrul zhags dug mda' dgra la rgyob//gza' yi dmag dpung dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs cod nas chod// 'og

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 649gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab po sa ma ya// hūṃ bhyoḥnub nas ce spyang mchu dmar bzhengs// mkha' 'gro kun gyi sde dpon bskul// dur bya rlung gshog myur du bskyod// dgra zor rgyu zhags dgra la phob// mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs cod nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab po sa ma ya// hūṃ bhyoḥbyang nas gnod sbyin bshan dmar bzhengs// bshan pa kun gyi sde dpon bskul// g.yu 'brug rlung gshog myur du bskyod// zangs gri dgra bo'i snying la phob// bshan pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab po sa ma ya// skyu bhyoḥshar lho srog gi spu gri bzhengs// dam can kun gyi sde dpon bskul// seng ge rlung gshog myur du bskyod// spu gri dgra bo'i snying la rgyob// dam can dmag tshogs dgra la phob//steng gi mi rabs cod nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab po sa ma ya// hūṃ bhyo:lho nub dgra 'dul 'jigs byed bzhengs// srin po kun gyi sde dpon bskul// ro langs rlung gshog myur du bskyod// ral gri rtse gsum dgra snying chod// srin po'i dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs cod nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab po sa ma ya// hūṃ bhyoḥnub yang shān ti /ting ro zan bzhengs// bdud mo kun gyi sde dpon bzhengs// spyang ki rlung gshog myur du bskyod// dgra sta /stanargyu zhags dgra la rgyob// bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab po sa ma ya kli bhyoḥ'ajig rten mi bsrun dregs pa'i tshogs// dpal chen 'bar ba'i bka' byung gis// rang rang dmag dpung go mtshon thogs// thog rgod lta bur myur du rgyugs// gnod sbyin zhe sdang che ba'i tshogs// dam nyams yul mkhar thal bar rlog/ ma mo phrag dog che ba'i tshogs// nad rkyal dgra la char ltar phob//

650 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigagaza' bdud nga rgyal che ba'i tshogs// dug mda' sdang ba'i dgra la rgyob//mkha' 'gro phrag dog can gyi tshogs// mi rung sna tshogs dgra la phob// bshan pa srog la rngams pa'i tshogs// dam nyams srog dbugs da lta chod// dam can dam nyams gshed ma'i tshogs// snying khrag dron mo myur du 'thungs//srin po sha khrag dga' ba'i tshogs// dam nyams sha rus khrag la rol// bdud mo ro la za byed rnams// dam nyams zas su da zo zhig/ srog bdag khrag la skem byed rnams// dam nyams khrong (khong khrag da 'thungs shig/ sde brgyad dbugs la rngams pa rnams// dam nyams dbugs la da 'gams sheg / srung ma dam la gnas pa rnams// dam nyams phung bar da gyis shig / bka' srung bka' bzhin sgrub pa rnams// bka' 'das brlag par da gyis shig/ chos skyong chos mdzad skyong ba rnams// chos bsnubs dam nyams da sgrol cig/phyogs skyong bcu yi gzhi bdag rnams// phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs da sod cig/ bos so bos so snyan ma sra// bskul lo bskul lo bang ma bul// rbad do rbad do mthu ma chung // bsten no bsten no gzhung ma ngan// rgyugs shig rgyugs shig dmag tshogs rnams// thul cig thul cig dgra dang bgegs// sod cig sod cig dgra bo 'di// choms shig choms shig sdig chen 'di// zo zhig 'thungs shig sha dang khrag/ khyer cig gtor cig dgra bo'i nor// shig sgyel cig dgra bo'i khyim// bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog/ lo dang zla bar ma 'gyangs shig/ zhag dang za (ja mar ma 'gyangs shig/ dam nyams dgra bo 'khor bcas kyi// srung skyob dpung gnyen byed pa rnams// de nyid thal ba'i rdul du rlog/ srung ba'i gur khang da shig cig/ 'gro ba'i lha lnga bdud du phob//tshe srog mdangs la hub kyis thob// bsod nams za thang rlung la phyor// tshe srog da lta chod la shog/ gal te las 'di ma bsgrubs na// 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad kyi// srog rtsa bdag gi lag na yod// khyod nyid phung bar gdon

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 651mi za// de bas myur du las gyis shig/ ces brjod phud dang rakta sbreng // hūṃ dregs pa'i dmag tshogs nye re re// go mtshon ru mtshon zangs se zang // nam mkhar bya nag thibs se thib// sa gzhir khyi nag 'du ru ru// rlung nag 'tshub ma ci li li// bar snang me stag 'tshubs se 'tshub// sbrul nag zhags pa na ra ra// thun gyi ser ba sha ra ra// khrag gi char pa si li li// nad kyi na bun thibs se thib// thog gi bu yug chil li li// rgyob dang sod sgra di ri ri// dam nyams ngu 'bod lhangs se lhang // khrag gi rgya mtsho khol lo lo// sha yi ri bo zangs se zang // rus pa'i kram khrod khra la la// mi snyan nga ro tse re re// gcan gzan sna tshogs zhungs se zhung // ba dan nam mkhar phyar ra ra// mtshon rtsed dgra la ta la la// gnam lcags 'khor lo sgor ro ro// sha khrag gzan la rubs se rub// tshangs pa brgya byin yin gyur kyang // rdul phran bzhin du brlag nus na// dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos// bka' srung 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs// gum gum chum chum dam la 'dus// kun 'dus rgyal ba'i bstan bshig 'di// rengs par khug la myur du sod// las kyi gshin rjes khram la thob// 'chi bdag sgo brang brdung du chug/ dus la bab po sa ma ya//zhes brjod gtor ma dgra la 'phangs// g.yab mo brdab tsang 'o dod 'bod//dam nyams rdul du brlag par bsam// 'di ni bstan pa spyi don nas// srog la babs na bskul bya yi// dus min bskul na rang la 'khu// de ltar bka' srung las 'grigs 'di// mdor bsdus bla ma'i bka' bzhin bris// dge bas bstan dgra tshar gcod shog/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rlabs chen 'grub par shog/ sarba maṅga lam̐/ shu rghaṃ//de/ chosaskyong gi gsol gamyur mgyogasaglog gi 'od 'bar bzhugasaso/gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharmā pā la sa ma ya sirnyi hūṃ/ brgyud pa'i rtsa gsum bla

652 ༄༅g.yu thog snying thigam dang // chos skyong dam can sde dgu yi// gsol mchod phrin las mdor bsdus pa// bla ma'i gsung las legs 'ongs bri// dus skabs rdzas mchod phrin las te// nya stong dus bzhi bskang gso'i dus// phrin las tshogs 'khor gzhung bsrangs te// bsgral las bstabs pa tshar skabs su// dkon mchog bka' srung spyi sgos kyi// dam rdzas sman 'bru rin chen lnga// bdud rtsi tshogs dumadza gad kyi// sgos su gsang phyi sha khrag bshos// mkha' lding ra yi sha tshil khrag/ nya sha khrag rul klad mchod khrag/ nal snying nya bo sha khrag snying // rtsi sman sha tshil sna tshogs bsags// bka' srung rang rang mnyes rdzas te// phyi mchod rin chen snod blugs brlabs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rtsa gsum mchod//ho sangs rgyas mnga' bdag ston pa dam chos bzhi// 'dren pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di// gsol lo mchod do byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// ho kun bzang rgyal ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// pad 'byung gu ṇa dbyer med rdo rje 'dzin// byin rlabs char 'bebs rtsa rgyud bla ma la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di// gsol lo mchod do dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// ho rigs lnga yab yum rta phag mkha' 'gro bzhi// lha dang drang srong ye shes sman mo sogs// yi dam dkyil 'khor rgyal ba kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di// gsol lo mchod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol// srung ma sgos mchod rang rang gi dam rdzas tshogs mchod 'bul/ hūṃ gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul te// mgon po chos skyong pho rgyud kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes tshogs mchod bshos gtsang sha khrag gas//gsol lo mchod do bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// hūṃ ma gcig dpal ldan e ka dza ṭī ma// nag mo sngags srung mo rgyud kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes zhal zas tshogs mchod mkha' lding gis// gsol lo mchod do dal yams dgra la

༄༅/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 653phob// hūṃ dam can chen po srog gi spu gri ste// dam nyams gshed ma dam can kun 'dus la// dgyes mchod ra yi sha khrag zhal zas mchog/ gsol lo mchod do ltas ngan dgra la phob// hūṃ bstan srung khyab 'jug chen po la sogs te// gza' gdong sde brgyad rgyu skar ma lus la// dgyes mnyes tshogs mchod sha khrag rus la sogs// gsol lo mchod do ki kai dgra la phob// hūṃ dgra dur 'jigs byed dam can srog gcod gtso// keng rus 'bum bskor srin po kun 'dus la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur klad mchin sha khrag tshogs// gsol lo mchod do dam nyams yul mkhar cham// hūṃ ce spyang mchu dmar mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso// gnas yul dur khrod sha za ma lus la// dgyes pa'i mchog gyur zhal zas ma lus 'di// gsol lo mchod do ma rungs dgra la bhyo// hūṃ shānti nag mo ro zan ded dpon ni// bya rgod mgo can bdud mo kun 'dus ma//dgyes mchod dam nyams gzugs phung sha khrag tshogs// gsol lo mchod do dgra bgegs nyam thag chod// hūṃ bshan pa dmar nag dgra bo'i gshed ma ste//sprul pu 'bum 'gyed gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la// dgyes rab mchog gyur tshogs mchod sha khrag snying // gsol lo mchod do bka' 'das rdul du rlog/hūṃ hob se las mkhan chen po srog gi bdag/ phrag la skye mched srog bdag kun 'dus ma// dgyes mchod rtsi sman sha tshil khrag sna tshogs// gsol lo mchod do dam nyams khong khrag 'thung // ho gzhan yang dam can lha srin sde brgyad tshogs// grangs med stong khams khyab rgyug rtsal ldan la// dgyes mnyes mchog gyur sha khrag tshogs mchod 'bul// gsol lo mchod do rnal 'byor stong grogs mdzod// ho yul 'di'i mnga' bdag gnyen po la sogs te// bod khams brtan ma yul lha dge bsnyen la// dgyes rab mchog gyur mnyes rab dam pa'i phur// gsol lo mchod do mi mthun bar chad sol// zhes brjod 'phrin las 'di ltar gzhol// ho chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed

654 ༄༅/g.yu thog snying thigarnams la de ltar bskang zhing gsol lo mchod do// bsngo'o// mgron no// su la mi re khyed rnams la re/ su la mi mchod khyed rnams la mchod/ su la mi bstod khyed rnams la bstod/ dpa' dang ha byed rnams 'phrar ro /dar du khyed rnams 'phyar ro / / phrag pa la khyed rnams khur ro// sdong /sdang ba'i dgra la mthu ma chung // gnod pa'i bgegs la rtsal ma zhan// yul du 'khor srungs shig/ byes su rkyen bzlog cig/ nyin gyi bya ra mdzod cig mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod cig mthu dpung stong grogs mdzod cig byad kha phur kha bzlog ciga'abod dus snyan ma sra/ g.yab dus spyan ma rtul/ bskul dus bang ma bul/rbad dus mthu ma chung / legs dang skyod (spyod la nyes dang bsnol cigasngon gyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sman raka ltaraganagator ma'i mchod pa dang / zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod/ dza gad phud kyi mnyes rdzas rgya chen po bzhes la/ bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig nad pa dang sri'u yod na/ nad pa mal nas slongs/ sri'u tshang nas thon/ ces gang dgos 'dod don gsol lo//gsol ka 'di la rab brtson na// chos skyong mi 'bral grib ltar 'grogs//nad pa'i don kun thogs med 'grub// bstan pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod 'gyur// smi/ /no/ g.yuthog snying thig bsgrub kyi dam can sde dgu'i sngagasabyang srog gi thig le bzhugasaso/oṃ mahā kā la yakṣa badzra tsitta kli phaṭa ratna sidhi hūm̐/ zhang blon srog sngags so// oṃ e ka dza ti ma ma tu baṃ hūṃ bhyo/ lha mo'o// oṃ ke ta ke ta swāhā/ rā hu la sa ma ya kli/ khyab 'jug go/ ḍā ki ni tsitta rakta sa ma ya hring hring dzaḥ mkha'

༄za/sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od/ 655'gro ce spyang mchu dmar gyi'o// yakṣa tsitta mahwa tsitta mahā rū tā mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/bshan dmar gyi'o// badzra sādha sa ma ya a mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dam can gyi'o// rakṣa rakṣa rā dza sa ma ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thum dza/ srin po'i 'o//durnyi tsitta kā la dgra bo thum ril mā ra ya rbad/ bdud mo ro zan gyi'o// tri shaṃ rbad bhuo king ka ra dgra bo'i srog la hab tab/ las mkhan gyi'o// dam can sde dgu'i srog sngags 'di nyid/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum dang / gtor ma 'bul ba dang / dbang bskur ba la sogs gang byed kyang / kha bsgyur gyi gnad shes par bya ste/ shin tu gsang / 'bod dus sngags sham du dzaḥdzaḥrbad dus bhyo bhyo/ bsad dus dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gtor ma 'bul dus ba sla ta khā hi/ dbang bskur dus la abhi ṣiñtsa gdags pa zhal gdams pa'o// shulha/oṃ su sti/ phyag na padmo thub bstan rgya mtsho yi// thugs bskyed mtha' bral kun gsal yangs pa'i klong // gang 'dul 'phrin las nyin byed 'od snang gis// bstan 'gro phan bde'i padmo ci yang 'dzum// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu thog pa'i// rmad byung rdo rje'i gsang tshig snying gi thig/ 'jam mgon mi yi rnam rol 'khor los sgyur// khri srong gnyis pa de mo rgyal bas bskrun// grangs med tshogs pa'i bsod nams chu gter rum// spangs rtogs rin chen gdengs ka dbyings su bteg/ bshad sgrub dgos 'dod nor bu'i 'byung gnas che// sku gsum klu yi dbang po thob phyir bsngo//zhes rje btsun mahā ku ṇa'i thugs kyi ti la ka g.yu thog snying thig tu grags pa 'di nyid da phan ljongs 'dir par du ma 'khor par brten/ rab tshes sa byi lor gzhung sa mchog nas par gzhi gsar bskrun mdzad skabs smon tshig tu chos kyi seng gis spel ba dge// //

656༄// g.yu thog snying thig gi rdzogs rim nye brgyud gsol 'debs bzhugs so//rigs 'dus rdo rje 'chang dang g.yu thog mgon// mañdzu sgo ṣa rin chen rnam rgyal dang // rtsa ba'i bla ma chos kyi seng ge la// gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol// lus la bde drod 'bar ba byin gyis rlobs// ngag la nus pa 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// sems la rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yi dpa' bo dang // mkha' 'gro ma rnams rang dbang mngon gyur te// phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol//zhes pa 'di'ang rgyal dbang phyag na padmo'i bla'i sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho nas zab lam 'di nyid kyi rdzogs rim nod skabs 'di ltar dgos zhes bskul ngor chos seng pas so// //

ca 657༄7// dam chos sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyi cha lag ku su lu'i tshogs gsog bzhugs so//phaṭaḥ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du rdzogs sangs rgyas// thob phyir de la bral ba'i dbyings rig bsre// rig pa khros ma'i skur gyur thod pa bregs//mi gnas skye med blo 'das bharnya'i snod// 'gyur med sku gsum skyed khar ye shes kyi// bhadhar bdud rtsi 'bru gsum yi ge gsum// sbyangs bsgyur spel ba mkha' 'gro grangs med kyis// thogs te dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams la//phul bas byin brlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mgon po yon tan mchod cing bar chad sel// rigs drug ci 'dod sbyin par gnod sems zhi//lan chags gdon bgegs la sbyin bu lon 'khor// khas zhan dbang chung lhag mgron ngom zhing tshim// mchod dang mchod pa mchod pa'i mkhan po med//dmigs med spros bral shes rab pha rol phyin// ma 'gags rol ba'i dge tshogs sgyu ma'i 'khrul// bla med thob phyir khams gsum yongs la bsngo// 'gro rnams rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog/cesapa 'di'ang dam chos sdug bsngal mun sel gyi sngon 'gro'i cha lag tu rgyal dbang phyag na padmo'i bla'i sman pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ngor rmongs rgan chos kyi seng gis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba marga lam̐/par 'di lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling du bzhugs// //

nām mi 'tshan 'khur pa/ sgring rnyisazlo bkra shes/ ༄kha thog nga gaḥm/ga g.yu/ga/ dzño mchin tan pagon po gas/per sgrimadabe mkhan/ trī rji /mi63 /kha spyan/'a daphyogasabagasad logag gsapa/'gremasardzomakhan/ mirigasadape smin khang gi bod yig rtsom sgrig khang /pecistobakopaskul/ na nga byang lam yang 4pa/zagadarang grangaska ma 3kha parasna gā'i/ dri/(12413parades0yodakungasipara'a'i//swā / yo da shāso//zhi pe tsho /brgyad0 mkhan/ rgyal ngas saganas na hwa da nga khang /ba mā/ 850445 68—— 732parabastana'itsā ga4 26〉〉 gi posmripar the ngas/287lo'i zla parapa/ga dngathe bags/pozlo1 grarjisna/ ཿ7—2 stu par na du par ngas dang brgyab/rin gong sgor 3450
